Daarbij zetten wij onder andere in op versnelling van het vaccinatietraject en verdere versterking van de bioveiligheid met een verplicht bioveiligheidsplan voor alle pluimveebedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over de vondst van plastic in veevoer, melk en vlees

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked the ministers about microplastics found in feed, milk, meat and blood, the health risks, the 0.15% action limit for packaging residues in feed, and enforcement. The minister answered that health risks are not expected but cannot be fully excluded, that research funding is provided, and that the Dutch policy already complies with EU rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het milieuzorgsysteem van Tata Steel

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the State Secretary about Tata Steel's environmental management system (ISO 14001), including whether its documents, coke oven plant 2 emissions and benchmarks can be disclosed and verified. The State Secretary answered that the system is not a single shareable document, that the matter is partly under court review and that the regional environmental service and certifier hold the relevant oversight, declining to provide documents or confirm several points.
Given my own role and position, as stated in the introduction, I also have no legal powers to demand – insofar as that is even possible – the relevant parts of the environmental management system.

Gelet op mijn eigen rol en positie, zoals aangegeven in de inleiding, heb ook geen wettelijke bevoegdheden om – voor zover dat überhaupt kan – de relevante delen uit het milieuzorgsysteem te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Esch over gezondheidsrisico’s door PFAS in de omgeving van Chemours

An MP asked the state secretary about PFAS health risks around the Chemours plant in Dordrecht, including breast milk exposure, vegetable gardens, permit decisions and a Europe-wide ban. The government disputed the breast-milk conclusion, largely followed RIVM advice on gardens, and pointed to permit competence of the province and Rijkswaterstaat and to an EU-level restriction planned for 2023.
Furthermore, the RIVM has been asked to develop a programme to investigate various exposure routes in the Netherlands and map out options for action.
Verder is aan het RIVM gevraagd een programma uit te werken om verschillende blootstellingsroutes in Nederland te onderzoeken en handelingsperspectieven in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht Zorgen over populariteit houtstook door oplopen gasprijzen: Help met isoleren van huizen

MP Van Esch asked the state secretary whether rising gas prices driving up wood-burning and whether the government would act to prevent worsened air quality and health harm from wood stoves this autumn and winter. The state secretary acknowledged the rise in wood burning, pointed to measures with municipalities such as stove alerts, a routewijzer and pilots, but declined to commit to a stricter 2030 reduction target and said further measures would be reported by the end of the year.
Regarding the further process on additional wood-burning measures, I will inform you further before the end of this year.
Over het verdere proces omtrent aanvullende maatregelen houtstook zal ik u nader informeren voor het einde van dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Omtzigt over een laag tarief op verse groente en fruit, dat al in een aantal EU-lidstaten wordt toegepast en dus ook in Nederland mogelijk zou moeten zijn.

MPs Van Esch and Omtzigt asked why the Netherlands cannot apply a reduced VAT rate on fresh fruit and vegetables as Italy, Latvia and Spain do. The government answered that it is studying the legal and practical delimitation with SEO, expects results in early 2023, and that a zero rate could take effect on 1 January 2024 at the earliest.
The cabinet emphasises that it is wise to await the conclusions of this study before proceeding to any introduction of a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables.
Het kabinet benadrukt dat het verstandig is om de conclusies van dit onderzoek af te wachten voordat tot eventuele invoering van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit wordt overgegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over eendenslachterij Tomassen Duck-To, die al zes jaar miljoenen dieren per jaar slacht zonder geldige vergunning en zonder dat hiertegen wordt opgetreden

MPs Vestering and van Esch ask why the Tomassen Duck-To duck slaughterhouse in Ermelo has operated for six years allegedly without a valid permit and without enforcement, and why three environmental services have not acted. The state secretary answers that Gelderland granted a permit in May 2022, that the municipality and environmental services are enforcing (including a Raad van State ruling on a penalty), and that the Van Aartsen recommendations on VTH enforcement are being implemented via the IBP VTH, though he rejects national supervision of environmental services.
I believe the VTH system must be strengthened as soon as possible.
Ik vind dat het VTH-stelsel zo spoedig mogelijk moet worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Van Esch en Vestering over de mogelijke bouw van huizen ten kosten van waardevolle natuur op Bonaire

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether housing construction on Plantage Bolivia on Bonaire, a valuable nature area, can be prevented and how the zoning plan and intent agreement are handled. The minister answered that the island authority is responsible for the zoning plan, that the current zoning protects the area, and that the national government will review any draft plan and can issue a reactive direction if needed.
Once the (draft) plan has been released, it will be assessed by the national government and a response will be given.
Nadat het (voor)ontwerp is vrijgegeven, zal dit door het Rijk worden beoordeeld en zal daarop worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat autofabrikanten alleen nog grote auto’s willen bouwen

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked whether car manufacturers are only building large, heavy cars and whether this conflicts with space, energy, circularity and emissions goals. The State Secretary disagreed with the framing, argued electric cars are more efficient despite their weight, pointed to innovation in batteries and to policies promoting cycling, public transport and shared mobility.
I recognise the picture. Cars have become heavier for several reasons.
Ik herken het beeld. Auto's zijn om verschillende redenen zwaarder geworden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het inzamelpercentage van kleine plastic flesjes

MP Van Esch asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management for the collection rate of small plastic bottles, which the sector was to report after 1 August 2022, and whether the 90% legal target will be met and what consequences follow if not. The State Secretary answers that the sector's 2021 report predates the legal 90% minimum (applicable from 2022), that the first report on it arrives in 2023, that he holds the sector to the target for all plastic bottles without separate small-bottle reporting, and that non-compliance could lead to enforcement by the ILT.
It is up to the packaging industry to achieve the legally set collection rate.
Het is aan het verpakkende bedrijfsleven om het wettelijk vastgestelde inzamelpercentage te behalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de vergunningverlening aan Chogogo Resort

MP Van Esch asked the ministers about the permitting of Chogogo Dive & Beach Resort on Bonaire, including whether conditions on a seawall were met, the enforcement memo, a fine for unpermitted sand dumping, and oversight of nearby developments. The Staatssecretaris answered that the authority believes the seawall conditions are met and is legalising the existing wall, that the enforcement memo and related documents will be shared, and that enforcement and VTH capacity on Bonaire will be strengthened with a monitoring plan and checks and balances.
I am willing to share all information with the House and am also willing to have it assessed by experts if necessary.
Ik ben bereid om alle informatie met de Kamer te delen en ben ook bereid deze zonodig te laten beoordelen door experts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Nieuwe milieunormen voor Tata laten op zich wachten door Europese stroperigheid’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether the EU process for setting best available techniques (BBT/BREF) for steel plants like Tata Steel is objective, whether environmental norms are outdated, and what the government will do about pollution around Tata Steel IJmond. The state secretary replied that the process is sufficiently objective, that the government will push in the Industrial Emissions Directive revision for faster BREF updates and an end date for outdated-installation exemptions, and that a National Environmental Programme on the right to a clean environment is being developed.
I agree that the process for drafting the BREF reference document and the associated BAT conclusions should proceed as objectively as possible.

Ik ben het met u eens dat het proces voor het opstellen van het Referentiedocument voor de Beste Beschikbare Technieken (BREF) en de daarbij behorende conclusies over de Beste Beschikbare Technieken (BBT-conclusies) zo objectief als mogelijk moet verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de problematische renovatie van het Rijkswaterstaatkantoor in Utrecht

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked about defects in the renovation of the Rijkswaterstaat office in Utrecht, including broken windows, a leaking pond, total costs and who bore responsibility. The minister answered that the windows posed no safety risk, that costs were around 8.2 million euro after updated figures, and that the Chamber was informed through the regular process, while declining to itemise costs per defect due to confidential contractor repair costs.
The repair costs incurred by the building consortium are not public in accordance with the WOB decision reference 4279186 dated 4 April 2022 concerning the Westraven government office.
De herstelkosten die de bouwcombinatie heeft gemaakt, zijn niet openbaar conform het WOB besluit kenmerk 4279186 d.d. 4 april 2022 inzake het rijkskantoor Westraven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over ziekmakende cabinelucht in vliegtuigen

MP Van Esch asks the ministers whether toxic cabin air in aircraft is making crew ill, whether standards, sensors, bleed-air bans, Arbeidsinspectie action, and monitoring of occupational diseases are adequate, and questions the independence of the FACTS research. The ministers reply that the cause of the complaints is still unclear, that the NAC advises on the issue, that standards and follow-up research are underway with Dutch participation, and that the Arbeidsinspectie sees no current reason to intervene, while committing to no new concrete measures.
According to the NAC, the cause of the complaints is not clear.
De oorzaak van de klachten is volgens de NAC niet duidelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Esch en Vestering over de recreatieve plannen bij het Henschotermeer

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked whether a YMCA complex relocating to the Henschotermeer area, within the Natuurnetwerk Nederland, conflicts with nature protection rules, including land use, species protection and a planned climbing forest. The minister confirmed the relocation is in process via a zoning plan revision, said compensation and ecological assessments are still being worked out, and that the municipality and province will assess the plan.
It is known that YMCA is developing plans to relocate to a site near the Henschotermeer. The zoning plan must however be amended for this.
Het is bekend dat YMCA plannen ontwikkelt om te verhuizen naar een locatie nabij het Henschotermeer. Daarvoor moet wel het bestemmingsplan worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het gebrek aan vegetarische en veganistische maaltijden in zorginstellingen

An MP asks the state secretary about the lack of vegetarian and vegan meals in care institutions, citing a petition and hospital nutrition figures, and whether extra steps and agreements will follow. The state secretary says hospitals are improving, that extra steps are not considered necessary now because food offerings are the responsibility of the institutions themselves, and that the concern is passed on to the Goede Zorg Proef Je project.
Food offerings are part of the quality of care and fall under the responsibility of the care institution itself.
Het voedingsaanbod is onderdeel van de kwaliteit van zorg en valt onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorginstelling zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de naar schatting 400.000 mensen die al jarenlang in de stank van de vee-industrie wonen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary about residents living in livestock odour, the failure of innovative stable technologies, court rulings annulling expansion permits, and whether animal numbers should be limited. The government answers that it is revising odour rules and commissioning research into low-emission stable management, but refuses to discuss animal numbers, which it says fall under another ministry's responsibility.

I am responsible for setting emission standards for ammonia and particulate matter from stables, odour policy for livestock farming and air quality standards. It is not about animal numbers but about emissions to the environment.

Ik ben verantwoordelijk voor de vaststelling van emissienormen voor ammoniak en fijnstof uit stallen, het geurbeleid voor de veehouderij en voor luchtkwaliteitsnormen. Het gaat daarbij niet om dierenaantallen maar om de emissies naar de omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht 'Duizenden cosmeticaproducten bevatten microplastics'

MP Van Esch asked the State Secretary about reports that many cosmetics contain intentionally added microplastics, their health effects, and whether the Netherlands would push for a broad EU restriction and stricter national rules. The government answered that more health research is underway, that it expects an EU Commission proposal on restricting intentionally added microplastics, and that it prefers EU-level regulation over unilateral national phase-out.
I therefore consider it important to pursue ambitious European regulation to limit and prevent microplastics that are intentionally added to products.
Ik vind het daarom belangrijk om in te zetten op ambitieuze Europese regelgeving voor het beperken en voorkomen van microplastics die bewust worden toegevoegd aan producten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de ‘ongekende droogte’

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the government about the 2022 drought, groundwater abstraction, illegal wells, enforcement, the water tax and compensation claims. The minister answered most questions substantively, pointing to existing measures, a ongoing review of the water tax, and declining to judge a pending collective claim.
I therefore refrain from giving a judgment on that.
Ik onthoud mij daarom van een oordeel daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het achterhouden van informatie in de granulietzaak en het toevoegen van bodemvreemd materiaal aan Granuliet

An MP asks whether the ministry withheld granulite-case information from the municipality West Maas en Waal, whether bodemvreemd flocculant added to granulite complies with soil quality rules, and whether the government will await further research. The state secretary admits the municipality was not properly informed, promises regular official consultation every six weeks, refuses a new study, and maintains that granulite is classed as soil and poses no harm.

In a telephone consultation on 7 April 2022 between alderman Ans Mol and the director-general of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management, apologies were offered for this and the agreement was reconfirmed that the municipality will be kept informed on developments in the granulite file.

In een telefonisch overleg op 7 april 2022 – tussen de wethouder Ans Mol en de dgWB van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat – zijn hiervoor excuses aangeboden en is de afspraak herbevestigd dat de gemeente blijvend zal worden geïnformeerd over de ontwikkelingen in het granuliet-dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over het bericht 'Demonstratie tegen 'verpretparking' Henschotermeer: 'Willen duidelijk signaal afgeven''

MPs Van Esch and Wassenberg asked whether recreation plans at the Henschotermeer would erode protected nature and landscape, and whether the government would intervene. The minister replied that the plans do not touch the Natuurnetwerk Nederland, that no concrete initiatives have yet been submitted, that the province will test any plans under nature law, and that the government will not urge the municipalities or province to block them.
As stated in the answer to question 3, these recreation developments will not convert any hectares within the boundary of the Natuurnetwerk Nederland into recreation land.
Er worden, zoals gemeld in het antwoord op vraag 3, als gevolg van deze recreatieontwikkelingen geen hectares binnen de begrenzing van het Natuurnetwerk Nederland omgevormd naar recreatiegebied.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Westerveld over het zo snel mogelijk naar het nultarief brengen van de btw op groente en fruit vanwege steeds duurdere boodschappen

MPs Van Esch and Westerveld asked why the VAT on fruit and vegetables cannot be cut to zero sooner, given rising grocery prices, and whether this could happen by 1 July 2022. The government answers that defining unprocessed produce raises complexity and fiscal-neutrality issues, so it cannot be done by 1 July 2022, and promises a plan of action with a study to the House by summer.
It is therefore not possible to arrange this by 1 July 2022.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om dit voor 1 juli 2022 te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Grondeigenaren moeten opdraaien voor drugsafval op hun terrein’

MPs Bikker and Van Esch asked whether landowners stuck with costs of large-scale drug waste dumping (exceeding the 25,000 euro subsidy cap) should be protected, and about subsidy adequacy and underspending. The minister answered that the Rijk has no statutory duty but co-funds costs via a regulation, that talks with IPO, BIJ12 and Noord-Brabant are ongoing, and promised to inform parliament before summer.
I will inform your House, on behalf of the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, before the summer about the state of affairs.
Ik zal uw Kamer, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat, voor de zomer informeren over de stand van zaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Hagen over het stimuleren van het gebruik van wasbare luiers en incontinentiematerialen

MPs Van Esch and Hagen asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about municipal and national handling of disposable versus washable nappies and incontinence products, including recycling, collection bins, VAT, insurance coverage and chemical content. The State Secretary answered at length, acknowledging limited recycling capacity and fragmented responsibility, but largely deferred to municipalities, care institutions, insurers and EU rules, and committed only to examining instruments and to pleading for EU labelling changes.
I am currently examining which instruments can be deployed to make the nappy chain more closed.
Momenteel bezie ik welke instrumenten ingezet kunnen worden om de luierketen meer sluitend te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg  vragen over het bericht in de Gelderlander ‘Slib storten in diepe plas zorgt niet altijd voor betere natuur’

MPs Van Esch and Wassenberg asked whether a study showing deep floodplain lakes are ecologically better than assumed, and that shallowing gives little ecological gain, should halt shallowing projects, and how permits are handled. The State Secretary responded that a policy reaction will follow before summer, that compliant ongoing shallowings cannot simply be stopped, and that competent authorities will be asked to consider the new findings for new initiatives.
Ongoing shallowings that meet all legal requirements cannot simply be stopped.
Lopende verondiepingen die aan alle wettelijke eisen voldoen kunnen niet zomaar worden stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Bikker over het niet opruimen van drugsafval

MPs Van Esch and Bikker asked why a large drug-waste dump in the Brabantse Wal nature area, found in March 2021, remains unremediated, and about health risks, cost recovery from the landowner, and dump statistics. The State Secretary answered that the province of Noord-Brabant is the competent authority, that partial clean-up has occurred, that remaining remediation is complex and under investigation, and that the Interior and Justice ministries are discussing whether the 25,000 euro compensation cap should be raised.
Removing the waste is a responsibility of local and regional governments; I have no insight into that.
Het opruimen van het afval is een verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale en regionale overheden, daar heb ik geen zicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over zwerfkapjes

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management, jointly with the Minister for Health, about face masks as litter, their share of litter, the reuse and recycling options, and the advice to wear medical masks. The government acknowledged the problem, reported that masks make up about 2 percent of litter in 2021, and said it prefers prevention and communication over an import levy, while answering most questions on substance and promising a sustainability study and SBIR competitions.
The Ministry of Health is going to talk with stakeholders (users, industry, inspectorate) to see which measures are possible to limit the waste mountain.
Het Ministerie van VWS gaat met veldpartijen (gebruikers, industrie, inspectie) in gesprek om te kijken welke maatregelen er mogelijk zijn om de afvalberg te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de zorgwekkende frisdrankconsumptie van jongeren

An MP asked the state secretary for health about youth soft-drink consumption, the need for national research, school measures, Nutri-Score, sugar tax and advertising limits. The state secretary answered that existing RIVM surveys suffice, outlined school and product-reformulation measures, and promised further measures and a sugar drinks tax in the Belastingplan 2023.
I hope to inform the House before the summer about the additional measures.
Ik hoop uw Kamer voor de zomer te informeren over de aanvullende maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Na jaar vertraging levert Schiphol onvolledige data over gifstoffen’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked about reports that Schiphol delivered late and incomplete data on emissions of carcinogenic substances, and whether the Omgevingsdienst NZKG should enforce before assessing the report and how citizens are protected. The minister replies that the reported emissions concern only 0.1% of Schiphol's total ZZS emissions under the environmental permit, that the regulator granted two extensions and gave Schiphol two months for supplementary data, that enforcement is not ruled out but no sanctions yet, and that the government will examine in the first half of 2022 whether aviation ZZS emissions require reduction.
Therefore I will examine in the first half of this year whether emissions of ZZS from aviation affect the surroundings of airports to such an extent that these emissions must be reduced.
Daarom zal ik nog in de eerste helft van dit jaar bezien of de uitstoot van ZZS door de luchtvaart, de omgeving van luchthavens dusdanig negatief beïnvloedt, dat die uitstoot moet verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de verwachting dat de productie van plastic rond 2040 zal zijn verdubbeld en het plastic afval in de oceaan tegen 2050 is verviervoudigd

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a WWF report on plastic pollution in oceans, microplastic health risks, bans on single-use plastics, extended producer responsibility, a possible plastic tax and a binding UN treaty. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing and planned measures (bans, deposit schemes, producer responsibility for litter, research funding, a study on a polymer tax) and said a binding UN plastics treaty negotiation will start in 2022.
I share WWF's concerns about plastic in the environment; it does not belong there.
Ik deel de zorgen van het WWF over plastic in het milieu, daar hoort het niet thuis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de bescherming van het koraal tegen de zandstorting van het Chogogo Dive and Beach Resort op Bonaire

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked ministers about a sand dumping project by Chogogo resort on Bonaire that allegedly lacked a permit and damaged coral, including a verbal tolerance decision and an unpaid penalty. The government answered that a natural permit was belatedly granted in January 2022 with conditions, that the island authority is responsible for enforcement and collecting the penalty, and that enforcement programmes will be strengthened, though impacts on coral are still unknown.
The public body is responsible for this.
Het openbaar lichaam is hiervoor verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Luchtvaartonderzoek houdt vliegherrie buiten beeld, waarschuwt GGD’

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked why the aviation cost-benefit guidance (MKBA werkwijzer) treats aircraft noise in ways that allegedly favour the aviation sector and diverge from WHO noise guidelines, and whether this undermines trust of residents. The minister replied that the guidance is an adequate first version, that noise valuation will be improved through a research agenda, that the ministry did not influence the noise norms, and that no 'rekentrucs' (calculation tricks) occurred.
It is indeed important that noise nuisance is taken into account properly in cost-benefit analyses.
Het is inderdaad van belang dat geluidhinder op goede wijze wordt meegenomen in MKBA's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de dreigende situatie rond vogelgriep onder in het wild levende zoogdieren en de risico’s voor mensen

An MP asks the Health Minister about avian influenza spreading among wild mammals such as foxes and stoats, the lack of counts and monitoring, mutation risk to humans, testing and carcass removal, and calls for a hunting ban. The minister answers that monitoring and the zoonosis structure are adequate, that a national hunting ban is disproportionate, and that signage and carcass removal are local responsibilities.
I recognise the importance of monitoring mammals that are (possibly) infected with HPAI in order to keep track of the spread of the virus in wild mammals
Ik onderken het belang van monitoring van zoogdieren die (mogelijk) besmet zijn met HPAI om zicht te houden op verspreiding van het virus in wilde zoogdieren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de plannen voor het hyperscale datacenter van Facebookmoederbedrijf Meta in Zeewolde en andere datacenters

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch (PvdD) asked about Meta's hyperscale data centre plans in Zeewolde, the sale of state land, energy and water use, and grid tariffs. The minister answered that the state conditions the land sale on energy and water standards, and that the government will tighten national steering and licensing criteria for hyperscale data centres.
The cabinet will tighten the choices in the NOVI regarding data centres.
Het kabinet zal de keuzes in de NOVI over datacenters aanscherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de Zembla uitzending over de uitstoot van giftige stoffen op Schiphol

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked the government about the Zembla broadcast on toxic emissions at Schiphol and the health risks for platform workers, including accountability, Arbowet compliance, and liability. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to sector-wide steps and ongoing Labour Inspectorate investigation, but largely placed responsibility on employers and stated that data on life expectancy and some emission assessments are unavailable or pending.

It is up to the employer and the client to ensure this. The Netherlands Labour Inspectorate started an investigation at the end of 2021 into compliance with working conditions legislation at Schiphol.

Het is aan de werkgever en de opdrachtgever om daar zorg voor te dragen. De Nederlandse Arbeidsinspectie is eind 2021 onderzoek gestart naar de naleving van de arbeidsomstandighedenwet- en regelgeving op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht 'Deltacommissaris: woningbouw houdt veel te weinig rekening met klimaatverandering'

An MP (Van Esch, PvdD) asked the ministers about a report that the Delta Commissioner finds housing construction takes too little account of climate change, including whether new homes are planned in flood-prone or unstable areas, and what action will be taken on climate-adaptive building, nature-inclusive building, subsidence and coastal/river development. The minister answers that a formal response to the Delta Commissioner's advice will follow in Q1 2022, that a national climate-adaptation action programme and a building-criteria framework will be produced, and that the government commits to these steps while describing many measures as ongoing or to be explored.

In the response to the Delta Commissioner's advice we will indicate how we will tackle this challenge of quickly realising affordable homes on the one hand and taking account of the consequences of climate change on the other.

In de reactie op het advies van de Deltacommissaris zullen we aangeven hoe we aan de slag gaan met deze uitdaging om enerzijds snel betaalbare woningen te realiseren en anderzijds rekening te houden met gevolgen van klimaatverandering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over geweld tegen anti-Zwarte Piet demonstranten in Volendam

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked why the cabinet did not condemn violence against anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators in Volendam, whether perpetrators should be prosecuted, and how the mayor and local triangle handled the unannounced demonstration. The minister condemned the violence and the attempt to block the constitutional right to demonstrate, but said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, and that assessing the mayor's and local triangle's conduct is for the mayor, who answers to the municipal council.
Facilitating and properly managing demonstrations is the responsibility of the mayor, who is accountable to the municipal council.
Het faciliteren en in goede banen leiden van demonstraties is aan de burgemeester, die daarover verantwoording aflegt aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de verwachte groei van de geitenhouderij in Noord-Brabant

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the minister about expected growth of goat farming in North Brabant, its links to lung infections in nearby residents, and whether national measures are needed. The minister replied that the moratorium blocks new stables and expansions, that the cause of the health risk is still under study, and that provinces hold the power to impose goat stops while the government supports them.
The authority for this lies with the provinces.
De bevoegdheid hiervoor ligt bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vestering en Van Esch over duisternis en stilte

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked the government about protecting darkness and quiet (light and noise pollution), the number and loss of quiet areas, and hunting in them. The Minister answered that darkness and quiet are recognised as important, that protection relies on existing law and provincial competence, that about 14,000 hectares of land quiet area were lost net, and that no new national rules are planned.
The cabinet is currently not intending to draw up new, additional rules on this, partly because of its caretaker status.
Het kabinet is op dit moment, mede vanwege zijn demissionaire status, niet voornemens hierover nieuwe, aanvullende regels op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de afgegeven opsporingsvergunningen voor aardwarmte in (huidige en toekomstige) drinkwatergebieden

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked why geothermal exploration licences were granted in current and future drinking water areas despite warnings from the Court of Audit and the State Supervision of Mines, and what safeguards exist. The Minister replied that a bill amending the Mining Act is pending, that licences are market-ordering concessions with no drilling rights until an environmental permit is granted, that provinces normally exclude mining in protected drinking water zones, and that no specific restrictions were attached to the licences.
The Court of Audit investigation took place in mid-2019.
Het onderzoek van de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) heeft medio 2019 plaatsgevonden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Wilders, Agema, Hijink, Westerveld, Kuiken, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Gündoğan, Van Esch, Simons en Den Haan over de uitspraken van dhr. Gommers dat hij over 10 dagen code zwa

MPs asked the Minister of Health whether the November measures were working, given expert warnings of a 'code black' hospital crisis, and questioned testing, boosters, staffing, supplies, security and a medium-term strategy. The Minister answered that pressure on care is rising, phase 2d was declared with planned care being scaled down, and that no indication yet exists for phase 3, while defending booster timing and deferring some points to earlier letters.
I am in constant contact with field parties in order to maintain a sharp view of the current situation on the shop floor in various care sectors.
Ook ben ik constant in gesprek met veldpartijen, om scherp zicht te houden op de actuele situatie op de werkvloer in verschillende zorgsectoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over geconstateerde ernstige misstanden op de dierenbeurs in Houten

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about serious animal welfare and public health concerns at the Houten reptile fair, including cramped housing, stress, zoonosis risk and NVWA inspections. The minister acknowledged the welfare concerns, reported NVWA findings and inspection history, and said a broader exploration of animal fairs and legal analysis is underway, without committing to a ban.
I have started an exploration into animal fairs in the Netherlands.
Ik ben een verkenning gestart over beurzen met dieren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het weigeren van Statenleden

Opposition MP Van Esch asked why Limburg provincial state members were refused entry to a committee meeting for lacking a corona pass, and whether the governor selection procedure should have been halted. The minister agreed access must not be denied, said meetings should be held elsewhere when the pass is required, and undertook to clarify the rules to decentralised governments, though the appointment proceeded.
Being able to take part in deliberations is, after all, the essence of being an elected representative.
Het kunnen deelnemen aan de beraadslaging is immers de essentie van het zijn van volksvertegenwoordiger.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over de vondst van zeehonden met hoogpathogene vogelgriep in Duitsland

MPs Van Esch and Vestering asked the ministers about avian flu (H5N8) found in seals in Germany, its spread to wild animals, monitoring, and protocols for dead wild birds. The minister answered all 14 questions, mostly on substance, noting monitoring and protocols are being developed while rejecting a hunting ban and some measures.
We do not share that view. We do not pursue a policy to combat the disease in wild birds.
Die mening delen wij niet. Wij voeren geen beleid om de ziekte bij wilde vogels te bestrijden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Esch over de aanhoudende onvrede, acties en voorgenomen rechtszaken tegen ambtenaren- en lerarenpensioenfonds ABP

MPs Teunissen and Van Esch asked the ministers about public and legal pressure on pension fund ABP over fossil-fuel and animal-suffering investments, and whether public employers should tender the scheme, and whether conscientious objectors can opt out. The government answered that ABP's board independently manages investments, that ABP has decided to divest from fossil fuel producers, that tendering is not required under the Dutch statutory system, and that individual opt-out for investment objections is not possible.
The ABP board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including the investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over de geluidsoverlast van motoren

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about noise nuisance from motorcycles, including health effects, EU-level and national noise norms, roadside acoustic cameras, municipal road closures and the regulation of non-certified exhausts. The minister replied that noise policy is being developed in an integrated response expected after a new cabinet, that municipalities may close roads case by case, and that EU and national rules on exhausts and inspections are being reviewed or enforced.
For this reason an integrated policy response is expected to be drafted and sent to the House after a new cabinet takes office.
Om die reden zal een integrale beleidsreactie naar verwachting na aantreden van een nieuw kabinet kunnen worden opgesteld en naar de Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Vestering over het vasthouden van water in natuurgebieden om overstromingen te helpen voorkomen

MPs Vestering and Van Esch asked about retaining water in nature areas to help prevent floods, including the role of agriculture, river space, and responsibilities across government tiers. Minister Schouten answered substantively, describing existing policy, river-widening measures and groundwater frameworks, and committing to further letters on climate adaptation for nature later this autumn.
Action lines on climate adaptation for nature will be communicated to you later this autumn.
Actielijnen klimaatadaptatie natuur u later dit najaar wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over de drukte bij de Formule 1 in Zandvoort

MPs Van Esch and Teunissen asked the health and education ministers about crowding at the Formula 1 event in Zandvoort, the rules for seated versus unseated events, and whether this was foreseen and would be evaluated. Minister De Jonge answered that the event followed the rules in force, that seated and unseated events differ in risk, that about 90 infections were traced to the event, and that the government aims to lift restrictions when the epidemiological situation allows.
It turned out that this was not possible at all times.
Het is gebleken dat dat niet op alle momenten mogelijk was.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de berichten dat ophoping van plastics en chemicaliën gerust mag worden beschouwd als de derde planetaire crisis en dat de schade door plastic bijna tien keer hoger ligt dan d

An MP asked the Minister whether plastic and chemical accumulation should be treated as a third planetary crisis and what the government will do about plastic's hidden costs. The State Secretary acknowledged the environmental problem, pointed to existing and planned measures (single-use plastics bans, deposit schemes, extended producer responsibility, a possible plastic levy left to the next cabinet) and said a global approach is needed.
I will shortly announce further measures to reduce the use of plastic cups and meal packaging.
Ik zal op korte termijn nadere maatregelen bekendmaken om het gebruik van plastic bekers en maaltijdverpakkingen terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het statiegeldsysteem voor kunststof flessen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the state secretary why small PET bottles cannot be returned for deposit at petrol stations, NS stations, cinemas and other venues, and whether the system is adequate. The state secretary answers that producers organise collection, that the system is satisfactory and will be evaluated in 2024, and that she sees no need to change responsibility for returns.
As promised, I will closely monitor shifts in the market and take additional policy measures if necessary.
Ik zal, zoals toegezegd, de verschuivingen in de markt nauwlettend volgen en indien nodig aanvullende beleidsmaatregelen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het bericht ‘mogelijk meer vluchten met besmette passagiers dan gedacht’

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the ministers whether a Canadian-data analysis (36% of July flights from Amsterdam to Canada carried an infected passenger, versus 9% in an NLR/RIVM study) reveals underestimated in-flight infection risk, and whether testing, mask and distancing rules are adequate. The minister answered that the NLR/RIVM study only covered aerosol inhalation in flight, used early-June prevalence and the original variant, that the government sees insufficient reason for stricter measures now, and that it will monitor the situation and reconsider if needed.

The cabinet currently sees insufficient reason, compared with the current policy on testing, the passenger health declaration, triage, masks on board and the quarantine declaration, to take additional measures.

Het kabinet ziet op dit moment onvoldoende aanleiding ten opzichte van het huidige beleid ten aanzien van testen, de gezondheidsverklaring van de passagier, triage, mondkapjes aan boord en de verklaring van de quarantaineplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over een brandbrief van KDS over de hoge slachtsnelheid in slachthuizen

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about a letter from the works council of KDS, the meat inspection body, complaining that high slaughter line speeds prevent proper inspection and threaten food safety and worker safety. Minister Schouten answered that the government takes the concern seriously, has frozen line-speed increases pending an investigation due at year-end, and that legally it cannot order a structural reduction in speed immediately.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het artikel ‘Spoelt granuliet toch weer weg? Wethouder wil verklaring van Rijkswaterstaat’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about press reports that granulite is washing up at the Moleneindse Waard lake near Dreumel, questioning the depth of the layer, its circular-economy status, and long-term environmental effects. The government replies that granulite meets the soil quality standards, that Arcadis is reviewing whether the actual situation matches its report, and that the Chamber will be informed once that assessment is complete.
Once the assessment is ready (expected in the autumn), I will inform the Chamber about it.
Zodra de beoordeling gereed is (naar verwachting in de herfst), zal ik de Kamer daarover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ‘Bontrup weigerde steekproeven granuliet op eigen terrein’

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Infrastructure Minister why Bontrup refused soil sampling of granulite, why the parliament was not informed, and why parts of the Arcadis review were altered or deleted. The state secretary answers that the government requested sampling but Bontrup declined, that Arcadis judged sampling no longer necessary, that the textual changes were Arcadis's own decision after a fact-check, and that no new investigation or stoppage of granulite use is planned.
Arcadis, as an independent and expert bureau, concluded that given the results of the research carried out, the need for sampling at Bontrup's production site was no longer present.

Arcadis heeft als onafhankelijk en deskundig bureau geconcludeerd dat – gezien de resultaten van het uitgevoerde onderzoek – de noodzaak voor bemonstering op de productielocatie van Bontrup niet meer aanwezig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de Rutte doctrine in het granulietdossier

An MP asked why earlier written questions on granulite contamination remained unanswered, and why the minister refused substantive response to a committee request citing ongoing court proceedings. The government apologised for delay, said the documents are part of a pending lawsuit so substantive comment is not appropriate now, and promised to inform parliament of the outcome after the case.
A substantive response to your House is, as is customary with documents that are before the court, not appropriate at this time.
Een inhoudelijke reactie naar uw Kamer is, zoals te doen gebruikelijk met stukken «die onder de rechter zijn», daarom nu niet gepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Teunissen over het loslaten van oranje ballonnen voor TeamNL

Two Partij voor de Dieren MPs asked whether the Dutch embassy in Japan releasing orange plastic balloons over water near the Olympic Village was harmful to the environment and contrary to Dutch environmental policy. The minister replied that balloon release is not banned at national level, that biodegradable balloons were chosen after consultation with Japanese authorities, NOC*NSF and the ministry, and that the embassy will not repeat the one-off action.
In that sense, the embassy's event in Japan was not in conflict with Dutch environmental policy.
In die zin was het event van de ambassade in Japan niet in strijd met het Nederlandse milieubeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de leefstijlcampagne ‘Fit op jouw manier’ en het aanpakken van de grondoorzaken van ongezond leven

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary of Health about the 'Fit op jouw manier' lifestyle campaign, its cost, its adequacy for low-income and polluted-area residents, and structural causes of unhealthy living. The State Secretary answers that the campaign budget is EUR 3.44 million, that it complements structural measures such as the Prevention Agreement and food-environment policy, and commits to further reports and a RIVM study.
I acknowledge that further steps are needed and have therefore asked the RIVM to investigate which additional measures could be deployed.
Ik erken dat er verdere stappen nodig zijn en heb daarom het RIVM gevraagd om te onderzoeken welke extra maatregelen ingezet kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht 'PUR-spuiter Eco Isolatie mag van Reclame Code Commissie niet claimen dat gespoten PUR-schuim milieuvriendelijk is'

An MP asks the government about advertising claims that sprayed PUR foam insulation is environmentally friendly, the health risks identified by the Health Council, and whether it will phase out or regulate the product. The minister answers that the advertising body's ruling suffices, that no new phase-out or campaign is planned, that a practice evaluation and a meeting with the sector will follow, and that the current subsidy and building rules remain in place.
I do not intend to start phasing out sprayed PUR foam.
Ik ben niet voornemens om te starten met het uitfaseren van gespoten PUR-schuim.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de overtreding van de coronaregels bij een kalverslachthuis in Apeldoorn

The MP Van Esch asked the Minister for Medical Care how positive-tested workers at the Apeldoorn calf slaughterhouse ESA were allowed on site, whether they were pressured to work, and what the NVWA knew of earlier COVID-19 rule violations. The Minister answered that the NVWA halted operations, that pressure could not be ruled out or traced through contact tracing, that inspections and a shutdown followed, and that the Inspectie SZW took enforcement action.
It is important that the competent authorities gain and maintain a clear view of any coercion and of who it comes from.
Het is van belang dat de bevoegde autoriteiten goed zicht krijgen en houden op eventuele dwang en van wie die dwang uitgaat
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het artikel van Zembla 'Ministerie lakt opnieuw stukken weg in Wob-documenten over granuliet'

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Infrastructure Minister about Zembla reporting that the ministry redacted documents on granulite under the Wob, including the weakening of a previously released passage and a claim that a document was wrongly marked out of scope. The state secretary answers that the redactions were justified under Wob exemptions, admits one part of a document was missed due to a work-allocation error, and promises a review of the objection and an independent investigation.

The part of the document declared 'out of scope' and not covered by the Rijkswaterstaat Wob decision will be assessed on substance as soon as possible and, expected at the decision on the objection, made as public as possible.

Het gedeelte van het document dat «buiten scope» is verklaard en niet in het Wob-besluit van Rijkswaterstaat betrokken is, zal zo snel mogelijk inhoudelijk worden beoordeeld en bij de eerst mogelijke gelegenheid, dat is naar verwachting de beslissing op bezwaar tegen het besluit van de bestuurskern van IenW, zoveel mogelijk openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het gebrek aan maatregelen tegen de gezondheidsrisico’s van de geitenhouderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister why the government does not take national precautionary measures against health risks from goat farming, and whether provincial moratoria should be left to provinces. The Minister answers that moratoria are a provincial competence, that the government supports them and funds follow-up research into the cause of raised pneumonia risk near goat farms, and that existing national zoonosis and Q-fever measures remain in place.
Establishing, lifting or extending such a moratorium is a competence of the province.
Het instellen, opheffen of verlengen van een dergelijk moratorium is een bevoegdheid van de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat inwoners rond Tata Steel IJmuiden vaker ziek zijn

An MP asked the government about reports that residents near Tata Steel IJmuiden are sicker, covering medical support, a possible compensation fund, short-term protection, RIVM follow-up research, emission monitoring, cumulative exposure and the province's enforcement. The state secretary answered that the province of North Holland is the competent authority for permits and enforcement, that the Rijk advises but cannot order a production stop, and that the ILT is monitoring the province's follow-up on the Randstedelijke Rekenkamer recommendations.
The provincial executive of North Holland is the competent authority here. The national government does not have the power to impose a production stop on Tata Steel.
Gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Noord-Holland zijn hier bevoegd gezag. Het Rijk heeft niet de bevoegdheid om een productiestop aan Tata Steel op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het gebrek aan maatregelen tegen de gezondheidsrisico’s van de geitenhouderij

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Health Minister why no measures have been taken against the health risks of goat farming near residents, given research since 2011 showing higher pneumonia risk, and questions the delayed follow-up research and the lack of a national production cap on goats. The minister answers that the research is ongoing with completion delayed to 2024 by COVID-19, that provinces (not the national government) control goat-farm moratoria which the cabinet supports, and that national risk-reducing measures await the cause being identified.
The cabinet is having these follow-up studies carried out in order to ultimately be able to take risk-reducing measures.
Het kabinet laat deze vervolgonderzoeken uitvoeren om uiteindelijk risicoreducerende maatregelen te kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over een toename van coronabesmettingen in slachthuizen

An MP asked the Minister of Health about rising COVID-19 infections at slaughterhouses (Vion Tilburg and Boxtel), cluster definitions, reporting obligations to the GGD, inspection of Vion Boxtel, and rotation of inspection staff. The minister answered in detail, confirming clusters and outbreak numbers, describing GGD and Inspectie SZW follow-up, and stating that inspection staff are not moved between slaughterhouses when symptomatic, while noting that a RIVM study on cold rooms was commissioned.
I commissioned the RIVM in January 2021 to conduct further research into the role of cold rooms in the food industry as a possible aggravating risk factor for the spread of COVID-19.
Het RIVM opdracht gegeven heb nader onderzoek te doen naar de rol van koude ruimtes in de voedselindustrie als mogelijke verhogende risicofactor voor verspreiding van COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Esch over lozingen in de Maas

An MP asked the minister about permitted microplastic discharges by Chemelot into the Maas, precautionary principle, and whether economic interests outweigh environmental ones; the minister replied that the competent authority (Waterschap Limburg) assesses discharges under BBT, that the precautionary principle applies, that economic interests are not a weighing factor, and that no change to the division of powers is needed. Several answers refer to answers given to other MPs rather than repeating substance.
No, I do not recognise the picture sketched.
Nee, ik herken het geschetste beeld niet.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Esch over het feit dat er niet wordt ingegrepen bij een clusteruitbraak van bijna 100 coronabesmettingen bij Vion Boxtel

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why no intervention follows a cluster of nearly 100 COVID-19 infections at the Vion Boxtel slaughterhouse, covering the earlier claimed inspection, cluster definition, comparisons with other sites, enforcement powers and worker exposure. The minister answers that the 2 March inspection did not take place, that the GGD sees no grounds for closure, that the Inspectie SZW lacks a closure power under the temporary COVID law but may halt work under the Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, and that a bill to allow mayoral closure is in preparation.
Currently the Temporary COVID-19 Measures Act does not provide the authority to order the closure of a location.
Momenteel biedt de Tijdelijke wet maatregelen COVID-19 niet de bevoegdheid om over te gaan tot sluiting van een locatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het bericht ‘Hoekstra: NS zal ‘op termijn’ minder moeten gaan rijden’

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked why the Finance Minister says NS (Dutch Railways) must run fewer trains when more sustainable public transport is needed, and why Air France-KLM is not held to the same standard, including whether a motion on capacity growth is being implemented. The minister answers that NS faces financial pressure from COVID-19, that a public-transport availability fee has been extended to end-2021, that talks on further support and a post-2021 scheme are ongoing, and that Air France-KLM is not bound by concession obligations, but gives largely general answers without committing to specific new steps beyond continued consultation.
In doing so we look at what NS can do itself, and at what the shareholder and concession authority can do.
Daarbij kijken we naar wat NS zelf kan doen, en naar wat de aandeelhouder en concessieverlener kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over het gebruik van bouwpuin vervuild met plastic voor wandelpaden

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether building rubble contaminated with plastic, used for forest and nature paths by State Forestry Service (Staatsbosbeheer), can be guaranteed free of harmful substances, and whether its use should be banned. The State Secretary answered that no national data exist on the quantities used, that the EU and Dutch standards cap plastic contamination at 1% but are not otherwise specific, and that the government will examine whether plastic contamination can be better regulated by year-end while supporting Staatsbosbeheer's initiative to explore alternatives.
At national level there is no insight into this. There is no reporting obligation for the application of recycled granulate as a building material.
Op landelijk niveau bestaat hierin geen inzicht. Op het toepassen van recyclinggranulaat als bouwstof rust geen meldingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over watergebruik in datacenters

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about water use by data centres, including whether dikes must be raised, permitting, discharge rules and drinking water use for cooling. The minister answered that the Wieringermeer dike meets the legal norm, that the permitting authority and discharge rules are set out, and that she does not find national legislation on data centre water use necessary, while committing to a national drinking water policy exploration.
There is no information available on cooling water use for specific data centres in North Holland.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over gebruik van koelwater voor specifieke datacenters in Noord-Holland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de Corona Opt-In, de wijze waarop mensen hun medische gegevens kunnen beschermen en mogelijk verkeerde antwoorden van de minister

An MP asks whether the Corona Opt-In, which opens medical records of about 8 million people who never consented to access by emergency services, remains in force, why it cannot be ended, who can view the data, and whether oversight of access is adequate. The minister replies that the measure remains necessary, that access is limited to authorised professionals with consent and logging, that pharmacies have no access, and that hospital audits are being arranged.
I believe that sufficient safeguards have been built into the Corona Opt-In to let the measure continue for as long as necessary within the Covid-19 context.
Ik vind dat er in het kader van de Corona Opt-in voldoende waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om de maatregel zolang noodzakelijk in het kader van Covid-19 te laten voortduren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin, Kröger, Moorlag, Schonis en Van Esch over het vervangen van de Paddepoelsterbrug en de aangenomen motie-Laçin c.s. (Kamerstuk 35570-A, nr. 30)

MPs asked the minister about the replacement of the Paddepoelsterbrug in Groningen, including whether agreements for a low movable bridge still stand after a 2021 motion. The minister said talks with residents and stakeholders continue, that a 2020 MIRT agreement provides for a fixed bridge at 9.10 metres with ramps and a €8.6 million federal contribution, and that the agreement is on hold pending the motion, while defending the drawbacks of a low bridge.
After concluding an administrative agreement, I will transfer the financial resources and implementation by the municipality of Groningen can begin.
Na het sluiten van een bestuursovereenkomst zal ik de financiële middelen overdragen en kan de uitvoering door de gemeente Groningen beginnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Wassenberg over het sluiten van trimsalons voor dieren

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked why dog and cat grooming salons were closed during the lockdown, whether owners may bring animals in, why salons count as public places, and whether small salons can get state support. The minister answered that salons may fetch and return animals, that home-based groomers may take clients by appointment, and that existing support schemes are sufficient, so no further widening is planned.
At this moment I see no reason and no room to broaden this further.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding en geen ruimte om dit nog verder te verbreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Esch over het bericht 'Bewoners op achterstand gezet in strijd tegen verbreding A27: ‘Hoort niet zo in een democratie’

MPs asked whether the A27/A12 Utrecht route decision was taken without updated traffic and nitrogen analyses, without the Commission for EIA's full review, and whether the Crisis- and Recovery Act's limits on local government appeals are compatible with democracy. The minister declined to discuss the substance because an appeal is pending, defended the procedure and the Act's restriction on decentralised appeals, and pointed to the publicly available reports.
Because the appeal procedure is still ongoing, I cannot go into the substance of the decision towards your House.
Omdat de beroepsprocedure nog loopt, kan ik richting uw Kamer niet op de inhoud van het besluit ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de boete voor een kapitein na een grote olielekkage in de Rotterdamse haven

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked why a captain was fined only 1,000 euros after a major oil spill in the Rotterdam port, and about liability, sentencing and environmental criminal law. The minister answered that the courts decide sentencing, that the shipowner's liability-limitation request was rejected and is pending before the Supreme Court, and that work on speeding up environmental enforcement is underway, without committing to new criminal-law measures.
I do not intervene in the decision of the criminal judge.
Ik treed niet in de beslissing van de strafrechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht dat studenten van de Erasmus Universiteit een tweede camera moeten gebruiken bij tentamens

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether the Erasmus University's requirement for a second camera during proctored exams is proportionate and privacy-compliant, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister answered that institutions decide their own measures after a risk analysis with the data protection officer, that she calls on institutions to use second cameras only when strictly necessary, and that alternatives to proctoring should be offered where possible.
I call on educational institutions to be restrained in using a second camera for online examinations and to adopt this measure only where it is deemed strictly necessary.
Ik roep onderwijsinstellingen op om terughoudend te zijn met de inzet van een tweede camera bij online tentaminering en alleen over te gaan op deze maatregel als het strikt noodzakelijk wordt geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over de MQ-9 Reaper drones en over vergunningen voor vliegbasis Leeuwarden

MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked about the armed potential of MQ-9 Reaper drones, civilian harm, and environmental permits (nitrogen and noise) for Leeuwarden air base, and whether residents can access full study information. The state secretary said arming the MQ-9 is not yet in defence plans but is being considered, stated that classified noise data are withheld while the permit authorities decide what is published, and said there are no significant effects on Natura 2000 areas.

If Defence states in the permit application that parts of the information supplied are classified, the competent authority includes a justification in the decision and those parts are not made available for public inspection.

Als Defensie bij de vergunningsaanvraag stelt dat delen van de geleverde informatie geclassificeerd zijn, dan wordt door het bevoegd gezag in de beschikking een motivering opgenomen en worden die delen niet ter inzage gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de dreigende slacht van honderdduizenden haaien voor coronavaccins

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether squalene from shark livers used in some COVID-19 vaccines should be replaced by plant-based sources and whether the government would choose vaccines without protected animals. The minister confirmed shark-derived squalene is in the Sanofi/GSK vaccine, said plant-based alternatives are preferable where equivalent, and promised to ask contract partners in future agreements about protected animals in production.
I am, however, willing to ask the contracting party in the case of new agreements whether they use protected animals in the production process.
Ik ben wel bereid om in geval van nieuwe overeenkomsten aan de contractpartij te vragen of ze gebruik maken van beschermde dieren bij het productieproces
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de effecten van een slechte luchtkwaliteit voor herstellende COVID-19 patiënten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government whether people recovering from COVID-19 are harmed by wood-burning smoke, whether ventilation advice conflicts with it, and why the Clean Air Agreement lacks binding measures such as a ban during smoke alerts and enforcement of complaints. The State Secretary answers that the health risks are plausible but not scientifically proven, points to voluntary measures (stookwijzer, pilot projects, complaint routing to municipalities) and declines a stoking ban for now.
As I explained in response to the Van Esch motion, I will ask municipalities to seriously follow up on reports received via the stookwijzer.
Zoals ik in reactie op de motie van Van Esch 4 , heb toegelicht, zal ik gemeenten vragen om serieus opvolging te geven aan meldingen die binnenkomen via de stookwijzer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het bericht ‘studenten die spionagesoftware moeten installeren om tentamens te kunnen doen’.

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether students being forced to install surveillance software (proctoring) for exams is acceptable, given privacy concerns and expert warnings. The Minister says proctoring is sometimes necessary when alternatives are infeasible, that GDPR-compliant safeguards apply, that students may object and request alternatives, but gives no figures on use and no commitment to compensate or to stop its use.
Institutions do not register how many students do or do not install proctoring software.
Instellingen registreren niet hoeveel studenten wel of niet proctoring-software installeren.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Onnodig veel gevaarlijke stoffen in rivieren: lozingsvergunningen flink verouderd’

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that hazardous substances such as benzene, lead and vinyl chloride still enter rivers under outdated discharge permits, asking about drinking water effects, how many permits are outdated, BBT compliance, monitoring, and Rijkswaterstaat's capacity and priorities. The minister answered that the three substances did not exceed EU water norms in 2017-2019, that about three quarters of roughly 800 permits need adjustment, that a multi-year structural approach with periodic review every 4 to 8 years will be implemented, and that the advisory report is attached.
In about 50% of the permits reviewed in the pilot, there were discharges of ZZS.
Bij circa 50% van de vergunningen die in de pilot zijn bezien, was er sprake van lozingen van ZZS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ''We verzieken ons leefmilieu en daarmee onszelf', artsen starten landelijke campagne'

An MP asked the health and infrastructure ministers whether they accept that air pollution from intensive livestock farming worsens COVID-19 outcomes and whether they will act on the link. The government answered that the link is plausible but not established, that more research is being explored with RIVM, and that existing air-quality policy (Schone Lucht Akkoord, nitrogen and livestock measures) is the response.
As indicated in the answer to question 4, RIVM has been asked to explore the research possibilities regarding the relationship between air quality, livestock farming and COVID-19.
Zoals aangegeven in antwoord op vraag 4 is het RIVM gevraagd een verkenning uit te voeren naar de onderzoeksmogelijkheden aangaande de relatie luchtkwaliteit, veehouderij en COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de oorzaken van droogte en de gevolgen voor natuur

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about drought causes, including drainage for agriculture, daytime irrigation, and effects on nature and Natura 2000 areas. The minister denied that drought is simply a policy failure, acknowledged agricultural drainage as one cause among several, and committed to an inventory of groundwater abstractions and area-based approaches.
The water boards and Rijkswaterstaat cannot state how many cubic metres that was in that period.
De waterschappen en Rijkswaterstaat kunnen niet aangeven hoeveel kubieke meter dat in die periode geweest is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het handhaven van de aangepaste maximumsnelheid op snelwegen

An MP asked the minister whether the lowered 100 km/h motorway speed limit is being complied with, whether enforcement has changed, and whether the expected nitrogen reduction is booked despite possible higher overtaking. The minister replied that offence figures show no clear rise compared with 2019, enforcement is unchanged with existing resources, and the nitrogen calculation uses representative driving behaviour, with the reduction booked on expected traffic rather than actual compliance.
The caveat to be made is that the lowering of the maximum speed coincides with a change in traffic intensities due to the COVID-19 measures.
De kanttekening die hierbij gemaakt dient te worden is dat de verlaging van de maximumsnelheid samenvalt met een verandering van de verkeersintensiteiten als gevolg van de COVID-19 maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Esch en Van Raan over het actief ontmoedigen van onnodige reizen naar risicogebieden

Green MPs Van Esch and Van Raan asked the government how it will discourage unnecessary travel to COVID-19 risk areas, including ticket advertising and the Schiphol test lane's capacity. The ministers answered that travellers bear responsibility for their choices, orange advice is in place, a Schiphol testing study is under way with results expected mid-September, and airlines were urged to stop promoting travel to orange areas.
It is the responsibility of the traveller themselves to weigh whether a trip is necessary or not.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de reiziger zelf om de afweging te maken of een reis noodzakelijk is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht ‘Jezelf van ziek naar gezond eten met een plantaardig dieet. Soms kan het echt’

An MP asked the state secretary whether plant-based diets help patients with conditions such as rheumatism, type 2 diabetes and atherosclerosis, which insurers reimburse lifestyle programmes, and how doctors are trained in nutrition. The state secretary replied that evidence of effectiveness is still needed before insurers reimburse such programmes, pointed to pending Health Council advice and ZonMw research funding, and said training is the responsibility of the profession.
For lifestyle programmes it is important that they are proven effective and can indeed bring about a behavioural change.
Voor leefstijlprogramma's is het belangrijk dat ze bewezen effectief zijn en inderdaad een gedragsverandering kunnen bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het meten van luchtkwaliteit nabij drukke wegen in de bebouwde kom

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister and State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management whether Dutch air-quality monitoring near busy urban roads, which measures beyond 10 metres from the kerb, conflicts with the EEA interpretation of the EU Air Quality Directive, and what measures follow. The government answered that Dutch monitoring is lawful under the Wet milieubeheer and Rbl, that no limit exceedances occur at the cited locations so no measures are required, and that the Schone Lucht Akkoord pursues further health gains.
At the same time, I do not consider that this statement conflicts with the interpretation of the Air Quality Directive.
Daarbij ben ik niet van mening dat deze uitspraak strijdig is met de interpretatie van de Richtlijn luchtkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat "Tata Steel onveilig omgaat met gevaarlijke stoffen en inspecteurs probeert te omzeilen"

MP Van Esch (PvdD) asked whether Tata Steel's handling of hazardous substances is unsafe, whether inspectors are undermined by management, and whether top officials communicate directly with Tata Steel over inspectors' heads. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate's concerns were from 2018, that the company has since improved but intensive supervision continues, and that the inspectorate's coordination and interventions are internally agreed, rejecting the suggestion of improper management interference.
It is up to the Inspectorate SZW to determine how it fulfils its supervisory tasks.
Het is aan Inspectie SZW om te bepalen op welke wijze zij haar toezichtstaken invult.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Esch over de berichtgeving over het niet tot uitvoering brengen van de pilot in de IJssel

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers why the plastic-catching bubble barrier pilot in the IJssel was cancelled as too expensive, and whether environmental costs, polluters, or the Rijk itself would cover the shortfall. The minister confirmed the budget of 400,000 was insufficient, explained that extra funding was sought without success, and said the decision was carefully taken and that lessons from the pilot will be reported.
It was therefore decided not to start this pilot.
Er is daarom besloten deze pilot niet te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Wassenberg en Van Esch over een alomvattend aanvalsplan om het risico op toekomstige overspringende zoönotische infectieziekten drastisch te verkleinen

MPs Ouwehand, Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about zoonotic disease risks, intensive livestock farming, wildlife trade, deforestation and a comprehensive action plan to reduce spillover risk. The ministers answered that risks are recognised and managed through the Dutch zoonosis structure, but declined to commit to new bans, a dedicated action plan or additional wildlife-trade enforcement, saying existing measures are sufficient.
The cabinet will continue to work to keep the risks as small as possible or make them smaller.
Het kabinet zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat de risico's zo klein mogelijk zijn of kleiner worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over installaties die het huishoudelijk verbruik van energie en drinkwater stevig kunnen reduceren

An MP asked the government about household water and energy saving installations (Hydraloop), including subsidies, payback periods and building-code uptake. The minister answered that no specific subsidy exists, preferred demonstration projects, gave only estimated payback figures, and promised to raise the theme with the new-build platform.
Furthermore, I will bring this theme to the attention of the platform for very energy-efficient new construction.
Voorts zal ik dit thema onder de aandacht brengen van het platform zeer energiezuinige nieuwbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het gevolgde en te volgen protocol bij coronarepatriëringsvluchten uit niet-brandhaarden

MPs Van Raan and Van Esch asked whether a COVID-19 repatriation flight from Kuala Lumpur was overcrowded and whether quarantine or protocol changes were planned for such flights.
