The minister could not independently confirm the footage, said the flight carried 285 passengers and 13 crew under EASA and RIVM guidance, and stated no new measures were being considered for now.
At this moment the cabinet is not considering new measures, but we are monitoring the situation closely.
Op dit moment overweegt het kabinet geen nieuwe maatregelen, maar we monitoren de situatie nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over het bericht dat een slechte luchtkwaliteit de overlevingskans voor mensen met het COVID-19 virus verslechtert

An MP asked the government whether air pollution worsens survival odds for COVID-19 patients, citing SARS and Italian data, and whether a causal link was established and would be investigated in the Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that the cited ecological studies do not prove causation, that the RIVM considers the hypotheses plausible but unproven, and that research is being explored through international networks and the veehouderij programme, with the Chamber to be informed.
Your House will be informed about which research will be carried out within the MCC framework.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over welk onderzoek er in MCC verband uitgevoerd zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over de ‘veronderstelde toegang’ tot elektronische patiëntendossiers

An MP asked whether the temporary 'corona opt-in' opened the GP records of about eight million people to any UZI-holding care worker, whether this is compatible with consent rules, and related questions on encryption, the Landelijk Schakelpunt operator and whether the measure will be reversed. The minister answered that access requires patient consent on the spot, that the measure is temporary until at most 1 June 2020, and that the LSP operator is bound to Dutch law, while declining to say how many people have opted out.
I do not know how many people currently have an opt-out registered and cannot and may not know, because this is part of the individual GPs' registrations and privacy-sensitive information.

Ik weet niet hoeveel mensen in de huidige situatie een opt-out hebben geregistreerd en kan en mag dat ook niet weten want dit is onderdeel van de registraties van de afzonderlijke huisartsen en privacygevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over een plantaardige voedingsaanbod in ziekenhuizen

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether plant-based meals are available in Dutch hospitals and whether the 2025 target of the National Prevention Agreement for healthy hospital food is ambitious enough. The State Secretary answered that healthy food should be available in hospitals, that availability is likely but not verified nationwide, and that the target has been set at 2030 with the Alliance Food in Care working toward it.
The goal is healthy food offerings in all hospitals by 2030.
Het doel is gezond voedingsaanbod in alle ziekenhuizen in 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Esch over honden afscheid laten nemen van baasje

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister of Medical Care whether hospitals should have standardised conditions for allowing pets to visit dying patients, after UMCG let a dog say goodbye to its deceased owner. The minister answered that such decisions are case-by-case for hospitals and care providers, that standardisation is not desirable given the unique hospitals and person-centred care, and that rouwcentra are private organisations.
It is up to the individual care providers to consider whether they can and want to admit pets and how they fill in the preconditions for this.
Het is aan de individuele zorgaanbieders om te bezien of zij huisdieren kunnen en willen toelaten en hoe ze invulling geven aan de randvoorwaarden daarvoor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van Esch over het toevoegen van klimaatlessen aan het onderwijscurriculum in Nieuw-Zeeland

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked whether the government will adopt New Zealand's climate-education curriculum and related lessons on climate crisis, activism and eco-anxiety, and asked about the psychological effects of climate change. The ministers answered that sustainability is already part of the Dutch curriculum, that New Zealand's materials are freely available to schools, that Dutch education policy is a national responsibility, and that they do not see a need to copy the Italian or New Zealand models.
The Netherlands therefore does not need to follow the example of Italy and New Zealand, since themes such as sustainability, climate and liveability are already embedded in Dutch education.
Nederland behoeft het voorbeeld van Italië en Nieuw-Zeeland dan ook niet te volgen, aangezien thema's als duurzaamheid, klimaat en leefbaarheid ook nu al ingebed zijn in het Nederlandse onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over de dierlijke oorsprong van het nieuwe coronavirus en de falende aanpak van de handel in bedreigde diersoorten

MPs Wassenberg and Van Esch asked whether the new coronavirus originated from wildlife sold at a Wuhan market and whether the government will tighten import checks, ban trade in protected species and push China and the EU for stronger wildlife trade rules. The minister acknowledged possible wildlife reservoirs and the zoonotic risk but declined new import controls, a CITES evaluation, a total trade ban or a call to China, arguing there was no evidence the spread stems from animal trade.
There is no reason now to tighten supervision and enforcement of imports of animal products and animals from China.
Er is geen reden om nu tot een aanscherping van toezicht en handhaving op de import van dierlijke producten en dieren uit China over te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wassenberg en Van Esch over bladblazerterreur

Two PvdD MPs asked the ministers about the health, noise and environmental harm of leaf blowers and whether they should be banned or phased out. The minister answered that a categorical ban is not possible under EU rules, that municipalities should decide on use, and that the national government will not intervene but will raise the topic with the VNG.
I do not consider it the task of the national government to intervene here, but I do want to bring this topic to the attention of the municipalities via the VNG.
Ik vind het niet de taak van de nationale overheid om hier in te treden, maar ik wil wel dit onderwerp bij de gemeenten via de VNG onder de aandacht brengen.

m: Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over de boete voor het niet aanvragen van een fysiek energielabel opschorten
Asks the government to suspend the fine for not requesting a physical energy label when selling a home until digital labels are available again.
requests the government to suspend the fine for not requesting a physical energy label for selling a house until 1 July 2021
verzoekt de regering, de boete voor het niet aanvragen van een fysiek energielabel voor de verkoop van een huis op te schorten tot 1 juli 2021
Motie van het lid Terpstra over een landelijke norm voor binnenstedelijk groen
Asks the government to study whether a national inner-city green standard can secure enough green space and liveability while building homes in cities.
requests the government to investigate how a national inner-city green norm can contribute to sufficient green provision and liveability
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe een landelijke binnenstedelijk-groennorm kan bijdragen aan voldoende groenvoorziening en leefbaarheid
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Terpstra over fiscaal gunstig bouwsparen voor starters
Asks the government to map the costs and effects of tax-favoured home savings for first-time buyers and inform the House quickly.
requests the government to map the costs and effects of tax-favoured home savings for starters
verzoekt de regering, om de kosten en effecten van fiscaal gunstig bouwsparen voor starters in kaart te brengen
Motie van de leden Terpstra en Koerhuis over het afschaffen van het Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap in Noord-Holland
Asks the government to take steps to abolish the Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap designation in Noord-Holland to allow more housing construction.
take steps to abolish the Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap in the province of Noord-Holland
stappen te zetten om het Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap af te schaffen in de provincie Noord-Holland
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Terpstra ter vervanging van nr. 25 over een hardheidsclausule
Adds a general hardship clause letting the minister deviate from housing corporation rules where strict application is unfair or harms public housing, with annual reporting to parliament.
Our Minister may in a specific case deviate from what is provided by or pursuant to chapters IIIa and IV, or allow deviation from it.
Onze Minister kan in een bepaald geval van het bij of krachtens hoofdstuk IIIa en IV bepaalde afwijken of afwijking daarvan toestaan
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 28 over opkoopbescherming
Lets municipalities require a permit before owner-occupied affordable homes are rented out, with the mayor and aldermen able to grant exemptions.
The municipal council may, in the housing ordinance, give the mayor and aldermen the power to grant exemption from that prohibition.
De gemeenteraad kan in de huisvestingsverordening aan burgemeester en wethouders de bevoegdheid geven om ontheffing van dat verbod te verlenen.
Motie van de leden Terpstra en Koerhuis over woningbouw in de Gnephoekpolder
Asks the government to consult with the provincial deputy, municipality and developers to speed up housing in the Gnephoekpolder and inform the House before summer 2021.
requests the government to consult with the responsible deputy, municipality Alphen and developers to achieve housing construction as quickly as possible
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te treden met verantwoordelijk gedeputeerde, gemeente Alphen en betrokken projectontwikkelaars om zo snel als mogelijk tot woningbouw te komen
Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over de woondeal Noord-Holland-Noord sluiten
Motion asking the government to conclude the housing deal (woondeal) for the Noord-Holland-Noord region.
requests the government to conclude the Noord-Holland-Noord housing deal
verzoekt de regering, om de woondeal Noord-Holland-Noord te sluiten
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Terpstra ter vervanging van nr. 8 over verduurzaming van gebouwen
Amends the Housing Act rules so housing associations may carry out sustainability measures on properties they do not own, including shared-ownership complexes.
Amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over opkoopbescherming
Adds a temporary municipal regime for buy-to-let protection in the Housing Act, requiring permits for renting out certain homes after sale.
It is prohibited to rent out a dwelling in a category designated by the municipal council for housing stock composition without a permit
Het is verboden om een woonruimte behorend tot een met het oog op de samenstelling van de woonruimtevoorraad door de gemeenteraad in de huisvestingsverordening aangewezen categorie van woonruimten
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Terpstra ter vervanging van nr. 6 over een hardheidsclausule
Adds a general hardship clause letting the minister deviate from strict statutory and regulatory rules for housing corporations where strict application is unfair or harms housing interests.
Our Minister may in a specific case deviate from what is laid down by or pursuant to chapters IIIa and IV, or permit a deviation from it
Onze Minister kan in een bepaald geval van het bij of krachtens hoofdstuk IIIa en IV bepaalde afwijken of afwijking daarvan toestaan
Motie van het lid Futselaar c.s. over 20 miljoen extra voor ontmoetingsruimten voor ouderen
Asks the government to make another 20 million euro available in 2022 for meeting rooms in elderly housing complexes.
requests the government to ensure that a sum of 20 million is also made available in 2022 to support meeting rooms in housing complexes
verzoekt de regering, om ervoor zorg te dragen dat ook in 2022 een bedrag van 20 miljoen beschikbaar gesteld wordt om de totstandkoming van ontmoetingsruimten in wooncomplexen te ondersteunen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra ter vervanging van nr. 37 over digitaal aanvragen van het nieuwe energielabel
Asks the minister to ensure homeowners can apply for the new energy label digitally, with or without remote adviser support, instead of requiring a physical visit by an energy adviser.
This amendment requests the Minister to ensure that homeowners can also apply for the new energy label digitally
Dit amendement verzoekt de Minister er zorg voor te dragen dat huiseigenaren het nieuwe energielabel ook digitaal
Motie van het lid Amhaouch c.s. over een Deltaplan voor het Noorden
Motion asking the government to draw up a northern Netherlands delta plan including the Lelylijn railway and to share its outlines with the House by 1 May 2021.
requests the government, in cooperation with the four northern provinces, to draw up a delta plan for and of the North
verzoekt de regering, in samenwerking met de vier noordelijke provincies een deltaplan van en voor het Noorden op te stellen
Motie van de leden Peters en Terpstra over regelingen voor kinderen die hun ouders willen helpen binnen de volkshuisvesting
Asks the government to map the problem and explore arrangements enabling children to help their parents in the housing market.
requests the government to map the problem and inform the House about it
verzoekt de regering, de problematiek in beeld te brengen, de Kamer daarover te informeren
Motie van het lid Terpstra over het effect van de inhaalhuurverhoging op de huurders monitoren
Asks the government to monitor the effect of the catch-up rent increase on tenants and to work with Aedes to prevent debts and evictions.
requests the government to monitor the effect of the catch-up rent increase on tenants
verzoekt de regering, te monitoren wat het effect van de inhaalhuurverhoging is op de huurders
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra t.v.v. 36 over digitaal aanvragen van het nieuwe energielabel
Requires the minister to ensure the new energy label can still be applied for digitally, so homeowners need not pay for an on-site expert visit.
This amendment establishes that homeowners can still apply for the new energy label digitally themselves
Dit amendement legt vast dat huiseigenaren het nieuwe energielabel nog steeds zelf digitaal kunnen aanvragen
Motie van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over spoedwetgeving om flexwoningen binnen zes maanden te kunnen plaatsen
Asks the government to introduce emergency legislation, possibly under the Crisis- en herstelwet, so flexible housing can be placed within six months.
requests the government to come up with emergency legislation before the end of the year, for example under the Crisis and Recovery Act
verzoekt de regering voor het einde van het jaar met spoedwetgeving te komen, bijvoorbeeld onder de Crisis- en herstelwet
Motie van het lid Koerhuis c.s. over de ondergrens verlagen naar 200 woningen
Asks the government to lower the 500-home minimum of the Housing Construction Stimulus to 200 homes in regions with many small villages.
requests the government, through a regional test, to lower the 500-home minimum to 200 homes for regions with many small villages
verzoekt de regering, door middel van een regiotoets de ondergrens van 500 woningen te verlagen tot 200 woningen voor regio's met veel kleine woonplaatsen
Motie van de leden Terpstra en Koerhuis over een proactieve aanwijzing over Rijnenburg en Reijerscop
Asks the government to issue a proactive aanwijzing under the Wro to force Utrecht to build housing in Rijnenburg and Reijerscop soon.
requests the government to give the city of Utrecht a proactive directive for Rijnenburg and Reijerscop under article 4.4 of the Spatial Planning Act
verzoekt de regering, de stad Utrecht voor de locaties Rijnenburg en Reijerscop een proactieve aanwijzing te geven als bedoeld in artikel 4.4 van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening
Motie van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over meer ruimte voor gemeenschappelijke woonvormen
Asks the government for an improvement agenda for shared housing forms and to weigh their effects in new housing legislation.
Also requests the government to explicitly weigh the consequences for shared housing forms in new housing laws and regulations.
verzoekt de regering tevens, om bij nieuwe woonwet- en regelgeving de gevolgen voor gemeenschappelijke woonvormen nadrukkelijk mee te wegen
Motie van de leden Terpstra en Dik-Faber over biedingsprocedures voor het kopen van huizen zo open en transparant mogelijk maken
Asks the government to introduce measures making house-purchase bidding procedures more open and transparent, including wider availability of online bidding.
requests the government to come up with measures to make house-purchase bidding procedures as open and transparent as possible
verzoekt de regering, met maatregelen te komen om de biedingsprocedures voor het kopen van huizen zo open en transparant mogelijk te maken
Motie van de leden Terpstra en Amhaouch over substantiële woningbouw langs de Lelylijn
Asks the government to add substantial housing construction along the Lelylijn route and inform the House about the options.
to add substantial housing construction along the route and to inform the House as soon as possible about the possibilities
substantiële woningbouw langs het tracé toe te voegen en over de mogelijkheden hiertoe de Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk te informeren
Motie van de leden Terpstra en Nijboer over een vernieuwde vorm van premie-A-woningen
Asks the government to explore a renewed form of premium-A starter homes, such as a partly repayable purchase premium for new builds, to help first-time buyers.
Amendement van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over digitaal aanvragen van het nieuwe energielabel
Requires the minister to ensure that the energy audit for the new energy label can be requested digitally, so homeowners need not pay for a physical visit by an expert.
The Minister shall ensure that an energy audit to be requested under the general administrative order can be done digitally

Onze Minister draagt er zorg voor dat een bij of krachtens de algemene maatregel van bestuur, bedoeld in artikel 120, eerste lid, aan te vragen energieaudit als bedoeld in artikel 3 van de Richtlijn 2006/32/EG
Amendement van de leden Terpstra en Koerhuis over middelen voor startersleningen
Moves 50 million euros from the housing budget to fund starter loans by shifting funds within the housing article.
The funding for this amendment comes from the Woningbouwimpuls for 2021.
De dekking van dit amendement komt uit de Woningbouwimpuls voor het jaar 2021.
Amendement van het lid Terpstra over een hardheidsclausule
Amendment giving the minister a general hardship clause to deviate from the Housing Act where strict application would be unfair or undesirable for local housing.
The Minister may in certain cases deviate from this law or permit deviation from it
Onze Minister kan in bepaalde gevallen van deze wet afwijken of afwijking daarvan toestaan
Amendement van het lid Terpstra over noodzakelijke activiteiten die onderdeel uitmaken van de prestatieafspraken
Allows housing associations to undertake liveability activities beyond the statutory list where these form part of performance agreements.
To steer specifically toward regional solutions in future, this amendment allows deviation from the exhaustive list in Article 45(2).
Om in de toekomst specifiek te sturen op regionaal gerichte oplossingen, wordt middels dit amendement de mogelijkheid geboden af te wijken van de limitatieve opsomming
Amendement van het lid Terpstra over verduurzaming met betrekking tot woningen die een bouwkundige eenheid vormen met eigen woongelegenheden
Amendment to the Housing Act allowing housing associations to carry out sustainability measures on dwellings that form a structural unit with their own or other associations' dwellings.
housing associations may also carry out sustainability measures on dwellings that form a structural unit with their own dwellings
toegelaten instellingen ook verduurzamingsmaatregelen mogen uitvoeren met betrekking tot woningen die een bouwkundige eenheid vormen met hun eigen woongelegenheden
Amendement van het lid Terpstra over een aanwijzing bij afwijking in de prestatieafspraken van nationale woonambities
Allows the Minister to instruct housing associations when regional performance agreements deviate from national housing ambitions.
Our Minister may give a directive to the approved institution if the agreements referred to in Article 42(1) deviate from national housing ambitions.
Onze Minister kan een aanwijzing geven aan de toegelaten instelling indien in de afspraken, bedoeld in artikel 42, eerste lid, wordt afgeweken van woonambities op nationaal niveau.
Motie van het lid Terpstra over de mogelijkheid voor kwetsbare kiezers om hun stem per post uit te brengen
Asks the government to allow vulnerable voters to cast their vote by post in addition to COVID measures for the elections.
to create the possibility for particularly vulnerable voters to cast their vote by post
de mogelijkheid te scheppen dat met name kwetsbare kiezers per post hun stem kunnen uitbrengen
Motie van de leden Snoeren en Terpstra over uiterlijk één maand na de herindelingsverkiezingen de evaluatie naar de Kamer sturen
Asks the government to send the evaluation of the 2020 reorganisation elections to the House no later than one month after the elections.
requests the government to send the evaluation to the House at the latest one month after the reorganisation elections
verzoekt de regering, de evaluatie ten uiterste één maand na de herindelingsverkiezingen aan de Kamer te doen toekomen
Motie van het lid Terpstra over deelplatforms die verhuur van woonruimten faciliteren medeaansprakelijk stellen
Asks the government to make platforms that facilitate rental of dwellings jointly liable for rule violations, as in France, in the short-term rental bill.
requests the government, as happens in France, also to hold platforms and websites that facilitate rental of dwellings jointly liable when rules are broken
verzoekt de regering, evenals gebeurt in Frankrijk, ook deelplatforms en websites die verhuur van woonruimte faciliteren zelf medeaansprakelijk te stellen wanneer regels worden overtreden
Motie van het lid Terpstra over advertenties zonder registratienummer op deelplatforms verplicht kunnen verwijderen
Asks the government to examine how ads without a registration number on short-stay platforms can be made mandatorily removable and to introduce this quickly.
requests the government to map what is needed to be able to mandatorily remove ads without a registration number on platforms
verzoekt de regering, in kaart te brengen wat er nodig is om advertenties zonder registratienummer op deelplatforms verplicht te kunnen verwijderen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Von Martels over het bericht 'Haal vervuilde bouwgrond langs N206 weg'

CDA MPs asked about reports that contaminated AEC bottom ash with batteries was used in construction along the N206 near Katwijk, raising health and water risks. The state secretary answered that partner tests and an additional study show the ash meets the Soil Quality Decree, that no health risks are expected, that RIVM research is unnecessary, and that the municipality and province are the first contacts for residents.
I am currently considering options for tightening the Soil Quality Decree in this area.
Ik bekijk op dit moment de opties voor aanscherping van het Besluit bodemkwaliteit op dit vlak.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Geluk-Poortvliet over de berichten 'Ronald McDonald Huis en provincie Utrecht in de clinch over nieuwe locatie logeerhuis' en 'Zelfs minister bemoeit zich met discussie over Ro

MPs Terpstra and Geluk-Poortvliet asked why the Minister of OCW intervened in the planned relocation of the Ronald McDonald House on Utrecht Science Park, which falls within the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie heritage zone, and whether the minister could help by adjusting the nomination. The government answered that it asked the province to weigh the World Heritage aspect in its advice, that alternative sites outside the zone exist, and that the nomination boundaries cannot be changed at this stage.
In January 2021 I asked the Provincial Executive of Utrecht to properly take the World Heritage aspect into account in its advice.
In januari 2021 heb ik aan het College van gedeputeerde staten van de provincie Utrecht gevraagd om in haar advies het aspect van werelderfgoed goed mee te nemen in de afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra over het bericht 'Taxatiebranche werkt samen aan kwaliteitsverbetering woningtaxaties'

An MP (Terpstra, CDA) asked the Minister of Interior about the new 2021 mortgage valuation report model for housing, its costs, the stacking of costs with energy labels and inspections, the examination pass rate of valuers and liability. The minister answered that the sector self-regulates, the new model adds risk and sustainability information without longer on-site inspection time, costs are not yet clear and will be monitored, and that the sector is urged to reuse existing data.
I have no insight into how many valuers have already passed the examination and how many still have to take it.
Ik heb geen inzicht in hoeveel taxateurs op dit moment al geslaagd zijn voor het examen en hoeveel taxateurs het examen nog moeten afleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters en Terpstra over het uit zijn huurhuis zetten van een bejaarde man door sociale woningcorporatie Stek in Lisse

MPs Peters and Terpstra asked whether housing corporation Stek should refrain from evicting a 76-year-old man from his social rental home in Lisse, given the COVID-19 agreement not to evict tenants, and what instruments the government has to enforce it. The minister replied that the case falls outside the agreement because the eviction rests on persistent nuisance rather than rent arrears, that an alternative temporary housing solution has been found, and that the eviction was postponed to 5 April.
The specific situation you ask me about falls outside the scope of the agreements in the statement.
De specifieke situatie waar u mij over bevraagt, valt daarmee buiten de reikwijdte van de afspraken in het statement.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis en Terpstra over het bericht ‘Huren van de corporatie terwijl je 59 panden bezit’

MPs Koerhuis and Terpstra asked the minister about reports that some social rental tenants also own one or more homes, including owners of many properties. The minister answered that such occupancy is undesirable, cited Kadaster data showing 1,055 tenants with two or more owned homes, and promised further research and talks with Aedes and the VNG on remedies.
It is undesirable if a tenant 'occupies' a social rental home from the housing corporation when he is not entitled to it to meet his housing needs because he owns one or more owner-occupied homes.

Het is ongewenst als een huurder een sociale huurwoning van de woningcorporatie «bezet houdt», als hij niet op die woning is aangewezen om te voorzien in zijn woonbehoefte vanwege het bezit van één of meer koopwoningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra de berichten ‘Over dingen die blijven’ en ‘Laat ons bouwen’

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about provincial Noord-Holland spatial rules (protected landscapes, 11-home limit, overprogramming, corporation financing, aviation noise) that may block housing construction. The Minister answers that the province makes its own choices, that housing plan capacity is sufficient, that the aviation noise issue is under impact analysis, and that corporations face financing gaps requiring a future cabinet decision.
The province has indicated that for the Alkmaar region, in cooperation with the municipalities, it will start an exploratory trajectory to make an integrated assessment.
De provincie heeft aangegeven voor de regio Alkmaar in samenwerking met de gemeenten te starten met een verkenningstraject om een integrale afweging te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra en Koerhuis over de bouwopgave in Noord-Holland in relatie tot het bericht ‘Nieuwe omgevingsverordening beschermt 32 bijzondere landschappen’

MPs Terpstra and Koerhuis asked whether the new Noord-Holland environmental regulation, including Bijzonder Provinciaal Landschap designations and extra sustainability requirements, makes outer-urban building nearly impossible and undermines the national housing target. The minister answered that the province still has ample housing plan capacity (127% outside the MRA, above 130% in the MRA), that the legal basis exists, and that she sees no evidence that plans will be blocked, while the enquiry was answered late due to consultation with the province.
For me it is paramount that provinces provide ample space for the realisation of building plans to meet the regional housing task.
Voor mij staat voorop dat provincies ruim voldoende ruimte bieden aan de realisatie van bouwplannen om invulling te geven aan de regionale bouwopgave.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Terpstra, Peters, Agnes Mulder, Beckerman en Jasper van Dijk over de betaalbaarheid van duurzaamheidsinvesteringen en de leningen die hiervoor moeten worden afgesloten

MPs asked the Minister how homeowners lacking funds for sustainability investments can be protected from being forced into loans, following a NIBUD study showing at least two million owners cannot afford them. The minister agreed that people without borrowing capacity should not be compelled to borrow, pointed to the energy-saving mortgage with income-based repayment and debt forgiveness, and promised to ask the Warmtefonds to monitor financial stress among vulnerable groups.
Daar ben ik het mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Terpstra over het bericht 'Migranten in Westland wonen in tenten en hutjes door gebrek aan huisvesting'

MPs Palland and Terpstra (CDA) asked ministers about reports that migrant workers in Westland live in tents and shacks due to lack of housing, including agreed bed-space targets and national support instruments. Minister Koolmees answered that the municipality reports about 4,500 people housed rather than 'barely any', that Den Haag is responsible for the tent images, and that the government will act on the Aanjaagteam advice and inform parliament by 16 December.
The cabinet is working on this and hopes to inform the House of Representatives about it by 16 December.
Het kabinet is hiermee aan de slag en hoopt voor 16 december daarover de TK te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra over het bericht «Protest kost bouwers handenvol geld: Bezwaar maken voor financieel gewin gaat over rug woningzoekenden»

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether residents who file objections against housing projects for financial gain, often leading to secret settlements with developers, should be stopped and whether the rules should change. The minister said such financially motivated objections are undesirable but that existing law already allows declaring them inadmissible for abuse of rights, while refusing further legal changes and not intervening in contractual freedom of the settlements.
With further amendment, I consider the risk too great that legal protection of parties standing up for their legitimate interests would be undermined.
Bij verdere aanpassing vind ik het risico te groot dat rechtsbescherming van partijen die voor hun gerechtvaardigde belangen opkomen wordt aangetast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp Van Eijs, Beckerman, Laan-Geselschap, Dik-Faber, Nijboer Geluk-Poortvliet en Terpstra over de noodzaak tot investeren in wonen voor senioren

MPs from several parties asked whether a 80,000-unit shortage of senior housing exists, what the government is doing with the taskforce on housing and care, and whether municipalities should be obliged to build senior homes. The minister answered that the shortage figure's source is unclear, that a senior housing monitor will be sent by year-end, that no binding national targets will be imposed, and that the government is supporting local action through taskforces, agreements and subsidy schemes.
Even after inquiry, it is not clear to us what the source of this figure is.
Het is ons, ook na navraag, niet duidelijk wat de bron is van dit aantal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Terpstra over het bericht ‘Vergunningsvrij bouwen gaat tijd opleveren’

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Interior about the Rotterdam 'Architect aan Zet' experiment with permit-free building, its possible adverse effects, and measures to speed up housing construction. The Minister defended the experiment and the planned expansion of permit-free building under the Omgevingswet and Wkb, while acknowledging a risk that buildings may deviate from rules without prior municipal review.
The municipality does not review the plans and there is no permit, but unlike permit-free building there is control over the execution.
De gemeente toetst de plannen niet en er is ook geen sprake van een vergunning, maar er is in tegenstelling tot vergunningvrij bouwen wel controle op de uitvoering.

Whether the next cabinet should have a Minister for Housing, Spatial Planning and Environment is a political choice and consideration for the parties involved in a future cabinet formation.

Of er in het volgend kabinet een Minister van Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer moet komen, is een politieke keuze en afweging die aan politieke partijen betrokken bij een volgende kabinetsformatie is.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het transport van dieren bij hoge temperaturen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal transport at high temperatures, including NVWA inspection numbers, EU temperature and water rules for short journeys, and planned measures. The government reported 78 inspections on hot days with 23 non-compliant situations, said EU rules leave room for member states, and pointed to the national heat protocol and six-monthly evaluations as progress.
A limited number of inspections had not yet been administratively processed at the time of answering these questions.
Een beperkt aantal controles zijn ten tijde van de beantwoording van deze vragen nog niet administratief verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de vervuiling van supermarktproducten

An MP asked the health minister about mineral oil hydrocarbons (MOAH/MOSH) found in supermarket food, whether they are banned, what enforcement and recalls followed, and whether harder action than a renewed appeal to supermarkets is planned. The minister replied that the NVWA does not yet test for these substances because no specific legal limits or sufficient scientific clarity exist, that a European monitoring study runs into 2017 with norms to be considered afterwards, and that companies bear responsibility for safety, with the industry federation acting.
In my answers of 23 November 2015 I indicated that the NVWA is currently not checking for the presence of the mineral oils MOAH and MOSH in foodstuffs.

In mijn antwoorden van 23 november 2015 4 op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber heb ik aangegeven dat de NVWA op dit moment niet op de aanwezigheid van de minerale oliën MOAH en MOSH in levensmiddelen controleert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Çegerek over het feit dat de geloofwaardigheid van keurmerken onder druk staat

MPs Dikkers and Çegerek asked the State Secretary about the ACM finding that eco-label credibility is undermined by proliferation and unclear meaning, and whether government should define criteria and coordinate a framework. The State Secretary referred to his earlier letter, declined to set criteria himself but invited parties to act on ACM and Milieu Centraal recommendations, and noted an agreement to achieve an ordering of robust sustainability labels by end 2016.
I therefore do not consider it reasonable for the government to formulate the requirements itself.
Ik vind het dan ook niet in de rede liggen om vanuit de overheid de eisen te formuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Dikkers over het gebruik van hormoonverstorende stoffen in voedingsverpakkingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked the ministers about hormone-disrupting substances such as BPA in food packaging, the protective measures, alternatives, and Dutch EU presidency efforts. The government answered that BPA exposure should be reduced through tighter EU limits rather than a ban, as substitutes are not yet proven safe, and committed to raising the issue at the Environment Council.
The Cabinet therefore adopts the RIVM advice to promote tightening of the current European standards and to reduce exposure to BPA as far as possible at national level.

Het Kabinet neemt daarom de adviezen van het RIVM over om aanscherping van de huidige Europese normen te bevorderen en om op nationaal niveau de blootstelling aan BPA zo ver mogelijk terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over nieuwe technieken om genetisch gemodificeerde organismen (ggo’s) te ontwikkelen

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about new gene-editing techniques for GMOs, including whether they fall under GMO rules, whether labelling should apply, whether they will be linked to pesticides, and when a national framework for GMO cultivation will be available. The State Secretary answered that the techniques are currently treated as genetic modification pending a European Commission legal analysis, that labelling applies until the techniques are listed in Annex IB, that the techniques are not inherently tied to herbicide use, and that a Rathenau Institute consultation report will inform a national framework.
The Rathenau Institute is preparing a report on this consultation and on that basis I will inform you further about the framework for decision-making on GM cultivation.
Het Rathenau Instituut stelt een rapport op van deze consultatie en op basis daarvan zal ik u nader informeren over het afwegingskader voor besluitvorming over gg-teelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het inspectierapport van Eyes on Animals over paardenmarkten

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an Eyes on Animals inspection report on horse markets, including welfare concerns, transport times, body condition assessment, and night-time NVWA enforcement. The State Secretary acknowledged the welfare risks, said no ban is planned, and promised to revise the horse market protocol, tighten NVWA supervision and export rules, while describing existing inspection staffing and the body condition scoring method.

I will consult with the Horse Sector Council and other stakeholders, including the Animal Protection Society and Eyes on Animals, to consider how the horse market protocol should be revised and tightened.

Ik zal in overleg met de Sectorraad Paarden en de andere stakeholders, waaronder de Dierenbescherming en Eyes on Animals, bezien op welke wijze het paardenmarktenprotocol dient te worden herzien en te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de ingrediënten die aan wijn worden toegevoegd

An MP asked the ministers about additives in wine after a consumer programme, and why wine is exempt from full ingredient labelling. The ministers said EU rules allow certain winemaking processes and exempt drinks above 1.2% alcohol from ingredient labelling, and that they await a Commission report before deciding on mandatory labelling.
As regards possible future mandatory listing of ingredients on alcoholic drinks, I am awaiting the Commission's report.
Voor wat betreft een eventuele toekomstige verplichte vermelding van de ingrediënten op alcoholische dranken wacht ik het verslag van de Commissie af
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over de lange afstandstransporten van kalveren

MPs asked the State Secretary about long-distance calf transports, including reported welfare problems, the number of animals and violations, and whether maximum transport times should be tightened. The government answered that it lacks centralized data on health complaints and violation types, has stopped certifying export of unweaned calves over long distances since December 2015 because vehicles do not meet EU requirements, and has commissioned Wageningen UR research on conditions for such transport.
I am not aware of any figures on complaints regarding the health or possible mortality of the animals imported.
Er zijn mij geen aantallen bekend van klachten met betrekking tot de gezondheid of eventuele sterfte van de dieren die aangevoerd zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Van Dekken over de uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Regiegroep Vitale Varkenshouderij, waarin hij stelt dat hij geen heil ziet in het verkleinen van de varkensstapel

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to respond to the chair of the pig sector steering group, who said reducing the pig herd is no solution, and asked whether the government will keep pushing for shrinking and extensifying pig farming. The State Secretary replied that the current export-dependent model offers little prospect, that the steering group will present a plan in early 2016, and that the herd size may be an outcome of the sector's process rather than a target.
The size of the pig herd may be a result of this process.
De omvang van de varkensstapel kan een resultante zijn van dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het gebruik van het middel Mucusol door visverwerkers

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health whether the NVWA had knowingly allowed Mucusol, a disinfectant, to be used as a fish de-slimming agent in 2008-2009 and why enforcement only started in 2016. The Minister answered that the NVWA has no inspection data showing improper use, that use as a de-slimming agent is permitted, and that the NVWA will check for misuse in regular inspections, without giving a full account of past decisions.
I have no reason to assume that the NVWA did not act correctly in this case.
Ik heb geen reden om aan te nemen dat de NVWA in deze casus niet juist zou hebben gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Van Dekken over de toename van het aantal kiloknallers

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the rise in supermarket 'kilo bargain' meat promotions and whether harder measures were needed. The State Secretary said such promotions are undesirable and shares concern about price pressure, but declined to verify the NGO research and pointed to the sector's sustainability agreement and voluntary commitments.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs does not conduct its own research into supermarket promotions.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken voert geen eigen onderzoek uit naar aanbiedingen van supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Dikkers over het bericht in ‘Groene Ruimte’ dat EFSA (European Food Safety Authority) wijst op mogelijke hormoonverstorende effecten van 15 stoffen

MPs Leenders and Dikkers asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the EFSA finding of possible endocrine-disrupting effects of 15 pesticide substances should lead to a temporary ban, and whether the precautionary principle permits a national use ban pending further EFSA research. The State Secretary answered that EFSA does no new research, that a possible endocrine-disrupting classification does not automatically mean risk, that the Ctgb tests authorised products against exposure limits, and that neither the Commission nor the Ctgb sees grounds to intervene in current authorisations.

The Ctgb informs that classifying an active substance as possibly endocrine-disrupting does not immediately mean there is also a risk when the substance is incorporated into a plant protection product.

Het Ctgb laat weten dat classificatie van een werkzame stof als mogelijk hormoonverstorend niet meteen betekent dat er ook sprake is van een risico als deze stof in een gewasbeschermingsmiddel wordt verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over het bericht «Gezondheid boeren bedreigd door pesticiden»

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked about a report that farmers' health is threatened by pesticides, including the Health Council's findings on nervous-system disorders in farmers and childhood leukaemia in their children, and whether the government would speed up follow-up research. The government answered that it is taking the Health Council advice seriously, that RIVM is preparing a multi-year exposure study with results expected in 2018, and that it will report on progress in June 2016.
The cabinet takes public health very seriously and the Health Council's advice prompted the cabinet to adopt the proposals in that advice.
Het kabinet neemt de gezondheid van de bevolking zeer serieus en het advies van de Gezondheidsraad vormde voor het kabinet aanleiding om de voorstellen in het advies van Gezondheidsraad over te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over de invoering van een tropenrooster voor het vervoer van slachtdieren

Two MPs asked whether the food safety authority NVWA should introduce a night inspection service and an automatic heat-related schedule for transporting slaughter animals, and whether the 30°C transport temperature limit should be lowered. The state secretary replied that the NVWA applied an extended 'tropenrooster' during the July 2015 heatwave, that it will do so again in future hot periods, and that a practical regulation is being developed with the sector, without committing to a specific automatic trigger or temperature.
The NVWA will introduce a tropical schedule in future periods of exceptionally hot weather.
De NVWA zal bij toekomstige periodes van bijzonder warm weer een tropenrooster in werking laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over illegale houtkap in de Amazone en de controle van de NVWA hierop

An MP asked the state secretary about Greenpeace findings that three Dutch timber firms linked to illegal logging in the Amazon were inspected by the NVWA but not sanctioned, and whether such timber reached the market in breach of EU timber rules. The government replied that one firm received a written warning, another passed inspection, a third will receive a warning, and that the NVWA is still investigating the market-entry claim and the due diligence question.
The NVWA is currently investigating this claim from the Greenpeace report.
De NVWA onderzoekt op dit moment deze bewering uit het rapport van Greenpeace.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het opnieuw in de fout gaan van visverwerker Foppen

An MP asked why food processor Foppen was warned in 2010 about using sodium nitrite yet was only re-checked in 2014, and whether NVWA policy will change. The minister replied that the 2010 warning was about stock, the 2014 audit found actual use, risk to health was judged absent, the fine was the maximum, and that NVWA's intervention policy and a supervisory framework will be tightened.
The NVWA's intervention policy means that after a detected violation, follow-up inspections take place to ensure the identified shortcomings have been remedied.
Het interventiebeleid van de NVWA houdt in dat na een geconstateerde overtreding vervolginspecties plaatsvinden om zeker te stellen dat de geconstateerde tekortkomingen zijn verholpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het toegenomen antibioticagebruik bij kippen en de antibioticadoelstelling

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked about the rise in antibiotic use in broiler chickens, its threat to the 70% reduction target for end-2015, and what measures will be taken against poultry farms with high use. The Staatssecretaris acknowledges the rise, attributes it possibly to later treatment at higher weight, announces sector measures and says the 70% target remains but will be hard to reach.
Antibiotic use in the four major livestock sectors (including broiler chickens) fell by 4% in 2014 compared with 2013.
Het antibioticumgebruik in de vier grote veehouderijsectoren (inclusief vleeskuikens) is in 2014 gedaald met 4% ten opzichte van 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het rapport met adviezen voor de aanpak van vogelgriep van de Dierenbescherming

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she views the Dierenbescherming report proposing more animal-friendly bird flu control, and whether she will adopt its recommendations. The State Secretary says progress has been made but many proposals are not feasible in the proposed timeframe, while pointing to ongoing work on vaccines, poultry hygiene scans, transport bans at hatcheries and a review of free-range farms near water.
In summary, the Dierenbescherming proposals are sympathetic but not all feasible, certainly not within the proposed timeline.
Samengevat zijn de voorstellen van de Dierenbescherming sympathiek, maar niet allemaal uitvoerbaar, zeker niet binnen de voorgestelde tijdslijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de etikettering van vruchtendranken

An MP asked the Health Minister about misleading labelling of fruit drinks, including whether front-of-pack names must match the main fruit content and whether naming rules should change. The minister said misleading labels are banned, the NVWA judges case by case, and she will consult European counterparts and industry on possible stricter rules and on naming the main fruit on the front of packs.
I will check with my European colleagues how they deal with these kinds of situations and whether they have specific laws and regulations for them.
Daarom zal ik bij mijn Europese collega’s nagaan hoe zij met dit soort situaties omgaan en of zij hiervoor specifieke wet- en regelgeving kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de verkoop van bedorven slavinken

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether the government would act on a Consumentenbond finding that some supermarket sliced chicken (slavinken) was spoiled before its use-by date and was too high in salt and saturated fat, and how the NVWA inspects such products. The minister answered that the NVWA intervenes when it finds spoiled products, sanctions and sampling are described, the NVWA is not at fault, and salt and fat matters are handled through a voluntary industry accord.
I will discuss the results of the research in the steering group of the Accord.
Ik zal de resultaten van het onderzoek in de stuurgroep van het Akkoord bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de herkomstetikettering op vlees

MP Dikkers (PvdA) asked the Health Minister whether the government would act on a European Parliament resolution calling for mandatory origin labelling of meat in processed products, and would amend the Dutch Warenwet to require it now. Minister Schippers said she supports origin labelling at EU level, will press for it in the Council, but will not amend the Warenwet in advance because a single EU market requires EU-wide rules.
Once this subject is on the agenda of the relevant Council in Brussels, the above-mentioned position will be put forward.
Zodra dit onderwerp op de agenda staat bij de betreffende Raad in Brussel, zal bovengenoemd standpunt ingebracht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht van Foodwatch over de lijst van producten die mogelijk paardenvlees bevatten

An MP asked the Minister of Health why the names of companies that bought Selten meat in the horsemeat scandal were withheld after a Foodwatch FOI request, and who decides on disclosure. The government answered that the Staatssecretaris of Economic Affairs, as the NVWA's parent ministry, decides on disclosure under the Wob, and that disclosure would unfairly harm the companies' reputations, so only a summary without names was released, with citizens' information needs weighed.
Therefore it was chosen, on the basis of article 7 of the Wob, first paragraph, opening words and under c, to provide the data as an extract or summary, that is without the brand and producer names.

Daarom is ervoor gekozen om op basis van artikel 7 van de Wob, eerste lid, aanhef, en onder c, de gegevens te verstrekken in de vorm van een uittreksel of samenvatting, dat wil zeggen zonder de merk- en producentennamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht van Foodwatch over de lijst van producten die mogelijk paardenvlees bevatten

An MP asked why it took about eighteen months for the food safety authority NVWA to release the product names linked to the horsemeat supplier Selten, and why supplier company names were not released. The minister answered that the NVWA refused to disclose company names under the Wet openbaarheid van bestuur, released anonymised product lists in August 2014, and promised a legislative change to enable faster active information disclosure.
Disclosure would constitute an unreasonable disadvantage under the Freedom of Information Act (article 10).
Openbaarmaking zou een onevenredige benadeling op basis van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (artikel 10) betekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over misbruik van EU subsidie voor de kweek van meervallen

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about alleged misuse of EU subsidies for catfish farming, including whether the EU is reclaiming funds and whether subsidies will be recovered and controls strengthened. The State Secretary largely referred to separate letters to parliament, said she did not agree the subsidy was wrong as it was a court matter, and pointed to earlier correction overviews.
I refer you for the answer to the parliamentary letter on subsidy development in aquaculture that was sent to your House at the same time.
Ik verwijs u voor de beantwoording naar de Kamerbrief inzake subsidie ontwikkeling aquacultuur die gelijktijdig aan uw Kamer is verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Dikkers over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten in de pluimveesector structureel worden onderbetaald

MPs Kerstens and Dikkers asked Minister Asscher about reports that temporary agency workers in the poultry sector are structurally underpaid, and whether the Inspectorate SZW and the SNCU have acted. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has run 229 poultry inspections since 2009 with fines mainly for working conditions, none for minimum wage violations, that the SNCU lacks jurisdiction over agencies mainly active in poultry, and that the Inspectorate will investigate three recent formal cao-compliance requests and may discuss the issue with sectoral social partners.
The Inspectorate SZW recently received three formal requests to start a cao-compliance investigation in the poultry sector.
Recentelijk heeft de Inspectie SZW een drietal formele verzoeken ontvangen om een cao-nalevingsonderzoek te starten in de pluimveesector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het Ierse rundvlees dat uit Holland komt

An MP asked whether Jumbo mislabelled beef as Irish when it was Dutch-raised, and how the government would respond. The minister answered that the NVWA addressed one franchise store's labelling error, which was corrected, and that enforcement options and consumer routes exist but the matter is considered closed for the NVWA.
In that store, Dutch beef was sold instead of Irish beef.
In die winkel is in plaats van Iers rundvlees Nederlands rundvlees verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Jan Vos over het bericht “Alleen nog duurzame soja is stap te ver voor vleesindustrie”

Two MPs (Dikkers and Jan Vos, PvdA) asked the government whether the meat sector will meet its 2015 pledge to buy only certified sustainable soy, and what the state can do to help. Minister Ploumen answers that the 2013 target was missed, that the sector's ambition for 2015 remains, that RTRS supply exceeded Dutch needs, and that the government will keep urging industry to meet its commitments without taking binding measures.
The target for 2013 was therefore indeed not met.
De doelstelling voor 2013 is dus inderdaad niet gehaald
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over de inbeslagneming van vee bij een Friese bioboer-oormerkweigeraar

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked whether the government knew the NVWA had seized cattle from a Frisian organic farmer who refused ear tags, and what it would do to develop alternatives for conscientious objectors. The Secretary of State confirmed the seizure and said a proposal for an alternative identifier was submitted to Brussels but lacked support, that a 20% CAP cut remains under EU rules, and that she will keep pursuing an EU-level alternative and discuss the cut with the Commission.
For the second means of identification, one could for example think of a rumen bolus with a chip or a chip implanted under the skin.
Voor het tweede identificatiemiddel kan bijvoorbeeld gedacht worden aan een maagbolus met een chip of een chip welke onderhuids wordt aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Kamerleden Cegerek en Dikkers over het bericht dat er teveel dioxine gevonden is in eieren nabij de afvalverbrandingsoven Harlingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked about reports of excessive dioxin in eggs from backyard hens near the Harlingen waste incinerator, whether eggs and milk should be removed, and whether the incinerator and its enforcement by a regional agency posing a conflict of interest are adequately checked. The minister replied that the eggs were not marketed, that existing consumption advice still applies, that a re-evaluation of the EU tolerable weekly intake will be pushed in Europe, that incinerator emissions are continuously monitored and tested twice yearly, that no extra research is needed, and that the regional agency only advises municipalities and enforcement is not delegated.
The province is the competent authority for the waste incineration installation and is not a shareholder.
De provincie is bevoegd gezag voor de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie en geen aandeelhouder.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Wolbert en Dikkers over het niet voldoen van testen die controleren op de aanwezigheid van hormoonverstorende stoffen in consumentenproducten

MPs Wolbert and Dikkers asked the health minister whether standard tests can detect low but harmful concentrations of hormone-disrupting substances in consumer products, which substances may slip through, and whether national measures and better consumer information are needed. The minister answered that current OECD tests are broadly adequate for some effects, that low-dose risks remain scientifically uncertain, and that no additional national product restrictions are planned for now, while the leaflet and website for pregnant women will be reviewed.

However, it is important that the government contributes to making information available about these uncertain risks, so that citizens have a course of action and can make conscious choices themselves.
Wel is het belangrijk dat de overheid bijdraagt aan het beschikbaar maken van informatie over deze onzekere risico’s, zodat de burger een handelingsperspectief heeft en zelf bewuste keuzes kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Wolbert over het bericht dat fabrikanten van levensmiddelen verdoezelen hoeveel suiker in producten zitten

MPs asked whether food manufacturers use many names for sugar and claims like 'no added sugars' to mislead consumers, and what labelling should require. The minister said the current EU and Dutch rules already require specific ingredient names, that 'no added sugars' claims are restricted, and that mandatory nutrition declarations with sugar content come from December 2016, and she agreed sugar content should be clearly stated on children's products.
In my view there is still generally too much sugar in our food supply.
Naar mijn mening zit er ten algemene nog teveel suiker in ons levensmiddelenaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Dikkers over het zeer trage betaalgedrag van een aantal grootbedrijven ten koste van het MKB

MPs Mei Li Vos and Dikkers asked whether large firms such as DE Master Blenders lengthening payment terms to 180-200 days complies with the 60-day statutory limit, and whether enforcement should be strengthened, including by the ACM. The minister replied that civil contracts are not subject to government enforcement, that public supervision is undesirable due to administrative burden, and that suppliers can go to civil court, collective action, or the ACM.
Civil-law contracts are not a subject of government enforcement.
Civielrechtelijke overeenkomsten zijn geen onderwerp van handhaving van overheidswege.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Dikkers en Wolbert over de uitbreiding van een melkveebedrijf in Coevorden naar 1.900 koeien

MPs Van Dekken, Dikkers and Wolbert asked the state secretary about a dairy farm expansion in Coevorden to 1,900 cows, its health and environmental impact, consistency with the cabinet's livestock scale position, whether the province can block it, and whether abolishing milk quotas will drive similar expansions. The state secretary answered that environmental permitting is a matter for province and municipality, that a new Wet Dieren provision will let them set health-based limits on livestock size, and that no data exist on the number of farms with expansion plans.
Provinces and municipalities can, under the Spatial Planning Act, for example set a maximum on stable size and impose restrictions on the establishment or expansion of livestock farms.

Provincies en gemeenten kunnen op basis van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening bijvoorbeeld een maximum stellen aan de stalgrootte en beperkingen opleggen aan de vestiging of uitbreiding van veehouderijbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over ziektes bij dieren door mest in stallen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal illnesses caused by manure and ammonia in stables, citing a Wakker Dier study and asking about antibiotic use, housing standards and measures to reduce harm. The State Secretary disputed the study's one-to-one causal links, said no structured comparison of housing systems exists, pointed to farmers' responsibility and existing rules, and listed measures such as a stricter ammonia standard in 2014 and a UDD antibiotic regulation.
The Wakker Dier study is a collection of quotes from various studies.
Het onderzoek van Wakker Dier betreft een verzameling van quotes uit verschillende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer waaruit blijkt dat bijna 3 miljard euro aan landbouwsubsidies onterecht is uitgekeerd

The MP asked about a European Court of Auditors report finding nearly 3 billion euro in wrongly paid agricultural subsidies, and whether Dutch money is affected, who pays corrections, and how agri-environment payments are checked. The State Secretary answered that Dutch funds were not sampled, the Dutch error margin is within the 2% tolerance, recovery of about 8 million euro a year is pursued, and at least 5% of agri-environment agreements are checked on site.
The European Court of Auditors report is based on representative samples in the member states.
Het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer is gebaseerd op representatieve steekproeven in de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Jacobi over de veiligheid van mestsilo’s

MPs Dikkers and Jacobi asked about the safety of manure silos after a fatal accident in Makkinga, including the adequacy of rules, inspection practices and comparison with neighbouring countries. The minister answered that current rules are adequate, pending the Safety Board's investigation, and that a reaction will be sent to Parliament after publication.
In my view, the current regulations for manure silos and manure gases are adequate.
Mijns inziens is de huidige regelgeving voor mestsilo's en mestgassen adequaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de prijzenoorlog tussen de supermarkten

An MP asked whether farmers are bearing the cost of the supermarket price war and what instruments the state has to protect primary producers' income. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to the new voluntary EU/Dutch fair trading code pilot with complaint and arbitration procedures, and said sustainability is the sector's own responsibility.
I consider it important that negotiations between parties in the agri-food chain take place transparently so that a fair price results.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er op transparante wijze tussen partijen in de agroketen wordt onderhandeld en dat zo een eerlijke prijs ontstaat.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over het bericht «Resistente schimmel verspreidt zich» (ingezonde

Two MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers about reports that resistant Aspergillus fungi are spreading, possibly linked to azole fungicides used in pesticides and biocides. The minister acknowledged a possible link, said the risk is limited to high-risk patients, pointed to a reference laboratory and a ministry-commissioned study due in summer 2013, and did not commit to new measures.
The risk to public health is limited to certain risk groups that are especially susceptible to infections.
Het risico voor de volksgezondheid beperkt zich tot bepaalde risicogroepen die in verhoogde mate vatbaar zijn voor infecties.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, Jacobi en Wolbert over het bericht dat bij 44% van de Europeanen glyfosaat in de urine zit

MPs Dikkers, Jacobi and Wolbert asked the health and economic affairs ministers about a German study finding glyphosate in the urine of 44% of Europeans, including whether the NVWA tests crops and what risk applies. The minister answered that the RIVM sees no health risk at these microgram levels, that the NVWA tests grains with no MRL exceedances, and that glyphosate is under EU re-evaluation which will be followed closely.
Because the RIVM currently has no indication that the glyphosate levels found in urine give cause for concern, there is no reason to inquire with neighbouring countries about such research.

Omdat het RIVM op dit moment geen aanwijzingen heeft dat de gevonden glyfosaatwaarden in de urine reden tot zorg geven, is er geen aanleiding om bij de omringende landen te informeren naar dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Van Dekken over het bericht dat weidegang niet noodzakelijk is voor weidepremie

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked whether cow grazing is required for the grazing premium and whether the term 'weidemelk' is misleading, and asked for definitions of sustainability labels. The state secretary replied that weidemelk requires grazing (at least 120 days, 6 hours a day), that existing Warenwet rules on misleading labelling suffice, and that no further conditions or talks with companies are needed.
The term 'weidemelk' applies only to milk from cows that actually get grazing, and in practice this is the case.
De term «weidemelk» geldt alleen voor melk van koeien die daadwerkelijk weidegang krijgen, dat is in de praktijk ook het geval.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over de uitzending Wild West op Zee van Zembla

An MP asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast alleging illegal fishing practices by Parlevliet & Van der Plas, its frequent reflagging, and the adequacy of fisheries inspection and quota enforcement. The state secretary answered that the offences occurred under foreign flags so the responsible flag states handle them, that German inspection is ongoing, and that she will inform parliament, while defending existing controls and planned measures on the landing obligation.
Since in all cases the ships fly a foreign flag and fall under the responsibility of the respective flag states, the responsible authorities did not inform the Netherlands.

Aangezien het in alle gevallen schepen onder een buitenlandse vlag betreft die onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de betreffende vlagstaten vallen, is Nederland door de verantwoordelijke autoriteiten niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht ‘vervolging om fraude met scharreleieren’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of eggs sold as free-range without meeting the housing density norms, how controls on the authenticity of quality marks work, and whether similar fraud occurs in other sectors such as free-range pork. The State Secretary explained the NCAE and Skal control regimes and the enforcement routes, said the supervision system is being analysed and promised to inform parliament of the results.

In view of the ongoing investigation into egg fraud, supervision in the egg chain is currently being further analysed and the possibilities to strengthen the current supervision system on stocking density at laying hen farms are being examined.

Naar aanleiding van het nog lopende onderzoek naar fraude met eieren wordt het toezicht in de eierketen op dit moment nader geanalyseerd en wordt nagegaan welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de huidige gehanteerde toezichtsystematiek op de bezettingsdichtheid op legpluimveebedrijven te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Dekken over de handelwijze van de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in de zaak Selten

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked about the NVWA's handling of the Selten meat case, including mislabelling of horse meat as beef, destruction of beef stock, delayed notification after a contaminated horse import, and the EU horse passport system. The government declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, explained labelling rules and the basis for recalling unverifiable meat, and withheld the names of buyers citing privacy law.
In general, and also in this case, we refrain from answering questions about ongoing criminal cases or claims by suspects in ongoing criminal cases.
In het algemeen en ook in deze casus onthouden wij ons van beantwoording van vragen over lopende strafzaken dan wel beweringen van verdachten in lopende strafzaken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos, Dikkers en Recourt over het bericht dat er tritium in het grondwater is gekomen door een lek van de reactor in Petten

MPs Jan Vos, Dikkers and Recourt asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports of tritium in groundwater from a leak at the Petten reactor, including how long the leak went unnoticed, the amount released, health risks, and prevention. Minister Kamp answered that the leak was found on 11 November 2012, roughly 10 GBq was estimated released, RIVM saw no direct health risk, and NRG is repairing the pipe and cleaning up under KFD supervision, with further inspection and tightened maintenance.
The KFD has instructed NRG to tighten and carry out the inspection and maintenance programme.
De KFD heeft NRG opgedragen om het inspectie- en onderhoudsprogramma aan te scherpen en uit te voeren
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers over het bericht dat energiebedrijven nog steeds niet openbaar maken of ze bloedkolen gebruiken

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether Dutch energy companies disclose whether they use coal linked to human rights abuses, including coal from Drummond mines in Colombia, and what the coal dialogue has achieved. The state secretary answered that self-regulation via the coal dialogue is preferred, that energy companies proposed only aggregated disclosure of mines citing commercial sensitivity, and listed interim dialogue results with the dialogue expected to run to end 2012.
Information on the specific suppliers of coal to energy companies is, according to the latter, commercially sensitive.
Informatie over de specifieke leveranciers van steenkolen aan energiebedrijven is, volgens laatstgenoemden, commercieel gevoelig.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers over financiering van Nigeriaanse veiligheidstroepen door Shell

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether the government will hold Shell to account for funding Nigerian security forces linked to alleged human rights abuses and whether this conflicts with the Voluntary Principles, which the Netherlands chairs. The minister answered that the government raises these issues with Shell regularly, that Shell says it applies the Voluntary Principles, and that the government presses Nigeria to endorse them, while transparency reporting is left to participants themselves.
For the implementation of the VPs and communication about it with stakeholders, the participants in the VPs, including Shell, are themselves responsible.
Voor de invulling van de VP’s en de communicatie daarover met belanghebbenden zijn de deelnemers aan de VP’s, waaronder Shell, zelf verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers aangaande aardschokken in Noord-Groningen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked whether recent earthquakes in Groningen are known, whether they have occurred for years, whether the burden of proof for gas-extraction damage should be reversed, and whether residents will be informed. The minister confirmed the quakes and recurrence, defended the existing claims procedure via NAM and the independent Tcbb as effective, and offered information on causes and damage handling.
I therefore see no reason to amend the procedure.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de procedure aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over het bericht dat de NAM gebruikt gaat maken van fracking nabij Blija

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked whether NAM's fracking near Blija is permitted under its existing licence, how often fracking is used in the Netherlands, and what objection rights residents have. The minister answered that the licence allows fracs, that notification was given under the general rules, that no formal objection or appeal route exists for fracking in existing wells, and that residents were informed through local newspapers.
Current laws and regulations provide no formal objection or appeal possibility when applying this type of technique in existing wells.
De huidige wet- en regelgeving biedt geen formele bezwaar- en beroepmogelijkheid bij het toepassen van dit soort technieken in bestaande putten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht dat de inspecties van de Milieudienst Rijnmond fors zijn gedaald

An MP asks whether inspections by the Rijnmond environmental service (DCMR) fell by tens of percent over ten years and what the consequences are for safety. The state secretary answers that the decline is not of that magnitude, partly due to changed counting definitions, that high-risk Brzo inspections have increased, and that safety remains paramount.
There is no decrease of tens of percent as stated in the report.
Er is geen sprake van een afname met tientallen procenten zoals in het bericht wordt vermeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over Douwe Egberts en de aanbesteding voor warme dranken- en vendingautomaten

An MP asked the government about the award of a hot drinks and vending machine tender for the Ministry of Defence and FMH to Douwe Egberts, including how fair-trade and living-wage criteria fit EU case law, how they are enforced, and whether the listing coincided with the company's stock market debut. The government answered that the tender followed EU-compliant special performance conditions, set out three living-wage compliance regimes with Douwe Egberts under regime 1, and stated the award was objective and unrelated to the listing.
The award was based on the most economically advantageous tender and is entirely separate from the stock market listing.
De gunning is op basis van de economisch meest voordelige inschrijving geweest en staat geheel los van de beursnotering.
Antwoord op vragen van de de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over de geplande aanleg van het agrologistieke bedrijventerrein Nieuw-Reijerwaard bij Ridderkerk

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked why the province of Zuid-Holland omitted air quality from the MER for the Nieuw-Reijerwaard logistics business park, questioning its demand, location and irreversible steps. The minister answered that the province is the competent authority under a decentralised budget, that air quality is covered by the NSL monitoring tool, and that the Rijk backed the project as an alternative location, with the provincial inpassingsplan due for adoption in spring 2013.
The province of Zuid-Holland is therefore also the competent authority for determining the scope and level of detail of the MER to be drawn up.
De provincie Zuid-Holland is daarmee ook het bevoegde gezag voor het vaststellen van de reikwijdte en het detailniveau van het op te stellen MER.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht dat Inspecties zich onafhankelijker moeten opstellen

MP Dikkers asked whether inspectorates should operate more independently to intervene earlier, as in the Odfjell case, and whether an independent review of DCMR is needed. The state secretary answered that several independent inspectorates supervise Odfjell, that he is considering giving the Inspectorate national enforcement power (doorzettingsmacht) within existing law, and that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid is investigating Odfjell and DCMR.
At the general debate on risk policy and external safety of 27 June 2012 I deliberately indicated that I am considering giving my inspectorate more enforcement power.
Ik heb in het algemeen overleg Risicobeleid en externe veiligheid van 27 juni 2012 bewust aangegeven dat ik overweeg mijn inspectiedienst meer doorzettingsmacht te geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, De Lange en Smeets over Shell’s gebrekkige rapportage over olielekkages in Nigeria en compensatie daarvan

MPs Dikkers, De Lange and Smeets asked the government about Shell's inaccurate reporting of oil spills in Nigeria, independent investigation, cleanup and compensation. The minister answered that the Bodo spill is under litigation and a NCP complaint is pending, that Nigerian law assigns spill investigations to joint teams, and that the Netherlands supports dialogue and oversight initiatives while Shell has accepted responsibility for the Bodo cleanup.
The extent of the pollution and the amount of compensation are the subject of a civil case.
De omvang van de vervuiling en de hoogte van de schadeloosstelling zijn onderwerp van een civiel proces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven, Dikkers en van Tongeren inzake het verpakkingenakkoord

Three MPs asked the state secretary whether the deadline for signing the packaging agreement with industry could be moved to 5 July, and what the legal basis was for refusing. The state secretary answered that the deadline cannot be moved, pointed to the Belastingplan 2012 requirement to report by 30 June, and said the agreement was already signed.
It is not possible to postpone the agreement to 5 July.
Het is niet mogelijk het akkoord te verschuiven naar 5 juli.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, De Lange en Smeets over de vernieuwing van de licentie van Shell in Nigeria
