Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they accept the renewal of Shell's Nigerian licence despite pollution from oil spills, what the Dutch government thinks of Shell Netherlands' remarks on polluted water, and whether they have discussed compensation for local residents with Shell. The government answered that licence renewals are a matter between Nigeria and the companies, that it has intensive contact with Shell on MVO and the Niger Delta, and that it facilitates a dialogue on pollution there.
Renewal of licences is a matter between the Nigerian government and companies with which the Nigerian government wishes to do business.
Verlenging van licenties is een zaak tussen de Nigeriaanse overheid en bedrijven waar de Nigeriaanse overheid zaken mee wenst te doen.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Recourt en Jacobi over de gevolgen voor Den Oever van een dijkverhoging door het Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier

MPs Dikkers, Recourt and Jacobi asked the state secretary about the consequences for Den Oever of a dike raising by the Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier, including whether an integrated approach was considered and whether a commission's recommendations were taken into account. The state secretary replied that the water board is primarily responsible under a subsidy programme, that an integrated alternative was studied and rejected on cost grounds, and that the concept preferred option can still be adjusted with the parties while the province safeguards regional interests.
The manager, in this case the Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier (HHNK), is primarily responsible for carrying out this project.
De beheerder, in dit geval Hoogheemraadschap Hollands Noorderkwartier (HHNK) , is primair verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van dit project.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Dikkers over de berichtgeving dat woningcorporaties geen prioriteit geven aan recycling

MPs Monasch and Dikkers asked whether housing associations are neglecting recycling of lamps and luminaires and whether the government should improve their recycling results. The state secretary acknowledged that only about half of discarded lamps are collected, called the missed opportunity a gap in the collection system, and promised to alert housing associations via their association and to examine collection options in implementing the revised EU WEEE directive.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over de SO2 uitstoot van afvalverbrander van Sita

An MP asked whether the ILT (formerly VROM-Inspectie) considers the Sita waste incinerator's SO2 emissions too high and whether the emission norm will be lowered. The state secretary replied that the ILT sought a stricter norm but the Raad van State did not side with it, that the permitted value falls within the EU best-available-techniques range, and that no change is planned, while noting alternative abatement techniques exist.
No, the Inspectorate for the Living Environment and Transport (ILT, formerly VROM-Inspectie) tried to have a stricter SO2 emission norm included in the permit issued by the province of Noord-Brabant.
Nee, de Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport (ILT, voorheen VROM-Inspectie) heeft getracht in de vergunning van de provincie Noord-Brabant een strengere norm voor SO 2 -uitstoot op te laten nemen.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het bericht dat kantoren vaak energiezuiniger kunnen

MP Dikkers asked whether energy-efficient offices waste energy through misuse, whether the government will engage owners and users, and whether the same problem affects government buildings and what savings are possible. The government answered that the Jones Lang LaSalle study rests on a small sample and does not separate building energy from plug-load, so it gives little basis for conclusions, while the Rijksgebouwendienst has already started a programme to improve climate installation use in government buildings.

The Rijksgebouwendienst already found some years ago that too much energy is structurally consumed due to insufficient attention to the proper functioning of climate installations, including through incorrect use.

Door de Rijksgebouwendienst is reeds enkele jaren geleden geconstateerd dat er structureel te veel energie wordt verbruikt door onvoldoende aandacht aan de goede werking van klimaatinstallaties, onder andere door onjuist gebruik daarvan.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het bericht dat Shell Chinees schaliegas gaat zoeken en produceren

An MP asked whether Shell's agreement with CNPC on Chinese shale gas includes rules on water, chemicals and working conditions, and whether the minister will press Shell for enforceable terms or oppose shale gas extraction. The minister replied that he has no insight into private contracts and no power to set rules outside Dutch territory, pointed to Shell's public commitments and operating principles, and said he cannot yet say whether shale gas can be developed safely pending a Dutch risk study.
I have no insight into agreements that companies conclude with each other, so also not into the arrangements made between Shell and China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC).
Ik heb geen inzicht in overeenkomsten die bedrijven met elkaar sluiten, dus ook niet in de afspraken die gemaakt zijn tussen Shell en China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC).
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Dikkers over het ontbreken van een deugdelijk rampenplan bij TWO Chemical Logistics

Two PvdA MPs asked why TWO Chemical Logistics in Nijmegen reportedly lacks an adequate disaster plan and what inspections found. The minister reported 2011 Brzo and environmental inspections with remedial deadlines, and said the regional safety board aims to adopt an updated disaster plan on 10 May 2012.
The board of the Gelderland Zuid Safety Region aims to adopt the new disaster plan on 10 May 2012.
Het bestuur van de Veiligheidsregio Gelderland Zuid streeft naar vaststelling van het nieuwe rampbestrijdingsplan op 10 mei 2012.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het rapport van milieudefensie over Biokerosine

An MP asks the ministers about a Milieudefensie report criticising biokerosene, including food security, social sustainability criteria, indirect land-use change, climate neutrality under the ETS, and government support. The state secretary answers that EU sustainability criteria apply, that the government supports indirect land-use change inclusion and advanced biofuels, and describes existing funding and initiatives.
The Netherlands, together with other member states, has repeatedly urged the European Commission to include ILUC at European scale in the sustainability assessment.
Nederland heeft, samen met andere lidstaten, meermaals bij de Europese Commissie erop aangedrongen ILUC op Europese schaal mee te nemen in de duurzaamheidsbeoordeling.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Recourt en Van Dam over het Haarlems Dagblad

MPs Dikkers, Recourt and Van Dam asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether the Haarlems Dagblad and Gooi- en Eemlander might disappear under Telegraaf Media Groep plans, and whether legal means exist to prevent it. The minister replied that TMG and HDC Media had stated no plan exists to close titles, that the press sector is primarily responsible for its own market problems, and that the government sees no reason to intervene.
The government therefore pursues a very restrained policy towards the press sector.
De overheid voert dan ook een zeer terughoudend beleid ten aanzien van de perssector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans over de staking van de olieproductie in Zuid-Sudan

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about the South Sudan oil production shutdown, alleged Sudanese seizure of oil, Dutch and EU roles in the negotiations, and the humanitarian situation. The minister answered that both states should revise unilateral steps and resume talks under the AU panel, that the Netherlands plays a supporting role, that the EU's role is supportive, and that the Netherlands will monitor the humanitarian situation.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over de steenkolendialoog

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the government about the stalled coal dialogue, supply-chain transparency for coal origin, and whether Nuon's commercial interests justify withholding it. The government replied that the dialogue is progressing, that origin disclosure is commercially sensitive and an imperfect indicator, and that it will invite parties to be transparent without itself publishing results.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation will, from its observer position, call on the parties involved to be transparent about the progress of the dialogue and the results achieved when the occasion arises.

Het ministerie van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, zal vanuit zijn waarnemerspositie, de betrokken partijen oproepen bij gelegenheid zelf transparant te zijn over het verloop van de dialoog en de bereikte resultaten.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat Indonesië kogels inzet tegen protesterende werknemers (

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the ministers about reports that Indonesian police used bullets against striking workers, including alleged deaths, and whether arms sales such as Leopard tanks should be halted. The government said the death toll could not be confirmed, that human rights concerns are raised bilaterally and in the EU dialogue, that arms exports are assessed case by case under the EU criteria, and that it is considering a parliamentary motion.
On 15 December, a motion by MP El Fassed on this issue was adopted. The government is considering how to implement the motion.
Op 15 december jl. is een motie van het kamerlid El Fassed aangenomen, die op deze kwestie ingaat. De regering beraadt zich op uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over beschietingen van kinderen bij de grens met de Gazastrook

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the foreign minister about reported shootings of children near the Gaza border and Israel's restrictions on building materials for Gaza. The minister condemned violence against children, said Israel has legitimate security needs and must act within international law, and said Dutch concerns are shared with Israel.
On the basis of the available information I cannot assess whether these Israeli military actions, as described in the question, were specifically directed against children.
Ik kan op basis van de beschikbare informatie niet beoordelen of deze Israëlische militaire acties zoals in de vraag gesteld zich specifiek tegen kinderen richtten.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over kinderarbeid in de cacaoketen

MPs Dikkers, Gesthuizen and Voordewind asked the government about child labour in the cocoa chain, including the Child Labour Platform, IDH's programme links, the Harkin-Engel Protocol targets and the reliability of industry commitments. The State Secretary answered that the CLP was set up independently of IDH programmes, that child labour is integrated in certification standards, and that guarantees cannot be given, especially in Ivory Coast.
Guarantees can certainly not be given in Ivory Coast.
Zekerheden zijn zeker in Ivoorkust niet te geven.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Smeets en Timmermans (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw, en Innovatie over het grootste lek in een olieveld van Shell in Nigeria sinds tie

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers about a large oil spill from a Shell pipeline off Nigeria, covering environmental and economic damage, liability, cleanup oversight, and compliance with OECD guidelines and Ruggie Principles. The government answered that Nigerian authorities determine damage and liability, that SNEPCO is cleaning up, that no economic impact information is yet available, and that the OECD guidelines are enforced via the National Contact Point and ongoing dialogue with Shell.
It is for the Nigerian authorities to determine under Nigerian law who is liable for the oil spill, its cleanup, and to decide on any compensation.

Het is aan de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten om op grond van het Nigeriaanse recht vast te stellen wie aansprakelijk is voor de olielekkage, het opruimen daarvan en te beslissen over eventuele schadevergoeding.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over Afghaanse wetgeving die de in de praktijk niet wordt toegepast (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

Two MPs (Dikkers and Timmermans, PvdA) asked the Foreign Minister why Afghan laws protecting women from violence are barely enforced, and what the government will do bilaterally, through the EU and at the Bonn conference. The minister acknowledged the enforcement shortfall, said Dutch and EU engagement on women's rights is ongoing with significant funding, and argued that aid need not be directly conditioned on specific reforms.
A direct link between aid and the improvement of women's rights is therefore not necessary.
Een directe koppeling tussen hulp en de verbetering van vrouwenrechten is daarom niet nodig.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Ferrier (CDA) en Dikkers en Vermeij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het feit dat het ABP betrokken is bij land

MPs from CDA and PvdA asked why the ABP pension fund's EUR 47 million investment in the Global Solidarity Forest Fund in Mozambique was linked to alleged land grabbing, and what the government would do about it. The state secretary said the ABP is a privatised fund at arm's length from the cabinet, that the relevant ministries would raise the matter in the employers' council and accountability body, and that pension transparency rules are planned.
ABP is a privatised fund and, like other pension funds in the Netherlands, is therefore at arm's length from the cabinet.
ABP is een geprivatiseerd fonds en staat daarmee net als andere pensioenfondsen in Nederland op afstand van het kabinet.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Timmermans over oriënterende gesprekken die Shell voert in Zuid-Sudan

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked whether Shell is exploring activities in South Sudan, including a possible pipeline to Ethiopia, and how the government ensures responsible conduct. The minister confirmed a general exploratory visit notified in advance to the ministry and embassy, said Shell has no pipeline plans, and pointed to OECD guidelines and Shell's assurances on transparency.
Shell has informed that it has no plans to construct a pipeline from South Sudan to Ethiopia.
Shell heeft laten weten dat het geen voornemens heeft om een pijpleiding van Zuid-Sudan naar Ethiopië aan te leggen.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers over het protest tegen mijnbouw in Mali

An MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs about a protest tour against a planned uranium mine in Mali, the impact of mining on local food security and water, and whether the government supports local participation and technical assistance. The state secretary acknowledged the report, stated that mining impacts depend on location and that environmental controls need improvement, pointed to Mali's EIA requirements, EITI membership and several capacity-building programmes.
It would go too far to answer this question positively in general terms.
Het zou te ver strekken om deze vraag in algemene zin positief te beantwoorden.

Vragen het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de waarschuwing van de International Land Coalition over negatieve impact van landgrabbing (ingezonden 21 december 2011).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about the International Land Coalition's warning on negative impacts of land grabbing, including Dutch-financed investments and the protection of local communities' land rights. The government says it lacks systematic data on land footprints of supported firms, relies on OECD guidelines and ambassador-level engagement, and pledges continued support for local land-rights claims.
Implementing agencies such as AgentschapNL do not systematically keep track of how much land is taken up by the companies they support in developing countries.
Uitvoeringsorganisaties als AgentschapNL houden niet systematisch bij hoeveel beslag er gelegd wordt op grond door ondersteunde bedrijven in ontwikkelingslanden.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verkiezingsuitslag in de Democratische Republiek Congo (DRC) (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about alleged large-scale fraud in the DRC's 2011 presidential election, the opposition's claim to victory, risks of violence, Kabila's legitimacy, economic motives of foreign backers, support for human rights defenders and safety of Dutch nationals. The minister acknowledged serious shortcomings and a lack of transparency, called for dialogue and reaffirmed diplomatic engagement, while stating no international mission found Tshisekedi would have won without the irregularities.

The Netherlands shares the conclusions of the EU observation mission and High Representative Catherine Ashton that the Congolese presidential elections were marred by serious shortcomings and a lack of transparency.

Nederland deelt de conclusies van de EU-waarnemingsmissie en Hoge Vertegenwoordiger Catherine Ashton dat de Congolese presidentsverkiezingen gepaard zijn gegaan met serieuze tekortkomingen en een gebrek aan transparantie.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de toename van geweld in de Democratische Republiek in Congo (DRC) (ingezonden 8 december 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about rising violence and suspected electoral fraud in the DRC after the November 2011 elections, and whether he would press the issue urgently in the EU and UN and hold the Congolese authorities to their human rights obligations. The minister answered that irregularities were reported, that the EU and UN have repeatedly issued statements calling for transparency and calm, and that the Netherlands will keep raising human rights in EU and bilateral channels.
The Netherlands will continue to do this both within the EU and bilaterally.
Nederland zal dit zowel in EU-verband als bilateraal blijven doen.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind, Schouten (ChristenUnie), Ferrier (CDA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Dijkhoff (VVD), Van der Staaij (SGP), Dikkers (PvdA), Gesthuizen (SP) en Hachchi (D66)

Ten MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour in Turkish hazelnut harvesting one year after it was first reported, including whether enforcement is adequate, whether companies are meeting their responsibilities, and the status of various studies and working groups. The government answered that the problem lies mainly with Turkey, that the embassy raised it with Turkish authorities and funds a study, that industry bodies have adopted guidelines and a Turkish action plan exists, but that it could not confirm concrete results of the Turkish working group and could not answer in time for the scheduled debate.
The cabinet will continue to raise this issue within the EU framework, including in the Council conclusions.
Het kabinet zal hier in EU-kader aandacht voor blijven vragen, ook in de Raadsconclusies.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de alarmerende situatie van mensenrechtenverdedigers in de Democratische Republiek Congo (DRC) (ingezonden 4 november 20

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the foreign minister about the situation of five human rights defenders in the DRC, EU coordination on monitoring them, emergency visas, Shelter Cities, and urging EU High Representative Ashton to prioritise the issue. The minister replied that Nederland will monitor Katende with EU partners, that no listed defender has requested an emergency visa, that visas are only for acute emergencies, and that the EU is already addressing the issue.
With EU partners in Kinshasa it was agreed that the Netherlands will take on monitoring the situation of Jean Claude Katende.
Met de EU-partners in Kinshasa is afgesproken dat Nederland het monitoren van de situatie van Jean Claude Katende op zich zal nemen.

Vragen van de leden Smeets, Dikkers en Groot (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken en aan de staatssecretarissen van Economie Landbouw en Innovatie, en van F

MPs asked whether multinationals such as Shell should be obliged to disclose tax payments and royalties per country and project, and whether Dutch tax policy attracting extractive firms is problematic. The government answered that transparency is supported via international initiatives (EITI, EU and OECD country-by-country reporting work), that it will not address individual companies on their payments, and that Dutch tax treaties are public.
The Netherlands favours transparency and seeks international agreements that apply to all internationally operating companies.
Nederland is voorstander van transparantie en streeft naar internationale afspraken die gelden voor alle internationaal opererende bedrijven.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de arrestatie van twee journalisten in Zuid-Sudan (ingezonden 11 november 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about the detention of two journalists in South Sudan held without trial by the National Security Services beyond the constitutional 24-hour limit, and about press freedom. The minister acknowledged the detention, said the 24-hour rule concerns police rather than the security service whose rules are still being developed, called the situation for journalists worrying, and said the Netherlands would raise the case bilaterally and in the EU and press for compliance with human rights obligations.
Although those involved were released without formal charge on 18 November, the Netherlands will hold the South Sudanese government to account for how the matter was handled.
Hoewel betrokkenen zonder formele aanklacht op 18 november zijn vrijgelaten, zal Nederland de Zuid-Sudanese regering aanspreken op de gang van zaken.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over rechten voor Afghaanse vrouwen die in het geding zijn (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the foreign minister about risks to Afghan women's rights after 2014, the lack of nationwide implementation of the anti-violence law, funding, and inclusive peace talks. The minister replied that women's rights remain a priority, cited Dutch programmes and funding of about EUR 7.2 million, and said Nederland will keep raising the issue bilaterally and in the EU.
The Netherlands will therefore continue to advocate strict adherence to the agreed conditions.
Nederland zal daarom blijven pleiten voor het strikt handhaven van de overeengekomen voorwaarden.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de toenemende mate van onderdrukking van persvrijheid en het recht op demonstratie in Uganda (ingezonden 3 november 2011

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the Foreign Minister about rising repression of press freedom and the right to demonstrate in Uganda, including arrests of activists, a public-order bill and a press amendment bill, and a planned end to bail for detained protesters. The minister answered that the embassy monitors the cases and raises the concerns bilaterally, in the EU and as chair of a donor group, and that the bail proposal is not yet a concrete bill.
The Netherlands, within the EU and as chair of the Justice, Law and Order donor group, has repeatedly raised the repressive policy on demonstrations.
Nederland heeft in EU-verband en als voorzitter van de Justice, Law and Order donorgroep het repressieve beleid ten aanzien van demonstraties herhaaldelijk aan de orde gesteld.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Smeets (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de staatssecretarissen van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht dat de ca

MPs from PvdA, ChristenUnie and SP asked the state secretaries whether the cocoa sector is failing to eliminate child and forced adult labour, whether self-regulation works, and how the Dutch government intends to lead, including the scope of the 2010 cocoa sustainability declaration and the IDH programme. The government answered that progress is being made but the problem is not solved, that certification and the declaration are the main tools, that IDH is showing results, and that dialogue continues through the Child Labor Platform and international cocoa agreement.
I do not agree with your observation that self-regulation does not work.
Ik ben het niet met uw constatering eens dat zelfregulering niet werkt.

Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanbestedingen van donorlanden die grotendeels bij de donorlanden zelf terecht komen (ingezonden 27 oktober 2011).

An MP from the PvdA asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about how much Dutch aid flows to domestic and other companies, compliance with Paris and Accra commitments on untied aid, local procurement, corporate social responsibility, and the level playing field. The state secretary answered that aid is largely untied (97% in 2010), 76% of delegated bilateral budget was procured locally, and gave indicative channel shares, while stating that exact company-level breakdowns cannot be provided.
It is not possible to state for the entire Dutch ODA budget what percentage is spent on local procurement.
Het is niet mogelijk om voor het gehele Nederlandse ODA-budget aan te geven welk percentage aan lokale aanbestedingen wordt uitgegeven

Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het algemene hulpverzoek van de VN aan de internationale gemeenschap voor het Rapid Response Plan ten behoeve van Pakistan (ingezonden

An MP asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about the UN Pakistan Floods Rapid Response Plan, including how much had been received, whether the Netherlands would contribute, and an overview of Dutch contributions. The state secretary confirmed awareness, reported 20% funding received, committed 4 million euro via WFP, and listed other direct and indirect Dutch contributions.
I have committed a contribution of 4 million euro to the Pakistan Flood Rapid Response Plan.
Ik heb een bijdrage toegezegd van 4 miljoen euro aan het Pakistan Flood Rapid Response Plan.

Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het feit dat steeds meer landbouwgrond in Derde Wereldlanden in handen komt van internationale investeerders (ingezonden 23 september

Dikkers (PvdA) asked the state secretary about large-scale foreign and domestic land acquisitions in developing countries, citing Oxfam's Land and Power report, and asked about transparency, local land rights, OECD guidelines for Dutch firms and whether subsidy instruments avoid supporting such deals. Minister Rosenthal acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing Dutch support for land governance and the International Land Coalition and Land Matrix, noted OECD guidelines are voluntary, and said that firms seeking state financing must sign a commitment to them while FMO applies IFC Performance Standards.
My policy on food security, which will be sent to you in a letter shortly, responds to this.
Mijn beleid op het gebied van voedselzekerheid, dat u binnenkort in een brief zal worden aangeboden, speelt daar op in.

Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over aanbestedingen van donorlanden die grotendeels bij de donorlanden zelf terecht komen (ingezonden 16 september 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about a Eurodad report claiming aid tenders largely flow back to donor countries, and whether this breaches the Paris and Accra declarations. The State Secretary rejected the 'boomerang aid' framing, argued that country-system tenders are compatible with the declarations, declined to quantify the share going to Western firms, and committed to work for stronger local tendering systems and a level playing field.
The Netherlands reports both ex-ante and ex-post on these contracts to the OECD.
Nederland rapporteert zowel ex-ante als ex-post over deze contracten aan de OESO.

Vragen van de leden Van Bommel (SP), Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de besteding van 850 000 euro

MPs from several parties asked why the 850,000 euro promised in 2009 for Balongsari (Rawagede) has not been fully disbursed, how much went via Hivos and an agreement with Indonesia's Interior Ministry, and whether the funds will be released quickly. The ministers explained a 250,000 euro microcredit project run by Hivos is operating, the school/market/health project is delayed in Indonesian administrative procedures, and funds will be transferred once preparations are complete, with Dutch monitoring.
Embassy funds can only be transferred to the Indonesian Ministry of Home Affairs once the aforementioned preparations are completed.
Fondsen van de ambassade kunnen pas naar het Indonesische ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken worden overgemaakt als eerdergenoemde voorbereidingen afgerond zijn.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de luchtbrug voor Somalië (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

Labour MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked whether the WFP would run an airlift to Mogadishu and whether the Netherlands would support it with funds or Air Force transport given the severe hunger in Somalia. The state secretary answered that humanitarian organisations are already flying aid to Mogadishu, that Dutch aid totals over 25 million euro, and that WFP has not asked for Dutch transport capacity.
WFP has indicated it has sufficient resources for the earlier mentioned air transports to Mogadishu, and has not asked the Netherlands to make transport capacity available.
WFP heeft aangegeven over voldoende middelen te beschikken voor de eerder genoemde luchttransporten naar Mogadishu, en heeft Nederland niet verzocht om transportcapaciteit ter beschikking te stellen.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een omstreden wetsvoorstel van de Cambodjaanse regering waardoor het werk van niet-gouvernementele organisaties (NGO's)

Two MPs asked the foreign minister how the Netherlands supports NGOs and human rights organisations in Cambodia, and what the consequences would be if a controversial NGO law is adopted. The minister said the government is concerned, that it gives no direct support to NGOs but funds UNICEF Cambodia, that the Netherlands has no bilateral aid relationship with Cambodia, and that the EU has repeatedly raised the law with Cambodian authorities.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers (PvdA) en Hachchi (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het opschorten van de investering in de Subsidiefaciliteit Burgerschap en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (SBOS) (ingezond

MPs Dikkers and Hachchi asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs why the SBOS subsidy facility was suspended until 2013, how much was saved, why the decision was not previewed in the Focus letter or debated in parliament, and whether the round could be reopened. The State Secretary answered that budget cuts forced choices, that the reduction was implemented via an amendment, that a further amount of 27 million euros in commitments remains, and that reopening the round is not possible due to lack of budget room.
There is not yet clarity about the amounts involved and I cannot inform you further at this time.
Over de hiermee gemoeide bedragen is er nog geen duidelijkheid en kan ik u nu niet nader informeren.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans, Dikkers en Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over anti-homo uitspraken van een Surinaamse parlementslid (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether he condemns anti-gay remarks by a Surinamese parliamentarian, Asabina, and whether the EU will jointly condemn them and open dialogue with Suriname on LGBT rights. The minister agreed the remarks are undesirable, stated they do not reflect the Surinamese government's position, and said LGBT rights are part of bilateral and EU human rights dialogue and that the ministry supports Surinamese LGBT organisations.
The statements by parliamentarian Asabina do not reflect the position of the Surinamese government.
De uitlatingen van de parlementariër Asabina geven niet het standpunt van de Surinaamse regering weer.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een NCP-klacht tegen Nidera (ingezonden 29 juni 2011).

Two MPs asked the state secretary and foreign minister about an OECD NCP complaint against the Dutch company Nidera and whether FMO's screening of Nidera's Argentine activities was adequate given the lack of formal CSR policy. The government answered that multiple sources were consulted, that the FMO's IFC Performance Standards framework is adequate, that it sees no reason to change FMO loan conditions, and that the FMO research report would be sent confidentially.
I see no reason to change the conditions under which FMO loans are granted.
Ik zie geen aanleiding tot wijziging van de voorwaarden waaronder FMO-leningen verstrekt.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de situatie in Somalië (ingezonden 4 augustus 2011).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister whether Al Shabaab is blocking humanitarian access and starving civilians in Somalia, and whether it should be referred to the ICC. The government answered that some Al Shabaab leaders threaten people fleeing and that aid access is partly expanding, that ICRC and UN agencies have limited access, and that ICC referral is not excluded but no support currently exists, pointing instead to UN sanctions listings.
It is not ruled out that obstructing humanitarian access may indeed fall under crimes against humanity and thus within the jurisdiction of the ICC.

Het is niet uitgesloten dat het belemmeren van « humanitarian access » inderdaad onder de noemer misdrijven tegen de menselijkheid kan worden gebracht en daarmee binnen de rechtsmacht van het ICC valt.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over het staken van het juridische onderzoek naar massaverkrachting in Oost-Congo (ingezonden 8 juli 2

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs about reports that Congo suspended a legal investigation into mass rapes in Walikale, the protection of civilians by MONUSCO, Dutch funding against sexual violence, and Dutch donor coordination in eastern DRC. The government answered that the Congolese authorities did not halt the investigation but suspended victim interviews due to threats, and described MONUSCO measures, Dutch programmes and its diplomatic presence in the east.
Yes. However, the Congolese authorities have not halted the legal investigation.
Ja. De Congolese autoriteiten hebben het juridisch onderzoek echter niet gestaakt.

Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over illegale houtexport vanuit Madagaskar (ingezonden 2 mei 2011).

An MP asks the foreign and economic affairs ministers about illegal timber exports from Madagascar, including to China, Delmas' role, whether illegal wood reaches the Dutch market, Bank of Africa and FMO financing, and CITES listing of rosewood. The minister says illegal wood may reach the Dutch market via other EU states, denies direct imports from Madagascar, cites EU FLEGT measures, and says Nederland will fully enforce a CITES Appendix III listing if adopted.
I currently cannot rule out that illegal wood from Madagascar reaches the Dutch market.
Ik kan momenteel niet uitsluiten dat illegaal hout uit Madagaskar op de Nederlandse markt komt.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het aanhoudende geweld in Nigeria (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the foreign minister about ongoing violence in northern Nigeria following the 2011 presidential election, including its causes, possible EU mediation between Jonathan and Buhari, and economic instruments to address northern deprivation. The minister condemned the violence, described its perpetrators and causes, said Buhari refused substantive dialogue, and pointed to existing EU programmes and Dutch diplomatic efforts.
Yes, in Nigeria this is actively conveyed by the Dutch embassy in its contacts with the Nigerian government.
Ja, in Nigeria wordt dit actief uitgedragen door de Nederlandse ambassade in de contacten met de Nigeriaanse overheid.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans en Plasterk (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken, en de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over speculatie met grondstof

PvdA MPs asked the government about speculation in commodity markets, DNB's warning on leveraged commodity strategies, price volatility, effects on developing countries, and whether EU regulation should match the US. The ministers replied that DNB and AFM supervision is sufficient, that no additional measures are planned now, and that they await European Commission proposals on commodity derivatives regulation.
I consider the financial supervision carried out by DNB and AFM sufficient to address the risks. I do not currently intend to take additional measures.
Ik acht het financieel toezicht uitgevoerd door DNB en AFM voldoende om de risico's te adresseren. Ik ben momenteel niet van plan additionele maatregelen te treffen.

Vragen van de leden Arib en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat wie eerlijk is over hiv een baan kan vergeten (ingezonden 30 mei

MPs Arib and Dikkers asked ministers about reports that job applicants who disclose HIV may be rejected, and about employer attitudes, legal protection, and planned measures. The state secretary acknowledged persistent prejudice, noted the legal ban on HIV-based discrimination and existing complaint routes, and promised to consult social partners and anti-discrimination bureaus and to respond to ILO recommendation 200.
I am examining whether it is possible, within existing frameworks, to give more attention to discrimination on the grounds of HIV.
Ik bezie of het mogelijk is om binnen bestaande kaders meer aandacht te geven aan discriminatie op grond van hiv.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de grote kans op etnische zuiveringen in de Abyei-regio (ingezonden 8 juni 2011).

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister about the risk of ethnic cleansing in Abyei after the Northern Sudanese invasion, Khartoum's refusal to withdraw troops, and what the Netherlands can do diplomatically. The government answered that it shares the concern, calls for returns and withdrawal, backs AU and UN mediation and sent envoys, but gave no concrete new commitments beyond existing diplomacy.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Van Bommel (SP) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bewering dat in Afghanistan producten met kinder- en slavenarbeid worde

Four MPs asked the foreign minister whether NATO/ISAF-funded construction in Afghanistan uses bricks made with child and slave labour, and what NATO and the Afghan government are doing about it. The government answered that NATO screens contractors on child labour, that direct contractors can reasonably be assumed to use no child or slave labour though firm guarantees are impossible given security, that an ILO study is planned, and that a contract clause on child labour is used in Kunduz.
However, firm guarantees cannot be given given the security situation and the resulting limited possibilities for control.
Harde garanties zijn gezien de veiligheidssituatie en de daardoor beschikbare mogelijkheden tot controle echter niet te geven.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers , Timmermans en Marchouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een mogelijke anti-homoseksualiteitwet in Oeganda (ingezonden 13 mei 2011).

MPs Dikkers, Timmermans and Marchouch asked whether the Netherlands would use development aid as leverage against Uganda's proposed anti-homosexuality bill, whether it would press the EU and World Bank to condition aid, what was being done to protect threatened LGBTI activists, and whether the embassy would open to them. The minister replied that the Netherlands opposes the bill and has raised concerns at the highest level, but that aid conditionality is not currently on the table, that EHAHRDP has run a security assessment and provided practical protection, and that the embassy already maintains contacts with the LGBTI community.
Using Dutch aid to Uganda as a means of pressure, as well as making EU and World Bank aid conditional, is currently not on the agenda.
Het inzetten van de Nederlandse hulp aan Oeganda als pressiemiddel, maar ook het conditioneel maken van de hulp van EU en Wereldbank, is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de toename van gewelddadigheden in Oeganda (ingezonden 16 mei 2011).

Two MPs asked the Foreign Minister about rising violence and heavy-handed police action against opposition demonstrations in Uganda, including Human Rights Watch's call for an independent inquiry. The government answered that it is concerned, that Ugandan commissions and internal reviews are underway with Dutch and EU pressure for publication, and that the EU urges dialogue and prosecution of violence, while sanctions are not currently on the table.
The Netherlands and the EU will press for these reports to be made public.
Nederland en de EU zullen aandringen op openbaarmaking van deze rapporten.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de politiek onrustige situatie in Burkina Faso (ingezonden 28 april 2011).

MPs Dikkers and Timmermans asked the Foreign Minister about rising political tensions in Burkina Faso, including the new smaller cabinet and the role of the international community. The minister said the situation is unclear, that the cabinet reshuffle should restore trust, and that the Netherlands will press the government through EU political dialogue and donor support.
The Netherlands, together with other EU partners, conducts an intensive political dialogue with the government of Burkina Faso.
Nederland voert, samen met andere EU-partners, een intensieve politieke dialoog met de regering van Burkina Faso.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Ouwehand (Partij voor de Dieren), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Gesthuizen (SP) en Dijkgraaf (SGP) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en In

MPs from six parties asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about child labour and underpaid adult labour in Dutch cocoa and hazelnut supply chains, including whether hazelnut processors acting through the FNLI and the IDH business network can be held responsible. The government answered that industry bodies are meeting their supply-chain responsibility within the limits of reasonable expectation, describes FNLI and IDH activities, and says the SZW dialogue with Turkey has not yet taken place.
Our answer of 15 December 2010 stated that companies must simply do what can reasonably be expected of them to combat child labour in their chain.
In ons antwoord van 15 december 2010 is aangegeven dat bedrijven zonder meer dienen te doen wat redelijkerwijs van hen mag worden verwacht om kinderarbeid in hun keten te bestrijden.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de berichten dat het Rotterdamse graanhandelsbedrijf Nidera zich volgens justitie in Argentinië schuldig maakt aan «slav

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the foreign minister about reports that Rotterdam grain trader Nidera was accused of slavery-like practices at its Argentine plantation, and about FMO's financing of the company. The government answered that the accusations are unsubstantiated, that it has engaged Nidera on CSR without intervening directly, that FMO applies social criteria and commissioned consultant reviews, and that it sees no need to change FMO lending conditions.
The answer to question 9 is available for confidential inspection by members only, deposited with the Central Information Point of the House of Representatives.
Het antwoord op vraag 9 is ter vertrouwelijke inzage, alleen voor de leden, gelegd bij het Centraal Informatiepunt Tweede Kamer.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over Nederlandse bedrijven die geen heil zien in Uruzgan

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked why Dutch firms have barely started economic activity in Uruzgan despite FEOU funding, and about the termination of a feasibility project and the closure of the fund. The state secretary explained local insecurity and weak demand, reported the fund closed on its legal date, and described the handover of the business office to the Dutch trade centre.
The FEOU was closed on 31 December 2010, on the legal date published in the Staatscourant.
Het FEOU is op 31 december 2010 gesloten, op de wettelijke datum die in de Staatscourant was gepubliceerd.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over AKZO Nobel en de internationale duurzaamheidsindex (ingezonden 24 februari 2011).

MPs Dikkers and Smeets asked the minister about AkzoNobel decoupling executive bonuses from its Dow Jones Sustainability Index position, and about stakeholder dialogue and OECD self-regulation. The state secretary answered that remuneration policy is the company's own responsibility under the Corporate Governance Code, that the government values such index-linked incentives, and that it would not intervene.
How AkzoNobel gives shape to its remuneration policy is up to the company itself.
Hoe AkzoNobel invulling geeft aan zijn remuneratiebeleid, is aan het bedrijf zelf.
Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over berichten dat de vrouwenopvang in Afghanistan in gevaar is (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs about Afghan plans to take over women's shelters from NGOs and the risks this poses, and whether the government supports the shelters and will assist the NGOs. The State Secretary acknowledged serious concerns, said the EU and partners pressed Afghanistan on the draft law, and said Netherlands funding flows via UNIFEM and EU/other donors while promising to examine any NGO request for support.
The Netherlands will speak out critically about (draft) legislation or policy that threatens the rights of women or other vulnerable groups in Afghanistan.
Nederland zal zich kritisch uitspreken over (concept-)wetge ving of beleid dat een bedreiging vormt voor de rechten van vrouwen of andere kwetsbare groepen in Afghanistan.

Vragen van de leden Smeets en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Buitenlandse Zaken over misleidende cijfers van Shell over olielekkages in de Nigerdelta (ingezonde

MPs Smeets and Dikkers asked whether Shell's claim that 98% of Niger Delta oil spills are caused by sabotage is misleading, and what the government will do about it. The ministers said they have no evidence for a 50% sabotage figure, have referred the complaint to the OECD National Contact Point, and will press for transparency while an independent UNEP study proceeds.
The NCP is considering how to handle the complaint.
Het NCP beraadt zich over de behandeling van de melding.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Recourt en Timmermans (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over vrijwilligerswerk in een Afrikaans Kindertehuis door verdachte Robert M (ingezonden 28 december 2010).

Three PvdA MPs asked the foreign minister whether the government had information about a children's home in Kenya where suspect Robert M. allegedly volunteered, whether children there may have been abused, and whether an investigation would be launched. The minister said the government has no concrete information, offered full cooperation with judicial authorities, but declined to order its own inquiry so as not to interfere with the criminal investigation.

I want to prevent an investigation initiated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs from interfering with this important criminal investigation, and therefore cannot answer your questions further at this time.

Ik wil daarbij voorkomen dat een op initiatief van het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken ingesteld onderzoek dit belangrijke strafvorderlijk onderzoek doorkruist en kan daarom op dit moment uw vragen niet verder beantwoorden.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over een georganiseerde campagne van geweld in Ivoorkust (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the Foreign Minister about reports of an organised violence campaign in Ivory Coast by Gbagbo's forces and militias against Ouattara supporters, and whether the government would act on Human Rights Watch's call for stronger pressure. The minister confirmed the reports, pointed to recent EU sanctions and support for the UN mission, and promised continued pressure and follow-up on a forthcoming UN human rights report.
The Netherlands will continue to increase targeted pressure on Gbagbo and those supporting him through the EU.
Nederland blijft via de EU de gerichte druk op Gbagbo en degenen die hem ondersteunen opvoeren.
Vragen van de leden Dikkers en Timmermans (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het UNEP/OCHA rapport over loodvergiftiging in Noord-Nigeria (ingezonden 12 januari 2011).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about the UNEP/OCHA report on lead poisoning from artisanal gold mining in Zamfara state, Nigeria, including health risks, sustainable mining, and EU gold trade links. The minister answered that the report shows serious concerns, that Nigerian authorities must act, that Dutch-funded initiatives such as EITI and Green Gold exist, and that the gold trade is too fragmented to trace.
It is now primarily up to the Nigerian authorities to follow up on the recommendations in the report.
Het is nu in de eerste plaats aan de Nigeriaanse autoriteiten om opvolging te geven aan de aanbevelingen in het rapport.
Vragen van de leden Timmermans en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over geweld tegen vrouwen op Haïti (ingezonden 7 januari 2010).

MPs Timmermans and Dikkers asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about a report on sexual violence against women in Haiti's earthquake camps, and whether Dutch aid for reconstruction could be conditioned on protecting women and girls. The state secretary agreed the violence is serious, described existing protection measures in the camps and UN efforts, and said Dutch aid bodies would pursue these issues in their projects.

I will therefore continue to press the Haitian authorities, the international aid organisations and the non-governmental organisations involved in managing the camps to do everything possible against this.

Ik zal dan ook doorgaan met het aanspreken van de Haïtiaanse autoriteiten, de internationale hulporganisaties en de niet-gouvernementele organisaties die betrokken zijn bij het beheer van de opvangkampen om hier al het mogelijke tegen in stelling te brengen.
Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de verhoogde bijdrage aan het Initiatief Duurzame Handel (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about a 100 million euro allocation to the Initiative Sustainable Trade (IDH), including private co-financing shares, what the programmes contribute to incomes, whether public money substitutes for private spending, how vague the action plan goals are, and secretariat and director salary costs. The secretary answered most questions in substance, stating private contributions of at least 50 percent for new and scaled-up programmes, SMART goal-setting, monitoring via the IDH council, and that the director's salary falls within the DG norm, while noting the action plan is a political manifesto rather than a project plan.

The monitoring protocol and the agreements made on annual planning and reporting, as well as the planned external evaluation, provide sufficient assurance that no direct ODA-funded financing of private sector activities takes place.

Het monitoringsprotocol en de afspraken die gemaakt zijn over jaarlijkse planning en rapportage, alsmede de geplande externe evaluatie in 2010 bieden voldoende waarborg dat er geen directe financiering met ODA-gelden van bedrijfslevenactiviteiten plaatsvindt.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans, Marcouch (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitspraak van de Keniaanse premier Raila Odinga over homoseksuele mannen (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about Kenyan Prime Minister Raila Odinga's reported call for arrests of gay men, whether such remarks are undesirable, whether the Dutch ambassador should discuss them, and what risks gay men face in Kenya. The minister agreed the remarks are undesirable, judged a meeting with the Kenyan ambassador unnecessary since Odinga had already corrected the picture, described limited risks and reported the embassy's ongoing work with local groups and the expected repeal of the colonial-era ban.
The embassy will continue to follow this process closely.
De ambassade zal dit proces nauwgezet blijven volgen.

Vragen van de leden Dikkers (PvdA), Voordewind (CU), Ouwerhand (PvdD) en Dijkhoff (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris voor Buitenlandse Zaken over het rapport van Human Rights Watch over de situatie in Burundi (ingezonden 26 n

MPs asked the Dutch government about a Human Rights Watch report on crackdowns on rights in Burundi, including whether it was unacceptable, whether it affects Dutch development aid, whether civil society should be supported, and the role of the Netherlands in the Great Lakes region. The government said it shares the concerns, has raised them bilaterally and multilaterally, will continue its security-sector and civil-society support, and will inform parliament in spring 2011 about its focus countries.
We share the concerns expressed in the report about the arrests of journalists, the documented cases of torture and the restriction of freedom for opposition parties and civil society.

Wij delen de in het rapport geuite zorgen over arrestaties van journalisten, de geconstateerde gevallen van marteling en de beperking van de vrijheid voor oppositiepartijen en het maatschappelijk middenveld.

Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA), aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over de actie van onder andere van Stop Aids Now over het mogelijke gevaar voor 180 000 HIV geïnfecteerde mensen die afhankelijk zijn van

An MP asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about a campaign claiming 180,000 HIV-infected people depend on Dutch aid, and whether medication access is guaranteed and preparations for cuts can be paused until parliament decides. The state secretary said the figure cannot be linked to Dutch aid, that Dutch funding via the Global Fund continues in 2011 with EUR 40 million, and that policy will only be implemented after the budget is adopted.
Only after the adoption of the Foreign Affairs budget will I implement the policy.
Pas na vaststelling van de begroting van Buitenlandse Zaken ga ik het beleid uitvoeren.

Vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Voordewind (beiden ChristenUnie), Dikkers (PvdA), Braakhuis (GroenLinks) en Gesthuizen (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken over uitbuiting door toeleveranciers van C&A en H&M

MPs from several parties asked the Economic Affairs minister about labour exploitation at Indian suppliers of C&A and H&M, including KPR Mills, its SA8000 certification, and government risk lists. The government answered that the companies have tried to influence the supplier, that it does not subsidise or supervise them, and that it will continue dialogue with the sector and the Indian government without committing to new binding measures.
We see no role for the government in this.
Wij zien hierbij geen rol voor de overheid.

Vragen van de leden Voordewind (ChristenUnie), Irrgang (SP), Dikkers (PvdA), Van der Staaij (SGP), Ten Broeke (VVD) en Peters (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over topsalarissen bij ontwikkelingsorgani

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about excessive director salaries at development organisation SNV, how the government will recover the excess against subsidies, whether other non-MFS organisations also pay above the cap, and whether a salary ceiling will be enforced. The state secretary answered that differences will be settled retroactively against the subsidy, that specific arrangements will be made with SNV, that other organisations will be referred to a separate letter, and that a salary cap will be agreed with non-MFS organisations largely funded by government.
Established differences between director salaries and the DG norm can be settled afterwards against the subsidy fixed afterwards for a given year.
Vastgestelde verschillen tussen directiesalarissen en de DG-norm kunnen achteraf worden verrekend met de eveneens achteraf vastgestelde subsidie over een bepaald jaar.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het optreden van de Verenigde Naties in Congo (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about UN peacekeepers' response to systematic rape by armed groups in eastern Congo, including sanctions, ICC referral, the UN's failure to react to warnings, communications gaps, and whether Congolese forces can protect civilians. The minister answered that perpetrators should be prosecuted, supports added targeted sanctions, notes existing UN measures and ICC investigations, reports the UN's internal review and reinforcements, and says MONUSCO lacks the capacity to protect all civilians everywhere.
In his report to the Security Council on 7 September, Khare openly admitted that the UN had fallen short in protecting civilians in the area.
In zijn verslaglegging aan de Veiligheidsraad van 7 september jl. gaf Khare ruiterlijk toe dat de VN tekort zijn geschoten bij de bescherming van de burgers in het gebied.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen (SP), Ortega-Martijn (ChristenUnie), Braakhuis (GroenLinks), Dikkers (PvdA) en Veldhoven-Van der Meer (D66) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de probleme

Five MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Economic Affairs about Shell's oil extraction problems in Nigeria, following a Zembla broadcast and an Amnesty International report, and whether the Dutch government will intensify its efforts and respond to a UNEP-related case. The ministers answered that Nederland supports EITI transparency, a human rights fund, and dialogue with Shell and the Nigerian government, will intensify efforts where needed, will contact UNEP's Ogoniland program head, and will await UNEP's report before drawing conclusions.
Where necessary, these efforts will be further intensified.
Waar nodig zullen deze inspanningen verder worden geïntensiveerd.
Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dikkers (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de recente massale verkrachtingen van vrouwen in Oost-Congo (ingezonden 25 augustus 2010).

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about mass rapes of women in Walikale, eastern Congo, whether such attacks are unusual, who is responsible, what Dutch-funded aid reaches victims, mining control, MONUC's response and whether further investigation is needed. The minister answered that the scale is exceptional, attributed the attacks to the FDLR and May-May militia on UN findings, described Dutch-funded aid and MONUSCO's limits, and said the UN Secretary-General sent an assistant secretary-general to investigate the response.

Given the seriousness of the situation, the UN Secretary-General sent the head of the UN Department of Peacekeeping Operations, Atul Khare, to the DRC to investigate further how the UN mission in the field responded to the events.

Gezien de ernst van de situatie heeft de secretaris-generaal van de VN het hoofd van het Departement voor Vredesoperaties van de VN, Atul Khare, naar de DRC gestuurd om verder onderzoek te doen naar de wijze waarop de VN-missie in het veld op de gebeurtenissen heeft gereageerd.
Vragen van het lid Dikkers (PvdA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over hulp aan de ramp in Pakistan (ingezonden 12 augustus 2010).

Motie Jadnanansing c.s. over afzien van het verhoogde collegegeld voor langstudeerders
Asks the government to drop the higher tuition fee for students exceeding the nominal study duration and propose alternative funding in early 2011.
Requests the government to refrain from the increased tuition fee for long-term students.
verzoekt de regering van het verhoogde collegegeld voor langstudeerders af te zien
Motie Van der Ham c.s. over openstelling van het Rubicon-programma voor studenten die al in het buitenland studeren
Asks the government to investigate opening the Rubicon programme to students already studying abroad.
requests the government to investigate how the Rubicon programme can also be opened to students who are already studying abroad
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken hoe het Rubicon-programma ook open kan worden gesteld voor studenten die al in het buitenland studeren
qa: Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that internship places were falling sharply, risking shortages of skilled workers, and whether the state should fund internships. The questions were declared withdrawn (vervallen) because they had been answered otherwise or the answer was no longer considered timely.
The questions below are to be considered withdrawn.
Onderstaande vragen dienen als vervallen te worden beschouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een blinde vrouw die werd gediscrimineerd door het ROC in Nijmegen

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether the ROC Nijmegen's refusal to admit a blind woman to VAVO education, which the Human Rights Board found to be discrimination, has consequences, whether the school had grounds to claim undue burden, and whether a proposed admission right would help. The minister declined to attach consequences as she is not a party, said the burden question is for the courts, noted the school's duty for reasonable adjustments under the WGB/hcz, and said the proposed admission right does not cover VAVO but that disability-based refusal is already prohibited.
Since I am not a party to this case, I do not attach any consequences to it.
Aangezien ik geen partij ben in deze zaak verbind ik hier geen consequenties aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht 'Mbo-student negatief over lessen'

An MP asked the Minister of Education about survey findings that many MBO students feel unchallenged, find lessons not useful, and find purchased teaching materials underused, plus questions on work-placement satisfaction and school costs. The Minister acknowledged the problems, pointed to existing measures such as shortened MBO-4 programmes, quality agreements, a bill giving student councils advice rights over school costs, and linked work-placement pay to improvement plans.
In the House of Representatives there is a bill before it giving student councils advisory rights over an institution's school-costs policy.
In de Tweede Kamer ligt het wetsvoorstel voor waarin studentenraden adviesrecht krijgen op het schoolkostenbeleid van een instelling.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Vermue over een mbo-school die stopt met beschermde stageplaatsen voor studenten met een lichamelijke beperking, gedragsproblemen of een moeilijke thuissituatie

MPs Jadnanansing and Vermue asked why Scalda, a vocational college, is ending funding for Inceptio, a student company giving placements to students with disabilities, behavioural problems or difficult home situations, and what this means for placements in Zeeland. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for their own support choices within their budgets, that extra funding is available, and that she would support regional arrangements without committing to a specific solution.
Institutions are free to make choices in how they shape this additional support.
Instellingen zijn vrij om keuzes te maken in de manier waarop zij deze (extra) ondersteuning vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Grote zorgen over vernieuwing in vmbo’

An MP asked the minister about a survey showing serious concerns among vmbo staff over the reform's implementation, including teacher retraining and underqualified teachers. The state secretary acknowledged the challenges, pointed to a transitional measure allowing schools until 2021 to bring teachers up to the required qualification, and described the support infrastructure, budget and training offers.
I have a transitional measure in preparation that gives schools room until 1 August 2021 to retrain existing teachers to an appropriate qualification.
Daarom heb ik een overgangsmaatregel in voorbereiding die scholen de ruimte biedt tot 1 augustus 2021 de zittende docenten te scholen naar een passende bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Jadnanansing inzake het bericht 'Ongelijkheid op Amsterdamse scholen groeit verder'

MPs Vermue and Jadnanansing asked the State Secretary for Education about reports that inequality and segregation in Amsterdam schools are growing, and whether categorical schooling undermines integration and opportunity. The State Secretary acknowledged the findings, said segregation is largely a societal problem, pointed to municipal agreements, a planned congress and an Onderwijsraad advisory request, and declined to commission new national research.
I see no added value in further research into segregation in education as a standalone phenomenon.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde in verder onderzoek naar segregatie in het onderwijs als een op zichzelf staand verschijnsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel, Vermue en Jadnanansing inzake het gebrek aan aandacht over seksuele diversiteit in het onderwijs

MPs Yücel, Vermue and Jadnanansing asked why only 25% of surveyed pupils had lessons on sexual diversity despite mandatory core objectives since 2012, and how inspectorate oversight and teacher training address this, also referring to a motion on citizenship education and a Stichting School en Veiligheid report on teacher colleges. The Minister and State Secretary answered that they await the Inspectorate's forthcoming thematic report before taking a position, that no enforcement against schools has occurred, and that the teacher-training competence profile and curriculum reviews are underway, while rejecting the claim that the training approach is merely voluntary.
We therefore first await the outcomes of this thematic study by the inspectorate, in order to then reach a considered position
Wij wachten daarom eerst de uitkomsten van dit themaonderzoek van de inspectie af, om vervolgens tot een afgewogen standpunt te komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake technische vmbo-scholen die in de knel komen door verschuivingen in de bekostiging

An MP asked the State Secretary whether technical vmbo schools will lose funding as the new profiles and the simplified per-pupil funding are introduced, and whether schools may switch to cheaper programmes. The State Secretary acknowledged the higher costs of vocational education, said start-up costs vary by school and can be covered by reserves, and promised a sample survey of school choices and a consultation with the VO-raad, while leaving the funding design open.
A sample survey is currently being carried out, partly due to concerns from VNO/NCW, to gain more insight into the choices schools intend to make in their profile offerings.
Er wordt op dit moment vanwege de zorgen van onder andere VNO/NCW een steekproef uitgevoerd om meer zicht te krijgen op de keuzes die scholen voornemens zijn te maken in hun aanbod aan profielen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over discriminatie bij het zoeken van stageplaatsen

Two MPs asked the Minister of Education about reports that vocational students, especially girls wearing headscarves and boys of Moroccan background, face discrimination when seeking internships, and what schools, employers and the government will do. The minister acknowledged the problem as unacceptable, announced City Deal measures, a study with the SBB, and said students can report discrimination, though no formal parliamentary-oversight change is proposed.
Discrimination in finding an internship is unacceptable and unacceptable.
Discriminatie bij het vinden van een stage is onaanvaardbaar en onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermue en Jadnanansing inzake examentraining die scholieren extern (moeten) inkopen

MPs Vermue and Jadnanansing asked whether schools should fund exam preparation themselves rather than having pupils buy external training, and whether a discount on exam training via the cultuurkaart encourages schools to outsource it. The State Secretary replied that schools are responsible for exam preparation from their own budget, pupils may freely buy extra external training, and no change is planned.
It is the responsibility of schools to properly prepare exam candidates for the examinations.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van scholen om eindexamenkandidaten goed voor te bereiden op de examens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jadnanansing over financiële ondersteuning voor volwassen scholieren

MPs Kerstens and Jadnanansing asked what financial support exists for adult pupils aged 18 and over who are not yet in a vocational or higher education programme, whether they face income loss, and what municipalities can do. The state secretary explained the DUO pupil allowance, the rules for the period before study finance and general assistance, and said municipalities hold individual discretion, while not holding data on municipal practice.
I do not have information on how municipalities deal with adult pupils who have not yet started an education programme.
Ik beschik niet over informatie hoe gemeenten omgaan met de volwassen scholieren die nog niet aan een opleiding zijn begonnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over de arbeidsmarktkansen van onderwijsassistenten en lerarenondersteuners

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the Minister of Education about declining graduate numbers, weak labour-market prospects and recruitment for education assistants and teacher assistants, including the pabo transfer pathway and vocational guidance. The minister answered with DUO data, noted schools decide on hiring, referred to the 50 million euro Herfstakkoord investment and existing mbo guidance and labour-market duty-of-care rules, but gave no new prognoses.
No figures are available on the number of education assistants and teacher assistants working in education.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal onderwijsassistenten en lerarenondersteuners dat werkzaam is in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jadnanansing inzake het misbruik van studiefinanciering

MPs Mohandis and Jadnanansing asked the Minister of Education about students receiving study grants without actually studying, as reported by the NOS. The minister said DUO holds no data on such students, that mbo institutions do not recognise a massive problem, and that attendance monitoring will be improved and the phenomenon investigated further.
As previously reported, I will investigate how often young people receive study financing without following education and what motives play a role.
Zoals reeds eerder gemeld ga ik onderzoeken hoe vaak het voorkomt dat jongeren wel studiefinanciering ontvangen maar geen onderwijs volgen en welke motieven daarbij een rol spelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Jadnanansing over het rapport 'PR onderzoek Safer Internet Day'

MPs Volp and Jadnanansing asked the State Secretary of Health about a PR study on Safer Internet Day showing young people's views on sexting and online sexual conduct, and what should be done in education. The State Secretary replied that sexual resilience education is already mandated in schools, listed existing programmes covering sexting, and said stigmatising victims is undesirable, referring criminal-law questions to the Justice Minister.
Since December 2012 the core curriculum components on sexuality and sexual diversity have been introduced, meaning schools are obliged to devote attention to them.
Sinds december 2012 zijn de kerndoelonderdelen seksualiteit en seksuele diversiteit ingevoerd, wat betekent dat scholen verplicht zijn hier aandacht aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake de aanpak van radicalisering op scholen

An MP asked the education minister how teachers lacking guidance on radicalisation in schools can be supported, how the motion on uprooted youth was implemented, how teacher training prepares for radicalisation and critical thinking, and how vocational education will strengthen civic education. The minister answered that schools and boards are primarily responsible, pointed to support from the School en Veiligheid foundation, outlined curriculum and EKB changes for critical thinking, and gave no information on withholding.
This is in the first place the responsibility of school leaders and board members.
Dit is in de eerste plaats de verantwoordelijkheid van schoolleiders en bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake overgangscontracten in het voortgezet onderwijs en het uitsluiten van leerlingen van deelname aan het eindexamen

An MP asked the state secretary about school 'transition contracts' that exclude pupils from the final exam, and whether schools may impose conditions on advancement and exam participation. The state secretary answered that such conditional admission to the final year is forbidden, that LAKS and the inspectorate handled reported cases (most contracts withdrawn, excluded pupils readmitted), that a funding sanction is possible but has not been applied in these cases, and promised clarification in the school newsletter.
Schools are prohibited from promoting pupils conditionally to the examination year.
Het is scholen verboden om leerlingen voorwaardelijk over te laten gaan naar het examenjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake functioneel analfabetisme op het vmbo

An MP asks the State Secretary for Education about claims that 14 percent of vmbo pupils are functionally illiterate and whether the Dutch curriculum must be overhauled. The State Secretary answers that most vmbo pupils reach reference level 2F, that remaining gaps are addressed through targeted pathways and the Onderwijs2032 curriculum renewal, and that results will be reported annually.
In the Examenmonitor VO and the progress report on language and arithmetic, your House receives annual information on results for the Dutch subject in secondary, primary and vocational education.
In de Examenmonitor VO en de voortgangsrapportage taal en rekenen ontvangt uw Kamer jaarlijks informatie over de resultaten voor het vak Nederlands in het VO, respectievelijk PO, VO en MBO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Jadnanansing over het bericht dat scholen steeds vaker een VOG vragen om moeilijke leerlingen te weren

MPs Volp and Jadnanansing asked whether schools increasingly require a certificate of good conduct (VOG) to exclude difficult students, and whether youths with criminal records are blocked from education and internships as a result. The government answered that the qualitative study cannot support claims about trends or numbers, that no data exist on schools requiring VOGs, and that it intends to address the issue through communication, local initiatives and further research, with a letter to parliament planned for mid-2016.
No figures exist on educational institutions that require their students to obtain a VOG, or that otherwise discourage people with a criminal record from enrolling in a course or study.

Er bestaan geen cijfers van onderwijsinstellingen die hun studenten om een VOG vragen, of personen met een justitieel verleden anderszins ontmoedigen om zich in te schrijven voor een opleiding of studie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma inzake mbo-opleidingen die jaarlijks tientallen studenten met psychische of lichamelijke beperkingen niet toelaten

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the Minister of Education whether tens of students with psychological or physical disabilities are refused entry to vocational (mbo) courses each year and do not get needed support, and how the government responds to complaints and to the Kinderombudsman's findings. The Minister says complaints exist but cannot tell how many refusals are disability-related, stresses institutions' legal duty to provide support, and promises talks with the MBO Raad and JOB plus a bill giving qualified students a right to admission.
I am working on a bill that will give students who have the right prior education the right to admission to mbo.
Ik werk aan een wetsvoorstel waarmee studenten die over de juiste vooropleiding beschikken het recht op toelating tot het mbo krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing inzake de brede brugklas en het uitstellen van selectie in het voortgezet onderwijs

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about a report finding that children of low-educated parents are steered to lower school tracks than peers with equal results, and about the value of broad first-year classes and delayed selection in secondary education. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, defended the shift to a later end-of-primary test with a school advice as the leading factor, and promised advisory research and measures to support broad first-year classes.
