I will inform the House before 1 March 2016 about the measures I am taking.
Ik zal uw Kamer voor 1 maart 2016 informeren over de maatregelen die ik neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over discriminatie van jongeren bij het vinden van een bijbaan of stageplaats

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked ministers about discrimination against young people, including migrant youth, when seeking part-time jobs or internships, and about the measures taken. The minister acknowledged that discrimination is unacceptable and that migrant youth need more applications for internships, described programmes such as the City Deal, Werkakkoorden and training initiatives, and said the anti-discrimination action programme would be updated in early 2016.
The revision of the action programme will work across specific policy tracks.
De herijking van het actieprogramma zal overkoepelend werken ten aanzien van specifieke beleidstrajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over leerlingen die kleine vakken thuis volgen achter de computer

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked whether a Liemers College arrangement letting pupils follow small subjects such as philosophy online at home, due to school shrinkage, is acceptable and how quality and compulsory-education rules are safeguarded. The State Secretary said the school's own professionals and parents decide, that distance learning can count as lesson time under the Leerplichtwet if integrated and approved by the works council, and gave no new concrete commitments.
Distance learning can be regarded as instruction time and therefore as lesson time within the meaning of the Compulsory Education Act, if this benefits the quality or accessibility of education.
Afstandsonderwijs kan gezien worden als onderwijstijd en daarmee ook als lestijd in de zin van de Leerplichtwet, als dit de kwaliteit of toegankelijkheid van het onderwijs ten goede komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing inzake het verdwijnen van brede scholengemeenschappen in krimpregio's

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary whether the disappearance of broad secondary schools in shrinking regions, such as Maastricht, harms pupils' pathways, and what measures could keep such schools. The state secretary replied that broad schools need not be dissolved, that Maastricht's board chose to cluster education by level while keeping three broad schools, and that cooperation between schools plus policy measures (relaxed 50% rule, pilot, fusion compensation) are the way to keep a wide offer.
School boards themselves decide which forms of secondary education are offered.
Schoolbesturen bepalen zelf welke vormen van voortgezet onderwijs aangeboden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over hoge extra opleidingskosten voor mbo-leerlingen

An MP asked the Minister of Education about high additional costs for mbo students and whether they can become barriers to enrolment, including cost information by programme and support for parents. The minister answered that enrolment may not depend on contributions beyond tuition, that schools must inform students in advance and offer payment arrangements, and that the Inspectorate and the MBO Raad will be engaged, with a bill giving student councils advisory rights on school costs.
Thousands of mbo programmes are offered. This makes it very difficult to request this information for each individual mbo programme and keep it up to date.
Er worden duizenden mbo-opleidingen aangeboden in mbo. Dit maakt het erg lastig om per individuele mbo-opleiding deze informatie op te vragen, en actueel te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Yücel over minimagezinnen waarvoor de kosten van mbo-opleidingen voor hun kinderen onbetaalbaar zouden worden

MPs Jadnanansing and Yücel asked whether low-income families can afford mbo school costs now that the WTOS allowance for under-18s was abolished, and whether this forces students to drop out. The minister acknowledges the change makes payment harder, says about 27,000 students previously received WTOS and that the kindgebonden budget increase compensates most, points to school payment plans and local funds, and says municipalities are responsible for local support.
It is true that the income-dependent allowance for education contributions and school costs (WTOS) for parents of children under 18 ceased to exist from school year 2015/2016.
Het klopt dat de inkomensafhankelijke tegemoetkoming in de onderwijsbijdrage en schoolkosten (WTOS) voor ouders met kinderen jonger dan 18 jaar vanaf schooljaar 2015/2016 is opgehouden te bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over mbo-scholen die probleemjongeren blijven weigeren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether vulnerable youths are routinely refused entry to mbo vocational colleges, following a broadcast, and whether the institutions acted carefully. The Minister denied a general pattern, pointed to complaint and mediation routes for refused youths, and referred to forthcoming legislation granting a right of admission.
A vocational college cannot simply refuse a young person.
Een mbo-instelling kan een jongere niet «zomaar» weigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over allochtone studenten die volgens de stagemonitor minder stagevergoeding krijgen en vaker moeten solliciteren voor ze een stageplek vinden

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked whether the National Internship Monitor shows that students with foreign-born parents receive lower internship pay, must apply more often, and get lower grades, and whether this amounts to discrimination, and what institutions and employers should do. The minister answers that the monitor shows more applications and lower pay for this group but cannot establish systematic differences or discrimination given sample and confounder gaps, acknowledges possible discrimination as a serious concern, and points to existing policy programmes and a forthcoming ROA study without committing to new concrete action.
On the basis of this monitor I cannot establish whether allochtone students are discriminated against in internships.
Op basis van deze monitor kan ik niet vast stellen of allochtone studenten worden gediscrimineerd bij stages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de klachten bij de vmbo-examens

An MP asked the State Secretary whether abolishing the second correction round for digital vmbo exams removes external quality control, and whether this affects validity, fraud risk and the end-of-April schedule. The State Secretary denied that external control is absent, pointing to a najaarscorrectie by exam correctors with inspectorate follow-up, and defended the flexible scheduling as serving pupils' interests.
There is indeed external quality control of the marked work for digital central exams.
Er is wel degelijk sprake van een externe kwaliteitscontrole op het nagekeken werk bij digitale centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de kritiek vanuit het onderwijsveld op de huidige aanpak op het voorkomen van radicalisering onder jongeren

An MP asked the Minister of Education about education-sector criticism that children of immigrant background feel alienated, that deep-rooted injustice may fuel radicalisation, and whether schools should be relied on to counter radicalisation. The minister acknowledges the concern, says the causes are complex and points to ongoing research and the civic education approach, without introducing new powers or oversight.
We recognise that there are groups of pupils who do not feel recognised and acknowledged in this society.
Wij herkennen dat er groepen leerlingen zijn die zich niet herkend en erkend voelen in deze samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over gebrekkige sociale en maatschappelijke vorming op scholen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about schools' weak, unplanned approach to social and civic education, which the Inspectorate says is at minimum level with little development. The State Secretary agreed it is concerning, pointed to planned measures, the #Onderwijs2032 curriculum process, SLO support and Inspectorate thematic research, but declined to target the weakest schools specifically.
I have asked the Inspectorate to examine, in a thematic study, how schools fulfil their civic education task.
Ik heb de inspectie gevraagd om in een themaonderzoek te bekijken op welke manier scholen hun burgerschapstaak invullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over scholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op lerarenScholen voor voortgezet onderwijs die bewust beknibbelen op leraren

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary whether secondary schools deliberately underspend on teachers relative to funding, whether the lump-sum system allows misuse of funds, and whether schools should spend 80% on the classroom. The State Secretary answered that staffing ratios have been stable, that the 2012 surplus was small and in line with the Court of Audit's view, that the lump-sum system will be kept for its flexibility, and that the ratio is a calculation model rather than a mandated spending rule.
It is up to the schools, together with the staff representatives of the works council, to determine an appropriate ratio here.
Het is aan de scholen om, samen met de (personeelsgeleding van de) medezeggenschap, hier een passende verhouding in te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een mogelijke terugkeer van het standenonderwijs

An MP asked the education minister whether it is true that rich and poor pupils rarely meet at school and whether Dutch education functions as an emancipation engine, and asked what steps are taken to improve teacher quality. The minister answered that data on segregation by parental income are insufficient, pointed to existing measures against educational disadvantage, outlined the teacher-quality agenda, and said the CBS study will be repeated in 2016.
At present there is insufficient data available to assess whether there is an increasing segregation by parental income in education.
Op dit moment zijn er onvoldoende gegevens beschikbaar om te beoordelen of er sprake is van een toenemende segregatie naar inkomen van de ouders in het onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma inzake mogelijke vooroordelen bij leerkrachten bij het geven van het schooladvies

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked whether teachers' school advice systematically underrates pupils of non-Dutch background, and what the government will do about it. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate finds little evidence of ethnic bias in advice, that the CITO-to-advice gap disappears after correction, and that existing mechanisms for switching school levels are sufficient, so no further measures are needed.
In the report 'The quality of primary school advice' (2014), the Inspectorate of Education concludes there is little evidence that ethnicity influences the level of advice.
In het rapport « De kwaliteit van het basisschooladvies» (2014) concludeert de Inspectie van het Onderwijs dat er weinig evidentie is dat etniciteit van invloed is op de hoogte van de advisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Jadnanansing over de ‘Global Teacher Prize 2015’

MPs Duisenberg and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about the 2015 Global Teacher Prize, the nomination of a Dutch history teacher, and whether online platforms could share the stories of the nominees. The secretary answered that the government supports the prize's aims, that learning from abroad matters, and that the ministry has started exploring online dissemination via its social media and a teachers' website.
We have started this exploration and it turns out that the Global Teacher Prize organisation is already very active on social media
Wij zijn deze verkenning gestart en het blijkt dat de organisatie van de Global Teacher Prize zelf al zeer actief is op social media
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over ‘de kritiek op de rekentoets van een wiskundedocent in het Onderwijsblad’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about a mathematics teacher's criticism of the rekentoets (arithmetic test), including calls to scrap it and doubts about teacher support. The State Secretary rejects the characterization of the test as an intelligence or eye test, cites teacher involvement and broad support, says the test is improved and that the union position is not a direct consultation partner, and notes a temporary adjustment of its role in the pass/fail rule is under review.
I therefore disagree with the remark that the arithmetic test does not test the arithmetic skills of young people.
Ik ben het dan ook oneens met de opmerking dat de rekentoets de rekenvaardigheden van jongeren niet toetst
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de hoogte van de kosten van schoolexcursies op middelbare scholen

The MP asks whether extremely expensive school excursions in secondary education push parents into financial trouble, lead to segregation, and exclude pupils, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answers that excursions are paid from the voluntary parental contribution, that schools are free to set their profile, that parents' representatives must monitor affordability, and that the inspectorate supervises school cost policy, promising to discuss the issue with the VO-raad.
A task of the parents' representatives is to ensure that the total costs for parents remain manageable.
Een taak van de oudergeleding is om erop toe te zien dat de totale kosten voor ouders beheersbaar blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jadnanansing over het bericht “Arcus College betaalt tonnen voor langdurige interimmer”

MPs Kerstens and Jadnanansing asked the Minister of Interior whether an interim manager paid over 300,000 euros by Arcus College, apparently beyond WNT pay limits under transitional rules, amounts to excessive pay or a sham construction. The minister answered that the Inspectorate of Education is still investigating compliance with the WNT, that transitional rules can apply if agreements predate 2013, that overpayment would have to be reclaimed, and that enforcement lies with the education minister and the inspectorate.

On the basis of further investigation of the annual report data and any notification from the institutional accountant, the Inspectorate of Education, on behalf of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, supervises compliance with the WNT.

Op grond van nader onderzoek op basis van de gegevens in het jaarverslag, en een eventuele melding van de instellingsaccountant, oefent de Inspectie van het Onderwijs, namens de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, het toezicht uit op de naleving van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Meenen c.s. over het bericht dat er zeer suggestieve vragen staan in de ‘Blikopener’-methode voor maatschappijleer op het VMBO

MPs asked whether the Blikopener social studies method for VMBO contains leading questions about Moroccan youth, headscarves and Islam, and reinforces gender stereotypes, and whether the method should be revised. The State Secretary answered that schools and teachers choose their own methods, that the content of methods is not for the government to judge, that there is no central quality control on methods beyond inspectorate oversight of coverage of attainment targets, and that the questions were not substantively addressed beyond referring back to the same general position.
It is not for me to assess the content of teaching methods or schools' choice of teaching methods.
Het is niet aan mij om de inhoud van lesmethodes of de keuze van scholen voor lesmethodes te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over ROC’s die kwetsbare jongeren weigeren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether ROC vocational colleges refuse vulnerable students to avoid inspection penalties for dropout, and what the government will do about it. The minister said there is no central registry, collected about 130 signals, will have the Ombudslijn mbo register refusals, says financial incentives reward admitting students, and will investigate cases and address institutions while the Inspectorate handles reports.
Because I want clear insight into the situation, I will instruct the Ombudslijn mbo to register reports of refused young people as a central point.
Omdat ik graag scherp zicht wil op de situatie, ga ik de Ombudslijn mbo opdracht geven als centraal punt de meldingen van geweigerde jongeren te gaan registeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over scholen die ouders onder druk zetten om schoolkosten te betalen die helemaal niet verplicht zijn

An MP asked the State Secretary of Education whether schools pressure parents into paying non-mandatory school costs, including a vmbo tool kit of €200 required for a course. The State Secretary answered that complaints to the Inspectorate stayed stable (95 and 97), that toelating may never depend on parental contributions, schools must communicate transparent cost policies, and the Inspectorate supervises compliance and acts if violations occur, but will not name individual schools.
The works council also has an important role.
Ook de medezeggenschapsraad heeft een belangrijke rol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het achterblijvende gebruik van de subsidieregeling praktijkleren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether employers find the apprenticeship subsidy scheme too complex and whether fewer internship places are being offered to mbo students. The minister says she has heard no signals of complexity, that 14,000 employers filed 92,000 applications with the full budget disbursed, and promises a first monitoring report in the 2015 budget debate.
For the 2015 OCW budget debate, your House will receive the first report with more detailed information on use of the subsidy scheme.
Voor de OCW- begrotingsbehandeling 2015 ontvangt uw Kamer de eerste rapportage met meer gedetailleerde informatie over het gebruik van de subsidieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Vermeij over het bericht dat er banen verdwijnen voor mbo-niveau 2 en 3 leerlingen

MPs Jadnanansing and Vermeij asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about a news report that 500,000 MBO level 2 and 3 jobs would disappear permanently, and how education and labour market links would be ensured. The minister rejected the claim as poorly supported, acknowledged technological and globalisation pressure on middle-skilled jobs, and pointed to labour market information, the study guide, the macro-efficiency bill and a planned career-route experiment as responses.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over de uitspraken van de heer K. (bestuurslid van de Stichting Islamitisch Onderwijs (SIO) Amsterdam en Omstreken)

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked whether a board member of the Islamic education foundation SIO Amsterdam, who publicly expressed support for ISIS, should be a reason to reconsider the approved Islamic secondary school and whether the foundation can be blocked from operating a school. The State Secretary answered that the school's approval was mandatory under the law and cannot be revised, that the inspectorate will be asked to examine the board's suitability before any funding begins, and that the government will act to prevent the school opening if it fails the civic-education requirements.
As soon as I receive notification that the school can actually become eligible for funding once housing becomes available, I will call in the inspectorate.
Zodra ik de melding ontvang dat de school door het beschikbaar komen van huisvesting daadwerkelijk in aanmerking kan komen voor bekostiging, zal ik de inspectie inschakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen, Segers, Kooiman, Van der Steur, Van Oosten, Oskam, Rebel, Van Laar, Bontes en Jadnanansingover mensenhandel

MPs from several parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on human trafficking, including police results, victim reception and return programmes, liaison posts, Roma victims, EU funds and border controls. The minister answered in detail on operational cooperation, joint investigation teams, return and reintegration projects, and border checks, giving substantive answers while noting that some data is unavailable.
There are no figures available on the number of people travelling from countries such as Bulgaria and Romania to other European countries, including the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal personen dat vanuit landen als Bulgarije en Roemenië naar andere Europese landen, waaronder Nederland, reist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jadnanansing over de instructietaal in het onderwijs op Sint Eustatius

MPs Van Laar and Jadnanansing asked about a reported plan to replace Dutch with English as the language of instruction on Sint Eustatius, the feasibility study behind it, who decides the language, and the next steps after the island council's motion. The Secretary of State referred to a letter and attached reports, said the statutory language regime is set by legislation, and noted the council motion did not disrupt the ministry's decision-making, though the ministry said it would follow up with the council.
The legislator therefore ultimately determines what the language of instruction in education on this island is.
De wetgever bepaalt dus uiteindelijk wat de instructietaal in het onderwijs op dit eiland is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘vergrijzing transport levert baankansen op’

MPs Kuiken and Jadnanansing asked about logistics sector labour shortages, whether school leavers are choosing logistics careers, and whether enough workers are being recruited and retrained. The government answered that the sector itself must attract workers, pointed to a sector plan with 30 million euro of training measures and 1,250 extra driver trainees, and said vacancies are not above average.
It is up to the sector itself to present itself as an attractive employer and to entice young people to choose a career in logistics.
Het is aan de sector zelf om zich een aantrekkelijk werkgever te tonen en jongeren te verleiden om te kiezen voor een carrière in de logistiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een verdubbeling van het aantal zwakke opleidingen op middelbare scholen in Amsterdam

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education why the number of weak secondary schools in Amsterdam doubled, what could be done, whether municipalities should get a bigger role, and what could be learned from Amsterdam having no very weak primary schools. The State Secretary answered that weak ratings are relative and rotate each year, that Amsterdam performs better than other large cities, that schools have support options, and that no strengthening of municipal roles is warranted.
Although the municipality has a role in local education policy, there are no reasons to strengthen that role.
Hoewel de gemeente een rol heeft in het lokale onderwijsbeleid, zijn er geen redenen voor een versterking van die rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Taalbarrière stremt Sabaanse Studenten’

MPs Van Laar and Jadnanansing asked about reports that Saban students struggle with language barriers in Dutch higher education and about barriers to studying in the United States. The minister said the data do not show most Saban students failing in the Netherlands, acknowledged language and cultural difficulties, pointed to extra Dutch lessons, a preparatory programme and an inventory of study options due to be completed in August 2014.
From the DUO data above it cannot be concluded that the majority of Saban students run into problems when studying in the Netherlands.
Uit de hierboven weergegeven gegevens van de DUO kan niet worden opgemaakt dat het merendeel van de Sabaanse studenten bij studie in Nederland in de problemen komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Rekentoets niet meetellen’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the mandatory arithmetic test for secondary school pupils risks creating a culture of accountability, whether teachers are adequately prepared, and whether pupils may be harmed in motivation or diploma chances. The State Secretary rejected these concerns, pointed to extra funding and teacher training, and said the timeline (test counting from 2015–2016) will stand, with monitoring of outcomes.
I am of the view that schools have sufficient time, with an implementation period of nearly six years, to adjust and optimise arithmetic education.
Ik ben van mening dat de scholen met de implementatieperiode van bijna zes jaar voldoende tijd hebben om het rekenonderwijs bij te sturen en te optimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over het bericht ‘Schoolrendement belangrijker dan leerling’

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the minister whether school selection hurdles that deny pupils from lower socio-economic backgrounds a fair chance are acceptable, and whether additional entrance tests at secondary schools are unlawful given a prior motion. The minister acknowledged that selection mechanisms must not be misused, promised a fuller policy response to the Onderwijsraad advice before summer, and deferred the question on additional tests to earlier answers.
A detailed description of our policy on easing transitions and access to the various types of education will be sent to you before the summer as a policy response to the Onderwijsraad advice.

Een uitvoerige beschrijving van ons beleid op de versoepeling van overgangen en toegankelijkheid van en naar de diverse onderwijssoorten, zullen wij u voor de zomer aanbieden als beleidsreactie op het advies van de Onderwijsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Inspectie wil geld terug van ROC's’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about reports that the Education Inspectorate wants money back from vocational colleges (ROCs) whose apprenticeship programmes failed legal requirements, and whether this amounts to improper claims on public funds. The minister answered that no final decisions have been taken yet, that the institutions can respond to the proposed recovery under the General Administrative Law Act, and that she intends to set funding lower and recover the amounts, though she declined to name the institutions or give totals.
At present a number of institutions have received a proposed decision from the Education Inspectorate to recover funds.
Op dit moment heeft een aantal instellingen van de Onderwijsinspectie (hierna: inspectie) een voorgenomen besluit tot terugvordering ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Stille crisis in mbo’

An MP asked the Minister of Education about financial problems at ROC Leiden, including which decisions caused them, what measures are being taken, and how similar problems will be prevented. The Minister confirmed ROC Leiden is under heightened supervision due to a liquidity problem tied to a new building and complex financing, commissioned an external financial study, asked the Inspectorate to investigate governance, and promised to report back once results are known.

In addition, with the interests of ROC Leiden's students in mind, I have asked the Inspectorate to start an investigation under Article 15 of the Education Supervision Act, examining the governance conduct at ROC Leiden.

Daarnaast heb ik, met het oog op de belangen van de studenten van ROC Leiden, de inspectie verzocht een onderzoek te starten als bedoeld in artikel 15 van de Wet op het onderwijstoezicht waarbij gekeken zal worden naar het bestuurlijk handelen bij ROC Leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Grote examenfraude ROC Amsterdam’

MP Jadnanansing asked the minister about exam fraud at ROC Amsterdam, how it compares to Ibn Ghaldoun, whether the Inspectorate is involved, and how school exams were leaked. The minister responded that investigations are ongoing, the Inspectorate is monitoring the case, and that schools are themselves responsible for exam security procedures.
The Inspectorate of Education closely monitors the measures taken by ROC Amsterdam.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs volgt de door het ROC van Amsterdam ingezette maatregelen nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over het bericht “Scholen niet blij met vergelijkingssite”

MPs Jadnanansing and Ypma asked the State Secretary for Education about criticism that the new school comparison website scholenopdekaart.nl is a confusing mass of data, the cost of Vensters PO compared with MBO Transparant, and whether data is openly available and SchoolInfo falls outside Wob and SLOA. The State Secretary rejected the criticism, explained the costs and the public nature of the data, confirmed SchoolInfo is outside Wob and SLOA, and promised a separate letter on transparency in spring.
In a separate letter to the House, which I will send you this spring, I will set out my vision on transparency and thereby also on Vensters voor Verantwoording PO and VO.
In een aparte brief aan uw Kamer, die ik u dit voorjaar toezend, zal ik mijn visie op transparantie en daarmee ook op Vensters voor Verantwoording PO en VO uiteen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het falend onderwijstoezicht op Ibn Ghaldoun

An MP asked the state secretary why the education inspectorate failed to act on Ibn Ghaldoun earlier, given repeated signals, and how it will address fragmented oversight of weak schools. The state secretary acknowledged fragmented, insufficiently integrated oversight, promised that from August 2014 the inspectorate will judge at board level and consider prior supervision history, and declined to give a firm answer on a hypothetical 'what if' scenario.
From August 2014 the inspectorate will assess at board level where there are risks in quality (in departments), finances or signals.
Met ingang van augustus 2014 zal de inspectie op bestuursniveau oordelen, als er sprake is van risico's het gebied van kwaliteit (bij afdelingen), financiën of bij signalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de gebrekkige kennis van Nederlanders over de universele mensenrechten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about Dutch citizens' limited knowledge of universal human rights, the claimed lack of systematic human rights education in schools, the share of youth aware of children's rights, and whether the government will structurally embed human rights in citizenship education. The State Secretary disagreed that human rights education is not guaranteed, cited curriculum goals and a forthcoming letter on citizenship education, and committed to supporting schools and reviewing core goals.
I do not agree with that.
Ik ben het daar niet mee eens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een dreigend tekort aan vakmensen

The MP asks the Minister of Education about the decline in youth choosing craft vocational training, the risk of shortages of skilled workers, and what will be done to attract youth to these trades. The Minister states that the falling interest is a matter of youth choice and sector responsibility, notes that enrolment in the listed courses has risen overall, points to pilots, the Techniekpact and the Focus op Vakmanschap plan, and promises to inform Parliament in spring after the MBO tour.
Parliament will be informed in the spring about the outcomes of this tour.
Uw Kamer zal in het voorjaar over de uitkomsten van deze tour worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over regionale opleidingscentra die autisten weren

An MP asked the Minister of Education whether regional vocational colleges deliberately exclude students with autism, which would conflict with their duty of care, and whether the equal-treatment law is enforced. The minister said the Inspectorate will investigate the complaints and the College for Human Rights may too, while stating that many students with autism do study in vocational education and that institutions must make reasonable adjustments or refer students to a more suitable programme.
The reports are for me a reason to have further investigation carried out by the Inspectorate of Education.
De meldingen zijn voor mij aanleiding tot het laten doen van nader onderzoek door de Inspectie van het Onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Hamer over het bericht dat er 280.000 potentiële stageplaatsen onbenut blijven

MPs Jadnanansing and Hamer asked the Minister of Education about a report that 280,000 potential internship places remain unused, the risk of an internship shortage raised by SBB, and why small firms and self-employed people rarely take interns. The minister answered that the stage and apprenticeship offensive is working, that self-employed people face no legal barriers but must meet quality criteria, that a practice-learning subsidy starts in January 2014, and that she opposes loosening quality requirements for training firms.
I am willing to examine whether such collaborations can make it easier for self-employed people to offer an internship or work-placement.
Ik ben bereid om te onderzoeken of dergelijke samenwerkingsverbanden ervoor kunnen zorgen dat het eenvoudiger wordt voor zzp'ers om een stage of leerwerkbaan aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de gebrekkige informatievoorziening bij de slaagregeling in het vmbo

An MP asked the state secretary for Education why many vmbo schools were unclear about the tightened pass/fail rule and whether information was poor, and whether pupils can be blamed for not knowing. The state secretary replied that schools were informed through letters, the examination website and information meetings, that no information gap was evident, that the rule is in the examination decree rather than the PTA, and listed improvement channels without new commitments.
The reactions from schools present showed no sign whatsoever that there was an information gap.
Uit de reacties van daar aanwezige scholen is geenszins gebleken dat sprake was van een informatieachterstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Jadnanansing over het bericht dat een pabo-studente geweigerd zou zijn voor een stage bij een Montessori basisschool vanwege het dragen van een hoofddoek

MPs Yücel and Jadnanansing asked whether a Rotterdam pabo student was refused a traineeship at a public Montessori school because she wore a headscarf, and about the wider position of headscarves and dress rules in schools. The state secretary answered that the traineeship ended for other substantive reasons, that the school did discourage the headscarf, that the school board and university agreed the headscarf is not an issue, and explained the case law and the rules for public versus religious schools.
This showed that the student was not refused because of wearing a headscarf, but that the traineeship did not proceed for other, substantive reasons.
Hieruit is gebleken dat de studente niet is geweigerd op grond van het dragen van een hoofddoek, maar dat de stage om andere, inhoudelijke redenen niet is doorgegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het gebrek aan stageplekken voor duizenden mbo-leerlingen

An MP asked the education minister about nearly 3,000 vocational students lacking internship places and possibly being unable to graduate, and about the quality of stages found through 'creative' solutions. The minister said the 3,000 figure refers to reports to a complaints desk, that over half had a placement by end-September, and that the government and SBB are pursuing a regional internship offensive, while the school's duty of care is to support students in finding placements.
If 3,000 students could not graduate due to a lack of internship places, I would consider that a serious matter.
Als 3.000 studenten niet zouden kunnen afstuderen vanwege het gebrek aan stageplekken, zou ik dat een ernstige zaak vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over een overschot dat ontstaat van studenten die zijn opgeleid voor de kinderopvang

An MP asked the education minister whether a surplus of about 14,000 graduates from childcare training would arise by 2015, and why vocational colleges keep training students for childcare despite job losses there. The minister denied a graduate surplus, citing that a staff surplus differs from a graduate surplus, announced the School-ex 2.0 support programme and better labour-market information, and said future childcare labour demand cannot be predicted.
The School-ex 2.0 programme has recently started.
Het programma School- ex 2.0 is onlangs gestart.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Van Meenen (D66) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Vanaf de gracht brallen over leiderschap in het onderwijs» (ingezonden 7 juni 201

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Meenen asked the state secretary about a newspaper report on consultancy firms influencing school leadership, including their effectiveness, spending on external advisers, and the ministry's ties to CBE. The state secretary said school boards are responsible for hiring advisers, the ministry does not track such spending, and it reported small CBE payments and general external hiring costs.
The department has no insight into this kind of specific spending by education institutions.
Het departement heeft geen inzicht in dit soort specifieke uitgaven van onderwijsinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het experiment ‘summerschool’

An MP asked the state secretary of Education about the reported success of a summer school pilot that let 87% of participating pupils advance without repeating a year, and whether the pilot should be extended. The state secretary said the pilot is being evaluated, results are expected in December 2014, and no conclusions or decisions on extension will be drawn before then.
I am awaiting the evaluation of the experiment before making further statements on this.
Ik wacht de evaluatie van het experiment af alvorens ik hier nadere uitspraken over doe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over onderzoek onder voortijdig schoolverlaters m.b.t. preventie en begeleiding van deze groep

An MP asks the Minister of Education about the ROA study of early school leavers, including whether the finding that many feel no one tried to help them is worrying and whether policy should be tightened. The minister answers that the approach has halved early school leaving, that schools can do more on intake, guidance and attendance, and that she will keep pressing schools on these points.
I will continue to hold schools and institutions to account on these points.
Ik blijf scholen en instellingen op deze punten aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Ypma over de administratie van instellingen in het onderwijs

Two MPs asked the state secretary for Education about irregularities in the school registry (BRIN) and whether schools can reclassify branches to avoid the regional planning procedure, plus the validity of diplomas issued under a different school name. The state secretary denied that the registry is generally unreliable, said schools must report changes and that main branches can be reclassified only through the regional plan or merger rules, and declined to invalidate diplomas, while promising to address a legal gap and to remind schools of diploma rules.
In my policy response to the evaluation of facilities planning I announce that I will repair this omission in the law, namely 'what happens when the main branch is closed and the branch is not'.

In mijn beleidsreactie op de evaluatie voorzieningenplanning kondig ik aan deze omissie in de wet, namelijk «wat gebeurt er als de hoofdvestiging gesloten wordt en de nevenvestiging niet», te repareren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mohandis en Jadnanansing inzake het feit dat studenten problemen ervaren tijdens hun stage

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister about student interns facing bullying and weak supervision, citing a 2013 stage monitor showing supervision rated only barely sufficient and one in five students reporting harassment. The minister called the findings serious and said schools must ensure supervision and teachers need adequate time, but left concrete improvements to schools and employers, seeing no direct role for herself.
I do not see a role for myself here in the first instance.
Ik zie hier in eerste instantie geen rol voor mijzelf weggelegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing inzake het adviesrapport van de Kinderombudsman Van leerplicht naar leerrecht

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary for Education how to tackle thousands of truant children, including the Children's Ombudsman's view that the system is too rigid, that passend onderwijs does not solve the problem, and whether a jeugdregisseur with binding authority is needed. The state secretary agreed flexible solutions are needed, pointed to existing leerplicht exemptions and the coming zorgplicht under passend onderwijs, and rejected statutory binding authority for a regisseur in favour of local cooperation.
Statutorily regulated binding authority does not, in my view, fit a system that offers room for local tailoring.
Een wettelijk geregelde doorzettingsmacht vind ik niet passen in een systeem waarin ruimte voor lokaal maatwerk wordt geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht dat veel jongeren een opleiding met gering baanperspectief volgen

An MP asked the education minister about reports that many young people enrol in vocational courses with poor job prospects, and about measures such as linking funding to graduates' labour-market success and improving study guidance. The minister acknowledged the signal, argued the FNV indicator is incomplete, and announced a tighter labour-market-prospects duty, performance agreements and a future power to revoke courses.
I intend to make the existing labour-market-prospects duty more results-oriented.
Ik ben voornemens om de bestaande zorgplicht arbeidsmarktperspectief meer resultaatgericht te maken.
Antwoord op vragen Jadnanansing over het uitgelekte vwo-examen Frans

An MP asked the state secretary about the leaked VWO French exam, the risk of further leaks, and measures to protect exams and provide replacements. The state secretary confirmed being informed, described the continuity plan and a one-day delay, said no further exams were known stolen, and promised an evaluation and investigation into the theft.
The investigation into the precise circumstances of the theft is still ongoing.
Het onderzoek naar de precieze toedracht van de diefstal is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ypma en Jadnanansing over de uitspraak van het College voor de Rechten van de Mens over het gebruik van de formulekaart bij dyscalculie

MPs Ypma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary of Education about the College voor de Rechten van de Mens ruling that a dyscalculia student should be allowed a formula card at the wiskunde exam, which the College voor Examens had refused. The secretary answers that a formula card is acceptable only if it does not replace required understanding or exam requirements, that the CvE will advise schools at the start of next year, and that a limited card was arranged for the student.
The CvE will advise schools at the start of the next course year on the use of a formula card and the rules that apply to it at the central exams.
Het CvE zal scholen aan het begin van het volgende cursusjaar adviseren over het gebruik van een formulekaart en de regels die daartoe gelden bij de centrale examens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Jadnanansing over de onnodige verstrekking van GBA-uittreksels voor de leerlingenadministratie op scholen

MPs Oosenbrug and Jadnanansing asked why schools still demand unnecessary GBA extracts from parents for enrolment, citing cost and municipal workload figures. The minister says the figures are a modelling exercise not verified by government, that some schools still ask for extracts, and that he will contact schools, accountants and parents and recheck with municipalities at year-end.
The government itself has not researched the number of GBA extracts issued for school enrolment, so the correct figures are not known to me.
Er is door de overheid zelf geen onderzoek gedaan naar het aantal verstrekte GBA-uittreksels ten behoeve van inschrijving in het onderwijs, derhalve zijn de juiste cijfers mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de staking van leerlingen in Maastricht n.a.v. gedwongen ontslag personeel Sint-Maartenscollege

An MP asked the State Secretary for Education about student strikes at the Sint-Maartenscollege in Maastricht over staff cuts and possible forced dismissals linked to financial problems. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate found no major financial problems, that no forced dismissals occur (staff will be redeployed to other locations due to falling pupil numbers), and that he is already discussing options with the governing body.
Inquiry with the competent authority of LVO shows that there is no question of forced dismissals.
Navraag bij het bevoegd gezag van LVO leert dat er geen sprake is van gedwongen ontslagen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yüçel en Jadnanansing over het optreden van een imam in de aula van een middelbare school in Vlissingen

MPs Yüçel and Jadnanansing asked how a controversial imam came to give a talk in a Vlissingen secondary school hall without the school knowing its content, and whether the school was put in an embarrassing position. The minister answered that the school rents out space without vetting event content, the organising group did not specifically report the speaker, the school will now assess rental requests on content, and the speech is publicly available online.
In future it will also assess rental requests on their content.
In de toekomst verzoeken van verhuur ook inhoudelijk zal beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht "Meer scholen met geldproblemen".

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about reports of more schools with financial problems and the risk to education quality, the causes, how insolvent schools will be handled, and a concrete recovery plan. The state secretary said quality is monitored by the inspectorate, cited falling pupil numbers and late cost adjustment as main causes, stated boards are primarily responsible, and announced support projects and intensified financial oversight of all boards within three years.
The inspectorate will actively approach and question all boards where it detects points of concern in financial management about the measures those boards have taken or must take.

De inspectie zal alle besturen waar zij aandachtspunten in de financiële huishouding bespeurt actief benaderen en bevragen op de maatregelen die besturen daarvoor hebben getroffen dan wel moeten treffen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over selectie in het mbo

An MP asked the education minister whether selection at the gate by mbo institutions is undesirable, given that vmbo diplomas grant access, and how many students are refused. The minister rejects the Expertisecentrum Beroepsonderwijs's concern, cannot yet quantify refusals, and says the Inspectie will monitor and a stricter admission duty may be considered if the problem grows.
At this moment the information needed to answer your question is lacking.
Op dit moment ontbreekt de informatie om uw vraag te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de financiële positie van Landstede MBO

MP Jadnanansing asked the minister whether Landstede MBO's board is right that its finances are sound and whether the institution could face the same fate as Amarantis, and asked about quality problems flagged by the inspectorate. The minister declined to equate the two cases, rejected the board's view that the accommodation burden is unavoidable, and said the inspectorate is closely monitoring Landstede under heightened financial and quality supervision with a meeting planned.
Landstede is under adjusted financial supervision due to elevated risk.
Landstede staat onder aangepast financieel toezicht wegens verhoogd risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Yücel over het bericht ‘Meer Marokkaanse drop-outs'

MPs Jadnanansing and Yücel asked the Minister of Education about a report of rising early school leaving among Moroccan-Dutch youth, the effectiveness of €30 million spent on the targeted approach, and the CPB findings on coaching. The minister answered that the rise was limited to a small group in 22 municipalities, that the rate has since fallen, that the subsidy served broader goals, and that she will continue the regional early-school-leaving approach and report to parliament.
In the meantime the decline in dropouts has resumed, both nationally and in the 22 municipalities.
Inmiddels heeft de daling van de uitval weer doorgezet, zowel op landelijk niveau als in de 22 gemeenten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake het bericht ‘Binnenkort geen timmerman meer te vinden’

An MP asked the education minister about reports of fewer technology lessons in secondary education and a shortage of skilled tradespeople. The state secretary replied that schools have discretion over lesson hours, cited existing targets and funding for technology, and said the critical teacher survey would be taken into account in the upcoming Techniekpact.
I do not have the precise data on the number of hours schools in secondary education spend on technology.
Ik beschik niet over de precieze gegevens over het aantal uren dat scholen in het voortgezet onderwijs besteden aan techniek.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de internationale school Eerde in Ommen

An MP asked the state secretary about alleged management abuses, gagging contracts, teacher pay and diploma validity at the international school Eerde, and whether the Inspectorate can intervene. The state secretary said the Inspectorate has only limited supervision of such schools, that Landstede's board has changed governance, and that the minister will raise the gagging contracts and any negative balance with the board and the accreditation body if needed.
I consider this an undesirable situation that does not fit normal labour relations in an educational institution, and I will hold the Landstede board to account for it.
Ik acht dit een ongewenste situatie die niet past bij normale arbeidsverhoudingen in een onderwijsinstelling en ik zal het bestuur van de Landstede hierop aanspreken.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over het bericht “Meer vroegtijdig schooluitval op vmbo-scholen”

An MP asked the state secretary about a report finding higher early school leaving at schools offering only vmbo, and about labour-market prospects, parental involvement and intensive coaching. The government replied that the link exists but concerns a small group, that the Aanval op Schooluitval programme and the ouders en school samen programme address it, and that further CPB research is planned.
We will inform the ROCs about the positive effects of intensive guidance on early school leaving in this pilot.
Wij zullen de ROC’s wel informeren over de positieve effecten van intensieve begeleiding op vsv in deze pilot.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kuzu en Jadnanansing over de aandacht van scholen voor het omgaan met geld door jongeren

MPs Kuzu and Jadnanansing asked whether young people lack financial self-reliance and how schools and government address responsible money management. The State Secretary answered that core objectives in primary and secondary education cover consumer self-reliance and budgeting, leaving school-level implementation to schools and declining to direct schools to use specific Nibud lesson packages.
It is not for the government to encourage schools to use certain lesson packages.
Het is niet aan de overheid scholen te stimuleren bepaalde lespakketten te gebruiken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansingh betreffende een dreigend tekort aan ervaren praktijkdocenten in het beroepsonderwijs

An MP asked the education minister about a predicted shortage of experienced vocational practice teachers and whether specialist-knowledge training is adequate. The minister disagreed that practice knowledge is lacking, said a study on the MBO labour market is underway, and promised a letter on strengthening teacher training.
I will send you a letter in the coming days announcing measures to strengthen training for teachers in vmbo and mbo.
Ik stuur u één dezer dagen een brief waarin ik maatregelen aankondig om de opleiding voor leraren in het vmbo en mbo te versterken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake de aansluiting van hbo'ers op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the education minister about a report finding that higher vocational (hbo) graduates are insufficiently connected to the labour market, and whether concrete improvements would be pursued. The minister replied that the connection is adequate according to student and employer ratings, that existing strategic agenda and coalition measures already address it, and that no additional action is currently needed.
I note that the connection of hbo with the labour market is sufficient.
Ik constateer dat de aansluiting van het hbo op de arbeidsmarkt voldoende is.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing inzake mbo-scholen die stagiairs onvoldoende begeleiden

An MP asked the education minister whether a pilot showed Amsterdam vocational students get too little help finding internships and too little supervision during them, and whether schools failing at this would be held accountable. The minister said the pilot's evidence is limited but a signal, schools must improve supervision, a national monitor per institution is being commissioned, and institutions will be called to account.
I expect educational institutions to seriously work on better supervision.
Ik verwacht van onderwijsinstellingen dat ze serieus werk maken van een betere begeleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Jadnanansing van uw Kamer inzake de huur van een skybox door Consent

Two PvdA MPs asked the education minister about reports that school board Consent rented a FC Twente skybox using education funds, asked staff to volunteer there, and closed a deficit by enlarging classes. The minister confirmed the rental, said the Inspectorate monitors lawful use of public funds and has questioned the board, and declined to pre-empt the Inspectorate's findings on the board's quality.
However, I do not want to anticipate the findings of the Inspectorate.
Ik wil echter niet vooruitlopen op de bevindingen van de Inspectie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Kuiken over problemen bij de opleiding tot ambulancebroeder

MPs Jadnanansing and Kuiken asked why the sector requested the medical first-responder training but now cannot or will not offer enough internship places, and what will be done for students. The minister says student intake was reduced from 90 to 75, legal embedding of graduates' powers is under discussion with the sector, and the programme was added to the Stagefonds to fund internship places.
This is being discussed with the Ministry of Health, the universities of applied sciences, the hospitals and the ambulance sector, with the aim of resolving it as soon as possible.
Daarover wordt met het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, de hogescholen, de ziekenhuizen en de ambulancesector gesproken, met als doel op zo kort mogelijke termijn
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Plasterk inzake mbo-instellingen en derivaten

MPs Jadnanansing and Plasterk asked whether vocational (mbo) institutions that traded interest rate derivatives, now costing them money, stayed within their tasks, and how such risky products could be prevented. The minister answered that institutions must follow the Beleggen en Belenen rules, that the Inspectorate is investigating derivative use with results expected in autumn, and that action will be considered if unacceptable risks are found.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the financial position of all publicly funded vocational education institutions.
Ik heb aan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar het financiële cijferbeeld van alle publiek bekostigde instellingen in het mbo.
Antwoord vragen Dijsselbloem, Hamer en Jadnanansing inzake ‘gebrek aan steun voor scholen bij het opzetten van burgerschapslessen’

Three Labour MPs asked the Minister of Education whether she would act on the Education Council's finding that schools lack clarity and support for citizenship lessons, and whether she would produce a plan to improve support and materials. The Minister acknowledged the advice, said citizenship is a shared school and parental task rather than a subject, and deferred a full policy response to the next cabinet.
I will leave a comprehensive policy response to this advice to the next cabinet.
laat ik een uitgebreide beleidsreactie op dit advies aan het volgende kabinet
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de effecten van de langstudeerboete op deeltijdstudenten

An MP asked the state secretary whether, after the July 2012 court ruling, part-time students who began before 1 February 2011 are exempt from the long-study fine, how study duration of part-time programmes is determined, and whether institutions will be compensated for resulting costs. The state secretary answered that these students are not exempt but subject to a transitional rule, that study duration is taken from formally fixed documents, and that institutions will be compensated for the financial effects on the state contribution but not for litigation or administrative costs.
This institution-specific information is only known to the universities and universities of applied sciences.
Deze instellingsspecifieke informatie is alleen bij de universiteiten en hogescholen bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de aansluiting van mbo-opleidingen op de arbeidsmarkt

The MP Jadnanansing asked the Minister of Education about a newspaper report that vocational (mbo) programmes train students for jobs that do not exist, and whether the government would act to better align them with the labour market and to improve honest advice to students. The minister replied that labour market prospects are largely reasonable to good (economics being an exception), that graduate unemployment is low, rejected the characterisation of a passive approach, and pointed to an information brochure and a LOB programme for student guidance.
It is indeed important that participants are informed in good time about the career prospects of the programmes they are (considering) choosing.
Het is inderdaad van belang dat deelnemers tijdig worden voorgelicht over de loopbaanperspectieven van de opleidingen waar zij voor (overwegen te) kiezen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de brief van studentenorganisatie ISO over de langstudeerboete

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a student-organisation letter on the long-study fine, and whether part-time students are unfairly penalised and whether earlier study history can be used. The state secretary answered that the rulings clarify the rules, that part-time students are not inherently slower, and that hardship cases can be handled through institutional hardship funds, with student organisations kept informed.

To calculate the number of enrolled study years of a student, the sum of their enrolments in the Central Register of Higher Education on the reference date in any year from 1 September 1991 onward is used.

Voor de berekening van het aantal ingeschreven studiejaren van een student wordt uitgegaan van de optelling van diens inschrijvingen in het Centraal register inschrijving hoger onderwijs op de peildatum in enig jaar vanaf 1 september 1991.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het opleggen van de langstudeerboete aan studenten van de TU Delft

The MP asks the state secretary whether it is unreasonable that TU Delft students face a 3000 euro long-study fine due to how the hard cut-off was introduced, and whether they can be exempted. The state secretary rejects both, arguing the case is not merely administrative since students were enrolled in and examined for the master, and refers to a letter for withdrawing the fine.
No, as stated in the answer to question 2, this is not merely an administrative matter.
Nee, zoals aangegeven in het antwoord op vraag 2 betreft het hier niet slechts een administratieve kwestie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het opleggen van langstudeerdersboetes aan zieke studenten

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable to impose long-study fines on students who fall ill, and how the earlier commitment to spare sick students will be restored. The state secretary said the law was amended to give extra time to more sick students and that the wrongly fined case was corrected, while rejecting that the measure has more drawbacks than benefits.
In that specific case DUO indeed did not act correctly, but this has since been rectified.
In dat specifieke geval heeft DUO inderdaad niet juist geopereerd, maar dit is inmiddels rechtgezet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de peildatum voor de langstudeerboete

An MP asked the state secretary why the cut-off date for the long-study fine was set at 1 November, allowing students to use up their extra year unnoticed via the 1 February scheme, and whether the rules would be changed. The state secretary replied that the cut-off date is 30 September rather than 1 November, that it is fixed by law and matches the funding date, and declined to change it.
The law chose a single reference date to limit administrative burdens for institutions and to ensure as transparent a system as possible for students.
Er is in de wet gekozen voor één peilmoment om de administratieve lasten voor de instellingen te beperken en te zorgen voor een zo transparant mogelijk systeem voor studenten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Monasch over hypotheekverstrekking aan mensen met een studieschuld

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked whether banks' practice of applying a 2% monthly norm to the total student debt, rather than actual repayments, inflates the mortgage burden and whether they will raise this with lenders. The State Secretary answered that lenders must consider student loan burdens under the Wft, that DUO loans are not consumer credit under that rule, and that banks and insurers agreed to use 0.75% of the original loan from 1 April 2013, with the government endorsing this method.
In good consultation these parties agreed that the mortgage lender will, in future, in principle base the monthly financial burden attached to the student debt on 0.75% of the original loan.

In goed overleg zijn deze partijen overeengekomen dat de hypothecair financier in de toekomst bij de berekening van de aan de studieschuld verbonden maandelijkse financiële lasten in beginsel uitgaat van 0,75% van de oorspronkelijke lening.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Timmermans en Jadnanansing over de onderwijsachterstand in Zuid-Limburg

MPs Timmermans and Jadnanansing asked the Education Minister whether educational disadvantage in South Limburg is comparable to the Randstad, whether it stems from mine closures and deprived pupil populations, and whether a joint regional approach will be initiated. The minister answered that there is no indication the problems are comparable, that no research links them to mine closures, and that existing provincial and national programmes and a convenant already cover the regional approach.
I do not have any indication that the problems are comparable to those in the Randstad.
Ik beschik niet over een indicatie dat de problemen vergelijkbaar zijn met die in de Randstad.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de langstudeerdersboete

An MP asks the state secretary for Education about the long-term student fine (langstudeerdersboete) after a court ruling upheld it, questioning its political support, the likelihood of its survival, and whether collection should be postponed. The secretary rejects postponement and calls the measure in force, while promising a general administrative order to address the court's ruling on part-time students.
I will promote that as soon as possible a general administrative order (amvb) is published that gives effect to the court's ruling.
Ik zal bevorderen dat zo spoedig mogelijk een algemene maatregel van bestuur (amvb) wordt gepubliceerd waarin gehoor wordt gegeven aan de uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing inzake frauderende hoogleraar Erasmus Universiteit Rotterdam (EUR)

An MP asked the state secretary about a Erasmus University professor accused of research fraud, who denied it and said his department culture left him feeling not personally guilty, and whether rules or dialogue with universities should change. The state secretary said integrity rules were recently tightened, researchers bear personal responsibility, universities enforce compliance, and no further action was needed.
No, I see no reason for that.
Nee, daartoe zie ik geen aanleiding.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de verwachte uitval van veel eerstejaars studenten

An MP asked whether the binding study advice (BSA) and expected first-year dropout are a concern, and whether matching interviews could prevent dropout. The state secretary said raising study-credit thresholds is not expected to cause mass dropout, and that study-choice activities are a useful instrument, with a bill on the statutory right to such activities expected in autumn 2012.
Yes, study-choice interviews and other study-choice activities are instruments that can contribute to reducing first-year dropout.
Ja, studiekeuzegesprekken en andere studiekeuzeactiviteiten zijn instrumenten die een bijdrage kunnen leveren aan de terugdringing van de uitval in het eerste jaar.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Van Dekken over de langstudeerdersboete voor topsporters

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Dekken asked whether the long-student fine deters elite athletes from combining sport with study and whether it should be replaced. Minister Zijlstra rejected this, pointing to existing extra study years, loan options, profiling-fund support and university athlete schemes, and promised few exceptions.
No, I do not share this view.
Nee, ik deel deze mening niet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijsselbloem en Jadnanansing over de afnemende interesse voor lerarenopleidingen en pabo’s

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about the falling intake for teacher-training and pabo programmes, the effect of the public-sector pay freeze, and the projected teacher shortages. The state secretary said the June figures are provisional, attributed the drop partly to the new language and arithmetic test, gave sector-by-sector shortage estimates and listed measures such as career and alternative-entry schemes, while leaving the pay freeze for a new cabinet to decide.
It is up to a new cabinet to decide whether or not to lift the pay freeze.
Het is aan een nieuw kabinet om te beslissen over het wel of niet opheffen van de nullijn.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het per scriptie betalen van een begeleider aan de UvA

An MP asked whether a university lecturer being paid per supervised thesis undermines diploma quality and whether such practice should be stopped. The state secretary said quality safeguards must be in place, the Inspectorate is seeking information from the University of Amsterdam, and no separate inspection of other institutions is planned.
The inspectorate has asked the college questions about the nature and scale of the hiring and how quality is safeguarded in such cases.
De inspectie heeft het college vragen gesteld over de aard en omvang van de inhuur en op welke wijze in dergelijke gevallen de kwaliteit wordt geborgd.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de langstudeersboete voor premasterstudenten

An MP asked the state secretary who should pay compensation for premaster students wrongly charged the long-study fine, whether disagreement between universities and the ministry will delay compensation, and whether other flaws in the long-study measure need fixing. The state secretary answered that institutions will compensate these students from the coming academic year, that there is no delay, and that the issue was already known and resolved through consultation with institutions.
The institutions will compensate premaster students who become long-term students because they enrolled in a master's programme for their premaster.
De instellingen zullen premasterstudenten compenseren die langstudeerder worden als gevolg van het feit dat zij voor hun premaster in een masteropleiding zijn ingeschreven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de 10-urennorm voor studenten van buiten de Europese Economische Ruimte

An MP asked the state secretary for Education whether the 10-hour weekly work limit for non-EEA students should be raised, comparing it with the EU-student 56-hour rule and asking about study progress and internship barriers. The state secretary declined to raise the limit, arguing study must remain the main purpose of residence, and said the rules differ because EU law applies only to Europeans, while noting no known internship obstacles.
The maximum norm of 10 hours of work per week or three months of full-time work in summer months precisely guarantees that study remains the main purpose.
De maximumnorm van 10 uur werk per week of drie maanden fulltime werk in de zomermaanden waarborgt juist dat studie het hoofddoel is.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over het terugbetalen van studieschuld

An MP asked the state secretary of Education whether DUO should allow student debtors to raise their fixed monthly repayment amount and whether such extra repayment should be encouraged. The secretary said extra repayment is already possible voluntarily, that a monthly-amount increase cannot be realised quickly because DUO's systems are inadequate, and that it will be examined in the Programma Vernieuwing Studiefinanciering with a possible date of 2015.
However, DUO cannot realise an increase of the legally repayable monthly amount in the short term.
DUO kan verhoging van het wettelijk terug te betalen maandbedrag echter niet op korte termijn realiseren.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Jacobi over de toekomst van de enige academische opleiding Friese taal en cultuur

MPs Jadnanansing and Jacobi asked whether the University of Groningen's plan to fold Frisian language and culture into a broad European languages bachelor threatens the only academic Frisian programme. The state secretary replied that the Frisian bachelor stays separately registered in the CROHO register and will be offered jointly with the new programme to safeguard Frisian's sustainability.

I understand that, contrary to what the University of Groningen's website states about Frisian, the Frisian language and culture bachelor programme remains registered as a separate programme in the central register of higher education programmes.

Ik heb begrepen dat – in afwijking van hetgeen op de website van de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen met betrekking tot het Fries is gesteld – de bacheloropleiding Friese taal en cultuur aan de RUG als afzonderlijke opleiding geregistreerd blijft in het Centraal Register Opleidingen Hoger Onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de taalvaardigheid van hbo-studenten

MP Jadnanansing asked the state secretary for Education about Dutch language skills of HBO students, whether this hinders success, why it occurs, and whether a language test would help. The state secretary acknowledges the concern, cites declining language levels across education sectors and new reference-level measures, says the responsibility for language mastery lies mainly with feeder education, and leaves the decision on language tests in higher education to the institutions.
As far as I am concerned, it is up to the higher education institutions themselves to assess for which programmes a language test is useful and necessary.
Wat mij betreft is het verder aan de instellingen voor hoger onderwijs zelf om de inschatting te maken voor welke opleidingen een taaltoets nuttig en noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de effecten van de langstudeerdersboete op leraren die willen doorstuderen

An MP asked the state secretary whether the long-student fine (langstudeerdersboete) deters teachers from pursuing further study and whether it should be withdrawn or adjusted for teacher training. The state secretary said he cannot say how many teachers will be deterred, that the rules allow three years at statutory tuition plus subsidy before the higher fee applies, and that he will not withdraw the measure but will offer case-by-case relief via the profileringsfonds.
I cannot say how many teachers will not (further) study because of the long-student measure.
Ik kan niet zeggen hoeveel leraren niet (verder) zullen studeren vanwege de langstudeerdersmaatregel.

Vragen van de leden Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Jasper VanDijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Ondernemende universiteit in zwaar weer» (ingezonden 26 oktober 2

MPs asked the state secretary about a newspaper report on alleged irregular spending, property losses and integrity gaps at TU Delft, and whether the ministry should act on PwC's withheld audit approval in 2007 and 2008. The state secretary said the Inspectorate validated TU Delft's commitments and sent improvement points, and that no sanctions were imposed because non-compliance with European tendering rules carries no state sanction policy.
On the basis of this consultation, the Inspectorate of Education further validated TU Delft's input.
Op basis van dit overleg heeft de Inspectie van het Onderwijs de inbreng van TU Delft nader gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de reis- en onkostenvergoedingen bij de TU Delft

An MP asked the state secretary what action would follow reports of excessive expense claims by TU Delft board members and whether the expenses were necessary. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate of Education sent a letter demanding improvements and reporting, that the supervisory board promised more attention to internal rules, and that the board decides on necessity.
The Inspectorate of Education sent the Executive Board of TU Delft a letter on 6 February 2012 about a number of points for improvement at TU Delft.
De Inspectie van het Onderwijs heeft het College van Bestuur van TU Delft op 6 februari 2012 een brief gestuurd over een aantal verbeterpunten bij TU Delft.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een decaan aan de TU Delft die opdracht gaf aan het bedrijf van zijn echtgenote (ingezonden 17 juni 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about a TU Delft dean who repeatedly awarded university contracts to his wife's company, and whether the situation constitutes serious conflict of interest, whether reprimands suffice, who should have supervised, and whether funds can be recovered. The state secretary answered that conflict of interest is wrong, an accountant's investigation found appearances of conflict but the dean was mostly not directly involved, the dean resigned, a repayment arrangement was made, and that the existing supervisory system (Inspectie, Raad van Toezicht, accountant) is sufficient though the Raad van Toezicht will pay extra attention.
I see no reason to change this supervisory system.
Ik zie geen reden om dit toezichtstelsel aan te passen.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de verdwijning van deeltijdstudies

An MP asked the state secretary for Education whether the disappearance of part-time degree programmes, reported after a sharp drop in applications, was the aim of policy and what would be done to prevent it. The state secretary answered that it is not the aim, that the decline has been ongoing for years, and that measures aimed at aligning part-time provision with demand will follow a broader review, referring to a parallel letter.
Following that broad review, I intend to take measures aimed at the future-proofing of the frameworks for part-time education, particularly regarding the alignment of provision with demand.
Ik ben voornemens naar aanleiding van die brede verkenning maatregelen te nemen gericht op de toekomstbestendigheid van de kaders voor deeltijdonderwijs
Antwoord vragen van Van Dekken en Jadnanansing over de langstudeerdersboete voor studerende topsporters.

MPs Van Dekken and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about the long-study fee's effect on student top athletes, who are often abroad and may fall behind in their studies. The state secretary rejected the concerns, pointing to extra study years, a profileringsfonds for exceptional cases, and institutional top-athlete schemes, and denied that the measure threatens Dutch sporting ambitions.
I am of the view that the number of exceptions to the long-study measure must be very limited.
Ik ben van mening dat het aantal uitzonderingen op de langstudeerdersmaatregel zeer beperkt moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over het bericht “Hoge boete weerhoudt studenten van master”

MP Jadnanansing asked whether the long-study fine deterring students from a master's harms the economy, how many employers see a university bachelor's as sufficient, and whether dropping out of vwo is also a 'conscious choice'. The state secretary answered that choosing to delay a master's is a conscious decision, that survey data show only 2% of university bachelor students will forgo a master because of the fine, and that completion of all programmes is valued.
When asked, the researchers openly provided access to the underlying (aggregated) data.
Desgevraagd hebben de onderzoekers in alle openheid inzage gegeven in de onderliggende (geaggregeerde) gegevens.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over extra betalingseisen van Universiteit van Amsterdam aan studenten

An MP asked whether the University of Amsterdam may charge students extra tuition after its own administrative error, and whether the state will intervene with the university. The state secretary answered that the error was a correction of tuition billing, that students can object and appeal under the WHW, and that he will not intervene with the university.
For students there is the possibility of objection and appeal against the decision of the Central Student Administration (CSA).
Voor studenten is er de mogelijkheid van bezwaar en beroep tegen het besluit van de Centrale Studentenadministratie (CSA).
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Monasch over hypotheekverstrekking aan mensen met een studieschuld

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked whether borrowing for study is responsible and whether banks have tightened mortgage rules for people with student debt.
