The state secretary replied that student debt is rightly counted in mortgage assessments, that banks have not tightened norms but apply them more strictly, and that starters remain important to the housing market.
From the Dutch Banking Association (NvB) I have learned that the norms for granting a mortgage to people with student debt have not become stricter.
Van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Banken (NvB) heb ik vernomen, dat de normen ten aanzien van het verstrekken van een hypotheek aan mensen met een studieschuld niet strenger zijn geworden.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing over de terugval in aanmeldingen voor deeltijdstudies

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about the drop in applications for part-time degree programmes and urged a prompt answer before summer, and whether fixing the long-term student rule was being disguised as technical maintenance. The state secretary promised a letter on the broad part-time review soon, linked to a pending SER advice, and said the long-term student measure would be addressed there.
I intend to inform the House shortly following the broad part-time exploration I announced.
Ik ben voornemens de Kamer op korte termijn te informeren naar aanleiding van de door mij aangekondigde brede verkenning deeltijd.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing inzake het wegjagen van Nederlandse studenten naar buitenlandse universiteiten

An MP asked the state secretary for Education about the flight of Dutch students to foreign universities, citing a newspaper article, and asked for numbers, motives, whether this is a brain drain, and whether Dutch students will stay abroad to work. The state secretary answered that about 16,000 Dutch students were enrolled abroad for a degree in 2007-2008, that motives are personal development and language, that there is no real brain-drain situation since inbound students far outnumber outbound ones, and that no representative stay-rate figures exist.
No representative figures are known on this.
Hierover zijn geen representatieve cijfers bekend.
Antwoord vragen Jadnansing over de vermindering van de uitgaven aan wetenschap

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about a reported 10 percent cut to scientific research and the expected long-term economic damage, and why science should not follow the rule that everything has its price. The state secretary said he expects future earnings to depend on scientific knowledge, pointed to science's intrinsic value, and referred to a forthcoming letter on indirect R&D spending instead of quantifying the long-term damage.
Against the declining direct government spending on R&D stands an increase in indirect spending.
Tegenover de teruglopende directe uitgaven van het Rijk voor R&D staat een toename van de indirecte uitgaven.
Antwoord vragen Jadnanansing en Dijsselbloem over het teruglopende aantal aanmeldingen voor pedagogische opleidingen

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary for Education about the falling number of applicants to teacher-training and pedagogy programmes, including the impact of pay freezes, tuition rules and the long-study fine. The state secretary replied that the decline is mainly in pabo intake, that no specific intake measures are planned for the short term, and that tuition and fine rules will not be relaxed, pointing to alternative routes and career measures.
No specific measures are foreseen to increase intake into the pabo.
Voor verhoging van de instroom in de pabo zijn verder geen specifieke maatregelen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jadnanansing over de verlichting van onderwijsprogramma's van de TU Delft om studenten sneller te laten afstuderen

The MP asked whether TU Delft's plans to lighten degree programmes to shorten study times lower academic content, undermine excellence, and create a perverse incentive from the long-term student measure. The state secretary answered that the curriculum revision aims to improve study-ability within the agreed quality plans, that technical programmes have long had low completion rates, and that the measure does not compromise programme quality.
The revision of the education programme is part of the agreements I have made with the three TUs on improving education quality, including the study-ability of the programmes.

De herziening van het onderwijsprogramma maakt deel uit van de afspraken die ik met de drie TU's heb gemaakt over verbetering van de onderwijskwaliteit, waaronder de studeerbaarheid van de programma's.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de openbaarmaking van het aantal contacturen bij universitaire opleidingen (ingezonden 7 december 2

Two MPs asked the state secretary why universities' contact-hour data, collected via the Nationale Studenten Enquête, was not published for prospective students. The secretary said the data was collected only for the inspectorate in a confidential pilot, universities judged it unfit for publication, and he pressed for proper questions in future surveys and a working group was set up.
I have therefore taken note with approval of the board's decision.
Ik heb dan ook met instemming van het besluit van het bestuur kennis genomen.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het scharen van pre-masters onder de masterfase (ingezonden 22 december 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether universities placed pre-master programmes under the master phase to avoid the long-term student fine, and whether affected students could be exempted. The state secretary confirmed some universities did so, said the number of students is not known, asked universities to map the group and help them graduate, and refused a one-off exemption.
I am not aware of that.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over problemen met DUO en Studielink (ingezonden 29 november 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about a poll reporting that 31% of students experienced errors by the Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) and whether service is reliable given the financial stakes for students. The state secretary rejects the poll's picture, citing satisfaction surveys (rated 7), performance indicators and complaint numbers, and sees no quality gap requiring a report to parliament.
In view of the foregoing, I see no quality shortfall at DUO that needs to be remedied and about which it is necessary to inform your House.
Gelet op het voorgaande zie ik geen kwaliteitsachterstand bij DUO die dient te worden verholpen en waarover het nodig is uw Kamer te informeren.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de informatievoorziening betreffende de langstudeerdersboete en andere studiemaatregelen (ingezonden 16 december 20

An MP asks the state secretary of Education how many students know about the long-study fine and other study measures, and whether information provision is effective rather than just a matter of effort. The secretary reports that information is given via websites, letters and meetings, that a baseline survey shows high awareness (95% WO, 83% HBO), and promises to send the final results to parliament in January with any extra information measures.
I intend to send the final results of the said research to your House in January.
Ik ben voornemens de definitieve resultaten van het genoemde onderzoek in januari aan uw Kamer te sturen.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het verdwijnen van 3000 plaatsen

MPs Dijksma and Jadnanansing asked whether the figure of 3000 lost postdoc and PhD positions due to innovation policy is accurate and what the government will do to prevent it. The minister disputes the VSNU calculation as incomplete and overstated, argues the real FES cut is about 240 million euros, and promises monitoring with knowledge institutions rather than concrete new measures.
I have agreed with the knowledge institutions that I will closely monitor the developments and involve them in this.
Ik heb met de kennisinstellingen afgesproken dat ik de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet zal monitoren en hen hierbij zal betrekken.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Lucas (VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het voornemen van voortgangstoetsing van drie samenwerkende hogescholen (ingezonden 16 november 201

MPs Jadnanansing and Lucas asked why a joint proposal by three universities of applied sciences to develop progress tests, submitted in September 2010 with a requested subsidy, had no decision for over a year. The State Secretary replied that the process was paused during an Inspectorate study on assessment practice, that €8 million has since been reserved for 2012-2015 to improve assessment, and that the institutions may pursue the plan independently.
Nothing prevents the institution from pursuing the plan independently, as happened in the past with five medical faculties attached to universities.
Er staat de instelling niets in de weg het plan zelfstandig op te pakken zoals dat in het verleden is gebeurd bij vijf medische faculteiten verbonden aan universiteiten.

Vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk (SP) en Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de wetenschappelijke fraude van de heer Stapel (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

MPs asked the state secretary how the government views the Levelt Committee's recommendations on the Stapel research fraud, including a fraud confidant, five-year data retention, openness in research culture, pressure on researchers, the Independent Science declaration, and protection of affected researchers. The state secretary answered that the recommendations are directed at institutions, that the KNAW and VSNU are acting, that the code of conduct did not fail, and that trust cannot be replaced by bureaucracy.
The recommendations of the Levelt Committee are directed at the institutions concerned.
De aanbevelingen van de Commissie Levelt zijn gericht aan de betrokken instellingen.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over pre-masters (ingezonden 3 november 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether the VU Amsterdam would stop offering premaster programmes, what this means for costs for HBO graduates, and whether premasters should stay at the statutory tuition fee. The state secretary denied that the VU is abolishing premasters, stated that premasters up to 30 ECTS will be available at statutory tuition fee (to be legislated), and that longer programmes may carry institutional tuition.
I have no information that universities plan to stop offering premasters.
Ik beschik niet over informatie dat universiteiten van plan zijn om te stoppen met het aanbieden van premasters.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het aantrekken van getalenteerde Chinese studenten door Nederlandse universiteiten (ingezonden 26 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education how Dutch universities can attract talented Chinese students amid rising competition, and whether obstacles such as visa fees and the end of the Huygens scholarships will be addressed. The state secretary agreed that talented foreign students are valuable, pointed to the Strategic Agenda and a planned privately funded successor to the Huygens programme, and rejected the claim that the visa fee increase endangers accessibility.
Nuffic is examining whether private money can be used to continue awarding scholarships to students under the name Huygens Scholarship Programme in the future.
De Nuffic onderzoekt de mogelijkheid om met privaat geld ook in de toekomst onder de naam Huygens Scholarship Programme beurzen aan studenten te verstrekken.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de abominabele financiële omstandigheden van Chinese bursaalstudenten (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about TU Delft's 2010 rule supplementing scholarships for Chinese PhD students after reports they relied on the food bank, and whether other universities had followed and should commit to minimum stipends. The state secretary confirmed knowing the rules but had not heard of food bank signals elsewhere, said he was unaware of other universities following suit, and pointed to ongoing VSNU work on a shared framework based on the IND income norm rather than committing to a minimum.
What I can tell you is that the VSNU is currently working on developing a joint university framework for doctoral students.
Wat ik u wel kan melden is, dat door VSNU op dit moment wordt gewerkt aan de ontwikkeling van een gezamenlijk universitair kader voor promotiestudenten.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de benadeling van mensen die een particuliere studie hebben gevolgd (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary whether students who first completed a private bachelor's degree and then a publicly funded master's were unfairly charged institutional tuition, and when a correction would come. The secretary said the press report was partly incorrect, acknowledged an unintended effect for students with a private or foreign bachelor's before a publicly funded master's, and committed to amending the regulations so those students can take a publicly funded bachelor's at statutory tuition.

I will correct this and promote that the regulations be amended so that students who, according to CRIHO, completed a publicly funded master's programme successfully and have not yet obtained a degree from a publicly funded bachelor's programme can take a publicly funded bachelor's programme at statutory tuition at a public university or university of applied sciences, from 1 September 2011 or retroactively.

Ik zal dit corrigeren en bevorderen dat de regelgeving op zodanige wijze wordt aangepast dat studenten die volgens het CRIHO een bekostigde masteropleiding hebben gevolgd en deze met succes hebben afgerond, en nog geen graad bij een bekostigde bacheloropleiding hebben behaald, per 1 september 2011 ofwel met terugwerkende kracht alsnog bij een bekostigde universiteit of hogeschool een bacheloropleiding tegen wettelijk collegegeld kunnen volgen.
Vragen van de leden Van Dekken , Çelik en Jadnanansing (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over een diplomatruc voor gezakte leerlingen (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

MPs asked the education minister why the Inspectorate's investigation into a school's diploma trick for failing pupils was not finished and why she would not announce a law change now. The minister replied that the Inspectorate needed time after the holidays for hearing and counter-hearing, and that she can only judge whether to amend rules once the findings are known.

As I indicated in answer 4 to the previously mentioned parliamentary questions, I can only assess whether and how laws and regulations should be amended on the basis of the outcome of the Inspectorate's investigation.

Zoals ik in antwoord 4 van de reeds eerder genoemde Kamervragen heb aangegeven kan ik pas op basis van de uitkomst van het onderzoek van de Inspectie beoordelen of en op welke wijze wet- en regelgeving moet worden aangepast.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de handel in afstudeerscripties (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the commercial trade in ghostwritten theses is known, how it is controlled, whether it is criminal and whether it will be prosecuted. The government called the trade reprehensible, said the WHW already gives examination boards and institutions power to refuse or revoke diplomas and end enrolment, and saw no need for additional measures or criminal prosecution unless fraud proves large-scale and organised.
I see no reason to take additional measures on this point.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op dit punt additionele maatregelen te treffen.
Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over hoogleraren accountancy (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

MPs Jadnanansing and Plasterk asked whether accountancy professors holding jobs at large accountancy firms are a conflict of interest and whether the sector's self-cleansing capacity and separation of oversight and advisory roles are adequate. The state secretary replied that combining chairs with business functions is acceptable if independence and transparency of side positions are guaranteed, that the matter is the universities' responsibility, and declined to investigate conflicts of interest.
It is the responsibility of the universities that appoint professors to ensure that no improper conflict of interest arises.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van universiteiten die hoogleraren benoemen om erop toe te zien dat van ongeoorloofde belangenverstrengeling geen sprake is.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de roep van gemeenten om bestandskoppeling te

MPs Spekman and Jadnanansing ask whether they recognise municipal calls for linking data files to fight benefit and study-finance fraud, why OCW/DUO is not in the national steering group, and why benefit, housing and municipal registers are not linked. The state secretary says the government prioritises fraud prevention, is studying harmonisation of data-sharing rules and an inventory of wider data matching, cites existing and proposed measures (home visits bill, student address rules), explains housing data is fragmented, and points to a risk-profile system (SARI) and DUO address checks as privacy-conscious alternatives.
In addition, I have started an inventory of the possibilities for broader use of data matching and data exchange to prevent and combat fraud.
Aanvullend hierop ben ik gestart met een inventarisatie van de mogelijkheden van een bredere inzet van bestandskoppeling en gegevensuitwisseling om fraude te voorkomen en te bestrijden.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over toepassing van zogenaamde «glijdende schaal» bij de bijverdiengrens in de studiefinanciering (ingezonden 15 augustu

An MP asked the state secretary whether the 2010 sliding-scale rule for the study-finance earnings limit should apply to earnings from years before 2010, following a district court ruling in a student's favour, and why the ministry is litigating. The state secretary answered that several readings are possible, that DUO appealed to the Centrale Raad van Beroep, that the legislative history excludes retroactivity, and that the ruling will be applied to all affected students once the higher court decides.
Once the Central Appeals Tribunal has ruled in this case, I will implement that ruling for all students who have been imposed a similar claim.
Zodra de Centrale Raad van Beroep in deze zaak een uitspraak heeft gedaan, zal ik deze uitvoeren ten aanzien van alle studenten, die een dergelijke vordering opgelegd hebben gekregen.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de groeiende wachtlijsten voor studentenkamers (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

MPs Jadnanansing and Monasch asked the Minister of Interior about growing waiting lists for student rooms and whether vacant government offices could be converted into student housing. The minister said demand varies locally, a regional monitor is being developed with Kences, an action plan on student housing is in preparation, and vacant government buildings can be sold or transformed, though this depends on local initiative.
In this letter I announced an action plan on student housing for this autumn, which I intend to draw up together with the parties involved in order to increase the supply of student housing locally.

In deze brief heb ik een actieplan studentenhuisvesting aangekondigd voor dit najaar, dat ik samen met de betrokken partijen wil opstellen om zo het aanbod voor studentenhuisvesting lokaal te vergroten.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het vereiste van werk voor buitenlandse (master)studenten in Nederland (ingezonden 22 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether foreign master's students losing Dutch student finance for not working 32 hours a month, and whether internships should count as work, and asks DUO to exempt interning students. The state secretary replies that the home country is primarily responsible for its nationals' student finance, that only real paid employment under an employment contract counts, and that the 32-hour rule is reasonable and upheld by judges.
Moreover, the policy rule mentioned in question 2 has already been assessed many times by independent judges and always found reasonable.
Bovendien is de in vraag 2 genoemde beleidsregel reeds vele malen beoordeeld door onafhankelijke rechters en altijd gezien als redelijk.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de negatieve effecten van de langstudeerdersboete op deeltijdopleidingen (ingezonden 25 augustus 2011).

The MP asks the state secretary whether the long-student fine (langstudeerdersboete) disproportionately harms part-time programmes and how a perceived flaw will be fixed quickly. The state secretary says it is premature to speak of effects, will monitor the measure, does not accept disproportionate impact, and will explore whether the WHW definition of part-time needs changing, reporting back if disproportionate effects are found.
I will monitor this measure, including its effect on part-time programmes.
Ik ga deze maatregel monitoren, inclusief het effect hiervan op deeltijdopleidingen.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de onrust bij een hbo-instelling door plannen voor schaalvergroting (ingezonden 19 juli 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary about unrest at a Dutch university of applied sciences over merger and scale-up plans, and whether the ministry will check the plans and their effect on staff and quality. The minister replies that the institution is restructuring itself, that it is already run as one institution, that the ministry has been informed, and that a ministerial role is not yet at issue, with the new fusion review law taking effect on 1 October 2011.
With the entry into force of the fusion review act, the minister will have a formal role in case of a merger between two or more institutions.
Met de inwerkingtreding van de wet fusietoets krijgt de minister een formele rol ingeval van een fusie tussen twee of meer instellingen.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de brandbrief van de Jonge Academie

Two MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science to respond in full to the Young Academy's letter calling cuts to fundamental research short-sighted, and to say what the reported 350 million euro cut would mean for research quality, quantity and training places. The government replied that the topsector approach keeps fundamental research funding at NWO and KNAW, that no 350 million euro cut applies, and that research will be steered more toward economic topsectors and grand challenges while curiosity-driven research remains possible.
Within the framework of the top sectors there is no question of a cut of 350 million euros.
Er is in het kader van de topsectoren geen sprake van een bezuiniging van € 350 miljoen.

Vragen van de leden Spekman en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister voor Immigratie en Asiel over de voorgenomen verhoging van de leges voor reguliere verblijfsvergunningen en de gevolgen daarvan voor kwetsbare gro

MPs Spekman and Jadnanansing asked the immigration minister why fees for regular residence permits were raised at short notice, with effects on vulnerable groups and the knowledge economy. The minister defended the increase as part of cost-recovery and budget targets, offered limited transitional relief and a lower fee for some vulnerable categories, and refused to reconsider.
However, I do not intend to ask the European Commission for advice on whether the increase is compatible with this directive.
Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens om advies te vragen aan de Europese Commissie over de vraag of de verhoging in overeenstemming is met deze richtlijn.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het beëindigen van de Huygens-beurzen en de gevolgen voor Nederland als mondiale kenniseconomie (ingezonden 21 apri

An MP asks the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science about ending the Huygens Scholarship Programme and its effects on Dutch international knowledge competitiveness, questioning the rationale of limited beneficiaries and the feasibility of private replacement funding. The state secretary rejects the 'ambition fine' characterisation, argues the programme benefits a small group relative to its cost, points to other excellence instruments and existing scholarships, and says Nuffic is exploring privately funded continuation.
I do not share the characterisation of a 'new ambition fine'.
De kwalificatie «nieuwe ambitieboete» deel ik niet.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en De Rouwe (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de hoogte en wijze van toerekenen van kosten bij instellingscollegegelden bij tweede studies (in

MPs Jadnanansing and De Rouwe asked the state secretary about very high institutional tuition fees for second degrees, which may make them unreachable, and how this fits the law's aims. The state secretary replied that institutions set their own fees with works council advice, that students can appeal via the institution and the College van Beroep, and that the government will monitor the fee policy through 2013 without setting a fee level.
In addition, the institutions' policy on institutional tuition fees will be part of the monitoring of the Wet versterking besturing and the subsidy scheme for second degrees in hbo and wo.
Daarnaast zal het beleid van de instellingen t.a.v. het instellingscollegegeld onderdeel zijn van de monitoring van de Wet versterking besturing en de subsidieregeling tweede graden hbo en wo.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over 3000 promotieplaatsen die zullen verdwijnen bij Nederlandse universiteiten door de bezuinigingen (ingezonden 20 mei

An MP asked the state secretary about reported loss of 3000 PhD positions at Dutch universities due to budget cuts, and the claim that the Netherlands would become a second-rate research country. The government replied that the cuts concern not using Fes funds for R&D in favour of generic fiscal measures, rejects the claim of decline, and says the strategic agenda for higher education will be sent to parliament.
The cabinet will inform you about these ambitions in the Strategic Agenda for higher education, research and science that your House will receive in June
Het kabinet zal u over deze ambities informeren in de Strategische Agenda voor hoger onderwijs, onderzoek en wetenschap die uw Kamer in juni zal ontvangen
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de «opbrengst» van een bursalenstelsel (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science whether a bursary system for PhD candidates would really save universities money and whether those savings would go to research, and how the non-employee PhDs' teaching and income would be handled. The state secretary said the estimated savings of about 10 million euros per year would fund roughly 350-400 bursary posts, that universities are responsible for staffing, and that he would monitor developments and hold institutions to account.
A better substantiation than this does not currently exist. I will monitor the development.
Een betere onderbouwing dan dit is er op dit moment niet. Ik zal de ontwikkeling monitoren.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het niet doorbreken van de zesjescultuur door middel van selectie aan de poort (ingezonden 21 april 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether selection at the entrance and extra incentives can break the 'six-pass culture' in higher education, and whether education is losing out to research. The state secretary answers that selection alone is insufficient, points to institutional study-culture measures and excellence scholarships, and says the education-research balance is monitored via the Toekomstbestendig Hoger Onderwijs Stelsel implementation.
Selection of suitable and motivated students alone does not automatically lead to students who remain motivated during their studies, nor to a decline in the six-pass culture.
Louter selectie van geschikte en gemotiveerde studenten leidt niet vanzelf tot studenten die ook tijdens de studie gemotiveerd zijn en tot afname van de zesjescultuur.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over niet bestrafte fraudegevallen aan de Universiteit Maastricht (ingezonden 22 februari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary why students caught plagiarising at Maastricht law faculty were not sanctioned, and why a lecturer who raised it was pressured. The state secretary said the Inspectorate found the programme's quality not at stake, 17 students received a reprimand, the examination board's communication was inadequate, and no further intervention was possible beyond talks with the institution.

Nevertheless, it is of the utmost importance that the conversation between the inspectorate and the institution explicitly addresses how the examination board can be better prepared for such incidents in the future.

Het is niettemin van het grootste belang dat in het gesprek tussen de inspectie en de instelling expliciet aan de orde is op welke wijze de examencommissie in de toekomst beter is voorbereid op dergelijke voorvallen.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mogelijke beëindiging van de financiële bijdrage voor het uitvoeren van experimenten door Nederl

MPs Jadnanansing and Dijksma asked whether the Netherlands would stop funding ELIPS-4 experiments on the ISS from 2012 and why Dutch scientists would then lose access, and asked how the scientific community is involved. The state secretary confirmed the signal, said the Netherlands stopped ELIPS-3 in 2008 on KNAW-based priorities, noted Dutch scientists can still use the ISS via international consortia, and stated no further action is needed.
As I already indicated in my answer to question 2, that is not necessary.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 al heb aangegeven, is dat niet nodig.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing (PvdA) en Van Dijk (SP) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over Nederlandse universiteiten die studenten werven in Saudi-Arabië (ingezonden 31 maart 2011).

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Dijk asked whether Dutch universities recruiting students in Saudi Arabia for paid contract education, a Dutch education attaché in Riyadh, and a numerus fixus conflict with Dutch students' access. The state secretary replied that contract education is cost-covering and does not displace Dutch students or public funds, that the attaché's costs are shared with the ministry as internationalisation policy, and that institutions are free to offer such education within those conditions.
This concerns contract education under the condition that it must be cost-covering and may not come at the expense of regular students and/or public funds.
Het gaat hier om contractonderwijs waarbij de voorwaarde geldt dat het kostendekkend moet zijn en niet ten koste mag gaan van reguliere studenten en/of publieke middelen.

Vragen van de leden Çelik en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de afkeuring door de rechter van de lagere plaatsing van een studente door de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs

MPs Çelik and Jadnanansing asked the education minister about a court ruling that rejected DUO's lower placement of a student in a lottery class due to varied mbo diploma formats. The minister answered that the problem was known, that DUO applies the lottery rules without assessing programme value, and that the RAS regulation and a future diploma and transcript model will clarify procedures.
The above-mentioned regulation will be amended in parts.
Bovengenoemde regeling wordt op onderdelen gewijzigd.

Vragen van de leden Van der Ham (D66), Lucas (VVD), Jadnanansing (PvdA), De Rouwe (CDA), Jasper van Dijk (SP), Klaver (GroenLinks) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de boeten rond de bijve

MPs asked the state secretary about DUO's letters to about 20,000 students who exceeded the income limit for study grants in 2008, the switch to gross income, appeal options, repayment of OV-card costs and possible hardship relief. The state secretary said the number fits a rising trend, that appeals against DUO decisions are possible while the income figure itself must be contested with the tax authority, and that no hardship scheme is planned.
I see no possibilities to arrive at a hardship scheme for this group.
Ik zie geen mogelijkheden om voor deze groep tot een coulance-regeling te komen.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister- president en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over uitspraken van de premier met betrekking tot de hoogte van overhead bij hoger onderwijsin

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether his earlier claim that overhead in higher education could reach 40% was incorrect, given newer research putting it at 25-26%, and whether this misinformation distorts the debate on cuts. The Prime Minister called the discrepancy a misunderstanding because the two figures measure different things, rejected the claim that cuts pressure education quality, and said the government uses the most current data while noting the latest secondary-process measurement dates from 2000.
I regard that as a misunderstanding. Both percentages concern different subjects and are not comparable with each other.
Dat beoordeel ik als een misverstand. Beide percentages betreffen verschillende onderwerpen en zijn onderling niet vergelijkbaar.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over studenten die geweigerd worden voor een opleiding met numerus fixus vanwege financiële risico’s voor de onderwijsin

An MP asked the state secretary whether universities refuse students re-admission or numerus fixus places because of financial risks from longer study duration after a switch of study, and whether this is acceptable. The state secretary said no such signals had reached him, that refusal of a legal right to re-enrolment would be unlawful, that the law offers no basis for preventive refusal, and that he would respond appropriately if the Inspectorate reports such signals.
If those signals point to a refusal of a renewed enrolment procedure for a person who has a legal right to it, then that is contrary to the law.
Als die signalen wijzen op een weigering tot een hernieuwde inlotingsprocedure ten aanzien van een persoon die daarop een wettelijk recht heeft, dan is dat in strijd met de wet.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over fraude bij tentamens op hogeschool Windesheim (ingezonden 8 februari 2011).

The MP asks the minister about a press report that students could easily cheat on exams at Windesheim university of applied sciences, and whether this harms the value of HBO diplomas and calls for better exam safeguards. The state secretary says the institution could not identify the students, did not use the whistleblower scheme, will leave identity-fraud prevention to institutions and cites existing sanctions, and will urge the HBO Raad to require official ID at exams.
I will point the universities of applied sciences, via their umbrella organisation the HBO Raad, to the importance of good security against identity fraud at exams
Ik zal de hogescholen via de koepelorganisatie, i.c. de HBO Raad wijzen op het belang van een goede beveiliging tegen identiteitsfraude bij tentamens

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Smeets (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over tekort aan studenten bij maritiem-technische opleidingen (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about a shortage of students in maritime-technical higher education, its effect on the maritime sector, and a poor student rating of a Scheepsbouwkunde programme in the Keuzegids HBO. The state secretary acknowledged the reports, said there are no quality findings that something is fundamentally wrong, pointed to ongoing talks with maritime education institutions and a re-accreditation visit planned for 2012.
In 2010 I began talks with maritime education (vocational and higher) which should lead to a package of measures to put this sector on a robust and sustainable footing.
In 2010 ben ik begonnen met maritieme opleidingen (mbo en hbo) gesprekken te voeren; deze moeten uitmonden in een maatregelenpakket.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over tentamenfraude bij Hogeschool InHolland (ingezonden 10 februari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about large-scale exam fraud at Hogeschool InHolland, including its causes and the damage to higher vocational education's reputation. The state secretary confirmed the fraud, said exams were invalidated affecting about a hundred students, noted a police report and investigation, and called the institution's response adequate.
The college has reported the matter to the police and an investigation into the course of events has been started.
De hogeschool heeft aangifte gedaan bij de politie en er is een onderzoek gestart naar de gang van zaken.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Klijnsma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het dubbel raken van Nederlandse studentenorkesten in bezuinigingen (ingezonden 4 februari 2011

MPs Jadnanansing and Klijnsma asked the state secretary for Education, Culture and Science how student orchestras are hit twice by cultural cuts and the long-term student rule, and whether the government will scrutinise the cumulative effects. The state secretary acknowledged the signal but called it premature, said the long-study rule applies to all students and does not harm excellent students, and promised proposals in June that will consider knock-on effects.
I have committed to the House to come with further proposals in June as a follow-up to the principles for cultural policy I formulated on 6 December 2010.
Ik heb de Kamer toegezegd in juni met nadere voorstellen te komen als vervolg op de uitgangspunten voor het te voeren cultuurbeleid

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het terugtreden van de Raad van Toezicht van Hogeschool InHolland (ingezonden 28 januari 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary about the resignation of the entire supervisory board of Hogeschool InHolland and whether the board failed to act on warning signals. The minister agreed the board did not intervene effectively, committed to proposals on powers over boards that fail, and promised a broader review of supervisory boards in higher education.
The supervisory board did not intervene effectively.
de Raad van Toezicht heeft niet op effectieve wijze ingegrepen.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over hantering van het instellingscollegegeld voor een tweede studie die een vereiste is voor bepaalde beroepsgroepen (ingezonde

An MP asked the minister about the high institutional tuition charged for a second study required for oral and maxillofacial surgery (dentistry plus medicine), and whether this undermines necessary dual study routes and whether tuition should be capped. The state secretary replied that the requirement is set by the profession itself, that institutions set tuition and may differentiate, and that she will not cap tuition or restrict required second-study routes, though she will raise transparency with the universities' associations.
I said in the legislative consultation that I will not set for the institutions how high tuition must be; it is not for nothing called institutional tuition.
Ik heb in het wetgevingsoverleg in aanvulling daarop gezegd dat ik niet voor de instellingen ga bepalen hoe hoog het collegegeld moet zijn; het is niet voor niets instellingscollegegeld.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen op de bedrijfsvoering van een faculteit van de UvA (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

An MP asked the state secretary about the UvA economics faculty's reorganisation plans after an undisclosed budget deficit, how the state can hold executive boards and supervisory boards accountable, and whether dismissals to build reserves are acceptable. The state secretary said the plans were unknown to him, that business operations are the board's responsibility under the WHW, that he could sanction only in exceptional cases or intervene in the supervisory board if continuity is threatened, and that staff and quality matters are for the institution.
Decisions on the operational management of an institution fall under the responsibility of the executive board as laid down in the Higher Education and Research Act (WHW).

Beslissingen over de bedrijfsvoering van een instelling behoren tot de verantwoordelijkheid van het college van bestuur zoals is vastgelegd in de Wet op het hoger onderwijs en wetenschappelijk onderzoek (WHW).

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over massaontslagen bij universiteiten door bezuinigingen en gevolgen voor de kenniseconomie (ingezon

MPs Jadnanansing and Dijksma asked the state secretary about mass layoffs at universities caused by budget cuts and the effects on the knowledge economy, including research quality and the government's ambition to reach the global top. The state secretary acknowledged the measures are drastic but necessary, pointed to a quality boost and planned structural balance from 2015, and said it is too early to judge research effects while checks on quality remain in place.
It is still too early to speculate about the effects on the quality and positioning of research in relation to the loss of jobs.
Het is nog te vroeg om te speculeren over de gevolgen van de kwaliteit en positionering van het onderzoek in relatie tot het verlies aan arbeidsplaatsen.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de staatsecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het grote aantal fraudegevallen met uitwonende studiebeurs (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

The secretary acknowledged the problem, said the sample came from risk profiles so national extrapolation is premature, and outlined a bill with administrative fines and municipal address checks, while declining to make relatives liable for facilitating fraud because of evidentiary problems.
The bill provides for amending the definition of living-away and living-at-home students in the Student Finance Act 2000, designating a supervisor, and introducing an administrative fine.

Het wetsvoorstel voorziet in aanpassing van de definitie van uit- en thuiswonende studerenden in de Wet studiefinanciering 2000, aanwijzing van een toezichthouder en invoering van een bestuurlijke boete.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Van Dekken (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de maatschappelijke kosten en effecten van de wetgeving tegen langstudeerders (ingezonden 16

MPs Jadnanansing and Van Dekken asked the state secretary whether the costs and societal effects of penalising long-term students were overstated, and whether students and parents would be informed quickly and exceptions made for students with illness or disability. The state secretary rejected the view that societal costs are small, argued the measure fosters a more ambitious study culture, promised early information to students, and announced an extra study year for students with a functional limitation.

Ik acht het van groot belang studenten, ouders en instellingen tijdig te informeren over de aanstaande wetswijziging.

MPs Klijnsma and Jadnanansing asked the state secretary about the University of Amsterdam refusing to issue an amended diploma after a gender change, and whether the law prevents it. The minister said the refusal was based on an overly strict reading of the WHW, which does not prevent issuing an amended certificate, so no law change is needed, and the relevant institutions will be informed.
On closer inspection it appears this interpretation of the law was too strict.
Bij nader inzien blijkt dat deze interpretatie van de wet te strikt is geweest.
Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs Cultuur en Wetenschap over de ruime vertrekregeling van de bestuursvoorzitter van InHolland (ingezonden 18 oktober 2010).

An MP asked the education minister to assess the generous severance package of the chair of the Hogeschool InHolland board, whether it fits the promised modest arrangement, and whether recovery should be considered as in an earlier Friesland College case. The state secretary said the package exceeds the 130% ministerial-salary norm and the court-clerk formula, that the difference will be recovered from the supervisory board, and that the inspectorate's fraud investigation must finish before judging the broader question.

Vragen van het lid Jadnanansing (PvdA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het ongeoorloofd verstrekken van diploma’s media-opleiding door hogeschool InHolland te Haarlem (ingezonden 13 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister about reports that InHolland Haarlem awarded about 250 media-management students diplomas through an irregular alternative graduation track, and how it responds to incentives tied to graduation bonuses. The state secretary condemns the practice, says the inspectorate is investigating alternative tracks across higher education, and outlines tighter accreditation and examination-committee rules and the new funding model.

MPs Jadnanansing and Ferrier asked whether the 10-hour weekly work cap for non-EEA students should be relaxed, given that many cannot cover living costs. The government replied it sees no evidence of widespread shortfalls, keeps the 10-hour cap to prevent students becoming labour migrants, and will consider raising it no earlier than 2012.
It must be prevented that working becomes a main activity, whereby study migrants could effectively become labour migrants.
Voorkomen moet worden dat het verrichten van arbeid een hoofdactiviteit wordt waardoor studiemigranten feitelijk arbeidsmigranten zouden kunnen worden.

Two MPs asked the ministers of Education and of the Interior whether they had noted AIVD warnings that universities should watch for foreign students possibly spying, and how universities could detect such espionage. The minister answered that the government takes the AIVD signal seriously and is formulating a response, that the AIVD has consulted universities, that identifying espionage is not a core university task, and that the response will address follow-up on the report's recommendations.
