Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de postzegelprijs (ingezonden 4 oktober 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Hamer asked the state secretary about a planned stamp price increase by PostNL and whether it complies with postal regulation, and about tariff fairness versus business post and staff conditions. The state secretary answered that OPTA set the Universal Postal Service tariffs under the Postwet and Postregeling without needing ministerial ratification, that business tariffs are not comparable, and that employment conditions are for social partners.
An increase in the UPD tariffs does not need to be ratified by ministerial regulation.
Een verhoging van de UPD tarieven hoeft niet te worden bekrachtigd bij ministeriële regeling.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma, Monasch en Jacobi ( allen PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vertraging van de aanleg van het knooppunt Joure (ingezonden 22 september 2011).

MPs from the PvdA asked the minister why the start of construction of the Joure junction slipped from 2012 to 2013, whether designing for 130 km/h caused the delay and extra costs of EUR 4 million, and whether the budget increase and cost decisions are justified. The minister confirmed the 2013 start and the extra EUR 4 million for a 130 km/h-proof design, said the opening year stays 2015, and rejected calling it a delay.
By way of explanation of my decision on 130 for Joure, the following.
Ter toelichting op mijn 130-besluit voor Joure het volgende.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Bouwmeester (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het berekenen van buitensporig hoge annuleringskosten (ingezonden 10 oktober 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Bouwmeester asked the minister whether cancellation fees of €50 by Vliegwinkel.nl plus €50 by the airline on booked tickets are excessive, why they were not clearly disclosed, whether this is a misleading practice, and what remedies travellers have. The minister answered that the fees are permitted if disclosed, that the Consumentenautoriteit and courts decide on unfair practices, and that consumers can turn to the Geschillencommissie Reizen or the civil courts.

The Consumentenautoriteit does not comment on any ongoing investigations, and the judgment whether a specific case involves an unfair commercial practice is reserved for the Consumentenautoriteit and the courts.

De Consumentenautoriteit doet geen uitspraken over eventueel lopende onderzoeken en het oordeel of er in een specifiek geval sprake is van een oneerlijke handelspraktijk is voorbehouden aan de Consumentenautoriteit en de rechter.

Vragen van de leden Van Dam en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, landbouw en Innovatie over hoge annuleringskosten bij online boeken van reizen (ingezonden 26 augustus 2011).

MPs Van Dam and Dijksma asked why distance-selling cooling-off rights do not apply to travel bookings, whether online bookings bind consumers, and whether excessive cancellation or correction fees should be curbed. The minister answered that travel services are excluded from the withdrawal right for cost reasons, that consumers are bound once they accept terms before confirmation, and that existing industry terms and the reasonableness principle suffice, though a Commission proposal is expected in 2012.
Given existing practice in the travel sector and the consumer's options to act against excesses, I see no reason to amend the rules.
Gelet op de bestaande praktijk in de reisbranche en de mogelijkheden voor de consument om tegen excessen op te treden, zie ik geen aanleiding om de regels aan te passen.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de markteffectentoets van het kabinet in het algemeen en die voor de

Two PvdA MPs asked why the government did not apply the SER-recommended enhanced market-effects test (markteffectentoets) to the mandatory tendering of regional public transport in the G3 cities, and how it will ensure the test is applied across departments. The ministers answered that market effects were already assessed for the Wp2000 and its amendment, that the enhanced test is now embedded in the Integraal Afwegingskader, and that departments will be checked through the IAK framework and coordinators.
I therefore see no added value in mapping the effects again.
Ik zie daarom geen meerwaarde in het opnieuw in kaart brengen van de effecten.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de bewegwijzering van brandstofverkooppunten met duurzame brandstoffen (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

Two MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether explicit road signage for sales points of sustainable fuels would be pursued, and whether multi-fuel stations should get the same signage. The minister replied that no follow-up steps were taken because few such outlets exist on the main road network, that operators must request signage, that a free fuel-finder app exists, and that a separate electric charging point signage approach is not needed once charging points are common.
No follow-up steps have been taken because there are few or no biofuel sales points at service areas on the main road network.
Er zijn geen vervolgstappen ondernomen omdat op verzorgingsplaatsen van het hoofdwegennet weinig of geen verkooppunten van biobrandstoffen zijn.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over overlast van de KLM Luchtvaart School op vliegveld Eelde (ingezonden 6 juli 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Van Dekken asked the state secretary about noise nuisance from KLM Luchtvaart School training aircraft at Eelde airport, and whether its economic importance justifies this, plus why older aircraft are used and what will be done. The state secretary answered that the airport operator has operational agreements with flight schools that keep the airport within its permitted noise space, that the government has no competence to review school plans or fleet choices, and that the airport is trying to reduce avoidable noise through pricing incentives.
In doing so, no actual exceedances have been found in recent years.
Daarbij zijn de afgelopen jaren geen feitelijke overschrijdingen geconstateerd.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Financiën over de positie van KLM binnen Air France-KLM (ingezonden 14 juli 2011).

An MP asked the state secretary and finance minister about the restructuring of Air France-KLM, including the new top layer, reporting lines of KLM's CEO to the holding, and guarantees that KLM remains the home carrier at Schiphol and the state's shareholding and option rights. The government answered that the structure is still in development, that the Air France-KLM chair will no longer also chair Air France, that existing Schiphol-related commitments were extended indefinitely in 2010, and that the state holds 5.9% of shares with a 50.1% option that lapsed in May 2010.
From KLM I understand that at this stage it is not yet concretely possible to state what will change in the structure.
Van KLM begrijp ik dat in dit stadium nog niet concreet is aan te geven wat er gaat veranderen in de structuur.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Jadnanansing (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de brandbrief van de Jonge Academie

Two MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and of Education, Culture and Science to respond in full to the Young Academy's letter calling cuts to fundamental research short-sighted, and to say what the reported 350 million euro cut would mean for research quality, quantity and training places. The government replied that the topsector approach keeps fundamental research funding at NWO and KNAW, that no 350 million euro cut applies, and that research will be steered more toward economic topsectors and grand challenges while curiosity-driven research remains possible.
Within the framework of the top sectors there is no question of a cut of 350 million euros.
Er is in het kader van de topsectoren geen sprake van een bezuiniging van € 350 miljoen.

Vragen van de leden Jacobi, Dijksma en Smeets (allen PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de onuitvoerbaarheid van de nieuwe Europese meldplicht voor Nederlandse traditionele zeilschepen (ingezonden 11

MPs Jacobi, Dijksma and Smeets asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment whether the new EU port state control reporting duties (24-hour and 72-hour notifications, electronic reporting) are unworkable for Dutch traditional sailing ships, and what the government will do to protect them abroad. The minister answered that the duties are not new, that most sailing ships under 300 GT are exempt, that electronic reporting is required only where possible, and that the problem has been raised with the European Commission, which is preparing rules for sailing vessels by mid-2012.
I have brought the problem of reporting via internet raised by the BBZ to the attention of the European Commission via the EU Committee on Safe Seas (COSS).
Ik heb de door de BBZ aangegeven problematiek betreffende melden via internet, onder de aandacht van de Europese Commissie (EC) gebracht via het EU Committee on Safe Seas (COSS).

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mogelijke beëindiging van de financiële bijdrage voor het uitvoeren van experimenten door Nederl

MPs Jadnanansing and Dijksma asked whether the Netherlands would stop funding ELIPS-4 experiments on the ISS from 2012 and why Dutch scientists would then lose access, and asked how the scientific community is involved. The state secretary confirmed the signal, said the Netherlands stopped ELIPS-3 in 2008 on KNAW-based priorities, noted Dutch scientists can still use the ISS via international consortia, and stated no further action is needed.
As I already indicated in my answer to question 2, that is not necessary.
Zoals ik in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 al heb aangegeven, is dat niet nodig.

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Hamer (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het tekort aan technici met een lagere en middelbare opleiding

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a predicted shortage of lower and intermediate-level technicians and the cuts to MBO training for over-30s. The ministers defended the €23 million technology investments, said the 30+ cut reflects private responsibility, and described an alternative financing arrangement with a €130 million box.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over slachtoffers door te gladde wegen (ingezonden 7 april 2011).

MPs Dijksma and Monasch asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about elderly people injured by slippery roads and footpaths, and how winter gritting is prepared, evaluated and funded. The minister answered that road managers are responsible for gritting under the Wegenwet, that cooperation with IPO and VNG on brine and training is ongoing, and that funding is a decision for municipal and provincial boards.
Under the Wegenwet, each road manager is itself responsible for keeping the roads it manages in good and safe condition
Op grond van de Wegenwet draagt elke wegbeheerder zelf de zorg voor het in goede en veilige staat houden van de wegen

Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Albayrak (beiden PvdA) aan de minister-president en de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de Europese markt voor diensten (ingezonden 22 maart 2011).

Two Labour MPs asked the Prime Minister and the Economics minister about the government's joint letter with eight other countries urging openness in the EU services market, and about the government's stance on the Services Directive and the country-of-origin principle. The minister confirmed the letter, said the directive is to be fully implemented and evaluated by 2011-2012 with possible amendments, and stated that labour law, minimum wage and working conditions are outside the directive and will not be used to undermine Dutch rules.
The country-of-origin principle is not part of the current Services Directive, which for the cabinet is the starting point for further strengthening the internal services market.
Het land-van-oorsprongbeginsel maakt geen deel uit van de huidige dienstenrichtlijn, die voor het kabinet het uitgangspunt is voor de verdere versterking van de interne markt voor diensten.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de tarieven die Schiphol berekent aan luchtvaartmaatschappijen (ingezonden 17 februari 2011).

MP Dijksma asks the state secretary whether the competition authority NMa asked for extra regulation of Schiphol's tariffs due to its market power, why airline tariff disputes recur, whether the 2010 tariff increase was shelved under government pressure, and whether the government will reconsider the tariff system, reintroduce ministerial consent, or use shareholding to influence tariffs. The state secretary answers that the NMa advised continuing sector-specific regulation and that the Wet luchtvaart evaluation (due end 2011) will assess changes, that Schiphol and KLM commissioned their own study and the government commissioned an independent one, and that shareholder interference in tariffs is legally inappropriate, with a letter on public interests promised before 1 October 2011.
Within the ongoing evaluation of the Aviation Act regarding tariff regulation, it will be examined whether and to what extent adjustment of the current system is desirable.
In het kader van de lopende evaluatie van de Wet luchtvaart ten aanzien van de tariefsregulering zal worden bezien of en in hoeverre aanpassing van het huidige systeem wenselijk is.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over concurrentie op de parkeermarkt (ingezonden 31 januari 2011).

An MP asks the minister whether municipalities transferring parking management to cooperatives they belong to breaches competition rules, whether they influence pricing, and whether core tasks like tax collection should stay in-house. The minister answers that competition and tendering assessments are for the NMa and civil courts, has no pricing data, and sees no need for national policy since municipalities remain directly accountable.
It is not for me to rule in individual cases on the applicability and compatibility of competition law.
Het is niet aan mij om in individuele gevallen over de toepasselijkheid van en de verenigbaarheid met het mededingingsrecht een uitspraak te doen.

Vragen van de leden Slob (ChristenUnie), Dijksma (PvdA), Bashir (SP), Van Tongeren (GroenLinks), Verhoeven (D66) en Thieme (PVDD) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voortgang van de werkzaamheden Landtu

Six MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about the schedule, budget and legal challenges for the A2 Leidsche Rijn tunnel and the temporary bypass. The minister answered that the schedule and budget are unchanged, the court rejected residents' challenge on 11 February 2011, and the bypass will open by 1 April 2011.
On Friday 11 February 2011 the court ruled. The appeal was declared unfounded and the request for an interim injunction was also rejected.
Op vrijdag 11 februari 2011 heeft de Rechtbank uitspraak gedaan. Het beroep is ongegrond verklaard en ook het verzoek voor een voorlopige voorziening is afgewezen.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Economie, Landbouw en Innovatie over de innovatieambities van dit kabinet (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

MP Dijksma (PvdA) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation whether the Netherlands is falling behind peer countries in R&D investment and whether the cabinet's cuts to innovation and education are wise given the crisis-era investment packages. The minister answered that public R&D spending is above the EU average but private R&D lags, that the new innovation policy aims at long-term competitiveness rather than more money, and that the crisis measures were appropriate for their time.
To strengthen the knowledge economy, it is not primarily about more money.
Om de kenniseconomie te versterken gaat het niet primair om meer geld.

Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de suggesties dat de jaarcijfers van Schiphol zijn gemanipuleerd om de bonussen van topbestuurders

MP Dijksma asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers whether suggestions that Schiphol's annual accounts were manipulated to inflate executive bonuses were true, and how the state as shareholder controls bonus policy, the CFO's mandate and possible corruption. The minister denied knowledge of manipulation, said an audit by the supervisory board is pending, described the bonus criteria including public-interest targets, and explained the shareholder's oversight via the articles of association and general meeting.
I am awaiting the outcome of that investigation before drawing conclusions about the allegations and/or the internal procedures at Schiphol.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek af alvorens conclusies te trekken over de beschuldigingen en/of de interne procedures bij Schiphol.

Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over massaontslagen bij universiteiten door bezuinigingen en gevolgen voor de kenniseconomie (ingezon

MPs Jadnanansing and Dijksma asked the state secretary about mass layoffs at universities caused by budget cuts and the effects on the knowledge economy, including research quality and the government's ambition to reach the global top. The state secretary acknowledged the measures are drastic but necessary, pointed to a quality boost and planned structural balance from 2015, and said it is too early to judge research effects while checks on quality remain in place.
It is still too early to speculate about the effects on the quality and positioning of research in relation to the loss of jobs.
Het is nog te vroeg om te speculeren over de gevolgen van de kwaliteit en positionering van het onderzoek in relatie tot het verlies aan arbeidsplaatsen.
Vragen van de leden Dijksma en Samsom (beiden PvdA) aan de minister Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over strengere eisen aan elektrische auto’s (ingezonden 2 december 2010).

Two PvdA MPs asked the economic affairs minister whether new safety requirements for electric cars, including a high-frequency test requirement and a fee of about 725 euro, hinder innovation and are justified, and whether small firms and students could be compensated. The minister answered that the rules are new rather than stricter, were developed after a TNO/KEMA study on high-voltage wiring risks, have caused no accidents, and that the costs are proportionate.
This does not concern stricter requirements but new requirements.
Het gaat hier niet om strengere eisen maar om nieuwe eisen.

Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht dat werkgevers gerichte investeringen in innovatie belangrijker vinden dan belastingverlaging voor het bedri

MP Dijksma asked the minister of Economic Affairs whether he shares concern that employers call budget cuts to innovation policy a 'hakken om het hakken', and whether he will discuss with VNO-NCW's Wientjes trading a lower corporate tax cut for smaller innovation cuts. The minister acknowledged the report, said he sees no reason to change the coalition's mix of generic and targeted measures, and promised a broader letter on business policy in early 2011.
However, I see no reason in advance to change the choices regarding the combination of a strengthened innovation policy and a lower corporate tax.
Op voorhand zie ik echter geen aanleiding om de keuzes ten aanzien de combinatie van een versterkt innovatiebeleid en een lagere vennootschapsbelasting te wijzigen.
Vragen van de leden Kuiken en Dijksma (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over flitspalen (ingezonden 22 oktober 2010).

MPs Kuiken and Dijksma asked whether new digital speed cameras can detect modern motorcycles, whether the government knew of the problem when buying them, and whether it would consult Flemish authorities and keep enforcing motorcycle speed limits. The minister answered that all vehicles including the newest motorcycles can be detected, that detection is monitored with suppliers, and that a separate motorcycle safety action plan has been sent to parliament.
Yes, the newest generation of motorcycles can also be detected by the new digital speed cameras.
Antwoord 2 Nee, ook de nieuwste generatie motoren kan herkend worden door nieuwe – digitale – flitspalen.
Vragen van het lid Dijksma (PvdA) aan de minister van Verkeer en Waterstaat over het bericht «Taxi’s speciaal vervoer sjoemelen» (ingezonden 5 juli 2010).

An MP asks the minister about reports that most taxi firms, including in special transport, evade the collective labour agreement and social contributions, and asks about public money involved and the minister's responsibility to end it. The minister replies that the Social Fund Taxi imposed about 2.4 million euro in back-payments in 2009, that the ministry has no formal responsibility for CAO enforcement but supports it through general binding declaration and possible referral to the Labour Inspectorate (none requested so far), and points contracting bodies to procurement guidelines that include CAO compliance as a selection criterion.
I have no formal responsibility for monitoring compliance with the Taxi transport CAO, but the central government has a supporting role in enforcement by the collective bargaining parties
Ik heb geen formele verantwoordelijkheid bij de controle op de naleving van de cao Taxivervoer, maar de Rijksoverheid heeft een ondersteunende rol bij de handhaving door cao-partijen
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over CEF-subsidiegelden

An MP from the VVD asked the government about EU Connecting Europe Facility (CEF) grant rejections for Dutch shipping projects such as exhaust gas scrubbers, and whether this breaches a level playing field. The minister answered that there is no evidence of repeated Dutch-specific rejections, that the same criteria apply to all applicants, and that the budget was oversubscribed two to three times.
I have no indication that CEF subsidies distort competition.
Ik heb geen aanwijzing dat CEF subsidies concurrentieverstorend werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over brandstofzwendel

MP Van Helvert (CDA) asked the government about possible fuel fraud in shipping, including whether a 'black list' of prohibited substances in marine fuel is delayed and whether enforcement is adequate. The government denies a major poisoning scandal is evident, describes ongoing ILT and prosecution investigations, and says an international black list is being pursued via IMO, with results expected in late 2018.
The Chamber can be expected to be informed about the results of this investigation in the first half of 2018.
Naar verwachting kan de Kamer in de eerste helft van 2018 over de resultaten van dit onderzoek worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Lacin over het bericht dat op station Amsterdam Centraal slimme reclameborden worden ingezet

MPs Hijink and Lacin asked about smart advertising boards at Amsterdam Centraal that reportedly track when and how long people look at them, including how many such boards exist, what data they collect, and whether companies and state holdings must obtain opt-in consent or seek advice from the Dutch data protection authority. The government answered that it cannot confirm whether personal data is processed, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (Dutch DPA) is looking into it and has jurisdiction, that the operator Exterion is itself responsible for legal compliance and has temporarily switched off the cameras, and that it sees no need to require DPA advice beyond what the law prescribes.
We do not know how many of the advertising boards referred to in the report are used by Exterion and other operators in the Netherlands, nor what data and techniques are used for this.

Het is ons niet bekend hoeveel van de in het bericht bedoelde type reclameborden worden gebruikt door Exterion en eventuele andere exploitanten in Nederland, noch welke data en technieken hiervoor worden gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de oproep van het Leger des Heils om hergebruik van textiel van de grond te krijgen

An MP asked the state secretary about the Salvation Army's call for better recycling of low-quality textiles, including demand for recycled textile, labelling accuracy, public procurement and inclusion in the National Raw Materials Agreement. The government acknowledges the problem, points to the Roadmap Circular Textiles, the IMVO convenant, pilots and the upcoming Transitieagenda Consumptiegoederen, and promises further talks with the sector.
I will consult with the clothing industry, Milieu Centraal and the Stichting Milieukeur and with the European Commission to see what we can do about this.
Ik ga in overleg met de kledingbranche, Milieu Centraal en de Stichting Milieukeur en met de Europese Commissie om te bezien wat wij hieraan kunnen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Eijs over schade door rubberkorrels kunstgras

MPs Diertens and Van Eijs asked about reports that water boards did not study rubber granulate contamination near artificial turf pitches and whether standards should be reviewed. The State Secretary disputed the claim of dozens of seriously contaminated fields, said heavy metals and PAHs may be present, ordered a RIVM study and promised to raise the concern with the water boards.
I have instructed the RIVM to map the environmental effects of the spread of rubber granulate into the surroundings.
Ik heb het RIVM opdracht gegeven de milieueffecten van de verspreiding van rubbergranulaat naar de omgeving in beeld te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Nijboer over pesticide die schadelijk zijn voor baby’s

MPs Kuiken and Nijboer asked whether a Nature study linking pesticide exposure to premature births and birth defects applies to the Netherlands, and whether Dutch research and protective measures are planned. The minister answered that she had taken note of the study and referred all substantive questions to a separate letter on the status of research into pesticide effects on residents near agricultural fields.
I refer you to my letter on the status of research into the effects of crop protection products on residents living near agricultural fields.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn brief met onderwerp: Stand van zaken van het onderzoek naar de gevolgen van het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen voor omwonenden van agrarische percelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het risico van 'bird-strikes' bij luchthaven Lelystad

An MP asked whether military radar data on bird movements at altitude, and Sovon bird observations, could support a more detailed bird-strike risk analysis for the flight routes to and from Lelystad airport, and whether the Air Force and air traffic control coordinate on bird-strike prevention en route. The minister answered that a baseline survey up to 6 km around the airport is underway, that Air Force radar data will be used for a risk analysis of the approach routes, and that Air Force information is shared with air traffic control, which notes that nearly all bird strikes occur below 3,000 feet.
In addition, the bird radar data of the Royal Netherlands Air Force will be used for a risk analysis of bird strikes on the approach routes to and from Lelystad airport.

Daarnaast zullen de vogelradargegevens van de Koninklijke Luchtmacht worden gebruikt voor een risicoanalyse met betrekking tot vogelaanvaringen op de aansluitroutes van en naar de luchthaven Lelystad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Von Martels over opwaardering Maaslijn en realisatie station Grubbenvorst Greenport-Venlo

MPs Jetten and Von Martels asked why the Maaslijn upgrade faces a funding shortfall and whether station Grubbenvorst Greenport-Venlo can still be realised. The state secretary answers that the national government paid its contributions, that the shortfall stems from the province misreading VAT rules, that the state remains willing to provide a capped subsidy if the province applies, and that the project planning is the province's responsibility.
The decision whether or not to proceed with building station Grubbenvorst rests with the province of Limburg.
De afweging om al dan niet over te gaan tot aanleg van station Grubbenvorst is aan de provincie Limburg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het inspraakproces luchthaven Lelystad

Kröger (GroenLinks) asks why the Lelystad Airport flight-route internet consultation site was reportedly unreachable, how input from the consultation and the Alderstafel is handled, and how affected municipalities and provinces are involved. The minister answers that the site was working but showed an incorrect error message due to duplicate-submission and certificate issues, that input is registered as formal responses with an advisory committee review and a summary to follow, and that the Alderstafel's mandate is unchanged while a stakeholder-management plan and an exploration of strengthening the Alderstafel are promised.
It is expected that from the end of November 2017 a summary of the input to the internet consultation, with a response, will be posted on the internet consultation page.
Naar verwachting zal vanaf eind november 2017 op de internetconsultatiepagina een samenvatting van de inbreng op de internetconsultatie, voorzien van een reactie, worden geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Tongeren, Van der Lee en Beckerman over overheidssteun voor de productie en het gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen

MPs from GroenLinks and the SP asked the government about the ODI/CAN-E report on public support for fossil fuels, the Netherlands' commitment to phase out inefficient fossil fuel subsidies, the absence of a consolidated overview of such support, and the state's share of decommissioning costs. The government denied direct specific support to fossil fuel firms, said budgets do not separate fossil from renewable support, and pointed to the Masterplan for Decommissioning and the new Nexstep platform.

Overviews that specifically distinguish between companies that use and/or produce fossil energy and companies that use and/or produce renewable energy are not available, as that distinction is not made in the budgets.

Overzichten die een specifiek onderscheid maken tussen bedrijven die fossiele energie gebruiken en/of produceren en bedrijven die hernieuwbare vormen van energie benutten en/of produceren, zijn niet voorhanden, aangezien dat onderscheid in de begrotingen niet wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Laçin over het incident bij het tankenpark van de NAM

MPs Beckerman and Laçin asked about a leak of aardgascondensaat at the NAM tank park near Farmsum, its environmental and safety effects, earthquake resistance of tanks, incident history, and supervision. The government answered that SodM and ILT supervise the site, the leak was cleaned up with no reported fauna deaths, the tanks are on the priority list for earthquake-resistance review, and supervision of loading procedures is ongoing.
It is being examined whether preventive additional measures are needed in case an earthquake occurs that is stronger than any so far in the area.
Onderzocht wordt of preventief aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn voor het geval een aardbeving plaatsvindt die zwaarder is dan zich tot nu toe heeft voorgedaan in het gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de luchtkwaliteit en onderzoekscijfers voor emissies van TNO

MP Remco Dijkstra asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about a study finding LPG performs better than petrol and diesel on ground-level ozone, and whether TNO's outdated emission data for fuel factsheets should be updated with newer tests. The State Secretary answered that the factsheets will be updated before summer 2018, that TNO may use all available sources including the German study, and that electric driving is cleaner by definition while the fuel-technology picture is largely a matter of exhaust technology and fuel origin.
The plan is that the new update of the fuel factsheets will be available before summer 2018.
De planning is dat de nieuwe update van de factsheets brandstoffen vóór de zomer van 2018 beschikbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Van der Molen over het bericht dat de overtocht naar één van de Waddeneilanden 21% duurder wordt

MPs Van Helvert and Van der Molen asked about reports that ferry tickets to a Wadden island would become 21% more expensive, and about VAT, the concession and fare rises. The government answered that the reports are inaccurate, that the Tax Plan 2018 removes the zero VAT rate for ships used on the Wadden Sea, and that the concession transfer to the province will be studied in 2018.

When long-term solutions take more shape, the State Secretary intends to commission, together with the Province of Friesland, an independent study in 2018 into the consequences of transferring concession management and award.

Wanneer de lange termijn oplossingen meer vorm krijgen, is de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu voornemens om samen met de Provincie Friesland in 2018 een onafhankelijk onderzoek uit te laten voeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de waterstofbussen in Arnhem

An MP asked the state secretary whether the hydrogen bus rollout in Arnhem is stagnating, whether more public money and risk-taking is needed, and what the national plan for hydrogen refuelling infrastructure is. The state secretary answered that hydrogen buses are still in an early innovation phase, that the ministry is subsidising a pilot and discussing a special-purpose vehicle to cover risks, and that the government facilitates through studies, subsidies and regional support.
The ministry has been in discussion with the region about this for some time.
Het ministerie is hierover al geruime tijd met de regio in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de naleving van de Richtlijn Industriële Emissies (RIE) (2010/75/EU)

Mr Laçin (SP) asks about the Commission's letter on Dutch compliance with the Industrial Emissions Directive regarding the Afvaloven Nee case and the treatment of measurement uncertainty margins at the Omrin waste incinerator. The Secretary of State says the facts are unchanged, that exploitants set uncertainty margins under provincial supervision as upheld by the Council of State, that work on better and harmonised methods is ongoing, and that the Commission has not taken Netherlands to task, while promising to update guidance once better methods exist.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat grond van een bungalowpark is vervuild met GenX

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that soil at a new holiday park in Papendrecht was contaminated with GenX and C8, and whether authorities should take stronger measures such as stricter permit conditions. The state secretary confirmed awareness, said the contamination is consistent with earlier air-deposition findings, noted that no reuse standards yet exist for these substances, and stated that the emission permit is under legal challenge so she cannot judge the authority's conduct, while pointing to ongoing coordination and prior letters.
For that reason I cannot give a judgment on this matter.
Om die reden kan ik geen oordeel geven over deze kwestie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over mogelijke blootstelling van werknemers aan asbest

An MP asked the government about possible asbestos exposure of workers and residents after asbestos-contaminated blasting grit supplied by Eurogrit to about 140 buyers, and about preventive measures. The minister answered that the ILT and Inspectie SZW investigations are ongoing, that employers are responsible for safe removal, and that a TNO study and a letter to parliament will follow by end of October.
As soon as the results of the first part of the TNO investigation are known, your House will be informed about this by letter.
Zodra de resultaten van het eerste gedeelte van het TNO onderzoek bekend zijn, wordt uw Kamer hierover middels brief geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van den Hul en Diks over moderne slavernij, kinderarbeid en onveilig en ongezond werk in Indiase granietgroeves die aan Nederlandse en Europese markt leveren

Three MPs asked the government about modern slavery, child labour and unsafe work in Indian granite quarries supplying Dutch and European markets, and what Dutch companies, procurement and diplomacy will do about it. The minister acknowledges serious abuses, points to OECD due diligence duties, an IMVO sector convenant under negotiation, procurement conditions and raising the issue in EU-India human rights dialogue, but offers no binding new measures and leaves much to the Indian government and ILO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht 'Vliegen op één rij kost fortuin'

MP Van Helvert asked whether hidden extra charges for choosing seats on airline tickets break the law, what rules ensure full price transparency, whether the ACM has fined airlines for this, and whether airlines may charge for seats keeping families together. The government answered that total prices must be shown upfront, optional seat fees must be disclosed early and opt-in, the ACM enforces this and has fined providers, and airlines may charge for specific seats with no legal cap on fees.
Booking specific seats is increasingly an optional choice.
Het boeken van specifieke zitplaatsen is steeds vaker een facultatieve optie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Haven stoot meer CO2 uit dan ooit’

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the government about reports that the Rotterdam port emits more CO2 than ever, whether it will help the port's climate ambitions, and how it will address the CCS project and local air quality. The state secretary answered that the transition is a multi-step process, pointed to existing port decarbonisation projects, and deferred most concrete choices to the incoming cabinet, while confirming the CCS ambition remains and alternative talks are ongoing.
It is up to the new cabinet, based on the coalition agreement presented on 10 October, to further shape the climate and energy transition in the Netherlands, and therefore also in the Rotterdam port.

Het is aan het nieuwe kabinet om op basis van het op 10 oktober jl. gepresenteerde regeerakkoord de klimaat- en energietransitie in Nederland, en dus ook in de Rotterdamse haven, verder vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Kröger over de bloedtest die beschikbaar gesteld wordt voor omwonenden van chemieconcern Chemours

MPs Van Eijs and Kröger asked why the Chemours blood test for residents is limited to the RIVM blue zone, whether financial barriers exist, and whether former workers and wider residents can participate. The State Secretary defends the zone as based on the RIVM sample, states there are no costs, promises to ask municipalities to offer tests to former workers without a traceable employer, and says municipalities will communicate the offer.

To prevent these people from having no opportunity to be tested, I will ask the municipalities of Dordrecht, Sliedrecht and Papendrecht to also make a test available for those cases where no former employer can be traced.

Om te voorkomen dat deze mensen geen mogelijkheid hebben om zich te laten testen, zal ik de gemeenten Dordrecht, Sliedrecht en Papendrecht vragen om, voor die gevallen waarin geen voormalige werkgever meer traceerbaar is, ook een test beschikbaar te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de uitspraak in de rechtszaak van Milieudefensie rechtszaak

An MP asks the State Secretary about a court ruling against the state on air quality, whether the government will accelerate measures, whether enforcement gaps exist between municipalities, provinces and the state, and whether stricter national air quality norms will be set. The State Secretary rejects the claim of a enforcement vacuum, promises to inform parliament in November on accelerated measures and says a new air quality plan will be drawn up in 2017-2018 without committing to stricter national norms.
At the beginning of November I will inform your House further.
Begin november zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de gevolgen van de uitspraak in de rechtszaak van Milieudefensie

An MP asked the state secretary what the court ruling in the Milieudefensie case means for numerous road, airport and infrastructure projects (A2, A16, A27, Rotterdamsebaan, Blankenburgtunnel, Schiphol, RTHA, biomass plant), whether they can proceed, and why projects were exempt from air quality limits under the NSL. The secretary answered that the ruling is addressed to the State, that projects are assessed under current law and the NSL, that statistical exceedance tests will be developed with RIVM, and that the NSL remains usable despite the court's view.

In the ruling the judge additionally prohibited the State from taking measures which, in RIVM's view, are statistically expected to lead to continued or renewed exceedance of the PM10 and NO2 limit values.

In het vonnis heeft de rechter de Staat daarenboven verboden maatregelen te treffen waarvan in de visie van het RIVM statistisch verwacht moet worden dat deze tot voortgaande dan wel hernieuwde overschrijding van de grenswaarden PM 10 en NO 2 zullen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de gevolgen van de uitspraak in de Milieudefensie rechtszaak

The MP Van Raan asks the State Secretary how the Milieudefensie air-quality ruling affects annual averages, hourly limits, enforcement, monitoring outside RIVM stations, and planned infrastructure and livestock projects. The State Secretary answers that hourly limits also apply, that rolling annual averages are rejected, that the ruling is being implemented via statistical exceedance probabilities and a map of locations, and that many projects are for decentralised authorities to decide.
I have sent you this overview by letter (TK 30 175 no. 256).
Dit overzicht heb ik u per brief toegestuurd (TK 30 175 nr. 256 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Ronnes over de rol van de Nederlandse Spoorwegen bij de verliezen die in Schotland worden geleden

MPs Von Martels and Ronnes asked whether the minister knew Abellio ScotRail, an NS subsidiary, was loss-making and received a group loan support, and whether this is reasonable given NS's Dutch-state ownership. The minister answered that the losses were known through regular shareholder consultation, that the group guarantee is a market-standard concession requirement capped under a risk framework, and that he sees no reason to doubt NS's expectation of eventual profitability.
That was known to me. The ministry, as shareholder, regularly consults with NS on the financial position of NS and relevant group companies.
Dat was mij bekend. Het ministerie heeft als aandeelhouder regelmatig overleg met NS over de financiële stand van zaken van NS en relevante groepsonderdelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de relatie tussen Air France en KLM

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Air France KLM's plan to create a low-cost airline (Joon) would rely on weaker labour conditions, whether it would affect KLM routes and Dutch staff, and how the government reacts to a leaked report on the Air France-KLM relationship. The state secretary answered that labour terms are for employers and employees to agree within legal limits, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, that no effects on the Dutch labour market are expected, and that KLM and Air France will draw lessons from the report.
It is up to Air France KLM to decide which destinations it will fly to with the new airline Joon and to provide information about this.
Het is aan Air France KLM om te bepalen op welke bestemmingen men gaat vliegen met de nieuwe luchtvaartmaatschappij Joon en daarover informatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Ronnes, Visser en Aukje de Vries over de samenwerking tussen KLM en Air France

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the government about the KLM-Air France relationship, including a cultural report, centralisation, the Joon/Boost subsidiary, governance and Dutch representation on the holding's executive committee. The state secretary said the cooperation is a private company matter, that the 2016 agreements still stand, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, and that the two-tier model is valued, while declining to comment on the report and refusing to take a position on board composition.
I did not discuss the report with the KLM management because I consider the cooperation a responsibility of the company Air France KLM and of the two airlines KLM and Air France themselves.

Ik heb over het rapport niet met de KLM-directie gesproken omdat ik de samenwerking een verantwoordelijkheid van de onderneming Air France KLM en de twee luchtvaartmaatschappijen KLM en Air France zelf vind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zwerfafval

An MP asked the state secretary about litter on roads and waterways, RWS's lack of documentation and cost figures for litter removal, contract standards for litter, and whether producers should pay litter-removal levies. The state secretary answered that RWS relies on performance contracts with frequency left to contractors, cannot separate litter costs from other maintenance costs, is developing a litter framework, and will inform parliament further on possible levies.
Because various activities are bundled in the individual performance contracts, it is no longer possible to determine afterwards what RWS's annual costs were for litter-specific activities.

Door de bundeling van verschillende werkzaamheden in de afzonderlijke prestatiecontracten is het niet meer mogelijk om achteraf te bepalen wat voor RWS de jaarlijkse kosten waren voor specifiek zwerfafvalgerelateerde werkzaamheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Futselaar over het bericht dat honderd miljoen euro aan subsidie is toegewezen voor een grote mest(co)vergistingsinstallatie in Rilland

An SP MP asked the ministers about the EUR 100 million subsidy for a large manure co-digestion plant in Rilland, covering nuisance from traffic, siting, emissions, landscape integration, the total energy gains from the EUR 2.5 billion spent on manure digesters, and whether such subsidies remain a sound investment. The minister answered that the provincial permit covers environmental effects, that the subsidy is a maximum under SDE+ and depends on actual output, that he considers subsidising digesters cost-effective, and that local residents' information is a municipal and provincial responsibility.
Informing residents about this initiative and organising the participation that goes with it is a task of local authorities.
Het informeren van bewoners over dit initiatief en het organiseren van inspraak die daarbij hoort is een taak van de lokale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het mogelijk steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen, in dit geval Boskalis en van Oord

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (Atradius DSB) would support Boskalis and Van Oord's role in the Nord Stream 2 pipeline and whether this conflicts with Paris climate goals. The government answered that a non-binding letter of interest was issued, that each application will undergo an environmental and social assessment, and that it sees no reason to exclude oil and gas projects from export credit insurance, while stating the political debate falls outside the scope of the export credit framework.
When assessing any applications, political and financial risks will be examined and an assessment of environmental and social impacts will be carried out.
Bij de beoordeling van eventuele aanvragen zal naar de politieke en financiële risico's worden gekeken en zal een beoordeling van de milieu en sociale gevolgen worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Beckerman over het steunen van de fossiele sector door middel van exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs Van Raan and Beckerman asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (EKV) support for fossil-fuel-related projects conflicts with the Paris Agreement, and asked about a phase-out plan, disclosure, coal and fossil exclusion lists and related OECD and fund matters. The Secretary of State answered that EKV is a generic, demand-driven instrument, that no phase-out plan is being prepared, that information disclosure and CSR policy are being developed, and that the government still supports ending public finance for new coal plants abroad but rejects an oil and gas exclusion list.
As described in the answer to question 2, no such plan is being worked on.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 2 beschreven wordt er niet gewerkt aan een dergelijk plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de berichten dat er een grote brand heeft plaatsgevonden bij de Esso-raffinaderij in het Botlekgebied

An MP asked the Minister about a large fire at the Esso refinery in the Botlek area, including the failure of the regional website, a delayed and incomplete NL-Alert, health risks and compensation for residents, and whether communication failures across recent incidents would be jointly investigated. The Minister replied that crisis communication is the responsibility of the safety region and its mayors, described the website outage and the corrected NL-Alert, said the GGD informed residents on health risks and Esso is compensating damage, and stated the region is evaluating the communication with the parties involved.
Responsibility for crisis communication lies under the Wet veiligheidsregio's with the mayor and, for incidents with regional effects, with the safety region board.

De verantwoordelijkheid voor de crisiscommunicatie ligt krachtens de Wet veiligheidsregio’s (Wvr) bij de burgemeester en, in geval van een incident met regionale effecten, bij het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de berichtgeving omtrent het alarm slaan van de Nederlandse spoorsector over de Duitse stremming bij Rastatt

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the reported alarm in the Dutch rail sector over the closure of the Rastatt rail line in Germany, including damage to Dutch freight operators and ports and calls for EU-level action. The State Secretary answered that the ministry has been in regular contact with German authorities and infrastructure managers, that the closure causes substantial economic damage, and that a joint evaluation and an EU-level meeting are planned, but she gave no detailed damage figures.
I do not have an exact picture of the damage.
Mij is geen exact beeld van de schade bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het nieuws dat grote industrieën verdienen aan het ETS

An MP asked whether large industries profiting from surplus free EU ETS emission allowances is undesirable, and whether the ETS should be abolished or strengthened. The State Secretary acknowledged early free allocation was too generous, defended the ETS as a cost-effective instrument, and said she supports strengthening rather than abolishing it.
I am not in favour of abolishing the ETS. On the contrary, I am committed to strengthening the ETS, as in principle it is a good instrument for cost-effectively steering CO2 reduction.
Ik ben geen voorstander van afschaffing van het ETS. Ik zet me juist in voor versterking van het ETS, aangezien het in beginsel een goed instrument is om kosteneffectief te sturen op CO 2 -reductie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat huishoudens twee derde van de milieubelastingen betalen

An SP MP asked the government about reports that households pay two-thirds of environmental taxes, the industry's share of those levies, whether the burden distribution undermines public support, and where the revenue is spent. The government confirmed the figures, said industry's share of energy tax and renewable energy levy was about 10% and that a full breakdown is not registered, and pointed to the Energy Agenda, an SER study and the general budget as the spending channels.
A complete picture of the precise contribution of the industrial sector to the revenues from environmental taxes and levies is lacking.
Een volledig beeld omtrent de precieze bijdrage van de sector industrie aan de opbrengsten van de milieubelastingen en heffingen ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over zwerfafval

Van Raan (PvdD) asked the State Secretary about the CE Delft study on deposit schemes for small bottles and cans, challenging the independence of the study and the credibility of industry critics. The State Secretary defended the study's independence and quality, and said policy decisions on packaging will follow the completion of ongoing evaluations, with an update expected by end 2017.
I expect to be able to inform you by the end of 2017 about the next steps in the packaging dossier.
Ik verwacht u eind 2017 te kunnen informeren over de vervolgstappen in het verpakkingendossier.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de stijging van CO2-uitstoot in 2016

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the 2020 CO2 reduction target (25% versus 1990), upheld by the court, is still achievable given a 1% rise in 2016 and a reduction of only 11% so far, and how the remaining 14% will be achieved year by year. The government denies the target is out of reach, says the Energy Agreement should close the remaining 4 Mton gap and that the NEV 2017 will be used to check course, with additional measures if needed.
At the NEV 2017 it will be examined whether we are still on track to implement the Urgenda judgment.
Bij de NEV 2017 zal worden bezien of we nog op koers liggen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Remco Dijkstra over de aanpassing van de dienstregeling van het treinverkeer in het Rivierengebied

Two MPs asked the State Secretary about the 2018 timetable changes for rail in the Rivierengebied, including longer transfer times at Tiel and Geldermalsen, and how affected residents were weighed and consulted. The State Secretary confirmed the impacts, explained that the frequency upgrade on the Amsterdam–Eindhoven corridor required them, reported consultations via ROCOV, and said NS had only made a small improvement at Geldermalsen while finding no better option for Tiel.
NS is responsible for the timetable and regularly informs me as concession grantor about developments in the timetable.
NS is verantwoordelijk voor de dienstregeling en informeert mij als concessieverlener regelmatig over de ontwikkelingen in de dienstregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Verhoeven over OV-chipkaartbedrijf Translink dat de reisgegevens van honderden studenten heeft doorgegeven aan de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs

MPs Jetten and Verhoeven asked how Translink could hand travel data of hundreds of students to DUO, on what legal basis, and whether travellers are notified. The government answered that DUO relied on general supervisory powers and data protection provisions, that the Hague court has since ruled these insufficient and transfers stopped, and it declined to address pending appeal questions while promising limited follow-up on privacy and information sharing.

The Hague District Court ruled in its judgment of 8 May that Articles 5:16 and 5:17 of the General Administrative Law Act do not in themselves provide a sufficiently specific legal basis for the data processing.

De rechtbank Den Haag heeft echter in haar uitspraak van 8 mei jl. geoordeeld dat de artikelen 5:16 en 5:17 van de Awb als zodanig geen voldoende specifieke wettelijke grondslag bieden voor de gegevensverwerking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Van Eijs over de Redichemse Waard en de bredere problematiek van verondieping van Nederlandse (diepe) waterplassen

MPs Jetten and Van Eijs asked the government about the planned shallowing of the Redichemse Waard lake with contaminated sludge and soil, its recreational and ecological value, and the legal basis for dumping, including imported waste. The minister answered that shallowing is not automatically a useful application, that Rijkswaterstaat assesses the draft plan without approving it, and that existing rules and the Omgevingswet give limited scope for further protection.
Shallowing a deep lake is not by definition a useful and functional application.
Het verondiepen van een diepe plas is niet per definitie een nuttige en functionele toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over fraude op Schiphol

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance Minister and Infrastructure State Secretary about fraud, cost control, investment and building-quality problems at Schiphol Group, following a NRC article. The government answered that Schiphol is primarily responsible for its own integrity and asset management, that an external review and KPMG study found procurement market-conform, and that existing building issues, including the Hilton case, were addressed with the competent authorities.
Schiphol is primarily responsible for its own business operations and integrity policy.
Schiphol is primair verantwoordelijk voor de eigen bedrijfsvoering en het integriteitsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de beschikbare zitplaatsen in treinen van de NS

An MP asks the State Secretary about seat shortages on NS trains in September 2017, including expected record crowding, the share of growth due to the economy, the new Flirt trains, and whether a study of the September peak and student travel is needed. The State Secretary answers that September peaks are known, ties growth mainly to economic factors, says standing during peaks is acceptable and NS must still meet concession requirements, and declines a new study while pointing to existing student travel pilots.
I therefore see no reason to launch further research into the causes of the September crowding.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek in te stellen naar de oorzaken van de septemberdrukte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de aanpak van de drukte op Schiphol

An SP MP asked whether unexperienced, unarmed civilians would perform passport checks at Schiphol and how the €20 million reinforcement of the Marechaussee translates into extra staff. The government answers that border control is done by trained, armed Marechaussee, that a single unarmed military reservist is being piloted alongside an armed colleague, and that 200 extra FTE are being added from 2017/2018 with further policy options being drafted.
It is not correct that the border at Schiphol is now guarded by civilians.
Het is niet correct dat de grens op Schiphol nu bewaakt zou worden door burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Visser, Jetten en Bruins over de vluchtroutes naar Lelystad

Five MPs from CDA, VVD, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the Lelystad airport flight routes, including the Alderstafel advisory process, consultation records, airspace safety and feasibility, environmental costs and the Helios second opinion. The state secretary answered most questions on substance, stating that no minutes or attendance lists were kept, that routes were designed within existing airspace structure, and that the Helios opinion would be sent before the committee meeting.
No minutes are made of the meetings of the Alderstafel Lelystad, nor is an attendance list kept.
Van de vergaderingen van de Alderstafel Lelystad worden geen verslagen gemaakt, noch een presentielijst bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Aalst over het bericht ‘Ook NS stopt nu met ‘dames en heren’’

An MP from the PVV asked the state secretary about NS replacing 'dames en heren' with 'beste reizigers' in announcements, asking for FTE and cost figures, sanctions on staff, and whether the government would push NS to dismiss those responsible. The state secretary said it is NS's own matter, did not have the FTE and cost data, said staff may still use 'dames en heren' and that it is up to the conductor, and refused to press for dismissals.
I consider it a matter for the company itself.
Ik vind het een zaak van het bedrijf zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de informatievoorziening rondom de incidenten bij Shell Pernis eind juli 2017

An SP MP asked the government about criticism from residents near Shell Pernis over information provided after two July 2017 incidents, including whether NL-Alert should have been used and whether causes would be shared. The state secretary answered that crisis communication lies with local and regional authorities (VRR, DCMR), that Shell and authorities used several channels, that NL-Alert was not used because no health risks were expected, and that causes will be reported to the province of Zuid-Holland which decides on disclosure.
It is up to the competent authority to share relevant information about the causes of these incidents.
Het is aan bevoegd gezag om relevante informatie omtrent de oorzaken van deze incidenten te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de berichten dat een toxicoloog meermaals alarm sloeg over gifgas bij Chemours

An MP asked the government to respond to reports that a toxicologist repeatedly warned about the toxic gas PFIB released by Chemours in Dordrecht, and to explain the health risks and detection levels. The state secretary answered that PFIB arises only as a minimal by-product, that the permit imposes strict controls and a shutdown obligation, that measured peaks stayed below RIVM norms, and described its serious inhalation health effects.

For that reason the substance has been designated a substance of very high concern, and the competent authority must impose strict requirements when granting permits to minimise risks to the surroundings.
Om die reden is de stof aangemerkt als zeer zorgwekkende stof en dient het bevoegd gezag bij vergunningverlening strenge eisen op te leggen om risico's voor de omgeving te minimaliseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over kartelafspraken van de grote Duitse autobouwers over prijzen en ook om niet of slechts minimaal aan de milieunormen te voldoen

Questions from MP Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) ask whether reported German car-maker cartel arrangements on prices and emissions, the possible deal on recall without type-approval withdrawal, and the emissions-defeat software issue have legal consequences in the Netherlands, and how APK, type approval and urban zones should respond. The government answers that cartels are a European Commission matter, that Dutch law currently gives no basis to compel recalls or prosecute the manufacturers, that about 77,000 Dutch vehicles still have an open Volkswagen recall, and that type-approval withdrawal and zone exclusion are limited or up to municipalities.
Currently there is no legal basis to prosecute manufacturers for this conduct or impose sanctions.
Momenteel is er geen juridisch aanknopingspunt om fabrikanten met deze handelwijze te vervolgen en sancties op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht dat Frankrijk de import van palmolie en onduurzame soja gaat verbieden

An MP asked whether the government will follow France in banning imports of unsustainable palm oil and soy to protect forests, and about Dutch responsibility for deforestation and the reliance on voluntary certification schemes. The minister answered that the government opposes import bans in principle, prefers sustainability in producing countries and voluntary standards (RSPO, RTRS), and rejects any contradiction in its climate and forest policy.

The cabinet is in principle not in favour of import bans, and instead works on making production in the countries themselves more sustainable and on increasing demand for sustainable palm oil and soy.

Het kabinet is in beginsel geen voorstander van importverboden, en werkt in plaats daarvan aan de verduurzaming van de productie in de landen zelf en aan het vergroten van de vraag naar duurzame palmolie en soja.
Antwoord op vragen de vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat recent twee ernstige incidenten hebben plaatsgevonden op Schiphol

An SP MP asked the government about two reported serious incidents at Schiphol (a runway incursion involving a bird patrol and a tailstrike) and what was known about them, the status of OVV recommendations, whether the incidents were avoidable, and air traffic controller workload. The Staatssecretaris answered that investigations are ongoing, that the sector bears primary responsibility under the ILT's supervision, that a response to the OVV will follow in October, and that the ILT has not found workload to create uncontrolled risks.
The Aviation Incident Analysis Bureau (ABL) of the ILT does not conduct independent investigations into individual incidents.
Het Analyse Bureau Luchtvaartvoorvallen (ABL) van de ILT doet geen zelfstandig onderzoek naar afzonderlijke incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over de haalbaarheid van de emissiereductie van broeikasgassen van 25% in 2020

MPs Van Raan and Wassenberg asked whether the CE Delft finding that the 25% greenhouse gas reduction target for 2020 (Urgenda ruling) is very likely unattainable with current policy is accepted, and how the 2017 projection handles the uncertainties (wind onshore, CCS ROAD, electricity imports) and what will be done if the analysis proves right. The Secretary of State disagrees, saying the Energy Agreement targets should close the remaining 4 Mton gap, that ROAD is no longer counted after withdrawal, and that the NEV 2017 will be reviewed with additional measures such as closing a coal plant if needed.
With the NEV 2017 it will be examined whether we are still on course to implement the Urgenda ruling.
Bij de NEV 2017 zal worden bezien of we nog op koers liggen om uitvoering te geven aan het Urgenda-vonnis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het rapport 'Wordt de 25% emissiereductie van broeikasgassen in 2020 gehaald?'

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the government whether the CE Delft report showing the 25% CO2 reduction target for 2020 is uncertain should be accepted, what concrete measures will ensure it is met, and why each factor (wind yield, ROAD cancellation, lower electricity imports) pushes emissions higher. The state secretary referred to earlier answers, said the NEV 2017 will give an integrated overview expected in October, promised the ROAD status update for the 2018 budget, and offered no new concrete measures.
The NEV 2017, expected in October, will give an integrated overview of the effects of all relevant energy developments affecting greenhouse gas emissions in the Netherlands.

De NEV 2017, die naar verwachting in oktober uitkomt, zal een integraal overzicht geven van de effecten van alle relevante ontwikkelingen op energiegebied die van invloed zijn op de broeikasgasuitstoot in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het landelijk asbestvolgsysteem en de programmatische aanpak asbestdaken

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about recurring faults, slowness and usability problems with the national asbestos tracking system LAVS, and about rules that prevent combining indoor and outdoor asbestos removal on agricultural buildings. The government answers that problems are normal during ICT development, that capacity and user meetings are being improved, and that combined indoor-outdoor removal is not prohibited, with a handbook under review.
In consultation with users, problems are discussed and addressed as quickly as possible.
In overleg met de gebruikers worden problemen besproken en zo snel mogelijk geadresseerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de informatie beschikbaar bij de Nederlandse overheid en regering over het onveilige luchtruim boven Oost Oekraïne in de eerste helft van 2014, dus vóór het nee

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked what information the Dutch government held about unsafe airspace over eastern Ukraine before MH17 was downed, including an April 2014 NCTV threat-analysis request, the Kiev memorandum, OVSE and ECAC warnings, NOTAMs, Eccairs reports and airline warning arrangements. The government answered that the April 2014 request was a routine terrorism-alert request on Dutch airports, that the relevant warnings concerned Crimea and the Black Sea rather than eastern Ukraine, and it offered some documents for confidential inspection by the House until the 2017 Christmas recess while withholding others from public disclosure.
To give your House a complete picture I will make all the requests mentioned above available for confidential inspection, only to members of your House, until the 2017 Christmas recess.
Om uw Kamer een compleet beeld te geven zal ik alle hierboven genoemde aanvragen ter vertrouwelijke inzage ter beschikking stellen, alleen aan de leden van uw Kamer, tot het kerstreces 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over overlast vliegverkeer in Zuid-Limburg

An MP asked whether new agreements or a treaty on aircraft noise over South Limburg (Liège airport approaches over Eijsden) were progressing, whether routes and volumes had changed, why monitoring is limited, and whether the ministry measures itself. The state secretary replied that a Memorandum of Cooperation with Belgium is planned for late 2017, a treaty is a longer-term goal, existing operational agreements remain in force, the ministry runs its own Fanomos monitoring, and monitoring covers all radar registrations up to 15,000 feet within a fixed area in four time periods.
I expect to be able to conclude the Memorandum of Cooperation in the second half of 2017.
Ik verwacht het Memorandum of Cooperation in de tweede helft van 2017 te kunnen afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Von Martels, Nijkerken-de Haan en Middendorp over het behoud van het station Valkenburg door de Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij

MPs from CDA and VVD asked the State Secretary about the ILT's refusal to let the Zuid-Limburgse Stoomtrein Maatschappij run over the main line to Valkenburg station without machinist licences, and whether the rules are stricter than EU requirements. The State Secretary answered that no regulatory change occurred, the ILT had no legal basis for an exemption, and ZLSM is expected to obtain a new safety certificate by early 2018 with a study into training for its machinists.
The ILT's decision arose from a request by the ZLSM.
Het besluit van de ILT komt voort uit een verzoek van de ZLSM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de onbewaakte spoorwegovergang in Santpoort-Zuid

An MP asked the state secretary about the unguarded level crossing at Santpoort-Zuid, its timeline, a possible expropriation, and whether obstacles or a mediator were needed. The state secretary explained that the southern crossing will close once a farm business is relocated, the northern one awaits agreement with several rights holders, and the state secretary has prioritised closing such crossings but is not a party to local measures.
Tackling public and publicly accessible unguarded level crossings on the passenger network is indeed a priority for me.
Het aanpakken van openbare en openbaar toegankelijke NABO's op het reizigersnet heeft voor mij inderdaad prioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat de ov-chipkaart op de mobiele telefoon flopt

An SP MP asked the state secretary about press reports that the OV-chip card on mobile phones had failed, the costs of the pilots, and whether the Bureau ICT Toetsing should review them. The government acknowledged the introduction was not smooth and that communication should have been better, but said the pilots are run and paid for by Translink, transport operators and banks, that no state funds are involved, and declined to refer them to the Bureau ICT Toetsing because they are not state projects.
No. The Bureau ICT Toetsing reviews large central government projects with an ICT component of more than €5 million.
Nee. Het Bureau ICT Toetsing toetst grote projecten van de rijksoverheid met een ICT-component van meer dan € 5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht “Twee conducteurs mishandeld door treinreizigers”

PVV MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports of conductors and police being assaulted on trains, asking why measures have not stopped it, whether travel bans and harsher penalties will be imposed, whether NS security staff will get batons and pepper spray, whether a perpetrator profile and a real-time database of travel bans will be created. The government answered that eight and 23 measures are being implemented or evaluated, that travel-ban evaluation will be shared in autumn, that NS security staff have no need for pepper spray, that a perpetrator profile report was already delivered, and that a database will be considered in the travel-ban evaluation.
These measures are currently being evaluated. You will be informed about this in the autumn.
Deze maatregelen worden momenteel geëvalueerd. Hierover zult u in het najaar worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Futselaar over de incidenten bij Shell-Pernis

MPs Laçin and Futselaar asked the state secretary about two incidents at Shell Pernis in July 2017, including flaring, residents' odour complaints, monitoring, e-nose placement and whether an independent investigation would be held. The government answered that the company and the provincial competent authority (DCMR) are responsible, that a criminal investigation is underway, that measurements showed no health-threatening levels, and that the existing legal framework for crisis communication is adequate, while declining to draw conclusions on causes and health effects until the investigations finish.
As long as the investigations are ongoing, I cannot make statements about the causes, the connection between the incidents and the possible effects on workers and the surroundings.
Zolang de onderzoeken lopen, kan ik geen uitspraken doen over de oorzaken, het verband tussen de incidenten en de mogelijke effecten voor werknemers en omgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de keuringsplicht voor noodstroomaggregaten

An MP asked why a mandatory inspection for emergency generators introduced on 1 January 2017 burdens farms and other firms with high costs, and whether it will be reconsidered. The state secretary defended the inspection as a safety measure for rarely used emergency equipment and said reconsideration is premature, though the regime may be revisited toward 2025.
To guarantee safety, it was chosen to still require an inspection.
Om de veiligheid te waarborgen is ervoor gekozen wel een keuring te eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Aalst en Helder over het bericht ‘Milieuactivisten maken voor tienduizenden euro’s schade’

MPs Van Aalst and Helder asked whether police knew in advance of a Code Rood activist break-in at an Amsterdam port business park, why police did not intervene sooner, how few arrests were made, and whether damages can be recovered. Minister Blok answered that the mayor is responsible for police operations, referred specific questions to the local authority, reported 13 arrests, and noted victims can claim damages through criminal or civil routes.
The mayor is responsible for directing the police with regard to public order in his or her municipality.
De burgemeester is verantwoordelijk voor de aansturing van de politie ten aanzien van de openbare orde in zijn of haar gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het bericht ‘Overheid, doe iets tegen vertraging containerterminals’ en ‘Wereldwijde scheepvaart worstelt met stookolie’

The MP Jetten (D66) asks about container terminal congestion in Rotterdam harbour that delays inland shipping and about the failure of IMO talks to phase out heavy fuel oil in shipping, and whether the government will lead on climate ambitions. The minister acknowledges the congestion, lists measures under way and says the government supports the Arctic heavy fuel ban at the IMO and pursues 2020 sulphur limits, without committing to a new concrete step beyond ongoing consultation.
I have no insight into the business information of the companies involved.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de bedrijfsinformatie van de betrokken ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de uitstoot van GenX-stoffen en PFOA door Chemours

An MP asks the government about GenX and PFOA contamination around the Chemours plant, including health risks from home-grown produce, control mechanisms and blood testing. The state secretary answers that the VU study is only indicative, that the RIVM second opinion cannot establish risk from garden produce, that PFOA emissions from the process are excluded, and that blood testing for residents will be offered.
In consultation with the province of Zuid-Holland and the directly involved municipalities, I have asked the RIVM to carry out a second opinion to interpret the results of the VU study.
Ik heb, in samenspraak met de provincie Zuid-Holland en de direct betrokken gemeenten, het RIVM gevraagd om een second opinion uit te voeren om de resultaten van het VU-onderzoek te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het onderzoek van Helios naar de vliegroutes van Lelystad

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the state secretary about the Helios second opinion on Lelystad airport flight routes, whether the B+ routeset is fixed, the London airspace comparison, military airspace in other countries, and LVNL's role. The state secretary maintained that the B+ routes and design principles are given, confirmed Helios would review the proposed routes within those principles, and provided the Helios assignment.

Helios is therefore, partly at my request, carrying out a second opinion next month on the currently proposed connecting routes and the consequences for the airspace, guided by the principles advised by the Alderstafel Lelystad and adopted by the cabinet.
