Helios voert dan ook, mede op mijn verzoek, komende maand een second opinion uit op de nu voorliggende ontwerp aansluitroutes en de gevolgen voor het luchtruim, met als leidraad de door de Alderstafel Lelystad geadviseerde en door het kabinet overgenomen uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Ronnes over de verbreding van de A2 tussen Weert en Eindhoven

Two CDA MPs asked why the government chose not to widen the A2 between Weert and Eindhoven despite daily congestion, and about the rules for paying drivers to avoid peak hours. The minister answered that the MIRT study was taken into account, that peak-avoidance payments would be capped at three months and follow Parliament's conditions, and that the region-led programme chose no-regret measures instead of a widening study because other bottlenecks had greater economic losses.
The Programme Council SmartwayZ.nl therefore weighed not having the state start an exploration for a further package of measures on the A2.
In de Programmaraad SmartwayZ.nl is daarom afgewogen nu geen verkenning door het rijk te laten starten voor een verdergaand maatregelenpakket op de A2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat GenX in meer drinkwater zit

MP Laçin (SP) asked the ministers how the government responds to reports that GenX has been found in drinking water at several locations, including whether permits should be tightened or a moratorium considered. The minister says concentrations are far below the provisional RIVM guideline, that the Chemours discharge is the source downstream of Dordrecht, that a court case on the permit is pending, and that research results will follow.
This is now before the court and therefore I cannot make further statements about it.
Dit ligt nu voor bij de rechter en daarom kan ik hierover nu geen nadere uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Visser en Jetten over het vliegveld Teuge

MPs asked whether the province of Gelderland pushed for a new flight route over the Teuge airport, whether provinces were consulted and informed about the planned airspace connections for Lelystad Airport, and what alternatives exist. The state secretary denied that Gelderland pushed for a route over Teuge, said the provinces were involved and informed, that a consultation procedure starts in September, and that she is exploring with Teuge and the parachute centre how to limit the effects.
There is no question of the province of Gelderland having pushed for a flight route over Teuge.
Er is geen sprake van dat de provincie Gelderland op een vliegroute boven Teuge zou hebben aangestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over het bericht dat NS een miljoenenboete moet betalen

An MP asked the government about the ACM fine imposed on NS for abuse of market power in the Limburg tender, including the administrative costs, the effect on the dividend, whether the fine is tied to criminal proceedings, and whether tendering in public transport is viable. The minister answered that ACM is independent and costs are not known, the fine lowers the dividend by 35 percent, the fine is separate from criminal proceedings, and NS has taken steps to prevent recurrence with a letter promised.
ACM carried out the investigation in its responsibility as an independent administrative body (ZBO). A ZBO does not fall under the direct authority of a minister.
ACM heeft het onderzoek vanuit haar verantwoordelijkheid als zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (ZBO) uitgevoerd. Een ZBO valt niet onder direct gezag van een Minister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jetten over het bericht dat de boete voor NS en ProRail niet ten koste mag gaan van de reiziger

MP Jetten asked whether the fine on NS and ProRail for underperformance should avoid passing costs to passengers, and whether the IC-direct supplement should be scrapped while performance lags. The State Secretary agreed fines should not burden travellers, placed the fine money in a passengers' fund, and committed to temporarily abolishing the IC-direct supplement off-peak this autumn.
To meet travellers on the IC direct, I intend to temporarily abolish the supplement on the IC direct in off-peak hours on weekdays and at weekends this autumn.
Om de reizigers op de IC direct tegemoet te komen ben ik voornemens om de toeslag op de IC direct in de daluren op werkdagen en het weekend dit najaar tijdelijk af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink, Ouwehand en Van Raan over het steunen van de fossiele sector dmv exportkredietverzekeringen

MPs from the SP and PvdD asked whether Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) substantially supports the fossil fuel sector, including the reported €7.3 billion Atradius DSB exposure, and whether it should be tightened to align with Paris goals. The State Secretary answered that the ekv is generic and demand-driven with no fossil-specific policy, that it is cost-covering, that about 39% of the portfolio (€6.4 billion) is fossil-related, that oil and gas transactions undergo environmental and social due diligence, and that he will not explicitly phase out support for non-Paris-aligned projects while promoting renewable and climate-related export cover.
There is no policy to support the fossil fuel sector in particular.
Er is geen beleid om de fossiele sector in het bijzonder te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over de brand bij de olieraffinaderij Isla op Curaçao

MPs from D66 asked the government about the fire at the Isla refinery on Curaçao, including health risks from smoke, the cause of the fire, past safety incidents and the refinery's non-compliance with permit requirements per an inspection report. The minister replied that responsibility for the Isla refinery lies with Curaçao, so he cannot answer the substantive questions, though he notes Curaçao has commissioned an inspection and audit and that the Netherlands stands ready to continue assistance on request.
Because responsibility for the Isla refinery rests with the country of Curaçao, the questions have not been answered individually.
Omdat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de Isla-raffinaderij bij het land Curaçao berust, zijn de vragen niet afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de olievervuiling aan de oostkust van Bonaire

An MP asked the ministers about oil pollution on Bonaire's east coast, its risks, frequency, economic effects, the adequacy of local capacity, spillover to other islands and existing regional cooperation. The minister answered that the tar balls posed limited risk, most oil was removed, local authorities were capable with Dutch support, and regional cooperation exists under the Cartagena Convention.
The public body Bonaire informed the population about this and took appropriate measures to prevent contact and ingestion.
Het openbaar lichaam Bonaire heeft de bevolking hierover geïnformeerd en passende maatregelen getroffen om contact en opname te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over schijnzelfstandigheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the government about alleged bogus self-employment among pilots at airlines with a Dutch base, citing VNV claims, the definition of 'home base', and comparisons with Germany. The government answered that the Tax Authority has adequate insight, that no labour-law violations were found, that the home-base definition does not affect the findings, and that no further investigation or talks with pilots are needed.
Furthermore, the inventory showed that there are no indications that labour legislation enforced under public law is being violated.
Verder is uit de inventarisatie gebleken dat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de arbeidswetgeving die publiekrechtelijk wordt gehandhaafd, wordt overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Van Helvert en Jetten over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen inzake de situatie op Schiphol

MPs Visser, Van Helvert and Jetten asked the state secretary about long queues at Schiphol airport, including slot allocation, KMar staffing, selectiveness policy and Lelystad. The government replied that Schiphol committed to fully staffing security lanes over summer, extra KMar capacity is planned, and most questions were answered with policy restatements and referrals to other bodies.
Soon I want to discuss in a follow-up meeting with Schiphol, KLM and BARIN which actions these parties can take to work towards a more structural solution in the medium term.
Binnenkort wil ik in een vervolggesprek met Schiphol, KLM en BARIN bespreken welke acties deze partijen kunnen nemen om op middellange termijn naar een meer structurele oplossing toe te werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat tientallen medewerkers van het asielzoekerscentrum Ter Apel al maanden thuiszitten

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked why only parts of the former NAVO terrain at the Ter Apel asylum centre were remediated, whether soil was tested when the centre was built, and whether COA, IND and other bodies should be ordered to carry out medical research into sick staff. The State Secretary answered that earlier soil studies found no health-relevant contamination, that a recent survey found none either, that COA has set up an independent commission, and that no broader medical study is currently planned.
For now I see no reason to instruct all other bodies working in or around the asylum centre to carry out such a study.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen aanleiding om alle andere instanties die werkzaam zijn in of rondom het asielzoekerscentrum op te dragen een dergelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.

Vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Von Martels (beiden CDA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht dat personeel in stads- en streekvervoer vaker slachtoffer van geweld is (ingezonden 29 me

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary whether rising violence against public transport staff (62% reporting an incident in 2016, up from 60% in 2014) and the failure of measures since 2016 meant more action was needed, including estimates of fare evasion losses and violence-related costs. The state secretary acknowledged the rise, pointed to the High Impact Crime action programme and a progress letter due autumn 2017, and said costs and lost revenue from fare evasion cannot be estimated.
It is still too early to draw conclusions about the effect of the measures and whether additional measures are needed.
Het is nu nog te vroeg om conclusies te trekken over het effect van de maatregelen en of aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Von Martels over berichten dat consumenten problemen met hun voertuig ondervinden na het toepassen van de software-update van Volkswagen

MPs Van Eijs and Von Martels asked whether the Volkswagen software update causes higher fuel use, power loss and EGR valve failures, whether EGR removal is adequately regulated, and how consumers are compensated. The minister replied that independent tests (KBA, RDW, TNO) found no negative effects on fuel use or power, that a ban on removing emission controls is being prepared, and that PON handles complaints individually while the recall is voluntary for consumers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over treinvertragingen door wangedrag

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary whether it is true that most train delays are caused by misconduct such as reckless behaviour, vandalism and bomb threats, what share of delays could be avoided, where such delays concentrate, and what is being done about track-trespassers and level-crossing offenders, including enforcement priority. The State Secretary confirmed the reports, explained that third-party disruptions account for 53% of disruptions (over half of which are trespassers), described prevention programmes and enforcement by ProRail inspectors, and promised an annual disruption report, while withholding the locations of high-risk sites for reasons of sensitivity.
ProRail however prefers, given the sensitivity of this issue, not to make these locations public.
ProRail geeft er echter, gelet op de gevoeligheid van deze problematiek, de voorkeur aan deze locaties niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Von Martels over de onveiligheid van conducteurs van NS

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary about conductors feeling unsafe in the evening, rising aggression figures, and what measures have been taken since 2015. The State Secretary answered that a dual-staffing measure is being implemented, a monitoring survey is planned, the WODC evaluation found it too early to draw conclusions, and an action programme (HIC-aanpak OV) with 23 measures is underway with a progress report promised for autumn 2017.
Together with NS I want to await the evaluation of this measure to see whether and what effect it has had.
Samen met NS wil ik de evaluatie van deze maatregel afwachten om te bezien of en welk effect deze heeft gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels, Ronnes, Omtzigt, Jetten en Van Weyenberg over het bericht in de Trouw van 4 mei 2017 “Staatsbedrijf NS ontwijkt fiscus weer”

MPs from CDA and D66 asked the government about reports that state-owned NS avoids Dutch tax via an Irish leasing subsidiary, including whether the 2015 agreements were honoured and how much tax is lost. The minister defended the arrangement as consistent with a 'level playing field' for foreign concessions, and refused to give tax figures citing secrecy rules and business confidentiality while promising phase-out of the Irish route on Dutch lines.

A more detailed specification of amounts I cannot give because under article 67 of the AWR I cannot make statements about the taxes of individual taxpayers, as business confidentiality precludes this.

Een nadere specificatie van bedragen kan ik niet geven omdat ik op grond van artikel 67 van de AWR geen uitspraken kan doen over de belastingen van individuele belastingplichtigen omdat bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid zich hiertegen verzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Laçin over de ICT-storing in het systeem van Amadeus waardoor overal ter wereld reserveringssystemen voor de luchtvaart uitvielen

MPs Hijink and Laçin asked about a worldwide Amadeus reservation system outage, its cause, possible data exposure, economic damage and cybersecurity safeguards. The government answered that a local hardware fault, not a hack, caused a brief outage with no data loss, and pointed to contractual arrangements and the forthcoming NIS directive implementation.
Resolving outages is of course the responsibility of the owner of the systems concerned, such as Amadeus.
Het verhelpen van storingen is uiteraard de verantwoordelijkheid van de eigenaar van desbetreffende systemen, zoals Amadeus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over berichten dat Duitsland en andere lidstaten in Europa verbetervoorstellen naar aanleiding van het dieselgateschandaal blokkeren

An MP from D66 asked the ministers whether Germany and other member states are blocking EU proposals to strengthen type-approval and market surveillance after the diesel emissions scandal, including EU retesting and fining powers, and what the Dutch position is. The ministers replied that negotiations are ongoing, the Dutch position broadly supports the Commission proposal with alternative methods, and they will report on RDW follow-up investigations and the D66 and European Parliament recommendations later.

To prevent a potential new diesel scandal, I am committed to strengthening the system of market surveillance of, and type approval for, motor vehicles and the uniform application of regulations throughout the EU.

Om een potentieel nieuw dieselschandaal te voorkomen zet ik me in voor versterking van het systeem van markttoezicht op – en typegoedkeuring van motorvoertuigen en de uniforme toepassing van de regelgeving in de gehele EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en De Boer over een gesprek met stakeholders uit de spoorsector d.d. 13 maart 2017

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about a stakeholder meeting on rail, the new method for ProRail's user charge (VMT and a planned levy), its effect on freight competitiveness versus Germany, and the costs of rail safety systems. The State Secretary answered at length, explaining the new methodology, the planned multi-year levy differentiated by market segment, efficiency steering of ProRail, and that a diesel tax is not planned, while deferring some figures to later publications.
With this I aim for transparency and stability of the tariffs.
Ik beoog hiermee transparantie en stabiliteit van de tarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Kerstens over de recycling van afgedankte smartphones

MPs Cegerek and Kerstens asked about recycling of discarded smartphones, Greenpeace's call on manufacturers, collection volumes, repair incentives, collection actions and the role of shops, recycling targets, and jobs. The state secretary answered that roughly half of about 900,000 discarded phones yearly are estimated to be recycled through certified channels, that existing producer collection and WEEE targets apply, and that circular-economy measures are under development, with a KPMG jobs study due in 2017.
No recent figures are known for this.
Hier zijn geen recente cijfers van bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat klimaatlasten oneerlijk zijn verdeeld

An SP MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether it is unfair that the poorest households bear relatively more of the costs of climate policy, and whether the government will ensure industry pays, protects low incomes and broadens public support. The minister acknowledged the regressive burden, pointed to the Energy Agenda, ETS strengthening, housing-corporation insulation rules and ongoing dialogue, but gave largely general answers without firm new commitments beyond a promised letter before summer.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will inform the House before the summer about the further elaboration and the investments required from housing corporations and their effects.

De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de verdere uitwerking en de daarvoor benodigde investeringen van corporaties en de effecten daarvan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het rapport "Are Belgium and the Netherlands in breach of their international obligations under the Basel Convention and customary international law due to their export of hi

Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) asked whether the Netherlands breaches Basel Convention, customary law and ESC rights by exporting high-sulfur fuels to Bamako Convention parties in Africa, and whether it will restrict such exports. Minister Ploumen answered that no Basel notifications of such fuels as hazardous waste exist, so no export ban is legally required, and that the government will pursue standards and industry engagement instead, while ILT increases inspection capacity.
Without notification under the Basel Convention, there is no obligation for the Netherlands under the Basel Convention to counter the export.
Zonder notificatie onder het Verdrag van Bazel bestaat er voor Nederland geen verplichting onder het Verdrag van Bazel om de export tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht 'Zuid-Holland wil lozingen Chemours in Merwede verminderen'

An MP asked the State Secretary about provincial plans to reduce Chemours' GenX discharges into the Merwede, the risks to drinking water and the RIVM assessment. The government answered that it supports the provincial reduction, that the permit includes research obligations, and that Rijkswaterstaat and the RIVM continue to advise on the risks.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de subsidiëring van fossiele energie

An MP asked the ministers about a European Parliament report claiming the Netherlands gave 10 billion USD in fossil fuel subsidies in 2015, asked for a ten-year breakdown of fossil and renewable subsidies, and asked whether the government would reduce emissions and meet climate commitments. The minister disputed that fossil fuels are subsidised in the Netherlands, listed only treaty-based excise exemptions and the degressive energy tax structure, gave renewable subsidy budgets for 2017 and 2023, and pointed to ETS and energy-transition paths without committing to new concrete measures.
Fossil fuels in the Netherlands, unlike renewable energy, are not subsidised, not even through fiscal measures.
Fossiele brandstoffen worden in Nederland, in tegenstelling tot hernieuwbare energie, niet gesubsidieerd, ook niet via fiscale maatregelen.
Antwoord op aanvullende vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de industrie niet daalt

An MP asked the ministers about reports that industrial CO2 emissions did not fall in 2016 and how this affects the Energy Agreement targets, including the 9 PJ industry energy-saving obligation. The government answered that it considers the agreed measures sufficient to meet all Energy Agreement targets and that an industry alternative to the 9 PJ obligation meets its conditions, with a fallback AMvB ready if needed.
For more information we refer to the letter from the Minister of Economic Affairs of 24 April.
Voor meer informatie verwijzen wij naar de brief van de Minister van Economische Zaken van 24 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Kröger over het bericht dat de CO2-uitstoot van de Nederlandse industrie in 2016 niet is gedaald

GroenLinks MPs Van der Lee and Kröger asked why industrial CO2 emissions stayed flat in 2016, whether this conflicts with the Urgenda ruling and Paris commitments, and whether ETS alone is insufficient so national measures are needed. Ministers Kamp and Dijksma attributed the flat figure to higher production and shifts in the power sector, agreed deep cuts are needed, and said the government is consulting industry on additional measures under the Energy Agenda.
Yes, as also indicated in the answers to the previous questions, the cabinet is in discussion with various societal parties and companies on the further elaboration of the Energy Agenda.
Ja, zoals ook aangegeven in de beantwoording van de voorgaande vragen is het kabinet in gesprek met diverse maatschappelijke partijen en bedrijven over de verdere uitwerking van de Energieagenda.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over duurzaamheidscriteria voor biomassa

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked whether coal plant operators and other Energieakkoord parties still lack agreement on biomass sustainability criteria, whether RWE will co-fire biomass at AMER9 and whether SDE+ subsidies for co-firing with non-FSC-equivalent certificates are permitted. The minister replied that agreement was reached in 2015, only implementation talks remain, a transitional reporting regime applies, and an independent advisory committee will assess certificates, with its composition to be announced soon.
An independent advisory committee will advise me on the extent to which certificates meet the Dutch sustainability criteria after the transitional regime.
Een onafhankelijke adviescommissie zal mij gaan adviseren in hoeverre certificaten na het overgangsregime voldoen aan de Nederlandse duurzaamheidscriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Van Helvert over de berichtgeving over Schiphol

Visser (VVD) and Van Helvert (CDA) asked the State Secretary about reports of queues, baggage, gate and runway capacity problems at Schiphol, KLM's concerns, the selectivity policy and the ongoing growth debate. The State Secretary answered that a meeting with Schiphol, KLM and BARIN led to agreed opening of security lanes in summer 2017, that the government is coordinating border-control measures, and that the selectivity policy and the MER/safety analysis on growth beyond 2020 are in progress.
On 8 May I held a meeting with the CEO of Schiphol, the CEO of KLM and the chair of BARIN about the situation that has arisen.

Ik heb 8 mei jl. een gesprek gevoerd met de president-directeur van Schiphol, de president-directeur van KLM en de voorzitter van de Board of Airline Representatives In the Netherlands (BARIN) over de ontstane situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Amhaouch over het opleiden van asbestsaneerders en het plan van aanpak asbestsanering

MPs Geurts and Amhaouch (CDA) asked whether there are enough certified asbestos removers to clear all asbestos roofs by 2024, how many roofs remain, how many certified workers exist and how many were trained, and whether asbestos awareness should be built into basic construction training. The State Secretary answers that the 2024 deadline is feasible if work is spread over years, that about 100 million m2 of asbestos roof remains, that certified worker numbers rose sharply since 2013, and that asbestos is not a standard part of vocational construction curricula but schools can choose to address it, with no additional funding planned.
It is unknown in what percentage of all rental homes and public buildings asbestos-containing applications are still present.
Het is onbekend in hoeveel procent van alle huurwoningen en openbare gebouwen nog asbesthoudende toepassingen aanwezig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bisschop over de aangescherpte regels voor gebruik van hoogwerkers bij asbestsanering

MPs Dijkgraaf and Bisschop asked whether the Inspectorate's stricter rules on aerial work platforms in asbestos removal make roof replacement impractical, and what support will be given. The minister replied that the rules were clarified in a brochure rather than tightened, that the existing exemption for occasional use remains available, and that a programmatic approach with financing options is being developed.
However, there is no question of tightening the rules.
Er is evenwel geen sprake van aanscherping van de regels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Ten Broeke over vliegen boven conflictgebieden

MPs Visser and Ten Broeke asked the State Secretary about aviation over conflict zones, including ICAO measures, information sharing, the Ten Broeke motion on safety management certification, and airspace closure powers. The State Secretary answered that ICAO has adopted measures with implementation timelines, that a convenant on threat information sharing works well with a formal evaluation planned, and that the government is pushing for further ICAO and EU rules.
As laid down in the Convenant, a formal evaluation will take place this year before the summer.
Zoals in het Convenant is vastgelegd vindt een formele evaluatie dit jaar voor de zomer plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat treinen vaker stilvallen

An MP asked the state secretary whether rising train breakdowns on NS are caused by more trains, and about economic damage, NS's performance and new Flirt trains. The state secretary answered that the share of cancelled trains rose on the main rail network but fell on the HSL, attributed the increase largely to the new Den Haag-Breda service and Flirt introduction problems, and said an improvement programme with ProRail is underway.
No research is available on the economic damage of trains that stop running.
Er is geen onderzoek beschikbaar naar economische schade van stilvallende treinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Visser over het bericht ‘Meer fijnstof achter het fornuis dan langs de snelweg’

MPs Dijkstra and Visser asked the State Secretary about a TNO study showing indoor fine-particle peaks from cooking that exceed outdoor levels, and about its representativeness, health implications, follow-up research and fit with the national air quality programme. The government answered that the study covers only nine homes, that indoor peaks are not covered by outdoor norms, that TNO and TKI Urban Energy research is underway, and that indoor ventilation rules in the Bouwbesluit apply.
TNO has indicated that an exploratory study will be carried out next year to determine emission factors for cooking meals.
TNO heeft laten weten dat er komend jaar een verkennende studie wordt gedaan naar bepaling van emissiefactoren van het koken van maaltijden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en De Boer over de doorverkoop van de Fyra’s aan een andere vervoerder

MPs Aukje de Vries and De Boer asked whether reported resale of the Fyra trains to Trenitalia was accurate, whether AnsaldoBreda had contacted the minister, and what compensation NS and the state would receive. The minister replied that no sale has yet occurred, that NS is not party to any resale contract, and that NS would receive up to EUR 3.5 million per train if resale succeeds, with the proceeds going to NS profit rather than the state.
If there is an actual sale, NS will be informed of it by AnsaldoBreda/Finmeccanica under this agreement, and NS will inform me of it.
Ingeval er sprake is van een daadwerkelijke verkoop, zal NS hierover conform deze overeenkomst door AnsaldoBreda/Finmeccanica op de hoogte worden gesteld en zal NS mij hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de monitoring van klimaat in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about the continuity of greenhouse gas measurements at the CESAR climate observatory in Cabauw, which were reportedly threatened with defunding. The secretary replied that the measurements will continue, that funding was secured through 2018 and a 2017 shortfall was covered, and that talks are underway to continue them after 2018.

I consider it important that the amount of greenhouse gases in the Netherlands is measured, therefore I will engage in discussions with the parties concerned to ensure these measurements continue after 2018.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat de hoeveelheid broeikasgassen in Nederland wordt gemeten, daarom ga ik met de betreffende partijen in gesprek om ervoor te zorgen dat deze metingen ook na 2018 worden voortgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over vervoer van doelgroepen in het openbaar vervoer, naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan een vervoerder d.d. 15 maart jl.

An MP asked the state secretary how Translink Systems is owned, whether new carriers can join its cooperative and the OV-chipkaart system, and whether paratransit (doelgroepenvervoer) should be integrated into it. The secretary answered that the cooperative is owned by public transport companies and membership requires a concession, that the OV-chipkaart is not used for contract-based paratransit, and that experiments combining the two will start, with ACM to advise on market regulation by end 2017.
Membership of the cooperative is only possible when holding a valid concession as referred to in the Passenger Transport Act 2000.
Het lidmaatschap van de coöperatie is enkel mogelijk bij het hebben van een geldige concessie als bedoeld in de Wet Personenvervoer 2000.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan de vereniging RONA in Overijssel en Gelderland op 20 februari jongstleden

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about freight train rerouting over Oost-Nederland lines, transparency on hazardous goods, calamity responsibilities, noise measures and quieter rolling stock. The State Secretary answered that rerouting raises freight trains from about 23 to 32 per day, that hazardous goods data is available to emergency services, that noise dampers and wagon bonuses are in place or planned, and that no extra funding is needed.
I endorse the importance of transparent information provision.
Ik onderschrijf het belang van transparante informatievoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het alternatief “Vaargeul Walvischstaart” voor de ontpoldering van de Hedwigepolder

An MP asks the minister about the 'Vaargeul Walvischstaart' alternative to the Hedwigepolder de-poldering, including a report by a nautical adviser and whether the idea was discussed at the ministry. The minister says the studies and report are not known to him, that Rijkswaterstaat judged rerouting the channel unnecessary and risky, and sees no need for further research.
Rijkswaterstaat indicated at the time that rerouting the shipping route from Oostgat to Walvischstaart was not necessary from a nautical safety perspective.
Door Rijkswaterstaat is destijds aangegeven dat een vaarrouteverlegging van Oostgat naar Walvischstaart vanuit het oogpunt van nautische veiligheid niet noodzakelijk was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat NS dreigt met afbraakbeleid tweede KLM te worden

MP Smaling asks whether NS's plan to divest its shop and retail activities, and withdraw from regional rail tenders, is justified, and how it affects staff, dividends, station offerings and political pressure. Minister Dijsselbloem answers that the strategy is NS's responsibility, that shop activities are profitable but profit figures are confidential, that dividends are expected to stay stable, and that no political pressure was applied, while declining to give some financial details.
Information on the amount of profit per business unit is commercially confidential and for that reason cannot be provided.
Informatie over de omvang van de winst bij bedrijfsonderdelen is bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kan om die reden niet verstrekt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht 'Europa dumpt nog steeds schepen op Aziatische sloopstranden'

An MP asked the ministers whether EU-flagged ships are still dumped on Asian beaches, about Dutch participation, the IMVO covenant with the shipping association, and ratification of the Hong Kong Convention. The government rejects the practice, reports a covenant aimed for this year, and says ratification will follow parliamentary approval of the treaty.
Het kabinet keurt deze praktijk af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat er nog steeds Europese schepen op Aziatische sloopstranden belanden

An SP MP asked the government how it responds to reports that European ships are still dumped on Asian breaking beaches, why the Hong Kong Convention is not yet ratified, how Dutch shipowners are obliged to ensure responsible scrapping, and whether it will agree hard sector agreements with the KVNR. The government condemns the practice, points to EU waste rules requiring prior consent for recycling, refers to ongoing IMVO talks with the KVNR and an expected covenant this year, and refers to earlier answers on the convention.
The cabinet is in talks with the KVNR within the framework of agreements on International Corporate Social Responsibility.
Het kabinet is in gesprek met de KVNR in het kader van de afspraken over Internationaal Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de tekortkomingen bij Brzo-bedrijven (bedrijven die vallen onder het Besluit risico's zware ongevallen)

An MP asked the state secretary about shortcomings at Brzo major-hazard companies following an Onderzoeksraad report on the Odfjell case, including fragmented supervision, uptake of audit tools, supply-chain checks, and publication of inspection reports. The state secretary welcomed the report, pointed to improvements in coordination and voluntary safety-culture measures, and promised to consult all parties and inform the House before summer.
I will therefore consult with all the parties involved about the conclusions of this investigation and the follow-up to this (follow-up) investigation.
Ik ga daarom met alle betrokken partijen in overleg over de conclusies van dit onderzoek en de opvolging van dit (vervolg) onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de prestaties van NS

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about NS missing its performance norms for capacity for the second time, whether fines would be passed on to fares, what steps would be taken, and whether crowded trains push people to cars. The State Secretary said fines cannot be passed on to fare prices under the concession, will be placed in a travellers' fund, that she will inform parliament on her assessment of the 2016 performance report, and that NS and ProRail are taking capacity measures, though answers largely restate existing policy.
I will inform your House within the foreseeable future of my judgement on this and of how I enforce the performance agreements with NS.
Ik zal uw Kamer binnen afzienbare tijd informeren over mijn oordeel hierover en de wijze waarop ik de prestatieafspraken met NS handhaaf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-de Haan en De Boer over het besluit van de Belgische regering om te investeren in het spoortraject Antwerpen-Weert

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary about Belgium's plans to electrify the Antwerp–Weert rail line, its CEF funding application, cost-benefit analysis, Brabant route relief, and a possible 4 million euro national contribution. The state secretary answered that Belgian federal decision-making is pending, no Dutch financing is involved, no cost-benefit analysis is yet available, the existing line has sufficient capacity, and electrification is not a national priority so no infrastructure fund reservation is appropriate.
I therefore conclude that electrification of the route is not a national priority.
Ik constateer daarmee dat elektrificatie van het tracé geen nationale prioriteit heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer, Van Oosten en Van der Linde over de viersporigheid van het treinverkeer tussen Rotterdam en Schiedam n.a.v. een werkbezoek op 23 januari jl.

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about keeping intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum and the four-track option between Rotterdam and Schiedam after a site visit. The State Secretary answered that the intercity stop may be kept only if four tracks are built and a study is ongoing, with no negotiations started and no Schiedam Kethel study reopened.
The study commissioned by the MRDH and carried out by ProRail shows that with PHS the existing Intercity stop by the Amsterdam-The Hague-Rotterdam-Dordrecht/Vlissingen service cannot be maintained.

Uit het onderzoek, dat in opdracht van de MRDH door ProRail is uitgevoerd, blijkt dat met PHS de bestaande Intercity-stop door de Intercitydienst Amsterdam-Den Haag-Rotterdam-Dordrecht/Vlissingen niet kan worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van ’t Wout en De Boer over de veiligheid en leefbaarheid langs het goederenspoor in de gemeenten Moerdijk, Halderberge en Roosendaal

MPs Van 't Wout and De Boer asked about noise and safety from freight trains in Moerdijk, Halderberge and Roosendaal, and why sleepers and rail dampers are not being installed sooner. The Secretary of State answered that sleeper replacement runs to 2019 but cannot be accelerated within available track-free periods, that noise-reduction measures will be prioritised in 2018 under the MJPG, and that slower train speeds results are expected in autumn.
I expect to be able to share the results of this exploration next autumn.
Ik verwacht komend najaar resultaten van deze verkenning te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over rolstoeltoegankelijkheid van treinen

Mr Van Helvert (CDA) asked the state secretaries about the wheelchair accessibility of trains after a TV report, including the number of stations without assistance, the risk of worsening access before 2024/2030, and whether timelines can be shortened. The state secretary rejected the report's conclusion as too one-sided, cited planned extra assistance stations and new accessible trains, and said the timelines are already near what is feasible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling, Dik-Faber, Remco Dijkstra, Ouwehand, Cegerek, Van Veldhoven, Van Tongeren en Geurts over het bericht dat chemiebedrijven de veiligheidsregels schenden

MPs asked the state secretary how to respond to reports that more than half of Dutch major-risk chemical firms repeatedly violated safety rules, including risks to workers and residents in Zaltbommel and how inspections and enforcement work. The state secretary replied that violations fell from 850 to 615 in 2015, that most are light offences, that inspectors act immediately on serious ones, that Zaltbommel is being handled through a planning and permit process, and that repeat offenders face escalated sanctions.
As previously promised, I will send the State of Safety of Major Risk Companies report for 2016 to your House before the summer, including an analysis of regional differences in compliance rates.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, zal ik de Staat van de Veiligheid Majeure Risicobedrijven over 2016 voor de zomer naar uw Kamer sturen inclusief een analyse van regionale verschillen in naleefpercentages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de aanhoudende stremmingen door te hoge vrachtwagens in de Coentunnel

An MP asked the minister about repeated closures of the Coentunnel caused by overheight trucks, including the number of height reports, economic damage, and whether further measures will be taken. The minister reports 1,185 height reports in 2016, a slight decline, describes ongoing Rijkswaterstaat measures such as signage and industry outreach, and says no further measures are planned beyond the ongoing pilot and dialogue with the sector.
Rijkswaterstaat does not have current calculations of economic damage.
Rijkswaterstaat beschikt niet over actuele berekeningen van economische schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over actie tegen afvalcriminaliteit

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment and the Minister of Security and Justice how waste crime by illegal dumpers is being tackled, including reinstating financial security deposits and escrow accounts. The government says it supports the polluter-pays principle, points to existing enforcement and prosecution tools, is willing to consult provinces and waste sector, but sees no reason yet to reintroduce financial security for these firms and considers escrow measures unsuitable.
Naturally I am willing to take measures if that helps to tackle the problem better, but for now I see no reason to reintroduce financial security for this type of company.

Vanzelfsprekend ben ik bereid om maatregelen te treffen als dat helpt om de problematiek nog beter aan te kunnen pakken, maar vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om financiële zekerheid voor dit type bedrijven opnieuw in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Albert de Vries over de inventarisatie van asbestdaken

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about gaps in municipal inventories of asbestos roofs and what this means for the 2024 removal deadline. The state secretary answered that removal is primarily the owner's responsibility, that municipalities decide whether an inventory is needed, and outlined a programmatic approach with communication tools and financing exploration.
It is not expected that all municipalities will have an asbestos inventory carried out.
Het is niet de verwachting dat alle gemeenten een asbestinventarisatie laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Veel grote gemeenten weten niet waar asbestdaken liggen’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether municipalities know where asbestos roofs are and how removal will be supported before 2023, including for homeowners who cannot afford removal. The State Secretary answered that removal is primarily the owner's responsibility, that municipalities decide whether to map asbestos roofs, and that a programmatic approach with financing arrangements and communication tools is underway, with a progress letter promised before summer.
From 2024 the decentralised government is responsible for enforcing the asbestos roof ban.
De decentrale overheid is vanaf 2024 verantwoordelijk voor het handhaven van het asbestdakenverbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling inzake de ‘asbestpaniek’ bij bewoners in Landsmeer

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about asbestos found in homes in Landsmeer, including whether inventory and air/tape sampling followed the rules, why residents were informed late, whether exposure is being studied, and the renovation plan. The government answered that asbestos was found in 31 attic spaces, no free fibres exceeded norms, communication was timely, no exposure study is planned, and attic remediation has started with a renovation plan due in April 2017.
It is very understandable that residents are alarmed by an asbestos finding in their home and worry about it.
Het is zeer begrijpelijk dat bewoners schrikken van een asbestvondst in hun woning en zich daarover zorgen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over een ZEMBLA-uitzending over de gezondheidseffecten van rubbergranulaat

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Health and the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment whether a ZEMBLA broadcast on health effects of rubber granulate on sports pitches warranted new measures or a different RIVM advice, and how the tyre industry's norm compares to EU and RIVM norms. The minister answered that the broadcast does not change RIVM's advice that safe use of the pitches is possible, that RIVM will consider the unpublished study once published, and that the industry norm is stricter than the existing EU limits while the government aims to lower it further.
As long as it is not known which substances in which concentrations were found by the VU, RIVM cannot make a statement
Zolang niet bekend is welke stoffen in welke concentraties door de VU zijn aangetroffen, kan het RIVM geen uitspraak doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Hoge NS bazen kregen half miljoen oprotpremie’

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked whether the government approved and knew the reasons for severance payments of about EUR 600,000 to two NS managers, and whether these were linked to the Limburg tender irregularities. The minister answered that NS restructured its top structure, that the board needs no approval for non-board severance, that the departures are unrelated to Limburg, and declined to share supervisory board minutes.
I do not have access to the minutes of the meetings of the supervisory board.
Ik heb geen beschikking over de verslagen van de vergaderingen van de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Tongeren over de ‘bijna ramp’ en illegale oliepraktijken voor de Nederlandse kust

MPs Van Veldhoven and Van Tongeren asked about a near-disaster involving chemical processing on the tanker Franz Schulte off Scheveningen and whether inspectorates can detect such illegal practices. The minister said the ILT found no violations since the 2014 SOLAS ban, that it is considering joint checks with other inspection services, and that international action depends on further information.
Based on inspections of ships in ports, the ILT has found no violations of the ban on chemical processing during sea voyages since 1 January 2014.
Op basis van controles aan boord van schepen in havens heeft de ILT sinds 1 januari 2014 geen overtredingen van het verbod op chemische bewerkingen gedurende zeereizen vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser, Nijkerken-De Haan en De Boer over een werkbezoek aan de provincie Limburg d.d. 6 februari 2017

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary about commitments on a rail connection and Carhandling Terminal Swentibold in Limburg, including the status of studies, ProRail's cost validation, provincial guarantees and whether national funding would be provided. The state secretary confirmed the agreements, said the connection now costs about EUR 40 million rather than EUR 20 million, and offered up to EUR 10 million in national funding (EUR 5 million each from the ministries) subject to conditions such as public access, job effects, a one-off contribution and a validated business case.
It has been agreed that the definitive cost estimate for the public connection of this rail terminal will be validated by ProRail according to the standard requirements.
Afgesproken is dat de definitieve kostenraming van de openbare aansluiting van deze railterminal door ProRail zal worden getoetst conform de standaard eisen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de voorgenomen zeer lage aanvliegroutes met veel geluidsoverlast in Overijssel naar vliegveld Lelystad

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked the State Secretary about very low approach routes over Overijssel to Lelystad airport causing noise nuisance, including route maps, the scope of the environmental impact assessment, and provincial representation at the Alderstafel. The State Secretary answered that the routes follow the agreed 6,000 ft and 3,000 ft heights, that low flying is limited to exceptional cases, that no new MER is needed, and that she will explore optimisations with LVNL and CLSK.
For the south-eastern approach route over Overijssel, this means traffic to Lelystad enters Dutch airspace well above 6,000 feet over Twente.
Voor de zuidoostelijke naderingsroute over Overijssel betekent dit, dat verkeer naar Lelystad boven Twente aanzienlijk hoger dan 6.000 voet het Nederlandse luchtruim binnenkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Hoe de lobby het rubber in het gras hield'

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked about press reports on industry lobbying over rubber granulate in artificial turf and whether the Netherlands shifted from treating it as an article to a mixture under REACH. The government answered that it reversed its position to align with the European Commission and most member states, that the health risk to sports users was judged low, and that it did not commit to a new national action beyond pursuing a lower EU norm.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Smaling over het bericht 'OV-kaart is geldmachine'

MP Smaling (SP) asked the state secretary about reports that the OV-chipkaart is a money machine, including whether Translink's profits should lower card costs, why the Translink director's pay exceeds the Wet normering topinkomens, and where profits go. The state secretary said a company should recoup investments, that a decision on card price and lifespan will come from the Nationaal OV Beraad before summer, that the topincome law does not apply because Translink is wholly owned by the COV, and referred back to the earlier answer on profit use.
Before summer the Nationaal OV Beraad will come with its decision on this.
Voor de zomer komt het Nationaal OV Beraad met haar besluit hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat de ov-chipkaart een geldmachine is

An MP asked whether the €7.50 price of the OV-chipkaart is still justified, whether Translink's profits should flow back to travellers, and whether card prices should fall drastically. The state secretary said profits should benefit travellers, that a company may recover its investments within the rules, that ACM is conducting an exploratory study, and that card costs and lifespan will be reviewed together before summer.
The National OV Council recently decided to examine the question of OV-chipkaart purchase costs and innovations in OV payment together before the summer.
In het Nationaal OV Beraad is recent besloten om de vraag naar aanschafkosten van de OV-chipkaart en innovaties in het OV-betalen voor de zomer in samenhang te bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de asbestproblematiek

An MP asked the state secretary about asbestos risks, including protection of homeowners removing small asbestos roofs, contaminated soil in Harderwijk, asbestos in drinking water pipes, talc and gemstones, mineral wool and nanomaterials, enforcement by environmental services, mandatory asbestos inventories for schools and hospitals, and enforcement of removal and imports. The state secretary answered that information will be provided to citizens via Milieu Centraal, that no further research is deemed necessary on several points, that the ILT will warn buyers of asbestos gemstones and inspect sellers, and that enforcement responsibilities lie with municipalities, the police and the ILT.

I have committed to inform your House that, in addition to communication on asbestos roofs under the programmatic approach, private individuals will also be informed about the safe and responsible removal of asbestos.

Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd in aanvulling op communicatie over asbestdaken in het kader van de programmatische aanpak ook particulieren te informeren over het veilig en verantwoord verwijderen van asbest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat vrachtautochauffeurs hun wagen uitrusten met apparatuur om uitstoot te verdoezelen

Member Smaling (SP) asked about reports that truck drivers fit devices to switch off AdBlue systems, hiding excess NOx emissions, and asked how widespread this is and what will be done. The State Secretary condemns the practice, estimates that manipulated trucks emit roughly Euro-I levels of NOx, says the number of affected trucks on Dutch roads is unknown, and commits to studying enforcement options with TNO and ECN and reporting back.
I am currently in discussion with TNO and ECN about roadside inspection options for switching off AdBlue systems.
Ik ben momenteel met TNO en ECN in gesprek over controlemogelijkheden langs de weg voor het afschakelen van AdBlue-systemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins inzake de aanpak van geluidhinder langs het spoor

An ChristenUnie MP asked how the roughly four million euro estimate for tackling booggeluid (curve noise) near the rail was calculated and how the most urgent locations would be addressed. The State Secretary explained the cost is based on existing SSCS installations, that ProRail has been asked to proceed but a formal tender is required, and that installation is expected in 2018.
ProRail expects the SSCS units can be installed in 2018.
ProRail verwacht dat de SSCS-sen in 2018 kunnen worden geplaatst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het bericht dat de ontwikkeling van moderne communicatie richting omwonenden Schiphol vastloopt

An MP asks why a promised modern social-media strategy and smartphone app giving residents near Schiphol real-time flight information has not materialised a year after the Belhaj motion, and whether funding is the bottleneck. The State Secretary replies that a stakeholder taskforce adopted a strategy in September 2016, that the app development has been ordered with a EUR 75,000 contribution, and that progress will be reported to the Chamber before summer.
On the progress regarding delivery of the mobile application under development, I will inform the Chamber before the summer.
Over de voortgang met betrekking tot de oplevering van de in ontwikkeling zijnde mobiele applicatie zal ik de Kamer voor de zomer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over aanhoudende problemen met de Intercity Direct en het stranden van reizigers in een donkere tunnel

MP Smaling asks the state secretary about a two-hour stranding of Intercity Direct passengers in a dark tunnel, compensation, rising cancellations and delays on the HSL corridor, the new Breda–Den Haag service, and whether the Traxx locomotive supplier can be held responsible. The secretary answers that NS and ProRail evacuated passengers within the ILT's two-hour norm (last passengers after 2h47m), that GTBV compensation and assistance are sufficient, that cancellations rose from 5.1% to 10.1% between October and January, and that an improvement programme and a 60 million euro infrastructure reserve are in place, while declining to assign responsibility to the manufacturer beyond ongoing warranty and repair processes.
I will continue to closely monitor this.
Ik zal dit scherp blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over vorderingen rondom mobiel bereik in tunnels

MPs Hoogland and Oosenbrug asked about progress on mobile coverage in tunnels, including how new tunnel standards, tender specifications, provider cooperation and the Ketheltunnel and Blankenburg projects are handled. The minister answers that coverage is being facilitated through updated standards and provider agreements, with providers responsible for funding and installation, and that no Building Decree change is planned.
I will inform your House in the second half of the year about the results of this inventory of mobile accessibility in existing tunnels.
Ik zal uw kamer in de tweede helft van het jaar over de resultaten van deze inventarisatie van mobiele bereikbaarheid in bestaande tunnels informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Belhaj over de berichten over de situatie bij de luchtvaartmaatschappij Insel Air

MPs Belhaj and Pechtold asked the government about safety concerns and the financial crisis at Insel Air, the Caribbean airline, including why action came late, why civil servants were barred from flying with it, and what happens to connectivity if it fails. The State Secretary answered that signals were received late 2016, inspections by ILT and cooperation with Curaçao and Aruba followed, a travel precaution for civil servants was adopted, and an expert group on regional connectivity was set up.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht “Vliegers Air France KLM op ramkoers”

MP Smaling asked the state secretary about reports of a dispute between Air France and KLM pilots over productivity, whether existing government agreements with Air France-KLM still hold, and whether a pilot deal could harm KLM growth and jobs. The state secretary replied that the pilots' dispute is a matter between Air France and French unions, that the agreements remain in force, that no deal is known that would conflict with them, and that the Perform 2020 strategy of growth through productivity has not changed.
I have no indication that an agreement with the Air France pilots is forthcoming that could potentially conflict with the agreements the Dutch government has made with Air France KLM.

Ik heb geen enkele indicatie dat er een overeenkomst met de Air France piloten op komst is die mogelijk in strijd zou zijn met de afspraken die de Nederlandse overheid met Air France KLM heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over problemen op het spoor na invoering van de nieuwe dienstregeling

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about rail disruptions on three routes after the new timetable, including subsidence on the Utrecht-Leiden line, a financing dispute with the province, and overcrowding. The State Secretary answered that the disruptions were mostly unrelated to the new timetable, denied the subsidence claim, said no extra track is currently planned, and pointed to performance agreements with NS and ProRail and a pending enforcement decision on overcrowding.
With NS and ProRail I have made clear agreements on operational performance across the entire rail network.
Met NS en ProRail heb ik duidelijke afspraken gemaakt over de operationele prestaties op het gehele spoornetwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de spoorcapaciteitsverdeling ten tijde van de problemen met de Moerdijkbrug

An MP asked the state secretary about the ACM finding that ProRail treated rail freight operators unequally when closing the Moerdijk bridge in April 2016 and whether the minister would act against ProRail and prevent future discrimination. The state secretary regretted the inadequate consultation, said ProRail promised better communication, and declined further action because the ACM as supervisor has already ruled and ProRail is complying.
ProRail has assured me that it will in future involve all rail users with capacity rights in good time in decisions on planning track closures.
ProRail heeft mij verzekerd voortaan alle spoorgebruikers met capaciteitsrechten tijdig te betrekken bij besluitvorming over de planning van buitendienststellingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de vernietiging van in beslag genomen nep-kleding

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked the ministers whether seized counterfeit clothing is destroyed, who decides, and whether a central record exists and destruction can favour circular recycling. The minister answered that counterfeit goods are destroyed under the Criminal Procedure Code, that a central seizure portal exists but has gaps with implementation planned for 2018, and that destroyed materials can be recycled where possible.
This cross-chain central ICT system still has shortcomings.
Dit ketenoverstijgende centraal ICT-systeem kent nog onvolkomenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Afnemer wil rechtszekerheid’

Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary about criticism that businesses lack legal certainty on whether residual streams are waste, and about the Helpdesk Afvalbeheer and possible reversal of the burden of proof. The State Secretary answered that interpretation differences exist, pointed to ministerial rules, legal opinions and LAP3 as clarification tools, denied the helpdesk problems, and said the burden of proof rests partly on companies.
I am continuously working on improving quality at the helpdesk, among other things through customer satisfaction surveys.
Ik werk doorlopend aan kwaliteitsverbetering bij de helpdesk, ondermeer met behulp van klanttevredenheidsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Volp en Hoogland over de toegankelijkheid van treinen en treinstations

Two PvdA MPs asked the state secretaries about worsened train accessibility for wheelchair users at Zevenbergen and Lage Zwaluwe stations and related planning. The government acknowledged the problem, explained that new SLT-to-other-rolling-stock deployment and platform-height timelines cause it, and committed to further accessibility measures and travel information.
ProRail's programme to bring all platforms to the correct height runs until 2030.
Het programma van Prorail om alle perrons op de goede hoogte te brengen loopt tot 2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over de berichten ‘O’Leary: Ryanair-vliegtickets worden gratis’ en ‘Zwijg of je vliegt eruit’

PvdA MPs asked the government about reports that Ryanair's chief executive said the airline's low fares rest on paying pilots very little, and about pay-to-fly contracts, safety risks and possible sham employment arrangements. The government answered that it opposes poor pay and unfair competition, is working at EU level on pay-to-fly and fatigue rules, joins court cases and investigates cabin crew, but cannot comment on individual taxpayers.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents the Tax Authority from making statements about individual taxpayers.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen belet het de Belastingdienst om uitspraken te doen over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de uitval van spitstreinen

CDA MP Van Helvert asked the State Secretary about the high cancellation rate of extra peak trains and the number of passengers affected, and whether NS and ProRail measure punctuality consistently. The State Secretary answered that extra peak trains are cancelled more often because they are the first to be dropped during disruptions, that 6.5% were cancelled in 2016 versus 1.8% overall, and that punctuality thresholds have been aligned from 2017 while she awaits NS's formal accountability report before judging performance.
I am awaiting this formal accountability with final figures before forming a judgement on performance on the main rail network.
Ik wacht deze formele verantwoording met definitieve cijfers af voordat ik mij een oordeel vorm over de prestaties op het hoofdrailnet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over de compensatie van emissierechten

An MP asked whether the state's roughly 89 million euro in indirect ETS emissions-cost subsidies, paid to firms that already receive free allowances, amounts to a double benefit and weakens carbon pricing incentives, and whether the ECB could buy ETS allowances. The minister answered that the subsidy compensates competitive disadvantage from electricity costs, is budgetarily separate from auction revenue, and that ECB purchases of allowances fall outside its mandate, while committing to pursue ETS strengthening via EU negotiations.
However, these subsidy expenditures are budgetarily decoupled from the revenue from the auction of emission allowances.
Deze subsidie-uitgaven zijn echter budgettair losgekoppeld van de inkomsten uit de veiling van emissierechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de bedragen die nog op verlopen OV-chipkaarten staan

An MP asked the state secretary about roughly 5 million euro left on expired OV-chipkaarten and what can be done to make refunds easier. The state secretary said about 5 million euro cannot be traced to holders, committed to scrapping the 1 euro counter fee and proactive refunds, and said the remaining balances are parked in a risk-free bank account.
I agreed this today in the National OV Council (NOVB).
Dit heb ik vandaag in het Nationaal OV Beraad (NOVB) afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jan Vos over de toenemende drukte op Schiphol en de overlast die dat oplevert voor de omgeving

MPs Leenders and Jan Vos asked the State Secretary about Schiphol nearing its 500,000 flight-movement cap, rising noise complaints from Bussum, low-altitude climb practices, ultrafine particles, and whether surrounding municipalities outside the Omgevingsraad Schiphol are heard. The State Secretary answered that the 50/50 rule and any new caps require agreement with the community, that complaints come from a stable number of about 24 residents per year, that noise stays well within legal limits, and that research on ultrafine particles is ongoing.
The agreed volume ceilings are not sacred, provided new agreements are made in good consultation with the surroundings.
De afgesproken volumeplafonds zijn niet heilig, mits er in goed overleg met de omgeving nieuwe afspraken worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Cegerek over het bericht 'Drie Chinezen blijven over in strijd om Attero'

MPs Nijboer and Cegerek asked about the 2013 sale of waste processor Attero to private equity firm Waterland, including dividends, environmental aftercare obligations and whether the sale price was too low. The state secretary answered that competition supervision applies as for any concentration, environmental aftercare is handled by the provinces, the sale was a decentralised decision, and a Zuidelijke Rekenkamer inquiry is due in May 2017.
The agreements form part of the confidential sale agreement.
De afspraken zijn onderdeel van de vertrouwelijke verkoopovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt en Ronnes over de rol die de Raad van Commissarissen van NS gespeeld heeft bij de fraude bij de aanbesteding in Limburg

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt and Ronnes asked the Finance Minister about the role of NS's supervisory board in the Limburg tender fraud, including when he learned of it, access to board minutes, discharge granted for 2014 and 2015, and damage claims. The minister answered that he was informed in April 2015 by the supervisory board, denied knowledge of board incitement to crimes, refused to release board and shareholder meeting minutes, and pointed to ongoing court and regulatory proceedings.
It is also not usual for such reports to be shared with the general meeting of shareholders.
Het is ook niet gebruikelijk dat dergelijke verslagen met de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de gevolgen van vislood op mens en milieu

An SP MP asked the state secretary about the health and environmental effects of fishing lead, citing claims that far more lead enters the water than assumed. The state secretary relied on Deltares 2013 estimates, said a Green Deal with stakeholders is being developed first, and would only examine a ban if voluntary agreements fail.
My first priority is to reach voluntary agreements in the Green Deal.
Mijn eerste inzet is gericht op het maken van vrijwillige afspraken in de Green Deal.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over het bericht ‘Maak nieuwe regels voor kunstgraskorrels’

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether artificial turf rubber granules should fall under stricter consumer PAH limits, and whether a special norm closer to the consumer standard should be set after consulting industry and RIVM. The government answered that EU REACH treats granules as a mixture with a looser limit, that it will push at EU level to lower the limit toward the consumer standard, and that it will continue talks with industry.
The cabinet aims for a source-based approach, in this case the cleanest possible car tyres.
Het kabinet streeft naar een aanpak aan de bron, in dit geval naar zo schoon mogelijke autobanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht “Vliegveld Lelystad wordt Lelystad-Zwolle Airport”

An MP asks whether the Secretary of State will engage Schiphol Group and regional authorities to strengthen Lelystad Airport's support for the Zwolle region and examine long-term infrastructure improvements. The government answers that regional consultation tables already exist, that the A6 and public transport upgrades have been agreed, and that the choice of the airport's regional role rests with regional authorities.
Where possible, I will support this process in the future.
Waar mogelijk zal ik dit proces in de toekomst ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de verzelfstandiging van de onderhoudsdivisie van AirFrance-KLM van de baan is

MP Smaling asked whether the spin-off of AirFrance-KLM's maintenance division is off the table and whether its independence under KLM is guaranteed. The state secretary confirmed Air France KLM dropped the planned study, stated no concrete plans are known, and pointed to the company's commitments on KLM's independent position.
No concrete plans are known to me at this time.
Er zijn mij thans geen concrete plannen bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de laatste berichtgeving in het dieselschandaal en de rol van het RDW

An SP MP asked the government about recent reporting on the diesel emissions scandal, whether the ministry knew about fraud earlier, and whether the RDW's dual role as public regulator and commercial testing body is problematic. The minister answered that the ministry knew of software fraud only from autumn 2015, that the RDW's testing is part of its public task with minimal commercial revenue, and that it will not separate those tasks.
I am therefore not willing to remove those tasks from the RDW.
Ik ben daarom niet bereid om betreffende taken bij de RDW weg te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Nijboer over het klimaatbeleid van banken

MPs Jan Vos and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister about poor climate scores of Dutch banks, their climate commitments, supervision and standards for non-financial reporting. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said banks should be more transparent and do more, and pointed to existing platforms and EU rules, committing to support international standards and to an accountant audit of non-financial information.
Unambiguous and enforceable international standards for presenting non-financial information, without too much discretion, would be an important step forward.
Eenduidige en afdwingbare internationale standaarden voor de weergave van niet-financiële informatie, zonder te veel vrijheidsgraden, zouden een belangrijke stap voorwaarts zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over hormoonverstorende stoffen

An SP MP asked whether the government should follow France by banning BPA in packaging and DEHP in neonatal and maternity medical devices, and whether a national biomonitoring system for hormone-disrupting substances should be set up. The minister answered that a ban is not appropriate because safer alternatives are not proven, that exposure of vulnerable groups is being reduced through talks with stakeholders, and that the RIVM participates in the European HBM4EU biomonitoring project.
A ban does not deserve to be followed, because manufacturers would then be forced to use alternatives in their products whose safety has not been well investigated.
Een verbod verdient geen navolging, omdat fabrikanten dan worden gedwongen alternatieven te gebruiken in hun producten, waarvan de veiligheid niet goed is onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de uitspraken van het Europees Milieu Agentschap (EMA) over de luchtkwaliteit in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary about a European Environment Agency report ranking Dutch air quality poorly and what action would prevent a similar result next year. The state secretary argued the ranking is distorted by monitoring locations, pointed to a declining NO2 trend and the Clean Air Action Plan, and said current projections show the Netherlands meeting the new emission ceilings without extra measures.
With the Clean Air Action Plan a broad package of measures is being deployed to further improve air quality.
Met het Actieplan Luchtkwaliteit wordt een breed maatregelenpakket ingezet om de luchtkwaliteit verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en De Boer over de effecten van de veranderde dienstregeling van NS op West-Brabant

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about the 2017 NS timetable change, which lengthened some West-Brabant to Randstad journeys (e.g. Oudenbosch–Schiphol), and whether NS consulted regional authorities and consumer groups as the concession requires. The State Secretary acknowledged some deteriorations but said the timetable is NS's responsibility, that the concession was respected, and that commercially confidential profitability data cannot be disclosed; she declined to study wider economic effects and offered only to discuss improvements for 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over de taxironselaars op Schiphol die de zangeres van Skunk Anansie belaagden

An MP asked the state secretary about aggressive taxi touting at Schiphol that harassed the singer of Skunk Anansie, whether the situation is untenable, why it cannot be solved quickly, and whether the government will intervene. The state secretary agreed the situation is unacceptable, explained that the municipality of Haarlemmermeer is responsible for amending its bylaw and is preparing that change with ministry help, and said the government will do what is needed while referring to earlier answers.
It is and remains the responsibility and competence of the municipality of Haarlemmermeer to amend the APV.
Het is en blijft uiteraard de bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Haarlemmermeer om de APV te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Nispen over de asbestzaak in Dodewaard

MPs Smaling and Van Nispen asked how hundreds of visitors to an event in a contaminated former brick factory in Dodewaard were exposed to asbestos in 2011, why the building was not closed, and whether the Public Prosecution Service was fully informed. The government called the exposure reprehensible, said the owners were convicted, explained the closure and communication history, and said it had asked the municipality and province to inform visitors jointly.
The answer to how large the chance of actual health problems is depends on the specific circumstances of the case.
Het antwoord op de vraag hoe groot de kans is dat daadwerkelijke gezondheidsproblemen ontstaan, is afhankelijk van de specifieke omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Hoogland over het bericht ‘België geeft het op met spoor Maastricht-Lanaken

MPs Fokke and Hoogland asked about reports that Belgium was abandoning the Maastricht-Lanaken freight rail line, its unused state, the public money spent and the lessons learned. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the Rijk paid about 5.6 million euro for revitalisation, that the line lacked freight after Sappi switched to road transport, and that future reactivations must be funded by the initiator.
In future, when reactivating disused railways, the costs of planning, reactivation, and management and maintenance will fall entirely on the initiator.
In het vervolg zullen bij reactivering van in onbruik geraakte spoorwegen de kosten voor planvorming, reactivering en beheer en onderhoud geheel bij de initiatiefnemer komen te liggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Duitse doelstelling broeikasgassen omlaag na protest industrie’

An MP asks the state secretary whether Germany has lowered its CO2 targets after industry protest, what this means for EU climate goals, and whether other countries will follow. The state secretary replies that Germany's 2050 plan targets a 55% cut by 2030 (higher than the EU's 40%), that global climate action requires all countries to contribute, and that the Netherlands remains committed to the Paris Agreement while awaiting US policy.
The central goal of the plan is a reduction of greenhouse gas emissions of 80–95% by 2050, with an interim target of at least 55% by 2030 (compared to 1990).
Het centrale doel van het plan is een reductie van de broeikasgasuitstoot van 80–95% in 2050, met een tussendoel van ten minste 55% in 2030 (ten opzichte van 1990).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het artikel ‘Impact fijnstof zwaar overdreven’

An MP asked the government to react to a newspaper article claiming air pollution has only a small effect on regional health differences, and whether livestock density correlates with chronic illness. The state secretary rejected the article's methodology as unsound, pointed to the VGO study and the planned air-quality measures, and promised to inform parliament about any measures.
Your House will be informed about the measures to be taken.
Uw Kamer zal geïnformeerd worden over de te nemen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht “Helft vliegtuigpassagiers krijgt geen vergoeding bij lange vertraging”

An MP asked the government about a report that half of air passengers receive no compensation for long delays, and whether the ILT (inspectorate) is doing enough to prevent barriers to claims. The state secretary answered that airlines largely comply with information duties, that the ILT handles complaints and can enforce, but that no structural problem or new measures are seen, while noting the 80,000 figure cannot be verified.
I have no overview of the total number of compensation claims, the extent to which they are justified or not, or whether money remains unpaid that should be paid out.
Ik heb geen overzicht van het totaal aantal compensatieclaims, de mate waarin deze gegrond zijn of niet en of er geld blijft liggen dat uitgekeerd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Griekenland krijgt 1,75 miljard euro uit EU-klimaatplan om twee nieuwe kolencentrales te bouwen’

An MP asks why Greece may use EU emissions-trading free allowances to fund two new coal plants, and whether this fits EU climate leadership and Dutch coal phase-out.
