The State Secretary answers that Greece does not meet the eligibility threshold, that only low-CO2 investments should qualify, and that the Netherlands will inform parliament on its coal phase-out later this year.
I am committed to ensuring that only investments in low-CO2 technologies are eligible for funding under this ETS exception.
Ik zet me ervoor in dat alleen investeringen in CO 2 -arme technologieën in aanmerking komen voor financiering uit deze uitzonderingsbepaling in het ETS.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Maij over Europese subsidie voor nieuwe kolencentrales in Griekenland

Two MPs asked the State Secretary why Greece should receive 1.75 billion euro in EU ETS allowance-based support for two new lignite plants, how this fits EU climate goals, and what can be done. The State Secretary said she opposes extending the derogation group, will push for CO2-free-only subsidy criteria and competitive bidding, but cannot stop the Greek request directly.
I therefore focus on strict criteria for the use of the funds.
Ik richt me daarom op scherpe criteria voor het gebruik van de middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Cegerek en Leenders naar aanleiding van berichtgeving over de toename van fijn stof in Zuidoost Brabant

Three PvdA MPs asked the state secretary about press reports that fine particulate matter in south-east Brabant would exceed norms in 2020, asking about health effects, prevention measures and causes. The state secretary acknowledged the forecast exceedance of the daily fine-dust norm in five Brabant municipalities near livestock farms, cited RIVM estimates of about nine months of life-years lost, and described an existing package of measures and an upcoming update on poultry-sector air quality.
You will be informed about this shortly.
U wordt hier binnenkort over geïnformeerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en De Boer over toegankelijkheid van het spoorvervoer en persoonlijke assistentieverlening op NS-stations

MPs Smaling and De Boer asked about NS station assistance for wheelchair users, expansion of assisted stations, costs and punctuality, ProRail's station upgrade timeline, and when all stations will be accessible. The Staatssecretaris answered that NS is extending assistance to 45 more stations, that 90% accessibility is targeted by 2020 and all stations by 2030, and declined to accelerate works for reasons of disruption and contractor capacity.
I want to work with NS and ProRail to examine how independent accessibility is developing in the Netherlands and, on that basis, decide whether there is reason to further expand assistance.

Ik wil samen met NS en ProRail bekijken hoe de zelfstandige toegankelijkheid zich in Nederland ontwikkelt en op grond daarvan besluiten of er aanleiding is om de assistentieverlening nog verder uit te breiden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het succes van de OV-fiets naar aanleiding van het artikel het artikel ‘Succes OV-fiets leidt tot tekort op stations’ in het Nederlands Dagblad van 15 november 2016

An MP asked the state secretary about NS's OV-fiets (public transport bike) expansion, whether it is a core task, who pays for 1,000 new bikes, and whether NS should hand it back to the market. The state secretary replied that NS takes the initiative as part of door-to-door travel, that NS funds the bikes itself, that subscriptions no longer carry bike costs, and that NS will not be asked to reconsider, while noting the questions could not be answered before the MIRT debate.
It has unfortunately not proven possible to answer these questions before the committee debate.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk gebleken deze vragen voor het notaoverleg te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de benchmark duurzaam inkopen van vervoer

An MP asked the state secretary about a benchmark showing 82% of municipalities fail their own 100% sustainable procurement targets for transport, and about updating outdated criteria, knowledge gaps and the Klimaatakkoord. The state secretary acknowledged the need for progress, pointed to a Plan van Aanpak, a manifesto with municipalities, a revised criteria document due February 2017, a new expert pool, and a benchmark under development.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Van Tongeren over een conflict tussen het verpakkende bedrijfsleven en gemeenten aangaande het inzamelen van kunststof verpakkingen

MPs Van Veldhoven and Van Tongeren asked about a dispute between packaging industry and municipalities over payment for collecting plastic packaging, including non-packaging plastics and PET-trays. The State Secretary answered that talks with the VNG have not yet reached agreement, that the packaging body StAV questions the lawfulness of paying for non-packaging plastic, and that the evaluation of the framework agreement and a plan for PET-trays are pending.
I aim for a solution that is workable for all parties.
Ik streef naar een oplossing die voor alle partijen uitvoerbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over een tweede intercity van en naar Fryslân

MPs De Boer and Aukje de Vries asked why the promised second intercity between Fryslân and the Randstad was not running and whether it can be realised, and what the obstacles are. The State Secretary answers that power supply limitations led ProRail to declare the infrastructure overloaded, that NS, ProRail and Fryslân agreed in November 2016 to start the service around end 2017, and that ProRail is installing an extra substation and other upgrades.
On 16 November 2016, NS, Fryslân and ProRail agreed that the second intercity is expected to run on the Leeuwarden–Zwolle route from the end of 2017.
Op 16 november 2016 hebben NS, Fryslân en ProRail afgesproken dat de tweede intercity naar verwachting eind 2017 gaat rijden op het traject Leeuwarden – Zwolle.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Van Oosten over het bericht ‘Aantal dumpingen drugsafval afgelopen jaren gestegen’

MPs Dijkstra and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Justice and Security about rising drug-waste dumping and whether many incidents go unreported and unpunished. The Minister acknowledges unreported cases, points to integrated regional approaches and the LFO specialist unit, and says cost recovery from offenders cannot be fully reported from existing systems.
No complete overview of cases in which suspects were convicted for dumping drug waste, and of the costs recovered from them, can be generated from the registration systems of the OM and the police.

Uit de registratiesystemen van het OM en de politie is geen volledig overzicht te genereren van zaken waarin verdachten zijn veroordeeld voor het dumpen van drugsafval en de eventueel op hen verhaalde kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van de motie 31793, nr. 143 in relatie tot berichtgeving over investeringen in fossiele energie.

The MP asks whether the financial sector should keep investing in fossil energy given climate targets, whether science-based targets for finance exist and whether PBL should study them, and what action followed motion 31793 nr. 143. The Staatssecretaris answers that finance firms are expected to contribute, that a sector initiative on science-based targets is welcome without a PBL study, and that the ministry joins the DNB-led Platform voor Duurzame Financiering and the PCAF.
I wholeheartedly welcome this sector initiative and currently see no reason to additionally ask PBL to conduct research on science-based targets for the financial sector.

Ik juich dit initiatief van de sector van harte toe en zie op dit moment dan ook geen aanleiding om in aanvulling daarop PBL te verzoeken onderzoek te verrichten naar wetenschappelijk onderbouwde doelstellingen voor de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klever over de Zembla uitzending 'Gevaarlijk spel'

The MP Klever asks the ministers why the government reversed its position on banning rubber granulate in artificial turf, whether the RIVM study was adequate, and whether children with leukaemia used such pitches. The minister replies that the government followed the Commission's classification of granulate as a mixture, that no unacceptable health risk has been identified, that RIVM research and an ECHA report are pending, and that no ban is planned.
I have asked the RIVM to determine the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and other substances in granulate.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de aanwezigheid van polycyclische aromatische koolwaterstoffen (pak's) en andere stoffen in granulaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Smaling over het bericht dat het sporten op kunststofgrasvelden mogelijk gevaarlijk is voor de gezondheid

MPs Van Nispen and Smaling asked the health minister about reports that playing sport on artificial turf with rubber granulate may harm health, and about the government's position in EU REACH classification. The minister answered that RIVM still finds no health effects on current evidence, that RIVM is analysing new studies and literature, and that results are expected before year-end.
I have asked RIVM to determine the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and other substances in the granulate.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de aanwezigheid van polycyclische aromatische koolwaterstoffen (pak's) en andere stoffen in granulaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Rudmer Heerema over onderzoek naar de gezondheidsrisico’s van kunstgrasvelden

MPs Dijkstra and Heerema asked the government about health risks of rubber granulate on artificial turf, including carcinogenic substances, the Hendrik-Ido-Ambacht case, and the representativeness of a 2006 RIVM-linked study, and whether a new study including children is needed. The minister answered that RIVM sees no public health risk from current evidence, that no specific government guidelines exist beyond REACH oversight by the NVWA, and that it is too early to decide on a new study pending literature review and measurements.
It is still too early to determine whether a new study is useful.
Het is nog te vroeg om te bepalen of een nieuw onderzoek zinvol is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat giftige olie vanuit Rotterdam naar Afrika wordt verscheept

Mr. Smaling (SP) asked the state secretary and the minister whether they knew that diesel was being contaminated before export from Rotterdam to Africa, what volumes are involved, whether this is a criminal offence, whether they will raise it at the IMO, and what has been done with the SP's 2013 'Oliezwendel' recommendations. Minister Ploumen replied that the government was unaware of this specific practice, has few details on the trade, sees no current breach of law (the EU fuel quality directive does not cover exports and the waste regulation does not apply), will work through UNEP and regional West African initiatives, deems the IMO inappropriate, and points to earlier letters on fuel adulteration.
Few specific details are available on the import, export and transit (such as origin) of diesel coming from outside Europe.
Er zijn weinig specifieke details beschikbaar over de in-, uit- en doorvoer (zoals de herkomst) van diesel die van buiten Europa afkomstig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het rapport 'Dirty Diesel – How Swiss Traders Flood Africa with Toxic Fuels'

An MP asked whether the Netherlands should restrict oil blending and trading infrastructure in Rotterdam and Amsterdam that supplies low-quality fuels to West Africa, as reported by Public Eye. The government acknowledged the report, said it would raise the case in the port work programme and ask the NCP to examine OECD guideline implementation, and emphasised a harmonised international approach through UNEP rather than unilateral national rules.

Are you prepared, on the basis of additional research, if necessary, to introduce legislation and regulation that makes it impossible for this infrastructure to still be used to produce and trade fuels

Bent u bereid op basis van aanvullend onderzoek zo nodig met wet- er regelgeving te komen die het onmogelijk maakt dat deze infrastructuur nog gebruikt wordt om brandstoffen te produceren en verhandelen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht dat internationale brandstofbedrijven op grote schaal giftige brandstof via Nederlandse havens naar Afrika exporteren

An MP asked the government about reports that international fuel companies export toxic fuel via Dutch ports to Africa, including exported volumes, air pollution, and whether Dutch and international law is violated. The minister answers that no violation of current rules is known, promises an NCP review of the oil and gas sector due in spring 2017, and describes multilateral efforts through UNEP and partnerships on cleaner fuel standards.
At this moment the cabinet has no indications that current legal and regulatory frameworks are being violated.
Op dit moment heeft het kabinet geen aanwijzingen dat in strijd met het huidige kader van wet- en regelgeving wordt gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over luchtvervuiling op het platteland door de veehouderij

MPs Cegerek and Van Dekken asked about a study linking living near livestock farms to reduced lung function, about low public awareness of air pollution, and about why EU air quality limits are looser than WHO guidelines. The government said it will inform parliament on measures and follow-up research, points to existing public information channels, and says a push for stricter EU norms is not currently realistic while it keeps working toward WHO levels.
The cabinet intends to inform parliament shortly by letter about the measures to be taken and the follow-up research.
Het kabinet is voornemens uw Kamer binnenkort per brief te informeren over de te nemen maatregelen en het vervolgonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over oplichting door taxichauffeurs op Schiphol

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how she would respond to broadcasts about taxi touts defrauding passengers at Schiphol, how a legal change she had signalled could be achieved, and how talks with Haarlemmermeer on amending the local APV are progressing. The State Secretary condemns the practice, says public order is a municipal responsibility and the Passenger Transport Act is unsuitable for it, and says talks with the municipality on an APV amendment are ongoing with the aim of a quick solution.
Haarlemmermeer and my ministry are currently jointly examining whether a further amendment of the APV is a solution.
Haarlemmermeer en mijn ministerie bekijken op dit moment gezamenlijk of een verdere wijziging van de APV een oplossing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en De Boer over de taxironselaars op Schiphol

MPs Hoogland and De Boer asked the state secretary about aggressive taxi touts at Schiphol, whether the Haarlemmermeer municipal bylaw (APV) leaves too much room for them, and what steps have been taken. The state secretary replied that the bylaw already prohibits intrusive solicitation, that enforcement is being intensified through targeted action against the worst offenders and ILT capacity, and that talks with the municipality and Schiphol are ongoing, with a possible bylaw amendment under consideration.
At present I am examining together with the municipality of Haarlemmermeer whether a further amendment of the APV can make enforcement more effective.
Op dit moment bekijk ik samen met de gemeente Haarlemmermeer of een verdere wijziging van de APV de handhaving effectiever kan maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over het bericht ‘1 op de 5 gecontroleerde vrachtwagens mag eigenlijk de weg niet op, volgens Belgisch onderzoek’

An MP asked the Minister whether Belgian findings that one in five checked trucks should not be on the road are known, whether technical defects pose a danger, and why the Netherlands does not register such results. The Minister confirmed knowledge of the figures and agreed defective trucks are dangerous, noted that Dutch results are reported to the European Commission every two years, and said harmonised defect classification will follow under EU directive 2014/47/EU by May 2018.
In accordance with Directive 2000/30/EC, the Netherlands records the results of technical inspections of commercial vehicles by the police, with assistance from the RDW.
Conform richtlijn 2000/30/EG registreert Nederland de resultaten van technische controles van bedrijfsvoertuigen door de politie, met assistentie van de RDW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Schiphol dreigt veel eerder ‘vol’ te raken dan voorzien’

MPs Monasch and Van Helvert asked the state secretary about reports that Schiphol may reach its capacity limit sooner than expected, the number of night flights, and whether Schiphol is breaching the Alders agreement. The state secretary confirmed that the 500,000-movement limit is coming into view sooner, that night flights are expected to reach about 31,600, and that the Omgevingsraad talks are ongoing, with a plan of action due by 1 December 2016 and a new noise calculation planned.
I have now called on the ORS to come up with a plan of action for the entire advice request by 1 December 2016.
Ik heb inmiddels de ORS opgeroepen om uiterlijk 1 december 2016 met een plan van aanpak te komen voor de gehele adviesaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de overlast van het spoor nabij America (gemeente Horst aan de Maas)

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about train noise nuisance near America (Horst aan de Maas), including a resident survey, a proposed reduction of freight wagons, and a planned freight terminal near Venlo-Blerick. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns, said America is among the areas under the noise-remediation programme with prioritisation in 2018 and sanitation plans by 2020, and declined to give a train-frequency conversion or to predict the effects of the terminal yet.
In 2018 the first prioritisation takes place for which measures can be taken where.
In 2018 vindt de eerste prioritering plaats voor welke maatregelen waar getroffen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Geurts en Lodders over het bericht dat fabrikanten woest zijn over eenzijdige aanpassing van emissies innovatieve stalvloeren

MPs Dijkgraaf, Geurts and Lodders asked why the government adjusted emission measurements for innovative low-emission stable floors, whether Wageningen University's overlapping roles are independent, why the Aeromix system received no provisional emission factor, and about the professionalisation of the advisory committee TacRav. The State Secretary answered that a expert panel is reviewing the measurements, a third party will advise by November, definitive factors are expected early 2017, and the TacRav professionalisation will be audited.
I want to have the advice at my disposal in November, so that after consultation with those involved I can definitively set the emission factors in early 2017.
Het advies wil ik in november tot mijn beschikking hebben, zodat ik na overleg met betrokkenen begin 2017 de emissiefactoren definitief kan vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes inzake een nieuw formaldehydelek

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the State Secretary about a new formaldehyde leak at a DuPont plant, whether Chemours failed to report it to municipalities, and why detectors allegedly did not alarm the regional service. The State Secretary answered that the company was only obliged to report to the province, that detectors did register a raised value on 10 August, and that the province imposed an order under penalty and stricter inspections.
There is no legal obligation for the company to report to other authorities.
Er bestaat voor het bedrijf geen wettelijke plicht tot het melden bij andere overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over rattenoverlast

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked the government about rising rat infestations, the increase in Weil's disease cases, the effectiveness of Integrated Pest Management and rodenticide use, and whether doctors are informed. The government answered that monitoring is still too short for firm trends, that Integrated Pest Management is essential, that cases rose but not tenfold, and that it will evaluate the policy with results expected in 2021.
The number of patients has not increased tenfold in the past year.
Het aantal patiënten is het afgelopen jaar niet verachtvoudigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over het gebruik van Dimethylaceetamide (DMAc) door DuPont

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked about DMAc exposure at DuPont Kerkrade, including past occupational health monitoring, inspection follow-up, urine test results withheld from workers, and possible risks to residents. The minister answered that the Dordrecht fact-finding study will cover lessons learned, that employers are primarily responsible for worker protection with inspection oversight, that urine results cannot be shared for privacy reasons, that RIVM found resident risk very unlikely, and that prosecutorial matters cannot be discussed.
Answering the questions about the situation at DuPont Kerkrade in the past would require in-depth research.
Het beantwoorden van de vragen over de situatie bij Dupont Kerkrade in het verleden zou diepgaand onderzoek vergen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over twee werkbezoeken aan de taxibranche d.d. 14 en 29 september 2016

MP De Boer asked the state secretary about the long delayed rollout of the mandatory taxi on-board computer (BCT), the reasonableness of charging operators for updates, enforcement and fines, and rest-time rules. The state secretary defended the market-led update approach, enforcement from 1 October 2016, an existing oversight committee, and the current rules, and promised an evaluation by 1 April 2017.
By 1 April 2017 at the latest I want to inform you about the results of this first evaluation.
Uiterlijk 1 april 2017 wil ik u informeren over de uitkomsten van deze eerste evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Van Dekken over het bericht “Machinisten Arriva: Veiligheid reiziger staat op het spel”

MPs Hoogland and Van Dekken asked about reported safety incidents (STS passages) involving temporary Arriva train drivers on the northern rail network, their training, and whether the ILT report should lead to talks with Arriva and VVMC. The State Secretary answered that only one incident is known to Arriva, that the driver was suspended and an ILT licence suspension started, that the training practice was not in breach of rules, and that ILT is investigating and further measures depend on the outcome.
Depending on the outcome of this investigation, I will inform your House whether it is desirable to take additional measures.
Afhankelijk van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal ik uw Kamer informeren of het wenselijk is extra maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over “een gesprek met de spoorgoederensector over onder andere de slechte bereikbaarheid van de Rotterdamse haven”

An MP asked about the reliability of rail freight links from the Port of Rotterdam, the causes of poor punctuality, the responsibilities of ProRail, Betuweroute maintenance capacity and Moerdijk bridge repairs. The Secretary of State reported that freight punctuality (75.9% in H1 2016) is below the 80% concession floor, attributed causes to ProRail's operational choices and reduced non-commercial stops, and described existing action programmes while promising a separate letter on the Moerdijk bridge.
At present ProRail scores on this indicator below the minimum value of 80.0 percent agreed in the management concession.
Op dit moment scoort ProRail op deze indicator onder de in de beheerconcessie afgesproken bodemwaarde van 80,0 procent.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Graus over de relatie tussen Taiwan en luchtvaartorganisatie ICAO

Two PVV MPs asked the government why Taiwan is excluded from ICAO while North Korea is a member, and whether the Netherlands will support Taiwan's permanent presence at ICAO meetings. The minister answered that only states can be members, that Taiwan gets ICAO information through indirect channels, and that the Netherlands will weigh participation case by case under the one-China policy without committing to permanent presence.
For future ICAO meetings, a case-by-case assessment will be made to determine whether some form of pragmatic cooperation with Taiwan is possible.
Voor toekomstige vergaderingen van de ICAO wordt per geval een afweging gemaakt om te bezien of enigerlei vorm van pragmatische samenwerking met Taiwan mogelijk is of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over problematiek rondom onveilige scootmobiels

An MP asked the State Secretaries about accidents with three-wheeled mobility scooters, whether councils wrongly issue them instead of safer five-wheeled models, and how scooters are checked for safety. The government answered that causes are multifactorial, a SWOV study is ongoing with results expected end 2017, and that scooters are not type-approved for road use, with councils responsible for individual suitability.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Bruins over de nieuwe veerboot Texelstroom van TESO

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport has not yet decided TESO's over one-year-old request to bunker CNG for the new Texel ferry, and when a decision will come. The minister replied that the assessment is ongoing because technical information is still missing from the company, that the Amsterdam sightseeing boats are not comparable, and that a decision will follow as soon as the information is supplied.
The assessment of the application is still ongoing because the ILT has not yet received all the necessary technical information to assess the application fully.
De beoordeling van de aanvraag loopt nog doordat de ILT nog niet alle benodigde technische informatie heeft ontvangen om de aanvraag volledig te kunnen beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Criminelen wijken uit naar Gelderland voor dumpen drugsafval’

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked about reports that drug waste dumping is shifting to Gelderland and why few people claim from the co-financing fund for cleanup costs, and whether the fund could pay faster or a higher share. The minister acknowledges a slight rise, explains low claim numbers (unawareness, missing documents, small amounts), refuses faster payment to keep the pro-rata system, and says talks with provinces on a higher share and a possible offender levy are ongoing.
I am in discussion with the provinces to explore the possibilities for better use of the compensation scheme.
Ik ben met de provincies in gesprek om de mogelijkheden voor betere benutting van de vergoedingsregeling te verkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat DuPont honderden kilo’s formaldehyde heeft gelekt

Two SP MPs asked the government about a reported leak of 2,730 kg of carcinogenic formaldehyde at DuPont, whether it was allowed to keep using the substance despite a claimed European ban, what the effects on workers, residents and the environment are, and how the company's safety culture would be addressed. The state secretary answered that no ban exists but a minimisation duty applies, that a criminal complaint and joint provincial and Inspectie SZW investigations are underway, that an initial indication shows no harm to health or environment, and that some production lines were halted at the province's urging, while declining to pre-judge the investigation outcomes.

Because a criminal complaint about this incident has been filed with the Public Prosecution Service on behalf of the province of Zuid-Holland, the competent authority for this company, I do not consider it appropriate to give a further judgment at this time.

Omdat er van dit incident namens de provincie Zuid-Holland, het bevoegd gezag voor dit bedrijf, aangifte is gedaan bij het Openbaar Ministerie acht ik het niet gepast op dit moment een nader oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Meer treinen met giftige stoffen dan toegestaan’

Mr Van Veldhoven (D66) asked the State Secretary whether reports of more trains carrying hazardous substances than permitted through Utrecht were accurate, and whether the government would improve oversight and public information on such transports. The State Secretary confirmed the wagon numbers, said there are no legal caps on the number of hazardous-goods trains but risk ceilings were exceeded, announced a package of measures and publication of quarterly transport figures, and said the ILT will report on registration compliance at the end of 2016.
I want to emphasise that the transport of hazardous substances takes place responsibly because of the strict requirements that apply to this transport as a result of international regulations.
Ik wil benadrukken dat het vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen op een verantwoorde wijze plaatsvindt vanwege de strenge eisen die gelden voor dit vervoer als gevolg van internationale regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Helvert over de snelle trein van Breda naar België

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretary why NS cannot promise fast trains from Breda to Belgium by April 2017 and whether earlier commitments still hold. The state secretary answered that delays at Bombardier in the signalling software mean the service will likely start only after timetable 2018, that NS is having the planning checked externally, and that the government will press Bombardier.
Together with NS I will engage in discussion with Bombardier to underline the Dutch interest in a rapid solution.
Samen met NS ga ik het gesprek aan met Bombardier om het Nederlandse belang van een snelle oplossing te onderstrepen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de berichten ‘Nederland ligt dwars bij aanpak dieselschandaal’ en dat een jaar na Dieselgate blijkt dat alle dieselmerken nog vervuilender zijn dan Volkswagen

An MP (D66) asked the ministers about reports that the Netherlands is resisting tougher diesel emissions testing and that most diesel models exceed emission limits, plus the RDW's positions in Brussels on independent testing, peer review and typeapproval for models such as the Opel Zafira. The ministers answered that a letter on the report would follow, that withdrawing approvals during ongoing investigations would be unlawful, and that the Netherlands supports Commission proposals for independent testing and peer review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht «Eijsden-Margraten dient klacht in over vliegtuiglawaai»

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary about aircraft noise over Eijsden and Mesch from Liège airport traffic after the municipality filed a complaint, and whether the 2013 airspace change should be revisited. The state secretary agrees the change caused unwanted noise, reports on meetings with the municipality and Belgian authorities, and says measures so far are insufficient and not yet structural, but argues the airspace change was needed for safety and that a new Environment Cell is working to reduce the noise.
I agree with the municipality that the airspace change has led to unwanted noise effects above Eijsden-Margraten.
Ik ben het eens met de gemeente dat de luchtruimwijziging heeft geleid tot ongewenste geluidseffecten boven Eijsden-Margraten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de kritiek op de Wet dieraantallen

MP Dijkgraaf asks the state secretaries whether criticism of the Wet dieraantallen (animal numbers law), including from IRAS researcher Heederik, the provinces of Gelderland and Limburg, and a Brabant longkanker correlation analysis, undermines the bill and its link to public health. The government answers that a joint approach is needed, that animal numbers caps remain useful for overburdened areas, that the bill will be pursued, and that further research on endotoxins and health will be reported this autumn.
Therefore the cabinet will, in addition to this approach, further advance the previously announced animal numbers bill.
Daarom zal het kabinet aanvullend op deze aanpak het eerder aangekondigde wetsvoorstel dieraantallen verder in gang zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht “Bureaucratie remt ontwikkeling Dronetechnologie”

MP Monasch asked the State Secretary whether bureaucracy is slowing drone technology development, including the authorisation of test centres. The government answered that a lighter mini-drone regulation took effect on 1 July 2016, that test-centre applications are handled with ILT and that new regulation to facilitate testing is being prepared.
The cabinet is preparing regulation to further facilitate the conduct of flights for testing and experimenting with drones.
Het kabinet is regelgeving aan het voorbereiden om de uitvoering van vluchten ten behoeve van testen van en experimenteren met drones verder te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Helvert over een overvolle sprinter in Almere

MP Van Helvert asked the State Secretary whether an overcrowded NS train at Almere Poort, where doors stayed closed, was dangerous and why, and how such situations are handled. The State Secretary answered that the conductor kept doors closed for safety on a shortened train, that NS has no fixed protocol for such exceptional cases and will review the incident with ProRail.
NS regrets the incident and is discussing it with ProRail in relation to the work at the shunting yard in order to learn from it.
NS betreurt het voorval en bespreekt dit in relatie tot de werkzaamheden op het opstelterrein samen met ProRail om van te leren.
Vragen van het lid Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) aan de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over Otapan (ingezonden 7 april 2016).

The MP asks whether the Dutch state will recover the costs of cleaning up the toxic ship Otapan from its owners, given that the owners are now known, and whether legal steps will be taken. The state secretary replies that thorough research found no convincing evidence of deliberate wrongdoing by the Basilisk directors, that proceedings are procedurally barred and the claims are likely time-barred, so new legal steps are deemed not useful.
The results of this research compel me to conclude that (re)initiating a recovery procedure, either against the directors of Basilisk or against Basilisk itself, is not meaningful.

De resultaten van dit onderzoek dwingen mij tot de conclusie, dat het (opnieuw) entameren van een verhaalsprocedure, hetzij tegen de bestuurders van Basilisk hetzij tegen Basilisk zelf, niet zinvol is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Van Veldhoven, Van Helvert en Madlener over het bericht dat Rover vindt dat het Ministerie de verkeerde prioriteiten stelt

MPs from ChristenUnie, D66, CDA and PVV asked the State Secretary about ROVER's claim that the ministry sets the wrong priorities in its ProRail repositioning, including concerns about rushed decisions, missing baselines, and the handling of parliamentary motions. The State Secretary answered that a public-law form for ProRail is already chosen, that an analysis with stakeholder input will be sent to Parliament before year-end, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before debate.
Until I have discussed this analysis with your House, no irreversible steps will be taken regarding the positioning of ProRail.
Totdat ik deze analyse met uw Kamer heb besproken, zullen er geen onomkeerbare stappen ten aanzien van de positionering van ProRail worden gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over “de Volkswagen dieselgate”

An MP from GroenLinks asked the state secretary about Volkswagen and Renault emissions updates, including whether independent testing of recalled models should be required and whether Renault's emissions study omitted details. The government answered that independent technical services already oversee Volkswagen testing, that an RDW/TNO second opinion is underway, that there is no legal basis to force manufacturers to run real-driving tests on updated models, and that it sees no reason to query France directly.
At the request of your House, the RDW and TNO will carry out a second opinion on the solution approved by KBA.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer 3 voeren de RDW en TNO wel een second opinion uit naar de door KBA goedgekeurde oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de inzet van militairen op Schiphol

An MP asked the government about deploying Royal Netherlands Marechaussee support and army infantry at Schiphol, whether the promised 85 new marechaussees were truly additional, and why a structural solution was still pending. The minister answered that army support was a temporary, ended measure, that the 85 recruits were redirected from regular intake and phased in, and that a capacity needs assessment would be sent to parliament in autumn.
This autumn I will inform you further.
Dit najaar zal ik u nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht OV-chipkaart blijft bron van ergernis

An MP asked the state secretary about complaints over the OV-chipkaart, including card replacement fees, the cost of new cards, and single check-in across operators. The government answered that complaints are reported quarterly, that alternative pricing is being studied within the NOVB, and that operational improvements and a single check-in pilot are underway.
I have previously indicated that it is desirable to explore alternatives to the current purchase price of the OV-chipkaart and the service costs.
Ik heb eerder al aangegeven dat het wenselijk is om alternatieven te onderzoeken voor de huidige aanschafprijs van de OV chipkaart en de servicekosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat huishoudens veel meer milieubelasting betalen dan de vervuilende industrie

An SP MP asked why households pay far more environmental tax than heavy industry, the relative burden of energy costs across income groups, and whether consumers will really benefit from the 2016 energy tax changes. The state secretary provided indicative tables showing that energy tax is set by consumption rather than income, that the average household energy bill falls by about 100 euro in 2016, and that the government aims to decarbonise housing without committing to new measures on the household-industry gap.
The costs of energy – and also the tax payable on it – do not depend on income, but are determined by consumption.
De kosten voor energie – en ook de te betalen belasting daarover – hangen echter niet af van het inkomen, maar worden bepaald aan de hand van het verbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat bewoners de rekening betalen bij mogelijke uitbreiding van Rotterdam The Hague Airport

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that residents would bear the cost of a possible expansion of Rotterdam The Hague Airport, and whether the growth figures and regional consultations were sound. The State Secretary replied that independent reviews of the airport's environmental report and economic case found them plausible, that an independent facilitator is running a regional consultation with a decision expected in 2017, and that the ministry will assess any formal permit request later without pre-judging the outcome.

I will await that application and will then make a substantive assessment based on all the information available, and subsequently draft a draft airport decision that will be submitted to your House for prior review.

Ik wacht die aanvraag af en zal op dat moment inhoudelijk een afweging maken op basis van alle informatie die er ligt en vervolgens een ontwerp luchthavenbesluit opstellen dat in voorhang aan uw Kamer wordt aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de jaarlijkse vernietiging van meer dan een miljoen kledingstukken

An MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the yearly destruction of over a million unsold garments and what measures reduce overproduction, support small retailers, cut direct-from-store destruction, and find alternative outlets. The State Secretary pointed to the Circular Economy programme, the textile covenant, a roadmap with industry, and a workshop, while stating that resale and market outlets are the responsibility of market parties.
Selling unsold products on the market is the responsibility of market parties.
Het verkopen van onverkochte producten op de markt is de verantwoordelijkheid van de marktpartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over “Afval van zolder kan mee in de kolencentrale”

An MP asks the state secretary about reports that waste-derived fuel pellets (Subcoal) can be co-fired in coal plants, whether the waste status can be ended, and how to make recycled products easier to reuse. The secretary explains that a legal opinion on end-of-waste status is pending, that a coal plant has co-fired Subcoal under an environmental permit, and that by-product and end-of-waste criteria will be clarified in the upcoming national waste plan.

This legal opinion has an informative character and can as such be submitted by the company in assessments and decisions by the administrative body that is the competent authority for the company's activities.

Dit rechtsoordeel heeft een informatief karakter en kan als zodanig door het bedrijf worden ingebracht bij beoordelingen en beschikkingen door het bestuursorgaan dat bevoegd gezag is ten aanzien van de activiteiten van het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over de berichten ‘Ministerie: Schiphol moet lawaai beter berekenen. Milieurapport zaait twijfel over stillere startmethode’ en ‘Gesjoemel met herrie’

An MP asks whether a Commissie m.e.r. advice shows Schiphol used outdated noise calculation methods that overstate the noise gains of new departure procedures. The Secretary of State says the Dutch model was applied correctly, acknowledges the Commission's view that international methods yield smaller gains, and commits to commissioning a new Dutch model, further calculations, and involving the Omgevingsraad Schiphol.
In doing so, I explicitly distance myself from a deliberately rosy presentation of the noise effects.
Daarbij neem ik nadrukkelijk afstand van een met opzet te rooskleurige voorstelling over de geluidseffecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het gebruik van plastic trays in de sierteelt

An MP asks the State Secretary about the sustainability of single-use plastic trays in the ornamental horticulture sector, including their recyclability, health effects of polystyrene, and whether reusable trays or a ban could be pursued. The State Secretary says the sector will be brought into the plastics chain agreement, an LCA study by Royal FloraHolland is awaited before discussing options with the sector, and no health study is deemed necessary.
I will therefore bring the ornamental horticulture sector into contact with various chain partners under the plastics chain agreement.
Ik zal dan ook de sierteeltsector in verbinding brengen met diverse ketenpartners onder het kunststof ketenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht «EU raadt beperkt gebruik glyfosaat aan in speeltuinen»

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether glyphosate use in playgrounds and recreation or sports fields should be banned or accompanied by protective measures, given the WHO classification as probably carcinogenic. The government answered that professional use on hard surfaces outside agriculture has been banned, that Green Deals aim to phase out pesticides on sports and recreation fields, and that the regulator considers glyphosate use on playgrounds safe for children, so no ban is planned.
The Ctgb has further informed me that the use of glyphosate on sports fields and in playgrounds has been assessed as safe for children.
Het Ctgb heeft mij daarnaast laten weten dat het gebruik van glyfosaat op sportvelden en in speeltuinen als veilig voor kinderen is beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het opruimen van oorlogsmunitie in Apeldoorn

An MP asked the ministers whether the ordnance clearance around Apeldoorn is underfunded and whether the remaining explosives pose an unacceptable fire and safety risk. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible for risk assessment and clearance, that the fire service works only on cleared paths, and that clearance of phase 2 is expected to take 8 to 8.5 years.
Responsibility for public order and safety is a local responsibility.
De zorg voor openbare orde en veiligheid is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het bericht ‘Bospaden bij Apeldoorn vol asbest’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that several forest paths near Apeldoorn contain asbestos, and how widespread, dangerous and in need of closure the problem is. The state secretary said the municipality is inventorying the asbestos, that the bound asbestos is not considered to spread and that closure is not needed for now, while noting that unknown numbers of asbestos roads remain nationally.
It is nationally unknown how many asbestos roads still exist and where they are located.
Het is landelijk onbekend hoeveel asbestwegen er nog zijn en waar deze zich bevinden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, Visser en De Boer naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten cha

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about NS timetable changes on the Kennemerlijn, overcrowding, and complaints about chaos in regional rail from April 2016. The State Secretary answered that NS is responsible for the timetable, reported falling complaint numbers after extra trains were added, stated the concession terms are met, and noted NS will add Intercity and Spitsintercity stops in the 2017 timetable.
Responsibility for designing the timetable for the main rail network and consulting stakeholders such as regional governments, other operators and consumer organisations lies with NS.

De verantwoordelijkheid voor het ontwerpen van de dienstregeling voor het hoofdrailnet en het overleg daarover met belanghebbenden als decentrale overheden, andere vervoerders en consumentenorganisaties ligt bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jan Vos over het bericht dat het Transatlantisch Handels- en Investeringspartnerschap (TTIP) mogelijk de klimaatdoelstellingen in gevaar kan brengen

An MP asked the ministers whether the published TTIP negotiating texts could endanger climate targets, including provisions on non-discrimination in energy infrastructure, shale gas imports, Arctic oil and environmental policy space. The government denied that TTIP threatens climate goals, said renewable priority rules remain possible, and pointed to explicit policy-space and climate cooperation provisions.
TTIP creates no obstacle to taking measures to protect the environment.
TTIP creëert geen belemmering voor het nemen van maatregelen ter bescherming van het milieu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Dordste fabriek stoot giftige stof uit

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about reports that the Dordrecht Chemours (ex-DuPont) plant emits GenX, a substance linked to health risks, and asked about the evidence, the regional environmental service's assessment, and whether the substance should be listed as a Substance of Very High Concern. The government answered that RIVM confirmed the substance is persistent and toxic, that bioaccumulation remains uncertain, that RIVM will do further research with a report promised by November, and that it will raise the issue at EU level.
I have therefore now asked RIVM to report to me in more detail on what is known about the persistence, bioaccumulation, toxicity, carcinogenicity, mutagenicity and reprotoxicity of FRD-903.

Ik heb daarom het RIVM inmiddels gevraagd mij uitgebreider te rapporteren over wat bekend is over de persistentie, bioaccumulatie, toxiciteit, carcinogeniteit, mutageniteit en reprotoxiciteit van FRD-903.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de uitstoot van het kankerverwekkende GenX door Chemours

An MP asks whether GenX emitted by the Chemours plant in Dordrecht is adequately controlled, given RIVM findings that it is likely toxic and persistent, and whether it will be placed on the EU list of very high concern substances. The government answers that the regional authority set strict emission limits, that the permit is publicly available and emissions stayed within it, that RIVM was asked for a further assessment, and that it will pursue an EU evaluation with Germany rather than an immediate ban.
The permit, including the maximum permitted emissions, is available for anyone to view on the Omgevingsdienst website.
De vergunning, met daarin de maximaal toegestane uitstoot, is voor iedereen in te zien op de website van de Omgevingsdienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over diverse toezeggingen met betrekking tot gewasbeschermingsmiddelen

An MP asked the state secretary about the Council of State's critical advice on the proposed ban on pesticide use by non-professionals, the preference order for non-chemical alternatives, environmental effects, packaging, enforcement budget and the risk of unauthorised substances. The government answered that the advice was published in April 2016, that the preference order will be promoted through a voluntary Green Deal with retailers with monitoring but no NVWA inspection, and that a modest additional budget of about two million euro was allocated to the NVWA for enforcement through 2017.
The advice of the Council of State has, as usual, been published together with the Nader Rapport in the Staatscourant.
Het advies van de Raad van State is, zoals gebruikelijk, met het Nader Rapport gepubliceerd in de Staatscourant
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Illegale inzet koper in biologische aardappel’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether illegal use of copper oxychloride by organic potato growers against Phytophthora, and the failure of inspection body Skal to enforce it, was acceptable and whether controls would be tightened. The government answered that such use violates the law since copper oxychloride products were banned in the Netherlands in 2000, that enforcement falls to the NVWA which applies the same inspection regime to organic and conventional farming, and that it considers the practice unacceptable and is funding resistant potato breeding.
This means that potato growers who use copper oxychloride products against Phytophthora are violating the law.
Dit betekent dat aardappeltelers die middelen met koperoxychloride gebruiken ter bestrijding van Phytophthora de wet overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over topinkomens bij Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens and Monasch asked how top-salary rules (WNT) apply to top officials at Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland after the organisation's management team structure was changed, and whether the rules can be circumvented. Minister Blok answered that the WNT applies based on actual leadership rather than formal structure, that the supervisor is the Eenheid toezicht WNT, that a legislative extension to all employees is in preparation, and that enforcement will follow if formal changes do not reflect actual practice.
Only if it is established that the officials concerned in practice have continued to provide leadership will enforcement action be taken.
Alleen indien komt vast te staan dat de betrokken functionarissen in de praktijk gewoon leiding zijn blijven geven, kan en zal handhavend worden optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat PSA Groep (Peugeot Citroën) de werkelijke verbruikscijfers van auto’s bekend heeft gemaakt

MPs Madlener and Tony van Dijck asked whether the new WLTP test method would raise measured CO2 emissions and tax revenue, and what it means for consumers, air quality policy and milieuzones. The government answered that WLTP will likely raise measured CO2 figures but is a technical change not intended to increase tax revenue, promised a bill by end 2016 with details on financial effects, and said WLTP does not affect air quality policy.
For the implementation of the WLTP in the car taxes, a legislative amendment is necessary.
Voor de implementatie van de WLTP in de autobelastingen is een wetswijziging noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het gevaar van plastic deeltjes in de lucht

An MP asked the state secretary whether plastic particles airborne in the air are harmful, whether research is lacking, and what policy addresses them. The state secretary answered that fine-particle health research exists but does not separate plastic components, that emissions reduction measures are being pursued, and that RIVM is studying options with a cost-effectiveness report promised for December.
In December I will inform you further on this.
In december zal ik u hierover nader berichten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders over het bericht "Onkruidverdelger glyfosaat niet kankerverwekkend" en het persbericht van FAO/WHO

An MP asked the state secretaries about reports that glyphosate is not carcinogenic and the consequences for the ban on its use on paved surfaces and for municipal weed control. The government answered that the ban on professional use on paved surfaces stands independently of glyphosate's classification, that ECHA has not yet ruled, and that the approval extension is still pending at EU level.

The ban, announced several years ago to protect the aquatic environment, applies to all plant protection products and is entirely separate from recent developments concerning the active substance glyphosate.

Dit verbod, dat al enige jaren geleden is aangekondigd ter bescherming van het aquatisch milieu, geldt voor alle gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en staat geheel los van de recente ontwikkelingen rondom de werkzame stof glyfosaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de aanbesteding van dienstauto’s voor de brandweer

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked about the tender for fleet cars for the fire service, including the diesel requirement, sustainability criteria and tax treatment. The State Secretary replied that the diesel requirement is being dropped, that the fire service's procuring body (IFV) has been asked to pay attention to environmental aspects, and that the choice of diesel versus alternatives has cost implications.
As indicated in the reply of 13 April 2016, the diesel requirement is being dropped.
Zoals aangegeven in de beantwoording van 13 april 2016 1 wordt de dieseleis geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Aukje de Vries over de veerdiensten naar de Waddeneilanden

Two MPs (De Boer and Aukje de Vries, VVD) asked the state secretary about price agreements under the Wadden island ferry concessions, the consultation on tariff increases, freight tariffs from Harlingen, and the structure of the concessions. The state secretary answered that tariffs have not risen since the concession became final, that the concessionaire must consult on its ferry timetable plan and that the concession authority approves it, and that freight is a free market outside the concessions.
It is up to the concession authority whether or not to approve (parts of) this transport plan, including the proposed tariffs for the next timetable year.
Het is aan de concessieverlener om al dan niet in te stemmen met (onderdelen van) dit vervoerplan, waaronder de voorgestelde tarieven voor het volgende dienstregelingsjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Oosenbrug over mobiele dekking in spoor- en autotunnels

Two MPs asked the government about the lack of mobile coverage in rail and road tunnels, including the Delft rail tunnel, and why it was delayed. The State Secretary answered that coverage in the Delft tunnel became available on 12 May 2016, admitted it came later than wished, and promised to report to parliament in autumn 2016 on talks with providers and to inform on responsibilities and tunnel standards.
It would have been better for travellers if they had been able to use a well-functioning mobile network directly when the rail tunnel opened.
Het was voor de reizigers beter geweest wanneer zij direct bij open telling van de spoortunnel over een goed werkend mobiel netwerk hadden kunnen beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Moors over het bericht ‘Schotschrift tegen asbesthysterie’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a critical pamphlet claiming asbestos policy is overly alarmist and that the asbestos roof ban is poor value for money. The State Secretary rejected the alarmism claim, defended the cost-benefit analysis and the 2024 roof-removal deadline, and outlined subsidies, a programme office and enforcement measures while declining to quantify victim numbers precisely.
No, I do not endorse that conclusion. The central government takes a sober and pragmatic approach to asbestos in the residential, working and living environment.
Nee, die conclusie onderschrijf ik niet. De rijksoverheid staat voor een nuchtere en pragmatische benadering van asbest in de woon-, werk- en leefomgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de noodzaak tot het verduurzamen van voedsel, mede via prijsprikkels

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks whether the government will act on an international panel's call for sustainable food systems, including pricing externalities via taxes, ending subsidies for unsustainable production, and a national awareness campaign. The state secretary agrees the government has a role, says true-pricing research is underway with results due in late 2016, rejects broadening taxation for now, and points to existing awareness efforts by other bodies and schools.
The cabinet is not in favour of broadening the instrumental use of taxation at this time.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander om het instrumentele gebruik van belastingheffing op dit moment te verbreden.

Vragen van de leden Smaling en Karabulut (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de actieagenda Schiphol de problemen niet oplo

MPs Smaling and Karabulut (SP) asked whether unfair competition from Gulf and Turkish carriers, social premium evasion, sham self-employment, slot allocation and Schiphol security threaten Schiphol and KLM and what the government will do. The state secretary answered that the position of Schiphol and KLM is still strong, pointed to EU mandates for aviation agreements and existing EU rules, and declined new legislation or changes to Schiphol's public status.
The cabinet sees no reason to change the current status.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om de huidige status te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Monasch over de mogelijkheid voor consumenten om bij annulering van een vliegticket deze over te kunnen dragen aan een ander

MPs Jacobi and Monasch asked why consumers can transfer package holidays but not airline tickets, and whether the government would allow resale of cancelled flight tickets as proposed by TradeYourTrip. The minister answered that package transfers are governed by Civil Code rules, airline resale is banned by IATA-based airline terms, and that the government will consult industry and consumer groups and examine feasibility, fraud and safety implications.

I will, together with the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment, enter into discussions with the Consumentenbond, industry bodies such as ANVR and BARIN, and airlines to discuss the possibilities and implications.

Ik zal in samenwerking met de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu in gesprek gaan met de Consumentenbond, brancheorganisaties zoals de ANVR en de BARIN en luchtvaartmaatschappijen om de mogelijkheden en implicaties te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Volp over de dumpingen van drugs en ander (gevaarlijk) afval in Gelderland

MPs Cegerek and Volp asked about illegal dumping of drug-lab and other hazardous waste in Gelderland, including prosecution rates and cost-sharing. The minister answered that enforcement focuses on production and prosecution, that the 50% state funding applies only to drug waste, and that a provincial cooperation like those in Brabant and Limburg would be joined if Gelderland wants it.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat er eieren worden gegooid naar een conducteur en dat dit wordt gefilmd

An MP asked the government about a viral video showing eggs thrown at a train conductor, whether the perpetrator would be punished, whether such incidents are common among NS staff, and whether answers could be provided before a committee debate. The Minister confirmed awareness, described the existing police and prosecution agreements on assaults on public-facing workers, said the suspect had been arrested and the case is ongoing so no further comment is given, and reported no comparable incidents known at NS.
The investigation has not yet been concluded. I therefore cannot respond substantively to the case.
Op dit moment is het onderzoek nog niet afgesloten. Ik kan dan ook verder niet inhoudelijk reageren op de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over ‘het hoge aantal treinen met gevaarlijke stoffen op het spoor Amersfoort – Deventer’

An MP asked the state secretary why hazardous-goods trains on the Amersfoort–Deventer line far exceeded Basisnet risk ceilings, whether residents remain safe, and why municipalities are only informed afterwards. The secretary answered that Basisnet sets no binding norms for individual carriers, that risk contours keep homes outside the danger zone, and that consultations with carriers are underway, while reporting quarterly to municipalities.
It is precisely because of Basisnet that I am now consulting with carriers on measures to prevent exceedances in the future.
Het is juist vanwege Basisnet dat ik nu met vervoerders in overleg ben over maatregelen om overschrijdingen in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Smaling over ‘gevaarlijke stoffen op het spoor’

MPs Van Helvert and Smaling asked why reports showing that risk ceilings for hazardous goods on the rail network will be exceeded were not sent to parliament sooner, and about registration failures and the enforcement response. The state secretary answered that the quarterly reports were delivered in April and used for policy reflection, that the exceedances are being analysed with results expected in July, and that stricter enforcement by the ILT is being expanded, while declining to publish a list of offenders due to ongoing criminal prosecution.
Criminal prosecution is ongoing against the offenders of the statutory obligation to register hazardous substances, and public disclosure of such a list is not among the options.
Tegen de overtreders van de wettelijke verplichting tot registratie van gevaarlijke stoffen loopt een strafrechtelijke vervolging waarbij dergelijke openbaarmaking niet tot de mogelijkheden behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het artikel ‘Nationale prijsbodem CO2 bij EU ETS is geen oplossing’

An MP asked the state secretary about an article arguing a national CO2 price floor under the EU ETS is no solution, and about France's planned price floor and possible state aid to EDF. The state secretary said a national floor would not cut EU-wide emissions due to the waterbed effect, preferred EU-level action to reduce the surplus of allowances, and left the state aid question to the Commission.
It is for the Commission to determine whether there is unlawful state aid here.
Het is aan de Commissie om te bepalen of hier sprake is van ongeoorloofde staatssteun.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Fokke over het bericht ‘gesjoemel met gevaarlijke stoffen tussen Eindhoven en Venlo’

MPs Cegerek and Fokke asked whether hazardous goods were transported on the Eindhoven–Venlo route in breach of Basisnet rules, and what the consequences are for residents and the government's measures. The State Secretary denied that any category is banned, acknowledged risk-ceiling exceedances without homes being within the contour, said causes are being analysed with results expected in early July, and affirmed the Basisnet commitments still apply.
Before further concrete measures are taken, it is important that the causes are properly identified. I expect the outcome of this analysis at the beginning of July.
Voordat verdere concrete maatregelen worden genomen is het van belang dat de oorzaken goed in beeld zijn gebracht. Ik verwacht de uitkomsten van deze analyse begin juli.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het artikel ‘BCT-fabrikanten verwachten update deze maand uit te rollen’

An MP asked the State Secretary about delays in the BCT taxi on-board computer software update and how this affects the evaluation, enforcement and taxi operators. The government confirmed the update is delayed, that evaluation and enforcement start on schedule 1 July 2016 with full enforcement from 1 October 2016, and that the ILT will not fine honest operating mistakes during the transition period.
For the start of the evaluation it is not necessary that all BCTs are fitted with an update in order to record the first effects.
Voor de start van de evaluatie is het niet noodzakelijk dat alle BCT’s zijn voorzien van een update om de eerste effecten te kunnen optekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Smaling over het bericht dat de Belastingdienst een bom legt onder gratis OV voor ouderen

MPs Bashir and Smaling asked whether the Tax Authority should bring free public transport for elderly residents under the VAT compensation fund and why it targets Capelle aan den IJssel. The state secretary replied that providing free transport is a municipal choice, that the VAT compensation law excludes benefits given to individual third parties such as transport cards, and that the Capelle audit was routine supervision.
Whether or not to provide public transport free of charge is a decision made by decentralised governments.
Het al dan niet gratis verstrekken van OV is een afweging, die door decentrale overheden wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teeven over het bericht ‘Laat veteranen op 25 juni vrij reizen’

An MP asked whether post-active veterans may travel free by rail on Veterans Day, and whether this excludes actively serving veterans and their families. The government answered that post-active veterans get two free day-train cards per year via the Veterans Institute, with an extra card for a partner or companion when registered for the parade, while active-duty veterans claim travel costs through Defence.
Post-active veterans receive travel tickets via the Veterans Institute, because they cannot claim through the regular Defence channels.
Post-actieve veteranen krijgen vervoerbewijzen via het Veteraneninstituut, omdat zij niet via de reguliere Defensiekanalen kunnen declareren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Vrij reizen voor veteranen op Veteranendag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether free travel for veterans on Veteranendag could be extended to active veterans, and whether the government shares the view that veterans deserve more open recognition. The Minister of Defence answered that the 76 percent public support for veteran recognition is noted, that recognition policy is already in place, and that active veterans can already claim travel costs to veteran events.
Veterans in active service already have that option. They can claim travel to veterans' events.
Veteranen in werkelijke dienst hebben die mogelijkheid al. Zij kunnen reizen naar veteranenevenementen declareren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de toename van ronselende taxichauffeurs rondom Schiphol

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about the rise in taxi drivers recruiting and defrauding passengers around Schiphol, including whether licences can be revoked and whether bans can be imposed. The State Secretary said the problem is primarily a municipal public-order matter, that the ILT can suspend or withdraw driver cards for relevant offences, and that the parties involved are cooperating without committing to new national measures.
Whether there is recruiting can only be established by observing it on the spot.
Of sprake is van ronselen kan alleen worden vastgesteld door het ter plekke te constateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat NS stopt met het doorgeven van actuele treinposities

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary whether NS (Dutch Railways) had stopped sharing real-time train positions, and whether this harmed cooperation with travel-app developers and passenger transparency. The state secretary answered that NS only has the feature offline during a test-to-production transition of a few months, that NS is not obliged to supply train positions but is expected to do so, and that no reversal is needed.
The impression that NS has stopped passing on current train positions is not correct.
Het beeld dat NS is gestopt met het doorgeven van actuele treinposities is niet correct.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over het bericht 'Fransen kapen KLM’ en ‘Stakingsdreiging Air France: wat zijn de consequenties voor KLM'

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked about reports that Air France might shift KLM flights from Amsterdam to Paris amid strike threats, and about the strain on the KLM-Air France relationship. The State Secretary replied that Air France KLM denies such a plan, that cost-cutting is needed at both airlines, that the government opposes shifting capacity at KLM's expense, and that it will keep defending the public interests tied to KLM and Schiphol, promising a letter to the House.
We continue to commit to safeguarding the public interests involved with KLM and the main-port function of Schiphol.
We blijven ons inzetten voor de borging van de publieke belangen die met KLM en de mainportfunctie van Schiphol zijn gemoeid.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het onderzoek over de radargegevens van de OVV, de non-disclosure clausules in het JIT MH17 verdrag, het archief over de MH17 en de brieven van nabestaanden

An MP asks the government about radar data on MH17, JIT non-disclosure clauses, the MH17 archive, and letters from relatives to Ukraine, Russia and the US. The minister answers that the government took note of the OVV report, that JIT-related agreements are not public, that the archive is being indexed, and that the interview notes of the Twente evaluation cannot be disclosed.

The cabinet wants to avoid that starting a dispute procedure could be taken to mean that the Netherlands considers this data necessary to draw the conclusions of the OVV report and that the investigation must be reopened.

Het kabinet wil voorkomen dat uit het starten van een geschillenprocedure zou kunnen worden geconcludeerd dat Nederland van mening is dat deze gegevens nodig zijn voor het trekken van de conclusies van het OVV rapport en dat het onderzoek heropend moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Smaling en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat er door een drugs-lab giftige stoffen zijn vrij gekomen in een woonwijk in Tilburg

MPs asked the government how harmful the toxic release from a Tilburg drug lab was, how residents are being informed and trained to spot drug labs, and how many labs are dismantled and what resources are assigned. The minister answered that methanol and sulphuric acid were present, residents were informed by letter, training and a smell map are being rolled out in the south, and labour conditions at the dismantling unit were investigated and improved.
In any case it is an undesirable situation when a drug laboratory is found in a residential area.
Het is hoe dan ook een onwenselijke situatie als een drugslaboratorium in een woonwijk wordt aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over het gebruik van chroom-6 verf bij de NS-Werkplaats in Tilburg

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked the ministers about chromium-6 paint exposure among re-integration participants at the NS workshop in Tilburg, including health symptoms, protection, liability and an independent medical examination. The minister answered that the employer is primarily responsible, that liability is for civil courts, that a medical consultation is available via CAOP, and that NedTrain's internal review found chromium-6 risks at several current sites with additional measures taken.
Who is civilly liable for any damage suffered in this case is a matter that can be assessed by the civil judge.
Wie er in dit geval civielrechtelijk aansprakelijk is voor eventueel geleden schade is een kwestie die door de civiele rechter kan worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over Otapan

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether the state should recover the costs of cleaning up the Otapan toxic ship from its owners now that they are known, and what steps the government would take. The State Secretary answered that a 2012 cost-recovery effort was ended because the Dutch default judgment was not recognised in Mexico, and that she is now examining whether recovery from the company's director and owners is possible and appropriate, promising results before the summer recess.
The report you cite has given me reason to examine to what extent cost recovery from the director of the company Basilisk and the owners of that company is now possible and expedient.

Het door u aangehaalde bericht is voor mij aanleiding te onderzoeken in hoeverre kostenverhaal op de in het bericht genoemde bestuurder van de vennootschap Basilisk en de eigenaren van die vennootschap thans mogelijk en opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de resultaten van de meetcampagne luchtkwaliteit 2015 van Milieudefensie

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the Netherlands risks breaching EU nitrogen dioxide limits, citing a Milieudefensie measurement report, and what measures would follow, along with questions on speed-limit increases and low-emission zone signage. The State Secretary answered that only a limited number of NO2 hotspots remain, that additional funds were allocated for Amsterdam and Rotterdam, that compliance will be clear from the RIVM monitoring report at the end of the year, and that further measures will be decided then.
The monitoring over 2015, due at the end of this year, will show to what extent the standard was actually exceeded in 2015.
Uit de monitoring over 2015 die eind van dit jaar uitkomt, zal blijken in hoeverre er sprake is van daadwerkelijke overschrijding van de norm over 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het feit dat Milieudefensie de Staat voor de rechter heeft gedaagd om gezonde lucht

An MP asked the State Secretary about Milieudefensie's lawsuit against the State over air quality, a report showing NO2 norm exceedances in at least 11 places, the timeline for resolving them, and whether the air quality action plan would be accelerated and funded for areas beyond Amsterdam and Rotterdam. The State Secretary replied that the RIVM expects no NO2 knelpunten by 2020, that the 2015 monitoring report due at year-end will guide any adjustments to the action plan, and that existing NSL funds for local authorities remain the instrument, with additional measures to be decided after that report.
I have asked the RIVM to include the findings of Milieudefensie's research in the monitoring.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van Milieudefensie te betrekken in de monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over de schadelijke effecten van microplastics in kunstgras voetbalvelden

The MP Wassenberg asks whether artificial turf football pitches releasing a million kilos of microplastics yearly threaten the environment, why the RIVM study led to no further research, and whether new infill-based pitches should be banned. The State Secretary says the RIVM rates turf's contribution as limited, expects policy updates by year-end on other sources, and defers the turf question until then.
No statement can be made about the stated quantity of 1 million kilos of microplastics on the basis of the RIVM quick scan.
Over de genoemde hoeveelheid van 1 miljoen kilo microplastics kan op grond van de quick scan van het RIVM geen uitspraak worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de geplande toegangspoorten op station Amsterdam Zuid

An MP from ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary whether requiring bus-to-tram transfers at Amsterdam Zuid to check in and out four times, and whether a gate-free passage could be provided. The State Secretary answered that the gates are a safety measure, that gate-free passage via Minerva exists, that widening Britten would cost over 10 million euro without budget, and that the public-transport interest is small.
However, the number of passengers transferring from bus to tram is a very small percentage of the total number of passengers at the station.
Het aantal overstappers van bus naar tram betreft echter een zeer klein percentage van het totale aantal reizigers op het station.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Elias over de brandbrief van Europese luchtvaartmaatschappijen over de ‘kwestie Gibraltar’

An MP asked the state secretary about a letter from European airlines complaining that the long-running Gibraltar dispute delays EU aviation legislation (SES2+, passenger rights, airport slots) and raises costs, and asked about Dutch EU presidency involvement and the timeline. The secretary acknowledged the delay, said the Netherlands and the Commission urge a solution as honest broker, and said a breakthrough is unlikely before the Spanish elections on 26 June.
As Chair we will continue to encourage both parties to reach a solution.
Als Voorzitter zullen we beide partijen blijven aanmoedigen om tot een oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over fraude met NS-abonnementen

An MP asked the state secretary about fraud with NS rail subscriptions via fake names and foreign bank accounts, and whether the subscription system would be reviewed. The secretary said NS had closed the control gap, added a checks, that transport operators are responsible for their own fraud measures, and declined to review the system.
It is not for me but for transport operators to take measures to prevent fraud when taking out subscriptions.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan vervoerders om maatregelen te treffen om fraude bij de abonnementsafsluiting tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht dat milieuzones in steden worden tegengewerkt

An MP asked whether the minister was obstructing city low-emission zones by delaying a uniform road sign and extending zones to lighter vehicles, despite a 2012 motion and requests from four municipalities.
