The minister answered that the sign delay stemmed from a Council of State advisory and redesign, that the passenger-car extension was dropped after a Visser motion, and that municipal zones are a local choice with local accountability.
To implement the Visser motion, the proposed amendment will drop the extension of the environmental zone sign to passenger cars.
Om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Visser zal uit de voorgenomen wijziging het voorstel tot uitbreiding van het milieuzonebord naar personenauto's worden geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over de bestuursrechtelijke uitspraak inzake de Utrechtse milieuzone

MPs Visser and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the government to respond to a court ruling that found the Utrecht environmental zone decision insufficiently reasoned, questioning the proportionality of environmental zones for passenger cars and the evidence on their air-quality effects. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible for such zones, that the ruling leaves the zone in force, that the proposed extension to passenger cars would be dropped in line with a motion, and that effects and alternatives are for the municipality to assess, with an evaluation expected.
To implement the Visser motion, the proposal to extend the environmental zone sign to passenger cars will be removed from this planned amendment.
Om uitvoering te geven aan de motie Visser zal uit deze voorgenomen wijziging het voorstel tot uitbreiding van het milieuzonebord naar personenauto's worden geschrapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Boer en Remco Dijkstra naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan de Waalhaven in Rotterdam op 25 april 2016

The MPs De Boer and Dijkstra (VVD) asked the state secretary about freight rail compensation for the German Betuweroute works, hazardous-goods transit under the Basisnet, rail capacity, usage charges, permits and information sharing. The state secretary answered in detail, noting State aid approval for compensation, that Basisnet exceedances are being investigated, and that she will inform parliament soon, but declined to commit to a usage-charge evaluation before summer.
I am consulting the sector to map as quickly as possible the causes of these exceedances and which measures can be taken.
Ik ben in overleg met de sector om zo snel mogelijk in kaart te brengen wat de oorzaken zijn van deze overschrijdingen en welke maatregelen genomen kunnen worden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema, De Boer en Visser over de adviesaanvraag dienstregeling 2017 en de diverse nieuwsberichten over de te verwachten chaos in het (openbaar) vervoer in Noord-Kennemerland vanaf

Three VVD MPs asked the government about NS's 2017 timetable request for Noord-Kennemerland, the planned Velsertunnel closure and the risk of rail and road disruption and overcrowding in the region. The State Secretary answered that NS will adopt some stopping changes at Heiloo and Castricum, that the timetable is NS's responsibility, that Rijkswaterstaat has a mitigation plan, and that NS is monitoring capacity without having quantified combined economic impacts.
The timetable is the responsibility and expertise of NS.
De dienstregeling is de verantwoordelijkheid en deskundigheid van NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over het advies van de Raad van State op het ontwerpbesluit dat het Besluit gewasbeschermingsmiddelen en biociden wijzigt en de reactie van de regering hierop

An MP asks why the government will not, on the basis of the Council of State's advice, adopt a ban on non-professional pesticide use on paved surfaces and instead allows it for now, and whether it will extend the ban to unpaved surfaces, as the Council's advice and a motion suggest. The state secretary answers that the Council found no legal basis for a private-use ban, so immediate entry into force was excluded, and that she will inform parliament before the summer recess on options and on extending the measures to unpaved areas.
The Council of State's view is that there is no legal basis for a ban on private use on paved surfaces.
Het oordeel van de Raad van State is dat er geen wettelijke grondslag is voor een verbod op het particulier gebruik op verhardingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over subsidiegelden

An MP asks how much the central government paid in 2014, 2015 and 2016 to environmental and nature organisations (Greenpeace, Milieudefensie, Natuur en Milieu, Urgenda, Sea Shepherd, IUCN, Wakker Dier), what they do with it, whether they also receive Postcode Loterij funds, and whether government funding of groups that protest against the government is appropriate. The government answers with detailed subsidy tables per organisation and project, notes that Postcode Loterij grants are not accounted to the state, and states that protest against government conduct is possible within the uniform subsidy framework.
Government subsidy payments are published as open data via Rijksbegroting.nl.
De subsidiebetalingen van de rijksoverheid worden gepubliceerd als open data via Rijksbegroting.nl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de punctualiteitscijfers van de IC Direct

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the State Secretary about falling punctuality and rising cancellations of the IC Direct train and who is responsible. The State Secretary acknowledged the poor performance, attributed most cancellations to NS, committed to a joint improvement programme with NS and ProRail, and said new performance indicators will be agreed from 2017.
This is for me a reason to make further agreements with NS and ProRail on improvement and to record these agreements in an improvement programme.
Dit is voor mij een reden om met NS en ProRail nadere afspraken te maken over verbetering en deze afspraken vast te leggen in een verbeterprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Volp over de verschuiving van drugsdumpingen van Noord-Brabant naar Gelderland

PvdA MPs Cegerek and Volp asked about the shift of illegal drug-waste dumping from Noord-Brabant to Gelderland, including enforcement capacity and the role of environmental services. The Minister largely referred to earlier answers, said he lacks an overview of enforcement capacity per province, attributed dumping patterns to the location of synthetic drug labs and offenders' choice of distant dumping sites, and described existing cross-agency cooperation in Brabant and Limburg.
I do not have an overview of the requested ratios in enforcement capacity.
Ik heb geen overzicht van de gevraagde verhoudingen in handhavingscapaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over dumping van drugsafval in Gelderland

ChristenUnie MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about the rise in illegal drug-waste dumping in Gelderland, including the cost-sharing fund, dumping figures, offender liability and cooperation with provinces. The government answered that it had not contacted Gelderland, that dumping appears to shift from Brabant toward neighbouring provinces, that a 1 million euro cofinancing fund covers all provinces with a review due by 1 September, and that it will not change its drug enforcement approach.
The total subsidy requested remains well below the available amount of 1 million euros, and the number of applications is also smaller than expected.
Het totaal aan gevraagde subsidie blijft ruim onder het beschikbare bedrag van € 1 miljoen en ook het aantal aanvragen is kleiner dan verwacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over drones bij Schiphol

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary whether stricter drone rules are needed after a drone flew close to landing aircraft at Schiphol, and how public awareness and enforcement can be improved. The government answers that existing rules already prohibit flying in controlled airspace without permission, plans to intensify public communication and talks with manufacturers on geofencing, and says the police and Marechaussee are alert to incidents and have arrested two drone operators.
In addition, I will soon consult with the largest producers of recreational drones about the possibilities of voluntarily applying technology to make flying near airports impossible.

Daarnaast overleg ik binnenkort met de grootste producenten van recreatieve drones om met hen te spreken over de mogelijkheden van vrijwillige toepassing van technologie om vliegen in de buurt van luchthavens onmogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de uitvoerbaarheid van het asbestdakenverbod

An MP asked the State Secretary about the feasibility of the 2024 asbestos roof ban, covering costs, subsidies, contractor capacity, information provision and a possible notification duty. The State Secretary answered that the government will support the ban with subsidies and the Versnellingsaanpak programme, that the 35 m2 self-removal limit will be kept, and that a national notification duty is hard to enforce, while promising progress reports.
I currently see no reason to reduce the 35 m2 limit.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de grens van 35 m 2 te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Veldhoven over hormoon verstorende stoffen en de relatie met de volksgezondheid

MPs Dijkstra and Van Veldhoven asked the Minister of Health about national and EU measures to reduce exposure to BPA and other hormone-disrupting substances, including prenatal advice, cancer trends and costs. The Minister replied that hospital and industry agreements, pressure on EFSA and the EU, and further research and advice updates are under way, with no firm timelines for some measures.
I have submitted the RIVM report to the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) and urged it to reconsider the tolerable daily intake (TDI) standard in light of the new insights.

Ik heb het RIVM-rapport aan de Europese Autoriteit voor Voedselveiligheid (EFSA) aangeboden en er op aangedrongen de norm voor de toelaatbare dagelijkse inname (Tolerabele Daily Intake, TDI) op grond van de nieuwe inzichten opnieuw te bezien.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving van Luchtvaartnieuws en Russia Today over oververmoeidheid en intimidatie bij het personeel van de vliegtuigmaatschappijen Emirates en Flydubai

An SP MP asked the state secretary about reports that Emirates and Flydubai pilots are overfatigued and intimidated, and whether this affects aviation safety. The state secretary answered that the UAE authorities are responsible for oversight of these airlines, that ILT spot checks found no verifiable fatigue incidents, and that an independent investigation into the Flydubai crash is ongoing.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het herzien van de wijze waarop het ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu inbreng levert in onderzoeken en het onafhankelijk onderzoek naar de aanschaf van de Search and Rescu

An MP asked whether the ministry of Infrastructure and Environment would set rules on its input into studies, and why it did not disclose its involvement in the independent SAR helicopter study. The minister said internal guidance and an inter-departmental integrity process were underway, that the ministry was the commissioning party for the SAR study, and that involvement by Rijkswaterstaat did not compromise the study's independence.
The subject has since been raised in the Inter-departmental Platform on Integrity Management.
Het onderwerp is inmiddels ingebracht in het Interdepartementaal Platform Integriteitsmanagement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over het bericht dat vliegreizen stilletjes duurder worden

An MP asked whether surcharges for hold baggage on flight tickets mislead consumers and should be stopped, and what role the market authority ACM should play. The minister answered that such fees are avoidable options that must be shown transparently, that ACM monitors compliance, and that he sees no reason to consult airlines on the matter.
It is up to the ACM to monitor this.
Het is aan de ACM om hier controle op te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Veldhoven over het gegeven dat de Rijksoverheid samenwerkt met de tabaksfirma Japan Tobacco International (JTI)

MPs Dijkstra and Van Veldhoven asked whether government co-operation with tobacco company JTI, via the Green Deal Schone Stranden on cigarette litter, complies with FCTC article 5.3. The state secretary answered that continuing the Green Deal in its current form is no longer acceptable and that the government will explore continuing it without the tobacco industry as a party.
I am of the opinion that continuing the GDSS in its current form is no longer acceptable in light of the current interpretation of article 5.3 of the WHO Framework Convention.
Ik ben van mening dat voortzetting van de GDSS in de huidige vorm niet meer acceptabel is gelet op de huidige invulling van artikel 5.3 WHO-kaderverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de aanbesteding voor nieuwe politieauto’s

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked whether the police tender for new patrol cars requiring diesel engines and a 140 g/km CO2 limit, and lacking further climate criteria, is consistent with air quality and sustainable procurement goals. The government answered that the diesel requirement will be dropped from the final programme of requirements, that the police are considering sustainability criteria, and that fiscal incentives (BPM and MRB exemptions) make diesel economically attractive for high-mileage vehicles.
However, this requirement will be dropped and will therefore not form part of the final programme of requirements.
Deze eis zal echter worden geschrapt en zal dus geen onderdeel uitmaken van het definitief programma van eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het Franse voornemen een verbod af te kondigen op neonicotinoïden in verband met hun rol in de zorgwekkende bijensterfte

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government about a French parliamentary move to ban neonicotinoid pesticides from 2018 and whether the Netherlands would pursue a total ban. The Secretary of State answered that the French proposal is not final and not yet notified to the EU, that the Dutch government considers the earlier motions unenforceable under EU regulation 1107/2009, and that a total ban is not appropriate given recent EFSA reassessments, while promising to inform parliament of relevant developments.
A total ban is, in my view and based on recent reassessments of the active substances in the neonicotinoid group, not an option.
Een totaalverbod is naar mijn inzicht en op basis van recente herbeoordelingen van de werkzame stoffen uit de neonicotinoïdengroep niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het bericht “betalen is brevet behalen”

An MP asked the state secretary about a report on the CAE Oxford Aviation Academy Amsterdam, including its oversight, the loosening of training requirements, the lack of sanctions, profit motives, and ABN AMRO ending pilot loans. The secretary said oversight passed to the British authority in 2014, that EU standards were unchanged, that access to training is mainly a sector matter, and that she will facilitate talks between the parties.
Since that date, supervision has been carried out by the British authority.
Sinds die datum vindt toezicht plaats door de Britse autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Marcouch over passagiers die grote vertraging hebben opgelopen op Schiphol door een overboekt vliegtuig

MPs Monasch and Marcouch asked the state secretary about passengers held for hours on an Air Arabia flight from Amsterdam to Nador, and how compensation, enforcement and in-flight care are handled. The government answered that a sudden crew illness forced offloading of 21 passengers on a voluntary basis, that the ILT found no violation, and that the ILT enforces the EU passenger rights regulation through complaints and inspections.
Based on the information currently available, the ILT has found no violation, so enforcement action is not at issue.
Op basis van de nu beschikbare informatie heeft de ILT geen overtreding geconstateerd, daarom is optreden niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Houwers over lange(re) wachttijden bij de inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport

An MP asked whether the Inspectorate for the Environment and Transport (ILT) has longer waiting times for aircraft checks and medical certification of pilots, and how these are addressed. The state secretary answered that there are no delays for aircraft inspections, that longer medical review times occur only in special cases referred to ILT, and that the workflow is being improved and doctors informed.
Requesting an inspection from the ILT is not possible.
Het aanvragen van een inspectie bij de ILT is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over het bericht “National Parliaments should approve Paris Climate Agreement before it is a done deal”

MP Remco Dijkstra (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the Paris Climate Agreement: EU signature and ratification, whether the agreement is legally binding, the costs and uncertainties of implementation, and the Commission's statements on policy flexibility. The State Secretary answered that the EU and member states will sign separately, ratify together after national procedures, that only the agreement's procedural obligations are binding (NDCs are not), and that the government will inform parliament on costs during ratification.
During the ratification procedure, your House will be further informed about these consequences.
Tijdens de ratificatieprocedure wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over deze consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over de brand bij een transportbedrijf in Duiven

MP Cegerek asked whether the fire at a Duiven transport company was a known risk business, whether supervision was adequate, what the health risks were, and what lessons follow. The government answered that the municipality, not the regional environmental service, was responsible for supervision, the cause could no longer be determined, and a multidisciplinary evaluation would identify lessons learned.
The company falls under the general rules of the Activities Decree.
Het bedrijf valt onder de algemene regels van het Activiteitenbesluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Rog over studenten in verzet tegen NS

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government shares unions' view that NS blames overcrowded trains on education and whether students are being consulted about off-peak travel plans. The government rejects the blame framing, says NS is responsible for capacity, that no negotiations exist but exploratory talks are ongoing, and that students will be involved in follow-up talks.
NS cannot and will not unilaterally refuse students in the peak hours.
NS kan niet en zal niet eenzijdig studenten weigeren in de spits.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de uitbreiding van het treinaanbod Leiden-Utrecht en Alphen aan den Rijn-Gouda

An ChristenUnie MP asked about delays to rail upgrades on Leiden–Utrecht and Alphen aan den Rijn–Gouda, including NS's refusal to guarantee service at new stations and the postponed frequency increases. The State Secretary answered that the project is a provincial responsibility, that options are being studied with NS and ProRail, and that no Rijk intervention is planned at this stage.
It is not a national government project but a provincial project.
Het is geen Rijksproject, maar een project van de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de werkdruk voor de beveiligers op Schiphol is toegenomen

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment, on behalf of the Justice Minister, how the government responds to union warnings that rising workload for Schiphol security staff creates safety and health risks, and why the new security system has not reduced pressure. The government says a TNO study on the workload is nearly finished, the Marechaussee sees no safety concerns in its oversight, and the employers and unions are responsible for working conditions with the results to be discussed in April.
It is the employer's task, i.e. the security companies, to ensure good working conditions and to shape the prevention of occupational risks, with the consent of the employees.
Het is de taak van de werkgever, i.c. de beveiligingsbedrijven, te zorgen voor goede arbeidsomstandigheden en om -met instemming van de werknemers- de preventie van arbeidsrisico’s vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de gifuitstoot van de afvaloven in Harlingen

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked the State Secretary about a technical fault at the Harlingen waste incinerator that raised dioxin emissions for two days in October 2015, and about health risks, causes, measures and monitoring. The government answered that the province and municipality found no clear effect on local dioxin levels, that the province imposed penalty-backed orders on the operator, and that monitoring is carried out under accredited, independent measurement rules.
The province of Fryslân has instructed REC Harlingen to make additional efforts within two months to further reduce dioxin emissions during malfunctions and the chance of malfunctions.
De provincie Fryslân heeft REC Harlingen opgedragen binnen twee maanden extra inspanningen te verrichten om de dioxine-emissie tijdens storingen en de kans op storingen verder omlaag te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de handhaving REC dioxine-uitstoot

An MP asked the state secretary about dioxin emissions exceeding norms at the REC Harlingen waste incinerator, alleged structural bypass use, faulty dust meters, and whether the national inspectorate ILT was informed. The secretary acknowledged elevated dioxin emissions in October 2015, said the province of Fryslân is responsible for supervision and enforcement, and said the ILT is examining the province's performance after receiving a signal of possible tolerance.
The province of Fryslân is responsible for supervision of the company.
De provincie Fryslân is verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht op het bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hoogland over mogelijke maatregelen naar aanleiding van de gepleegde fraude met dieselauto’s

MPs Hoogland asked the government about possible measures following the diesel emissions fraud at Volkswagen, covering prosecution, regulation, testing (WLTP and RDE), type approval and fiscal options. The government answered that no facts currently justify a criminal investigation, that Dutch national bans on type-approved diesel cars are legally excluded, and that it is pursuing stricter EU-level testing and market surveillance rules.
There are currently no facts or circumstances known on the basis of which the Public Prosecution Service can start a criminal investigation.
Er zijn thans geen feiten of omstandigheden bekend geworden op grond waarvan het Openbaar Ministerie een strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de intercity Dordrecht-Breda

MP Bruins asks the State Secretary about the Dordrecht–Breda intercity, the regional costs of its loss, and whether NS and the regions were given feasibility analyses of alternatives. The State Secretary answers that a two-year intercity was decided, that several alternatives were examined with NS, that NS cannot be obliged to carry the operating deficit, and that she is willing to look broadly for a structural solution.
I am willing to realise an intercity connection Dordrecht-Breda for a period of two years.
Ik ben bereid om voor een periode van twee jaar een intercityverbinding Dordrecht-Breda te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Luchtkwaliteit in gevaar door 130 kilometer per uur’

Two MPs asked the minister whether raising motorway speed limits to 130 km/h complies with environmental and safety norms, and questioned RIVM and TNO statements on air quality. The minister answered that the speed increases were tested against safety and environmental conditions, that monitoring shows no norm exceedances after the increase, and that the RIVM and TNO statements do not contradict the NSL 2015 report.
The speed increases of 5 February were – as with previous speed increases – tested against safety and environmental preconditions.
De snelheidsverhogingen van 5 februari zijn – evenals voorgaande snelheidsverhogingen – getoetst aan randvoorwaarden van veiligheid en milieu.
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Cegerek en Jacobi over de gevolgen van jarenlang gebruik van PFOA bij Dupont in Dordrecht

MPs Cegerek and Jacobi asked about long-term PFOA use at DuPont (now Chemours) in Dordrecht, including undisclosed blood test results, unpermitted emissions, drinking water contamination, and calls for a population health study. The state secretary answered that the company is responsible for sharing blood results, that a RIVM exposure study and an Inspectie SZW investigation are underway, that polluter-pays rules apply, and that a stricter drinking water guideline is being prepared.

For privacy reasons and because of the medical confidentiality of the company doctor, results traceable to individual employees may not simply be shared with the Labour Inspectorate (or any other government body).

Uit privacyoverwegingen en vanwege het medisch beroepsgeheim van de betrokken bedrijfsarts mogen naar individuele werknemers herleidbare uitslagen niet zonder meer met de Inspectie SZW (of enig ander overheidsorgaan) worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Helvert over de onderzoeken naar de vliegramp bij Faro en de mogelijke heropening van dat onderzoek door de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OVV)

MPs Omtzigt and Van Helvert asked whether new facts justify asking the OVV to reopen the Faro air disaster investigation, and why the Netherlands seeks reopening of the Portuguese report, with questions on confidentiality, expert access to documents, and maintenance responsibility. The State Secretary answered that the OVV was asked to assess new relevant facts, that the Portuguese authority alone can reopen the investigation, that ICAO rules restrict disclosure of records, and that the aircraft was found airworthy and maintenance-deferral records remain unverified.
I have not asked the OVV to reopen the Portuguese investigation.
Ik heb de OVV niet gevraagd het Portugese onderzoek te heropenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het artikel uit het Financieel Dagblad van 29 februari 2016 over ‘ABN AMRO staakt financiering pilotenopleiding’

An MP asked the State Secretary whether ABN AMRO withdrawing financing for pilot training makes the training inaccessible, what alternatives exist, and what the government will do to safeguard quality and access. The State Secretary answered that pilot training is primarily the sector's responsibility, that quality is guaranteed through EASA rules and inspection, and that she will facilitate talks between the parties and report back.
The pilot training institutions are private bodies and are primarily a matter for the aviation sector.
De pilotenopleidingen zijn private instellingen en zijn primair een aangelegenheid van de luchtvaartsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de wens van Rotterdam The Hague Airport om ze snel mogelijk uit te breiden

Member Smaling (SP) asked the state secretary how she views Rotterdam The Hague Airport's push for rapid, substantial expansion, whether talks with the airport director took place, and what noise and fine-particle impacts are expected. The state secretary replied that the airport's environmental impact report and economic analysis are being reviewed, that she expects a regional consensus before an airport decision application, and that she will assess the plans only once the application is filed, with the environmental report to be tested by the Commission for Environmental Assessment.
I will await the application for the airport decision and will then make a substantive assessment.
Ik wacht de aanvraag voor het luchthavenbesluit af en zal op dat moment inhoudelijk een afweging maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie jarenlang te makkelijk nieuwe bestrijdingsmiddelen heeft toegelaten

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked the State Secretary whether the European Commission's lax approval of pesticides, flagged by the European Ombudsman, endangers health and environment and what the Netherlands will do about it, including holding producers liable. The State Secretary answered that there is no reason to believe safety is at risk, that the Ctgb assessed the confirmatory data positively, that the Commission has accepted the Ombudsman's recommendations, and that no further tightening of authorisation policy is currently needed.
I consider this ruling a reason to tighten the current procedures.
Ik vind deze uitspraak aanleiding om de huidige procedures aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het onderzoeksrapport naar statiegeld van het Wageningen University and Researchcentre (WUR)

An MP asked the state secretary about press reports that ministry officials intensively shaped a WUR study on deposit schemes, whether the study was biased, and what follows from the research integrity committee's judgment on it. The state secretary replied that the ministry asked WUR to add a societal-cost perspective and speed up the study, that the committee's assessment of WUR's quality is for the committee alone, and that the Framework Agreement on packaging remains in place with its evaluation planned for 2017.
Apart from WUR's publication on its website, the ministry has no further knowledge of this matter.
Het ministerie heeft, naast de publicatie van de WUR op haar website, geen verdere kennis van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de onderzoeken naar de kosten en baten van het statiegeldsysteem

An MP asks whether the ministry's involvement in a Wageningen University study on the costs of the deposit system, commissioned by industry stakeholders and later revised with ministry input, breached integrity rules and whether the study remains reliable. The State Secretary answers that the ministry did give informal input, that no explicit rules govern such involvement, that additional agreements are needed, and that a TNO comparison and the 2017 framework-agreement evaluation will address costs.
Moreover, I believe that additional agreements are needed on this last point.
Overigens meen ik dat er op dit laatste punt aanvullende afspraken nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkstra over het artikel ' Wagenings onderzoek statiegeld onzorgvuldig'

An MP asked the state secretary about a Trouw article alleging that a Wageningen research report on deposit schemes (statiegeld) was influenced by the ministry and that complaints were filed against it, and about NGO influence on postponing abolition of the deposit. The secretary said the ministry was not the commissioning party, acknowledged contact with the researchers to broaden the cost analysis and speed up the report, and said the 2015 decision not to release the deposit stands and will be assessed in the 2017 evaluation.
For further information I refer you to the WUR.
Voor nadere informatie verwijs ik u naar de WUR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat 2.000 chauffeurs in het streekvervoer dreigen met stakingen

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked whether drivers' threatened strikes over volunteers replacing paid bus drivers in regional transport are justified, and how provinces handle the Brede doeluitkering and bus line cuts. The State Secretary says provinces are responsible for public transport concessions, that volunteer arrangements are possible where no employment relationship or cao applies, and that she will consult provinces and metropolitan regions before reporting back to parliament.
Specifically regarding public transport, the provinces are responsible for the supply and the concession contract.
Specifiek met betrekking tot het openbaar vervoer (OV) zijn de provincies verantwoordelijk voor het aanbod en het concessiecontract.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over het evacueren van reizigers uit gestrande treinen

MP Bruins (ChristenUnie) asked about long delays evacuating passengers from stranded trains on the main rail network and the HSL, and whether promised procedures and quick-win measures were followed. Staatssecretaris Dijksma acknowledged procedures were not followed in several incidents, promised a joint NS/ProRail evaluation and an ILT investigation, but gave no full overview of stranded-train evaluations.
I do not receive a report on every stranded train and therefore cannot send them to your House.
Ik ontvang niet over elke gestrande trein een rapport en kan dat dus niet naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de toekomst van vracht op Schiphol en de rol van de KLM hierin

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about the future of air cargo at Schiphol, KLM's role, the reduction of Martinair's freighter fleet and possible unfair competition from Gulf carriers. The State Secretary answered that air cargo remains core for Air France KLM, that fleet reduction reflects global overcapacity, that cargo access is assessed case by case rather than open skies, and that Schiphol's cargo strategy and Smartgate project aim to keep handling quality high.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Çegerek en Dikkers over het gebruik van hormoonverstorende stoffen in voedingsverpakkingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked the ministers about hormone-disrupting substances such as BPA in food packaging, the protective measures, alternatives, and Dutch EU presidency efforts. The government answered that BPA exposure should be reduced through tighter EU limits rather than a ban, as substitutes are not yet proven safe, and committed to raising the issue at the Environment Council.
The Cabinet therefore adopts the RIVM advice to promote tightening of the current European standards and to reduce exposure to BPA as far as possible at national level.

Het Kabinet neemt daarom de adviezen van het RIVM over om aanscherping van de huidige Europese normen te bevorderen en om op nationaal niveau de blootstelling aan BPA zo ver mogelijk terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya, Verhoeven, Van Veldhoven en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht ‘Bontkragen van kinderjassen vol schadelijk gif’

D66 MPs asked whether mislabelling of fur-trimmed children's jackets and possible toxic substances warranted action, and whether the NVWA should have flagged the issue proactively. The minister said labelling rules are already set at EU level, toxic levels were below legal norms per NVWA and RIVM, and a formal NVWA risk assessment is pending with advice expected end of March.
I have asked the NVWA to have its risk assessment of the Kassa research reviewed by the RIVM.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht haar risico-inschatting van het onderzoek van Kassa te laten toetsen door het RIVM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Madlener over het bericht dat NS schikt met omstreden bestuurder en antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de schikking met NS-fraudeurs

MPs Madlener, Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the government about reports that NS settled employment contracts with controversial managers linked to irregularities in the Limburg concession tender, and asked for the settlement terms. The Minister of Finance answered that NS's board handles such labour matters under Dutch law, that the state was not involved and the shareholder has no role, so the contents cannot be disclosed by the government.
I therefore cannot inform you about the exact course and content of the agreed settlements, because I do not have that information.
Ik kan u dan ook niet informeren over het exacte verloop en de inhoud van de overeengekomen schikkingen, omdat ik niet over die informatie beschik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Financiën over de schikking met NS-fraudeurs

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked why NS settled employment contracts with executives involved in the Limburg concession tender irregularities despite the minister's earlier promise of no severance payments, and about the amounts, timeline and whether the state approved them. The minister answered that the NS board handled the settlements under employment law, that the state as shareholder has no role in ordinary employee dismissals, that he does not know the individual amounts, and that the settlements avoided costly litigation.
It is not for the shareholder to make this information public. That is for the company itself.
Het is niet aan de aandeelhouder om deze informatie publiek te maken. Dat is aan de onderneming zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins, Hoogland, Smaling en Van Helvert over het sluiten van overwegen door ProRail

MPs from four parties asked the State Secretary about ProRail's closure of level crossings, including the Laantje van Alverna private crossing, the status of a QuickScan on 100 unsupervised crossings, and how recreational interests are weighed. The State Secretary answered that ProRail follows the agreed procedure with the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking, that recreational interests are weighed in the Omgevingswet process, and that clarification on definitions will follow in spring 2016.
Nevertheless, I note that there is uncertainty between ProRail and the other members of the Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking about some definitions in the procedure.
Niettemin constateer ik dat er tussen ProRail en de overige leden van de Stuurgroep Infrastructurele Barrièrewerking over sommige definities uit de procedure onduidelijkheid bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Albert de Vries over het gevaar van betonblokken

MPs Cegerek and Albert de Vries asked whether concrete blocks containing waste (including lead-containing cathode-ray tube glass and fluorescent tubes) pose risks to people and the environment, how many accidents occurred, and whether stricter controls are needed. The State Secretary answered that cathode-ray tube glass processing is a permitted practice, that the RIVM advises against it, that existing permits are not criminal, that new insights will be shared with the regional authorities and the third national waste plan, and that the only reported accident is with the public prosecutor, so no conclusion on stricter controls can be drawn.

I will present the new insights to the environmental services that are the competent authorities for the producers of concrete blocks and will also include these insights in the upcoming third National Waste Management Plan (LAP3).

Ik zal de nieuwe inzichten voorleggen aan de omgevingsdiensten die bevoegd gezag zijn voor de producenten van betonblokken en deze inzichten tevens opnemen in het komende derde Landelijk Afvalbeheerplan (LAP3).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat bewoners in Wateringen nog steeds blootgesteld worden aan asbest

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about reports that residents of Wateringen remain exposed to asbestos a year after a major fire, and about whether municipalities are equipped to handle such incidents, including a rapid response force, asbestos removal certification and insurance. The State Secretary answered that the GGD judges health risks as negligible, the province sees no need for further supervisory steps as the municipality has a plan of action, an updated national asbestos fire plan is due around September 2016, a rapid response force is not considered useful, and certification compliance has improved; on insurance she will consult the insurers' association.
The province currently sees no reason to take further steps from its supervisory role.
De provincie ziet op dit moment geen aanleiding om verdere stappen te zetten vanuit haar toezichthoudende rol.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over de gevolgen van het Besluit huisvesting

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked why small extensions of traditional barns were not exempted from the new emission requirements in the final Besluit huisvesting, and whether the government will consult the sector on exempting them. The State Secretary confirmed the change from the draft was made after consultation, explained that traditional barns cannot use the alternative, and promised to check the reported problems with the sector and consider adjusting the technical requirements in the leaflets.
I will consult with the sector to see whether they have proposals for amending these leaflets
Ik zal in overleg met de sector na gaan of zij wijzigingsvoorstellen hebben voor deze leaflets
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het onderzoek dat loopt naar de mogelijkheden om piloten met Insulin-Treated Diabetes Mellitus (ITDM) alsnog te laten vliegen

An MP asked whether the Dutch government would join the UK study allowing pilots with insulin-treated diabetes to fly, and whether it would commission a second opinion on the restrictions imposed. The State Secretary answered that the UK authority would not accept the additional Dutch conditions (no take-offs/landings, third pilot only), so the government will await the UK study results and EASA's follow-up and sees no added value in a second opinion now.
I am awaiting the results of the British study and any follow-up steps by EASA.
Ik wacht de resultaten van het Britse onderzoek af en de eventuele vervolgstappen van EASA.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Hoogland over eenvoudige compensatie voor treinreizigers die achterblijven op het perron

MP Hoogland asked whether NS's structural capacity shortage justifies a simple compensation scheme for passengers left behind on overcrowded trains. The State Secretary answered that NS has no such scheme, that individual eligibility is hard to verify, and that monitoring and an external review with consumer groups will follow instead.
Of course I will continue to closely monitor the implementation of the measures announced by NS to see whether NS continues to meet the requirements of the concession.
Uiteraard blijf ik de uitvoering van de door NS aangekondigde maatregelen nauwgezet monitoren om te bezien of de NS blijft voldoen aan de vereisten uit de concessie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat de gemeente Amersfoort overgaat tot grootschalige kap en het gebruik van Roundup in parkbos Nimmerdor

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about Amersfoort's large-scale felling and use of Roundup in the Nimmerdor park forest, questioning whether alternatives were used and whether public health was at risk. The State Secretary said the pesticide rules are being tightened, that the municipality's approach fits current policy, and that the ministry has no competence over the municipal management decision, so no talks with the municipality would change it.
The ministry has no competence or responsibility in this matter.
Het ministerie heeft daarin geen bevoegdheid of verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de tarieven van de Kiwa die taxi’s betalen voor een vergunning

An MP asks the state secretary why Kiwa's fees for a taxi entrepreneur's operating permit remain near 1,500 euro after the professional-competence requirement was dropped, and whether Kiwa's tariffs must be cost-covering and why the savings are not passed on. The state secretary confirms the requirement was dropped, says tariffs are being reviewed with the ILT and that the savings will be considered in a separate letter, and states that Kiwa processes applications within the legal 12-week term (target 15 days) with no backlogs.
I will inform you about this in a separate letter to the House.
Ik informeer u daarover in een afzonderlijke kamerbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over minder toezicht op de veiligheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the state secretary whether oversight of aviation safety in the Netherlands has been reduced and whether defects are under-reported, citing an AEI executive and an EASA report. The state secretary rejected claims of reduced oversight, said inspections found no elevated risk, and pointed to the Basic Regulation proposal, promising a BNC-fiche.
I do not recognise the claim that governments are increasingly withdrawing and no longer have a good overview, at the expense of safety.
Ik herken me niet in de uitspraak dat overheden zich steeds meer terug trekken en geen goed overzicht meer hebben ten koste van de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat glyfosaat gaat gebruiken op de kribben in de IJssel

An SP MP asked the government about reports that Rijkswaterstaat would use glyphosate on river groynes in the IJssel, and whether this was assessed against drinking-water and water-quality rules. The minister answered that glyphosate is currently legally permitted for treating tree stumps, that its use is targeted and limited to dry weather in the growing season with negligible water impact, and that no permit is required for this maintenance.
For this type of maintenance work there is no permit requirement, but there are rules for safe and sustainable use.
Er is bij dit type beheer en onderhoudswerk geen sprake van een vergunningsplicht, wel zijn er voorschriften voor veilig en duurzaam gebruik
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Jacobi over het bericht dat Rijkswaterstaat een omstreden onkruidverdelger in wil zetten langs de IJssel

MPs Leenders and Jacobi asked how Rijkswaterstaat's planned use of the contested herbicide glyphosate along the IJssel fits with the upcoming ban on glyphosate use and whether safety grounds justify an exception even when alternatives exist. The minister answers that current rules allow glyphosate on stumps, that Rijkswaterstaat applies a stricter-than-required policy, that an exception for safety-critical cases is planned in a ministerial regulation, and that water contamination risk is negligible.
Nevertheless, Rijkswaterstaat preferably does not use crop protection products in management and maintenance.
Desalniettemin gebruikt Rijkswaterstaat bij voorkeur geen gewasbeschermingsmiddelen bij beheer en onderhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht ‘Rijkswaterstaat gebruikt onkruidmiddel dat slecht is voor water’

MPs Lodders and Visser asked why Rijkswaterstaat may use glyphosate-based weedkiller (Roundup) on tree stumps in hydraulic structures when the planned pesticide ban would apply to everyone else, and what alternatives were considered. The minister answered that glyphosate remains legally permitted, that a planned exception for situations without feasible alternatives will be written into a ministerial regulation, and that the same rules will apply to all parties including Rijkswaterstaat.
Rijkswaterstaat uses plant protection products for stumps in hydraulic structures only when no feasible alternatives exist.
Rijkswaterstaat gebruikt alleen gewasbeschermingsmiddelen voor stobben in waterbouwkundige constructies als er geen uitvoerbare alternatieven zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over ‘de manipulatie van de natuurstatistieken van het Planbureau voor de Leefomgeving’

An MP from the CDA asked the state secretaries whether the PBL's biodiversity indicator (MSA) and its graph presentation give a skewed picture of Dutch nature, and whether investments in nature can be measured per euro. The government defended the MSA as an international instrument used for long-term and cross-regional comparison, pointed to the PBL's independent supervisory committee, and referred to existing technical documentation and evaluations, without committing to new action.
In addition, an advisory committee of the PBL made up of independent members is responsible for supervising the scientific quality and social relevance of the planning agency's work.

Daarnaast is een uit onafhankelijke leden bestaande Begeleidingscommissie van het PBL verantwoordelijk voor toezicht op de wetenschappelijke kwaliteit en de maatschappelijke relevantie van het werk van het planbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de overweg Laantje van Alverna

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about the Council of State ruling that the Laantje van Alverna level crossing became public through prescription, and about the implications for other unsecured crossings and ProRail's fencing and closure practice. The state secretary said the crossing stays closed until 1 April 2016 pending alternatives, explained that the ruling is case-specific, defended ProRail's enforcement and project costs, and declined to commit to pausing closures or to a national inventory.
This ruling therefore relates specifically to the case of the Laantje van Alverna.
Deze uitspraak heeft dan ook specifiek betrekking op de casus van het Laantje van Alverna.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven heeft gesteld over het bericht ‘Verplicht duurzaam beton’ en ‘Blog: de betrekkelijke waarheid van duurzaam beton’

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary whether the government is failing to invest in sustainable concrete, whether Rijkswaterstaat specifies recycled concrete enough, and whether binding rules should replace voluntary Green Deals. The State Secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat already uses recycled concrete as foundation material, that the Green Deal is progressing slowly and a broader Betonakkoord is planned for 2016, but declined to make recycled aggregate mandatory.

I do not make mixed granulate mandatory as a raw material for concrete, because its technical performance is insufficient for general applications at Rijkswaterstaat and concrete is less readily recyclable in a subsequent lifecycle.

Menggranulaat schrijf ik niet verplicht voor als grondstof voor beton, omdat de technische prestaties onvoldoende zijn voor algemene toepassingen bij Rijkswaterstaat en het beton in een volgende levenscyclus minder goed recyclebaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland, Van Dekken, Nijboer over de stremming van het treinverkeer tussen Bad Nieuweschans en Leer

MPs asked the State Secretary about the closure of the rail bridge between Bad Nieuweschans and Leer, its duration, passenger and freight impacts, alternatives, and consequences for the Groningen–Bremen rail project's national funding and EU grant. The State Secretary answered that replacement may take 3 to 5 years, will write to the German counterpart, provides replacement buses, and says funding conditions and the EU study budget are still being assessed.
In the short term I will send my German counterpart a letter drawing attention to the current disruption.
Op korte termijn zal ik mijn Duitse ambtscollega een brief sturen, waarin ik aandacht zal vragen voor de huidige hinder
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Veldhoven over het beleid om op basis van de typegoedkeuringswaarde CO2 gedifferentieerde belastingen vast te stellen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Veldhoven asked whether the Finance Ministry knew of the growing gap between type-approval and real-world CO2 figures used for car taxes, and why no alternative basis was studied, plus the Volkswagen tax impact and planned action. The state secretary answered that the ministry was aware through TNO and Court of Audit work, that alternatives were judged impractical pending the WLTP test, that Volkswagen-related revenue losses are expected to be very limited and clarity is expected in early 2016, and that Autobrief II measures address the plug-in hybrid gap.
The cabinet is aware of the gap between standard and real-world consumption and has informed the House on several occasions.
Het kabinet is bekend met de afwijking tussen norm- en praktijkverbruik en heeft daar uw Kamer bij verschillende gelegenheden over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over de vernielde spoorbrug bij het Duitse Weener d.d. 3 december 2015

An MP asked the state secretary whether she would contact her German counterpart, raise the destroyed Weener rail bridge with the EU Commissioner for CEF funding, consider a temporary bridge, and put the issue on the agenda of the Dutch EU-presidency rail summit. The state secretary answered that she will consult German partners and await DB Netz's study, will not yet commit to a CEF application, and will discuss the issue at the summit while a Groningen quick scan of a temporary bridge is underway.
I think it is logical that there is also room at this summit to discuss current issues, such as the collision with the bridge at Weener.
Ik vind het logisch dat op deze top ook ruimte is om over actuele issues te spreken, zoals de aanvaring van de brug bij Weener.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins over de stremming van het treinverkeer tussen Bad Nieuweschans en Leer

An MP asked the state secretary about the rail bridge damage near Weener that halted train traffic between Bad Nieuweschans and Leer, including a temporary bridge, freight rerouting, shorter bus journeys, and speeding up the line upgrade with ETCS. The secretary answered that DB Netz's study is still pending, that a letter to the German counterpart will follow, that the 2018–2020 speed-up plan is in planning, and that she cannot yet decide on the signalling system.
Yes, see also the answer to question 2. The DB Netz study into improving the temporary situation is still ongoing.
Ja, zie hiervoor ook de beantwoording van vraag 2. Het onderzoek van DB Netz naar een verbetering van de tijdelijke situatie loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Boer over het bericht over volle treinen

MP De Boer (VVD) asked the State Secretary about reports of overcrowded trains, the causes and locations of complaints, shortage of rolling stock, reinstating Mat'64 trains, the taskforce on peak spreading and the effect on NS performance indicators. The State Secretary answered that NS's capacity performance is insufficient in places, pointed to concession obligations and fines, and deferred several questions to separate letters while stating the Mat'64 would be kept as an emergency reserve until 1 April 2016.
I will inform you further about this in a separate letter.
Via een separate brief informeer ik u hierover nader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over het artikel ‘Schiphol kan verder met uitbreiding’

An MP asks the state secretary about the demolition of Vrachtgebouw 1 at Schiphol, the expected decline in freight volume after Martinair's fleet reductions, and the value of freight to the Schiphol mainport. The state secretary answers that freight capacity is not materially affected, that Air France KLM will keep a substantial freight fleet, and that freight and passenger traffic both matter to the mainport, with an Actieagenda Schiphol to address freight.
This has no effect on the development of freight traffic at Schiphol.
Dit heeft geen effect op de ontwikkeling van het vrachtverkeer op Schiphol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de uitspraken van de topman van Emirates dat steun voor KLM schadelijk is voor Schiphol

An SP MP asked the state secretary to react to Emirates' chief executive's claims that support for KLM harms Schiphol, and whether the second daily A380 flights should be blocked pending state-aid checks. The state secretary declined to comment on the CEO's remarks, found no grounds under the bilateral air agreement to stop the second A380, and said the EU mandate for Gulf negotiations could include fair-competition safeguards.
I had the request from Emirates for a second A380 tested against the provisions of the agreement.
Ik heb de aanvraag van Emirates voor een tweede A380 laten toetsen aan de bepalingen van het verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht dat steun voor KLM schadelijk is voor Schiphol

An MP asked the state secretary whether the Netherlands is undermining a common EU front on Gulf aviation by refusing landing rights, whether Emirates' second A380 is compatible with the bilateral agreement, and about Schiphol's reward programme and cross-national regulation. The secretary answered that the second A380 was approved as a modest capacity increase under the liberal 1990 agreement, that Schiphol's reward programme is open to all airlines and its cost is confidential, and that Dutch policy follows an EU-coordinated approach via a pending Commission mandate.
The financial scope of this programme is classified by Schiphol as commercially confidential.
De financiële omvang van dit programma wordt door Schiphol als bedrijfsvertrouwelijk aangemerkt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Van Dekken over de uitspraken van de voorzitter van de Regiegroep Vitale Varkenshouderij, waarin hij stelt dat hij geen heil ziet in het verkleinen van de varkensstapel

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to respond to the chair of the pig sector steering group, who said reducing the pig herd is no solution, and asked whether the government will keep pushing for shrinking and extensifying pig farming. The State Secretary replied that the current export-dependent model offers little prospect, that the steering group will present a plan in early 2016, and that the herd size may be an outcome of the sector's process rather than a target.
The size of the pig herd may be a result of this process.
De omvang van de varkensstapel kan een resultante zijn van dit proces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Hoogland over de aanvraag van een OV-begeleiderskaart

MPs Otwin van Dijk and Hoogland asked why applying for an OV-begeleiderskaart requires a five-page questionnaire and an IQ test on top of a CIZ indication, and whether these burdens could be dropped when a valid CIZ indication exists. The State Secretary agreed partly: a CIZ indication suffices as proof in one specific case (IQ test no longer required for those with an AWBZ/Wlz 24-hour care indication), reviews of the questionnaire are planned for early next year, but data exchange with CIZ is not straightforwardly permitted under privacy law.

I also want to explore with the indication body for the OV-begeleiderskaart whether the questionnaire can be made more concrete regarding required evidence, so that one piece of evidence per criterion suffices.

Ik wil daarnaast met de indicatiesteller voor de OV-begeleiderskaart bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om de vragenlijst op het punt van de benodigde bewijsstukken zodanig te concretiseren dat er met één bewijsstuk per criterium volstaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken en Jan Vos over het bericht dat Nederlandse banken een megakippenbedrijf in Oekraïne financieren

Two PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch banks financing a huge Ukrainian poultry company, export credit guarantees for intensive livestock systems, and Dutch versus Ukrainian animal welfare standards were acceptable. The minister answered that Ukrainian standards are currently lower but the EU association agreement requires convergence, that export credits are assessed under IFC standards including animal welfare, and that the government sees no reason to refuse credits on the basis of herd size.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht «Weer hoge bijensterfte in Nederland»

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about rising winter bee mortality, the link to neonicotinoid pesticides such as thiacloprid, calls for a total ban, usage data, legal grounds for not banning them, and the timing of reassessments. The State Secretary answered that Dutch winter mortality is below the ten-year average, that multiple factors are involved, that a ban decision awaits the CTGB advice, and that further information will follow before the end of the Christmas recess.
I will inform the House about this by letter before the end of the Christmas recess.
Hierover zal ik uw Kamer voor het einde van het kerstreces informeren per brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het maatschappelijk verantwoord inkopen (MVI) van mobiliteit door overheden

An MP asked why most public mobility tenders in 2015 failed the minimum sustainability criteria, and whether the criteria and monitoring should be tightened. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said criteria are being updated annually and a benchmark is being set up, but made no firm binding commitment to 100% sustainable procurement by 2016 and withheld the budget overview pending interdepartmental consultation.
I have made efforts to answer on time. Due to the necessary interdepartmental coordination, this unfortunately did not succeed.
Ik heb mij ingespannen voor een tijdige beantwoording. Als gevolg van de noodzakelijke interdepartementale afstemming is dit helaas niet gelukt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Swinkels over het artikel ‘Tientallen vliegtuigen bij Schiphol met laser beschenen’ en de uitzending van het programma opsporing verzocht

Two D66 MPs asked about reports of lasers aimed at landing aircraft at Schiphol and about a Opsporing verzocht broadcast on the matter, including police action, the difficulty of catching the perpetrator, and possible restrictions on laser pointer sales. The state secretary answered that police have acted, the suspect has not yet been caught because the beam is hard to trace, the government sees no need for new national measures or a campaign, and sales from foreign webshops are hard to supervise.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on the exact nature of the actions taken by the police.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen omtrent de exacte aard van de acties die door de politie zijn verricht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Albert de Vries over het bericht 'Zeeland beter af met een Intercity'

MPs Hoogland and Albert de Vries asked the State Secretary about a report claiming Zeeland would benefit from an Intercity stopping only at the three largest stations and about related rail options. The State Secretary called the report a rough quickscan, said the options could be discussed in the regional public transport table, and declined to endorse the claimed figures without further study.
Without research, no accurate statement can be made about this.
Zonder onderzoek is hier geen nauwkeurige uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht “Misstanden in de varkenshouderij”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about a report by Varkens in Nood listing 120 abuses in Dutch pig farming, covering sick animals, enrichment materials, farrowing crates and water quality. The State Secretary responded that policy is being pursued through sector agreements and NVWA enforcement, that the NVWA finds sick animals are generally treated, that enrichment material shortages are declining, and that a stricter water-quality enforcement approach will be introduced from 2017.
In a few cases the NVWA sees that the treatment or housing is not appropriate to the condition.
In enkele gevallen ziet de NVWA dat de behandeling of huisvesting niet passend is bij de aandoening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het bericht ‘Bodem en water rond appel- en perenboomgaarden vol landbouwgif’

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about a Greenpeace report finding high pesticide use and water contamination around apple and pear orchards, and whether enforcement is adequate. The State Secretary answered that pesticide use is an acceptable condition for food production, that water norm exceedances are acknowledged with existing reduction targets and measures, and that the NVWA enforces on a risk basis and plans a new fruit-sector project in 2016.
The use of crop protection products is a prerequisite for producing high-quality, healthy and safe food.
Het gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen is een randvoorwaarde om hoogwaardig, gezond en veilig voedsel te produceren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en De Boer over de beantwoording van eerdere vragen over de ‘verslechtering van de treinverbinding tussen Alkmaar en Den Haag/Rotterdam’ van 27 maart 2015 en over de nieuwe

MPs Heerema and De Boer ask whether the new NS timetable from 15 December 2015 worsens the Alkmaar–Den Haag/Rotterdam rail link through longer transfer times and whether a three-minute earlier departure from Alkmaar could improve the Haarlem connection. The Staatssecretaris answers that NS achieved a travel-time gain of at least 10 minutes in the morning peak, that a further Haarlem transfer adjustment will follow in early 2016 rather than 15 December, and that the timetable is a complex trade-off among passenger groups.
This adjustment cannot take effect on 13 December 2015 anymore, but will be introduced in early 2016.
Deze aanpassing kan niet meer per 13 december 2015 van kracht worden, maar wordt begin 2016 ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Remco Dijkstra over de Ontwerp Regeling beheer verpakkingen

An MP asks how the planned ban on free plastic bags would be enforced by the ILT, how shops and consumers would be checked and informed, and whether the rule should be tested by the Council of State and delayed. The Secretary of State answers that enforcement starts cautiously via the ILT intervention ladder and targets shops, that a Council of State review is unnecessary because the underlying decree was already advised on, and that the 1 January 2016 start date stays.
Moreover, the Packaging Management Decree 2014, on which the basis of this regulation rests, was already submitted to the Council of State for advice in 2014.
Bovendien is het Besluit beheer verpakkingen 2014 waar de grondslag van deze regeling opgenomen is, in 2014 aan de Raad van State voor advies voorgelegd geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Dekken over misstanden in de nertsenhouderij en massale uitbreidingen door nertsenhouders

MPs Van Gerven and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about footage of injured mink, inspection and enforcement at mink farms, and reported mass expansions of mink farms. The State Secretary declined to explain the footage without knowing its origin, said inspections and warnings were carried out by the NVWA, confirmed some expansions via municipal permits while noting the ban had been suspended by court, and promised further examination of the matter.
Because it is unclear how, where and when the footage you refer to was obtained, I cannot interpret it further in relation to the current situation in the Dutch mink farming sector.
Omdat het onduidelijk is hoe, waar en wanneer de door u aangeduide beelden verkregen zijn, kan ik deze niet nader duiden in relatie tot de huidige situatie in de Nederlandse nertsenhouderij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over het bericht dat gemeenten uitbreidingsvergunningen voor nertsenhouderijen goedkeuren

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked the state secretary about municipalities approving expansion permits for mink farms despite the suspended fur farming ban. The secretary confirmed about 15,000 additional breeding animals permitted in Noord-Brabant since 2013, said municipalities hold zoning powers, and that enforcement is being examined with the Public Prosecution Service.
The province of Noord-Brabant cannot confirm whether the cages for the number of permitted animals have actually been built.
De provincie Noord-Brabant kan niet bevestigen of de kooien voor het aantal vergunde dieren ook daadwerkelijk gerealiseerd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Cegerek over het feit dat sommige Europese landen niet voldoen aan de in 2010 aangenomen Europese Richtlijn die import van illegaal gekapt hout verbiedt

An MP asked whether four EU member states still failing to implement the 2010 EU timber regulation are letting illegally logged timber into the Netherlands, what pressure exists to make them comply, and why the EU forest action plan has yielded poor results. The State Secretary answered that Dutch imports from those countries are small (0.21% of sawn wood), that the Commission has started infringement proceedings against three of them, and referred to a separate letter for the broader question.
It is for the European Commission to deploy pressure instruments when member states do not comply with EU law and regulations.
Het is aan de Europese Commissie om drukmiddelen in te zetten wanneer lidstaten zich niet houden aan EU wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en De Boer over de intercitystatus van station Schiedam Centrum en de mogelijkheden voor realisatie van station Schiedam Kethel

Two MPs asked the state secretary about keeping Intercity stops at Schiedam Centrum under the PHS timetable and about options for a new Schiedam Kethel station. The state secretary said no formal Intercity status exists, that Schiedam Centrum loses Intercity stops without extra measures, and that a variant D upgrade is being studied but no extra funding is currently available, while declining to study the Kethel station options further.
The region is free to expand the research assignment with this question, if desired.
Het staat de regio overigens vrij om, indien gewenst, de onderzoeksopdracht met deze vraagstelling te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verkrijgen van panda’s uit China

An MP asked whether three former Prime Ministers wrote letters to China to obtain pandas, what those letters argued, and whether the cabinet accepts animals as diplomatic currency and taxpayer money is involved. The minister answered that the loan is part of a wider conservation project with Ouwehands Dierenpark funded by the zoo, declined to provide the letters as a commitment, and stated that no Dutch government money was invested.
Can the House be given access to all letters written by the cabinet regarding the supply of pandas?
Kan de Kamer inzage krijgen alle brieven die vanuit het kabinet inzake de levering van panda’s zijn geschreven?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de veiligheid van treinen van IC-direct

An MP asked whether IC-direct trains with refurbished ICR carriages pose a safety risk, including overbuffering, wheelset and axle wear, a stranded train with a hot axle box, and a smoke incident. The Secretary of State answered that the Inspectorate found no violations and no grounds to ban the rolling stock, that NS sees the overbuffering risk as near zero and reports no failures from added weight, and that the inspectorate is investigating further.
The ILT has found no violations of the applicable laws and regulations and has since informed the Maatschappij Voor Beter OV of this.
ILT heeft geen overtredingen van de vigerende wet- en regelgeving vastgesteld en de Maatschappij Voor Beter OV hierover inmiddels geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Jan Vos over de invloed van grote bedrijven op het duurzaamheidsbeleid

MPs Cegerek and Jan Vos asked whether large companies unduly influence sustainability policy, citing a PhD study on business lobbying, and whether small players are disadvantaged in schemes such as SDE+, the postcode rose scheme and the energy savings fund. The minister answers that government policy is now shaped jointly with stakeholders, that the cabinet weighs interests itself, that most innovation funds go to SMEs, and that the postcode rose and energy savings fund rules have been simplified, with a further review promised.
In doing so, the cabinet is responsible for a balanced weighing of the various interests.
Daarbij is het kabinet verantwoordelijk voor een evenwichtige afweging van de verschillende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht “Illegale opvangers vrijuit om wanbeleid Pieterburen”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how he assessed a court ruling that acquitted two unlicensed seal carers, and whether he saw a financial rather than animal-welfare motive at a licensed seal centre, and what intervention or mediation was possible. The State Secretary answered that the public prosecutor has appealed so the case is before the courts, and that the government is exploring possible solutions with provinces and stakeholders, with a follow-up promised.
The Public Prosecution Service lodged an appeal on 16 October against the court's ruling.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft op 16 oktober jl. hoger beroep ingesteld naar aanleiding van voornoemde uitspraak van de rechtbank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de vervuiling door bandengruis

An SP MP asked the state secretary for Infrastructure and Environment how she would respond to reports that tyre wear particles are a major source of microplastic pollution, whether international differences exist, how winter and summer tyres compare, and whether she would investigate, consult sectors, introduce an eco-label or raise the issue in Europe. The state secretary answered that a RIVM study is pending (due February 2016), explained the drivers of tyre wear, noted the EU tyre label does not cover wear, and said she would await the RIVM study before any follow-up action.
For any follow-up actions I am awaiting the RIVM study.
Voor eventuele vervolgacties wacht ik het onderzoek van het RIVM af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Remco Dijkstra over de milieuvervuiling van bandengruis

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Environment about tyre-wear particles (bandengruis) and microplastic pollution, including the reliability of a 1,000-tonne estimate, other brake and road wear, follow-up research, remedies, and foreign measures. The State Secretary answered that the data are uncertain, gave emission estimates for brake and road wear, and said a RIVM study on microplastic sources was due in February 2016.
It is important, given the uncertainties in the data, that emissions from tyre wear and other road-vehicle wear (and road surface wear) are better mapped, including the share of microplastics.

Het is van belang – gezien de onzekerheden in de data – dat de emissies van bandenslijtage en andere slijtstof van wegvoertuigen (en van het wegdek) beter in beeld worden gebracht, inclusief het aandeel van microplastics hierin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Nijkerken-de Haan en Öztürk over de keuringen beperkt houdbare producten die via Maastricht Aachen Airport (MAA) ons land binnen komen in Zuid-Limburg

MPs asked why perishable goods imported via Maastricht Aachen Airport must be tested at a single NVWA laboratory in Wageningen, why more labs are not certified, and whether the long turnaround times disadvantage the airport compared with Germany and Belgium. The government confirmed the Wageningen lab handles high-risk non-EU produce under EU rules, and said an ongoing MAR-L study of laboratory procedures and tariffs will report by year end.
The results of this study are expected to be ready by the end of this year.
Naar verwachting zijn de resultaten van dit onderzoek eind dit jaar gereed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van katten

An MP asked the state secretary about the provincial shooting of cats, including whether counts are kept and why some provinces still allow it. The government replied that provinces decide themselves, no registration of cat shootings is kept, and an advisory opinion on alternatives is expected this year with a government response to follow.
No, the Ministry of Economic Affairs does not keep any registration of the shooting of cats.
Nee, er wordt door het Ministerie van Economische Zaken geen registratie bijgehouden van afschot van katten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Geurts over een juridische analyse van de visie van de Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) op de Kip van Morgen

MPs Dijkgraaf and Geurts asked whether an informal ACM view on the Kip van Morgen chicken-welfare agreement should meet motivation duties, whether public interests like sustainability and animal welfare are weighed, and how competition rules and the Wouters doctrine apply. The minister answered that the ACM must motivate informal views but at a lower bar, that public interests are considered, and promised a revised sustainability policy rule by year end and follow-up with the European Commission.
An informal view is a provisional judgment and does not bind the ACM or the undertakings involved.
Een informele zienswijze is een voorlopig oordeel en bindt de ACM en de betrokken ondernemingen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Cegerek over het bericht dat gemeenten de geuroverlast van veehouderijen niet terug mogen dringen

MPs Van Dekken and Cegerek asked whether municipalities can tighten odour rules in overburdened areas, citing a reported Council of State ruling, and whether cumulative odour nuisance and resident perception should be reflected in the Wet geurhinder en veehouderij evaluation. The state secretary corrected the press report, said the evaluation working group will advise before any response, noted the Crisis- en herstelwet has not yet been used coercively, and confirmed the RIVM comparison and that these matters will be part of the evaluation.
Yes. At my request the RIVM carried out a comparative analysis in which the research methods and results of the Utrecht University and GGD study were compared with the 2001 PRA study.
Ja. Het RIVM heeft op mijn verzoek een duidingsonderzoek uitgevoerd waarin de onderzoeksmethodiek en resultaten van het onderzoek van de Universiteit Utrecht en de GGD
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de mogelijke aanwezigheid van schadelijke stoffen in gerecyclede verpakkingen

MP Dik-Faber asked the health minister about mineral oil hydrocarbons found in recycled food packaging after a Foodwatch study, including health risks, regulation, NVWA oversight and industry engagement. The minister confirmed the findings are not surprising, said risk assessment and a possible norm are under study, noted no legal limits exist yet, and committed to talks with industry and RIVM and to raising the issue at EU level.
I will engage in discussion with industry to talk about which initiatives have been taken and which additional actions are possible.
Ik ga het gesprek met de industrie aan om te bespreken welke initiatieven er genomen zijn en welke aanvullende acties mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lodders over een nieuwe Europese richtlijn over antibioticagebruik

MPs Ziengs and Lodders asked whether the new EU antibiotic guidelines for animal husbandry fall short of Dutch rules and how the Netherlands will push for stronger EU action during its presidency. The State Secretary replied that the guidelines are non-binding, draw on Dutch experience, and that the Netherlands will advocate stricter EU rules and raise the issue at a February ministerial conference.
I agree with you that the approach to antibiotic resistance must be addressed at European level.
Ik deel met u dat de aanpak van antibioticaresistentie op Europees niveau moet worden opgepakt.
