Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Dikkers over het bericht in ‘Groene Ruimte’ dat EFSA (European Food Safety Authority) wijst op mogelijke hormoonverstorende effecten van 15 stoffen

MPs Leenders and Dikkers asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the EFSA finding of possible endocrine-disrupting effects of 15 pesticide substances should lead to a temporary ban, and whether the precautionary principle permits a national use ban pending further EFSA research. The State Secretary answered that EFSA does no new research, that a possible endocrine-disrupting classification does not automatically mean risk, that the Ctgb tests authorised products against exposure limits, and that neither the Commission nor the Ctgb sees grounds to intervene in current authorisations.

The Ctgb informs that classifying an active substance as possibly endocrine-disrupting does not immediately mean there is also a risk when the substance is incorporated into a plant protection product.

Het Ctgb laat weten dat classificatie van een werkzame stof als mogelijk hormoonverstorend niet meteen betekent dat er ook sprake is van een risico als deze stof in een gewasbeschermingsmiddel wordt verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over medische claims over het middel Souvenaid en de handhaving door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

An SP MP asked the Health Minister about the NVWA's January 2015 finding that Souvenaid is not medical dietary food, the warning to Nutricia, and enforcement after the deadline expired. The minister confirmed the finding and warning, said a September 2015 re-inspection found the product still sold as medical dietary food, and said the NVWA's standard intervention policy is being applied, with Nutricia able to respond.
The NVWA then started its intervention policy and is following it consistently and carefully.
De NVWA is vervolgens gestart met haar interventiebeleid en doorloopt deze consequent en zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries inzake Franse verhuizing Transavia

MPs Visser and Aukje de Vries asked whether Transavia Nederland would sell its 40% stake in Transavia France and whether governance changes would weaken KLM's independence and Schiphol's hub role. The government answered that talks between the companies are ongoing, that no formal Dutch or French government role exists, and that it stressed KLM's independent position and Schiphol's network quality.
No definitive answer can yet be given on changes to Transavia Nederland's governance structure, because these talks are still ongoing.
Over wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat deze gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Mei Li Vos over de artikelen ‘Ce que veut faire Air France-KLM avec ses deux Transavia (La Tribune, 4 november 2015) en ‘Strijd om Transavia’

Two MPs asked the government about reported plans to merge or restructure the governance of Transavia Holland and Transavia France within Air France-KLM, and whether this threatens KLM and Schiphol's network. The government confirmed talks are ongoing, said Transavia France does not fly from Schiphol, stressed the importance of KLM and Schiphol's network, and said it raised concerns with Air France-KLM, without committing to a concrete binding step.
As for possible changes in the governance structure of Transavia Netherlands, no definitive answer can yet be given, because for this airline the talks are still ongoing.
Wat betreft mogelijke wijzigingen in de governancestructuur van Transavia Nederland is nog geen uitsluitsel te geven, omdat wat deze luchtvaartmaatschappij betreft de gesprekken nog lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over fraude met emissiesoftware door Volkswagen

The MP Smaling asked whether the Volkswagen emissions-software fraud undermines the national air quality programme (NOx) and the Programmatic Approach to Nitrogen (PAS) and AERIUS model, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that air quality policy need not be changed because it is already based on real-world emission measurements, that the latest data will be incorporated in the annual model update, and that extra measures for cities will be sent to parliament in November.
Air quality policy does not need to be adjusted as a result of the software fraud at Volkswagen.
Het luchtkwaliteitbeleid hoeft naar aanleiding van de softwarefraude bij Volkswagen niet te worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs naar aanleiding van een werkbezoek aan een pluimveeslachterij op 19 oktober 2015

MPs Lodders and Ziengs asked why the NVWA refused the poultry sector's request to keep slaughterhouses running on 26 and 27 December, and why it handled the request slowly and charged waiting costs to the company. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA allowed a one-time exception for 26 December with conditions, that the sector was informed, and that the claim procedure for NVWA-caused losses exists.
The NVWA will allow poultry slaughterhouses, on a one-time basis, to submit applications for inspections on Saturday 26 December (Second Christmas Day).
De NVWA zal eenmalig voor pluimveeslachterijen toestaan om aanvragen voor keuringen op zaterdag 26 december (Tweede Kerstdag) in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de wijziging van de gebiedsanalyse van Achter de Voort, Agelerbroek en Voltherbroek

An MP asked why the Achter de Voort, Agelerbroek and Voltherbroek area analysis was amended to add 46.2 hectares of pine forest in the buffer zone without prior consultation with the province and municipality. The State Secretary explained the amendment as a precautionary nitrogen measure, acknowledged the consultation shortfall, and said the pine planting was dropped in favour of a smaller broadleaf-based measure.
The ecological assessment could no longer be fully justified with the current restoration measures, so additional restoration measures were deemed necessary under the precautionary principle.
Het ecologisch oordeel was hierbij niet meer volledig te onderbouwen met de huidige herstelmaatregelen, waardoor vanuit het voorzorgbeginsel aanvullende herstelmaatregelen nodig worden geacht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over de berichtgeving ‘Dinkelland tegen besluit EZ over Natura 2000’ en ‘Geen naaldbossen in Twente’

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports that Dinkelland opposed an EZ Natura 2000 measure, including planting coniferous forest in a buffer zone after an interim AERIUS update. The State Secretary acknowledged local unrest, said the measure was revised after consultation to drop the conifer planting and reduce its scope, and defended the AERIUS update as necessary for the PAS's legal soundness.
After the public inspection period (TIL), the measure was reassessed, partly in light of questions about its usefulness and necessity.
Na de ter inzage legging (TIL) is de maatregel, mede in het licht van de vragen over nut en noodzaak, opnieuw beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van ’t Wout over het bericht “France offers new farm aid as 1,500 tractors hit Paris streets”

MPs Lodders and Van 't Wout asked about reports that the French government would freeze implementation of new, mainly environmental, rules for livestock farming, and whether this distorts the EU level playing field. The government answered that the French moratorium until 1 February 2016 only checks for national rules stricter than EU requirements, that EU implementation is not frozen, and that the Netherlands has pressed for European rather than national action.
A specification of possibly stricter national measures cannot be given at this stage, as the French government's review has not yet been completed.
Een specificering van mogelijk stringentere nationale maatregelen is in dit stadium is niet te geven, daar de toetsing door de Franse overheid nog niet is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Pia Dijkstra over het bericht dat een verboden emulgator in frisdranken AH en Jumbo zit

Two D66 MPs asked how a banned emulsifier could end up in soft drinks sold by AH and Jumbo without enforcement, and how import controls by the NVWA work. The minister answered that businesses are responsible for food safety, the NVWA uses risk-based inspection, the chain acted after a signal, and full certainty cannot be given.
The NVWA enforces compliance with food legislation. It deploys its capacity and resources based on risk assessments.
De NVWA handhaaft de naleving van de levensmiddelenwetgeving. Zij zet haar capaciteit en middelen in op basis van risico-inschattingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de uitspraak dat Circus Renz International toch olifanten mag vervoeren ondanks verbod

An MP asked the state secretary about a court ruling allowing Circus Renz International to transport elephants despite the ban on wild animals in circuses. The secretary respects the interim ruling, will grant temporary exemptions for transport until the end of current tours for circuses in a similar position, and says performance with animals remains prohibited and will be enforced.
I respect this ruling. That means I will grant a temporary exemption for transporting animals until the end of their tour to circuses in a comparable situation.

Ik respecteer deze uitspraak. Dat betekent dat ik aan circussen die zich in een vergelijkbare situatie bevinden een tijdelijke ontheffing zal verlenen voor het vervoer van de dieren tot het einde van hun tournee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Milieu ondergeschikt bij inkoop materialen door overheid’

An MP asked the government to respond to a Forest Stewardship Council report finding that much tropical timber used in public works cannot be shown to be sustainably sourced, and asked whether the government's sustainable procurement goals and measures are adequate. The state secretary largely defends existing policy (Green Deal, PIANOo support, monitoring), disputes some of the report's conclusions and promises a study of the causes with a government reaction later in the year.

Because of these signals, after signing the Green Deal in 2013 the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment commissioned a study into why it cannot in all cases be demonstrated that sustainable timber was supplied in central government projects.

Vanwege de genoemde signalen is na het ondertekenen van de Green Deal bevorderen duurzaam bosbeheer in 2013 opdracht gegeven door het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu voor een onderzoek naar de redenen waarom bij rijksoverheidsprojecten niet in alle gevallen aangetoond kan worden dat duurzaam hout is geleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het rapport “Stoppen met kiloknallen”

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Wakker Dier report on 'kiloknallers' (supermarket meat price-cutting), linking lower margins to rising animal density, antibiotic resistance, food fraud and animal welfare problems, and asks whether production limits, sales-below-cost bans or export bulk phase-outs will be introduced. The State Secretary answers that welfare is primarily the keeper's responsibility, rejects new production or density norms, relies on sector-led antibiotic reduction and voluntary supermarket agreements, and rejects a legal ban on sales below cost.
I am in discussion with the piglet vitality steering group about this.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met de stuurgroep bigvitaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Diervriendelijke subsidiepotjes’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how EU agricultural subsidy funds of 29.94 million euro support market position, cost control, competitiveness and exports, and whether they fund environmental measures or weidevogel conservation without evidence. The State Secretary answers that the funds support dairy and pig sector sustainability, manure processing and competitiveness, that no funds go to stable environmental measures, and that weidevogel spending is justified by scientific studies and practical experience, with details to follow in a letter to parliament.
I have informed you about this in my letter to the House of Representatives of 24 September.
Ik heb u hierover geïnformeerd in mijn brief aan de Tweede Kamer van 24 september jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Natuurmonumenten gaat de mist in met bonus’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Natuurmonumenten paid its director a bonus in breach of sector rules, omitted it from the annual report, and about the director's salary and raise. The State Secretary replied that the association's employment terms are its own matter and declined to assess the specifics, while stating the questions were answered adequately.
It is therefore not for me to give my judgment on specific parts of the employment terms about which you have asked questions.
Het is daarom niet aan mij om mijn oordeel te geven over specifieke onderdelen van de arbeidsvoorwaarden, waarover u vragen heeft gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over duizenden kalveren die langzaam stikken tijdens en na de slacht van de moederkoe

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that thousands of unborn calves suffocate during slaughter of pregnant cows, and whether the Netherlands would ban such slaughter and extend transport restrictions. The state secretary said pregnant animals are not registered in Dutch slaughterhouses, that EFSA advice is due by 30 November 2016, and that measures will be decided after that advice and a Wageningen study.
No registration is kept of this.
Hier wordt geen registratie van bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over nieuw rekenmodel om de verspreiding van Q-koorts te voorspellen

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether a new weather-based model predicting Q-fever spread is ready for use in an outbreak, how much further development is needed, including for other zoonoses, and whether the government will support it. The minister replied that the model can map exposure but cannot yet compute infection risk without emission data, that it can be extended to other airborne pathogens over one to two years per pathogen, and that RIVM will continue the work.
The RIVM has in recent years built up expertise in modelling the spread of airborne pathogens.
Het RIVM heeft de afgelopen jaren expertise opgebouwd in het modelleren van de verspreiding van luchtoverdraagbare ziekteverwekkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het middel Souvenaid en de handhaving door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about marketing of Souvenaid as a medical dietary product for early Alzheimer's, its price, online sales, and NVWA enforcement, including whether labelling has been corrected. The minister answered that NVWA found Souvenaid does not meet the definition of medical dietary food, issued a warning to Nutricia, and that further steps depend on the company's response, while several questions were deferred to the NVWA or left without substantive detail.
The NVWA then established that Souvenaid does not meet the definition of dietary food for medical use.
De NVWA heeft vervolgens vastgesteld dat Souvenaid niet aan de definitie voor dieetvoeding voor medisch gebruik voldoet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over het bericht «Gezondheid boeren bedreigd door pesticiden»

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked about a report that farmers' health is threatened by pesticides, including the Health Council's findings on nervous-system disorders in farmers and childhood leukaemia in their children, and whether the government would speed up follow-up research. The government answered that it is taking the Health Council advice seriously, that RIVM is preparing a multi-year exposure study with results expected in 2018, and that it will report on progress in June 2016.
The cabinet takes public health very seriously and the Health Council's advice prompted the cabinet to adopt the proposals in that advice.
Het kabinet neemt de gezondheid van de bevolking zeer serieus en het advies van de Gezondheidsraad vormde voor het kabinet aanleiding om de voorstellen in het advies van Gezondheidsraad over te nemen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over de omstandigheden bij het Europees octrooibureau in Rijswijk en de inzet van Nederland

SP MPs asked why the Dutch representative on the EPO Administrative Council supported 2013 strike restrictions and 2015 sick-leave rules, whether Dutch privacy and labour inspection apply to the EPO, and what Netherlands is doing about labour conflict. The State Secretary answered that the rules were modelled on ILO standards, that Netherlands pushed for safeguards and review, that the Netherlands joined the Supreme Court appeal on EPO immunity, and that the social dialogue has so far produced no concrete results.
However, if it turns out that intervention by a third party, for example through mediation, is indeed desirable, I would like to commit to that, in consultation with other countries.
Als echter blijkt dat interventie door een derde, bijvoorbeeld via mediation, inderdaad wenselijk wordt, dan wil ik mij daar graag, in samenspraak met andere landen, voor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Lodders en Dijkgraaf over het openbaar maken van meetdata ammoniak door Wageningen Universiteit

MPs Geurts, Lodders and Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary whether Wageningen University should publish its ammonia measurement data and calculation methods behind manure emission factors, citing an international review's call for free data availability. The state secretary said the research was published and reviewed, that Wageningen UR is willing to share underlying data and show calculations to critics, and that older data from the 1990s no longer exists under the five-year retention rule, and declined to request further disclosure.

Since 1 January 2005 it has been customary to retain research data for 5 years, in accordance with the rules of the Dutch Code of Conduct for Research Integrity of the Association of Universities (VSNU).

Het is sinds 1 januari 2005 gebruikelijk om onderzoeksgegevens 5 jaar te bewaren, conform de hiervoor geldende regels vanuit de Nederlandse Gedragscode Wetenschapsbeoefening van de Vereniging van Universiteiten (VSNU).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over fors hogere pachtprijzen door verpachten van grond door het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister for Housing and Government Services and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about sharply higher lease prices when the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf auctions farmland, the transfer of payment rights, sustainable land management, and bank guarantees. The minister answered that higher prices reflect scarcity, that a mandatory building plan and soil checks secure sustainable use, and that the outgoing tenants held liberalised leases that end, but gave limited detail on some points.
For land leased out in liberalised tenancy through public tender or auction, a building plan is prescribed.
Voor de grond die in geliberaliseerde pacht wordt uitgegeven door middel van een openbare inschrijving of een veiling per opbod wordt een bouwplan voorgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht ‘Onderzoeker kritisch over aanlandplicht’

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a Flemish researcher's finding that the EU landing obligation (aanlandplicht) may harm seabirds and scavengers and young fish, and what the government will do with it. The state secretary said the study cannot yet quantify the effects, that monitoring is under way, and that exemptions for high-survival species are being piloted and sought in regional discard plans.
Monitoring will be needed to detect any changes.
Monitoring zal nodig zijn om eventuele veranderingen te constateren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat het slecht gaat met weidevogels als grutto’s, scholeksters en veldleeuweriken

MP Smaling (SP) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the decline of meadow birds, their causes, and the government's plans to reverse it. The State Secretary answered that a new agri-environment scheme from 2016 and talks with provinces are the main response, and committed to inform parliament on the outcomes of the discussions and on the neonicotinoid reassessment.
I will inform your House of the outcomes thereof.
Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomsten daarvan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dolfijnenslachtingen op de Faeröer-eilanden

The MP asked about dolphin drive hunts in the Faroe Islands, Danish protection of the hunt, and what the government has done or will do to stop it. The government answered that it raised the issue through the IWC and ASCOBANS, will keep pressing Denmark and will ask the Commission to examine EU action, while noting the Faroes' autonomy over whaling.
I will ask the European Commission to examine whether and how the EU can act.
Ik zal de Europese Commissie verzoeken om mogelijkheden te onderzoeken of en op welke wijze de EU kan optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het doden van wilde dieren door trofeejagers

An SP MP asked the ministers about trophy hunting of protected wildlife such as the lion Cecil, the share of hunting revenue reaching local communities, enforcement against illegal trophy trade and online wildlife sales. The government said hunting can be permitted under conditions, that it lacks data on local benefit shares, promised an exploration of limiting trophy imports in October 2015, and described NVWA/Douane enforcement and ongoing talks with Marktplaats.

The State Secretary for Economic Affairs will send the House in October 2015, as promised in the committee debate on nature policy and biodiversity of 28 May, an exploration of options to further reduce or prohibit the import of hunting trophies.

De Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken zal in oktober 2015, zoals toegezegd in het AO Natuurbeleid en Biodiversiteit van 28 mei jl., een verkenning naar de Kamer sturen van de mogelijkheden om de invoer van jachttrofeeën verder te verminderen of te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts inzake het gelijkberechtingingsdossier

An MP from the CDA asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the equal-treatment dispute over nature management, including state aid law, the Marker Wadden project awarded to Natuurmonumenten without an open tender, and how such projects are allocated. The State Secretary replies that the current policy is compatible with state aid rules, that the European Commission has not yet ruled on the complaint, that the Marker Wadden tender was properly published, and that equal treatment is the agreed starting point with the provinces.
To give potentially interested cooperation partners the opportunity to participate, a public call was published in the Staatscourant on 17 September 2013.
Om potentieel geïnteresseerde samenwerkingspartners in de gelegenheid te stellen om deel te nemen, is op 17 september 2013 een openbare uitvraag gedaan in de Staatscourant
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de evaluatie vogelgriep 2014

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the delayed evaluation of the 2014 avian influenza outbreak response, the urgency before the migration season, and whether recent foreign outbreaks and EU-level standards would be addressed. The State Secretary answered that the report is delayed and will be sent to parliament with a policy response this month, while referring to expert advice and the Beleidsdraaiboek and stating EU rules set the minimum measures.
The report will be completed this month. I will send it to your House, with my policy response, after completion.
Het rapport wordt deze maand afgerond. Ik zal uw Kamer het rapport, voorzien van mijn beleidsreactie, na afronding toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het bericht ‘Weidevogels ernstig bedreigd door koeienexplosie’

Opposition MP Grashoff asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that rising cow numbers after the end of the milk quota threaten meadow birds, and whether the phosphate rights and nitrogen policy would protect biodiversity. The State Secretary answered that the decline has several causes, cow numbers rose 1.8 percent in the spring, the phosphate scheme cannot include bird-specific conditions, and extensification is one measure, with a promised letter on the weidevogel approach.
During the legislative consultation on the Nature Conservation Act I promised to send your House a letter on my vision for tackling the declining meadow bird population.
Tijdens het wetgevingsoverleg over de Natuurbeschermingswet heb ik toegezegd uw Kamer een brief te sturen over mijn visie op de aanpak van de teruglopende weidevogelstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voortgang van het Programma Aanpak Stikstof (PAS)

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Programme Aanpak Stikstof (PAS), including a three-month deadline for reporting herd expansions, its effect on farmers, administrative burden, a consultation meeting and a helpdesk. The State Secretary defends the three-month notification window to prevent speculative reporting, says the PAS takes farmers' interests into account, claims it reduces administrative burden, and points to a helpdesk for general questions.
A time limit has been prescribed to prevent activities being reported that are never realised.
Er is een termijn voorgeschreven om te voorkomen dat activiteiten worden gemeld, die nooit worden gerealiseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de BTW-plicht voor agrarisch natuur- en landschapsbeheer

An MP asked whether VAT should not be charged on payments for agricultural nature and landscape management, whether the payments remain cost-covering, and whether farmers would be compensated if VAT applied. The government replied that payments are based on income loss and labour, that VAT would make them non-cost-covering, but that the tax authority has ruled no VAT is due on the subsidies received via collectives, and it gave no commitment to compensation.
The position is that there is no VAT liability for the subsidy received from the province for implementing the management packages by the farmers who together form the collective.

Het standpunt luidt dat er geen BTW-plicht is voor de subsidie die van de provincie wordt ontvangen in het kader van de uitvoering van de beheerpakketten door de betrokken agrariërs die samen het collectief vormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het artikel ‘Worden we de melkvee-industrie ingerommeld’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the proposed phosphate rights system for dairy farming harms grounded farms, whether it risks turning dairy into industrial production, and whether a quick scan, a rule change, an enquiry into the KringloopWijzer, a legal liability route, and reporting on grounded production should follow. The State Secretary answers that details are still being worked out with sector organisations, that no outcome for specific farm types can yet be stated, that the dairy sector remains largely grounded, that a quick scan would not change the conclusion, and that she will inform parliament once the system is clearer.
I will inform your House as soon as more clarity exists on how the phosphate rights system will be filled in.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren zodra er meer duidelijkheid bestaat over de wijze waarop invulling gegeven wordt aan het stelsel van fosfaatrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de voortgang van het Programma Aanpak Stikstof

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the mandatory AERIUS Calculator was offline, whether permits could be issued from 1 July, what the economic harm and remedies would be, and how this fits with growth ambitions. The State Secretary said the calculator was unavailable 9-30 June for adjustments, will be available from 1 July, that development space is limited to protect Natura 2000 habitats, and that a stakeholder meeting was held on 29 June.
The AERIUS Calculator was not available from 9 to 30 June.
AERIUS Calculator was van 9 t/m 30 juni niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Bommel over de praktijk van 'landjepik in Europa'

MPs Smaling and Van Bommel (SP) asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about large-scale farmland acquisition by foreign investors in Europe, its effects on local populations, food security, land prices, EU subsidies, and whether EU or national rules can restrict it. The government answered that local populations are not generally harmed, the TNI report's effects are insufficiently substantiated, existing EU rules allow only non-discriminatory and proportionate restrictions, and it sees no reason to raise the issue at EU level.
The cabinet sees no reason to raise this at European level.
Het kabinet ziet geen reden om dit op Europees niveau aan te kaarten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het per ongeluk doodschieten van honden door jagers

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary about two incidents in which hunters mistakenly shot dogs, and about evidence that hunters often miss their prey, asking whether the law should be tightened and whether the hunters should be prosecuted and lose their licences. The State Secretary answers that these incidents are regrettable and rare, that the Public Prosecution Service is investigating, that she sees no reason to amend legislation or repeat the research, and that prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and the courts to decide.
Pending the results of the Public Prosecution Service investigation, I see no reason at this time to amend legislation.
In afwachting van de resultaten van het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om wetgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over de invoering van een tropenrooster voor het vervoer van slachtdieren

Two MPs asked whether the food safety authority NVWA should introduce a night inspection service and an automatic heat-related schedule for transporting slaughter animals, and whether the 30°C transport temperature limit should be lowered. The state secretary replied that the NVWA applied an extended 'tropenrooster' during the July 2015 heatwave, that it will do so again in future hot periods, and that a practical regulation is being developed with the sector, without committing to a specific automatic trigger or temperature.
The NVWA will introduce a tropical schedule in future periods of exceptionally hot weather.
De NVWA zal bij toekomstige periodes van bijzonder warm weer een tropenrooster in werking laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over de afsluiting van het kreeftenvang-seizoen op de Oosterschelde

Two MPs asked whether intensive lobster fishing at the end of the season on the Oosterschelde keeps prices down and causes animal suffering, and whether the government will investigate stopping it. The state secretary confirmed intensified late-season fishing and said prices fluctuate seasonally, found no evidence of greater damage, and declined to restrict fishing because only stock and nature considerations, not market prices, are decisive.
Solely stock considerations and nature interests are decisive for this, as I already informed your House in my letter of 26 March 2015 on lobster fishing in the Oosterschelde.
Uitsluitend bestandsoverwegingen en natuurbelangen zijn hiervoor bepalend, zoals ik uw Kamer reeds heb medegedeeld met mijn brief d.d. 26 maart 2015 over de kreeftenvisserij in de Oosterschelde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht ‘Natuurmonumenten gaat de mist in met bonus’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that Natuurmonumenten paid its director a bonus contrary to sector rules, omitted it from the annual report, and raised salaries, and whether the government would hold the organisation to account. The State Secretary answered that Natuurmonumenten is a private association whose remuneration is its own matter, that sector standards apply, and that ministry subsidies concern specific activities separate from director pay.
The employment conditions of the directors and other employees of Natuurmonumenten are a matter for the association itself.
De arbeidsvoorwaarden van de directie en overige medewerkers van Natuurmonumenten betreft een aangelegenheid van de vereniging zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over het bericht ‘dat Europese salamanders bedreigd worden door de Aziatische schimmelziekte’

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a Science study showing that the chytrid fungus threatens European salamanders, and about measures against its spread in the Netherlands. The government confirmed the disease was found in the Limburg fire salamander population, described containment steps with Staatsbosbeheer and the NVWA, and said it supports EU and Bern Convention action while exploring EU funding once cooperation prospects are clear.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de erkenning van MTCS als een duurzaam certificeringssysteem voor hout in het Nederlands beleid voor duurzaam inkopen en de reactie hierop van inheemse volken

An MP asked the state secretaries whether the government's account of consultations with Malaysian indigenous peoples on the MTCS timber certification scheme is accurate, given objections from JOAS, and questioned the independence of the planned TPAC check. The government largely defended its findings, declined to verify its report with JOAS, said it cannot explain the discrepancies, and stated that the TPAC check will be limited to information from the last visit while its scope is still being considered.
For the TPAC check, independence, due care and speed must be ensured, also in light of the relevant European framework.
Voor de check door TPAC moeten de onafhankelijkheid, zorgvuldigheid en snelheid geborgd zijn, mede in het licht van het Europese kader terzake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over de berichtgeving inzake de certificering van Maleisisch hout

An SP MP asked the State Secretaries about media reports questioning whether Malaysian timber certification (MTCS) meets Dutch procurement standards, the reliability of NGO motives, and an EU complaint against FSC-only municipal policies. The government replied that MTCS improvements are visible, that TPAC will be asked for a final check, and that the complaint concerns exclusion of other certification schemes rather than FSC purchasing itself.
To establish whether the previously identified points at MTCS have been resolved, the Timber Procurement Assessment Committee (TPAC) is being asked to carry out a final check.
Om vast te kunnen stellen of de eerder geïdentificeerde punten bij MTCS zijn opgelost wordt de Toetsingcommissie Inkoop Hout (TPAC) gevraagd een laatste check te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Smaling over het gebrekkige toezicht en de handhavingsaanpak bij zwanendriften

MPs Thieme and Smaling asked whether police and NVWA enforcement against swan-harassment is inadequate, whether the NVWA emergency line works, and whether a ban is needed. The minister rejects claims of inadequate enforcement, says NVWA and police coordinate well, and promises to investigate a legal ban by autumn.
There is no question of deficient enforcement.
Er is geen sprake van een gebrekkige handhavingsaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het niet ingrijpen van de politie bij het zwanendriften

An MP asked the state secretary and minister why police do not intervene in swan-driving (zwanendriften), including whether the ministry's exemption was withdrawn and whether police should enforce and prosecute. The government answered that swan-driving is currently legal, the ring-obligation exemptions were withdrawn on 7 May 2015, a criminal investigation led to prosecution and pending court cases, and it sees no reason to deploy other police units or indications of corruption.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders, Jacobi en Van Dekken over mogelijke schade door zoutwinning aan de flora en fauna van werelderfgoed de Waddenzee

Three PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she responds to a study by environmental groups showing the Wadden Sea seabed could subside from salt extraction, harming birds' feeding and the World Heritage site, and why it conflicts with the industry consultant's findings. The State Secretary declined to give a substantive response, citing the ongoing appeal before the Council of State's administrative law division, and promised to inform the House after that ruling.
In light of this, I do not wish to give a substantive response to the mentioned research report at this time.
In dit licht wil ik nu geen inhoudelijke reactie geven op het genoemde onderzoeksrapport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over illegale vogelvangst in Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about illegal wild bird trapping and fraud disguising wild-caught birds as captive-bred, and whether enforcement in rural areas and the NVWA's inspectors' expertise were adequate. The State Secretary pointed to existing measures such as digital ring registration and inter-ministerial letters, saw no need to intensify enforcement, and rejected the claim of a knowledge gap among NVWA inspectors.
Given current efforts and ongoing initiatives for further improvement, supervision and enforcement in rural areas can now and in the future take place at a sufficient level.
Door de huidige inzet en de lopende initiatieven voor verdere verbetering kan het toezicht en handhaving in het buitengebied nu en in de toekomst op voldoende niveau plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser naar aanleiding van de acties van de Franse boeren

VVD MPs Lodders and Visser asked ministers about French farmers' blockades that disrupted Dutch transport, the lack of French police action, damages, state aid and whether Dutch inspections could allow derogations from driving-time rules. The government condemned the actions, protested to France and the Commission, said damages are a civil matter, and said it would raise the issue at the 7 September Agriculture Council.
We condemn these actions. Like the Spanish government, the Netherlands has also protested.
Wij keuren deze acties af. Net als de Spaanse regering heeft ook Nederland geprotesteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over mishandeling van olifanten

An MP from the PVV asks the government why animal abusers do not receive harsher sentences and why abused animals are not seized faster, and why foreign circuses are scrutinised more than the Dutch national circus. The government says a review of the animal-holding ban is underway with a policy response due in autumn, disagrees that foreign circuses are treated more harshly, and notes that over 6,000 animals were taken into administrative custody in 2014.
This will include the level of sentences imposed.
Daarin wordt meegenomen wat de hoogte is van straffen die worden opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over rekening houden met fauna bij renovatie van woningen

MP Ouwehand asked whether alternative roosts for protected species were actually realised under the Stroomversnelling renovation exemption, and whether energy renovation of 111,000 homes should be redesigned to disturb fauna less. The Secretary of State said temporary alternatives are provided, overcompensation is expected, consultation with species organisations is ongoing, and that ensuring alternative roosts is the exemption holder's responsibility.
The initiator has not offered permanent alternative roosts in the area because, after an environmental check, it was found that sufficient alternatives exist nearby.

Door de initiatiefnemer zijn geen blijvende alternatieve verblijfplaatsen in de omgeving aangeboden omdat, na uitvoering van een omgevingscheck, is geconstateerd dat er in de omgeving voldoende alternatieven zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Veldhoven over de controle op illegaal hout

MPs Smaling and Van Veldhoven asked the State Secretary about NVWA enforcement against illegal timber under the EU Timber Regulation, including staffing, inspection numbers, the use of warnings rather than fines, and due diligence. The State Secretary answered that 3 FTE are deployed, 101 inspections and 29 written warnings have been issued, that enforcement is warning-first and has been effective, and that the NVWA follows EU-coordinated practice on due diligence and document verification.
The NVWA has 3 FTE available for combating illegal timber and this appears sufficient given the required deployment.
De NVWA heeft 3 fte beschikbaar voor het bestrijden van illegaal hout en dit blijkt gezien de benodigde inzet voldoende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over illegale houtkap in de Amazone en de controle van de NVWA hierop

An MP asked the state secretary about Greenpeace findings that three Dutch timber firms linked to illegal logging in the Amazon were inspected by the NVWA but not sanctioned, and whether such timber reached the market in breach of EU timber rules. The government replied that one firm received a written warning, another passed inspection, a third will receive a warning, and that the NVWA is still investigating the market-entry claim and the due diligence question.
The NVWA is currently investigating this claim from the Greenpeace report.
De NVWA onderzoekt op dit moment deze bewering uit het rapport van Greenpeace.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de consequenties van een mogelijke fusie van Monsanto en Syngenta voor de voedselzekerheid

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the food-security consequences of a possible Monsanto takeover of Syngenta, including whether BASF might also acquire parts of Syngenta and whether the takeover could be blocked by competition authorities. The government expressed concern about concentration of the global food supply at a few multinationals, and explained that Dutch and EU merger control apply under defined turnover thresholds, with the ACM and the European Commission assessing significant impediments to competition.
I find it worrying if the global food supply threatens to be concentrated among a few multinationals
Ik vind het zorgelijk als de wereldvoedselvoorziening dreigt te worden geconcentreerd bij enkele multinationals
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de impact van certificering op de arbeidsomstandigheden in de landbouwsector in ontwikkelingslanden

MP Voordewind asked the ministers whether they know the SOMO report on certification and labour conditions in developing-country agriculture, and whether they will engage supermarkets, ISEAL and the Sustainability Consortium on stronger certification, due diligence and convenants. The minister answers that the report is noted, that the Alliance and supermarkets are working on sustainability agendas, and that certification is one tool among others, with no binding government commitment beyond ongoing dialogue and subsidy.
The initiative for the agreements lies with the sectors themselves.
Het initiatief voor de convenanten ligt bij de sectoren zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de natuurontwikkeling op Texel, zoals het Gebied Dorpzicht

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about nature development on Texel (Dorpzicht), the conversion of permanent grassland for nature, and whether natural managers are subject to the same grassland-retention rules as farmers. The State Secretary confirmed the situation, said permanent grassland can still count after conversion, and said nature managers receiving first-pillar CAP support are bound by the same rules, while exact hectare figures are still being compiled by RVO.
As soon as the outcomes are known, I will inform the House about this.
Zodra de uitkomsten hiervan bekend zijn, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bestrijdingsmiddel azadirachtin dat hommels bedreigt

An MP asked the State Secretary about a 2015 study linking the pesticide azadirachtin to reduced bumblebee survival and reproduction, why its approval did not consider bumblebees, how much is used, and whether a moratorium will be imposed. The Secretary said the study will be considered in the Ctgb's re-assessment, that the EU bee guidance now includes bumblebees, that sales data are confidential, and that no moratorium is planned pending that assessment.
The Ctgb has indicated that the cited publication will be taken into account in the re-assessment of the said product.
Het Ctgb heeft aangegeven dat de aangehaalde publicatie zal worden meegenomen binnen de herbeoordeling van het genoemde middel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Oskam over de toename van voedselfraude binnen het Europese voedselsysteem

Two CDA MPs asked the ministers about the rise in food fraud in the EU, citing a 2015 Europol/OHIM report, and asked about EU coordination, training, labelling and non-EU organic certification fraud. The government answered that food fraud is hard to measure, that the NVWA, the Food Fraud Network and training initiatives are underway, and that importers and private certifiers bear primary responsibility.
Food is one of the many product categories that were assessed.
Voedsel is één van de vele productcategorieën die zijn beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Rudmer Heerema over de beantwoording in mijn brief van 3 maart 2015 van eerdere vragen over oversteekplaatsen voor otters

MPs Visser and Rudmer Heerema asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about measures, costs, targets and monitoring for otter crossings following a court ruling requiring 21 urgent road-otter conflict points to be resolved by 1 May 2017. The government answered that seven urgent points are being prepared, that Rijkswaterstaat budgets €665,000 for four of them, that the 79 potential hotspots carry no court-imposed deadline, and that the population target is a sustainable size defined by a 5% extinction risk over 100 years.
In the run-up to 1 May 2016 and 1 May 2017, when the 14 remaining points must be resolved, I expect to be able to inform you further about my consultations with the provinces.
Ik verwacht u in de aanloop naar de datum van 1 mei 2016, respectievelijk 1 mei 2017 waarop de 14 knelpunten opgelost moeten zijn, nader te kunnen informeren over mijn overleg met de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leenders en Van Dekken over het gebruik van een nekbreekapparaat om ganzen te doden

MPs Leenders and Van Dekken asked whether a neck-breaking device used in Gelderland to kill geese is permitted under Dutch and EU rules, whether it was properly tested, and whether its use should be banned. The state secretary answered that the device is not on the approved list but provinces may deviate if no unnecessary suffering is caused, that testing is the province's responsibility, that the matter is under court appeal so no judgement will be given, and that the unit has voluntarily paused its use.
How this device was assessed and/or tested is the responsibility of the province.
Op welke wijze dit apparaat is beoordeeld en/of getest, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de NVWA

MP Van Gerven asked the State Secretary about the NVWA's requirement of a transport document per horse for travel to Germany, whether a three-month document or a Germany-wide memorandum could reduce bureaucracy, and about a bakery cat ban. The government answered that EU rules require health certification per animal, that a Benelux memorandum exists but Germany is not yet covered (talks with the German riding federation are underway), and that the cat must be removed under EU hygiene rules.
With Germany it has so far not been possible to conclude such an agreement, which means that all horses crossing the border into Germany must be certified.
Met Duitsland is het tot op heden niet gelukt om zo'n overeenkomst te sluiten, wat betekent dat alle paarden die de grens overgaan naar Duitsland gecertificeerd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de rechtszaak van de Nederlandse Varkenshouders Vakbond (NVV) tegen de provincie Noord-Brabant

Two MPs asked the state secretary about the NVV pig farmers' union lawsuit against the province of Noord-Brabant over its livestock sustainability score, and about related policy such as the Brabant law and the stopper scheme. The state secretary said the NVV must make its own choices, that a sustainable pig sector transition is needed, and that the Crisis- en herstelwet experiment for Brabant gives the province a firmer legal basis; several answers point to ongoing talks and a future bill.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Albert de Vries over de financiële problemen bij onderzoeksinstituut NIOZ en de gevolgen voor NIOZ-Yerseke

MPs Jacobi and De Vries asked about NIOZ's financial problems and the reported plan to close the Yerseke branch and move staff to Texel, questioning the government's commitment to Zeeland. The Secretaries answer that the financial problems are real, that options including concentration on Texel are being studied with regional parties, that no irreversible decisions have been taken, and that a broader regional knowledge strategy is under review.
There is currently intensive consultation with the province and the municipality, and no irreversible decisions have yet been taken.
Er is inmiddels intensief overleg met de provincie en de gemeente en er zijn nog geen onomkeerbare besluiten genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het uitroeien van de Indische huiskraai in Hoek van Holland

MP Thieme asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the Indian House Crow was ordered eradicated in Hoek van Holland given its stable population, what the costs and results are, and whether the operation is judged a success. The State Secretary answers that a risk assessment and NVWA advice justified early intervention, that about 23,600 euro has been spent and 26 crows removed with 5 remaining, and that it is too early for a final judgement.
Eliminating the birds requires effort and care.
Het elimineren van de vogels vergt inzet en zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het massaal afschieten van ganzen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about mass goose culling in Utrecht that, according to Sovon research, has not reduced goose numbers, and whether the government will back more effective, non-lethal measures. The State Secretary says provinces are responsible for goose management, that culling serves safety and damage-prevention purposes, that further research is needed to judge other measures, and that provinces may pursue experiments such as laser systems with Wageningen expertise.
The province is responsible for managing goose populations and makes its own considerations in this regard.
De provincie is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van ganzenpopulaties en maakt daarin zijn eigen afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs asked the ministers why GPs in Reusel-De Mierden warn of rising resistant-bacteria infections in livestock farmers when RIVM data do not show it, whether data submission should be made mandatory, and whether the GGD study will be shared. The minister replied that RIVM data reflect local trends adequately, that laboratory participation is good and all relevant institutions will be connected by end 2015, that a letter on antibiotic resistance will follow before summer, and that the GGD will not publish a report.
The GGD Brabant-Zuidoost has indicated that it will not publish a report.
De GGD Brabant-Zuidoost heeft aangegeven dat zij geen rapport zullen uitbrengen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Schouw over een rapport van het Duitse Milieu Agentschap (UBA) inzake de belasting op het milieu door conventionele landbouw

An MP asked the government about a German Federal Environment Agency report on environmental pressures from conventional agriculture and whether its findings apply to the Netherlands. The state secretaries answered that the Dutch situation shares nutrient surplus and ammonia issues covered by existing rules, declined further PBL research as unnecessary, and said the report's knowledge would feed into existing policy tracks.
I am of the opinion that additional research by the PBL is not necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat extra onderzoek door het PBL niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht «Meitelling door ruim de helft nog niet ingediend» en de brief van de Nederlandse Melkveehouders Vakbond (NMV)

An MP asked about reports that over half of farmers had not yet submitted the 2015 Gecombineerde Opgave, and about the NMV's concerns over RVO's information provision and accessibility. The Secretary of State said the deadline was extended, RVO maintains contact with the sector, extra call-centre capacity was added, and she rejects a direct link between the submission backlog and RVO's accessibility.
RVO has in the meantime made contact with the NMV so that they could further explain their concerns.
RVO heeft inmiddels contact gelegd met de NMV zodat zij hun zorgen verder hebben kunnen toelichten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties tijdens het Nederlandse EU-voorzitterschap in wil zetten op stedelijke ontwikkeling ten

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked whether the Minister of Interior intends to shift CAP funds toward urban development during the Dutch EU presidency, and questioned the claims about urban green areas and regulation. The minister denied any plan to move CAP budget, pointed to existing EU urban funds (EFRO, ESF) and a planned European Urban Agenda, and did not commit to reconsidering.
The intention is not to take decisions during the Dutch presidency on shifting CAP or other European fund budgets to urban development.
De inzet is niet om tijdens het Nederlands voorzitterschap besluiten te nemen over het verschuiven van budget van het GLB of andere Europese fondsen naar stedelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over een Europese berisping van Nederlandse nertsenhouders

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about EU criticism that Dutch mink farmers' killing practices lack a notification system and proper controls, and about inspection, sanctions and the gassing method. The government acknowledged the missing notification system, said it is being set up with regulatory changes due in 2015, and described past inspections, possible administrative sanctions and planned controls from 2016, while not sanctioning farmers for past non-notification.
The NVWA is currently setting up a notification system.
De NVWA richt momenteel een meldingssysteem in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over de berichten “Met keien vissers pesten”, “Een kei op zijn kop moet de zeenaaktslak beschermen” en “Aangifte tegen Greenpeace om zwerfkeien in zee”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether she condemns Greenpeace's dumping of stones in the Klaverbank area, whether it endangers fishers, whether damages will be recovered, and the timetable for designating the Klaverbank as a Natura 2000 site. The State Secretary condemned the action, said no damage to government is yet established, and gave the expected timeline for the designation decision.
Once that is completed, I will, in accordance with Article 10a(6) of the Nature Conservation Act 1998, submit the draft decisions to the House of Representatives and the Senate.
Zodra dat is afgerond zal ik, conform artikel 10a lid 6 van de Natuurbeschermingswet 1998, de ontwerpen van de besluiten voorhangen bij uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber naar aanleiding van het bericht dat regionale voedselbanken in het nauw komen

An MP asked the state secretaries whether regional food banks in the Rijnmond area are receiving too little food and what the government is doing about it, including progress on the Alliance and Voedselbanken cooperation and support for donation projects. The government attributes the shortfall mainly to a seasonal pattern, describes ongoing cooperation and some supportive measures, and says it is unaware of other obstacles.
It is regrettable that a number of food banks in the Rijnmond region are temporarily receiving too little food.
Het is te betreuren dat een aantal voedselbanken in de regio Rijnmond – tijdelijk – te weinig voedsel aangeleverd krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en de Boer over loslopende reeën ter hoogte van de Oostvaardersplassen

MPs Heerema and De Boer asked whether roaming deer near the Oostvaardersplassen, which briefly halted some Intercity services, can be prevented from disrupting trains, and whether Staatsbosbeheer should be made to secure the fencing. The state secretary answered that preventive fencing exists, the disruption was limited and brief, and Staatsbosbeheer and ProRail are coordinating on possible extra measures.
It is not possible to give an indication of the costs of a disruption, because this differs strongly per situation.
Het is niet mogelijk een indicatie te geven van de kosten van een verstoring, omdat dit per situatie sterk verschilt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de gezondheidsklachten bij mensen die in de buurt van stallen en boerderijen wonen

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether the 2015 NIVEL/IRAS findings on health complaints near livestock farms, and the lack of firm conclusions in the 2012 Health Council report, meant the government would set distance criteria or other health norms. The state secretary answered that evidence is still insufficient, pointed to the ongoing RIVM VGO study due in 2016 and the Wgv odour framework, and said action would be considered after that study.
After this study is completed in 2016, it will be examined whether additional measures regarding public health aspects are needed.
Na afronding van dit onderzoek in 2016, zal worden bezien of aanvullende maatregelen in relatie tot volksgezondheidsaspecten aan de orde zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Aukje de Vries over het artikel “Stop met vissen in de Waddenzee”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a newspaper article calling for an end to fishing in the Wadden Sea, including whether that view fits the Rijke Waddenzee programme. The state secretary answered that fish stock trends show decline since the 1980s with causes still unclear, that sustainable fishing fits the Wadden Sea, and that fishers can add value, with measures being pursued via a fisheries strategy and existing agreements.
Through the development of a fisheries strategy, more insight should be gained into the necessary (trilateral) studies to fill the knowledge gaps.
Via de ontwikkeling van een visstrategie moet er meer zicht komen op de benodigde (trilaterale) onderzoeken om de kennislacunes op te vullen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Graus over «Brute mishandeling door zwanendrifters» naar aanleiding van klokkenluidersverklaringen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs to react to broadcast footage of abuse of swans by swan-uppers, to explain why Parliament was allegedly misinformed, to end the practice quickly, and to introduce lifetime animal-keeping bans for animal abusers. The State Secretary answered that the footage led to revoking the ringing exemptions, that the NVWA imposed a penalty order, that a ban on swan-upping is being explored, and referred the lifetime-ban question to a separate answer.
Furthermore, I am examining in the short term the legal possibilities to prohibit swan-upping.
Verder bezie ik op korte termijn de wettelijke mogelijkheden om het zwanendriften te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over het bericht dat de ingrijpende gevolgen van Q-koorts onderschat worden

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the health consequences of Q-fever, including chronic patients who may be overlooked, are being underestimated, and whether doctors' training, compensation and a general fund for future zoonosis outbreaks will be pursued. The Minister of Health answered that Q-fever remains serious, that Q-support and professional training will address recognition, rejected direct state compensation while promising to review arguments from patient groups, and saw no need for a general zoonosis fund.
I will of course carefully examine whether there are indeed more or different insights that could change the position.
Ik zal uiteraard zorgvuldig bezien of er inderdaad meer of andere inzichten zijn die het standpunt kunnen wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Dekken over zieke rashonden en het Fairfok-keurmerk

MPs Van Gerven and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs why the Fairfok plan of the Dutch kennel club would succeed where earlier agreements failed, and about guarantees, inbreeding, DNA testing, breed standards and enforcement of the animal welfare breeding ban. The State Secretary answered that the plan is ambitious and broadly supported, that targets are reducing sick dogs to 25% by 2019 and 10% by 2024, that no guarantee of health can be given, and that enforcement of article 3.4 has started.

How far guarantees about the absence of hereditary conditions can be given when buying a Fairfok puppy will have to become clear in the elaboration of the Fairfok project plan by the Raad van Beheer and the other organisations involved.

In hoeverre garanties over afwezigheid van erfelijke aandoeningen bij aankoop van een Fairfok-pup kunnen worden gegeven, zal in de uitwerking van het projectplan «Fairfok» door Raad van Beheer en de andere betrokken organisaties moeten gaan blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Teeven over de berichten “Welzijn scharrelvarken niet beter dan gangbaar” en “Welzijn straalt uit naar buren”

MPs Lodders and Teeven (VVD) asked whether animal welfare standards in the EU and in Denmark and Germany are raising Dutch pig farming costs and weakening competitiveness, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that Dutch production costs are only modestly above EU peers, mostly due to environmental rules, and that the government will push for EU-level welfare standards and innovation without unilateral tightening.
I am in favour of tightening animal welfare requirements at European level because of the consequences for the competitiveness and future prospects of the Dutch pig sector.
Ik ben voorstander van het aanscherpen van dierwelzijnseisen op Europees niveau vanwege de gevolgen voor de concurrentiepositie en het toekomstperspectief van de Nederlandse varkenssector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht “bodemvissers worstelen met verbod op teruggooien bijvangst”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how the Dutch government will implement the landing obligation for bycatch in demersal fisheries, given sector concerns about costs and survival, and why bycatch cannot be used for human consumption. The State Secretary answered that she is seeking maximum room for exemptions within the CFP, proposed postponing the landing obligation for plaice in the tongue fishery to 2018 pending survival research, and sent a letter to the European Commission proposing a definition allowing high-value bycatch for human consumption.
I am committed to maximising use of the exemption possibilities offered by the basic CFP regulation.
Ik zet mij in voor maximale benutting van de uitzonderingsmogelijkheden die de basisverordening van het GVB biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de fiscale vrijstelling voor SNL-subsidies

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretaries whether the tax exemption for SNL nature and landscape management subsidies, which applied until 2013, has been approved by the European Commission for 2014 onward, and what the consequences are for tax returns and the timeline. The government answered that the exemption falls under a state aid notification covering provincial schemes, that the Commission began questioning the notification on 13 May 2015, and that approval is not expected before the last quarter of 2015, while taxpayers may rely on national law but face recovery with interest if approval is refused.
Where possible, the Dutch authorities involved are making efforts to obtain a prompt response from the Commission.
Waar mogelijk spannen de betrokken Nederlandse autoriteiten zich in om spoedig een reactie te krijgen van de Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het niet meer mogen afschrijven van productie- en ammoniakrechten

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Economic Affairs about the Tax Authority's decision to stop depreciation of production and ammonia rights, and whether this was agreed with the agricultural sector. The government answered that depreciation of production rights is allowed because their temporariness is demonstrable, that ammonia rights may be written off in 2014 and 2015 given the PAS, and that the Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 will be corrected.
The Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 will be adjusted on the point of production rights and ammonia rights.
De Landelijke Landbouwnormen 2014 zullen op het punt van de productierechten en ammoniakrechten aangepast worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het niet meer mogen afschrijven van productie- en ammoniakrechten

An MP asked the State Secretaries of Finance and Economic Affairs whether they knew of reports that the tax authority would correct depreciation of production and ammonia rights, and whether they would refrain from corrections and fines until consultation with accountants and the agricultural sector was completed. The State Secretary answered that he had decided to allow the depreciation and referred to earlier answers.
I have decided to allow the depreciation.
Ik heb besloten de afschrijving toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de berichtgeving “Suzuki-fruitvlieg hele winter op grote schaal actief gebleven” en “Suzuki-fruitvlieg”

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that the Suzuki fruit fly survived winter and threatens the harvest, including requests for emergency exemptions for pesticides such as Tracer for cherry growers. The State Secretary answered that exemptions for Exirel and Tracer on cherries have been granted or decided and that the government will pursue a long-term EU-level solution.
I support a joint European approach, which I also advocated in the Agriculture and Fisheries Council, in which the sector is also actively involved.
Ik steun een gezamenlijke Europese aanpak, waar ik ook voor heb gepleit in de Landbouw en Visserijraad, waarbij ook de sector actief is betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de berichten dat, tegen gemaakte afspraken in, varkenshouders weer beginnen met castreren van biggen

An MP asked the state secretary about reports that pig farmers resumed castrating piglets despite the 2018 Brussels Declaration goal, and whether a legal ban would follow. The state secretary said the 2018 ambition stands but that the market is primarily responsible, refused a unilateral national ban, and saw no need for further research on Improvac.
I will not proceed to a unilateral ban on castration in the Netherlands.
Ik zal niet overgaan tot een eenzijdig verbod op het castreren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht “Ministeries zijn het nog niet eens over alle details in Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof”

MPs Lodders and Visser asked whether ministries disagree on details of the Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof and whether new recalculations are needed, with consequences for timing and consultation. The State Secretary answers that the Rijk and 12 provinces reached agreement on finalising the programme, with entry into force on 1 July 2015 and a partial amendment by 15 December 2015 after an AERIUS Monitor update, subject to public consultation.
The Rijk and the 12 provinces have reached agreement on the finalisation and entry into force of the programme aanpak stikstof.
Het Rijk en de 12 provincies hebben overeenstemming bereikt over de afronding en inwerkingtreding van het programma aanpak stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de Nederlandse implementatiewijze van de Vogel- en Habitatrichtlijn

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Dutch implementation of the Birds and Habitats Directives, including whether an inventory of problems across the provinces had been made for the EU fitness check, its timing, how results would reach parliament, and which laws the identified problems stem from. The State Secretary confirmed the inventory was done with the IPO and completed, referred to a separate letter with the results, and stated the problems stem from the EU directives, which will be raised with the Commission, while nationally changed matters are addressed in a pending nature protection bill.
In my view, the problems I mention in the above-mentioned letter to your House stem from the European Birds and Habitats Directives.
De knelpunten die ik in bovengenoemde brief aan uw Kamer noem, vloeien naar mijn oordeel voort uit de Europese Vogel- en Habitatrichtlijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over een uitbreiding van een nertsenfokkerij in Haps gemeente Cuijk

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an expansion permit for a mink farm in Haps, and whether new or expanded mink farms can be stopped while the Fur Animal Farming Ban is suspended by court ruling. The government answered that the permit concerns an existing situation without more animals, that the ban cannot currently be enforced pending appeal, and that the Rijk does not track permit applications kept at provincial and municipal level.
I am not aware of how many other permit applications have been submitted for expansion and new mink farms since the court ruling that suspended the law.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel andere vergunningsaanvragen er zijn gedaan voor uitbreiding en nieuwe nertsenfokkerijen sinds de uitspraak van de rechter waarmee de wet buiten werking is gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het afsterven van spenen bij melkkoeien

An MP asked the State Secretary whether rising reports of ischemic teat necrosis in young dairy cows, linked to housing, feed, exercise, cold and higher milk yield, warrant further research and stricter supervision. The State Secretary replied that there is no evidence of a causal link to milk yield or reduced grazing, sees no reason for research, does not systematically record the data, and notes the condition itself is not a welfare violation.
At this moment I therefore see no reason for research into the condition ischemic teat necrosis.
Op dit moment zie ik dan ook geen reden voor onderzoek naar de aandoening ischemische speennecrose.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de compensatie aan vissers op het IJsselmeer

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the delayed 340,000 euro compensation for IJsselmeer fishers, the allocation key proposed by the producers' organisation, and whether illegal shad fishing affects compensation. The State Secretary answered that the money has been paid to a transition foundation which passes it to the producers' organisation, that the allocation key is left to that organisation under the 2014 agreement, and that illegal fishing has no effect on the compensation.
The administrative agreement stipulates that the allocation key is determined by the PO.
In het bestuurlijk akkoord is afgesproken dat de verdeelsleutel door de PO wordt bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir ,Van Gerven en Schouw over een einde aan de kraambox voor zeugen en enige andere samenhangende vragen

MPs Bashir, Van Gerven and Schouw asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about ending farrowing crates for sows, the Pro Dromi alternative, funding for its research, nesting material and inspections, and the EU welfare guidelines, covering 16 questions. The State Secretary answered that Pro Dromi is promising but needs further optimisation before wider rollout, declined to make it mandatory to preserve innovation, pointed to existing funding routes, and said nesting material is largely exempt due to manure systems.
I will discuss with the Dutch pig producers' organisation (POV) and the entrepreneurs involved which bottlenecks exist in practical implementation.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met de Producentenorganisatie Varkenshouderij (POV) en de betrokken ondernemers om na te gaan welke knelpunten er zijn bij de praktijkimplementatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over het rapport met adviezen voor de aanpak van vogelgriep van de Dierenbescherming

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she views the Dierenbescherming report proposing more animal-friendly bird flu control, and whether she will adopt its recommendations. The State Secretary says progress has been made but many proposals are not feasible in the proposed timeframe, while pointing to ongoing work on vaccines, poultry hygiene scans, transport bans at hatcheries and a review of free-range farms near water.
In summary, the Dierenbescherming proposals are sympathetic but not all feasible, certainly not within the proposed timeline.
Samengevat zijn de voorstellen van de Dierenbescherming sympathiek, maar niet allemaal uitvoerbaar, zeker niet binnen de voorgestelde tijdslijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi, Albert de Vries, Bosman en Visser over het strandvissen met kleine fuiken

Four MPs asked the State Secretary whether the ban on recreational eel fyke-netting in Zeeland's beach fishing could be reconsidered given its heritage status and the Waddeneilanden exception. The State Secretary answered that the ban applies nationwide, enforcement would be disproportionate, and the eel stock remains critical, so there is no reason to reopen the ban or consult again.
I therefore see no reason to revisit the position of my predecessors or to enter into consultation on this again.
Ik zie daarom geen reden om op het standpunt van mijn ambtsvoorgangers terug te komen en hierover opnieuw in overleg te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Leegte en Veldman over de gevolgen van windenergiegebieden op zee voor de visserij

Three VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the economic damage to fishing from the Borssele offshore wind zones, including detours, fishing-ground loss, and passage for vessels up to 42 metres. The State Secretary answered that impacts will be assessed in the final environmental report, that a decision on passage for vessels up to 24 metres is planned for end-2015, and that the fishing sector remains involved.
At this moment it therefore cannot yet be indicated what the effects will be.
Op dit moment is dan ook nog niet aan te geven wat de effecten zullen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Leenders over de “maffiahandel in puppy’s”

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of mafia-style trafficking of puppies from Eastern Europe, including health risks, protection of veterinarians, possible vet complicity, and steps to stop it. The government answered by referring largely to a separate letter on puppy trade, noting rabies vaccination exemption for puppies was ended, that vets involved can face criminal or disciplinary prosecution, and that threatened vets can report to police.
Where enforcement and supervision reveal that Dutch veterinarians are involved in illegal dog trade, they can be prosecuted under criminal or disciplinary law.
Daar waar bij handhaving en toezicht blijkt dat Nederlandse dierenartsen betrokken zijn bij illegale hondenhandel kunnen zij strafrechtelijk, dan wel tuchtrechtelijk worden vervolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over de illegale handel in puppy’s

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the State Secretary and Justice Minister about illegal cross-border puppy trade, document fraud, online sales, veterinary complicity, police and NVWA enforcement, and a lifetime animal-keeping ban. The government answered that it has taken measures, pointed to separate letters, said veterinarians cannot be prosecuted without proven intent, rejected mandatory parent-dog presence, and promised an evaluation of the keeping ban before the summer recess.
At the request of the House, the Minister of Justice will also examine in the evaluation the possibilities of imposing the keeping ban as a standalone measure or penalty.
Op verzoek van uw Kamer laat de Minister van V&J in de evaluatie ook kijken naar de mogelijkheden het houdverbod als zelfstandige maatregel of straf op te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over ‘de dood van tienduizenden veldleeuweriken door maaien’

An MP asked the state secretary about reports of tens of thousands of skylarks killed by mowing, the trend in other provinces, whether field supervision and enforcement should be tightened, and how this relates to the Rli's criticism of agri-environment management. The state secretary said trends in most provinces show modest decline, that provinces are seeking solutions and that strengthening field supervision is a provincial responsibility, and pointed to the new collective agri-environment scheme from 2016.
Strengthening field supervision is also an option, but that is a consideration that falls within the powers of the province.
Versterking van het veldtoezicht is ook een optie, maar dat is een afweging die tot de bevoegdheden van de provincie behoort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de uitbraak van vogelgriep in Barneveld

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government about a bird flu outbreak in Barneveld, including preventive culling, animal welfare in culling, the broeder transport ban, and the Wet dieraantallen en volksgezondheid and Brabantwet. The state secretary answered that no preventive culling occurred, that vaccination is not yet a feasible alternative, that the sector must prepare for transport bans, and that the outbreak does not warrant the Brabant law's use in Gelderland.
No animals have been preventively culled on farms surrounding the infected company.
Er zijn geen dieren preventief geruimd op bedrijven rondom het besmette bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Mohandis over de hernieuwde plannen voor experimenten op honden door de Universiteit Maastricht
