MPs Van Dekken and Mohandis asked whether Maastricht University's renewed plans for dog experiments on pacemaker research, suspended last year, were reasonable, including the ethics committee's approval and alternatives. The government replied that the research is not yet resumed, an external commission is reviewing the internal approval procedure first, the DEC's approval meets the legal requirements, and no further inquiry is planned.
Maastricht University has indicated that the internal procedures that led to approval of this animal experiment will be evaluated by an external committee.
De Universiteit Maastricht heeft aangegeven dat de interne procedures die hebben geleid tot de goedkeuring van deze dierproef geëvalueerd zullen worden door een externe commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het gebruik van mineralenconcentraat (verkregen uit mestverwerking) als kunstmestvervanger binnen de EU

MP Lodders asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether manure-derived mineral concentrate should be allowed as a fertiliser substitute outside the Nitrates Directive manure standard, what steps had been taken with the European Commission, and whether the Commission's refusal frustrates Dutch innovation. The State Secretary replied that the Nitrates Directive currently only permits use within the 170 kg nitrogen per hectare standard, that she is pursuing three tracks (EU fertiliser framework changes, circular economy discussions, and expanding the pilot toward derogation), and that the pilot entered a new phase on 1 January 2015.
I am currently concentrating on the three tracks already named in the answer to questions 1 and 2.
Ik concentreer mij op dit moment op de in het antwoord op vraag 1 en 2 al benoemde drie sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Van Dekken over de “toename van antibiotica in water”

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about rising antibiotics in surface water, including whether swimmers could develop resistance and whether drinking water is at risk, and what steps would reduce emissions. The government answered that no research shows low antibiotic concentrations cause resistance in swimmers, that drinking water treatment is effective and meets norms, that residues come from both livestock and human use, and that an integrated approach letter will follow before summer.
No research data are known on the presence of antibiotics specifically in Dutch recreational waters.
Over de aanwezigheid van antibiotica specifiek in Nederlandse recreatiewateren zijn geen onderzoeksgegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over vleesaanbiedingen onder de € 4,12 per kilo zonder dierenwelzijnskeurmerk

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why policy on cheap meat offers below 4.12 euro per kilo without an animal welfare label relies on unverified Wakker Dier figures, and how a 'reasonable price' is defined. The State Secretary largely referred to earlier answers, said policy is not based on Wakker Dier data, that price is set by market supply and demand, and pointed to existing price monitoring reports.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verstrekken van subsidie op het versnipperen van kuikens

An MP asked whether the government's bird-flu compensation scheme for hatching eggs and day-old chicks rewarded hatcheries that kept hatching and sent surplus chicks to the macerator, and what would be done about animal suffering during transport bans. The state secretary said the sector is responsible for mitigating suffering, the scheme was a short 10-day compensation based on market value that she judged created little incentive, and she would consult the poultry sector on requiring temporary chick-holding facilities.
I have no statistics on the way in which the companies have done this.
Ik heb geen statistieken over de wijze waarop de bedrijven dit hebben gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Wolbert en Leenders over de gezondheidsrisico’s van de intensieve veehouderij

MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers whether they share concern from Reusel-De Mierden GPs about rising multiresistant infections and requested an overview of infection trends in Noord-Brabant. The minister replied that Brabant infection rates are not higher than elsewhere in the Netherlands, no regional data for Reusel-De Mierden is available, and an integrated antibiotic resistance approach letter will follow before summer.
Separate data for Reusel-De Mierden are currently not available to us.
Aparte gegevens voor Reusel-De Mierden zijn bij ons op dit moment niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht ‘Vee heeft invloed op gezondheid’

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers about preliminary research suggesting livestock farming affects residents' health, and whether a moratorium on new large stables should follow. The government replied that the findings are not conclusive, that the study will finish in 2016, that no measures are warranted now, and that permitting is a decentralised matter.
That means the interim results are not a basis for taking any measures at this time.
Dat betekent dat de tussentijdse resultaten geen basis zijn om op dit moment maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de dreigende toelating van Amerikaanse chloorkippen tot de Europese markt

MP Thieme asks whether the EU will lift its ban on chlorine-washed American chicken before end-2015, linked to TTIP, and whether this erodes EU food and environmental standards, including on cloned-animal products and endocrine disruptors. The minister replies that such chicken is not admitted, that the EU ban on hormone-treated beef is kept under the precautionary principle, that the Commission has committed to keeping EU standards in TTIP talks, and that EFSA found no health differences for clone offspring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over kunstmatige vossenburchten en jacht

An MP asked whether artificial fox earths sold online for fox hunting are animal-unfriendly and non-species-specific, possibly endangering badgers, and whether their sale should be banned. The minister said the rules do not prohibit artificial earths, that hunters would act if badgers were found, that keeping the diameter small prevents badger use, that provinces hold any figures on frequency, and referred back to these points on the ban question.
The regulations do not exclude the use of an artificial fox earth, the so-called kunstbouw.
De regelgeving sluit het gebruik van een kunstmatige vossenburcht, de zogenaamd kunstbouw, niet uit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over uitspraken van de Eurocommissaris voor Betere Regelgeving over de Nederlandse implementatie van het Europese natuurbeleid

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary whether the government shares the EU Better Regulation Commissioner's view that Dutch implementation of EU nature directives causes many problems, and whether it will inventory these with the provinces and address them. The State Secretary acknowledged the Commissioner's remarks, said Dutch implementation is largely shaped by EU requirements but that national law can be improved (pointing to a pending nature protection bill), and said the economic and social factors are taken into account in management plans, while no firm new commitment beyond inventorying knowledge gaps was made.
Yes, the weighing takes place within the development of the management plan for the designated Natura 2000 area.
Ja, de afweging vindt plaats in het kader van de ontwikkeling van het beheerplan voor het aangewezen Natura 2000 gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over landschapselementen als invulling van de vergroening

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether landscape elements such as hedgerows and tree rows, including those under former agri-environment agreements, can count toward the ecological focus area of the EU greening requirement, and raised concerns about administrative burden and monitoring. The State Secretary answered that landscape elements are only partly eligible (field margins in the general list, managed elements within approved equivalent packages), that double financing must be avoided, and that a study on a growth model for landscape elements is underway.

In line with the adopted Jacobi, Dik-Faber motion, I am currently having a study carried out with Landschapsbeheer Nederland into the possibilities for a growth model for landscape elements as ecological focus area.

In lijn met de aangenomen motie Jacobi, Dik-Faber, Kamerstuk 28 625, nr. 214 van uw Kamer, laat ik thans in samenwerking met Landschapsbeheer Nederland een studie uitvoeren naar de mogelijkheden voor een groeimodel voor landschapselementen als ecologisch aandachtsgebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over kritiek van de Waddeneilanden op de Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof

An MP asked the State Secretary whether objections from the Wadden islands to the Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) were known, why a simpler German system and small-scale municipalities were not accommodated, how municipalities are involved, and about alternative emission techniques and the foreign share of nitrogen deposition. The State Secretary answered that 561 objections were received and analysed in a Nota van Antwoord without direct contact with all submitters, defended the Dutch threshold of 1 mol/ha/year, said provinces involve municipalities, and committed to adjusting the programme if foreign deposition causes shortfalls.
As promised to the island municipalities, the municipalities will be involved in implementation.
Zoals aan de eilandgemeenten is toegezegd, worden de gemeenten bij de uitvoering betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts met betrekking tot “het onmogelijk maken van private kwaliteitssystemen”

An MP asks the government whether private quality systems in the pig and veal sectors, which fund mandatory self-checks on banned substances, can survive the abolition of the productschappen, and what consequences non-participation would have. The State Secretary answers that the sector is responsible for financing its own systems, that the regulation change takes effect 1 July 2015, that NVWA will supervise self-checks and may apply differentiated supervision, and that AVV cannot cover control costs.
As a result, it is now explicitly stated that not only processors of primary products, such as slaughterhouses, must carry out self-checks, but also livestock farmers.
Hierdoor wordt nu expliciet aangegeven dat niet alleen de verwerkers van primaire producten, zoals slachterijen, zelfcontrole moeten uitvoeren, maar ook de veehouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over visserijproblemen op het Lauwersmeer

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about intensive commercial fyke-net fishing on the Lauwersmeer and whether a fishing company complies with its lease conditions, including participation in the fish stock management committee. The State Secretary confirmed the concerns, described a 2015 enforcement action and a report for late return of fyke nets, explained the sanctions available under criminal and private law, and said the existing fish management plan suffices while a new statutory regime is being prepared.

At a control action at the beginning of this year, however, a official report was drawn up against this commercial fisherman for failing to empty the fyke nets in time (and after being called upon to do so), as a result of which unnecessary mortality of the bycaught scaled fish occurred.

Bij een controleactie begin van dit jaar is wel een proces verbaal opgemaakt tegen deze beroepsvisser vanwege het niet tijdig (en na oproep hiertoe) legen van de fuiken als gevolg waarvan onnodige sterfte van de bijgevangen schubvis optrad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het veilen en opvangen van dieren na een inbeslagname

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked why a severely neglected pony was auctioned after a bankruptcy and whether curators may auction animals and pressure debtors with seizure threats. The government answered that auctions are permitted under the Bankruptcy Act, that criminal complaints were filed, that curators must follow the Animal Welfare Act and may be complained about to the rechter-commissaris, and that no additional national policy is considered necessary.
This of course does not prevent those involved from complaining about the curator's conduct to the rechter-commissaris, who supervises the proper handling of the bankruptcy.
Dit laat uiteraard onverlet dat betrokkenen zich over het gedrag van de curator kunnen beklagen bij de rechter-commissaris, die toeziet op de correcte afwikkeling van het faillissement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het Duitse beroepsverbod aan een Nederlandse varkenshouder

MP Thieme asks the state secretary about a German professional ban on a controversial Dutch pig farmer, whether Dutch sites were affected, past NVWA inspections, and prosecutions. The state secretary confirms the German ban is limited to Germany, reports 14 NVWA inspections since 2007 with fines and an injunction, and says the NVWA will inspect the farmer's sites very regularly from now on.
The NVWA will therefore continue to inspect the farmer's businesses very regularly in the coming period.
De NVWA zal de bedrijven van de betreffende veehouder komende tijd dan ook zeer regelmatig blijven inspecteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de Gemeenschappelijke Marktordening subsidies

MPs Geurts asked whether the government would uphold the former state secretary's position that corrections to fruit and vegetable CMO programmes (2006-2008) were the Dutch state's cost and not recoverable from beneficiaries, and about legal uncertainty, litigation, support for producer organisations and recovery practices in other member states. The state secretary answered that the 2014 CJEU ruling made the Commission's EUR 22.7 million correction final, that Dutch law requires recovery from beneficiaries in principle, that she has pressed the Commission on audit uncertainty, and that she has no insight into other member states' recovery practices.
I have no insight into the recovery practice of other member states following financial corrections imposed by the European Commission.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de terugvorderingspraktijk van andere lidstaten naar aanleiding van opgelegde financiële correcties van de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over berichtgeving omtrent het schandaal bij AquaPurga in Den Bosch

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions, health risks, subsidies, and liability at manure processor AquaPurga following press reports. The government answered that it cannot disclose individual inspection or bankruptcy information, found no known health risks to residents, and stated that liability for workplace health damage lies between employer and employee, with courts deciding if they disagree.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make the results of an inspection at an individual company public.
Inspectie SZW maakt de resultaten van een inspectie bij een individueel bedrijf niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over afschot van herten op het eiland Haringvreter

The MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the culling of fallow deer on Haringvreter, the basis for the deer population growth assumptions and the need for independent research, and whether the permit should be withdrawn. The State Secretary answers that the province of Zeeland is the competent authority for the Flora- and faunawet permit, that population growth and grazing pressure justify culling, and that the province is responsible for the decision.
For issuing any exemption under the Flora- and faunawet, the province of Zeeland is in this case the competent authority and therefore responsible for taking a considered decision.

Voor het afgeven van een eventuele ontheffing op grond van de Flora- en faunawet is de provincie Zeeland in dit geval het bevoegd gezag en daarmee verantwoordelijk voor het nemen van een afgewogen besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de herintroductie van de Atlantische zalm naar aanleiding van de antwoorden op eerdere vragen

Jacobi (PvdA) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about staand want fishing permits at the Rotterdam harbour mouth, the 500m fishing-free zone at the Haringvliet sluices, survival of discarded protected fish from seine fishing, and causes of declining fish stocks. Dijksma answered that the three historic permits (only two in use) are not new, that the zone is set in the Uitvoeringsregeling, that seine-caught discards survive well, and that a 2012 study found no overfishing in the Benedenrivieren area.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over ganzen afschotdag

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary about a mass goose-shooting day in Limburg, questioning whether it violated animal welfare duties and the rules on competitions with animals, and whether residents were informed. The state secretary answered that the shooting was invasive-species management within legal bounds, that no disturbance of nature was evident, informing residents is the hunters' responsibility, and that there was no reason to ban the event.
Reports of the goose shooting day of 21 February show no sign that it conflicted with the provisions of the Animal Welfare Act.
Uit verslaggeving van de ganzen afschotdag op 21 februari jl. blijkt niet dat hier sprake was van strijdigheid van de bepalingen van de Wet Dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten “Varkensschuur in Putten in de as gelegd” en “40.000 kippen omgekomen bij brand in Veendam”

An MP asked the government whether two barn fires (a pig barn in Putten and a poultry barn in Veendam) met fire-safety rules, how existing barns are being adapted under the Stalbranden action plan, and for a progress overview. The government answered that both barns complied with the rules in force, that new fire-safety requirements apply to new or rebuilt barns since April 2014, and that a progress report will be sent to parliament this autumn.
A progress report on the action plan is planned for this autumn. I will send this report to your House.
Een voortgangsrapportage van het actieplan is voorzien voor dit najaar. Ik zal uw Kamer deze rapportage toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het afgeven van exportcertificaten door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) op zaterdag

An MP asked whether the NVWA's refusal to issue export certificates on Saturdays hurts Topigs Norsvin's competitiveness and asked for weekend certification. The state secretary replied that the NVWA already offers Saturday certification on request, subject to additional conditions for out-of-hours requests.
The NVWA does, in line with its planning framework, indeed offer the possibility of export certification on Saturday for companies that wish it.
Antwoord 3 De NVWA biedt, conform haar planningskader 1 , wel degelijk de mogelijkheid tot exportcertificering op zaterdag voor bedrijven die dat wensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de langetermijneffecten van Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked about long-term effects of Q fever, including whether the government will settle claims with patients outside court and reach an amicable settlement. The minister acknowledged the health burden, pointed to support via Stichting Q-support and research funding, but stated the state accepts no liability and sees no reason for an amicable settlement.
According to the State, however, there is no question of unlawful conduct as a result of which Q-fever patients have suffered damage.
Volgens de Staat is evenwel geen sprake van onrechtmatig handelen als gevolg waarvan Q-koortspatiënten schade hebben geleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de langetermijneffecten van Q-koorts

An MP asked why livestock farmers can claim compensation for animal disease outbreaks while people made ill by Q fever cannot, and whether the government will pay damages to Q fever victims. The minister replied that Dutch law places own-damage risk on individuals with solidarity-based health care, that farmers receive culling compensation from the Animal Health Fund but not consequential losses, and that the state sees no unlawful act and therefore no reason for damages, though it funded the Q-support foundation.
According to the State, there is however no unlawful act as a result of which Q fever patients have suffered damage.
Volgens de Staat is evenwel geen sprake van onrechtmatig handelen als gevolg waarvan Q-koortspatiënten schade hebben geleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht in de Boerderij “Fout bij 1 op 12 EU-subsidies”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how she responded to a European Court of Auditors finding of an 8.2 percent error rate in rural development subsidies, whether Dutch error rates and costs are known, and whether she will act on the finding that farmers are not incentivised to comply and controls and sanctions are too weak. The State Secretary answered that the error rate reflects procedural documentation gaps rather than proven fraud, that Dutch error rates are not comparable and no cost overview exists, that she does not recognise the claim about farmer incentives, and that she will pursue simpler rules and collective agri-environment management from 2016.
I do not have an overview available of the costs incurred by these errors in paying out rural development funds.
Ik heb geen overzicht beschikbaar van de kosten die gemaakt zijn door deze fouten bij het uitkeren van plattelandsontwikkelingsgelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het in beslag nemen van nachtegalen en sijzen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the seizure of Japanese nightingales and siskins and why a trader caught with unringed siskins received only a warning and loss of the birds, and whether stricter action should follow. The State Secretary confirmed the news, said the birds could not have come from the wild so seizure and a warning were deemed sufficient, and considered the action adequate.
In the present case, in my view, action was taken adequately.
In het onderhavige geval is naar mijn mening adequaat opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over steun voor de varkenssector

An MP asks why the Netherlands abstained on the Commission's private storage scheme for pork, whether it will oppose the measure, and about its costs, market effects and seasonal fit. The Secretary of State says the Netherlands supported private storage given low prices but abstained because the Commission refused early release, that the scheme is funded from the EU agricultural guarantee fund, and that the Netherlands is willing to support it while preferring a different design.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de slechte score op voedselveiligheid van visbedrijven

An SP MP asked the State Secretary and Minister of Health about the poor food safety scores of fish processing firms, the NVWA's inspection frequency and capacity, the classification of Foppen as 'red' despite earlier praise from the Safety Board, and why inspection reports are published later for processors than auctions. Minister Schippers acknowledged the share of 'green' firms is too low, defended the inspection system and its risk-based frequency, declined to disclose individual firm inspection results, and committed to adding inspectors and publishing reports from 2015-2016.
I do not inform the House about the individual inspection results.
Ik informeer de Kamer niet over de individuele inspectieresultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over overmacht bij het niet tijdig melden van het uitrijden van ruige mest

An MP asked the State Secretary whether force majeure can be invoked in an agricultural nature-management subsidy case where a manure-spreading notification was late, and whether provinces should be asked to include such a clause in their rules. The State Secretary confirmed the case and the legal basis for force majeure, and said she will alert provinces to the option of including a force majeure clause in new rules, while noting provinces are autonomous.
However, I consider it important that in distressing situations an appeal to force majeure can be made.
Ik vind het echter belangrijk dat in schrijnende situaties een beroep op overmacht gedaan kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over “vleesaanbiedingen onder € 4,12 per kilo zonder dierenwelzijnskeurmerk”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs why she based her stance against meat offers below 4.12 euro per kilo without an animal welfare label on Wakker Dier's unverified figures, and asked for supporting data and comments on the sector. The state secretary answered that such offers are undesirable as a signal and for welfare and food safety reasons, that the ministry does not verify the Wakker Dier figures and conducts no own supermarket research, and that discounting near expiry is acceptable as it prevents food waste.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs does not conduct its own research into offers in supermarkets.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken voert geen eigen onderzoek uit naar aanbiedingen in supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over dieronvriendelijke muizenbestrijding

An MP asked the state secretary about a 'drowning machine' used by farmers to kill mice and whether the state would discourage it. The state secretary said the grower may choose how to control mice causing crop damage, and that a joint study will look at alternatives before any discouragement is considered.
I see no reason to discourage the method in question in advance of that.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om vooruitlopend daarop de betreffende methode te ontmoedigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de belangen van jachtopzieners naar aanleiding van het schieten van houtsnippen door jachtopzieners

An MP asked about a hunting party at Landgoed Duivenvoorde where a gamekeeper and others shot woodcock unlawfully, asking about proces-verbaal, revocation of hunting licences, the dual role of gamekeepers, and a ban on woodcock trade. The state secretary answered that a police investigation is ongoing and licence revocation will follow it, defended the gamekeeper's dual role, and stated that woodcock trade is already prohibited.
When this is concluded, the chief of police will decide, under Article 42 of the Flora and Fauna Act, whether the hunting licences of those involved will be revoked or not.
Wanneer dit is afgerond zal de korpschef, op grond van artikel 42 van de Flora- en faunawet, besluiten of de jachtaktes van de betrokkenen al dan niet worden ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Rudmer Heerema met betrekking tot oversteekplaatsen voor otters

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Infrastructure and Environment how the government will respond to a Hague appeals court ruling requiring measures for otter road crossings, including which bottlenecks will be fixed, when, at what cost, and how this relates to the national ecology programme and provincial responsibilities. The government answered that seven urgent bottlenecks will be addressed immediately, the other 14 urgent ones by about 2016 and all 21 by mid-2017, funded from the Economic Affairs budget, with provinces responsible for nature policy implementation and some costs and measures still undetermined.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment (Rijkswaterstaat) and the provinces of Friesland and Overijssel will immediately start on the seven most urgent bottlenecks named in the ruling.

Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken, het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu (Rijkswaterstaat) en de provincies Friesland en Overijssel starten direct met de zeven meest urgente knelpunten zoals benoemd in het arrest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van ’t Wout over het bericht «Mug met virus groeit hard in poldermoeras»

Two VVD MPs asked the health and economic affairs ministers how mosquito-borne disease is monitored and whether wetland restoration raises public health risks such as dengue and West Nile virus. The minister answered that current mosquito species pose no significant disease risk, that monitoring and existing Alterra and RIVM studies continue, and that wetland expansion is a provincial matter with no current measured disease burden, so further RIVM advice is awaited.
The RIVM is currently working with the NVWA's Centre for Vector Monitoring on policy advice on the control of native mosquitoes.
Het RIVM werkt op dit moment in samenwerking met het Centrum Monitoring Vectoren van de NVWA aan een beleidsadvies over de inheemse muggenbestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over beweiding en bemesting in het kader van de Natuurbeschermingswet

MP Dijkgraaf asked whether the Council of State ruling on grazing and manure application under the Nature Conservation Act means these must be assessed per parcel for nitrogen deposition, what consequences this has for existing permits, the Programmatic Approach Nitrogen and encouraging grazing. The Secretary of State answered that a permit may be required near nitrogen-sensitive Natura 2000 areas unless existing use can be shown, that provincial executives must judge existing use, that per-parcel deposition calculations cannot be excluded, and referred to a separate letter on the exemption.
The provincial executives of the province concerned are the competent authority for the permit under the Nbw and will have to assess whether in the specific case there is existing use.
Gedeputeerde staten van de betrokken provincie zijn bevoegd gezag voor de vergunning op grond van de Nbw en zullen moeten beoordelen of in het concrete geval sprake is van «bestaand gebruik».
Antwoord op vragen van de Aukje de Vries en Lodders over bankfinanciering in relatie tot muizenschade in Fryslân

MPs asked whether Deutsche Bank takes a stricter line than Rabobank toward farmers suffering vole damage in Fryslân, and whether the minister would raise this with Deutsche Bank and survey other banks' financing problems. The government answered that Deutsche Bank's affected client base is too small to show a specific policy, that complaints unrelated to its strategic reorientation must be filed by clients themselves, and that the State Secretary is consulting banks and regions and examining a guarantee scheme for residual hardship cases.

As I indicated in my letter of 29 January and as agreed with your House, I will continue to bring complaints that are the direct result of Deutsche Bank Nederland's strategic reorientation directly to the attention of its Management Board.

Zoals ik in mijn brief van 29 januari jl. heb aangegeven en ook met uw Kamer heb afgesproken, zal ik klachten die het directe gevolg zijn van de strategische heroriëntatie van Deutsche Bank Nederland rechtstreeks onder de aandacht blijven brengen van de Raad van Bestuur van Deutsche Bank Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leenders over het bericht “Run boeren op vergunning uit vrees voor PAS”

MPs asked whether a surge of nature permit applications in Gelderland and Noord-Brabant, filed before the PAS nitrogen programme takes effect, would consume PAS nitrogen space and whether these applications could be granted without the PAS. The state secretary answered that granting them does not affect PAS space, that new developments need proof of no negative effects, and that transitional rules bar pre-PAS applications from receiving PAS development space, requiring new PAS applications instead.
Granting these permits has no consequences for the space that is created with the PAS.
Het verlenen van deze vergunningen heeft geen gevolgen voor de ruimte die met de PAS gecreëerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de kwaliteit van het middelbaar agrarisch onderwijs in Noord Nederland

An MP asked the State Secretary and Education Minister about complaints from farmers and parents over the quality of agricultural vocational education in Northern Netherlands, including basic skills and contact hours. The government answered that quality is the institution's primary responsibility, pointed to improvement plans and inspection follow-up at AOC Terra, and declined further inspection research.
Determining the educational content and methodology of vocational training is the primary responsibility of the institution.
De bepaling van de onderwijsinhoud en -methodiek van beroepsopleidingen is de primaire verantwoordelijkheid van de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over verkeersveiligheid en faunabeleid naar aanleiding van wilde zwijnen op de A1

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about wild boar on the A1 motorway, including fence quality, the planned shooting, and wider boar management and night-hunting rules. The State Secretary answered that the fence was in place but three boar got through, that shooting was planned but not carried out because the animals had left, and that boar management and shooting policy are the responsibility of the provinces.
As a result of this incident with wild boar, Rijkswaterstaat has decided to carry out an extra one-time inspection at the location concerned.
Als gevolg van dit incident met wilde zwijnen heeft Rijkswaterstaat besloten om op de betreffende locatie éénmalig een extra inspectie uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Bommel over visserij voor de kust van de Westelijke Sahara

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about Dutch-flagged fishing off Western Sahara, including the legal basis for treating the activity as lawful, whether local population consent is required, and how fishing revenues benefit the local population. The minister defended the UN position treating Morocco as de facto administering power, stated that consent of the indigenous population's representatives is not currently required under international law though consultation should occur, and described EU payments and 31 Morocco-reported projects, 13 of them in Western Sahara, with reporting due at the next joint committee.

The Netherlands is of the view that the proceeds of fishing through EU payments for access to, among other waters, the waters of Western Sahara, where Morocco exercises de facto authority, should also benefit the original population of Western Sahara.

Nederland is van oordeel dat de opbrengsten van de visserij via de EU-afdrachten ten behoeve van toegang tot onder meer de wateren van de Westelijke Sahara, waar Marokko feitelijk gezag uitoefent, ook ten goede moeten komen aan de oorspronkelijke bevolking van de Westelijke Sahara.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de hulpverlening aan Q-koortspatiënten

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the minister about support for Q-fever patients, including Q-support's reach, overheads, consultation with patient organisation Q-uestion, future outbreak support, and goat vaccination across the Belgian and German borders. The minister answered that Q-support is reaching more patients, overheads were about 11% in its start-up year, Q-uestion is consulted through structural channels, and that member states set their own Q-fever policy with no EU-wide rules, while the ministry lacks data on foreign farms.
My colleague at Economic Affairs does not have data on companies in Belgium or Germany, only on goat farms in the Netherlands.
Mijn collega van Economische Zaken beschikt niet over gegevens van bedrijven in België of Duitsland, uitsluitend over gegevens van geitenbedrijven in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over pijnbestrijding bij het onthoornen van kalveren

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about pain relief when calves are dehorned, including the share of farmers giving no analgesia, whether pain relief should be mandatory, and who may perform the procedure. The State Secretary said pain relief is promoted through sector agreements rather than regulation, that dehorning remains permitted for safety reasons, and that compliance is checked by the NVWA, without committing to new rules or an interim evaluation.
This approach, in which the sector takes its responsibility, is my preference over regulation.
Deze aanpak waarbij de sector haar verantwoordelijkheid neemt heeft mijn voorkeur boven regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Storing op mijnRVO.nl’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about an outage on the RVO.nl portal that prevented dairy farmers from viewing their phosphate reference values before the 1 February 2015 deadline, and whether the deadline would be extended. The State Secretary confirmed the technical outage lasted from 14 to 15 January, described smaller ongoing glitches, and extended the phosphate reference objection period by two weeks to 13 February 2015.
To accommodate the entrepreneurs, I have decided to extend the response period for the phosphate reference value by two weeks, until Friday 13 February 2015.
Om de ondernemers tegemoet te komen heb ik besloten om de reactietermijn voor de fosfaatreferentiewaarde met twee weken te verlengen tot en met vrijdag 13 februari 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de herintroductie van de Atlantische zalm

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the declining return of Atlantic salmon after reintroduction, the alleged role of new fishing permits and by-catch, and measures to improve the outcome. The State Secretary disputed that new permits were issued, cited research attributing losses mainly to conditions at sea, and pointed to the planned Haringvliet sluice opening (Kier) in 2018 and ongoing international coordination.
I cannot agree with that. Contrary to the claims, there are no new permits, and this fishery does have restrictions, which have not recently been changed.

Dat kan ik niet onderschrijven. In tegenstelling tot de beweringen is er geen sprake van nieuwe vergunningen en kent de betreffende visserij wel degelijk beperkingen en zijn deze niet onlangs gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Aukje de Vries, Geurts en De Rouwe over de toename, omvang en gevolgen van muizenschade in Friesland

MPs asked the state secretary about the growth and damage of mouse plagues in Friesland, the ban on ploughing grassland, the risk to dykes, and possible derogations from the Nitrates Directive action programme. The state secretary referred to earlier letters on most questions, said the ploughing ban rests on both environmental and agronomic considerations, and noted that nitrate levels in the affected area are well below the norm.
For the answer to these questions I refer you to my letter of 27 January 2015
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar mijn brief van 27 januari 2015
Antwoord op vragen van lid Jacobi over het gebruik van verboden bestrijdingsmiddelen op sierplanten

MP Jacobi asked the state secretaries about Greenpeace findings that ornamental plants sold in garden centres contained banned pesticide residues, and about how to stop illegal use. The government shares the concern, says residues may stem from illegal use, storage or imports, promises publication of NVWA compliance measurements, and announces extra enforcement, tougher sanctions and retail-chain certification.
I told your House during the committee meeting on crop protection agents on 4 December 2014 that I find the illegal use of crop protection agents completely unacceptable.
Ik heb uw Kamer tijdens het AO gewasbeschermingsmiddelen op 4 december 2014 aangegeven dat ik het illegaal gebruik van gewasbeschermingsmiddelen volstrekt onaanvaardbaar vind.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jan Vos over de Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij

MPs Van Dekken and Jan Vos asked whether the Maatlat Duurzame Veehouderij (sustainability scale for livestock farming) wrongly excludes energy-saving cooling systems like ECO200 that avoid high-GWP HFCs, and whether manufacturers are preparing for the 2020 HFC ban. The government answered that the scale does not exclude such systems but rates them by function, that ECO200 components were included in the energy theme, and that the new EU F-gas regulation provides sufficient incentive for innovation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de bespreking van de zeebaars bij de Landbouw- en Visserijraad

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the sea bass recovery measures discussed at the December 2014 Agriculture and Fisheries Council, including the outcome, minimum landing size, bag limits for sport fishers and proportional contributions. The State Secretary answered that the outcome was disappointing, no EU-wide measures were agreed, the Commission only issued a call for effort reduction, and recreational catch limits and a minimum size increase were discussed with partial national measures already in place.
I find the outcomes disappointing, given the need to take urgent measures.
Ik vind de uitkomsten teleurstellend, gelet op de noodzaak om dringend maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Veldhoven over de Rijksverkoop van natuur in Nationaal Park

MPs Ouwehand and Van Veldhoven asked whether the sale by the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf of the Vafamil nature site in Bloemendaal, which lies within the EHS, Zuid-Kennemerland National Park and Natura 2000, should be stopped or transferred to a nature manager. Minister Blok answered that the site remains protected by zoning and Natura 2000 obligations regardless of buyer, that sales follow state-aid rules, and that zoning changes are a municipal responsibility.
For this reason, in principle it does not matter to whom the site is sold: a large nature manager or another private legal entity.
Om deze reden maakt het dan in beginsel niet uit aan wie het terrein wordt verkocht; een grote natuurbeheerder of een andere particuliere rechtspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de dolfijnenslachtingen door Japan en de Faeröer en het plan van Japan om de walvisjacht weer te hervatten

An MP asked the government about dolphin hunts in Japan and the Faroe Islands, Danish police role, whether Japan would resume Antarctic whaling despite the ICJ ruling, and the EU-Japan trade and framework agreements. The ministers said Denmark would be pressed on dolphin killings, the ICJ ruling strengthens opposition to whaling, and whaling and dolphin killing would be raised in the EU-Japan framework negotiations, though no EU consensus exists on linking trade to whaling.
The cabinet will again address Denmark and indicate that killing dolphins, as happens in the Faroe Islands, is not acceptable.
Het kabinet zal Denemarken opnieuw aanspreken en aangeven dat het doden van dolfijnen, zoals dit gebeurt op de Faeröer eilanden, niet acceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven toekomen over onderhoud van otter- en dassentunnels

An MP asked the government about badger and otter tunnels left flooded or unmaintained, the cost of construction and maintenance, otter deaths in fyke nets and on roads, and responsibility after decentralisation. The state secretary answered that Rijkswaterstaat has tightened maintenance for its tunnels, that most tunnels are managed by provinces and municipalities over which the minister has no responsibility, and that the government is appealing and implementing a court ruling on otter road hazards.
I bear no responsibility for the maintenance of these.
Voor het onderhoud hiervan draag ik geen verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van een bijna verdronken vos

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a hunter who shot an exhausted fox from a moving car, after a near-drowning, acted lawfully, and whether provincial variation in hunting rules is acceptable. The State Secretary confirmed the incident, stated that the Flora- and faunawet's hunting rules did not apply to foxes, that the matter is a criminal question on which she cannot judge, and that provinces apply the same rules but may differ in practice.
Whether the hunter in this case acted in accordance with the legal requirements is a criminal matter on which I cannot make any statements.
Of de jager in dit geval al dan niet in overeenstemming met de wettelijke vereisten heeft gehandeld, is een strafrechtelijke kwestie waarover ik geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het goed samengaan van natuur en veehouderij

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a Wageningen/Dienst Landelijk Gebied study finding no negative link between farming and nature in Noordoost-Twente applies more widely, and what the government has done with it. The State Secretary answered that the study does not address ammonia deposition, that the findings are not representative of rural Netherlands in general, and that no follow-up study is planned.
I do not consider a follow-up study useful, because the research design is not suitable to support the conclusions drawn.
Een vervolgonderzoek acht ik niet zinvol, omdat de onderzoeksopzet niet geschikt is om de getrokken conclusies mee te onderbouwen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “melkvee heeft geen negatief effect op natuur”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a V-focus article claiming dairy cattle have no negative effect on nature, and about a report on land-use interweaving in Noordoost-Twente. The State Secretary largely rejected the article's conclusions, stated that nature remains harmed by nitrogen deposition, and declined further studies and early answers while noting the EU Habitats Directive evaluation timetable.
Government policy aims to further build on this recovery while also giving agriculture (and other economic sectors) room, among other things through the Programmatic Approach to Nitrogen.

Het regeringsbeleid is erop gericht om dit herstel verder uit te bouwen én ook de landbouw (en andere economische sectoren) ruimte te geven, onder andere door middel van de Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het agressieve gedrag van paardenhandelaren jegens NVWA-inspecteurs

An MP asked the state secretary about aggressive behaviour by horse dealers toward NVWA inspectors at the Hedel horse market, the removal of tailed horses, and enforcement of the tail-docking ban and voluntary welfare protocols. The state secretary replied that inspectors did not experience the behaviour as aggressive, that two docked horses were removed while two others were allowed to stay, and that the NVWA enforces the existing law rather than private protocols.
NVWA staff did not experience the behaviour of the horse dealers or market staff as aggressive.
De medewerkers van de NVWA hebben het gedrag van de paardenhandelaren of de medewerkers van de paardenmarkt niet als agressief ervaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de extra kosten door ammoniakbeleid

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked the state secretary about the extra costs of proposed ammonia rules for livestock farms, the effect on consumer prices, the sector's ability to bear the burden, and the comparison with EU Member States under the NEC directive. The state secretary answered that per-farm costs are hard to average since rules apply only to new or substantially expanded barns (at most 3% annual extra cost), cannot estimate consumer price effects, notes Dutch reduction targets are lower than the EU average, and says the position on the Commission proposal will follow later this year.
No, I cannot indicate how much more consumers will on average pay and to what extent comparable extra costs were passed on to consumers in the past.
Nee, ik kan niet aangeven hoeveel meer geld de consument gemiddeld gaat betalen en in hoeverre vergelijkbare extra kosten in het verleden zijn doorberekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht dat Nederland door Rusland als grote illegale vleessmokkelaar wordt genoemd

MP Thieme asked whether reports that Russia had found Dutch pork disguised as other goods in containers were accurate and whether stricter controls via EFSA would be pursued. The government confirmed no Dutch pork certificates have been issued to Russia since January 2014, that the containers were not registered, and that the meat was sold to traders for other EU destinations; it declined to pursue EFSA controls because enforcement lies with member states.
Enforcement of European food safety legislation is the responsibility of member states, not EFSA.
De bevoegdheid tot controle op de naleving van de Europese wetgeving ten aanzien van voedselveiligheid ligt bij de lidstaten en niet bij de EFSA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de effecten van het gebruik van landbouwgif op Natura 2000-gebieden

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked whether the Alterra report on bulb cultivation near Natura 2000 areas, showing high pesticide use may harm protected wetlands, justifies a ban and mandatory appropriate assessments. The state secretary replied that the Ctgb already accounts for non-target risks, that bulb growing is treated as existing use not requiring a permit, that provinces are competent authorities, and that no ban or retroactive assessments are planned, while noting knowledge gaps are being studied.
Are you willing to introduce a ban on growing bulbs and other pesticide-intensive crops in and around Natura 2000 areas?
Bent u bereid om een verbod in te stellen op het in telen van bollen en andere gif-intensieve teelten in en rond Natura 2000-gebieden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen over de vertraging bij de uitvoering van het cohesiebeleid 2014-2020

MP Van Veen asked State Secretary Dijksma whether she was aware of delays in implementing the 2014-2020 cohesion policy, which programmes lag, which Dutch programmes are approved, and about unpaid 2007-2013 bills. The answers attribute delays to late adoption of EU regulations and new programming requirements, state that four Dutch ERDF, two of four INTERREG and the ESF programmes are approved, and explain that payments to beneficiaries occur after the fact via the managing authority.
The Dutch ESF programme was approved as the fourth of all European ESF programmes.
Het Nederlandse ESF-programma is als vierde van alle Europese ESF-programma's goedgekeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de verschillen in faunabeleid tussen provincies

An MP asked the State Secretary about differences in provincial fauna policy, notably Utrecht allowing cage traps for crows and rooks while North and South Holland do not. The government answered that provinces apply the same Flora- and Faunawet with room for regional tailoring, that provinces bear primary responsibility with only interbestuurlijk toezicht available, and that no separate investigation is planned.
I see no reason to launch an investigation into this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hierover een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over een nieuw vogelpesttype in Duitsland

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the H5N8 bird flu outbreak in Germany, its effects on Dutch poultry, steps taken since last year, research on free-range risk, industry involvement, and oversight after the abolition of the product boards. The answers describe culling and a protection zone, a mandatory second cleaning of returning trucks, a CVI risk study to be sent to parliament early next year, and state takeover of public tasks while cleaning remains an industry responsibility.
I will inform your House early next year about the results.
Ik zal uw Kamer begin volgend jaar informeren over de resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over de uitbraak van de hoog pathogene variant van vogelgriep in Hekendorp

Two PvdA MPs asked about measures to prevent human infection and spread of highly pathogenic bird flu from the Hekendorp outbreak, signs of human infection, causes, a possible link to Germany, and measures against future zoonotic outbreaks. The government answered by referring to earlier letters on measures and the investigation, stating there are no signs of human infection, and referring to earlier answers on pandemic risk.
For the answer to this question I refer to the answers to questions about the report 'Pandemic from Brabant is possible'.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar de antwoorden op vragen over het bericht «Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de antiboeren-natuurwetgeving in Nederland

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether Dutch nature-protection obligations under EU directives burden farmers more than in Germany and Belgium, and whether the Netherlands protects far more species than required. The State Secretary answers that Dutch implementation is not stricter than elsewhere in the EU, that nitrogen pressures explain why problems are felt more strongly, and that there are no national species lists.
Research on the implementation of nature legislation (Natura 2000) in the Netherlands compared with other EU countries shows that the Netherlands is not stricter than other countries.
Uit onderzoek naar de implementatie van natuurregelgeving (Natura 2000) in Nederland in vergelijking met andere landen in de EU blijkt dat Nederland hierbij niet strenger is dan andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over de relatie tussen ammoniakuitstoot en emissiearme bemesting

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked whether measurement data cast doubt on the link between low-emission manure application and ammonia emissions, and whether the NEMA emission model was sound. The State Secretary answered that the scientific basis of ammonia policy was reviewed internationally without doubts, that the CDM was asked for a quick scan of the significant trend difference, and that Dutch ammonia measures are a national choice within EU ceilings.
Thereupon I asked the Expert Committee on the Fertilisers Act (CDM) to prepare a quick scan to explain the difference between the trends.
Daarop heb ik de Commissie Deskundigen Meststoffenwet (CDM) gevraagd een quick scan op te stellen om het verschil tussen de trends te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over de aangepaste begrenzing van Natura 2000-gebieden na uitspraken van de Raad van State

MPs Heerema and Dijkgraaf asked why certain land was left out of two Natura 2000 area boundaries and whether the Council of State rulings will lead to more boundary changes. The State Secretary answered that the land was excluded for lack of present Natura 2000 values or proven necessity, that no other annulments on this ground are known, and that a limited number of further boundary changes may follow rulings expected in 2015.
Yes, this is possible due to a limited number of Council of State rulings expected during 2015.
Ja, dit is mogelijk door een beperkt aantal uitspraken van de Raad van State, die in de loop van 2015 te verwachten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht “Springendal bij Vasse definitief Natura 2000-gebied, boeren teleurgesteld”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the economic impact of designating Springendal and Dal van de Mosbeek as a Natura 2000 area, whether ecology can outweigh economy in boundary decisions, and how economic interests can be considered. The State Secretary answered that economic impacts will be assessed in the management plan due in 2015, that boundaries may be set only on ecological grounds under EU case law, and that the Council of State's single boundary annulment did not produce incomplete economic calculations.
A precise determination of the consequences of a designation decision can only take place when the management plan is established.
Een nauwkeurige vaststelling van de gevolgen van een aanwijzingsbesluit kan pas bij vaststelling van het beheerplan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Europese subsidies voor promotie van bloemen

MP Ouwehand asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether EU co-financing for the 'Lievelingsbloem' flower promotion campaign should be opposed, questioned pesticide use and social costs in flower cultivation, and asked for stricter conditions. The State Secretary confirmed roughly EUR 4.04 million in EU co-financing over three years, said promotion should be left to the sector but that the Council accepted all farm products, and stated that pesticide use is regulated and enforced by the NVWA without quantifying social costs.
From the standpoint of a level playing field, as long as Dutch entrepreneurs comply with the Community rules, I will not deny them the possibility of using this scheme.
Vanuit het oogpunt van gelijk speelveld ga ik Nederlandse ondernemers, zolang zij zich aan de communautaire regels houden, niet de mogelijkheid ontzeggen om van deze regeling gebruik te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanwezigheid van furazolidon in de voedselketen en het lopende strafrechtelijk onderzoek

An MP asked whether potentially carcinogenic furazolidon in meat poses consumer health risks and whether the precautionary principle should apply to informing consumers while a criminal investigation is ongoing. The minister answered that the NVWA's risk assessment found negligible risk, that consumers are informed when a real health risk exists, and that affected animals were destroyed.
If there is a danger to public health from possibly contaminated foodstuffs, the consumer is informed of this so that they can take their own measures.
In het geval er een gevaar voor de volksgezondheid is door mogelijk besmette of verontreinigde voedingsmiddelen wordt de consument daarover geïnformeerd, zodat deze zelf maatregelen kan nemen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over “de doorgaande ellende in de Oostvaardersplassen”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reported mass starvation of large grazers in the Oostvaardersplassen and whether the experimental management plan has failed. The State Secretary denied that thousands of animals starved, described early-reactive management and its roughly 250 thousand euro annual cost, and said she will await an evaluation before judging the grazer management.
I am still awaiting an evaluation by the Oostvaardersplassen Management Advisory Committee of the large grazer management over the past four winter seasons.
Ik ben nog in afwachting van een evaluatie door de Beheeradviescommissie Oostvaardersplassen van het grotegrazersbeheer gedurende de afgelopen vier winterseizoenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘‘extra geld voor controleurs natuurgebieden’’

An MP asked the ministers about a reported 100,000 euro in extra funding for training of nature-area enforcement officers (groene boa's), including its cost coverage, cost control, the content of training and whether bureaucracy will be reduced. The government answered that the funds are a structural contribution to employer costs, will be covered within the Economic Affairs budget, that an evaluation of training is under way due by year-end, and that cooperation arrangements with employers were agreed, though several questions were answered with references to future evaluation.
Based on this research, a decision will follow on whether and, if so, which adjustments should be made within the overall training system in domain II.
Op basis van dit onderzoek zal een beslissing volgen of en zo ja welke aanpassingen er binnen de gehele systematiek van opleiden binnen domein II dienen plaats te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en De Liefde over de opkomst van de suzuki-fruitvlieg

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the spread of the suzuki fruit fly, its damage to Dutch growers, control options such as parasitic nematodes, and the authorisation of the pesticide Tracer. The State Secretary answered that the sector is responsible for pest control, that the damage is estimated at 2 to 20 percent of unsaleable fruit without exact measurement, that small-scale trials of nematodes are underway, and that Tracer was authorised for some crops but refused for cherries.
The sector is itself responsible for combating diseases and pests in crops and also accepts this responsibility.
De sector is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de bestrijding van ziekten en plagen in gewassen en neemt deze verantwoordelijkheid ook op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over trofeereizen waarbij in het buitenland wordt gejaagd op bedreigde diersoorten

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about Dutch-booked trophy hunts of protected species abroad, including whether hunting licences could be revoked and whether such trips or trophy imports should be banned. The government answered that the trips are legal under CITES and EU rules, that it sees no legal basis to revoke licences for foreign kills, and that it will pursue tighter international rules and anti-wildlife-crime projects rather than a ban.
No, these are legal activities that are bound by rules within the EU and internationally.
Nee, het betreft legale activiteiten die binnen de EU en internationaal aan regels gebonden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over verspreiding van besmettelijke dierziekten door de jacht

An MP asked the State Secretary whether hunting of infected wild boar spread African swine fever and whether hunting and intensive livestock farming endanger public health, and whether protocols on culling and housing orders should be revised. The State Secretary declined to confirm the Commission remark, found no scientific study linking hunting to spread, and refused to revise culling or housing protocols as current measures suffice.
I see no reason, based on the cited dissertation, to revise the protocols on culling and housing orders during animal disease outbreaks.
Ik zie geen reden om op grond van het aangehaalde proefschrift de protocollen rond ruimingen en ophokplicht bij uitbraken van dierziekten te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over afschot van wilde zwijnen in de draag- en zoogtijd

An MP asks the state secretary whether boar piglets are shot in the nursing period under provincial permits, and questions the ethics, evidence and oversight of such culling and of night hunting. The state secretary replies that provinces (gedeputeerde staten) are responsible for permits and culling policy, that a closed season runs 15 March to 1 July, and declines a national evaluation or to end the practice.
Handling of such exemption applications is the responsibility of the provincial executive (gedeputeerde staten).
Afdoening van dergelijke ontheffingsaanvragen is de verantwoordelijkheid van gedeputeerde staten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de achteruitgang van vogelsoorten en de werkzame stof imidacloprid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about declining bird populations linked to imidacloprid, suspension of its authorisation, liability of the producer, water-utility costs, CTGB staffing and risk assessment procedures. The government answered that EFSA reassessments are pending, the producer has a duty to report new information, CTGB has toxicologists and conducts structural consultation, and cumulative effects cannot yet be assessed; several questions were referred to a separate Kamerbrief.
The CTGB has the general power to amend or withdraw the authorisation of a crop protection product if it no longer meets the authorisation requirements.
Het Ctgb heeft in algemene zin de bevoegdheid om de toelating van een gewasbeschermingsmiddel te wijzigen of in te trekken als het middel niet meer voldoet aan de toelatingseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de achteruitgang van vogelsoorten en de werkzame stof imidacloprid

An MP asked the state secretaries whether research showing that neonicotinoids such as imidacloprid also harm birds means the temporary EU moratorium is too limited, and whether the government will act and raise the study in Brussels. The state secretary refers to a separate letter to parliament of 27 October 2014 for all answers, without giving substantive content here.
For the answers to questions 1 through 4 I refer you to the letter to parliament.
Voor de antwoorden op de vragen 1 tot en met 4 verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Schouw over de achteruitgang van vogelsoorten en de werkzame stof imidacloprid

MPs Van Veldhoven and Schouw asked whether a Nature study linking neonicotinoid pesticides such as imidacloprid to declining farmland bird populations requires action under EU pesticide law and the Birds Directive, whether EFSA should assess it, and whether precautionary measures should be taken quickly. The Secretary of State referred the answers to a separate letter on the Nature publication, indicating no substantive answer is given in this document.
For the answers to questions 1 to 3 I refer you to the letter to the House titled 'Nature publication imidacloprid and decline of bird populations' of 27 October 2014.
Voor de antwoorden op de vragen 1 tot en met 3 verwijs ik u naar de Kamerbrief «Nature publicatie imidacloprid en afname van vogelpopulaties» van 27 oktober 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme met betrekking tot een reddingsactie van wilde zwijnen

An MP asked the state secretary whether a hunting warden shot wild boar that had just been rescued from water, and how that squares with the duty of care under the Flora and Fauna Act. The government said three animals were shot, some were already dead, no proces-verbaal was drawn up, the warden's police authorisation was withdrawn, and it deferred the zero-population policy to the provinces.
In the given circumstances the hunter should first have consulted the police to see whether alternatives to shooting existed.
In de gegeven omstandigheden had de jager eerst met de politie moeten overleggen of er alternatieven waren behoudens afschot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over muizenschade bij boeren

MPs Lodders and Heerema asked whether farmers suffering vole damage not compensated by the Faunafonds can be helped, including a derogation from the grassland-ploughing ban and an adjusted nitrates calamity scheme. The state secretary refused a derogation, said grassland may be ploughed from 1 February 2015, and stated the planned calamity scheme does not cover vole damage and that no further policy is foreseen.
I have informed the province of Friesland that I do not intend to grant an exemption from the ban on ploughing grassland.
Ik heb de provincie Friesland er van op de hoogte gebracht dat ik niet voornemens ben een ontheffing op het verbod op het scheuren van grasland te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de maatschappelijke onrust over het vangen van wilde ezels op Bonaire

An MP asked about public unrest over the capture of wild donkeys on Bonaire, the current status of a sustainable solution, and whether the minister will play a role in protecting the donkeys' welfare. The State Secretary answered that mares and foals are sheltered, stallions are castrated and released, unsalvageable animals are euthanised, that the policy is the Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire's and is supported as addressing nature damage and traffic danger, and that the Openbaar Lichaam is primarily responsible for animal welfare.
The Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire is primarily responsible for animal welfare.
Het Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire is eerstverantwoordelijke voor het welzijn van dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over cross compliance en natuurbeschermingswetvergunning

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about farmers in Limburg facing cuts to income support under cross compliance for lacking a Natura 2000 permit, whether such permits are required for all agricultural activities, whether the rule changes from 2015, whether the Programmatic Approach to Nitrogen (PAS) will solve the problem and when it will be sent to parliament, and how cuts can be avoided. The State Secretary answered that permit possession remains a cross compliance condition, listed the specific rule changes for 2015, explained that the PAS offers a framework for permitting, and said farmers can avoid cuts by applying for a permit and that no cut applies where the authority fails to decide within statutory deadlines.
A farmer can avoid a cut by submitting a complete application with all required data for a nature protection permit.
Een landbouwer kan een korting voorkomen door alsnog een volledige aanvraag met alle benodigde gegevens voor een natuurbeschermingsvergunning te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de toelating van eieren van Avangardco op de Europese interne markt

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the EU approval of Avangardco egg products, the welfare conditions of its laying hens, and whether the Netherlands will act in the Council and on a sector masterplan. The State Secretary says EU approval was procedurally sound, opposed duty-free Ukrainian egg imports at the committee vote, asked the Commission to press Ukraine on welfare reform, and declines to draw up a sector masterplan.
I have no information about the precise production conditions at Avangardco.
Over de precieze productieomstandigheden van Avangardco heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over verspilde miljoenen vissubsidies in de Peel

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about millions in fish-farming subsidies in the Peel, including a tilapia project by entrepreneur Van Rijsingen, weak subsidy controls, a possible bankruptcy-causing unfair competition, and whether fraud prosecution is warranted. The State Secretary answers that the matter is set out in a separate letter to parliament, reports that the RVO refers suspected fraud to the Public Prosecution Service, cites a court ruling on the bankruptcies, and refers many questions to that separate letter.
Once I have indications that criminal offences have occurred, I will certainly not hesitate to bring the matter to the attention of the Public Prosecution Service.
Op het moment dat ik aanwijzingen heb dat er sprake is van strafbare feiten, zal ik vanzelfsprekend niet aarzelen om de zaak onder de aandacht te brengen van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Leenders over misbruik van EU subsidie voor de kweek van meervallen

MPs Dikkers and Leenders asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about alleged misuse of EU subsidies for catfish farming, including whether the EU is reclaiming funds and whether subsidies will be recovered and controls strengthened. The State Secretary largely referred to separate letters to parliament, said she did not agree the subsidy was wrong as it was a court matter, and pointed to earlier correction overviews.
I refer you for the answer to the parliamentary letter on subsidy development in aquaculture that was sent to your House at the same time.
Ik verwijs u voor de beantwoording naar de Kamerbrief inzake subsidie ontwikkeling aquacultuur die gelijktijdig aan uw Kamer is verzonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Graus, De Graaf en Wilders over het Islamitisch Offerfeest op Werelddierendag

Three PVV MPs asked whether the Islamic Feast of Sacrifice falling on World Animal Day, and the ritual slaughter it involves, was acceptable and whether the practice should end. The minister answered that the government respects religious traditions within the rule of law, that unstunned ritual slaughter is governed by law and enforced by the NVWA, and that it sees no reason to end the practice.
The manner in which unstunned ritual slaughter may take place is laid down in Dutch laws and regulations.
De wijze waarop onbedwelmde rituele slacht mag plaatsvinden is vastgelegd in de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de dreiging van ziekmakende en levensbedreigende bacteriën op vlees

An MP asked the minister about Wakker Dier findings of bacteria such as ESBL-producing strains, E. coli, Listeria and Campylobacter on barbecue meat, and whether bacterial counts above ten million cfu per gram show spoiled meat and call for a legal limit. The minister confirmed the findings, said that bacterial counts are a hygiene signal rather than a spoilage measure, and declined to introduce a legal cfu limit for fresh meat, pointing to producer and supermarket responsibility.
This is also the reason why there is no legal norm for the number of bacteria per gram of meat.
Dit is ook de reden dat er geen wettelijke norm is voor het aantal bacteriën per gram vlees.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het maatschappelijk verzet tegen dierproeven op labradors

An MP asked the state secretary about public opposition to planned dog experiments on 39 labradors at Maastricht University, the 323 dogs used 2004–2012, rising dog-experiment numbers, and ethical review and transparency. The answers say the experiments were paused, an external commission will review them, and a new central licensing body (CCD) with published summaries will increase transparency and ethical scrutiny.
The Government Information (Public Access) Act ensures that every citizen can gain insight into government actions.
De Wet openbaarheid van bestuur zorgt ervoor dat iedere burger inzage kan krijgen in het overheidshandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over belemmeringen voor het gebruik van alternatieven voor metam-natrium

An MP asked the state secretary about obstacles to alternatives to metam-sodium, the soil disinfectant, and about hectares treated, nematode control, grassland ploughing rules and funding. The state secretary reported consultations with the sector, pointed to Common Agricultural Policy catch-crop rules, a 150,000 euro funding commitment for 2014, and a promise to seek advice on extending the grassland ploughing deadline by 1 December, while referring back to earlier answers on several questions.
I am willing to examine whether there are possibilities within manure policy to extend the deadline for ploughing grassland.
Ik ben bereid na te gaan of er in het kader van het mestbeleid mogelijkheden zijn de termijn voor het scheuren van grasland te verlengen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de interpretatie van de Habitatrichtlijn

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the Sweetman and Briels rulings of the EU Court of Justice imply a distinction between qualifying and non-qualifying habitat types and species when applying Article 6(3) of the Habitats Directive, and how Dutch rules reflect this. The State Secretary answered that the rulings do not support such a distinction, since they address only the permanent loss of qualifying or priority habitats and do not address non-qualifying ones.
No conclusion can be drawn from the rulings that, in applying Article 6(3) of the Habitats Directive, a distinction is made between qualifying habitat types and species and non-qualifying ones.

Uit de arresten kan niet de conclusie worden getrokken dat bij de toepassing van artikel 6, derde lid, habitatrichtlijn onderscheid wordt gemaakt tussen kwalificerende habitattypen en soorten en niet-kwalificerende habitattypen en soorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de noodsituatie van kippenboeren

CDA MP Geurts asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the financial crisis facing Dutch egg farmers, the causes of oversupply, imports of eggs from outside the EU, the enforcement of the EU battery cage ban, and whether animal welfare standards can be applied to imports under WTO and trade-agreement rules. The State Secretary answered that the market must correct itself, gave import figures, and said animal welfare cannot currently be required of third-country imports under WTO rules, with trade deals not expected to lower EU standards.
The cabinet considers further improving animal welfare important and actively contributes to adjustments of EU animal welfare policy and regulation.
Het kabinet vindt het verder verbeteren van dierenwelzijn belangrijk en denkt actief mee bij aanpassingen van het Europese dierenwelzijnsbeleid en Europese dierenwelzijnsregelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het opvolgen van een rechterlijke uitspraak inzake een klokkenluider

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the government would take a position on, and speed up the resolution of, a whistleblower's compensation case following a 2005 court ruling that found his reputation had been harmed. The State Secretary replied that the claim is still under negotiation and a related objection procedure, that the government sent the requested documents in 2013 and offers full inspection of the original file, and that talks can resume quickly.
With a decision on the objection of 13 October 2008, the aforementioned ruling of the Breda District Court of 2 May 2007 has already been complied with.
Met een beslissing op bezwaarschrift van 13 oktober 2008 is reeds gevolg gegeven aan de genoemde uitspraak van de Rechtbank Breda van 2 mei 2007.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht ‘Q-koorts: Staat aansprakelijk’

An MP asked the health minister about reports that the state is liable for the Q-fever epidemic, including delayed source tracing, withheld information, the role of manure, the Stichting Q-support evaluation, its budget, and individual compensation. The minister acknowledges that government action could have been better, points to measures taken and the first report on Q-support, and declines individual financial compensation in favour of support through the foundation.
The cabinet has acknowledged that the government's action could have been better.
Het kabinet heeft erkend dat het overheidsoptreden beter had gekund.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de betrouwbaarheid van aantalsschattingen van ganzen en andere watervogelsoorten

An MP asked the state secretary whether Alterra research showing that hunting-association (WBE) counts of geese and waterbirds are systematically higher than SOVON counts undermines the reliability of hunting plans, and whether the bias could lead to excessive culling. The secretary acknowledged the findings, attributed the differences to counting methods and timing, said provinces decide which figures to use, and defended the role of WBEs in the proposed Natuurwet.
Provincial executives, which are responsible for issuing culling exemptions, work on the basis of the best information available at the time.
Gedeputeerde staten, die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de afgifte van ontheffingen voor afschot, gaan uit van de op dat moment best beschikbare informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over provinciale besluitvorming met betrekking tot stikstofdepositie
