An MP asks the State Secretary about Drenthe withdrawing its Beleidskader Stikstof 2.0, the number of firms stuck by nitrogen policy, how other provinces handle permits while the PAS is unavailable, and the transitional rule in the PAS amendment. The State Secretary confirms the withdrawal on Raad van State rulings, says the exact number of stuck firms is unknown, notes the Natuurbeschermingswet 1998 governs permits, and promises to inform the Chamber soon about PAS progress.
The exact number of firms per province in a deadlock due to the nitrogen policy is not known to me.
Het exacte aantal bedrijven per provincie, dat in een impasse verkeert ten gevolge van het gevoerde ammoniakbeleid, is mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over salmonella en gezondheidsrisico’s bij de firma Foppen naar aanleiding van WOB stukken NVWA van Omroep Gelderland

An SP MP asked the government about NVWA enforcement at salmonella- and listeria-linked fish firm Foppen, including why warnings rather than fines or recalls were used, the traceability failures in the 2012 outbreak, and prosecution. The State Secretary and Minister replied that NVWA intervention follows a predetermined risk-based scale, that fines were imposed for recall and traceability failures, and that the Public Prosecution Service found insufficient grounds for criminal prosecution.
The inspection report can only be made public after an extensive procedure in which the company Foppen is asked for its views.
Het inspectierapport is alleen openbaar te maken na een uitvoerige procedure, waarbij het bedrijf Foppen om een zienswijze wordt gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de financiële verplichtingen voor het grensoverschrijdend Park De Zoom –Kalmthoutse heide

An MP asked whether the national government's withdrawal of structural funding for the cross-border De Zoom-Kalmthoutse Heide park, despite the 2011 extension of a ministerial decision, breaches informal financial commitments and harms relations with Flanders. The minister replied that the decision only provides a formal basis for a commission and no funding, that structural national funding ended as part of budget cuts and decentralisation, that the province of Noord-Brabant is responsible, and that he is willing to consult Flanders if needed.
The decision provides no basis for financial support to the commission itself.
De beschikking geeft geen grondslag voor financiële steun aan de commissie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht dat minimaal 33% en mogelijk zelfs 60% van de inwoners van Herpen besmet is met Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked whether the Q-fever investigation in Herpen is too slow, whether screening should be expanded, and about a dissertation on antibody testing. The Minister replies that the research runs within subsidy deadlines, first results show no large group of missed patients, and a single antibody check one year after acute infection is recommended for patients without risk factors.
At the next revision of the LCI Q-fever guideline, this recommendation will be included.
Bij de volgende revisie van de LCI-richtlijn Q-koorts zal deze aanbeveling opgenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Ziengs en Van Veen over het artikel 'Miljoenenstrop door stoffen'

MPs Dijkstra, Ziengs and Van Veen asked about the European Commission's plan to add five substances to the RoHS II restriction list, whether the process followed REACH procedures, and what the costs and benefits would be. The Secretary of State answered that the Commission acted within the RoHS framework after consulting member states and stakeholders, that the costs are real but the benefits of phasing out hazardous substances justify them, and that the government sees no reason to intervene, while it will monitor exemption applications.
I therefore see no reason to hold the Commission to account on this.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding de Commissie hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Agnes Mulder en Wolbert over de dreigende sluiting van attractiepark De Sprookjeshof in Zuidlaren

MPs Ziengs, Agnes Mulder and Wolbert asked about the threatened closure of the De Sprookjeshof amusement park, the inconsistent certification of identical attractions by inspection bodies, and whether the government is responsible for consistent rules. The minister answered that certification rules were applied correctly, that individual inspection was required for unique slides, that operators bear primary responsibility for compliance, and that the answers could not be sent by the requested date.
On 12 September the NVWA held consultations with the CdK Drenthe, where it was agreed that the inspection body and the owner of De Sprookjeshof will again consult on measures that ensure safety.

Op 12 september heeft de NVWA met de CdK Drenthe overleg gevoerd waarbij is afgesproken dat de keuringsinstelling en de eigenaar van De Sprookjeshof opnieuw in overleg gaan over de maatregelen die de veiligheid waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over de oorzaken van het teleurstellend lage aantal deelnemende boeren en tuinders aan de pilot eerlijke handelspraktijken

An MP asks why only one LTO cooperative has joined the fair trading practices pilot in agrofood, and what is being done about low farmer participation and anonymous complaint procedures. The Secretary of State says the pilot is self-regulatory, the steering group is responsible, outreach is ongoing, and a progress report will follow at end 2014 with evaluation at end 2015.
At the end of 2014 the Minister of Economic Affairs will send an interim report to your House.
Eind 2014 zal de Minister van Economische Zaken een tussenrapportage naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Dik-Faber over de aanpak van drugsafval

MPs Segers and Dik-Faber asked whether a fund could be created, financed from Plukze proceeds, to compensate landowners for clearing dumped drug waste, and what clean-up costs were in 2012 and 2013. The minister answered that no legal barriers exist but the cabinet is reluctant to create budget funds, that costs should fall on the perpetrator, and estimated Noord-Brabant clean-up costs at about 1.5 million euro in 2012 and 3 million euro in 2013.
The costs that landowners face for clearing dumped drug waste should primarily be borne by the perpetrator.
De kosten waarmee grondeigenaren worden geconfronteerd om gedumpt drugsafval op te ruimen dienen primair ten laste te komen van de dader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het bericht dat er nog steeds wrede dierproeven voor Botox worden gedaan

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether animal toxicity tests (LD50/LC50) for Botox products continue in the EU and the Netherlands despite bans on cosmetic animal testing and on LD50 tests, and why an animal-free alternative was not used. The State Secretary answers that no botulinum toxin LD50 tests are done in the Netherlands, that no EU ban applies to these medicinal products, that exemptions remain possible when no alternative exists, that an alternative exists only for one producer's product, and that a review of LD50/LC50 testing will be sent to parliament.
I have no information available on the increase in the use of botulinum toxin nor on the (increase in the) number of animal tests for botulinum toxin products.
Ik heb geen informatie beschikbaar over de toename van het gebruik van botulinetoxine noch over (de toename van) het aantal dierproeven voor botulinetoxine-producten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over rotte-eierenlucht bij Deurne

MPs Smaling and Van Gerven asked about H2S (rotten-egg) gas near Deurne, the expert panel's findings on health risks, pyrite and fertiliser causes, and whether fertiliser levels should be reviewed. The government answered that exposure effects are temporary, that more regional and local pyrite knowledge is needed, and that the nitrate action programme and a manure-fermentation evaluation are under way, with results promised for early 2015.
A policy evaluation on manure fermentation is under way, and the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and I will send you the results in the first quarter of 2015.
Ten aanzien van mestvergisting is een beleidsevaluatie gaande, waarvan de Staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en ik u in het eerste kwartaal van 2015 de resultaten zullen doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Dijkgraaf over het bericht ‘Alleen ruimen bij risico voor volksgezondheid’

MPs Lodders (VVD) and Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the NVWA failed to inform veterinarians directly about the furazolidon contamination incident and how farmers and industry bodies were informed, and whether the substance is freely available. The State Secretary replied that SMS alerts, the NVWA website, a beschikking to affected farmers and three information meetings with industry bodies were used, and that furazolidon is not available everywhere.
These remarks are taken into account by the NVWA in the evaluation of this furazolidon incident.
Deze opmerkingen worden door de NVWA meegenomen bij de evaluatie van dit incident met furazolidon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over visserij-uitspraken van Eurocommissaris Damanaki

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the State Secretary shares criticism of EU Commissioner Damanaki's call for consumers to avoid fish caught with bottom-disturbing methods, and whether she will publicly oppose the remarks to defend Dutch fisheries. The State Secretary answered that the Commissioner's views are her own responsibility, that bottom trawling does affect ecosystems, that she supports pulse fishing, and that the Commissioner did not target Dutch fishing specifically.
What the Commissioner writes in her weblog is primarily her own view and her own responsibility.
Wat de Eurocommissaris in haar weblog schrijft, vind ik primair aan haar en is haar verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht ‘NVWA veegt fouten onder het tapijt’

The MP Thieme asks the state secretary how she assesses an Ombudsman report on non-transparency about pigs contaminated with a hormone in feed, whether the Ombudsman's recommendations were followed, whether further test results will be disclosed, and the status of the NVWA investigation into illegal hormones. The state secretary replies that the Ombudsman is independent, that the recommendation was followed with a conversation with the farmer whose outcome is confidential, that all available information was already shared, and that the investigation is ongoing with no new results to report yet.
All available information has been shared; I therefore refer to the answers to parliamentary questions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8 of 7 March 2013.
Alle beschikbare informatie is gedeeld, ik verwijs hiervoor dan ook naar de beantwoording op Kamervragen 1 2, 3, 4, 5 en 8 van 7 maart 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Gerven over het bericht dat dieren gedood worden als gevolg van de vondst van het verboden antibioticum furazolidon op diverse kalverhouderijen

Two MPs (SP) asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the discovery of the banned antibiotic furazolidon on calf farms, the health risk, the investigation capacity, testing and culling of animals, and liability. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA and Public Prosecution Service are investigating, that no consumer health risk is expected, that the EU rules require culling of positive animals, and that she will discuss private liability with industry.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht dat dieren gedood worden als gevolg van de vondst van het verboden antibioticum furazolidon op diverse kalverhouderijen

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about mass culling of calves after the banned antibiotic furazolidon was found in feed, including whether individual testing should be required, who bears testing costs, how the contamination occurred, and how it relates to past feed-sector scandals and a positive list of feed ingredients. The State Secretary answers that individual testing is an option for farmers under EU Directive 96/23/EC, that costs fall on the farmer, that the criminal investigation prevents comment, and that a positive list is unnecessary given existing EU registration.
No statements can be made about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over de aanwijzing Binnenveld in Veenendaal als Natura 2000-gebied

MPs Heerema and Lodders asked the State Secretary about the designation of Binnenveld in Veenendaal as a Natura 2000 area, including the municipality's appeal, the feasibility of the management plan and its economic consequences for farmers. The State Secretary answered that the designation stands, the management plan is delegated to the provinces and water board and expected in September, and that the economic consequences will be assessed within that plan.
The designation decision only concerns the boundary of the area and the setting of the conservation objectives.
Het aanwijzingsbesluit betreft alleen de begrenzing van het gebied en de vaststelling van de instandhoudingsdoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Aanwijzingsbesluit Natura 2000-gebied Buurserzand & Haaksbergerveen houdt stand’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the designation of the Buurserzand & Haaksbergerveen Natura 2000 area, based purely on ecological grounds, upholds a balance between economy and ecology, and how compensation for affected farmers would be funded. The State Secretary answered that designation may rest on ecological grounds, that economic interests are considered when setting management measures, and that no compensation arises at this stage since measures come in the management plan run by the province of Overijssel, whose provincial reserve covers the development task.
According to settled European and national case law, the selection and delimitation of Habitats Directive areas may be based solely on ecological considerations.
Volgens vaste Europese en nationale jurisprudentie kan de keuze en de begrenzing van Habitatrichtlijngebieden louter geschieden op grond van ecologische overwegingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over export van levende wolhandkrabben naar voedselautomaten in China

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about export of live Chinese mitten crabs to Chinese vending machines, including their packaging, welfare, dioxin contamination and whether export should be halted. The government answered that export to Hong Kong is the only destination recorded, that no welfare rules specific to invertebrates exist, that it sees no reason to stop exports because EU free movement of goods forbids a ban, and that it will talk with the sector about careful transport.
I see no reason to stop the export.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de export te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Stikstofdepositie op natuur veel lager dan verondersteld’

An MP asks the State Secretary whether RIVM measurements of nitrogen deposition on nature are much lower than modelled, whether the 70 percent model uncertainty undermines ammonia policy, and whether policy should rely on measurements instead. The government answers that models are needed for nationwide and forward-looking coverage, that measurements validate the models, that ammonia concentrations fell about 20 percent since the 1990s but no longer decline, and that a CDM-led investigation into the trend discrepancy has been commissioned with results promised soon.

Following RIVM signals that the trend in calculated ammonia emissions is not supported by the measurements, we recently commissioned the Expert Committee on Manure Policy (CDM) to conduct further research with RIVM.

Naar aanleiding van signalen van het RIVM dat de trend in de berekende ammoniakemissies niet ondersteund wordt door de metingen, hebben wij onlangs de Commissie Deskundigen Mestbeleid (CDM) de opdracht gegeven samen met het RIVM nader onderzoek te doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de vergoeding voor rietlandbeheer

MPs Geurts, Van Hijum and Omtzigt asked why subsidies paid by provinces to nature managers are exempt from VAT while payments from nature managers to reed cutters are subject to VAT, and asked about the basis for a possible exemption. The State Secretary explained the VAT treatment under EU case law, that the subsidy scheme is taxable only where the payment is consumed, and that stakeholders and government are exploring a restructured single-entity arrangement.

Representatives of private reed managers, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, the province of Overijssel and the Ministry of Economic Affairs are examining whether the relationship between reed managers and land owners can be changed and formalised so that there is a single entity.

Vertegenwoordigers van de particuliere rietlandbeheerders, Staatsbosbeheer, Natuurmonumenten, de provincie Overijssel en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken onderzoeken of de relatie tussen rietlandbeheerders en terreineigenaren zodanig gewijzigd en geformaliseerd kan worden, dat sprake is van één entiteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat de NVWA steeds meer strafrechtelijke onderzoeken naar voedselfraude verricht en afrondt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the rising number of criminal food fraud investigations by the NVWA and related questions on capacity, outcomes, and reporting. The government answered that the increase stems from the NVWA merger, extra capacity and wider attention after the horsemeat scandal, reported convictions and sentences, and committed to continued work on public reporting channels.
The Functional Prosecution Service was able to trace the 56 cases to 146 suspects registered with it, of whom 52 were convicted at first instance.

Het Functioneel Parket heeft de 56 zaken kunnen herleiden naar 146 bij het Functioneel Parket geregistreerde verdachten, waarvan er in eerste aanleg ten aanzien van 52 verdachten een veroordeling is uitgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over afvalopslag in zoutholtes

An MP from D66 asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about plans to stabilise salt caverns in Twente by filling them with waste-based material, covering applicable law, consultation with authorities and residents, leakage risks, liability, alternatives and whether sinkholes are guaranteed to be prevented. The government answered that several laws apply, that a risk assessment and risk management plan are still pending and will be reviewed by supervisory bodies before a decision, and that the mining company is liable for damage.
State Supervision of Mines, TNO and the Technical Committee on Soil Movement assess the storage plan before I make a decision.
Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen, TNO en de Technische Commissie Bodembeweging beoordelen het opslagplan alvorens ik een beluit neem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat het eten van voedselbanken vaak onvoldoende is

An MP asked the State Secretaries about a report that food bank recipients often lack enough healthy food, the food insecurity comparison with the UK, and how to get surplus food from companies to food banks. The government answered that municipalities hold primary responsibility for poverty policy, that cooperation with the food alliance is progressing, and that a tax-clarification meeting is planned.

As indicated in the answers to the questions of MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten of 25 March 2014, it is important that people who rely on food banks are helped and that the underlying problems are addressed.

Zoals in de antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten (ChristenUnie) van 25 maart 2014 (TK Aanhangsel van de Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2013–2014, nr. 1852 ) is aangegeven, is het van belang dat mensen die een beroep doen op de voedselbank geholpen worden en dat de achterliggende problematiek wordt aangepakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht dat minimaal 33% en mogelijk zelfs 60% van de inwoners van Herpen besmet is met Q-koorts

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the ministers about reports that 33% to 60% of Herpen residents had Q-fever, the validity of a new test, chronic Q-fever diagnoses, expanding screening, underreporting and livestock farming limits. The minister answered that the GGD study results are due spring 2015 and that screening expansion will await them, while Q-support has started and an evaluation is planned for around September 2014.
I am awaiting the final result of this study and the related conclusions and recommendations before I seek advice on the necessity and usefulness of a more extensive study.
Ik wacht het uiteindelijke resultaat van dit onderzoek en de daarbij behorende conclusies en aanbevelingen af, voordat ik mij laat adviseren over nut en noodzaak van een uitgebreider onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht dat het mestbeleid een koude douche voor boeren is

An MP from the CDA asked the government about a press report that manure policy is a cold shower for farmers, questioning whether the cabinet ignores business input, why LTO's proposals on the fifth Nitrates Action Programme were not adopted, the status of equivalent-measures and phosphate-chain agreements, and whether negotiation documents with the European Commission on the derogation will be shared. The State Secretary largely defended the process, refused to release negotiation documents and departmental involvement details, and acknowledged that communication on the phosphate-fertiliser ban could have been better, without offering an apology.
I will not make available any documents relating to the course of the negotiations with the European Commission.
Ik zal geen documenten ter beschikking stellen die betrekking hebben op het verloop van de onderhandeling met de Europese Commissie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf, Lodders en Geurts over het rapport van Watermaatschappij Limburg over mogelijke overschatting van nitraatgehaltes in lössgrond

Three MPs asked the State Secretary about a Watermaatschappij Limburg report suggesting nitrate levels in loess soil may be overestimated by about 30% compared with RIVM's method, and whether this affects loess-soil use standards and EU reporting. The State Secretary answered that the report rests on a very small dataset, that the nationwide monitoring network (LMM) and model calculations still show concentrations above the 50 mg/l target, that WML and RIVM will discuss the methodology, and that a pilot with equivalent measures in loess areas is viewed positively.
RIVM and WML will soon enter into discussion about the methodology of nitrate measurements.
RIVM en WML gaan op korte termijn in gesprek over de methodiek van nitraatmetingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de toenemende verwaarlozing van landbouwdieren

An MP asked the government about rising neglect of farm animals and the NVWA finding that 60 farmers are notorious offenders, including whether a permanent ban on keeping animals could be imposed as a standalone measure. The state secretary described an integrated prevention and support approach, reported the violations and animals taken into custody, and deferred the question on a standalone ban to answers from the Minister of Justice and Security.

For the answer to these questions I refer you to the answers to the questions from members Van Gerven (SP) and Schouw (D66) to the Minister of Security and Justice on the ban on keeping animals as a standalone penalty

Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Van Gerven (SP) en Schouw (D66) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het houdverbod als zelfstandige straf
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het houden van kamelen en dromedarissen en de overdracht van MERS

An MP asked whether the Berlicum camel dairy's exemption for keeping dromedaries, its routine oxytocin use and mother-young separation, and the MERS transmission risk were acceptable. The State Secretary answered that the exemption was extended to 2018 under conditions, oxytocin is no longer used structurally, MERS is not present in the Netherlands, and no ban or further investigation is planned.

Given that the welfare regulations for production animals are complied with, the company is under veterinary supervision and oxytocin is no longer structurally used to stimulate milk release, I extended the exemption for the company in 2013 by 5 years to 1 March 2018, subject to conditions.

Gelet het feit dat de voorschriften van het Besluit welzijn productiedieren wordt nageleefd, het bedrijf onder controle staat van een dierenarts en oxytocine niet meer structureel wordt toegepast om de melkgift te stimuleren heb ik onder voorwaarden de ontheffing voor het bedrijf in 2013 verlengd met 5 jaar tot 1 maart 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over het bericht ‘vergunningen veehouderij gebaseerd op rekenfouten’

Two SP MPs asked the state secretaries about reports that livestock odour permits rest on calculation errors, including the legal consequences, the province of Noord-Brabant's requests, health effects, and whether the odour law and maximum odour loads should be tightened. The government says the V-Stacks model works in most situations, that existing permits are unaffected, and that a targeted model adjustment and guidance for municipalities will follow, but it declines to tighten the law now and leaves cumulative odour checks to municipalities.
I will ensure a solution for the short term.
Ik zal zorgen voor een oplossing voor de korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht dat twee derde van de dierenartsen meer antibiotica voorschrijft dan de streefwaarde

An MP asks the State Secretary whether she is concerned that two-thirds of veterinarians prescribe more antibiotics than the benchmark target, whether stronger measures are needed, and whether the NVWA sanctions vets based on SDa data. The government answers that the benchmark is a tool for self-improvement by the profession, that existing private improvement trajectories and NVWA risk-based supervision suffice for now, and promises to report new benchmark figures and consider post-2015 reduction targets.
The SDa does not pass data on to the NVWA.
De SDa geeft geen gegevens door aan de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over ‘Varkensexport lijdt onder capaciteitsprobleem NVWA’

MP Lodders (VVD) asked whether the NVWA lacks vets to carry out all requested pig export inspections at farms, with consequences for animal welfare, health and exports, and what the cost is for businesses. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the stricter inspection regime causes temporary vet shortages on peak days, with 51 inspections postponed in one period, that welfare is not affected, and that twenty extra vets are being trained to solve the capacity problem by the second half of 2014.
It is expected that the twenty veterinarians will have completed the full training programme and be operational in the second half of 2014, at which point the capacity problem will be resolved.

Naar verwachting zullen de twintig dierenartsen in de tweede helft van 2014 het volledige opleidingstraject afgerond hebben en operationeel zijn, waarmee het capaciteitsprobleem dan zal zijn opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het voorstel dat een nationaal teeltverbod op gengewassen mogelijk zou moeten maken

Deputy MP Ouwehand asked the state secretaries whether the proposal giving member states a national power to ban GM crop cultivation had changed, which countries block it, whether the Netherlands can support a proposal that does not meet the Ouwehand motion, and whether a political debate should precede any decision. The government answered only by referring the Chamber to a recent letter on the proposal and the expected Environment Council discussion.
For the answers to your questions I refer you to the recent letter sent to your Chamber on the proposal for national cultivation competence
Voor de beantwoording van uw vragen verwijs ik u naar de recent aan uw Kamer gestuurde brief over het voorstel voor nationale teeltbevoegdheid

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de zorgen die leven bij de Vereniging Natuurmonumenten over de beheersvergoedingen in het kader van het rietlandbeheer in Nationaal Park de Weerribben-Wie

CDA MPs asked whether the subsidy levels for reed-land management in the Weerribben-Wieden park are adequate, and whether the 2014 income-tax changes and 6% VAT rate undermine the SNL standard-cost system. The State Secretary says provinces set compensation at 75% of norm costs under the Natuurpact, that VAT is due on paid management outsourcing, that no relevant tax changes occurred, and that a reduced VAT rate is not possible under EU rules, while committing to no concrete action.

On the basis of the information known to me, I cannot assess whether and to what extent the management compensation provided to reed cutters is insufficient to achieve the desired nature quality through the summer mowing regime.

Op basis van de mij bekende gegevens kan ik niet beoordelen of en in hoeverre de verstrekte beheersvergoedingen die in het kader van het rietlandbeheer aan riettelers verstrekt worden ontoereikend zijn om de gewenste natuurkwaliteit via het regime van zomermaaibeheer te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Visser over het bericht «Boeren en waterschappen koppelen grondgebruik aan waterbeheer»

MPs Lodders and Visser asked about reports that farmers and water boards are launching 30 new area projects under the Deltaplan Agrarisch Waterbeheer, and whether this creates overlapping regulation with the Nitrates Directive and crop protection rules. The State Secretary answered that LTO leads the initiative with water boards, that the government plays a supporting role, and that equivalent measures could give farmers exemptions from generic use norms from 2015, without adding new binding regulation.
I do not foresee that this will lead to an accumulation of regulation.
Ik voorzie niet dat dit leidt tot een stapeling van regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over Aalt Dijkhuizen als boegbeeld van de topsector Agri&Food

MPs Van Gerven and Smaling asked why former Wageningen UR executive Aalt Dijkhuizen was chosen as figurehead of the Agri&Food top sector, given his public opposition to organic farming, and how the biological sector's share of funding and the 2013 amendment were implemented. The minister answered that he was chosen for his sector knowledge and networks, that his remarks were personal, that the sector's budget and amendment implementation are described in earlier letters, and that no second figurehead is needed.
Mr Dijkhuizen's statements were made in a personal capacity, and he indicated that he is absolutely not an opponent of the organic sector.
De uitspraken van de heer Dijkhuizen zijn op persoonlijke titel gemaakt, waarbij hij heeft aangegeven dat hij absoluut geen tegenstander van de biologische sector is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van levende dieren bij militaire oefeningen

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether the Ministry of Defence should stop using live animals in military medical training, given available simulators and EU rules, and why it allegedly told PETA US otherwise. The minister acknowledged live-animal training remains mandatory for trauma surgeons and anaesthetists (DSTC/DATC courses) with no alternative, denied a breach of Dutch law, and admitted the 2011 statement to PETA was inaccurate.
This information is not known to me. There are no international agreements or obligations regarding such reporting, and in practice this information is also not exchanged.
Deze informatie is mij niet bekend. Er zijn geen internationale afspraken of verplichtingen inzake dergelijke rapportages en ook in de praktijk wordt deze informatie niet uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de advisering door de Technische Commissie Bodem

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the Technical Commission Soil Protection (TCB) may legally consider ammonia emissions when advising on a research exemption for surface spreading of manure, arguing its advice should be limited to soil protection. The state secretary answered that the law does not restrict TCB advice to soil protection, that ammonia effects fall within its remit, and that the government will weigh but not be bound by TCB advice.
In the final decision that the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment and I take, the views of the TCB are weighed, but we make our own assessment.
In het uiteindelijke besluit dat de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en ik nemen, wegen de opvattingen van de TCB mee, maar wij maken onze eigen afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over namaakvoedsel

An MP asked the ministers whether the NVWA's plan of action addresses trade in counterfeit food and whether organised crime is involved. The government answered that the issue concerns mislabelled food, that the NVWA has enforcement tools and is strengthening fraud detection, and that it would inform the House by summer 2014.
At the General Consultation on Food of 18 December 2013 I committed to informing the House before summer 2014 about my approach to misleading labelling.
In het Algemeen Overleg Voedsel van 18 december 2013 heb ik toegezegd voor de zomer 2014 de Kamer te informeren over mijn aanpak voor wat betreft misleidende etikettering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over Chinees mensenhaar in brood

An MP asked whether Chinese human hair or goose feathers are used to make L-cysteine, a bread improver ingredient, and whether this reaches Dutch bread, and called for an import ban. The minister answered that the source is not known to her, that EU law prohibits human-origin L-cysteine and bans relevant animal-origin imports from China, and that Dutch bakery suppliers reportedly use only plant-based L-cysteine, so no further consumer information is planned.
I am not aware whether L-cysteine is extracted from human hair in China or whether this hair is collected from local hairdressers.
Mij is niet bekend of L-cysteïne in China uit mensenhaar wordt gewonnen en of deze haren bij de plaatselijke kappers worden opgehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Lodders naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘Dijksma zegt nee tegen Basamid’

An MP asks why the State Secretary for Economic Affairs refused to sign the exemption request for the pesticide Basamid, and about its impact on Dutch growers and exports. The government answers that the Ctgb advised against the exemption due to formaldehyde risks to users and bystanders, that the state secretary weighted human health above agricultural interest, and that economic effects cannot be precisely quantified.
In my assessment I gave more weight to the seriousness of the risk to humans than to the agricultural interest.
In mijn afweging heb ik de ernst van het risico voor de mens zwaarder laten wegen dan het landbouwkundige belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Schouw over het bericht dat landbouwgeld nog steeds naar sportclubs, kerken en golfbanen gaat

MPs Pechtold and Schouw asked whether EU agricultural subsidies still reach sports clubs, churches and golf courses, and whether the government will ensure spending is limited to farmers. State Secretary Dijksma answered that the 2014-2020 rural development programme aims at farmers, while LEADER and some cooperation measures may reach non-farmers, and that the Netherlands will not oppose member states choosing to fund non-farmers within EU rules.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over het bericht dat de Voedselbank EU-geld voor armoedebestrijding opeist

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked why the government is using EU food-aid fund FEAD for 2014-2020, whether consultation occurred, and how food surpluses could better reach food banks. The state secretary answered that the funds are reallocated from ESF/EFRO rather than additional, that the fund targets social inclusion, and that gemeenten and the AVV-Voedselbanken cooperation are being engaged, with promises of further talks and support.
It is correct that for the 2014-2020 programme period the Netherlands will deploy 3.5 million euros for the EU Fund for European Aid to the Most Deprived (FEAD).
Het klopt dat Nederland voor de programmaperiode 2014–2020 3,5 miljoen euro zal inzetten voor het Fonds voor Europese hulp aan de meestbehoeftigen (FEAD).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders, Visser en De Liefde over het einde aan de betutteling van het milieubeleid

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government's Duurzaam Doen website and planned environmental measures amount to an end to paternalism in environmental policy, and about its cost, related initiatives, and the basis for recommending meat reduction. The minister answered that the site offers practical guidance rather than mandates, cost about 49,909 euros, that similar initiatives exist, and that reducing meat consumption benefits health and sustainability per official reports.
The cabinet wants to make use of the energy and ambitions that many parties and residents in our country have in the area of environment and sustainability.
Het kabinet wil gebruik maken van de energie en ambities die veel partijen en bewoners in ons land hebben op het gebied van milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de voortgang van het convenant ‘Asbestdak eraf, zonnepanelen erop’

An MP asked the state secretary about progress on the covenant 'Asbestos roof off, solar panels on' for agricultural buildings, including how much asbestos has been removed, whether the 2024 full-removal target will be met, and the low uptake of the subsidy. The government answered that about 430,000 m2 has been subsidised (around 1 million m2 including pipeline), that current pace is too slow but it expects to reach the target with the planned 2024 ban and extra measures, and that it is consulting with the provinces on adjusting the covenant.
The current pace of roughly 4 million m2 of asbestos roof removed per year is too low to reach the goal of full removal.
Het huidige tempo van ongeveer 4 miljoen m 2 gesaneerd asbestdak per jaar ligt te laag om het doel van volledige sanering te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders naar aanleiding van het Volkskrant artikel getiteld “Wolf krijgt ‘verblijfsvergunning”

MPs Heerema and Lodders asked why the wolf should receive legal protection and what effect wolf damage claims would have on the Faunafonds, which may lack funds for goose damage. The State Secretary answered that provinces requested clarity on the wolf's status so they can use their management powers, that the Faunafonds is provincially responsibility and expected only relatively small wolf damage costs, and that the fund has no ceiling on compensation.
It is up to the provinces to give a judgement on that.
Het is aan de provincies daarover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het lot van uitgezette otters in Nederland

An MP asks the State Secretary about otters killed in muskrat traps, PCB contamination, road deaths and the legitimacy of the otter reintroduction programme, and whether permits should be revoked. The State Secretary answers that bycatch is minimised but cannot be fully prevented, that the PCB link is unproven, that reintroduction met IUCN guidelines, and that one permit remains valid with no new applications known.
I have asked Alterra to prepare a report on the traffic hotspots where otters are often victims of road traffic.
Ik heb aan Alterra gevraagd om een rapport op te stellen over de verkeersknelpunten waar otters vaak slachtoffer van het verkeer zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht ‘Boeren Dinkelland halen gelijk bij Raad van State

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a Council of State ruling that the Dinkelland Natura 2000 designation, including an agricultural enclave, was insufficiently motivated and that the boundary should not expand the area. The government answered that it will supplement the motivation as the court requested, denies that compensation for De Vetpot was required, and maintains the enclave is necessary for conservation goals without changing the management plan.
I will, in line with the interim judgment of the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State, still motivate the decision adequately.
Ik zal conform het tussenvonnis van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State het besluit alsnog toereikend motiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het gebruik van baden met garra-rufavissen

An MP asked the government about health risks, animal welfare and a Belgian advisory opinion concerning fish spa baths with garra rufa fish. The minister said RIVM considers the risks acceptable with user restrictions and hygiene rules, rejected a ban, and pointed to existing animal welfare rules.
I intend to provide, in the amendment of the Bhvbz, that the operator must ensure the fish spa is not used by them.
Daarom ben ik voornemens om bij de wijziging van het Bhvbz te regelen dat de exploitant ervoor zorg moet dragen dat de fish spa niet door hen gebruikt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over slechte prijzen voor Noordzeevis

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why North Sea fish prices (sole and plaice) remain low, whether fish prices can be included in the food price monitor, and how producer organisations and the ACM could enable better pricing and sales. The State Secretary answered that prices result from market supply and demand with no signs of insufficient competition, that the food price monitor excludes fish for cost reasons, that the existing EU framework already allows producer agreements, and that a revolving fund for fishing investment is planned for summer 2014.
I have no signals that there is insufficient market competition in the fish chain.
Ik heb geen signalen dat in de visketen onvoldoende marktwerking is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de Programmatische Aanpak Stikstof (PAS) en de problematiek rond de zogenaamde «interim-uitbreiders»

An MP asked the state secretary about the Noordelijke Rekenkamer reports on decentralised nature policy and about 'interim expanders', farms expanded without a Natuurbeschermingswet permit, including the regional response, a national working group, a complete list of such farms, the effect on PAS deposition space, a standstill and a generic solution. The secretary acknowledged the problem, said a generic solution via individual permits could legalise most cases, but gave no list yet, rejected a standstill and only described ongoing exploratory work.
It is not yet clear whether this information is suitable for identifying all interim expanders.
Het is nog niet duidelijk of deze informatie geschikt is om alle interim-uitbreiders te identificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over zwanendrifter in de fout

An MP asked the ministers whether a swan drifter caught with 18 swans, some bloodied, was fined or prosecuted for animal cruelty and Flora- and Faunawet violations, and whether his exemption could be revoked. The government answered that no fine or animal-cruelty report was issued, that the police findings are recorded and the violations are still being assessed, that revocation is possible if violations are established, and that the NVWA carried out no inspections in 2013 but plans to do so this year.
At this moment it is being examined whether there has been a violation of the laws and regulations and if so which.
Op dit moment wordt bekeken óf er sprake is geweest van een overtreding van de wet- en regelgeving en zo ja welke.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het verkrijgen van een Europees patent op soja door Monsanto

An MP asked whether the European Patent Office granted Monsanto a patent on soybean traits giving exclusive rights over more than 250 varieties, and whether this conflicts with the Biotechnology Directive and calls for no patents on conventional breeding. The State Secretary answered that the patent covers only a marker-based screening method, not plants or varieties, that it was granted under the EPC, that no objection will be lodged, and that the government is pursuing a broad breeders' exemption.
I see no reason to object to the patent in question.
Ik zie geen reden om bezwaar te maken tegen het onderhavige octrooi.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bruins Slot over de dreigende sluiting van ruiter- en mountainbikepaden beheerd door Staatsbosbeheer

MPs Geurts and Bruins Slot asked whether the government shares fears that horse-riding and mountain-bike paths managed by Staatsbosbeheer will decline, and how it oversees path maintenance and possible user fees. The state secretary replied that no closures are planned, that the government does not supervise path maintenance, that it steers Staatsbosbeheer only at a general level, and that it leaves the matter to talks between the agency and sports federations.
The cabinet does not supervise this.
Het kabinet houdt hier geen toezicht op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘LTO wil snelle oplossing stuifbestrijding’

MP Lodders asks why no permanent solution for dust control (stuifbestrijding) has yet been reached despite a commitment last summer, and whether the delay tied to the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme requires a faster national fix for arable farmers, and asks about the economic damage including a claimed 2 million euro loss for sugar beet. The State Secretary replies that the fifth programme proposes a structural exemption for cattle slurry on arable land in the peat-colony areas and Texel from 2015, that a transitional arrangement for 2014 has been published and is in force, and that she knows of no damage incurred before the transitional arrangement took effect.
In anticipation of this structural arrangement, I have put in place a transitional arrangement for this year.
Vooruitlopend op deze structurele voorziening heb ik voor dit jaar een overgangsregeling getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de Gelderse voorkeur voor afschot boven hekken

An MP (Thieme, PvdD) asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a Gelderland deputy's preference for culling over fencing conflicts with the Flora and Fauna Act's requirement that other solutions come first. The State Secretary says the provinces are responsible for wildlife management and the deputy's views are his own, so she will not intervene, though she accepts the statutory principle that harm should be minimised.
I leave the statements in question to the responsibility of the deputy.
De bedoelde uitspraken laat ik voor rekening van de gedeputeerde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Noorden verwacht dassenexplosie’

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about a report predicting a sharp badger population increase in the north, with uncompensated damage and financing concerns. The government said badger management and damage financing are provincial responsibilities, rejected the comparison with goose problems, and reported an approved relocation of a badger family in Cuijk.
The province is responsible for management and damage control.
De provincie gaat over beheer en schadebestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het afschieten van huiskraaien

An MP asked the state secretary about shooting house crows in Hoek van Holland by a hired wildlife manager who allegedly killed a protected jackdaw, and about the classification of native versus alien species. The secretary answered that the permit decision lies with the province of Zuid-Holland, that shooting was allowed only as a last resort per the provincial order, and that the house crow is an invasive alien species under national rules while the Vogelrichtlijn protects all wild European species.
Withdrawing the order is, incidentally, a power that lies with the province.
Het eventueel intrekken van de aanwijzing is overigens een bevoegdheid, die ligt bij de provincie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over gefokte fazanten voor de jacht

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether a pheasant breeder supplying birds for hunting and consumption violates the ban on releasing animals for hunting, and whether labelling or a breeding ban is needed. The State Secretary said there is no indication birds are sold to Dutch hunters for release, that releasing is banned under the Flora and Fauna Act, that breeding captive animals is permitted, and referred back to earlier answers on labelling.
I have no indications that animals are sold to Dutch hunters to be released.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat dieren aan Nederlandse jagers worden verkocht om deze uit te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanpak van broodfok en malafide hondenhandel

The MP asks the State Secretary and Minister how the government will tackle puppy-farming and dishonest dog trade, including inspection numbers, prosecution, licensing of vets, and identification and registration of dogs. The government answers with inspection and recheck figures, enforcement capacity, prosecution limits, a rejection of a standalone kennel ban and of an extra identification requirement, and a commitment to a review in about eighteen months.
This information cannot be generated from the systems of the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Deze informatie kan niet uit de systemen van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik Faber over het terugroepen van vlees bij Van Hattem

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the Van Hattem meat recall could have been partial, whether the NVWA ignored a court opening, and how the sector's losses and traceability oversight stand. The government denied any court offer for partial recall, said the burden of proof for traceability lies with the business, and gave no estimate of economic damage.

At present it cannot yet be said with certainty how many of the companies involved in the recall can demonstrate the legally required safety and traceability of their products, and how much meat must be removed from the market.

Op dit moment is nog niet met zekerheid te zeggen hoeveel van de bij de terugroepactie betrokken bedrijven de wettelijk vereiste veiligheid en traceerbaarheid van hun producten kunnen aantonen en hoeveel vlees van de markt moet worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het storten van staalslakken in de Oosterschelde

Two SGP MPs asked whether Rijkswaterstaat should cover steel slag dumped in the Oosterschelde with rubble to protect the Oosterschelde lobster and benthic life, and whether it will do so. The minister acknowledged the species' value, said consultation with lobster fishers and a provincial permit are in place, and offered an ecological finish on a test section and a joint exploration for the next cluster, but did not commit to rubble cover.

Besides the test section with ecological finishing being dumped in the second cluster, I will explore with the parties involved and the market what options exist within the current financial frameworks

Naast het testvak met de ecologische afwerking dat in het tweede cluster wordt bestort, zal ik samen met de betrokken partijen en de markt verkennen welke mogelijkheden er binnen de huidige financiële kaders zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw inzake wildlife crime

An MP asked the state secretary and justice minister about EU-level action against wildlife crime, including enforcement rules, penalties and prosecutorial capacity. The government said it will send a written reply to the Commission, that existing EU rules suffice and enforcement is national, and that maximum penalties are rarely imposed though courts have handed down substantial sentences.
In the BNC fiche sent to your House on 14 March, it is announced that a written response will be sent to the Commission regarding the Communication.
In het BNC fiche dat op 14 maart jl. aan uw Kamer is gezonden, wordt aangekondigd dat een schriftelijke reactie aan de Commissie zal worden verstuurd naar aanleiding van de Mededeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over het bericht ‘GPS moet dier tijdens transport beschermen’

An MP asked the State Secretary why GPS monitoring of livestock transports is only applied on a sample basis to long journeys, and whether it should be mandatory and extended to domestic transport. The State Secretary said GPS is mandatory for transports over 8 hours, that IBD checks GPS data for about 15% of long transports, that GPS will become mandatory under manure rules, and that industry is asked to include GPS in a quality system.
Within the enforcement of manure regulation, GPS is going to be made mandatory.
In het kader van de handhaving van de mestregelgeving gaat GPS verplicht worden voorgeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slob over het ‘Masterplan Toekomst IJsselmeer’

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Masterplan for the future of the IJsselmeer, including funding for a transition fund, a possible three-year fishing halt, compensation and buyout of fishers, and the rejected fishing plan. The State Secretary answered that a total package is important, that the EUR 2.25 million transition budget is for sustainable fishing and ecology rather than buyouts, that other ministries are responsible for funding sources, and that a full response would follow within two weeks.
I consider it very important to come to a total package for the IJsselmeer fisheries, including the deployment of financial resources.
Ik acht het van groot belang om met een totaalpakket voor de IJsselmeervisserij te komen, inclusief inzet van financiële middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwenhand over het fokken en doden van gezonde dieren in dierentuinen

An MP asks the State Secretary whether zoos may cull healthy animals to prevent inbreeding, how many animals Dutch zoos breed and cull, and whether the EAZA rules should be tightened. The State Secretary answers that euthanasia is a last resort, that Dutch zoos report births and deaths to RVO.nl with no excesses found, and that no tightening of breeding programmes is planned.
These overviews are assessed for excesses and risks.
Deze overzichten worden beoordeeld op excessen en risico's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Wolbert over het bericht ‘Pandemie uit Brabant is mogelijk’

MPs Van Dekken and Wolbert asked the government about reports that a pandemic originating in Brabant is possible, including calls to reduce animal numbers, close farms, and separate pig and poultry farms by a kilometre. The minister answered that current hygiene and early-warning measures are sufficient, that reducing animals or fully closed farms is not the solution, and that the RIVM distance advice did not lead to a policy change.
We are of the view that the current measures are sufficient to keep the chance of an outbreak as small as possible.
Wij zijn van mening dat de huidige maatregelen voldoende zijn om de kans op een uitbraak zo klein mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de openstelling van de markt voor het ophalen en verwerken van kadavers

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether the Dutch rules allow more than one firm to enter the market for collecting and processing animal carcasses, whether competition would improve prices, and whether the minister would talk to interested parties. The State Secretary answered yes on the legal room for multiple regional operators, agreed in general that competition may help but noted it is not guaranteed and that the current system is efficient, and said she is willing to talk with interested parties.
I am happy to enter into discussion with parties that are interested in joining.
Ik ga graag in gesprek met partijen die belangstelling hebben om toe te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over aanvallen van Japanse walvisvaarders op Nederlandse schepen van Sea Shepherd

The MP asks the government whether it knows of Japanese whaling vessels attacking a Sea Shepherd ship, whether this endangers maritime safety, what it has done to respond, and whether it will prosecute or raise the issue at the IWC. The minister answers that the ILT has examined the February 2 incidents, found intimidating manoeuvres that may have been deliberate, referred the report to the Public Prosecution Service, raised concerns with the Japanese ambassador, and will voice concerns at the IWC.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether further action will follow.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of terzake nadere actie zal volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verbod op het aanbinden van koeien

MP Thieme asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about extending the tie-stall derogation for organic cows, the number of organic farms still tying cows, and animal welfare concerns. The State Secretary answered that the small-stall definition will be temporarily widened to 50 animals until 1 January 2016, with agreements with Bionext to phase out tying, and that inspections and welfare rules remain in place.
I have decided to temporarily widen the definition of small stalls until 1 January 2016, from 10 to 50 animals.
Ik heb besloten de definitie voor kleine stallen tijdelijk tot 1 januari 2016 te verruimen van 10 tot 50 dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het Ierse rundvlees dat uit Holland komt

An MP asked whether Jumbo mislabelled beef as Irish when it was Dutch-raised, and how the government would respond. The minister answered that the NVWA addressed one franchise store's labelling error, which was corrected, and that enforcement options and consumer routes exist but the matter is considered closed for the NVWA.
In that store, Dutch beef was sold instead of Irish beef.
In die winkel is in plaats van Iers rundvlees Nederlands rundvlees verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over terugroepactie sleurt vleesbedrijven mee

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the NVWA's recall of Van Hattem Vlees meat threatens dozens of other small and medium meat companies and whether the NVWA considered that. The State Secretary answered that the NVWA was obliged under EU law to recall untraceable meat, that businesses bear responsibility for traceability, and that food safety comes first.
The NVWA was therefore obliged under European legislation to declare the meat unfit for human consumption and to order the company to remove it from the market as a precaution.

De NVWA was daarom op grond van Europese wetgeving genoodzaakt het vlees als niet geschikt voor humane consumptie aan te merken en het bedrijf te sommeren om dit uit voorzorg van de markt te laten halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht Recall Van Hattem kan beperkter

MP Lodders asked why the NVWA apparently moved from demanding a full recall of Van Hattem meat to a more nuanced stance, and what this means for 55 meat businesses. The State Secretary replied that the NVWA's position has not changed: companies that can prove full traceability and legal compliance need not recall meat, with the burden of proof on the business, and that the consequences vary per firm.
Moreover, there is no question of a changed position of the NVWA.
Ook is er geen sprake van een veranderde opstelling van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Jan Vos over het bericht “Alleen nog duurzame soja is stap te ver voor vleesindustrie”

Two MPs (Dikkers and Jan Vos, PvdA) asked the government whether the meat sector will meet its 2015 pledge to buy only certified sustainable soy, and what the state can do to help. Minister Ploumen answers that the 2013 target was missed, that the sector's ambition for 2015 remains, that RTRS supply exceeded Dutch needs, and that the government will keep urging industry to meet its commitments without taking binding measures.
The target for 2013 was therefore indeed not met.
De doelstelling voor 2013 is dus inderdaad niet gehaald
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Dikkers over de inbeslagneming van vee bij een Friese bioboer-oormerkweigeraar

MPs Jacobi and Dikkers asked whether the government knew the NVWA had seized cattle from a Frisian organic farmer who refused ear tags, and what it would do to develop alternatives for conscientious objectors. The Secretary of State confirmed the seizure and said a proposal for an alternative identifier was submitted to Brussels but lacked support, that a 20% CAP cut remains under EU rules, and that she will keep pursuing an EU-level alternative and discuss the cut with the Commission.
For the second means of identification, one could for example think of a rumen bolus with a chip or a chip implanted under the skin.
Voor het tweede identificatiemiddel kan bijvoorbeeld gedacht worden aan een maagbolus met een chip of een chip welke onderhuids wordt aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en De Rouwe over het bericht heksenjacht bij erkende oormerkweigeraars

Two CDA MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that the NVWA blocked farms of conscientious objectors who refuse ear tags for cattle and removed animals, calling it a witch-hunt. The State Secretary answered that the protocol was terminated after repeated non-compliance, that blocking follows EU and national identification rules, that one farm also faced welfare neglect, and that the NVWA will re-check participants in Q4 2014.
The reason for the termination is that the conscientious objectors did not meet the conditions of the aforementioned protocol.
De reden voor de opzegging is dat de gewetensbezwaarden niet hebben voldaan aan de voorwaarden van het eerder genoemde protocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over ongunstige milieucondities in natuurgebieden

An MP asked the state secretary about a Wageningen study finding nitrogen from livestock farming and drying-out of nature as main threats to Dutch nature, and whether sustainable farming and policy changes would follow. The state secretary agreed the study points to these problems, supports further sustainable farming within existing plans, and said the study offers no new insights beyond what led to the nitrogen programme.
I am in favour of further sustainability in agriculture; this contributes to improving nature quality.
Ik ben een voorstander van een verdere verduurzaming van de landbouw, dit draagt bij aan het verbeteren van de natuurkwaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Neppérus over het bericht dat varkenshouders teleurgesteld zijn in EZ

Two VVD MPs asked why the loose-housing sow stall with feeding stalls was excluded from the Maatlat duurzame veehouderij, thereby losing access to MIA and Vamil tax schemes, and whether the ministry should be making such system choices. The state secretary answered that the exclusion reflects that this system is now the legal minimum for group housing of sows, that the scheme is meant to reward above-standard innovators, and that varkenshouders can still qualify through other housing types, so no change is planned.
It is an entrepreneur's decision which housing system is chosen.
Het is een ondernemersbeslissing welk huisvestingssysteem wordt gekozen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de ecotopenkaarten van de Westerschelde

An MP asked the state secretary about changes in the ecotope areas of the Western Scheldt estuary since its Natura 2000 designation, and whether this matches the claimed decline used to justify polder restoration. The government corrected the maps for an error involving Flemish territory, said the area of low-dynamic intertidal habitat shows no structural positive trend, and maintained that the Natuurpakket Westerschelde is still needed to halt deterioration.
Hereby you receive the corrected maps and also an overview table with the correct figures.
Hierbij ontvangt u de gecorrigeerde kaarten en tevens een overzichtstabel met de juiste cijfers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodschieten van een verweesd jong damhert bij Marum

An MP asked whether police shot a young orphaned fallow deer in a pasture near Marum, whether less lethal alternatives were tried, and whether protocols were followed. The minister said an internal police investigation is ongoing and cannot be anticipated, and that the duty of care under the Flora- and faunawet applies, but whether it was met cannot be said while the investigation runs.
An internal police investigation into the precise events in this case is under way. I cannot anticipate the results of this investigation.
Er loopt een intern politieonderzoek naar de precieze gebeurtenissen in deze zaak. Ik kan niet op de resultaten van dit onderzoek vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over dolfijnenslachtingen in Taiji en handel in dolfijnen voor entertainment

An MP asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the dolphin slaughter in Taiji, the sale of dolphins for entertainment, and follow-up on earlier motions and IWC efforts. The government answered that the ambassador voiced disapproval, that Dutch efforts continue via the IWC and EU trade talks, and that it will inform parliament of outcomes.
On the Dutch position at the upcoming IWC annual meeting in September 2014, your House will be informed in good time.
Over de inzet van Nederland tijdens de komende jaarvergadering van de IWC in september 2014 zal uw Kamer tijdig worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Rebel over handhaving dumping drugsafval in de natuur

MPs Jacobi and Rebel asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about enforcement against dumping of drug waste in nature, including whether existing law is adequate, who pays cleanup costs, enforcement numbers and capacity, and expertise. The minister replied that existing Environmental Management Act provisions suffice, that no new rules are planned, that the polluter should pay with waterproofing funds being explored, and that specialist police expertise (LFO) is available.

Further data on the number of drug waste dumpings and the resulting prosecutions, sentences, and collected fines cannot be generated from the business process systems of the Public Prosecution Service and investigative agencies.

Nadere gegevens over aantallen drugsafvaldumpingen en de daarop volgende strafvervolging/strafoplegging en geïnde geldboetes en/of gevangenisstraffen kunnen niet uit de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het OM en de opsporingsinstanties worden gegenereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over biggensterfte door onderkoeling

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about piglets hung on wash clips to prevent drowning after hypothermia, the number of piglets dying from cold, and whether reducing litter size would reduce piglet mortality. The State Secretary said the rescue action is acceptable within the sustainable livestock vision but could be replaced by welfare-friendlier vests, and that no data exist on hypothermia deaths or the share of mortality it causes.
No data on this are recorded.
Hier worden geen gegevens over geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de mogelijkheden voor een importverbod op foie gras

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands could ban imports of foie gras because its production breaches EU animal welfare Directive 98/58/EC and Council of Europe recommendations, and whether the Dutch government would press for an EU-wide ban on individual cages and force-feeding. The State Secretary opposed the force-feeding practice but said an import ban is not legally possible on animal welfare grounds under EU law, and committed to ask the Commission to monitor France's cage phase-out by 2016 and to commission research into welfare and alternatives.
Moreover, introducing a national import ban on grounds of animal welfare is not possible under European law.
Het instellen van een nationaal importverbod op grond van dierenwelzijn is Europeesrechtelijk bovendien niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Ziengs over het bericht "DDB wil meer informatie ZuivelNL"

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that the Dutch Dairy Board wants more information on the new dairy chain body ZuivelNL, including a levy of EUR 0.05 per 100 kg milk, and whether interbranch organisations may take over productschap tasks and use general binding declarations. The minister answered that the LTO-NZO cooperation is not yet a recognised interbranch organisation under the CAP, that the levy is a voluntary private contribution rather than a statutory levy, that public tasks remain with the ministry and no general binding declaration applies, and that a framework regulation will be published in the second quarter of 2014.
A private organisation is free to ask its voluntarily affiliated participants for a financial contribution, whether or not it is an interbranch organisation within the meaning of the CAP.
Het staat een private organisatie, of dit nu een brancheorganisatie in de zin van het GLB is of niet, vrij om een financiële bijdrage te vragen aan de (vrijwillig) aangesloten deelnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Aukje de Vries over het bericht over de visie van natuurclubs op het Waddengebied in relatie tot de Natuurwet

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about natuurclubs' call to prioritise nature over economy in the Wadden area and whether tourism and harbour development should remain possible there. The government replied that the Structuurvisie allows economic development within the nature-protection aim, that the Wadden area is already well protected, and that it will present a new Natuurwet proposal balancing economy and ecology.
I will soon present my proposals for the new Natuurwet.
Ik kom binnenkort met mijn voorstellen voor de nieuwe Natuurwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Remco Dijkstra over het bericht ‘extra ammoniakeisen dreigen vanuit Brussel’

MPs Lodders and Dijkstra asked about reports that the European Commission would propose tighter ammonia and fine-particle emission ceilings, and what this means for intensive livestock farming in the Netherlands. The Secretary of State answered that the proposed ceilings can likely be met under existing policy, that no direct effect on intensive livestock farming is expected, and that further Dutch stable and manure rules are being prepared but will not be suspended.
I do not want to suspend these measures because that would cause problems with implementing the PAS and with meeting the agreements already made under the European air quality directive.

Ik wil deze maatregelen niet opschorten omdat er dan problemen ontstaan met de implementatie van de PAS en ten aanzien van het voldoen aan de reeds gemaakt afspraken in het kader van de Europese luchtkwaliteitsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Jacobi over het nemen van onomkeerbare maatregelen bij sluis Eefde

MPs Kuiken and Jacobi asked why a rook colony at lock Eefde is being relocated and irreversible measures taken before the new lock chamber decision and zoning plan are final, and whether the relocation could wait. The minister answered that a Flora and Fauna Act exemption was granted, no objection was filed, no irreversible steps will be taken before the zoning plan is adopted, and relocation must start before the next breeding season.
Moreover, no irreversible measures will be taken pursuant to the exemption before the zoning plan has been adopted.
Overigens worden er ter uitvoering van de ontheffing geen onomkeerbare maatregelen genomen voordat het bestemmingsplan is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het lot van de paarden die na het faillissement van een zorgboerderij worden geveild

MP Ouwehand asked why the 28 horses of a bankrupt care farm were being auctioned, whether the auction should be stopped in favour of rehoming, and whether the food safety authority NVWA had checked animal welfare or was involved in the auction decision. The state secretary answered that bankruptcy handling follows the rules regardless of cause, that high bids made impulse purchases or slaughter sales unlikely so stopping the auction is not needed, and that the NVWA had received no welfare complaints and was not involved in the auction decision.
The NVWA is not involved in the decision to auction the horses or in its further course.
De NVWA is niet betrokken bij het besluit tot veiling van de paarden of het verdere verloop daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Kamerleden Cegerek en Dikkers over het bericht dat er teveel dioxine gevonden is in eieren nabij de afvalverbrandingsoven Harlingen

MPs Cegerek and Dikkers asked about reports of excessive dioxin in eggs from backyard hens near the Harlingen waste incinerator, whether eggs and milk should be removed, and whether the incinerator and its enforcement by a regional agency posing a conflict of interest are adequately checked. The minister replied that the eggs were not marketed, that existing consumption advice still applies, that a re-evaluation of the EU tolerable weekly intake will be pushed in Europe, that incinerator emissions are continuously monitored and tested twice yearly, that no extra research is needed, and that the regional agency only advises municipalities and enforcement is not delegated.
The province is the competent authority for the waste incineration installation and is not a shareholder.
De provincie is bevoegd gezag voor de afvalverbrandingsinstallatie en geen aandeelhouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over verhogingen lasten veehouderij

The CDA MP Geurts asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the takeover of VION Ingredients by Darling International, government involvement, and sharp increases in carcass disposal tariffs for livestock farmers in 2014. The State Secretary answered that tariffs can only change with actual costs or revenues under the Besluit dierlijke producten, referred to her letter of 5 February 2014 for details, and stated that the government would further examine standard weights in the coming year.
In consultation with all parties it was decided to examine this carefully in the coming year as part of setting the tariffs.
In overleg met alle partijen is besloten hier het komende jaar nog zorgvuldig naar te kijken in het kader van de totstandkoming van de tarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht LTO en NVV boos over tariefverhoging Rendac

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that farm and pig-farmer organisations object to a Rendac tariff increase for animal carcass processing, including whether Rendac holds a monopoly and whether the market should be opened. The State Secretary largely refers to a letter on carcass tariffs and a LEI study, denying that the sale of the parent company caused the increase and that the ministry opposes a free market for health reasons.
I refer you to my letter on carcass tariffs of 5 February 2014 and the LEI study carried out, which is attached as an annex.
Ik verwijs u hiervoor naar mijn brief over kadavertarieven van 5 februari 2014 en het door het LEI uitgevoerde onderzoek welke als bijlage is bijgevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het opstellen van duurzame energiedoelstellingen voor 2030

An MP asked whether the government still supports leading international cooperation on sustainable energy, how it relates to a letter from eight EU ministers calling for binding 2030 renewable targets, and why the Netherlands did not co-sign it. The government answered that it backs a CO2 reduction target of at least 40% and that, as Green Growth Group members disagree on separate renewable and efficiency targets, the Netherlands took no explicit position and was not asked to co-sign.
In the Green Growth Group the Netherlands, in line with the cabinet's response to the European Green Paper, has argued for a CO2 reduction target of at least 40% compared with 1990.
Nederland heeft in de Green Growth Group conform de kabinetsreactie op het Europese Groenboek gepleit voor een CO 2 -reductiedoel van ten minste 40% ten opzichte van 1990.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Lodders over het uitrijden van drijfmest op grasland

MPs Dijkgraaf and Lodders asked why manure spreading on grassland is allowed only from 15 February while arable land may be fertilised from 1 February, and whether earlier grassland application would benefit the environment and grass growth. The State Secretary defended the later grassland date on water-quality and leaching grounds, noting the uncertain agronomic benefit, and declined to bring the date forward.
Given the uncertain agronomic benefit attached to this, I therefore consider bringing forward the spreading period on grassland not justified.
Mede gezien het onzekere landbouwkundige voordeel dat daaraan is verbonden, acht ik daarom een vervroeging van de uitrijperiode op grasland niet verantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Jacobi, Van Gerven, Graus, Schouw, Klaver en Klein over de gevolgen van het bestrijdingsmiddel metram-natrium op de volksgezondheid, het milieu en de natuur

MPs from several parties asked the state secretary about the EU ban on metam-natrium, its health and environmental risks, and why the Netherlands keeps granting exemptions, including a 120-day article 38 exemption that the Ctgb advised against. The state secretary answered that the EU exemption is for essential use, that the article 38 exemption covers a very small area against a quarantine nematode, and promised talks with the sector and a letter to parliament on limiting exposure of residents.
I will shortly consult with LTO and the relevant party in the crop protection industry on the possibilities for further regulating residents' exposure to metam-natrium.

Ik zal op korte termijn over de mogelijkheden van het verder reguleren van de blootstelling van metam-natrium aan omwonenden in overleg treden met LTO en de relevante partij in de gewasbeschermingsmiddelenindustrie.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Thieme over de ontwikkeling van stapelbakstallen
