The MP Thieme asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the Hy-care stacked-pen pig housing concept, including plastic pens moved by conveyor and stacking, and whether this is ethical and has social support. The State Secretary answers that the concept may improve welfare and reduce antibiotics if it meets current law, but acknowledges it may further industrialise pig farming and that ethical and social acceptance must be examined further.
From the perspective of social acceptance and ethics, such a development must be examined further.
Vanuit maatschappelijke acceptatie en ethisch oogpunt moet een dergelijke ontwikkeling nader worden bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over rondslingerende munitie in de natuur

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether lead ammunition should be banned for hunting and pest control in the Netherlands, following reports of hunters losing ammunition in nature. The minister answered that such data are unavailable, noted that 14 EU states ban lead shot, and declined to extend the ban to lead bullets, citing insufficient grounds from the single incident.
The incident mentioned in the cited media report gives me insufficient reason to extend the existing ban on lead shot to a ban on lead cartridges for hunting and pest control.

Het incident, genoemd in het aangehaalde mediabericht, geeft mij onvoldoende aanleiding om het geldende verbod op het gebruik van loodhoudende hagel uit te breiden met een verbod op het gebruik van loodhoudende kogelpatronen voor jacht en schadebestrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de toepassing van arsenicum in de kippen- en kalkoenindustrie in de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked the government about US use of arsenic-based growth promoters in poultry and turkey, EU bans, arsenic toxicity, labelling of imported products, and whether an EU-US trade deal would allow imports of meat from animals given such additives. The government welcomed US attention, confirmed EU bans and limits on arsenic in feed, said it lacked an overview of other countries' rules, and stated that EU food and product safety standards are not up for negotiation in the trade talks.
There will be no compromise on consumer and product safety.
Er zal niet ingeboet worden op consument- en productveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over uitbreiding van vergunningsplicht bij natuur

VVD MPs Rudmer Heerema and Lodders asked whether the State Secretary would accept proposals by nature, landscape and animal welfare organisations to extend permit requirements to nature areas of national importance, to restrict netting-off (saldering) under the PAS, and to abolish the list of huntable species. The State Secretary replied that the organisations' vision document was noted, that the Nature Conservation Bill is before parliament, and that an amendment note will be submitted in spring to stress the link between economy and ecology.
I have taken note of the vision document "A new Nature Conservation Act" from the nature, landscape and animal welfare organisations.
Ik heb kennisgenomen van het visiedocument «Een nieuwe wet natuurbescherming» van de natuur-, landschaps- en dierenwelzijnsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Wolbert over het bericht dat fabrikanten van levensmiddelen verdoezelen hoeveel suiker in producten zitten

MPs asked whether food manufacturers use many names for sugar and claims like 'no added sugars' to mislead consumers, and what labelling should require. The minister said the current EU and Dutch rules already require specific ingredient names, that 'no added sugars' claims are restricted, and that mandatory nutrition declarations with sugar content come from December 2016, and she agreed sugar content should be clearly stated on children's products.
In my view there is still generally too much sugar in our food supply.
Naar mijn mening zit er ten algemene nog teveel suiker in ons levensmiddelenaanbod.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de toelating van gentechgewassen in de Europese Unie

The MP Ouwehand asked why the government voted for EU import approval of genetically modified maize MON 87460 without first informing parliament, and whether it considers GMO safety proven given scientists' concerns. The government replied that its vote followed EFSA, COGEM and RIKILT advice, that it trusts the EFSA risk assessment, and that it will place a parliamentary reservation and inform parliament on its approach to GMO approvals, including maize 1507, before that vote.
Until I have discussed this cabinet approach with you, I will enter a parliamentary reservation on votes concerning this crop.
Totdat ik deze kabinetsaanpak met u besproken heb, zal ik een parlementair voorbehoud aantekenen bij stemmingen over dit gewas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over “De bedreigde status van vissen door de jacht op nepkaviaar"

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether the lumpfish is threatened by hunting for its roe used in fake caviar, and whether Dutch fishing should be banned. The State Secretary answered that the species is poorly studied and not assessed as threatened, that Dutch catches are incidental (about 500 kg since 2002), and that a Dutch ban is not appropriate, though she will raise the issue in the Fisheries Council.
However, I will raise attention for the issue in the Fisheries Council, since other member states such as Denmark and Sweden land larger quantities.
Wel zal ik in de Visserijraad aandacht vragen voor de problematiek, aangezien andere lidstaten zoals Denemarken en Zweden grotere hoeveelheden aanlanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over gecoupeerde paardenstaarten binnen de geledingen van de Koninklijke Vereniging “Het Nederlandse Trekpaard en De Haflinger”

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about docked horse tails within the KVTH horse breed association, including whether judging rewards docked horses and whether breeding officials sell docked horses. The government said the association made no substantive commitment on judging, will be invited for talks and asked to set a date after which docked horses are excluded from shows, and that the recognition of studbooks does not depend on tail status.
While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make further statements about it.
Lopende het onderzoek kan ik daarover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het gebruik van CO2 voor faunabeheer

An MP asked the state secretary whether CO2 gassing of geese should be allowed for population control and whether a temporary exemption could be granted, given crop damage and the stalled goose agreement. The government agreed CO2 is the most acceptable method but refused a temporary exemption because crop and nature damage does not meet the Biocides Regulation's health or environment threshold, and said the EU approval timeline cannot be influenced.
Combating geese because of nuisance to fields, meadows and nature does not fall under this definition and therefore does not qualify for an exemption.
Het bestrijden van ganzen vanwege overlast voor akkers, velden en natuur valt niet onder deze definitie en komt derhalve niet in aanmerking voor een vrijstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over problemen met zeugen in groepen

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of high abortion rates in group-housed sows, whether the four-day group-housing rule should be scrapped, and whether enforcement should be suspended pending a lawsuit and studies. The State Secretary answers that causes are multifactorial and unknown, keeps the rule, offers guidance to problem farms, and refuses to suspend enforcement.
There are no grounds for this, neither of a policy nor of a legal nature.
Er zijn hiervoor geen redenen, noch van beleidsmatige noch van juridische aard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Schouw over bacteriën zonder vijand

MPs Van Gerven and Schouw asked the ministers about carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE) in the food chain, monitoring, zero-tolerance policy, the role of intensive livestock farming and incentives for new antibiotics. The minister answered that food monitoring since 2011 found no CRE, that RIVM was asked for an integrated advice within three months, and that pull incentives such as patent extension will be explored with the European Commission.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de fiscale vrijstelling voor (agrarisch) natuurbeheer

An MP asked whether subsidies under the SNL and SKNL nature schemes are exempt from income and corporation tax, whether agrarian nature management is covered, and whether farmers and reed cultivators face tax or VAT liabilities. The State Secretary confirmed a tax exemption limited to landscape management, said the government intends to continue it if the European Commission approves, refused a dedicated exemption for other agrarian nature management, and declined to confirm VAT exemption in all cases.
I cannot provide that at present. I undertake to inform your House further before the new agrarian nature management system is introduced.
Dat kan ik momenteel niet geven. Ik zeg toe dat ik uw Kamer voor het invoeren van het nieuwe stelsel van agrarisch natuurbeheer nader zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over geweld tegen Australisch exportvee in Gaza

An MP asked the Dutch government whether it knows of videos showing extreme violence against Australian export cattle in Gaza, whether Dutch live animals are exported there, and whether it will press Gaza and Australian counterparts to act. The government confirmed the videos, stated that no live cattle are exported directly from the Netherlands to Gaza because no veterinary certificate exists, declined official contact with Gaza under its no-contact policy, and said Australia must make its own decision.
No live cattle are exported directly from the Netherlands to Gaza, because the Netherlands has not agreed a veterinary export certificate with Gaza.
Er worden vanuit Nederland in directe zin geen levende runderen naar Gaza geëxporteerd omdat Nederland geen veterinair exportcertificaat is overeengekomen met Gaza.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de (illegale) aanleg van bedrijventerrein Baanstee Noord in het leefgebied van beschermde diersoorten als de steenuil en de kerkuil

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the alleged illegal construction of the Baanstee Noord business park in habitat of protected owl species, following a court ruling requiring an exemption procedure, and why the government appealed. The State Secretary answered that the municipality's measures (nest boxes and new habitat) guaranteed ecological functionality so no exemption was needed, that appeal was made because of precedent concerns, and that the nature law bill addresses such cases.
According to settled case law, no exemption under the Flora and Fauna Act is needed if measures are taken that guarantee the lasting ecological functionality of a breeding or resting place.

Naar vaste rechtspraak is geen ontheffing op grond van de Flora- en faunawet nodig indien maatregelen worden genomen die de blijvende ecologische functionaliteit van een broed- of rustplaats garanderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het gebruik van de geboortekrik

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the use of calving jacks (geboortekrik) in cattle births, which is banned, including whether it is used illegally, whether enforcement occurs, and whether difficult births and calf mortality are rising. The government answered that use is hard to detect, no enforcement action was taken in the past twelve months, difficult births have fallen, and it intends to regulate use with conditions for users and equipment.
Use of a calving jack is difficult to establish and check, because it can only be detected in the act.
Het gebruik van een veeverlosser is lastig te constateren en te controleren, omdat dit alleen op heterdaad kan gebeuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het vangen van duiven in Amsterdam

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about a pigeon-catching operation in Amsterdam, including whether the licence conditions were met and whether the licence should be withdrawn. The State Secretary declines to answer the questions substantively, citing an ongoing police investigation and a pending enforcement request, and promises to inform the House once the investigation is concluded.
While the investigation is ongoing, I will not disclose information about this case.
Lopende het onderzoek breng ik geen informatie over deze zaak naar buiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over Natura 2000-complementaire doelen

An MP asked whether provinces may pursue complementary Natura 2000 nature goals outside the designation decrees and whether permits can be refused on such goals, citing a motion. The Secretary of State replied that designation decrees contain no complementary goals, provinces may pursue additional nature policy within management plans, and the draft Nature Conservation Act removes non-Habitat/Bird-directive objectives so permits concern only designated objectives.
The designation decrees contain no complementary goals.
De aanwijzingsbesluiten bevatten geen complementaire doelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de tijgermug en de Aziatische bosmug

An MP from the SP asked the Health and Economic Affairs ministers about tiger mosquito imports via used tyres and Lucky bamboo, the VACO covenant, and the Asian bush mosquito. The minister replied that the policy targets the highest-risk pathways, that self-regulation via a covenant is used for tyre importers, and that the Asian bush mosquito is not a relevant disease vector in practice and cannot feasibly be eradicated.
My policy focuses on the greatest risks of introduction and spread of tiger mosquitoes in the Netherlands.
Mijn beleid richt zich op de grootste risico’s van introductie en verspreiding van tijgermuggen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Rutte over hondsdolheid

VVD MPs Heerema and Rutte asked whether rabies poses a risk in the Netherlands, whether current policy is adequate, and whether imports of dogs from Eastern Europe and Morocco should be restricted. The State Secretary answered that Nederland is adequately prepared, that the current euthanasia, vaccination and prophylaxis policy is sufficient, and that she will consider lifting the exemption for unvaccinated puppies under three months and will write to the House early 2014.
Early 2014 I will inform you in a letter in more detail about the measures I am going to take.
Begin 2014 zal ik u in een brief nader informeren over de maatregelen die ik ga nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de angorawolproductie

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the treatment of rabbits in angora wool production, the share of Chinese imports, a possible national import ban, and labelling rules. The State Secretary condemned the practice, reported EU import volumes, said the government would consult on possible actions, and confirmed that EU regulation already requires angora labelling.
Statistics on global production of angora wool are not known.
Statistieken over de wereldwijde productie van angorawol zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Recourt over de vestiging van een nieuwe nertsenhouderij in Gemert

MPs Van Dekken and Recourt asked about a new mink farm in Gemert that appears to expand or relocate mink farming despite the 2013 ban, and about distance rules and whether such expansion is undesirable. The government answered that the relocation is permitted if animal numbers do not increase, that the permit is under appeal, and that the NVWA will check compliance on site.
The NVWA monitors the standards of the Fur Animal Farming Ban Act and will determine whether specific situations fit within the purpose and scope of that Act.
De NVWA controleert de normen uit de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij en zal constateren of specifieke situaties binnen doel en strekking van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het handhaven van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij

An SP MP asked whether the Dutch food authority NVWA and the Dienst Regelingen enforce the fur-farming ban, and why a municipality reported that enforcement was being held back pending court challenges. The state secretary answered that enforcement is ongoing, with 17 inspections and one proces-verbaal, denied that municipalities were told not to enforce, and said unlawful expansions are checked against the 15 January 2013 baseline.
The quotation you cite does not give a correct account of the NVWA's enforcement policy.
Het door u opgevoerde citaat geeft geen correcte weergave van het handhavingsbeleid van de NVWA.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het uitbreiden in oppervlakte van bestaande Natura 2000-gebieden

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs who is responsible for enlarging Natura 2000 areas such as Engbertsdijkvenen, Willinks Weust and Lopikerwaard, on what legal basis, and what the local economic effects are. The State Secretary answered that the Minister of Economic Affairs decides on designation under the Nature Conservation Act with public participation, that boundaries change only on ecological criteria, and that economic effects cannot be considered at the designation stage but may be in management plans.
The competence to adopt the designation decisions lies with the minister responsible for Economic Affairs.
De bevoegdheid van het vaststellen van de aanwijzingsbesluiten ligt bij de bewindspersoon van Economische Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over Visserij Partnerschapsakkoorden

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs how many EU fisheries partnership agreements have been concluded in the past ten years, what framework guides Dutch positions on them, how Dutch fishers' interests are weighed, and how the Netherlands handles agreements where it has no direct interest. The State Secretary answered that most of the 20 agreements predate ten years, that Dutch positions are tested against EU external fisheries standards including sustainability, human rights clauses and local benefit, and that the same framework applies regardless of Dutch direct interest, with a parliamentary reservation used on new protocols.
When discussing a new protocol or a new negotiating mandate, the Netherlands routinely enters a parliamentary reservation.
Nederland tekent bij de bespreking van een nieuw protocol of een nieuw onderhandelingsmandaat standaard een parlementair voorbehoud aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het jagen op vossen in het donker

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Minister of Security and Justice about Council of State rulings that the Benelux treaty bans night hunting and artificial light in fox management, and how many provincial exemptions exist and whether they will be revoked. The State Secretary confirmed the rulings, said two exemptions were annulled and others are in court, and referred to a letter of 6 December 2013 for the remaining questions.
Two of those exemptions were annulled last Wednesday.
Twee van die ontheffingen zijn afgelopen woensdag vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Dikkers en Wolbert over de uitbreiding van een melkveebedrijf in Coevorden naar 1.900 koeien

MPs Van Dekken, Dikkers and Wolbert asked the state secretary about a dairy farm expansion in Coevorden to 1,900 cows, its health and environmental impact, consistency with the cabinet's livestock scale position, whether the province can block it, and whether abolishing milk quotas will drive similar expansions. The state secretary answered that environmental permitting is a matter for province and municipality, that a new Wet Dieren provision will let them set health-based limits on livestock size, and that no data exist on the number of farms with expansion plans.
Provinces and municipalities can, under the Spatial Planning Act, for example set a maximum on stable size and impose restrictions on the establishment or expansion of livestock farms.

Provincies en gemeenten kunnen op basis van de Wet ruimtelijke ordening bijvoorbeeld een maximum stellen aan de stalgrootte en beperkingen opleggen aan de vestiging of uitbreiding van veehouderijbedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de afname van mineralengehaltes in gras door het mestbeleid

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether tighter manure-application standards have reduced mineral and protein content in grass, forcing dairy farmers to buy mineral supplements, and whether the Netherlands should press the European Commission for more room for circular farming. The State Secretary acknowledged the analysis but rejected the claim that circular farming is viable on dairy farms, citing environmental goals, and offered manure processing support as the remedy.
I welcome initiatives that lead to a larger share of the animal manure produced being put to useful application within Dutch agriculture.
Ik juich initiatieven toe die er toe leiden dat een groter deel van de geproduceerde dierlijke mest binnen de Nederlandse landbouw een nuttige toepassing vindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over genetisch gemodificeerd voedsel

An ChristenUnie MP asked, after a report that many consumers are unaware whether they buy genetically modified food, about the share of unaware consumers, the number of GM-labelled products on the Dutch market, and whether labelling should be improved. The minister answered that labelling already guarantees consumer choice, that surveys are not reliable indicators of purchasing, and that the government sees no need for changes beyond existing rules and Voedingscentrum information.
The mandatory labelling of foodstuffs containing GMOs, consisting wholly or partly of GMOs or produced with GMOs guarantees consumers' freedom of choice.
De verplichte etikettering van voedingsmiddelen die GGO’s bevatten, geheel of gedeeltelijk uit GGO’s bestaan of met GGO’s zijn geproduceerd, waarborgt de keuzevrijheid van consumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de goudvisindustrie

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about welfare conditions for ornamental goldfish in breeding, air transport, sedation, retail housing and sales volumes, following a Keuringsdienst van Waarde broadcast. The State Secretary answered that transport is governed by IATA rules and NVWA enforcement, that volumes and origins are not registered, and that new pet-trade rules and buyer information will improve welfare.
The origin and the species are not registered.
De herkomst en de soorten worden niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht Broedvogels verdwijnen uit Oostvaardersplassen

MP Heerema asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether she knows the report that breeding birds are disappearing from the Oostvaardersplassen, whether grazing pressure by large herbivores explains it, and whether population management should be tightened. The State Secretary says the trends are local to the dry part of the area, that the large grazers were introduced deliberately to favour grass-eating waterbirds, that the grazer population has declined for two years under the existing early-reactive management, and that no tightening is needed.
No. Based on the Gabor advisory report from 2010, Staatsbosbeheer applies so-called early-reactive management.
Nee. Op basis van het advies-Gabor uit 2010 past Staatsbosbeheer zogeheten vroeg-reactief beheer toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Dikkers over ziektes bij dieren door mest in stallen

MPs Van Dekken and Dikkers asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about animal illnesses caused by manure and ammonia in stables, citing a Wakker Dier study and asking about antibiotic use, housing standards and measures to reduce harm. The State Secretary disputed the study's one-to-one causal links, said no structured comparison of housing systems exists, pointed to farmers' responsibility and existing rules, and listed measures such as a stricter ammonia standard in 2014 and a UDD antibiotic regulation.
The Wakker Dier study is a collection of quotes from various studies.
Het onderzoek van Wakker Dier betreft een verzameling van quotes uit verschillende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Lodders over het bericht Drenthe schort verlenen vergunning op

MPs Heerema and Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Drenthe provincial executive's decision to suspend livestock permits near Natura 2000 areas until 1 February 2014, and whether the Groenmanifest framework was working. The State Secretary defended the suspension as prudent to check ecological and economic interests remain in balance, said the framework had enabled many permits, and pointed to the PAS as the longer-term solution.
I consider it sensible of the Drenthe Provincial Executive to temporarily suspend permit issuance in order to investigate whether nature and economic interests are still in balance.
Ik vind het verstandig van Gedeputeerde Staten van Drenthe dat ze de vergunningverlening tijdelijk opschort om te onderzoeken of de natuurbelangen en economische belangen nog in evenwicht zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over de essentaksterfte van 24 oktober 2013

Member Geurts (CDA) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about ash dieback (essentaksterfte), its threat to Dutch trees and landscape, and whether the government would fund or support research after the Productschap Tuinbouw stopped financing it. The State Secretary answered that only removing affected trees is currently possible, that the sector and tree growers should take the lead, that international research is supported, and that the nursery sector is expected to finance the research itself.
I am aware of ash dieback and recognise that the ash is an important tree species in our country for urban green, forest, nature and landscape.
Ik ben bekend met de essentaksterfte en besef dat de es een belangrijke boomsoort is in ons land voor het stedelijk groen, bos, natuur en landschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Natuurbeschermingswetvergunningverlening in Drenthe

MP Ouwehand asks the State Secretary about Drenthe granting 214 Nature Conservation Act permits in 2013 under the Groenmanifest, possibly exhausting nitrogen headroom before the PAS is in force, and whether the province is too lax. The State Secretary answers that none were tested by the Council of State, the province has suspended the Groenmanifest until 1 February 2014, and the PAS, like the Groenmanifest, uses a 'hand on the tap' principle, with detailed figures to follow in the draft PAS programme.
Given the large number of permit applications, the province of Drenthe decided to pause and suspend the Groenmanifest until 1 February 2014.
Naar aanleiding van het grote aantal vergunningaanvragen heeft provincie Drenthe besloten een pas op de plaats te maken en het Groenmanifest tot 1 februari 2014 op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Geurts over vergunning blijft struikelblok mestverwerking

Two MPs asked whether the failure of permit granting for manure processing plants should affect the manure rights system and whether the government would evaluate or abolish it. The State Secretary said a national working group on speeding permits with the provinces and municipalities has been set up, a complaints point opened, and she will not abolish manure rights but will evaluate the Meststoffenwet annually.
I intend to evaluate the Meststoffenwet annually after its introduction on the objectives achieved.
Ik heb het voornemen om de meststoffenwet na invoering jaarlijks te evalueren op de behaalde doelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer waaruit blijkt dat bijna 3 miljard euro aan landbouwsubsidies onterecht is uitgekeerd

The MP asked about a European Court of Auditors report finding nearly 3 billion euro in wrongly paid agricultural subsidies, and whether Dutch money is affected, who pays corrections, and how agri-environment payments are checked. The State Secretary answered that Dutch funds were not sampled, the Dutch error margin is within the 2% tolerance, recovery of about 8 million euro a year is pursued, and at least 5% of agri-environment agreements are checked on site.
The European Court of Auditors report is based on representative samples in the member states.
Het rapport van de Europese Rekenkamer is gebaseerd op representatieve steekproeven in de lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het verzoek om extra stikstof in spruiten

MP Lodders (VVD) asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether LTO's request for an extra nitrogen dose for Brussels sprouts growers after heavy rainfall is being considered, and whether a 60 mm rainfall threshold applied in past such requests. The State Secretary answered that the request will be included in talks with the European Commission on the fifth Nitrates action programme, that no minimum rainfall threshold has ever been set, and that a proposed calamity scheme would make such requests unnecessary.
LTO has requested that an extra dose be permitted; no amount was specified.
LTO heeft gevraagd om een extra gift toe te staan; een hoeveelheid is niet genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Bosman, De Liefde en Rudmer Heerema over nationale koppen ten aanzien van Europese regelgeving op het gebied van landbouw, natuur en visserij

MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs for an overview of stricter-than-EU national rules (nationale koppen) affecting farmers, growers and fishers, including their regulatory-burden effects and planned reductions under the coalition agreement. The government answered that the overview was sent in September 2013 and a sector-specific regulatory-burden approach for agro and food is underway, with a table of measures and their burden effects, and no full list of nationale koppen per directive was given beyond the inventory of current rules.
Progress on the ambition to reduce regulatory burden by 2.5 billion euro by 2017 is reported to the House twice a year.
Over de voortgang ten aanzien van de ambitie om de regeldruk per 2017 met 2,5 miljard euro te verminderen wordt uw Kamer twee maal per jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Jacobi over de veiligheid van mestsilo’s

MPs Dikkers and Jacobi asked about the safety of manure silos after a fatal accident in Makkinga, including the adequacy of rules, inspection practices and comparison with neighbouring countries. The minister answered that current rules are adequate, pending the Safety Board's investigation, and that a reaction will be sent to Parliament after publication.
In my view, the current regulations for manure silos and manure gases are adequate.
Mijns inziens is de huidige regelgeving voor mestsilo's en mestgassen adequaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over de mogelijkheid om hagelkanonnen in te zetten om de oogst te beschermen

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked whether anti-hail cannons may be used by fruit growers and whether municipalities should decide, and how enforcement by fines should be handled. The state secretary said the balancing of crop protection against noise nuisance is a local decision for municipalities, that no national rule or exception is appropriate, and that enforcement is up to the municipality.
The balancing of interests for the use of the anti-hail cannon must take place at the local level.
De belangenafweging voor het gebruik van het antihagelkanon dient op lokaal niveau plaats te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de zware gevolgen voor agrarische ondernemers door de nieuwe stikstof- en nitraatnormen

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the severe effects of tighter nitrogen and nitrate manure standards on farmers, including yield losses, soil fertility and competitiveness. The State Secretary replies that the measures are targeted, that yield losses of 10 to 50 percent are not expected (WUR calculates a maximum of 6 to 7 percent), that some norms will be raised, and that an equivalence route will allow farmers to request exemptions from 2015.

I offer initiatives that can demonstrate, through scientific underpinning and adequate safeguards, that other measures achieve an equivalent environmental result the opportunity, from 2015, to apply for an exemption from the generic use standards.

Ik bied initiatieven die door wetenschappelijke onderbouwing en adequate borging kunnen aantonen en garanderen dat zij met andere maatregelen tot een equivalent milieuresultaat komen, vanaf 2015 de gelegenheid om ontheffing aan te vragen van de generieke gebruiksnormen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over over het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

An MP asked why the government drops the 95 percent margin on manure excretion factors and what this means for Dutch farmers under the Nitrates Directive action programme. The Secretary of State answered that the margin understated manure production, so the factor moves to 100 percent from 1 January 2014, with updated standard values likely from 2015 and no retroactive effect.
I am not aware of any other member state that applies less than 100 percent.
Mij is niet bekend dat enige andere lidstaat minder dan 100 procent inrekent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doden van honden in Roemenië

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and the Foreign Minister about Romania's law permitting mass killing of stray dogs and whether the government will raise it with Romania. The government replied that decisions are made case by case by local authorities, that euthanasia must be performed by a vet using a quick, painless method, and that Dutch NGOs can be put in contact with Romanian authorities.
It is for the Romanian authorities to formulate policy in compliance with European and international regulations.
Het is aan de Roemeense autoriteiten om beleid te formuleren met in achtneming van Europese en internationale regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het ontnemen van het predicaat ‘Koninklijk’ wegens gecoupeerde paardenstaarten

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the Royal Dutch Heavy Horse and Haflinger association keeping its royal title despite members widely docking horses' tails, and about possible evasion via France, breeding-register recognition, and calls to revoke the title. The government answered that the association meets the criteria for the title and studie register recognition, that tail docking is banned by law but not a register condition, and that EU harmonisation will be pushed.
No. See my answer to question 4.
Nee. Zie mijn antwoord op vraag 4.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat voedingsfabrikanten niet gestraft worden voor het plaatsen van misleidende informatie op etiketten

An MP asked the health and economics ministers why food manufacturers face few penalties for misleading labels, how enforcement capacity was increased, who is liable in the chain, and why the NVWA issued only 45 fines from 143 violations. The minister acknowledged that labels cannot be guaranteed fully accurate, described enforcement reprioritisation and planned higher fine ceilings and publication of inspection data.
In addition, I intend to double the fines for violations under the Commodities Act.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens de boetes voor overtredingen in het kader van de Warenwet te verdubbelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat er teveel landbouwgif op groente en fruit zit

An MP asked the ministers whether the legal pesticide residue limits (MRLs) on fruit and vegetables are unsafe, as reported by Milieudefensie, Foodwatch and TROS Radar, and what is being done about it. The minister acknowledges that some MRLs permit intake above the acute reference dose, says Nederland is pushing for revision in Brussels, and argues the share of unsafe MRLs is well below 10% with the actual health risk very small.
I consider the existence of such MRLs undesirable.
Ik vind het bestaan van dergelijke MRL's onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Dekken over aanhoudende overtredingen van het verbod op het verloten van dieren

MPs Ouwehand and Van Dekken asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why animals such as horses, ponies, calves and pigeons are still being raffled despite the legal ban, whether enforcement and penalties will be tightened, and how the ban is enforced. The State Secretary acknowledged the violations, said existing tools (compliance orders with penalty payments and criminal action) are sufficient, confirmed repeated administrative action against the Assendelft riding-school owner, and reported five compliance orders and one warning since 2011 but no permanent monitoring of all sites.
I have sufficient possibilities to act against the raffling of animals.
Ik heb voldoende mogelijkheden om tegen het verloten van dieren op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat Franse wijnen vol gif zitten

An MP asked the health and economic affairs ministers whether a Belgian report that French wines contain pesticide residues poses health risks in the Netherlands, and what the government will do. The minister answered that NVWA testing shows no health risk, that existing EU residue limits for grapes apply to wine, and that no further action is planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over seleenvergiftiging bij zeugen en de volksgezondheidsrisico’s bij de consumptie van varkensvlees

An MP asked about possible selenium poisoning in sows, excessive selenium use in pig feed and public health risks from pork, and whether intensive sow breeding endangers animal welfare. The minister replied that there are no signs of widespread overdosing, that the two farm cases were isolated and within the legal limit, and that existing projects address sow longevity and welfare.
I have no indications that selenium is excessively administered to sows on a large scale.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat selenium op grote schaal overmatig aan zeugen wordt toegediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dikkers over de prijzenoorlog tussen de supermarkten

An MP asked whether farmers are bearing the cost of the supermarket price war and what instruments the state has to protect primary producers' income. The state secretary acknowledged the concern, pointed to the new voluntary EU/Dutch fair trading code pilot with complaint and arbitration procedures, and said sustainability is the sector's own responsibility.
I consider it important that negotiations between parties in the agri-food chain take place transparently so that a fair price results.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er op transparante wijze tussen partijen in de agroketen wordt onderhandeld en dat zo een eerlijke prijs ontstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het plankgasplannetje op de A2

MP Ouwehand (PvdD) asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs why the minister of Infrastructure and Environment's claims about raising the A2 speed limit to 130 km/h were not coordinated with her, whether the nitrogen reduction under the PAS can deliver what was promised, and when nature will have recovered enough for the speed increase. The state secretary replied that the earlier answers were given on behalf of the cabinet, that preliminary AERIUS calculations suggest little impact on nitrogen, that the PAS will be substantiated when the draft programme is published, and that nature recovery timing is covered by the PAS.
The draft PAS programme will be made available for public inspection.
Het conceptprogramma PAS zal ter inzage worden gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het houden van haaien in een discotheek

MP Ouwehand asked whether sharks kept in a discotheque aquarium in Arnhem comply with animal welfare law, whether the NVWA inspected before opening, and whether the state will act. The state secretary confirmed the aquarium, reported a September inspection finding no animal suffering or violation and no legal basis for seizure, and referred to earlier answers for the remaining questions.
The NVWA was unable to establish animal suffering, and therefore also no violation.
De NVWA heeft geen dierenkwelling kunnen vaststellen, en daarmee ook geen overtreding.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de schimmelinfectie die de vuursalamander bedreigt

MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about a chytrid fungus threatening the fire salamander, including its spread, possible spillover to other amphibians, and funding for multi-year research and protection. The state secretary agreed the findings are important and said she is taking stock of research priorities with researchers and managers and is willing to contribute financially, without committing to a specific multi-year study or timetable.
I am taking stock, with the researchers and managers involved, of the priorities for further research and remedial measures.
Ik inventariseer met betrokken onderzoekers en beheerders de prioriteiten voor verder onderzoek en remediërende maatregelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over Canadese en Nederlandse robotvogels

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs whether a trial with robotic birds (drones) to deter geese and gulls, as used in Ottawa, would be organised in the Netherlands, and why robirds are no longer used at Schiphol. The government answered that Schiphol's experiments in 2008-2009 were ended because results were insufficient, since the robot bird was hard to fit into airport bird-control operations, could not operate in wind or rain, and only worked on airport grounds.
The experiments were ended because the results were not sufficient.
De experimenten werden beëindigd omdat de resultaten niet voldoende waren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over kasteelheren die natuurorganisaties 40.000 hectare natuur afhandig willen maken

An SP MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about proposals by large landowners to take 40,000 hectares of nature from nature organisations, and whether nature is a public good and whether tendering should be reintroduced. The state secretary said the matter is primarily between the VGG and nature managers, that nature is a shared public responsibility, that no evidence shows private management is less efficient, and that equal treatment of private nature managers is the government's starting point; she also said no tendering is used yet and provinces decide how to proceed.

This wish of the Association for Equal Rights of Landowners is primarily a matter between the VGG and the land-managing organisations, because the government cannot intervene in private property relations.

Deze wens van de Vereniging Gelijkberechtiging Grondbezitters is primair een zaak tussen de VGG en de terreinbeherende organisaties, omdat de overheid niet kan treden in private eigendomsverhoudingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Rudmer Heerema over het bericht «Grond natuurclubs moet in de verkoop; Een à twee miljard ten onrechte verkregen subsidies»

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports that nature organisations must sell land acquired with allegedly unlawful state aid, the EU General Court ruling on German TBO subsidies, and whether equal treatment of private landowners functions. The State Secretary answered that the EU complaint concerns 1998–2008 and is undecided, the court ruling concerns only Germany, equal treatment is anchored in the Natuurpact, and she will raise its application in the annual consultation with provinces.
It is important to stress that the Court's ruling concerns only the German situation and not the Dutch situation.
Het is goed te benadrukken dat de uitspraak van het Gerecht enkel ziet op de Duitse situatie en niet op de Nederlandse situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over vernieling van proefvelden met aardappelen in Valthermond en de gemeente Eemsmond

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and justice minister about vandalised potato trial fields of Wageningen University in Valthermond and Eemsmond, including effects on blight-resistance research, prevention, penalties and recovery of damage, and group involvement and prosecution statistics. The government condemned the vandalism, said the research has not been significantly delayed, described cameras and resilience measures, outlined the maximum penalty and civil recovery routes, and stated that perpetrators have not been identified and protest groups are not registered.
Despite police efforts on this case, because the vandals acted extremely covertly, it has so far not been possible to trace those responsible for these incidents.
Ondanks de inzet van de politie op dit dossier is het vanwege het uiterst heimelijke optreden door de vernielers vooralsnog niet gelukt in verband met deze gevallen verantwoordelijken op te sporen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en de Liefde over een schadelijk buitenlands fruitvliegje dat de Nederlandse fruitoogst bedreigt

MPs Lodders and De Liefde asked why the government was slow to grant an exemption for a biological pesticide against the harmful spotted-wing drosophila fruit fly and what it will do to act faster. The state secretary answered that the fly is spreading in the Netherlands, that the exemption for Tracer was requested in March and has now been granted for the affected crops, and did not commit to further specific reforms.
The agent has now been exempted for the mentioned crops.
Het middel is inmiddels vrijgesteld voor de genoemde gewassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Geurts en Dijkgraaf over de Nederlandse inzet inzake het vijfde actieprogramma Nitraatrichtlijn

Dutch MPs from VVD, CDA and SGP asked the state secretaries about the Dutch negotiating position on the fifth Nitrates Directive action programme, including the 50 mg nitrate standard, phosphate norms, the derogation and the lack of sector support. The government answered that the 50 mg standard is a binding target Netherlands committed to, that equivalent measures are being developed with LTO, and that it will press the Commission on monitoring results and the derogation.

I am in consultation with LTO on a number of these measures, with a view to having the required justification and assurance in place before the nitrogen use standards for leaching-sensitive crops in the southern sand and loess region are lowered on 1 January 2015.

Ik ben met LTO in overleg over een aantal van deze maatregelen met het oog op het beschikbaar hebben van de vereiste onderbouwing en borging voordat op 1 januari 2015 de stikstofgebruiksnormen voor uitspoelingsgevoelige gewassen in het zuidelijke zand- en lössgebied worden verlaagd.

Vragen van het lid Van Bommel (SP) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over een nieuw protocol voor de Partnerschapsovereenkomst inzake visserij tussen de EU en Marokko (ingezonden 7 augustus

An SP MP asks the ministers whether the new EU-Morocco fisheries protocol covers waters off Western Sahara, whether it complies with international law, and whether the Sahrawi population benefits and controls the funds. The government confirms the protocol covers those waters without implying recognition of Moroccan sovereignty, says funds are conditional on agreement in the Joint Committee, and says it will seek further clarification before forming a final view.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to respond to all parts of publications.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om op alle onderdelen van publicaties te reageren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de snelle opslibbing in de Hedwigepolder, de consequenties hiervan en de kostenverdeling met het Vlaams Gewest

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about rapid silting of the Hedwigepolder after de-poldering, whether high salt marshes would replace the desired low dynamic intertidal area, the consequences for Natura 2000 targets, and Flemish cost-sharing. The State Secretary answered that the project creates estuarine habitats that expand the Natura 2000 target area, that monitoring will determine whether additional measures are needed, and referred to the treaty for Flemish financial obligations.
The financial obligations of the Flemish Region are laid down in the Treaty on the implementation of the Ontwikkelingsschets 2010.
De financiële verplichtingen van het Vlaams Gewest zijn vastgelegd in het Verdrag betreffende de uitvoering van de Ontwikkelingsschets 2010.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de sloop van flats in Hoensbroek zonder ontheffing

An MP asked the state secretary whether the municipality of Heerlen would demolish flats in Hoensbroek without the required wildlife exemption protecting house sparrows and swifts, and whether enforcement would follow. The state secretary answered that Heerlen has committed to applying for the exemption for these species before starting demolition, so the state secretary expects the legal rules to be followed.
I assume, following the commitments of the municipality of Heerlen, that the legal rules will be observed.
Ik ga er, na de toezeggingen van de gemeente Heerlen, van uit dat de wettelijke regels in acht genomen zullen worden.

Vragen van de leden Thieme (PvdD) en Van Dekken (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over het toestaan van de export van jonge kalveren (9–12–26 weken) naar Turkije (ingezonden 22 augustus 2013).

MPs Thieme and Van Dekken asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about animal welfare problems on livestock transports to Turkey and whether export of young veal calves to Turkey would be permitted. The state secretary answered that no export of mestkalveren to Turkey is being pursued, no Dutch health certificate has been agreed, no ethics commission was set up, and transports of cattle stopped after August 2012.
I can only inform your House about data on transports from the Netherlands.
Ik kan uw Kamer alleen informeren over gegevens van transporten vanuit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het bericht ‘Verdienen aan eieren zit er voorlopig niet in’

An MP asked the state secretary about egg farmers in financial distress after the battery-cage ban, unequal enforcement and imports from third countries, and whether the Ingrepenbesluit should be brought forward. The state secretary attributed the problems to a temporary market disruption, refused to delay the ban, proposed bringing forward the beak-trimming ban to 2018, and said she would push for an EU-wide ban on procedures.
My aim is to achieve animal-friendly and economically sound poultry farming with, in principle, as few or no procedures as possible.
Mijn doel is om te komen tot een diervriendelijke en economisch verantwoorde pluimveehouderij met in beginsel zo min mogelijk of geen ingrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over bijsluiters bij diergeneesmiddelen

MP Thieme asked the state secretary whether owners buying veterinary medicines receive no package leaflet, and whether leaflets should be mandatory as for human medicines to fight antibiotic resistance. The state secretary replied that leaflets are mandatory and must contain all relevant information, and that a leaflet may only be omitted if the information is already on the packaging, including when medicines are repackaged.
A package leaflet is mandatory and may only be omitted when all relevant information is already on the primary and outer packaging.
Een bijsluiter is verplicht en mag alleen achterwege gelaten worden wanneer alle relevante informatie al op de primaire en op de buitenverpakking is aangebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht dat boeren in 2012 nog steeds veel antibiotica gebruikten

An MP asked the state secretaries whether farmers' antibiotic use remained high in 2012, why reduction stalled, and about illegal antibiotic use. The government answered that use fell about 15% in 2012 in line with the 70% target, that sectors must tackle structural high users, and that enforcement against illegal trade was intensified.
I agree with the SDa that sectors must above all focus on reducing use in this category of high users.
Ik ben het met de SDa eens dat sectoren zich met name moeten inzetten om het gebruik in deze categorie van veelgebruikers terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het verjagen van herten met gemeenschapsgeld in de Hierdense Poort

MP Thieme asks why community money (EUR 5,000 from the province of Gelderland) is paid to a hunting unit to chase red deer away from a wildlife overpass, and whether the overpass should be closed to deer and the province held to account under the Flora and Fauna Act. The State Secretary replies that the payment is a one-off support measure to build goodwill and prevent damage, that ecoducts are important for biodiversity but deer should be chased from farmland, and that she sees no violation or need to amend the code.
No, I do not share this view. The province implements nature policy, including by reconnecting nature areas through ecoducts.
Nee, deze mening deel ik niet. De provincie geeft uitvoering aan natuurbeleid, onder andere door het (weer) verbinden van (natuur)gebieden door ecoducten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en De Vries over de bereikbaarheid van de jachthaven van Schiermonnikoog

MPs Jacobi and De Vries asked why the Schiermonnikoog marina will not be dredged in 2013, whether Natura 2000 rules prevent dumping silt for salt-marsh creation, and whether silt disposal can be restored. The minister explains the municipality stopped unpermitted dumping, its 2009 permit was refused for lack of information, and that options including a Rijkswaterstaat disposal arrangement are being explored, with clarity expected in autumn.
In the autumn, more clarity will emerge on this.
In het najaar ontstaat hierover meer duidelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het uitzetten van edelherten in klein omhekt gebied

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about releasing red deer into a small fenced area in Noord-Brabant, questioning whether the herd is viable, whether it counts as release under the Flora and Fauna Act, the provincial role, and the biodiversity claims. The State Secretary answered that the animals are kept rather than released, that captive-bred deer fall under a statutory exemption, that the provincial policy is autonomous, and that low deer density can benefit biodiversity.
There is no question of release here but of keeping red deer.
Er is hier geen sprake van uitzetten maar van het houden van edelherten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de exportpositie naar Rusland na de uitbraak van vogelgriep

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs why Russia banned poultry exports from the whole province of Utrecht after a low-pathogenic avian influenza outbreak, whether the narrower municipal restriction was formally agreed, and how to secure binding terms with the Customs Union. The state secretary confirmed the province-wide ban, said Russia had orally agreed to limit restrictions to the municipality and later confirmed this in writing for the Tzum outbreak, and committed to continued efforts on exports.
Following the latest LPAI outbreak in Tzum, Russia has confirmed in writing that import restrictions will only be imposed on the municipality of Franekeradeel.
Inmiddels heeft Rusland naar aanleiding van de laatste LPAI uitbraak in Tzum schriftelijk bevestigd dat alleen importbeperkende maatregelen worden genomen voor de gemeente Franekeradeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over stopzetten diervriendelijke aanpak zwerfkattenprobleem terwijl jacht op katten blijft toegestaan

An MP asks why the state secretary froze new exemptions for the Trap-Neuter-Return method for stray cats while provinces still authorise shooting cats, and questions the rejection of an identification and registration duty for cats. The secretary answers that exemptions are under review for effectiveness, no new ones are issued pending results, and that culling permission and cat-policy choices lie with provinces.
Granting permission to shoot stray cats is a responsibility of the provinces.
Het verlenen van toestemming voor afschieten van zwerfkatten is een verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het serveren van de beschermde spreeuw

An MP asked the state secretary whether a Utrecht restaurant serving protected starling should be stopped, whether the species' decline warrants removing it from the pest-control list, and whether pest-control exemptions create a perverse incentive for commercial hunting. The state secretary answered that the starling stays on the list because it is still common and can cause local damage, that commercial use of protected species is undesirable, that the existing law already requires no satisfactory alternatives, and that enforcement against the restaurant is for the province.
It is up to the province to take enforcement action.
Het is aan de provincie om handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het dumpen van hondjes

An MP asks the State Secretary whether dumping puppies in water (Voorburg, with a witness seeing the man walk away, and a nursing dog left at a supermarket) should lead to a ban on keeping animals, and what will be done to prevent such cases. The government declines to comment on the individual cases pending prosecution, but says dumping animals will be explicitly classed as animal cruelty in the draft Besluit houders van dieren, allowing a keeping ban of up to 10 years as a condition of a suspended sentence.
In general, abandoning an animal (dumping) will be explicitly classified as animal cruelty in the draft Besluit houders van dieren.
Ten algemene, wordt het zich ontdoen van een dier (dumpen) in het concept-Besluit houders van dieren expliciet aangemerkt als dierenmishandeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders, De Liefde en Ten Broeke over het importverbod van Rusland op pootaardappelen en plantmateriaal

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and the foreign trade minister about Russia's import ban on Dutch seed potatoes and plant material, asking about EU and Dutch action, WTO compliance, and how to prevent such unilateral bans. The government answered that it keeps pressing the European Commission for quick follow-up talks with Russia, supports a derogation and traceability measures, and sees no WTO challenge yet, while acknowledging the ban harms Dutch growers.
I will keep urging the European Commission for swift follow-up steps given the major trade interests of Dutch business.
Ik zal bij de Europese Commissie blijven aandringen op spoedige vervolgstappen gezien de grote handelsbelangen van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over de uitrijdperiode van mest

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs whether the manure spreading periods for grassland and arable land should be extended because the cold spring prevented farmers from spreading in time. The state secretary said an extension was not needed for grassland per the technical advisory committee, but she intends to extend the arable-land spreading period by two weeks to 15 September for farmers who grow cover crops.

Therefore I intend to extend the spreading period for liquid manure on arable land by two weeks until and including 15 September, on condition that the farmers concerned grow a cover crop by that last date.

Daarom ben ik voornemens de uitrijdperiode voor drijfmest op bouwland met twee weken te verlengen tot en met 15 september, onder voorwaarde dat de betreffende ondernemers uiterlijk op die laatste datum een groenbemester telen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het stikken van varkens door een kapot ventilatiesysteem

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the deaths of about 1,100 pigs after a ventilation failure at a farm in Milheeze, whether the fault went unnoticed for a day, whether earlier similar incidents occurred, and whether alarm, timing-control or outdoor-access rules should be imposed. The state secretary said the investigation is ongoing, cited three earlier pig incidents and two poultry cases, and declined to introduce mandatory alarm-logging or timing-control systems, instead promising extra summer stable-climate inspections.
The investigation into the cause of this calamity has not yet been completed, but preliminary results show that neither the emergency system nor the alarm came into operation.
Het onderzoek naar de toedracht van deze calamiteit is nog niet afgerond maar uit voorlopige resultaten blijkt dat zowel het noodsysteem als het alarm niet in werking zijn getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht: ‘kippen- en varkensstallen meest duurzaam’

An MP from the CDA asked why sustainable barns lag in dairy farming, whether open and grazing systems should count in the monitor, and how the sustainable barn investment scheme and budget cuts affect progress. The state secretary answered that the monitor covers only certified or subsidised integrally sustainable barns, that the scheme is oversubscribed, and that a sector stimulus package and an all-sustainable-new-build requirement from 2015 are planned.
For the 2014 monitor, it will be examined whether new developments in integrally sustainable barns and housing systems can be included.
Ten behoeve van de monitor 2014 wordt nagegaan of nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het terrein van integraal duurzame stallen en houderijsystemen kunnen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over Mishandeling van pony’s

An MP asked the state secretary about online videos showing women riding and mistreating undersized ponies, whether the perpetrators are Dutch, and whether enforcement against animal mistreatment should be tightened. The government confirmed it disapproves of the conduct, declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, and pointed to strengthened enforcement capacity, seeing no reason for further tightening.
A criminal investigation is currently ongoing. Due to the investigative interest, no statements can be made about the criminal investigation.
Er loopt momenteel een strafrechtelijk onderzoek. In verband met het opsporingsbelang kunnen over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het misbruiken van Braziliaanse «Moeders voor Moeders» door MSD voor vruchtbaarheidsversnellers voor de bioindustrie

MP Ouwehand asked whether MSD's use of Brazilian women's urine and pregnant mares' blood to produce the fertility drug PG600 for pig farming was misleading, and whether these animal tests should be stopped. The state secretary answered that the women were not properly informed and that the programme has been stopped, that PG600 is a licensed veterinary drug, and that she is investigating whether the horse-blood animal test licence still fits the Animal Testing Act framework.
Exact data on the number of farms using this product and the number of pigs involved are not known.
Exacte gegevens over het aantal bedrijven die dit middel gebruiken en bij hoeveel varkens zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme met betrekking tot de opgehangen ezels op Bonaire

An MP asked the state secretary about images of wild donkeys hanged in Bonaire, the status of a donkey management plan, and whether the Bonaire authority will investigate abuse. The state secretary confirmed knowing the images, said the plan's timing is unknown, and said animal welfare is the responsibility of the Bonaire public body, adding that the reports may concern goats rather than donkeys.
As indicated in the answers to questions on the welfare of donkeys on Sint Eustatius of 17 April, ensuring animal welfare is a responsibility of the public body.

Zoals aangegeven in de antwoorden op vragen over het welzijn van ezels op Sint-Eustatius van 17 april jl. is het waarborgen van het welzijn van dieren een verantwoordelijkheid van het Openbaar Lichaam.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Lodders over grondwaterzuiveringsinstallaties bij boeren

MPs Dijkstra and Lodders asked whether strict Activiteitenbesluit rules and rare discharge exemptions leave farmers with groundwater treatment installations no option but costly chemical waste disposal of brine, and whether the rules should be loosened. The state secretary replied that the rules are not stricter than the former Lozingenbesluit, that transitional rules and case-by-case maatwerkvoorschriften offer flexibility, and that no amendment is needed.
The decree gives the competent authority ample opportunities, within the appropriate frameworks, to broaden discharge possibilities case by case through a maatwerkvoorschrift.
Het besluit biedt het bevoegd gezag ruime mogelijkheden om binnen de geëigende kaders bij maatwerkvoorschrift de lozingsmogelijkheden per individueel geval te verruimen.
Vragen van het lid Dik-Faber (ChristenUnie) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over de consumptie van «Schipholganzen» (ingezonden 21 juni 2013).

MP Dik-Faber asks the state secretary whether geese killed near Schiphol for airport safety are properly used as food, whether provinces' permits require their use, where they go, and whether the government will ensure all culled geese enter the food chain and consider goose meat in sustainable procurement and food-waste talks. The state secretary replies that the geese are sold via a poulterer to restaurants and food banks, about 63% entered the human food chain this year, the rest going to animal feed, and commits to pursue maximum human use and to discuss it with provinces and the implementing agency.
This year 63% of the total number of captured geese has entered the human food chain.
Dit jaar is 63% van het totaal aantal gevangen ganzen de menselijke voedselketen ingegaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de stand van zaken met betrekking tot de vaccinatie van geiten tegen Q-koorts

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about progress on the mandatory Q-fever vaccination of goats by 1 August 2013 and whether non-compliant goat farmers would be sanctioned. The state secretary answered that only 24% of holders had vaccinated by 1 July, and that from 1 August the NVWA will impose enforcement orders, vaccinate animals itself at the owner's cost, and draw up official reports against non-compliant holders.
From 1 August 2013 the NVWA will impose an enforcement order on the holder aimed at restoring compliance, namely vaccinating the animals after all.
Vanaf 1 augustus 2013 zal de NVWA de houder een last onder bestuursdwang opleggen die is gericht op herstel van de overtreding, namelijk het alsnog vaccineren van de dieren.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over dode dieren in een Rotterdamse dierenwinkel.

An MP asked the state secretary how about a hundred dead animals could lie unnoticed for months in a Rotterdam pet shop, whether the shop had the required competence and permits, and whether sales rules and enforcement would be tightened. The state secretary confirmed the case, said enforcement relies on reports, withheld details due to an ongoing criminal investigation, and pointed to planned Besluit gezelschapsdieren rules and joint NVWA/LID enforcement from 2014 while rejecting a fixed registration of every animal and a sharp cut in sales outlets.
Because of the interest of criminal investigation, no statements can be made about the criminal investigation.
In verband met het opsporingsbelang kunnen over het strafrechtelijk onderzoek geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Van Gerven over het beschadigen en weghalen van een beverburcht door het waterschap

An SP MP asked whether the water board Peel en Maasvallei violated the Flora- and faunawet by destroying beaver dams without a permit, and what the consequences and safeguards are. The State Secretary answered that the water board acted carefully and in line with the law, that lowering and removing the dams was unavoidable to prevent flooding, and that no further consequences or new measures were planned.
The water board Peel en Maasvallei has acted in accordance with the Flora- and faunawet.
Het waterschap Peel en Maasvallei heeft conform de Flora- en faunawet gehandeld.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over bewegende lasers aan windmolenwieken in vogelgebied

An MP asked whether planned moving lasers on wind turbines at the Tweede Maasvlakte bird area had been studied for effects on migratory birds and protected colonies, and whether the state land owner would prevent nature disturbance. The state secretary answered that no such study exists yet, that the operator must show no significant harm to protected nature, and that any permit would be assessed later.
No, no research has been done on that.
Nee, daar is geen onderzoek naar gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen Jacobi over de «realisatiestrategie EHS» van de provincie Zuid-Holland waarbij natuur verkocht wordt en internationale natuurdoelen mogelijk niet gehaald worden

MP Jacobi asked whether Zuid-Holland's EHS realisation strategy, which sells land outside the revised nature network and may jeopardise international nature targets, complies with the Lenteakkoord funding and the Rijk's responsibilities. The state secretary answered that the province is responsible for its instruments and boundaries, that the Rijk remains the contact for the EU and for agricultural nature management standards, and that she sees no reason to doubt the province's approach while calling buy-back by compensated farmers undesirable in principle.
It is the responsibility of the province to determine which measures are needed to realise that ambition.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie om te bepalen welke maatregelen nodig zijn om die ambitie te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodmaaien van vogels en verwoesten van nesten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government how it reconciles mowing during the breeding season and destroying nests with the Flora and Fauna Act, whether it will ban maintenance and hunting during breeding season, and how it will improve enforcement and a code of conduct for mowing. The state secretary answered that the Act already protects nesting sites, rejected a general breeding-season ban as disproportionate, saw the Rhenoy case as an incident with local enforcement working well, and reported that an agricultural code of conduct lacked sufficient support.

No, such a ban would constitute too severe an intrusion on practice in the agricultural and timber sectors, would have only a very minimal added value compared with the current legal protection, and would therefore overshoot its goal.

Nee, een dergelijk verbod zou een te zware inbreuk vormen op de praktijk van onder andere de agrarische en de houtsector, slechts een zeer minimale meerwaarde hebben ten opzichte van de huidige wettelijke bescherming en daarmee zijn doel voorbij schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het schieten van zogende dieren

An MP asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether shooting a nursing fox, leaving her cubs orphaned, is unacceptable animal suffering and whether a hunting ban during gestation and nursing should be introduced, and whether prosecution should follow under the Flora- and Faunawet duty of care. The State Secretary answered that shooting nursing animals should be avoided and a general hunting ban is disproportionate, leaving prosecution to the Public Prosecution Service.
I do not comment on prosecuting persons in individual cases. That decision is for the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik doe geen uitspraak over het vervolgen van personen in individuele zaken. Die beslissing is aan het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de toepassing van artikel 6 van de Habitatrichtlijn

An MP from the SGP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs how Article 6 of the Habitats Directive should be applied, including whether Dutch practice wrongly equates 'natural characteristics' with site conservation objectives and whether non-qualifying bird species are covered. The state secretary answered that the two are not equated, that the case law on 'natural characteristics' is still developing, that Article 6 covers all species for which a site is designated, and that the local conservation status plays an important role.
The assumption that the 'natural characteristics' of an area and the conservation objectives formulated for that area are equated in the Netherlands is not correct.
De veronderstelling dat de «natuurlijke kenmerken» van een gebied en de voor dat gebied geformuleerde instandhoudingsdoelstellingen in Nederland aan elkaar gelijk worden gesteld is niet juist.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders over de bouwstop veehouderij in Brabant

Parliamentarian Lodders (VVD) asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about a temporary building stop for livestock farms in Brabant, the province's ambition for a careful-livestock standard, conflicting provincial decisions on reconstruction policy, and how to restore entrepreneurs' prospects. The state secretary answered that no general building stop exists (only a one-year extension for goat and sheep farms), that the national government supports the Van Doorn approach, that it does not see provincial ambitions hindering manure processing, and that reconstruction policy is now a provincial task.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het Gelderse paard

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the current status of the Gelderse paard breed, the implementation of a 2008 motion, what concrete measures are planned, and whether abolishing the Gelders-blood requirement is undesirable. The state secretary replied that research was funded and talks held with breeders, that next steps are up to the parties themselves, and that breed selection and breeding goals are a private matter for the stud book.
Determining the selection criteria and breeding objectives is a private matter for the stud books, in this case the KWPN.
Het bepalen van de selectiecriteria en fokdoelen is een private aangelegenheid van de stamboeken, in dit geval het KWPN.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de komst van een mega-melkveebedrijf in Oploo

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and the health minister about a mega dairy farm in Oploo, the public health risks flagged by the GGD report, and whether further Health Council research is needed. The government replied that the municipality has taken the GGD's recommendations into account, adopted a stricter odour distance norm and a monitoring system, and commissioned a 3.4 million euro RIVM study on health effects of livestock farming.
As indicated in the letter of 14 June to your House, I have commissioned additional research into the quantitative health effects of livestock farming
Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 14 juni jl. aan uw Kamer heb ik opdracht gegeven voor het uitvoeren van aanvullend onderzoek naar de kwantitatieve gezondheidseffecten van veehouderijen
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over het bericht ‘Intensieve veehouderij in Achtkarspelen: een bedreiging voor de volksgezondheid’

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Health about public health concerns over intensive livestock farming in Achtkarspelen, including fine dust, odour, and municipal expansion despite provincial policy. The government said responsibility for expansion lies with the local authority, pointed to the restrictive national policy and provincial interim rules, and committed to a new RIVM study and a possible knowledge platform.
Responsibility for decisions on any expansion lies with the local competent authority.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor beslissingen aangaande de eventuele uitbreiding ligt bij het lokaal bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Klaver over het bericht “Fraude voedsel niet gemeld”

An MP asked whether food fraud is rarely reported to the NVWA, how it will monitor fraud, whether budget cuts reduce inspections, when the traffic-light disclosure model will publish inspection results, and whether shops and producers will be publicly rated. The government referred to its earlier reaction, said inspections are risk-based and the strategy will be revised, that a disclosure pilot starts in autumn with broader rollout after the Health Act amendment, and that the NVWA can set its own priorities.
Based on the experience with food fraud, the NVWA will revise its supervision strategy.
Op grond van de ervaringen met de voedselfraude zal de NVWA de toezichtstrategie gaan herzien.
Antwoord vragen Dijkgraaf over de monitoring in het kader van Natura 2000

MP Dijkgraaf asked the state secretary about monitoring of habitat types and species under the Natura 2000 directives, including baseline data, Noordse woelmuis observations, and free access to the national fauna and flora database. The state secretary answered that monitoring is already adequate via national networks and area plans, refused to send historical data and declined free access for stakeholders, while committing to map updates and a legal anchoring of article 11 in the Wetsvoorstel natuurbescherming.
The government will not reimburse this for stakeholders.
De overheid zal dit niet voor belanghebbenden vergoeden.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de openbaarheid van jachtgegevens

Parliamentary questions from MP Thieme ask whether the government will ask provinces to publish hunting-area data after the Council of State ruled in a Gelderland case, and whether AIVD reports support the claim that disclosure enables disruption of wildlife management. Minister Plasterk declines to judge the province's conduct, says the Council of State's reasoning concerns only the specific parties, and states that the AIVD will publish an extremism report in September 2013 which will be shared with parliament.
I expect this publication to appear in September 2013 and will therefore share it with the House.
Ik verwacht dat deze publicatie in september 2013 zal verschijnen en zal haar dan ook delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dikkers, Jacobi en Wolbert over het bericht dat bij 44% van de Europeanen glyfosaat in de urine zit

MPs Dikkers, Jacobi and Wolbert asked the health and economic affairs ministers about a German study finding glyphosate in the urine of 44% of Europeans, including whether the NVWA tests crops and what risk applies.
