The minister answered that the RIVM sees no health risk at these microgram levels, that the NVWA tests grains with no MRL exceedances, and that glyphosate is under EU re-evaluation which will be followed closely.
Because the RIVM currently has no indication that the glyphosate levels found in urine give cause for concern, there is no reason to inquire with neighbouring countries about such research.

Omdat het RIVM op dit moment geen aanwijzingen heeft dat de gevonden glyfosaatwaarden in de urine reden tot zorg geven, is er geen aanleiding om bij de omringende landen te informeren naar dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over haaien als attractie in een club

An MP asked the state secretary whether a planned permanent shark aquarium in an Arnhem nightclub, which would hold small sharks and groupers, threatens animal welfare, and whether such animals should be banned as pets. The answer acknowledges the plan, says noise, vibration and light could stress the animals and that the NVWA has been asked to investigate, and points to a forthcoming positive list for pets.
I have asked the NVWA to conduct further investigation into this.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht hiernaar nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord vragen Dikkers en Van Dekken over het bericht dat weidegang niet noodzakelijk is voor weidepremie

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked whether cow grazing is required for the grazing premium and whether the term 'weidemelk' is misleading, and asked for definitions of sustainability labels. The state secretary replied that weidemelk requires grazing (at least 120 days, 6 hours a day), that existing Warenwet rules on misleading labelling suffice, and that no further conditions or talks with companies are needed.
The term 'weidemelk' applies only to milk from cows that actually get grazing, and in practice this is the case.
De term «weidemelk» geldt alleen voor melk van koeien die daadwerkelijk weidegang krijgen, dat is in de praktijk ook het geval.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over het vergassen van ganzen in de wijde omgeving van Schiphol in 2013

MP Thieme asks the state secretaries about the 2013 CO2 gassing of geese around Schiphol, the exemption granted to Duke Faunabeheer, lease conditions, the Luchthavenindelingbesluit, the grain-ploughing subsidy, transparency of the goose management plan, the Raad voor Dierenaangelegenheden advice, costs, and the scientific basis for the cull. The government answers that the exemption was granted, lease conditions and bird-test plans are being developed, the subsidy runs to 2017, the Stichting withheld tender details, and costs are about 5 euro per goose.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over de uitzending Wild West op Zee van Zembla

An MP asked the state secretary about a Zembla broadcast alleging illegal fishing practices by Parlevliet & Van der Plas, its frequent reflagging, and the adequacy of fisheries inspection and quota enforcement. The state secretary answered that the offences occurred under foreign flags so the responsible flag states handle them, that German inspection is ongoing, and that she will inform parliament, while defending existing controls and planned measures on the landing obligation.
Since in all cases the ships fly a foreign flag and fall under the responsibility of the respective flag states, the responsible authorities did not inform the Netherlands.

Aangezien het in alle gevallen schepen onder een buitenlandse vlag betreft die onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de betreffende vlagstaten vallen, is Nederland door de verantwoordelijke autoriteiten niet geïnformeerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dikkers over het bericht ‘vervolging om fraude met scharreleieren’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports of eggs sold as free-range without meeting the housing density norms, how controls on the authenticity of quality marks work, and whether similar fraud occurs in other sectors such as free-range pork. The State Secretary explained the NCAE and Skal control regimes and the enforcement routes, said the supervision system is being analysed and promised to inform parliament of the results.

In view of the ongoing investigation into egg fraud, supervision in the egg chain is currently being further analysed and the possibilities to strengthen the current supervision system on stocking density at laying hen farms are being examined.

Naar aanleiding van het nog lopende onderzoek naar fraude met eieren wordt het toezicht in de eierketen op dit moment nader geanalyseerd en wordt nagegaan welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de huidige gehanteerde toezichtsystematiek op de bezettingsdichtheid op legpluimveebedrijven te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dikkers en Dekken over de handelwijze van de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) in de zaak Selten

MPs Dikkers and Van Dekken asked about the NVWA's handling of the Selten meat case, including mislabelling of horse meat as beef, destruction of beef stock, delayed notification after a contaminated horse import, and the EU horse passport system. The government declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, explained labelling rules and the basis for recalling unverifiable meat, and withheld the names of buyers citing privacy law.
In general, and also in this case, we refrain from answering questions about ongoing criminal cases or claims by suspects in ongoing criminal cases.
In het algemeen en ook in deze casus onthouden wij ons van beantwoording van vragen over lopende strafzaken dan wel beweringen van verdachten in lopende strafzaken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over boogschieten op damherten

MP Thieme asked the ministers whether the perpetrator of a bow-and-arrow shooting of a fallow deer had been found, whether the government is aware of the Dutch archers' association's push to legalise bow hunting, and whether there are plans to legalise it. The minister replied that the police investigation was halted for lack of leads, that bow hunting remains prohibited under the Flora- and faunawet because of the risk of unnecessary suffering, and that there are no plans to legalise it.
There are no plans to legalise bow hunting.
Er zijn geen plannen om de boogjacht te legaliseren.
Antwoord vragen Jacobi en Mei Li Vos over de doorvoer van walvisvlees via de haven van Rotterdam

MPs Jacobi and Mei Li Vos asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs whether the government would block transit of whale meat through Rotterdam, citing a petition and earlier commitments to pursue an EU or IWC transit ban. The state secretary replied that no formal transit ban is legally feasible because of Iceland's and Japan's CITES reservations, but said she would pursue a West-European port and industry code of conduct and approach EU colleagues.
As I reported above, a formal transit ban is not feasible.
Zoals ik u hierboven meldde, is een formeel doorvoerverbod niet haalbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over het aan banden leggen van teelt pootgoed

An MP asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs why the European Commission proposed a stricter crop-rotation rule (1-in-4) for seed potatoes, whether it was justified, and whether the Netherlands would oppose it at the Agriculture Council. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands had strongly opposed the unjustified proposal, and the Commission has since said the rule would apply only to specific regions, which excludes the Netherlands, so the main concerns are addressed, with a promise to ensure the final proposals reflect this.
Naturally, I will ensure that in the final proposals this commitment is actually implemented.
Vanzelfsprekend zal ik er op toezien dat in de definitieve voorstellen deze toezegging daadwerkelijk wordt ingevuld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het verlenen van een omgevingsvergunning voor de uitbreiding van een nertsenhouderij

An MP asked whether the municipality of Bladel could grant an environmental permit for expanding a mink farm given the Dutch ban on fur farming, and whether the state would stop violations. The state secretary answered that municipalities cannot refuse such permits under the Wabo because the ban is ethical rather than environmental, and that the NVWA will enforce the ban.
Under the Wabo, the municipality therefore has no possibility to refuse a permit with a view to the Fur Farming Ban Act.
Op grond van de Wabo is er voor de gemeente dus geen mogelijkheid om een vergunning te weigeren met het oog op de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Litjens over Natuurbeleid moet weg van details

Litjens (VVD) asked whether the government shares the RLI advice that Dutch nature policy is too technocratic, focused on specific species, and undermines public support, and whether it will use the advice for the nature vision and nature law. Dijksma replied that the advice offers a useful mirror and will feed into the nature vision and the amended nature protection bill, with a fuller response to follow, and acknowledged that agricultural nature management needs greater effectiveness.
The advice will then be a building block for the nature vision I am currently developing.
Het advies zal vervolgens een bouwsteen zijn voor de natuurvisie die ik momenteel ontwikkel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de oproepen van de Dierenbescherming aan dierenwinkels in Amsterdam en Diemen te stoppen met de verkoop van konijnen

MP Ouwehand asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the Dierenbescherming's call on pet shops to stop selling rabbits, the overcrowding of rabbit shelters, and an industry trade magazine article advising how to persuade parents into impulse purchases, asking whether the government will resist self-regulation and address impulse buying in its animal welfare policy letter. The State Secretary agrees the initiative to rehome rabbits is good, notes that sellers must advise buyers under the Besluit Gezelschapsdieren, points to the Landelijk Informatiecentrum Gezelschapsdieren, says certification could complement rules, and promises an animal welfare policy letter before summer including impulse purchases.
As promised, I will send your House an animal welfare policy letter before the summer, of which impulse purchases will be part.
Zoals toegezegd stuur ik uw Kamer voor de zomer een beleidsbrief dierenwelzijn, waar impulsaankopen onderdeel van uit maakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de fraudebestendigheid van het registratiesysteem voor honden

An MP asked the state secretary about fraud vulnerabilities in the dog registration system, including whether personal data could be deleted anonymously and why multiple databases exist. The state secretary said the system is sound, that only Dienst Regelingen can delete central records, and that no changes are planned until a three-year evaluation.
In three years the measures taken under the identification and registration of dogs will be evaluated.
Over 3 jaar worden de maatregelen genomen in het kader van identificatie en registratie van honden geëvalueerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Jacobi over “overtredingen door veehouderijen met luchtwassers”

MPs Van Dekken, Fokke and Jacobi asked about violations by livestock farms with air scrubbers, including 58% of inspected cases with breaches and 16% serious ones, and their effect on fine-particle and nitrogen calculations, enforcement in Brabant versus other provinces, and sanctions. The state secretary acknowledged the non-compliance, pointed to mandatory electronic monitoring from 2016, said enforcement is delegated to municipalities and provinces without a national register, and promised to take further measures if compliance does not improve.

There is no national system in which the competent authorities under the Wabo record inspections, so no overview of the results of inspections of intensive livestock farms with air scrubbers can be given.

Er is geen landelijk systeem waarin de bevoegde gezagen voor de Wabo de controles registreren, waardoor geen overzicht van de resultaten van controles op intensieve veehouderijen met luchtwassers gegeven kan worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid van Gerven over huisartsen in Gemert-Bakel die zich zorgen maken over de gezondheid van de bevolking Gemert-Bakel

An SP MP asked the state secretary about health risks, odour, emissions and antibiotic-resistance concerns raised by GP's regarding a large biogas digester near a residential area in Gemert-Bakel. The government answered that siting and permitting are decentralised to the local authority, which must consult the municipal health service, and that national intervention is not possible for siting or odour.
The competent authority can refuse the permit if the expected odour nuisance cannot be sufficiently limited by measures or conditions.
Het bevoegd gezag kan de vergunning weigeren als de te verwachten stankoverlast in onvoldoende mate kan worden beperkt door maatregelen of voorschriften.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van mestvergisters voor de volksgezondheid

MP Ouwehand asked whether manure digesters pose public health risks, citing a 2012 biogas leak in Coevorden that forced evacuations, and whether local permitting and oversight are adequate and whether national rules or a construction stop are needed. The government answered that the RIVM risk assessment was sound, that the permit and enforcement questions are for the competent local authority and that it has no information on the Coevorden permit, and that it will evaluate co-digestion policy in two years but sees no need for a construction stop.
I have no insight into the permit for the digester in Coevorden and its enforcement by the competent authority.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de vergunning voor de vergister in Coevorden en de handhaving daarvan door het bevoegde gezag.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de wettelijke bescherming van de huiskraai

Thieme (PvdD) asks why the state secretary removed the house crow from the protected species list in March 2013, whether it is native, and whether the change should be reversed while a court case by the Faunabescherming is pending. The secretary answers that the species is treated as an invasive alien species, that the removal resolves confusion between two regulations, that the European Commission confirmed the position, and that the government awaits the court's rulings.

Following the ruling, I concluded that the conflicting designations of the house crow as an invasive alien species in the Regulation on animal management and damage control, and as a protected species in the Announcement of protected species lists, cause unnecessary confusion.

Naar aanleiding van de uitspraak heb ik geconcludeerd dat de tegenstrijdige aanwijzingen van de huiskraai als invasieve exoot in de Regeling beheer en schadebestrijding dieren enerzijds en als beschermde soort in de Bekendmaking lijsten beschermde diersoorten anderzijds, tot onnodige verwarring leidt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over het gebruik van slangen in amusementsprogramma’s

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about snakes used in the entertainment show Killer Karaoke, including whether the stress caused to the animals should be combated and whether oversight should be tightened. The state secretary replied that the NVWA has started a criminal investigation under the Animal Health and Welfare Act, declined to comment on the stress while it is ongoing, and saw no reason to tighten oversight.
Pending that investigation, I make no statements about the remarks of Dr. Freek Vonk and the stress the snakes may have undergone.
Hangende dat onderzoek doe ik geen mededelingen over de uitlatingen van Dr. Freek Vonk en de stress, die de slangen mogelijk ondergaan hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevaren van bestrijdingsmiddelen voor de volksgezondheid

Ouwehand (PvdD) asked whether an Australian study linking parental pesticide exposure in pregnancy to childhood brain tumours applies in the Netherlands, and whether imidacloprid and similar products should be withdrawn. Minister Schippers answered that RIVM and Ctgb see no evidence of tumour formation from authorised pesticides, that the study cannot establish causation or the substances involved, and that no fixed measures or deadlines can be set in advance for new scientific findings.
The Ctgb and RIVM concluded that for pesticides authorised in the Netherlands there are so far no indications that these agents lead to tumour formation in the brain.
Het Ctgb en het RIVM hebben geconcludeerd dat voor bestrijdingsmiddelen die in Nederland zijn toegelaten vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen zijn dat deze middelen leiden tot tumorvorming in de hersenen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het doden van een hond na een bijtincident

An MP asked the state secretary about the planned euthanasia of a dog after a bite incident, whether training could be an alternative, and whether tailored solutions and reliable behavioural testing would be pursued. The state secretary answered that municipalities are responsible, the mayor accepted a free training and assessment offer from a behavioural centre, and the state secretary has asked the Animal Affairs Council for an advisory opinion on preventing aggressive dog behaviour.
It is the responsibility of the municipality to decide how to handle bite incidents.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente te besluiten hoe om te gaan met bijtincidenten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman, Litjens, en Aukje de Vries over mosselkweek en natuur op de Waddenzee

MPs Bosman, Litjens and Aukje de Vries asked about the Produs research on mussel farming and Wadden Sea nature, including the withdrawn press release and whether mussel seed fishing should continue until harm is proven. The state secretary said the findings will feed into the convenant evaluation due spring 2014, that the government will not prejudge policy decisions, and that a spring fishing permit was granted on 7 May.
I want to give the covenant parties the room to reach agreements based on the evaluation.
Ik wil de convenantspartijen de ruimte geven om op basis van de evaluatie tot afspraken te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de paardenvleesaffaire

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about the horsemeat scandal, including the Selten firm's denial of fraud, the NVWA's sampling and figures, and the legal basis for the recall. The government declined to comment on the ongoing criminal investigation, maintained that the untraceable meat must be withdrawn under the General Food Law, and said there was no discrepancy in its letters and no reason to revise its decisions.
Meat that is unfit for human consumption may not be placed on the market.
Vlees dat ongeschikt is voor humane consumptie mag niet op de markt worden gebracht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanhouding van een jachtopziener voor illegale jacht

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice and the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about the arrest of a gamekeeper for illegal hunting at estate De Eese, including whether employers, hunters, the crown prince and the gamekeeper's BOA status should be scrutinised. The minister declined to say more on the ongoing criminal investigation, stated the BOA powers were withdrawn, denied the crown prince had hunted there, and rejected changes to BOA oversight.
In the interest of the investigation, the Public Prosecution Service cannot currently make any further statements.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan het Openbaar Ministerie thans geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanwezigheid van huisdieren in voedsel en veevoer

An MP asked about reports that stray dogs, road-killed animals and pets were rendered into feed ingredients in Spain, possibly supplied to Dutch firms, and whether Dutch food safety controls (NVWA) are adequate and why no RASFF alert was raised. The state secretary answered that Spanish tests found no dog DNA, no evidence of Dutch involvement, that NVWA controls are sufficient, that licences can be withdrawn for illegal trade, and that dolphin DNA findings in tuna were from a small 2010 study and are being addressed at EU level.
So far there are no indications that this prohibition is being violated in the Netherlands.
Vooralsnog zijn er geen aanwijzingen dat in Nederland dit verbod wordt overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven en Hachchi over de aantasting van de beschermde status van het Mariene Park bij Bonaire

MPs Van Veldhoven and Hachchi asked the state secretary about reports that Bonaire's executive council would weaken the protected status of the Bonaire National Marine Park, the planned pier near Karel's Bar, and whether the national government had enough oversight of coastal development. The state secretary answered that Bonaire is responsible for permits under its own ordinances, that the national minister issued a conditional permit for the pier after assessment, and that a strategic environmental assessment of the coastal zone is being prepared.

The Openbaar lichaam Bonaire is responsible for the good management, conservation and protection of the marine park in accordance with the Bonaire Nature Management Ordinance and the spatial planning framework.

Het Openbaar lichaam Bonaire is verantwoordelijk voor een goed beheer, behoud en bescherming van het mariene park overeenkomstig de Verordening Natuurbeheer Bonaire en de kaders van de ruimtelijke ordening.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over overtredingen bij het zaaien van met bestrijdingsmiddelen behandelde zaden en plotselinge vogelsterfte in Friesland

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs whether neonicotinoid-treated sugar beet seed was left exposed during sowing in strong wind, whether the usage rules were breached, what enforcement occurred, and whether a link exists to bird deaths in Friesland. The government answers that no violation was established, no NVWA report was received, the bird deaths were attributed to roosting starlings and a broken branch, and it sees no grounds to tighten Ctgb approval criteria.
Based on the article you cite, it cannot be established whether there was a violation, because information about the conditions during sowing is missing.
Op grond van het door u geciteerde artikel kan niet worden vastgesteld of er sprake was van een overtreding, omdat informatie over de omstandigheden tijdens inzaai ontbreekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over salmonellabesmetting in zalm

An MP asked the government why contaminated smoked salmon was not traced and withdrawn in time during the 2012 salmonella outbreak, including inspection history, traceability rules and NVWA staffing. The minister answered that the NVWA's internal evaluation has led to procedural improvements, that the Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid and the Openbaar Ministerie are investigating so detailed answers are withheld, and that the NVWA's response timeline and inspection record are described in general terms.
Because the Dutch Safety Board (OvV) is investigating this case, VWS is not carrying out its own evaluation.
Omdat de Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid (OvV) onderzoek doet naar deze zaak voert VWS geen eigen evaluatie uit.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de aanwezigheid van castoreum als smaak- of geurstof

An MP asked whether castoreum (beaver gland extract) is used as a flavouring in food, whether it must be labelled, and where it originates. The minister confirmed castoreum may be used as a natural aroma under EU rules, declined to research which foods contain it or to change labelling rules, and said the extract comes from North American beavers since European beavers are protected.
Given that castoreum extract is legally permitted for use as a flavouring in foodstuffs, I see no reason to investigate which foodstuffs contain castoreum extract.
Gezien het feit dat castoreum-extract wettelijk is toegestaan voor gebruik als aroma in levensmiddelen zie ik geen aanleiding om te onderzoeken in welke levensmiddelen castoreum-extract is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat onderzoeken naar de gevaren van bestrijdingsmiddelen voor bijen in Nederland niet openbaar gemaakt worden

Parliamentary questions from MP Schouw (D66) asked why studies on the harm of Bayer's insecticide to bees are not published in the Netherlands while available in England, and whether the Ctgb's disclosure assessment should change. The state secretary answered that the matter is before the court, which forbade publication of part of the studies pending a ruling, and that the Ctgb judged the studies on sublethal effects to be publishable while referring further to a letter to parliament.
This matter is before the court, which has forbidden the Ctgb from making it public before a ruling is given in the substantive proceedings.
Deze zaak is onder de rechter en die heeft het Ctgb verboden om tot openbaarmaking over te gaan voordat er in de bodemprocedure uitspraak is gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over de Tweede Nota Duurzame Gewasbescherming

An MP asked the state secretaries how the Second Pesticide Reduction Policy Note is progressing, the status of the Grashoff motion on glyphosate use and comparative studies of chemical versus non-chemical weed control, who is responsible for promoting non-chemical methods (Nefyto), and when the Note will be sent. The government answered that the Note will be finalised and sent in May, the two studies are nearly ready and will be forwarded with the Note, and responsibility for non-chemical methods lies with the ministers, not with industry.
I will finalise the Note and send it to you in May.
Ik zal de Nota afronden en u deze in mei toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht «EU will anbau von obst und gemuese gaerten verbieten»

An MP asked the state secretary whether EU plant-health and seed proposals would regulate small-scale growing such as urban farming, allotments and heirloom seeds. The state secretary answered that the Commission's proposals do not appear to require registration for hobby seed trade and that exemptions for small growers are welcome, and promised a BNC-fiche within six weeks.
In line with the agreement with the House of Representatives, the cabinet will send its position on these proposals via a so-called BNC-fiche as soon as possible, and at the latest within 6 weeks.
Conform afspraak met de Tweede Kamer zal het kabinet zo snel mogelijk, maar uiterlijk binnen 6 weken middels een zogenaamd BNC-fiche zijn standpunt over deze voorstellen toezenden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “Toezicht overheid op MKZ-lab faalde jarenlang”

An MP from the CDA asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether the government would publish the EU Food and Veterinary Office inspection report on foot-and-mouth disease laboratories in Lelystad and Wageningen, and what it thought of its findings. The State Secretary answered that the report was released under a Wob request, that the only other inspection was a 2007 and 2009 national review, and that the recommendations were adopted in an action plan and the lab's safety reports were attached.
In consultation with the European Commission, I provided the report last month in the context of a Wob procedure.
In overleg met de Europese Commissie heb ik het rapport afgelopen maand verstrekt in het kader van een Wob-procedure.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Litjens over de Natura 2000-gebieden Nieuwkoopse Plassen & De Haeck en Binnenveld

MPs Dijkgraaf and Litjens asked whether the Natura 2000 conservation targets for Nieuwkoopse Plassen & De Haeck and Binnenveld should be changed to preservation targets given nitrogen problems, whether designation should wait for the PAS and local support, and what the provinces' advice is. The State Secretary refused to change the expansion targets, will not designate either area before summer, and noted that the regional governments want to take over the Binnenveld management plan.
Pursuant to the Geurts et al. motion, I will not designate the Nieuwkoopse Plassen & De Haeck area before the summer.
Het gebied Nieuwkoopse Plassen & De Haeck zal ik, ter uitvoering van de motie Geurts c.s. (Kamerstuk 33 037, nr. 62 ), niet voor de zomer aanwijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Fokke en Kuiken over het niet vernietigen van een bouwvergunning voor een geitenstal in Landerd (Noord-Brabant)

Three PvdA MPs asked why the Crown did not annul the municipality of Landerd's building permit for a goat barn despite the province of Noord-Brabant's request, and whether the expansion should be allowed on public health grounds. The minister replied that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, so annulment under the Constitution's Article 132 could not be applied, and that the decision takes no position on the desirability of the expansion or the provincial building freeze.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een vergunning voor de omstreden geitenstal in Landerd

An MP asked the ministers whether the controversial goat stable in Landerd may proceed despite a provincial construction stop and the Health Council's report on livestock health risks, and whether the Crown should annul the building permit. The government answered that annulment is discretionary, that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, that the permit was lawfully granted, and that it will not further suspend or annul the permit or await the cabinet response.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de weigering om de bouwvergunning te vernietigen die de gemeente Landerd heeft afgegeven voor de bouw van een grote geitenstal

MP Van Gerven (SP) asks why the minister refused to ask the Crown to annul the Landerd municipal building permit for a large goat barn during the Q-fever context, despite the provincial building freeze, and questions the legal basis and discretion involved. The minister answers that the permit was lawfully granted, that no conflict with law or the general interest was shown, and that the Crown's annulment discretion was not triggered, while declining to comment on the wisdom of the freeze or the municipal inquiry's conclusions.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Vermeij en Albert de Vries (over de planontwikkeling van een recreatiepark nabij Fort Benoorden Spaarndam)

MPs Vermeij and De Vries asked the ministers about plans for bungalows at Fort Benoorden Spaarndam within the World Heritage Stelling van Amsterdam, and whether the national government should be involved. The minister said the Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed had studied the plans and found no harm to the World Heritage value, that the province is the lead on the project and can request advice from the College van Rijksadviseurs which the government would support, and that the alternative plan from a heritage foundation is a matter for the province.
A request from the province of Noord-Holland I will support and submit to the college.
Een verzoek van de provincie Noord-Holland zal ik steunen en voorleggen aan het college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klaver over dierproeven in het Biomedical Primate Research Centre

An MP asked the state secretary about the reduction of primate experiments at the BPRC, the number of marmosets, the nature of experiments, the independence of its animal experiment committee, and primate imports and exports. The government answered that about 1500 primates are held, mostly in a breeding colony, that primate experiments in the Netherlands fell from 691 in 2002 to 345 in 2011, and that some requested data, such as institution-level figures and alternatives found, are not released or not reported.
Companies are not obliged to report to the government on the use of alternatives to animal experiments.
Bedrijven zijn niet verplicht aan de overheid te rapporteren over het gebruik van alternatieven voor dierproeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Geurts over het bericht “Boetes monsterhoeveelheden; reacties fabrikanten en CUMELA”

An MP asks the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reports of fines for insufficient manure sample volumes, whether problems with sampling equipment were known at approval, whether research reports will be shared, and about weighing and specific gravity rules at laboratories. The State Secretary answers that a 1999 field test flagged low fill levels with thick manure, that later studies found no such problems, that responsibility lies with the intermediary, and that the relevant norms and enforcement basis are described, while sharing the reports is not explicitly committed.
This research is public and can be found on the Wageningen-UR website.
Dit onderzoek is openbaar en terug te vinden op de website van Wageningen-UR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de cumulatieve effecten op natuur en milieu van activiteiten in het Waddengebied

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about cumulative effects on nature and environment of activities in the Wadden Sea, including salt extraction increasing sand hunger, and whether a central overview of effects should be kept. The State Secretary answers that impact assessments and permit conditions will address sand hunger mitigation, that cumulative effects are handled by the competent authority per project, and that a data-access taskforce will report by end May 2013.
I agree with you on that.
Dat ben ik met u eens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Jacobi over het bericht ‘Vergunning megastal Grubbenvorst geweigerd’

MPs Van Dekken and Jacobi asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs about the Council of State's annulment of environmental permits for a large livestock farm in Grubbenvorst, and whether such projects near homes are responsible given health risks, and whether the arrival could be prevented. The state secretary replied that the annulment was on procedural grounds (inadequate notice to interested parties), that other grounds were not reached, and that the Health Council advice and a policy response on farm scale will follow.

The Council of State declared the appeal against this environmental permit well-founded and ruled that the contested decision must be annulled for breach of article 3:12, first paragraph, of the General Administrative Law Act.

De Raad van State heeft het beroep inzake deze milieuvergunning gegrond verklaard en bepaald dat het bestreden besluit wegens strijd met artikel 3:12, eerste lid, van de Awb dient te worden vernietigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over natuurbezuinigingen en schaapskuddes

An MP asked whether nature budget cuts caused the bankruptcy of a sheep herder on the Veluwe and whether the government would support finding a solution for the flock. The state secretary answered that the herder's problems stemmed from losing a tender for a project rather than from cuts, that an acute solution has been found, and that provinces now handle nature management subsidies.

I am glad that a solution for this flock appears to have been found, and I am willing to think along about solutions for roaming herded sheep flocks, taking into account the responsibility of the provinces.

Ik ben blij dat er een oplossing voor deze kudde gevonden lijkt en ik ben bereid mee te denken over oplossingen voor rondtrekkende gescheperde schaapskuddes, met in acht neming van de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Straus over het huiswerkblad van Maandtaak

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretaries whether a Maandtaak primary-school homework sheet on modern farming (on the farm, chicken, calf, pig) gives a one-sided picture, who is responsible for the content, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that the content of educational materials is not for the government to assess, that schools choose their own methods and sources, and that the government does not steer method choice, so no action is committed.
It is not for the (national) government to assess the content of educational materials.
Het is niet aan de (rijks) overheid om de inhoud van educatieve materialen te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het verdwijnen van de plofkip uit de Nederlandse winkelschappen

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about supermarket and poultry-sector agreements to phase out fast-growing 'plofkip' chicken, covering who does what, enforcement, environmental impact, animal welfare and labelling. The state secretary welcomed the agreements as a first step, pointed to private quality systems for enforcement, and said welfare improvements would continue stepwise.
I welcome the initiative of the supermarkets and the poultry meat chain to produce a new market segment of fresh poultry meat for Dutch supermarkets.
Ik ben verheugd met het initiatief van de supermarkten en de pluimveevleesketen om een nieuw marktsegment voor vers pluimveevlees te gaan produceren voor de Nederlandse supermarkten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de handhaving van het coupeerverbod voor honden en paarden

An MP asked the state secretary how the ban on docking dogs' tails and horses' tails is enforced, given footage showing docked dogs at Dutch shows and an apparent trade in docked dogs. The state secretary replied that enforcement of the ban on the procedure abroad rests with Belgian authorities, that a ban on owning or exhibiting legally docked foreign dogs would conflict with EU free movement, and referred to a letter on horses.
Enforcement of that is for the Belgian enforcement authorities.
Handhaving daarvan is aan de Belgische handhavingsinstanties.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de verwaarlozing van ezels op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked the government about reports that dozens of stray donkeys on Sint Eustatius were held in a fenced area without adequate food and water, and whether national authorities should intervene and harmonise animal welfare rules. The state secretary answered that a drought caused a temporary feed shortage now resolved, that the public body is responsible and has acted with a stakeholder action plan, and that legislative restraint toward Caribbean Netherlands applies until the 2015 evaluation.
Ensuring animal welfare is a responsibility of the public body.
Het waarborgen van het welzijn van dieren is een verantwoordelijkheid van het openbaar lichaam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het niet functioneren van tal van faunavoorzieningen die als compensatie moesten dienen voor het aantasten van de natuur

MP Ouwehand asked the state secretary whether many wildlife compensation structures (fish passages, animal tunnels, amphibian tunnels, ledges) are malfunctioning, how they are inspected, whether sanctions were imposed, and whether an investigation will be launched. The secretary says he has no data confirming or denying the claims, that enforcement covers only structures tied to the Flora- and faunawet, that 200 cases were resolved in three years without sanctions, and that he will approach managing bodies to check for deterioration.
As stated in my answer to question 3, my responsibility and authority are limited to facilities related to violations of the Flora- and faunawet
Zoals vermeld in mijn antwoord op vraag 3 beperkt mijn verantwoordelijkheid en bevoegdheid zich tot voorzieningen die zijn gerelateerd aan overtredingen van de Flora- en faunawet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het toestaan van de vrije vangst van de rivierprik in Nederland

An MP asked the state secretary why the river lamprey was moved from the Flora- and Faunawet to the Visserijwet, whether it is a sustainable population, and whether this complies with the Rhine convention. The state secretary answered that the species is now under strict fishing restrictions (closed seasons and a minimum size) following an IMARES analysis, so no negative effect on the stock is expected and commercial fishing will hardly be possible.
Because of the restrictive conditions under which the river lamprey is included in the Visserijwet, no negative effect on the stock situation of this species is expected.
Vanwege de beperkende voorwaarden waaronder de rivierprik in de Visserijwet is opgenomen, is geen negatief effect op de bestandssituatie voor deze vissoort te verwachten.
Antwoord vragen De Liefde en Lodders over het bericht ‘Jumbo verstuurt 3-procentsbrief aan leveranciers huismerk’

MPs De Liefde and Lodders asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that Daymon unilaterally imposed a 3% discount on Jumbo's private-label suppliers and how this relates to the unfair trading practices code and related motions. The minister said commercial negotiations are a matter between firms, that the government facilitates a self-regulatory code with dispute resolution, that legislation would only be considered if self-regulation fails, and that the motions will be addressed by letters before summer.
The government should in principle interfere as little as possible in this.
De overheid hoort zich daarmee in beginsel zo min mogelijk te bemoeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber over natuurontwikkeling in het Binnenveld

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretary about the stalled nature development and Natura 2000 management plan for the Binnenveld, including a possible 20 cm water level rise, the lack of local support, and whether Staatsbosbeheer would sell land. The state secretary answered that the process is complex, that a consultation with the competent authorities is planned, that Staatsbosbeheer will not sell Natura 2000 or EHS land, and that talks with the provinces and water board will take place at the end of April.
It is my intention to soon consult administratively with the other competent authorities about possible solutions.
Het is mijn voornemen om binnenkort bestuurlijk met de andere bevoegde instanties te overleggen over mogelijke oplossingen.

Vragen van de leden Van Veldhoven (D66) en Jacobi (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken over het voornemen van de provincie Overijssel om 9000 hectare EHS-natuur te schrappen (ingezonden 8 maart 2013).

MPs Van Veldhoven and Jacobi asked the state secretary about Overijssel's plan to remove about 9,000 hectares from the Ecological Main Structure, and whether this conflicts with national and international obligations and the coalition agreement. The state secretary replied that the province is responsible for nature policy under the 2011 nature agreement, that Overijssel will still add new EHS areas in the Reestdal and Regge, and that she will assess the provinces' plans after the new nature policy outline is adopted.
With the signing of the nature governance agreement, the province has become responsible for implementing nature policy.
Met de ondertekening van het bestuursakkoord natuur is de provincie verantwoordelijk geworden voor de uitvoering van het natuurbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Dekken over antibioticaresistentie

An MP asked the health minister and economy state secretary about antibiotic resistance, citing a radio warning, the lack of new antibiotic development, and high antibiotic use in livestock farming. The minister acknowledged the threat, pointed to existing and planned national and international measures, and promised letters before the summer recess with further detail.
I will inform you by letter before the summer on how this specific topic will be worked out during the current cabinet period.
Over de uitwerking van dit specifieke onderwerp binnen de huidige kabinetsperiode zal ik u voor de zomer per brief informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aantasting van het leefgebied van de zeer zeldzame veldspitsmuis in Sibculo

An MP asks whether a monastery foundation in Sibculo violated Flora- and faunawet protections for the rare field shrew through past clearing and maintenance, and how supervision will ensure compliance and the planned compensation garden. The state secretary answers that a Zoogdiervereniging study found shrews present, a management plan was requested via Dienst Regelingen, NVWA checks on request, and further steps are left to Dienst Regelingen.
If there is cause, the NVWA checks at the request of Dienst Regelingen whether the foundation complies with the management plan drawn up by the Zoogdiervereniging.
Als daar aanleiding voor is, controleert de NVWA op verzoek van Dienst Regelingen of de stichting zich houdt aan het door de Zoogdiervereniging opgestelde beheerplan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het Oostvaarderswold

An MP asked the state secretary about the Oostvaarderswold ecological connection after Flevoland province decided to abandon it and prepare sale of acquired land, questioning conflict with the coalition agreement and whether state-funded land sales are allowed. The secretary answered that the province is responsible, that sale is not per se contrary to agreements but proceeds from ILG-funded land must go to development, and that talks with the province are planned.
Based on Mr Bekker's advice, the province of Flevoland has decided to abandon its efforts on the Oostvaarderswold ecological connection zone.
De provincie Flevoland heeft op basis van het advies van de heer Bekker besloten de inzet op de verbindingszone Oostvaarderswold los te laten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over Europese subsidies die het stierenvechten in stand houden

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked whether EU agricultural and cultural subsidies sustain bullfighting in Spain, including bull breeding, arena upkeep, and whether such subsidies should be withheld. The government answered that EU cultural funds do not finance arenas, bull breeding is not a separate EU subsidy category, and animal welfare and spending of national funds are member-state responsibilities, while promising only to support future welfare rules.
Fighting bulls do not form a separate category in relation to EU subsidies.
Vechtstieren vormen geen aparte categorie in relatie tot EU-subsidies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een sterke afname van de vlinderstand

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the sharp decline in butterfly populations, its causes in intensive agriculture, and whether the government will expand habitat, including flower-rich road verges. The State Secretary acknowledged the decline in about half of the 51 Dutch butterfly species, pointed to existing generic measures and provincial powers, and said talks with the provinces on nature policy would be reported to Parliament soon.
I am in discussion with the provinces about nature policy inside and outside the EHS, including agricultural nature management. I can inform your House about this soon.
Ik ben met de provincies in gesprek over het natuurbeleid binnen en buiten de EHS, waaronder het agrarisch natuurbeheer. Daarover kan ik uw Kamer binnenkort informeren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en Ten Broeke over bontproductie in China

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs about fur farming conditions in China, how Dutch fur farming standards compare, global demand for fur, the revenue lost from the Dutch fur farm ban, and whether production will shift to countries with weaker animal welfare. The state secretary answered that data on Chinese fur farming is scarce, outlined regulatory differences, cited industry figures on rising fur turnover, estimated the Dutch fur sector's turnover above 300 million euro without quantifying lost state revenue, and said production may shift to countries like Denmark, Poland, Romania or Belarus and China, though the extent is unknown.
To what extent the Dutch state is losing revenue cannot be said on this basis, as it depends on various factors.
In hoeverre de Nederlandse staat inkomsten mis loopt is op basis hiervan niet te zeggen, dit is afhankelijk van diverse factoren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het zwanendriften

An MP asked whether the 2008 exemption allowing swan farming expires on 31 March 2013 and whether no new exemptions will be granted, and whether unannounced inspections took place in 2012. The state secretary confirmed the expiry and that no new exemptions will be issued, noting swans may still be kept as ornamental birds, and confirmed two inspections in 2012 found no violations.
Yes, no more exemptions will be granted.
Ja, er zullen geen ontheffingen meer worden verleend.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Litjens over de aanmelding van Polder Stein als Habitatrichtlijngebied

MPs Dijkgraaf and Litjens asked the state secretary about the status of Polder Stein as a Habitat Directive area, including whether the habitat type H6510 occurs there and why its designation changed. The state secretary answered that the area will be re-notified to the European Commission this year, that the habitat was found present after a 2012 field visit, and that the earlier exclusion rested on an incorrect 2010 conclusion.
This area will be re-notified to the European Commission as a Habitat Directive area again this year.
Dit gebied zal nog dit jaar weer bij de Europese Commissie worden aangemeld als Habitatrichtlijngebied.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over preventief afschot van grote hoefdieren in Drenthe

An MP asked the state secretary about Drenthe province preemptively shooting red deer, wild boar and fallow deer when they cross provincial borders, and how this fits with ecological corridor policy. The state secretary confirmed the policy is provincial responsibility, declined to provide the requested cull figures, and said the state secretary will keep in contact with the responsible provincial deputy.
The culling concerned is the responsibility of the province of Drenthe.
Het betreffende afschot is de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Drenthe.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jacobi en Wolbert over de mogelijke frustratie van recreatie en natuurontwikkeling in het gebied Dwingelderveld als gevolg van stagnatie bij de herinrichting

MPs Jacobi and Wolbert asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reports that renewed delays in the Dwingelderveld restoration would stall nature development and keep parts of the area closed to walkers, cyclists and disabled visitors, including whether the rezoning and subsidy deadlines are at risk. The State Secretary answered that she is aware of the reports but that, under the Bestuursakkoord Natuur, responsibility for the restoration and for walking paths lies with the province of Drenthe and regional bodies, and she declined to take that responsibility on.
By signing the Bestuursakkoord Natuur, the restoration of the Dwingelderveld falls under the responsibility of the province of Drenthe.
Met het ondertekenen van het Bestuursakkoord Natuur valt de herinrichting van het Dwingelderveld onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de provincie Drenthe.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de schandalen rond de herkomst van voedsel

An MP asks the state secretary about German egg-fraud scandals and the origin of food, including the scale of illegal battery-hen eggs and whether enforcement capacity will be expanded. The state secretary says the Dutch authorities are investigating, declines to give further details on an ongoing investigation, describes existing inspection arrangements, and promises a taskforce proposal before summer.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on this.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik hierover geen nadere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een steakhouse dat al 63 jaar paard verkoopt als rund

An MP asked whether a steakhouse that served horse meat as beef for 63 years violated the Warenwet and why no proces verbaal had been drawn up. The minister answered that the Warenwet allows meat sold as steak regardless of species, that misleading labelling is assessed case by case by the NVWA, and that no proces verbaal had yet been drawn up but the NVWA has been asked to give the case due attention and report back.
I have asked the NVWA to give this matter the required attention and to inform me how it assesses this specific case.
Ik heb de NVWA verzocht hieraan de vereiste aandacht te geven en mij te informeren over hoe zij deze specifieke casus beoordeelt.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over de onenigheid tussen het Rijk en het Recreatieschap Midden-Delfland over de uittreedvoorwaarden en uittreedsom die het Rijk dient te betalen bij uittreding uit het Recreat

An MP asked the state secretary about the dispute with Recreatieschap Midden-Delfland over the exit terms and the exit sum (51 million euro) the state must pay to leave the joint arrangement, and whether the state would appeal the council's decision. The state secretary answered that the state will appeal the council's decision because the sum is unreasonable and disproportionate, that negotiation is preferred but only possible if the council withdraws its decision, and that the situation differs from the De Grevelingen case in nature protection duties and finances.
I will appeal against the decision of the Midden-Delfland council.
Ik ga in beroep tegen de beslissing van de Midden-Delflandraad.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over diarreebacteriën die van varkens overgaan op mensen

An MP asks the state secretaries whether the transmission of resistant diarrhoea bacteria from pigs to humans, and their presence in air and meat, poses public health risks and calls for testing and policy changes. The government answers that the risk to public health is not large, that a follow-up NVWA meat study is planned for 2014, and that antibiotic reduction policy will continue, but declines to link the findings to the Health Council report or to extend the research beyond planned studies.
The NVWA has planned a follow-up study for 2014 on the presence of the bacterium on meat.
De NVWA heeft voor 2014 een vervolgonderzoek gepland naar het voorkomen van de bacterie op vlees.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht dat alle Nederlandse kip halal is

An MP asked the state secretary of Economic Affairs whether nearly all Dutch chickens are slaughtered halal without prior stunning, and about the NVWA's oversight, consumer labelling and welfare implications. The state secretary denied that nearly all chickens are slaughtered unstunned, said most halal poultry is stunned under EU-permitted methods that the NVWA enforces, and deferred labelling to the European Commission.
The NVWA does not track whether, or how much, meat from unstunned slaughtered animals ends up in the regular circuit.
De NVWA houdt niet bij of en zo ja hoeveel vlees afkomstig van onbedwelmd geslachte dieren in het reguliere circuit terecht komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de voorwaarden voor onderhandelingen over een vrijhandelsakkoord met Japan

MP Ouwehand asked whether reopening the Japanese market to Dutch veal, and respect for human rights and the whaling moratorium, were conditions for launching FTA talks with Japan, and whether the government would make these binding preconditions. The minister answered that veal access was a litmus test for Japan's non-tariff barriers, that human rights will feature in a framework agreement with a possible suspension clause (whaling excluded), and refused to make whaling a precondition while promising to raise it through IWC and bilateral channels.
No. The negotiations with Japan will be used to raise these themes further.
Nee. De onderhandelingen met Japan zullen worden aangegrepen om deze thema's verder aan de orde te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw en Hachchi over de situatie van ezels op Sint Eustatius

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs about reportedly poor conditions for dozens of donkeys on Sint Eustatius and whether local authorities had promised to end the situation. The State Secretary answered that the public body had rounded up most loose donkeys, that a drought-related food shortage has since been resolved, that an action list was agreed with Greenfound Foundation, and that the ministry would mediate if local authorities asked.
If the local authorities request it, I am willing to engage in mediation where possible.
Indien de plaatselijke autoriteiten daartoe verzoeken ben ik bereid om mij waar mogelijk in te zetten voor bemiddeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Jan Vos en het lid Klaver over mogelijke bijdrage van voedselproducenten aan mensenrechtenschendingen in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Maij, Jan Vos and Klaver asked whether Dutch food and drink producers contribute to human rights abuses such as land grabbing, exploitation of women and farmers, and labour violations in developing countries, following an Oxfam report. The minister responded that she shares concerns, relies mainly on voluntary OECD guidelines, IFC standards and sector cooperation, will engage the industry federation, and will encourage companies to map gender and labour conditions in their supply chains.
From Dutch companies I ask that they comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises, which include the responsibility to prevent human rights abuses.
Van Nederlandse bedrijven vraag ik dat zij de OESO richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven, waarin de verantwoordelijkheid tot het voorkomen van mensenrechtenschendingen is opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over het bericht ‘NVWA veegt fouten onder het tapijt’

An MP asks the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why a pig farmer's requests for MPA test results from the MPA feed crisis were refused, whether the NVWA destroyed data, and what protocols and controls now exist. The State Secretary answers that the results were no longer archived after retention periods expired, denies intentional destruction, states that results are provided on request, and lists measures taken since then.
Test results are kept by the NVWA for 3 years.
Uitslagen van testen worden door de NVWA gedurende 3 jaar bewaard.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Geurts over de NMa opinie "Versterking landbouw vraagt om innovatie, niet om minder concurrentie"

An MP asked the ministers about an NMa opinion arguing that strengthening agriculture requires innovation rather than less competition, and whether the NMa's language about MEPs and national politicians undermines its independence. The minister answered that the NMa's opinion is within its independent role, that the government supports producer organisations under the CAP reform while keeping competition rules, and that the NMa will supervise compliance with competition rules.
The NMa, from its economic expertise, states how it views the CAP reforms and the role competition should play in them.
De NMa geeft vanuit haar economische expertise aan hoe zij aankijkt tegen de hervormingen in het GLB en de rol die mededinging daar in zou moeten nemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de aanwezigheid van paardenvlees in rundvlees

An MP asked the state secretary why horsemeat mixed into beef escaped inspection, why a previously convicted trader could resume activities, and about stray dogs and diseased sheep in pet food, plus stricter enforcement, labelling and DNA testing. The government answered that such practices are hard to detect without cause, that the NVWA has a criminal investigation and a large-scale chain inspection underway, and that it will consider further measures and push for EU-level horse registration and origin labelling.
At present the NVWA is carrying out a large-scale chain investigation to check for the illegal mixing of beef with horsemeat.
Op dit moment voert de NVWA een grootschalig ketenonderzoek uit om te controleren op het illegaal vermengen van rundvlees met paardenvlees.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Slob met betrekking tot de situatie in de haven van Boulogne

An MP asked the state secretary whether France's new restriction on Dutch fly-shooters in the port of Boulogne breaches the code of conduct and why talks with the port authorities were delayed. The state secretary confirmed the restriction is contrary to the code, raised it with the French minister, and said the situation was positively resolved from early March with police protection added.
Yes, I spoke with my French counterpart about this in Brussels on Tuesday 26 February 2013.
Ja, ik heb mijn Franse ambtsgenoot hier dinsdag 26 februari 2013 in Brussel over gesproken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over energiebesparing door minder en duurzame verlichting

An MP asked the government about reducing energy use through less and more sustainable road and building lighting, including switching off road lighting after 21:00, dimmable or presence-sensitive lighting, LED road markings, cooperation with provinces and municipalities, night-time lighting rules for offices and shops, and designating dark areas. The state secretary answered that the road-lighting switch-off was being prepared for spring 2013, that presence-sensitive lighting is unsuitable on main roads, that existing rules already cover energy-saving measures in buildings, and that dark-area designation is a provincial responsibility, though the topic can be raised with local climate ambassadors.
However, I am willing to raise this topic at the local level in the consultations with the 'climate ambassadors'.
Wel ben ik bereid om in het overleg met de «klimaatambassadeurs» dit onderwerp op lokaal niveau te agenderen.
Antwoord vragen Schouw naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Europese landbouwsubsidies naar kerken en sjoelclubs'

An MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why EU agricultural subsidies under the rural development programme were going to churches and card clubs, and whether this matched the rules. The State Secretary answered that these non-agricultural projects fall under rural-development axis 3 and LEADER within the POP2 framework, gave budget figures and publication details, and said future spending would focus on agriculture and innovation.
The examples cited in the article fall under axis 3.
De voorbeelden aangehaald in het artikel vallen onder as 3.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het faillissement van de Stichting Nederlands Opvangcentrum Papegaaien (NOP)

An MP asked the state secretary about the bankruptcy of the parrot shelter N.O.P., the welfare of the roughly 1,800 animals left, who is responsible for them, and whether the NVWA still supervises them. The state secretary answered that the NVWA inspects weekly, the appointed curator is responsible for the animals and is seeking a new home for them, and there is no current reason to doubt their welfare.
I supervise compliance with the relevant legislation. It is now up to the curator to find a solution for the animals.
Ik zie toe op de naleving van de relevante wetgeving. Het is nu aan de curator om een oplossing te vinden voor de dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders over zonder gewasbeschermingsplan drie procent minder subsidie

An MP asked whether farmers lacking a crop protection plan should really lose three percent of income support, and whether the NVWA should drop these checks while a replacement is being developed with the sector. The state secretary refused to reverse the decision, saying the absence of a plan can no longer be remedied under EU cross-compliance rules, while a sector-agreed alternative is being explored.
I do not share your views in questions 2 and 3.
Ik deel uw opvattingen onder 2 en 3 niet.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de verlenging van de Praktijkproef Bovengronds aanwenden van mest

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why the trial of surface application of manure (Praktijkproef Bovengronds aanwenden van mest) has not been extended as a parliamentary motion requested, given the new manure season. The State Secretary replied that extension was not appropriate after evaluation, but that a new research proposal received in February 2013 is being assessed by the Technical Commission Bodem and a decision is expected in early March.
I expect to be able to make a decision on the request of the two associations in early March, based on the TCB's response.
Ik verwacht begin maart op basis van de reactie van de TCB een besluit te kunnen nemen op het verzoek van de twee verenigingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Geurts over de gevolgen van stopzetten (agrarische) financiering door Deutsche Bank

MPs Van Hijum and Geurts (CDA) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the consequences of Deutsche Bank ending agricultural lending, including possible unfair terms for clients moved from ABN AMRO, complaints received, and support for farmers' financing. The government answered that the decision is a private business choice, that the EC remedy set no lending-terms commitments, that AFM cannot disclose investigations, and that existing agricultural support measures are in place.
However, the AFM cannot make any statements about possible investigations into individual institutions.
Over mogelijke onderzoeken naar individuele instellingen kan de AFM echter geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de berichten dat Deutsche Bank geen leningen meer verstrekt aan bedrijven met een omzet van minder dan 1 miljoen euro

Dijkgraaf (SGP) asked whether Deutsche Bank's withdrawal from lending to small businesses (turnover under 1 million euro), including agricultural firms, forces clients into costly refinancing, collateral lock-in and break fees, and what DNB or the AFM could do. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the bank's strategy is a private choice, that DNB supervises strategy only for sustainability, that the AFM has no lending oversight, and that the bank will talk with affected clients, without committing to new action.
I am not aware of the precise content of the private contracts between entrepreneurs and Deutsche Bank.
Van de precieze inhoud van de private contracten tussen ondernemers en Deutsche Bank ben ik niet op de hoogte.
Vragen van het lid Van Gerven (SP) aan de minister van Economische Zaken en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over biovergisters (ingezonden 28 november 2012).

An SP MP asked the ministers about harmful gases released during biomass digestion, which substances may legally be digested, possible fraud in the sector, and how supply chains and installations are supervised. The state secretary replied that harmful gases are normally removed before combustion, that only listed co-digestion materials are allowed, that fraud is hard to quantify, and that supervision involves several bodies with sampling, while committing to a certification and enforcement review.
I have no insight into the efforts that provinces and municipalities make in enforcing the environmental permit.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de inspanningen die provincies en gemeenten leveren in het kader van de handhaving van de omgevingsvergunning.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Lodders over ‘Imker: neonicotinoïde is niet het probleem’

An MP asked the state secretary whether neonicotinoids used per instructions cause no bee problems, and about a German lab test and the varroa mite. The state secretary said the authorisations were based on the then-applicable framework, that EFSA's new assessment identified acute risks and data gaps, and that EU-level action is being pursued, while noting varroa is one factor and EFSA does not study causes of bee mortality.
That is why I have proposed to the European Commission that action be taken at Community level.
Daarom heb ik de Europese Commissie voorgesteld om op communautair niveau actie te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over een onlangs verleende vergunning voor een nertsenhouderij door de gemeente Putten

An MP asked the state secretary whether it is acceptable that the municipality of Putten granted a permit for a new mink farm just before the mink ban took effect, and whether steps can be taken to stop it. The state secretary answered that municipal environmental and building permits are assessed only on environmental and building criteria, so the ethical ground of the ban cannot be used to refuse them, and that no steps can be taken if the operator meets the ban's conditions.
Under the Wabo, the municipality therefore has no possibility to refuse a permit with a view to the Fur Farming Ban Act.
Op grond van de Wabo is er voor de gemeente dus geen mogelijkheid om een vergunning te weigeren met het oog op de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de illegale handel in antibiotica in de veehouderij

An MP asked the government about the illegal trade in antibiotics for livestock farming, including a seizure of 3.5 tonnes, whether the registration system could prevent such trade, and whether further illegal circuits exist and will be investigated. The state secretary answered that the practice is condemned, the network was detected and dismantled by the NVWA, registration cannot prevent illegality but aids enforcement, a new registration duty for antibiotic traders under the Animal Act is coming, and extra enforcement funding is provided, though no indication of further circuits currently exists.
We have no indication that the illegal network in question could have been detected (much) earlier.
Wij hebben geen indicatie dat het betreffende illegale netwerk (veel) eerder had kunnen worden opgemerkt.
Antwoord vragen Thieme (PvdD) over gewonden door jachtongelukken

An MP asked the state secretary about hunting accidents that injured passers-by and a relative, whether such incidents are tracked, and whether shooting-skill tests and hunting-licence validity should be tightened. The government answered that no centralised data on such injuries exists, that the existing hunting exam and annual licence renewal are adequate, and that the incidents give no reason to tighten the rules.
The requested data on the number of passers-by or other people hit by hunting rifle bullets are not kept in a centralised system.
De gevraagde gegevens over het aantal passanten of andere mensen dat geraakt werd door kogels uit jachtgeweren, worden niet in een gecentraliseerd systeem bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ouwehand over een vuurwerkverbod tijdens het broedseizoen

Member Ouwehand asked the state secretaries whether municipalities should be barred from permitting fireworks at events such as Queen's Day during the bird breeding season, citing a court ruling on Weesp. The state secretary replied that the court ruling concerned a handhavingsverzoek rejected by the Dienst Regelingen, not a municipal permit, and rejected a national fireworks ban, relying instead on the Flora- en faunawet's prohibition of intentional disturbance and organisers' duty to assess locations case by case.
I do not share your view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over het bericht dat de provincie Friesland 50 km aan wandelpaden over boerenland schrapt

MP Jacobi asks whether the province of Friesland's decision to fund no hiking-path applications under the Boerenlandpad scheme, and the resulting gaps in the historic farm-path network, is acceptable, and why the 1000 km target for 2013 is relevant. The state secretary answers that the national government has ended funding for hiking paths, that responsibility now lies with regional authorities, and that she will not step in, while acknowledging the 2013 target was 879 km with 207 km realised by 2011.
The national government has ended the funding for hiking paths.
Het Rijk heeft de financiering voor wandelpaden beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Dekken over de ontwikkelingen rond het geitenbedrijf in Ambt Delden, en de relatie volksgezondheid en intensieve veehouderij

An MP asks whether a goat farm in Ambt Delden keeping about 1000 goats without proper permit has a valid permit, whether a plan for 5000 goats is pending, and how this fits with the cabinet's position on maximum farm size and public health risks such as Q fever. The state secretary replies that the environmental permit is still under review after public consultation, that the government will issue a policy response on the Health Council advice by 1 March 2013 including on size limits, fine particulate matter and buffer distances, and that vaccination of goats makes elevated Q fever risk for residents unlikely.
The cabinet will give Parliament a policy response to this advice no later than 1 March 2013.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer uiterlijk 1 maart 2013 een beleidsreactie geven op dit advies.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over meer stroperij door vermindering van toezicht

MP Thieme (PvdD) asks whether reduced numbers of nature wardens (BOA's) and planned job cuts at Staatsbosbeheer increase poaching, and whether nature oversight should be independent of landowners and hunting organisations. State Secretary Dijksma answers that about 800 green BOA's are active, that most are employed by nature organisations, provinces and municipalities rather than hunting bodies, that poaching is mainly a police/security matter, and that oversight of BOA's is exercised by the functional prosecutor.
Supervision of nature in the Netherlands is independent.
Het toezicht in de Nederlandse natuur is onafhankelijk.

Vragen van het lid Geurts (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken en de minister en staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht «Zeven boeren per dag stoppen ermee» (ingezonden 5 december 2012).

An MP asks the state secretaries of Economic Affairs and Finance about reports that seven farmers a day are quitting, citing ageing, discouraged successors, tax burdens on red diesel and insurance tax, bank financing demands and consumer prices. The government replies that farm exits are a long-running 3% annual trend, points to existing tax and subsidy support, notes the red diesel rate is being abolished, and says tighter bank scrutiny is a healthy development.
Yes, I am aware that banks are imposing increasing requirements.
Ja, het is mij bekend dat banken toenemende eisen stellen.

MPs Depla and Kraneveldt-van der Veen asked the education state secretaries whether a Den Helder primary school foundation's sponsorship of a basketball club, with its name on team shirts and €8,000 paid from the state grant, is permissible. The government said the arrangement is sponsorship, that using state funds for advertising breaches the funding rules, and that it will ask the Inspectorate to act and request the foundation to end the arrangement.
I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to take this signal under consideration and inform the Meerwerf Basisscholen foundation by letter of my request to end this sponsorship.

Ik zal de Inspectie van het Onderwijs verzoeken om dit signaal in behandeling te nemen en de Stichting Meerwerf Basisscholen per brief in kennis te stellen van mijn verzoek om deze sponsoring te beëindigen.

m: Amendement van het lid Ergin over het vastleggen van de mogelijkheid onderwijs op afstand te volgen

Lets the school's competent authority decide to provide distance or hybrid education to chronically ill students when needed for continuity of education, after consultation with parents or the student.

If the competent authority, after consulting the legal entity and the parents of the sick pupil or the pupil themselves if adult, judges it necessary for continuity of education, distance education is provided.

Indien het bevoegd gezag, na overleg met de rechtspersoon en de ouders van de zieke leerling dan wel, indien de leerling meerderjarig is, met de zieke leerling zelf, van oordeel is dat dit met het oog op de continuïteit van het onderwijs noodzakelijk is, wordt het onderwijs op afstand verzorgd.

Motie van de leden Beckerman en Ergin over onderzoeken op welke wijze studenten die gedupeerd zijn vanwege de fraudeaanpak door DUO financieel gecompenseerd kunnen worden
Asks the government to investigate how students harmed by DUO's fraud-control approach can be financially compensated.
requests the government to investigate how students harmed by DUO's fraud approach can be financially compensated
verzoekt de regering om te onderzoeken op welke wijze studenten die gedupeerd zijn vanwege de fraudeaanpak door DUO financieel gecompenseerd kunnen worden
Motie van het lid Ergin over de ambities op het gebied van kansengelijkheid in de komende jaren in stand houden en prioriteren
Asks the government to maintain and prioritise equal opportunity ambitions in education in the coming years.
requests the government to maintain and prioritise equal opportunity ambitions also in the coming years
verzoekt de regering de ambities op het gebied van kansengelijkheid ook in de komende jaren in stand te houden en te prioriteren
Motie van het lid Ergin over vaart zetten achter de implementatie van de aanbevelingen van de Inspectie Overheidsinformatie en Erfgoed

Asks the government to speed up implementing the Inspectorate's recommendations on incomplete archiving of chat messages at the Prime Minister's ministry, and to report to parliament quarterly on progress.
also requests the government to inform the House quarterly during the current year about progress
verzoekt de regering tevens de Kamer gedurende het lopende jaar per kwartaal te informeren over de voortgang
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 130 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euro within the health budget from unallocated funds to pilot specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics for two years.
With this amendment money is made available for two years, after which the clinics can be financed through the regular funding method
Met dit amendement wordt voor twee jaar geld vrijgemaakt, daarna kunnen deze klinieken volledig gefinancierd worden vanuit de reguliere financieringsmethodiek
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 42 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Moves 27 million euro in 2024 to a budget line for specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics by lowering the undistributed reserve.
This amendment therefore binding lowers the commitment and expenditure amounts in article 11 by 27 million euro.
Met dit amendement worden daarom taakstellend het verplichtingen- en uitgavenbedrag in artikel 11 verlaagd met € 27 miljoen.
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 131 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euros from the unallocated article 11 to curative care to fund specialised post-COVID outpatient clinics.
