This amendment raises the commitment appropriation in article 2 (Curative Care) by 27 million euros and the expenditure amount by 12 million euros in 2024.
Dit amendement verhoogt het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 2 (Curatieve Zorg) met € 27 miljoen en het uitgavenbedrag met € 12 miljoen in 2024.
Motie van de leden Dobbe en Ergin over gedurende het proces bij het Internationaal Gerechtshof geen militaire goederen aan Israël leveren
Asks the government not to deliver military goods to Israel while the International Court of Justice case is ongoing.
requests the government not to supply military goods to Israel during the proceedings at the International Court of Justice
verzoekt de regering om gedurende het proces bij het Internationaal Gerechtshof geen militaire goederen aan Israël te leveren
Motie van het lid Nordkamp c.s. over het in kaart brengen van het aandeel van in NAVO-landen geproduceerde defensieproducten dat naar buiten de NAVO weglekt
Asks the government to map the extent of NATO-made defence products leaking to non-NATO countries and report to the House.
requests the government to map the scope and developments
verzoekt de regering om in kaart te brengen wat de omvang en ontwikkelingen zijn
Motie van het lid Ergin c.s. over het onderzoeken van de mogelijkheden van een humanitaire luchtbrug en een maritieme corridor
Asks the government to keep exploring a humanitarian air bridge for medical aid to Gaza and a maritime corridor.
requests the government to keep investigating the possibilities for a maritime corridor
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden voor een maritieme corridor te blijven onderzoeken
Motie van het lid Ergin over het stopzetten van alle militaire samenwerking met Israël en het verbieden van alle activiteiten van de Israëlische wapenindustrie in Nederland
Asks the government to immediately end all military cooperation with Israel and ban activities of the Israeli arms industry in the Netherlands.
requests the government to immediately stop all military cooperation with Israel and to ban all activities of the Israeli arms industry in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering om alle militaire samenwerking met Israël per direct stop te zetten en alle activiteiten van de Israëlische wapenindustrie in Nederland te verbieden
Motie van het lid Slagt-Tichelman c.s. over een kasschuif toepassen om de bezuiniging op het scheiden van wonen en zorg terug te draaien
Asks the government to reverse the budget cut on separating housing and care by using a cash-shift to fund more nursing home places.
requests the government to reverse at the Spring Memorandum the saving linked to separating housing and care
verzoekt de regering om bij de Voorjaarsnota de bezuiniging die samenhangt met het scheiden van wonen en zorg en de huisvestingtarieven terug te draaien
Motie van de leden Dijk en Ergin over mondzorg opnemen in het basispakket
Asks the government to include dental care in the basic health insurance package.
requests the government to include dental care in the basic package
verzoekt de regering om mondzorg op te nemen in het basispakket
Motie van het lid Slagt-Tichelman c.s. over onderzoek naar een bekostingingsaanpassing om de specialist ouderengeneeskunde als regiebehandelaar mogelijk te maken
Asks the government to commission research into funding changes enabling specialists in geriatric medicine to act as care coordinators for elderly patients outside nursing homes.
requests the government to have research carried out into how adjustments in funding can contribute
verzoekt de regering onderzoek uit te laten voeren naar de wijze waarop aanpassingen in de bekostiging kunnen bijdragen
Motie van het lid Dijk c.s. over het eigen risico zo snel mogelijk afschaffen
Motion asks the government to abolish the health insurance deductible (eigen risico) as soon as possible.
requests the government to abolish the deductible as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering om het eigen risico zo snel mogelijk af te schaffen
Amendement van het lid Bushoff c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 37 over 27 miljoen euro voor post-COVID-poliklinieken
Shifts 27 million euro within the health budget from unallocated funds to post-COVID specialist outpatient clinics as a two-year pilot.
This amendment raises the commitment amount in article 2 (Curative Care) by 27 million euro
Dit amendement verhoogt het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 2 (Curatieve Zorg) met € 27 miljoen
Amendement van het lid Westerveld c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 55 over een overbruggingsregeling voor de tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten
Shifts 1 million euro per year in 2024 and 2025 within the subsidy budget for the civic service to fund a bridging transport-cost scheme for practical-education pupils.
The coverage for 2024 (1 million) and 2025 (1 million) is found within the subsidies instrument under the civic service rule.
De dekking voor 2024 (1 miljoen) en 2025 (1 miljoen) wordt gevonden binnen het instrument subsidies op de regel maatschappelijke diensttijd.
Motie van de leden Stultiens en Ergin over onderzoek naar de invoering van een wettelijke minimumstagevergoeding
Asks the government to study introducing a statutory minimum internship allowance, including its costs and implementation effects.
therefore requests the government to examine the introduction of such a minimum internship allowance
verzoekt daarom de regering om de invoering van zo'n minimale stagevergoeding te onderzoeken
Amendement van het lid Westerveld c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 40 over een overbruggingsregeling voor de tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten
Moves budget within education to fund a bridging scheme for reimbursing travel costs of practical-education pupils in 2024 and 2025.
This bridging scheme costs 1 million euro for 2024 and 1 million euro for 2025.
Deze overbruggingsregeling kost 1 miljoen euro voor 2024 en 1 miljoen euro voor 2025.
Motie van het lid Teunissen c.s. over gezonde en groene schoolpleinen
Asks the government to consult schools, municipalities and IVN and propose how national government can help realise greener school playgrounds, starting with the most vulnerable schools.
requests the government to consult with schools, municipalities and IVN
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met scholen, gemeenten en IVN
Motie van het lid Ergin c.s. over verkennen welke elementen uit het Stagepact mbo 2023-2027 kunnen worden toegepast bij het hbo en wo
Motion asking the government to explore applying elements of the mbo internship pact to hbo and wo to address internship discrimination.
requests the government to explore which elements of the mbo Internship Pact 2023-2027 can be applied to hbo and wo.
verzoekt de regering om te verkennen welke elementen uit het Stagepact mbo 2023–2027 toegepast kunnen worden bij het hbo en wo
Motie van het lid Ergin over een effectenverkenning van het oormerken van onderwijshuisvestingsmiddelen
Asks the government to carry out an impact assessment of earmarking school building funds, focused on the national school-housing improvement task.
requests the government to carry out an impact assessment of earmarking school housing funds
verzoekt de regering om een effectenverkenning uit te voeren van het oormerken van onderwijshuisvestingsmiddelen
Motie van het lid Ergin over de mogelijkheden verkennen van een second opinion in het kader van onderadvisering bij leerlingen met een migratieachtergrond
Asks the government to explore whether a second opinion can be introduced to counter under-advice of pupils with a migration background.
requests the government to explore whether enabling a second opinion is workable, effective and feasible
verzoekt de regering te verkennen of het mogelijk maken van een second opinion werkbaar, effectief en uitvoerbaar is
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de hersteloperatie

Ergin (DENK) asks the State Secretary for Finance how she reconciles her claim that nobody can say no one has been helped with thousands of childcare-benefit victims still waiting, struggling mentally or in poverty, and why the recovery operation repeats past failures and fails ex-partners, relatives and victims abroad. The State Secretary answers that nearly all parents received compensation and that remaining gaps are being addressed through new damage routes, a mental-health hub, a government-VNG agreement extending broad support and a budget extension, while largely rejecting the charge of repeating past patterns.
In the recovery operation the parent's story is leading and the starting point for compensation is generosity.
In de hersteloperatie is het verhaal van de ouder leidend en is het uitgangspunt voor compensatie ruimhartigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over een leerkracht van de Koning Willem-Alexanderschool in Culemborg die tot tweemaal toe een Free Palestine-shirt uittrekt bij Qasim (8)

An MP from DENK asked the state secretary for Education about a teacher at a Culemborg primary school who allegedly twice removed an eight-year-old pupil's Free Palestine shirt, and about the school's conduct, neutrality and duty of care. The state secretary replied that the case is with the College voor de Rechten van de Mens and the inspectorate found the board acted properly, so no enforcement is planned, while saying schools set their own rules within legal frameworks and no specific guidance will be issued.
It is not for me, but for the inspectorate, to assess whether a school acts in breach of the duty of care.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de inspectie om te beoordelen of een school handelt in strijd met de zorgplicht.
Antwoord op vragen lid Ergin over het uitstelbericht onderzoek naar aangetroffen documenten bij de Belastingdienst op nationaliteit en postcode

An MP asked why the Belastingdienst investigation into spreadsheets selecting on nationality and postcode was delayed from June to December 2025, and requested the full methodology and correspondence with the Auditdienst Rijk. The State Secretary attributed the delay to added independent review by the ADR and promised the report and correspondence after the Christmas recess, while declining to share the full methodology before then.
I regard your request to share correspondence about this delay and the contact between the Belastingdienst and the ADR as a request for information under Article 68 of the Constitution.

Ik beschouw uw verzoek om correspondentie te delen over dit uitstel en het contact tussen de Belastingdienst en de ADR hierover, als een vraag om inlichtingen overeenkomstig artikel 68 uit de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over ‘correspondentie inzake versterkte gebedsoproepen buurtonderzoek’

The MP asks the State Secretary to release the full correspondence and any neighbourhood study concerning the government's trajectory on amplified call-to-prayer (versterkte gebedsoproepen). The State Secretary declines to release the full correspondence for now, citing business-sensitive information about the contractor relationship and promising to publish the rest after the trajectory ends, and states that the dialogues are not a neighbourhood study so none can be released.
The full correspondence on the trajectory surrounding the amplified call-to-prayer cannot yet be shared by me at this stage.
De volledige correspondentie over het traject rondom de versterkte gebedsoproepen kan ik in deze fase nog niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over correspondentie Catshuissessie moslimdiscriminatie

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs to release the full correspondence received after a Catshuis session on Muslim discrimination, including messages from participants who described feeling ill and felt politicians present facilitated anti-Muslim hatred. The State Secretary refused, arguing the messages were shared in confidence and publication would undermine citizens' trust in contacting ministers.
Therefore I do not consider it desirable to make the correspondence you requested public.
Daarom acht ik het niet wenselijk om de door u gevraagde correspondentie openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ‘Palestijnse journalist Mustafa Ayash aangehouden op Schiphol’

An MP from DENK asked the Justice and Education ministers whether Netherlands should refuse extradition of journalists, whether extradition to Israel is possible, and how press freedom and detentions of people suspected of international crimes are handled. The minister answered that he cannot comment on pending surrender requests, explained the European Arrest Warrant grounds for refusal assessed by the court, noted PersVeilig funding and that the Marechaussee found no detentions for suspected Israeli international crimes since 7 October 2023.
I cannot make statements about any pending surrender requests.
Over eventuele lopende overleveringsverzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen de leden van Baarle en Ergin over het rapport ‘Tussen Minaret en Ministerie’ Ministerie’

Two DENK MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers how the government will restore trust among mosque boards and Muslim communities after the 'Tussen Minaret & Ministerie' report, and whether it will apologise, ban discriminatory policy, appoint a national coordinator against anti-Muslim hatred and hold structured dialogue. The government answered that rebuilding trust is needed and it is pursuing dialogue, a discrimination test in the Beleidskompas, and periodic talks with Muslim organisations, but it declined a separate anti-Muslim-hatred coordinator in favour of a single coordinator for all discrimination grounds.

Nevertheless, the cabinet considers it desirable that the other grounds of discrimination be housed in a single institute, so that fragmentation of attention and approach to these grounds is prevented.
Desalniettemin acht het kabinet het wenselijk dat de overige discriminatiegronden bij één instituut belegd worden, zodat versnippering van de aandacht en aanpak van deze gronden voorkomen wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het wetsvoorstel van het lid Ouwehand

An MP asked the agriculture minister about a private member's bill on animal slaughter, including whether it exceeds EU minimum rules and affects religious freedom. The minister answered that the bill is an initiative of parliament, that notification to the EC is a procedural step without implying government support, and that the government will form its view later in the process.
The process of handling it is of course also for your House.
Het proces van behandeling daarvan is uiteraard ook aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht dat bijna 1 op de 3 mensen in armoede problematische schulden heeft

An MP asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about CBS data showing nearly one in three people in poverty have problematic debts, and about the policy response and the reach of debt relief. The State Secretary acknowledges the figures, attributes the rise partly to resumed tax collection and business payment deferral ending, and points to the National Programme on Poverty and Debt, debt-relief reforms and early-warning measures, without accepting that current policy is ineffective.
The cabinet considers it important to help people with financial worries and to reduce the consequences of poverty and debt problems.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om mensen met geldzorgen te helpen en de gevolgen van armoede- en schuldenproblematiek te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Ergin over de voortgangsbrief Actieagenda Integratie en Open en Vrije Samenleving

An MP from DENK asked the state secretary about the need to regulate amplified calls to prayer, the planned baseline survey and data collection on mosques, and whether other religious denominations are covered. The state secretary answered that a survey of municipalities is underway to map experienced problems, that proposals will follow in early 2026, that municipalities hold the data and regulatory powers, and that the survey also covers other religious amplified sounds.
This data, including the number of mosques using amplified calls to prayer and how often, should be known to the municipalities where those mosques are located.

Deze gegevens, waaronder het aantal moskeeën dat gebruikmaakt van de versterkte gebedsoproep en de frequentie daarvan, zouden bij de gemeenten waarin de betreffende moskeeën zijn gevestigd bekend moeten zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over “de opdracht die de staatssecretaris van Financiën – Fiscaliteit, Belastingdienst en Douane aan de Belastingdienst heeft verstrekt inzake de analyse van de 14 spreadsheets”

MP Ergin asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Belastingdienst's analysis of 14 spreadsheets with nationality-based selections, how it will be carried out, who supervises it, whether it will be externally tested, and why 35 postcode-based spreadsheets were excluded. The government answered that the analysis follows the Selectie aan de Poort compensation approach, that the Auditdienst Rijk will independently review it with reporting after summer 2025, and that the 35 postcode spreadsheets are now included after a legal analysis.
In June 2025 the Belastingdienst will deliver the analysis to the Auditdienst Rijk.
In juni 2025 zal de Belastingdienst de analyse aanleveren aan de ADR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het verbod op gebedsrituelen op het Cobbenhagenlyceum

An MP asked the government whether a Tilburg secondary school's refusal to allow prayer during breaks violates religious freedom and equal treatment law. The State Secretary answered that the school denies any prayer ban, that a special school may require adherence to its denominational principles under the Awgb, and that the Inspectorate and courts, not the government, would assess compliance, so no new measures are planned.
These bodies will assess case by case whether the school's policy is indeed in line with the law.
Deze instanties zullen van geval tot geval beoordelen of het beleid van de school inderdaad in overeenstemming is met de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ‘Leerlingen mogen niet bidden op school: ‘Als je wordt gepakt krijg je straf’

MP Ergin (DENK) asked the state secretary for Education about reports that over 180 secondary schools ban prayer, and whether this breaches pupils' rights. The state secretary replied that public schools may not forbid prayer but need not facilitate it, that pupils can seek redress via the Equal Treatment Commission, courts or the Inspectorate, and that no additional measures or guidelines are planned.
If pupils nevertheless feel discriminated against, I call on them to discuss this with the school before taking legal steps.
Als leerlingen zich toch gediscrimineerd voelen, dan roep ik ze op om daarover met de school in gesprek te gaan vóórdat ze juridische stappen ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ''Het gaat heel ver dat bewindspersonen en politici zich online tegen individuele burgers keren''

An MP asked the state secretary for Social Affairs whether the government's distancing from a public figure's remarks on children's names was based on accurate facts, and whether it would apologise since the quoted words were taken out of context. The state secretary stood by the principle that parents may freely choose names, declined to apologise, said the government did not act to have the article removed, and answered each question briefly.
I have since spoken with the person concerned. We established that we share the message that people in the Netherlands must always have the freedom to choose a name they want.
Ik heb inmiddels met betrokkene gesproken. We hebben vastgesteld dat we de boodschap delen dat mensen in Nederland altijd de vrijheid moeten hebben om een naam te kiezen die zij willen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over "de beantwoording van ingezonden vragen d.d. 6 december 2024” (n.a.v. bericht ‘Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los’)

MP Ergin asked when the SCP was commissioned to update the SIM survey, whether the commissioning letter will be shared, how the government will implement the Becker motion, and how it responds to criticism from the NCDR and mosque federations. The State Secretary answered that the formal request was sent on 4 October 2024 and the assignment confirmed on 27 November 2024, that the letter cannot be shared due to procurement and budget details, and that the SIM2025 was already planned and is carried out independently by the SCP.
The assignment letter to the SCP contains financial information about the available budget and therefore cannot be sent in full to the House for procurement reasons.
De opdrachtbrief aan het SCP bevat financiële informatie over het beschikbare budget en kan derhalve om aanbestedingstechnische redenen niet integraal worden toegestuurd aan de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over dreigende incidenten bij een islamitische basisschool in Nijmegen

An MP from DENK asked the Education Minister whether threatening incidents at an Islamic primary school in Nijmegen, and a possible pattern of anti-Muslim hostility toward Islamic schools, warrant concern, and how the state safeguards such schools. The State Secretary said there are no concrete signals of danger, that safety rules apply equally to all schools, and that the police handle the investigation and the schools cooperate with partners, without acknowledging a pattern.
OCW has no knowledge of the perpetrators and their motives because investigating this incident is a task of the police.
OCW heeft geen kennis omtrent de daders en hun motieven omdat het onderzoeken van dit incident een taak is van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het verbod op bidden tijdens pauzes bij Zadkine

An MP asked ministers about the Zadkine school's ban on prayer during breaks and its compliance with equal-treatment law. The minister says the institution's email was withdrawn, pauses are free time, and the school is revising its student statute and discussing quiet rooms, with no further national measures planned.
The Zadkine board states that the wording of the email was unfortunate and gave rise to misunderstandings.
Het bestuur van Zadkine geeft aan dat de formulering van de betreffende e-mail ongelukkig gekozen is en aanleiding geeft tot misverstanden.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Dijk, Stultiens, Vijlbrief, Koekkoek, Grinwis en Ergin over de brandbrief van enkele fracties inzake voortgang van de Hersteloperatie Toeslagen na het aftreden van Staatssec

Seven MPs from several parties asked the Prime Minister to respond to a letter raising concern that the Toeslagen recovery operation was stalling after the resignation of State Secretary Achahbar. The new State Secretary Palmen responded that a rapid-advice commission will report on 23 January, a pilot for bereaved relatives has started, the claims portal opens in late January, and the government commits to finishing Integrale Beoordelingen by end 2025, while acknowledging backlogs in objections and dossier provision.
This commission has the task, with regard to the needs of those affected, of examining how the implementation of the Toeslagen recovery operation can be accelerated and improved.
Deze commissie heeft tot taak om, met oog voor de behoeften van de gedupeerden, te onderzoeken op welke wijze de uitvoering van de hersteloperatie toeslagen kan worden versneld en verbeterd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de nieuwe Rapportage Integratie en Samenleven 2024

An MP asked the state secretary for a government reaction to the 2024 CBS integration report before a committee debate, and whether he still stands by his statement that a large part of Muslim youth does not share Dutch norms and values. The state secretary replied that the questions came too late for a written answer, that he reflected on his statements during the committee debate and still stands by them, and that the report will inform the Actieagenda Integratie due in 2025.
In the committee debate I reflected on my statements, which I still stand by.
In het WGO heb ik een reflectie gegeven op mijn uitspraken, waar ik nog steeds achter sta.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het gebruik van AI-systemen door de overheid en de risico’s daarvan waar niet naar wordt gekeken

An MP asked the State Secretary of Interior Affairs about government AI use, the lack of risk analyses found by the Court of Audit, low registration in the algorithm register, and discrimination safeguards and compensation. The State Secretary largely pointed to existing instruments, the AI Regulation timelines, a planned discrimination protocol and ongoing work, without committing to new binding measures.
All departments have committed to having registered at least the high-risk AI systems by the end of 2025.
Alle departementen hebben toegezegd ten minste de hoog-risico AI-systemen eind 2025 geregistreerd te hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht 'Veel schade bij basisschool na brand begint nu wel een patroon te worden'

An MP from DENK asked the State Secretary for Education whether arson and vandalism at an Islamic primary school showed a worrying pattern, whether threats to Islamic institutions were tracked, and what preventive measures would be taken. The State Secretary said he had no signals of heightened threat, that such incidents are the responsibility of police, prosecutors and the municipality, that the ministry keeps no overview of threats to schools, and that the Inspectorate supervises school safety, while largely referring the matter to other bodies.
Such an overview is not maintained by the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science.
Een dergelijk overzicht wordt niet door het Ministerie van OCW bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de mishandeling van een bejaarde vrouw in Den Haag

An MP from DENK asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the serious assault on an elderly woman in The Hague, police and housing corporation response, and anti-Muslim discrimination. The minister answers that the case is under prosecution, that police responded to two complaints, that privacy limits further detail, and that a national study on Muslim discrimination will report in early 2025.
Because of the privacy of both parties, I cannot go into the substance of this case further.
Vanwege de privacy van de beide partijen kan ik verder niet inhoudelijk op deze casus ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ‘Kamermotie over onderzoek naar Nederlanders met migratieachtergrond maakt veel los’

An MP asks whether a parliamentary motion to study Dutch citizens with a migration background as a distinct group, and its possible stigmatising effects, can be justified, and asks the government to reconsider. The government replies that the SCP survey covers the entire population, that its scope is not being narrowed or changed, and that it sees no reason to reconsider.
The cabinet notes that the motion has caused considerable upheaval in society. The cabinet will carry out the implementation of the motion very carefully.
Het kabinet constateert dat de motie veel commotie te weeg heeft gebracht in de samenleving. Het kabinet zal de uitvoering van de motie heel zorgvuldig ter hand nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de eerdere vragen 2024Z18293

An MP asks the state secretary for an exhaustive list of the Dutch norms and values he referred to, and of the groups said not to accept or respect them, and asks how his claim that a large part of Muslim youth does not share these values fits with his claim that most Dutch Muslims are well integrated. The secretary declines to give an exhaustive list, says most people participate, and argues that the apparent contradiction is not one since most Muslim youth take part while intolerant conduct occurs within that group too.
It is not possible to give an exhaustive enumeration here, because society is constantly in motion and integration is not static.
Het is niet mogelijk om hier een limitatieve opsomming van te geven, want de samenleving is continue in beweging en integratie is niet statisch.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten, Krul, Paternotte, Stultiens, Kostić, Beckerman, Eerdmans, Dassen, Ergin, Stoffer en Ceder over het bericht 'Bezorgdheid om bezuinigingsplannen onderwijs: 'Maakt Nederland op lange

MPs from several parties asked the government about the education, research and innovation budget cuts, their effect on the economy, productivity, startups, internships in care and agriculture innovation. The minister answered that the cuts were a political trade-off, that the government cannot reliably model long-term growth effects, and that a number of impacts cannot be quantified in advance.
It is not possible to give a precise estimate of the consequences of this for welfare.
Het is niet mogelijk om een precieze inschatting te geven van de gevolgen hiervan op de welvaart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht ‘Na geweld in Amsterdam laait politieke discussie over integratie weer op’

An MP from DENK asks the State Secretary for Social Affairs about his remark, made after violence in Amsterdam, that Muslim youth largely do not share Dutch norms and values, and asks for evidence, a list of the norms at issue, and a retraction. The State Secretary confirms the remark on behalf of the cabinet, cites research on antisemitism among some Muslim youth while stressing it also occurs among other groups, and says he does not blame all Muslim youth but will keep speaking out on the problem.
I do not make this observation a reproach toward all Islamic youth.
Ik maak met deze constatering geen verwijt richting alle islamitische jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk, Beckerman, Pijpelink en Ergin over het delen van alternatieve opties voor het uitstellen van de curriculumherziening

Four MPs asked the State Secretary for Education to share a scenario exploration document on revising the core objectives (kerndoelen) before a committee debate on the curriculum reform. The State Secretary refused, citing the convention that documents prepared for cabinet and sub-committee deliberations are not made public to protect cabinet unity.
In line with cabinet-wide disclosure policy, documents prepared for the Council of Ministers and its sub-committees are in principle not made public in order to safeguard the unity of cabinet policy.

In lijn met het kabinetsbrede beleid rondom openbaarmaking worden stukken ter voorbereiding van de ministerraad en onderraden in principe niet openbaar gemaakt om de eenheid van kabinetsbeleid te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over de extreem lange wachttijden voor EU-ingezetenen bij de Europese grensovergangen

An MP asked the government about very long waiting times at EU external border crossings affecting EU residents, and whether it would raise the issue with the relevant countries, assess their capacity, and press for improvements in Europe. The government answered that the delays are a seasonal summer peak, that embassies received few complaints, that it sees no reason for bilateral action, and that systematic checks are necessary for Schengen security.
The cabinet therefore sees no reason to raise the perceived long waiting times with the authorities concerned.
Het kabinet ziet dan ook geen aanleiding om de gepercipieerde lange wachttijden op te brengen bij de betreffende autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Ergin over het bericht ‘Van plofkip tot slacht: hoe heilig is het halalkeurmerk in de supermarkt eigenlijk’

MPs El Abassi and Ergin asked whether supermarkets selling halal-certified chicken that is actually cheaper plofkip (broiler) meat amount to consumer deception, and whether ACM, NVWA oversight of halal slaughter and the 2012 convenant are adequate. The minister replied that supermarkets' move to BLk1* chicken is a private initiative outside government judgment, that halal certification is a private matter with no government role, and that existing accreditation and inspection frameworks are sufficient, committing to no new action.
The halal certification mark is a private initiative.
Het halal keurmerk betreft een privaat initiatief.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ergin over het bericht 'Ministerie van Sociale Zaken informeert mensen actief over onrechtmatige verwerking van persoonsgegevens'

An MP from DENK asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the unlawful processing of personal data on salafism and radicalisation, asking how many people were affected, how many access requests were filed and handled, the cause, whether apologies were given, and preventive measures. The minister said 12 of the first 131 access requests revealed unlawful processing, that apologies were sent, that proactive notification and an investigation by the Data Protection Authority are pending, and that the deadline for requests is extended to 31 July.
I therefore expect to be able to inform your House only after the summer about the total of unlawful processing of personal data.
Ik verwacht daarom uw Kamer pas na de zomer te kunnen informeren over het totaal aan onrechtmatige verwerkingen van persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden El Abassi en Ergin over het NOS-bericht “Problemen op werk door uitspraken over Gaza-Israël, soms zelfs ontslag"

MPs El Abassi and Ergin asked ministers about a NOS report on employees facing problems at work, even dismissal, over pro-Palestinian statements, asking whether civil servants can be ordered to remove online posts, whether dismissal for such posts is justified, what they will do about reported unsafe workplaces, whether a national reporting point will be set up, and whether a DJI employee was dismissed on the spot for sharing a video. The minister answered that civil servants have free speech subject to limits in the Ambtenarenwet, that dismissal is a matter for courts and the employer, that the government will strengthen workplace safety and consider mandatory codes and complaint procedures, but declined to create a national reporting point and declined to comment on individual cases.
This concerns a matter between an employer and an employee. As is customary, individual cases are not discussed.
Dit betreft een aangelegenheid tussen een werkgever en een medewerker. Zoals gebruikelijk wordt er niet ingegaan op individuele casuïstiek.

m: Motie van het lid De liefde over postzegels met verschillende snelheden en prijzen
Asks the government to investigate how stamps with different speeds and prices could be offered within the universal postal service (UPD).
requests the government to investigate how stamps with different speeds and prices can be realised within the UPD
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken hoe postzegels met verschillende snelheden en prijzen binnen de UPD gerealiseerd kunnen worden
Motie van het lid De Liefde over de door de ACM aan het bedrijfsleven doorberekende kosten
Asks the government to limit the ACM costs passed on to business to at most one third of the ACM budget in coming years.
requests the government to limit the costs charged to business to at most a third of the ACM budget in the coming years
verzoekt de regering, de doorberekende kosten aan het bedrijfsleven de komende jaren maximaal een derde van de ACM-begroting te laten beslaan
Motie van het lid De Liefde over modernisering van de wetgeving inzake telecommunicatie
Asks the government to propose modernised telecom, media, privacy and copyright legislation in 2014.
Requests the government to send proposals to modernise laws on telecoms, media, privacy and copyright.
verzoekt de regering, in 2014 voorstellen naar de Kamer te sturen om waar nodig wet- en regelgeving over onder andere telecommunicatie, media, privacy en auteursrecht te moderniseren
Motie De Liefde over de bevoegdheden van de ACM
Asks the government to instruct the ACM to explain in its decisions why a lighter instrument was not chosen, in line with proportionality and motivation duties.
requests the government to instruct the ACM to also make clear in the motivation of its decisions why a lighter instrument was not chosen
verzoekt de regering, de ACM op te dragen bij de motivering van besluiten ook duidelijk te maken waarom niet voor een lichter instrument is gekozen
Amendement van de leden Mei Li Vos en De Liefde over het inzichtelijk maken van de kostentoerekening door de verlener van de universele postdienst
Requires universal postal service provider to make its cost and revenue allocation transparent to the ACM, with details set by regulation.
A universal service provider makes the allocation of costs and revenues of the universal postal service and of other activities transparent to the Authority for Consumers and Markets.

Een verlener van de universele dienst maakt de toerekening van de kosten en opbrengsten van de universele postdienst en de kosten en opbrengsten van andere activiteiten inzichtelijk aan de Autoriteit Consument en Markt.
Amendement van de leden Mei Li Vos en De Liefde over het vijf maal per week ophalen en bezorgen van poststukken
Amends the postal rules so that letters are collected six days a week only for mourning and medical letters, while general post collection drops to five days.
This article provides that collecting post is only required five days a week.
Dit artikel regelt dat het ophalen van de post slechts vijf dagen per week wordt verplicht.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid De Liefde c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over het verkorten van de periode waarna de Wet op de vaste boekenprijs geevalueerd dient te worden van vijf naar vier jaar
Shortens from five to four years the interval after which the Fixed Book Price Act must be evaluated.
and thereafter every five years replaced by: and thereafter every four years.
en vervolgens telkens na vijf jaar» vervangen door: en vervolgens telkens na vier jaar.
Amendement van het lid De Liefde over het verkorten van de periode waarna de uitgever en de importeur de vaste boekenprijs kunnen opheffen tot een periode van 6 maanden
Shortens the period after which publisher and importer may end the fixed book price from one year to six months.
It has become apparent that most copies of a new title are sold directly after publication.
Gebleken is dat de meeste exemplaren van een nieuwe titel direct na de verschijning worden verkocht.
Amendement van het lid De Liefde c.s. over het verkorten van de periode waarna de Wet op de vaste boekenprijs geëvalueerd dient te worden te verkorten van vijf naar drie jaar
Shortens from five to three years the interval for evaluating the Book Price Act.
en vervolgens telkens na drie jaar
Amendement van het lid De Liefde over het verkorten van de periode waarvoor de vaste boekenprijs geldt
Shortens the period after which publishers and importers may change the fixed book price from six months to three months.
the phrase 'after a period of six months' is replaced by: after a period of three months
wordt de zinsnede «na verloop van een half jaar» vervangen door: na verloop van drie maanden
Amendement van de leden De Liefde en Voordewind over het uitzonderen van het Wetenschappelijk boek van de vaste boekenprijs
Proposes exempting scholarly books from the fixed book price law, aligning them with school books.
In article I, part A, the second part is replaced by two parts
In artikel I, onderdeel A, wordt het tweede onderdeel vervangen door twee onderdelen
Motie De Liefde over fiscale mogelijkheden voor schaatsaccommodaties
Asks the government to point initiators of skating venues to the tax options of the new Geefwet and to explore a skating lottery.
expresses that the government points initiators to the tax options of the new Geefwet and examines whether a skating lottery can be realised
spreekt uit dat de regering initiatiefnemers wijst op de fiscale mogelijkheden van de nieuwe Geefwet en onderzoekt of een schaatsloterij gerealiseerd kan worden
Motie De Liefde c.s. over de kunstvakopleidingen
Motion asks the government to reach firm agreements with art academies to substantially reduce intake and sharpen their profiles, redirecting freed funds to quality.
requests the government to reach firm agreements with art colleges on a substantial reduction in intake of programmes
verzoekt de regering te komen tot scherpe afspraken met kunstvakhogescholen over een substantiële reductie van de instroom van opleidingen
Motie De Liefde c.s. over misleidende reclame-uitingen

Asks the government to tackle misleading gambling advertising more strictly through the planned AMvB, ministerial rules, licence conditions and Kansspelautoriteit enforcement policy, with heavy sanctions and licence revocation for repeat offences.
requests the government to further elaborate this approach to misleading advertising in the announced General Administrative Order
verzoekt de regering deze aanpak van misleidende reclame-uitingen nader uit te werken in de aangekondigde Algemene Maatregel van Bestuur
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over de grote verschillen tussen de postzegelprijs voor consumenten en op de zakelijke markt

MP De Liefde asks why the universal postal service stamp price (73 cents in 2016) far exceeds business mail tariffs, and whether the difference reflects only collection method, and urges a market analysis by the ACM. Minister Kamp explains the gap by PostNL's legally mandated nationwide network, bulk-processing economies in business mail, declining volumes, and says the ACM confirmed the UPD tariff reflects actual costs, while the ACM is already analysing the 24-hour business market.
The cost difference mainly stems from the extensive network that PostNL, as UPD provider, is legally required to maintain.
Het verschil in kosten vloeit met name voort uit het uitgebreide netwerk dat PostNL als UPD-verlener wettelijk verplicht in stand moet houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over de bezuinigingen op het nationale standaardenlaboratorium VSL

The MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs about budget cuts to the national metrology institute VSL, their size, the reasoning behind them, and industry objections including alleged favouritism toward German clients. The Minister answers that the cuts follow from the Lenteakkoord and Rutte II, that a multi-year plan will be discussed with VSL and industry with results reported in spring 2016, and that the alleged discrimination is hard to substantiate but will be investigated at EU level.
I will inform your House in spring 2016 about the outcomes of that.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het voorjaar van 2016 over de uitkomsten daarvan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen het lid De Liefde over hoge servicekosten voor toegangskaarten

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs why businesses charge consumers card surcharges that exceed actual costs, which is unlawful, and whether the ACM's weak enforcement and low fines are acceptable, and whether fines will be raised. The minister said the ACM independently chooses its enforcement instruments, that fines should deter, and that a bill raising ACM fine maxima has been submitted, while the ACM decides itself whether to investigate surcharging.
The bill ... raises the maximum fines the ACM can impose under the laws it supervises.
Het wetsvoorstel ... verhoogt de maxima van de boetes die de ACM kan opleggen op grond van de wetten op de naleving waarvan zij toezicht houdt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over vleesaanbiedingen onder de € 4,12 per kilo zonder dierenwelzijnskeurmerk

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs why policy on cheap meat offers below 4.12 euro per kilo without an animal welfare label relies on unverified Wakker Dier figures, and how a 'reasonable price' is defined. The State Secretary largely referred to earlier answers, said policy is not based on Wakker Dier data, that price is set by market supply and demand, and pointed to existing price monitoring reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en De Boer over het ACM-besluit over de overtreding van de Spoorwegwet door NS

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary about an ACM finding that NS breached Article 67 of the Spoorwegwet, whether NS blocked publication and threatened a damages claim over the Limburg tender, and whether ACM would publish its decision and correspondence before the Spoorwegwet debate. The State Secretary confirmed one article was breached, said NS sought interim relief and announced a possible damages claim, and declined to request publication or correspondence, citing ACM's independence and pending legal proceedings, while committing to send the answers to Parliament.
Given the independence of the ACM, it is for the ACM and possibly the court to decide on making this information public.
Gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van de ACM is het aan de ACM en eventueel de rechter om te beslissen over het openbaar maken van deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over “vleesaanbiedingen onder € 4,12 per kilo zonder dierenwelzijnskeurmerk”

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs why she based her stance against meat offers below 4.12 euro per kilo without an animal welfare label on Wakker Dier's unverified figures, and asked for supporting data and comments on the sector. The state secretary answered that such offers are undesirable as a signal and for welfare and food safety reasons, that the ministry does not verify the Wakker Dier figures and conducts no own supermarket research, and that discounting near expiry is acceptable as it prevents food waste.
The Ministry of Economic Affairs does not conduct its own research into offers in supermarkets.
Het Ministerie van Economische Zaken voert geen eigen onderzoek uit naar aanbiedingen in supermarkten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Veen en De Liefde naar aanleiding van het bericht ‘ICT-sector trekt weg’

MPs Van Veen and De Liefde asked whether ICT firms are really leaving the Netherlands, how large any shortage of ICT staff is, and what is being done about it. The Minister answered that there is no evidence of an exodus, that firm startups and closures are roughly stable, that the ICT training intake is rising, and listed programmes such as the Techniekpact and the sector plan.
I have no information showing that the ICT sector is leaving the Netherlands.
Ik heb geen informatie waaruit blijkt dat de ICT-sector wegtrekt uit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leegte, De Liefde en Ziengs over activiteiten van netbeheerbedrijven op de markt voor laadpalen voor elektrische auto’s

MPs from the VVD asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether grid operators' commercial activity in the electric vehicle charging-point market, via subsidiary Allego, creates an unfair level playing field and whether this should be prohibited. The minister acknowledged the risk of cross-subsidy and unequal advantage, said grid operators should only perform statutory tasks in the forthcoming STROOM bill, and committed to clearer rules, transparent accounting and publication of anonymised information.
Grid operators may only carry out statutory tasks.
Netbeheerders mogen alleen wettelijke taken uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en De Liefde over de opkomst van de suzuki-fruitvlieg

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about the spread of the suzuki fruit fly, its damage to Dutch growers, control options such as parasitic nematodes, and the authorisation of the pesticide Tracer. The State Secretary answered that the sector is responsible for pest control, that the damage is estimated at 2 to 20 percent of unsaleable fruit without exact measurement, that small-scale trials of nematodes are underway, and that Tracer was authorised for some crops but refused for cherries.
The sector is itself responsible for combating diseases and pests in crops and also accepts this responsibility.
De sector is zelf verantwoordelijk voor de bestrijding van ziekten en plagen in gewassen en neemt deze verantwoordelijkheid ook op zich.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en De Liefde over de overname van Ziggo door Liberty Global (UPC)

MPs Oosenbrug and De Liefde asked the minister about the Liberty Global (UPC) takeover of Ziggo, its market effects, the EU conditions, and whether access regulation of KPN and cable networks is adequate. The minister answered that the EU Commission found no extra competition problems, that the ACM will keep regulating KPN's unbundled access, and that he will push at EU level to regulate both networks more easily.
I have asked the ACM to inform me one year after its final decision about developments in the internet, television and fixed telephony markets.
Ik heb de ACM verzocht mij een jaar na haar definitieve besluit te informeren over de ontwikkelingen in de internet-, televisie- en vaste telefoniemarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over het gebruik van cookies bij de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO)

An MP asked the minister whether the NPO's repeated use of tracking cookies without prior consent, flagged by the Dutch data protection authority, would be addressed and whether the CBP report would be sent to parliament. The minister declined to judge an independent regulator's individual decision, noted NPO has taken measures, and said websites must comply with the law without committing to concrete government action.
It is not for the cabinet to give a judgement on a decision of an independent supervisor in an individual case.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om een oordeel te geven over een besluit van een onafhankelijke toezichthouder in een individueel geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over de toegang tot het glasvezelnetwerk van Reggefiber

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the timing of the ACM's review of KPN's takeover of Reggefiber, whether competitors must keep access to the fibre network, whether non-discriminatory wholesale access is sufficient, and whether the ACM could be asked to answer the questions. The minister said the ACM will decide after the European Commission's Liberty Global/Ziggo decision, that the ACM is independent and the minister cannot pre-empt its review, that current access must be non-discriminatory, and that the ministry will report on EU telecom framework changes later in the year.
The ACM is an independent administrative body (ZBO). This means it has independent tasks and powers assigned to it directly by the legislature.
De ACM is een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (ZBO). Dat betekent dat zij zelfstandige taken en bevoegdheden heeft die door de wetgever direct aan haar zijn toebedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over de oorzaken van het teleurstellend lage aantal deelnemende boeren en tuinders aan de pilot eerlijke handelspraktijken

An MP asks why only one LTO cooperative has joined the fair trading practices pilot in agrofood, and what is being done about low farmer participation and anonymous complaint procedures. The Secretary of State says the pilot is self-regulatory, the steering group is responsible, outreach is ongoing, and a progress report will follow at end 2014 with evaluation at end 2015.
At the end of 2014 the Minister of Economic Affairs will send an interim report to your House.
Eind 2014 zal de Minister van Economische Zaken een tussenrapportage naar uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Elias over wie de baas is van 'de rode knop' op de afstandsbediening

MPs De Liefde and Elias (VVD) asked whether the government intends to resolve the dispute over who controls the 'red button' on TV remotes between broadcasters and cable/telecom providers, and how the legal rules differ between cable, IP-TV and over-the-top services. The State Secretary answered that the rules on must-carry obligations are technology-neutral since 1 January 2014, that the legislator cannot impose carriage obligations on specific techniques such as HbbTV, that the relevant rules will be reviewed and modernised later this year, and that carriage negotiations between providers and broadcasters are free commercial negotiations.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en De Liefde over het bericht «Geen progressie in open data»

MPs Moors and De Liefde asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of no progress on open data, the steps taken since November 2013, dataset counts per ministry, and how open data becomes the default. The minister listed actions taken (top-50 dataset list, portal upgrade, cost study, projects), said exact per-ministry counts are not available until a portal upgrade, and promised a cabinet proposal by end of September.
This is not known. Via data.overheid.nl there is not yet the possibility to monitor exact figures per ministry or other governments.
Dit is niet bekend. Via data.overheid.nl bestaat nog niet de mogelijkheid om exacte cijfers per ministerie of andere overheden te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Moors, Dijkhoff en Litjens over de opslag van vertrouwelijke data door overheidsorganisaties en semi-publieke instellingen

MPs from the VVD asked whether foreign intelligence services should be able to access confidential government data and where that data is stored by government and semi-public bodies. The minister answered that the central government is building a Rijkscloud within Dutch data centres, that subnational and semi-public bodies are responsible for their own security, and that a complete overview of storage locations cannot be given.

It is not possible to provide such an overview for all ministries, provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions, and as regards provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions it falls outside my responsibility.

Het is niet mogelijk om een dergelijk overzicht voor alle ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en de semi-publieke instellingen te geven en valt wat betreft provincies, gemeenten en de semi-publieke instellingen buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Neppérus en Litjens over fraude met vertrouwelijke gegevens die per reguliere post verzonden worden

MPs De Liefde, Neppérus and Litjens asked about fraud with confidential data sent by regular post, how often it occurs, who is liable, whether government letters should omit identifiers like BSN and bank numbers, and whether separate or courier delivery could reduce risk. Minister Plasterk answered that the postal law and regulator do not track misuse, liability is set by contracts or the universal service, identifiers are necessary for communication, and no new agreements or mandatory changes are planned, pointing to existing measures and digital channels.
It is therefore not possible to establish how often confidential data sent by post is misused.
Het is dan ook niet mogelijk te achterhalen hoe vaak er misbruik wordt gemaakt van vertrouwelijke gegevens die met de post worden verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra, Lodders, Visser en De Liefde over het einde aan de betutteling van het milieubeleid

MPs from the VVD asked whether the government's Duurzaam Doen website and planned environmental measures amount to an end to paternalism in environmental policy, and about its cost, related initiatives, and the basis for recommending meat reduction. The minister answered that the site offers practical guidance rather than mandates, cost about 49,909 euros, that similar initiatives exist, and that reducing meat consumption benefits health and sustainability per official reports.
The cabinet wants to make use of the energy and ambitions that many parties and residents in our country have in the area of environment and sustainability.
Het kabinet wil gebruik maken van de energie en ambities die veel partijen en bewoners in ons land hebben op het gebied van milieu en duurzaamheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en De Liefde over wifi-tracking door winkels

MPs Oosenbrug and De Liefde asked whether shops may collect device identifiers via wifi or bluetooth from people inside and passing by their stores, and whether shops must disclose this and whether the data protection authority will be asked to investigate. The state secretary answered that tracking inside a shop may be justified as a legitimate interest under the Dutch data protection act if limited to visitor counts and movement, but collecting data from passers-by on the public road requires consent, and the minister will discuss the issue with the data protection authority.
The Minister of Economic Affairs indicated at the general consultation with your House on 12 February that he would discuss this issue with the Data Protection Authority (CBP).
De Minister van Economische Zaken heeft tijdens het algemeen overleg met uw Kamer op 12 februari j.l. aangegeven dit vraagstuk te zullen bespreken met het College bescherming persoonsgegevens (CBP).

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Bosman en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat de aanleg van glasvezel in Caribisch Nederland twee keer duurder is dan begroot en volledig door de Nederlandse belastingbetaler wo

MPs from the VVD asked why the Caribbean Netherlands submarine fibre cable cost roughly double its budget, why the state took on extra costs, and why it became a shareholding in SSCS B.V. without prior parliamentary approval. The minister replied that costs exceeded the original estimate by about EUR 8.9 million (not a doubling), that the extra funds covered redundancy and protection, that the shareholding was a transitional choice under the Comptabiliteitswet, and that the company is non-profit with cost-based tariffs.
With my letter of 9 December I aimed to align as closely as possible, albeit retrospectively, with the normal procedure of Article 34.
Met mijn brief van 9 december jl. heb ik beoogd zoveel mogelijk, zij het achteraf, aan te sluiten bij de normale procedure van artikel 34.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Liefde over misleidende kortingen bij elektronicawinkels

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether discount claims in electronics shops and online, such as inflated reference prices and false 'last piece' claims, are misleading and what can be done. The Minister said misleading practices are unacceptable, referred the matter to the consumer authority ACM which enforces unfair trading rules with fines up to 450,000 euro, and judged existing legislation sufficient.
I have, however, informed the ACM of the practices described in the newspaper article.
Wel heb ik de ACM in kennis gesteld van de praktijken die in het krantenartikel worden beschreven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders, Bosman, De Liefde en Rudmer Heerema over nationale koppen ten aanzien van Europese regelgeving op het gebied van landbouw, natuur en visserij

MPs from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs for an overview of stricter-than-EU national rules (nationale koppen) affecting farmers, growers and fishers, including their regulatory-burden effects and planned reductions under the coalition agreement. The government answered that the overview was sent in September 2013 and a sector-specific regulatory-burden approach for agro and food is underway, with a table of measures and their burden effects, and no full list of nationale koppen per directive was given beyond the inventory of current rules.
Progress on the ambition to reduce regulatory burden by 2.5 billion euro by 2017 is reported to the House twice a year.
Over de voortgang ten aanzien van de ambitie om de regeldruk per 2017 met 2,5 miljard euro te verminderen wordt uw Kamer twee maal per jaar geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Lodders over vernieling van proefvelden met aardappelen in Valthermond en de gemeente Eemsmond

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary and justice minister about vandalised potato trial fields of Wageningen University in Valthermond and Eemsmond, including effects on blight-resistance research, prevention, penalties and recovery of damage, and group involvement and prosecution statistics. The government condemned the vandalism, said the research has not been significantly delayed, described cameras and resilience measures, outlined the maximum penalty and civil recovery routes, and stated that perpetrators have not been identified and protest groups are not registered.
Despite police efforts on this case, because the vandals acted extremely covertly, it has so far not been possible to trace those responsible for these incidents.
Ondanks de inzet van de politie op dit dossier is het vanwege het uiterst heimelijke optreden door de vernielers vooralsnog niet gelukt in verband met deze gevallen verantwoordelijken op te sporen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en de Liefde over een schadelijk buitenlands fruitvliegje dat de Nederlandse fruitoogst bedreigt

MPs Lodders and De Liefde asked why the government was slow to grant an exemption for a biological pesticide against the harmful spotted-wing drosophila fruit fly and what it will do to act faster. The state secretary answered that the fly is spreading in the Netherlands, that the exemption for Tracer was requested in March and has now been granted for the affected crops, and did not commit to further specific reforms.
The agent has now been exempted for the mentioned crops.
Het middel is inmiddels vrijgesteld voor de genoemde gewassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde en Mei Li Vos over de btw-vrijstelling die geldt voor PostNL

Two MPs asked the government about the VAT exemption for universal postal services that benefits PostNL, including its origins, its size and revenue cost, and whether the government would push for its abolition in Europe. The State Secretary confirmed the exemption covers only universal service parcels, explained its historical basis, declined to give volumes or revenue loss citing confidentiality, and said the Netherlands supports abolition, which the Commission withdrew, with a possible future proposal to be notified to parliament.
Due to the commercial confidentiality of the data, the exact size of the UPD share of the total market cannot be stated.
Door de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid van de gegevens, kan de exacte grootte van het UPD-aandeel in de totale markt niet worden aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lodders, De Liefde en Ten Broeke over het importverbod van Rusland op pootaardappelen en plantmateriaal

Three VVD MPs asked the state secretary for Economic Affairs and the foreign trade minister about Russia's import ban on Dutch seed potatoes and plant material, asking about EU and Dutch action, WTO compliance, and how to prevent such unilateral bans. The government answered that it keeps pressing the European Commission for quick follow-up talks with Russia, supports a derogation and traceability measures, and sees no WTO challenge yet, while acknowledging the ban harms Dutch growers.
I will keep urging the European Commission for swift follow-up steps given the major trade interests of Dutch business.
Ik zal bij de Europese Commissie blijven aandringen op spoedige vervolgstappen gezien de grote handelsbelangen van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en De Liefde over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten kiezen voor het vrijwillig melden van cybersecurity incidenten

Two MPs from the VVD asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Economic Affairs about reports that the United States opts for voluntary reporting of cybersecurity incidents while the EU proposes a mandatory reporting duty, and about the consequences for Dutch citizens, businesses and cloud computing. The minister answered that the EU proposal does include a reporting obligation, that Dutch legislation on a reporting duty is being prepared, that the US executive order relies on voluntary sharing with privacy safeguards, and that the government will take the differences into account in EU negotiations.
Antwoord vragen De Liefde en Lodders over het bericht ‘Jumbo verstuurt 3-procentsbrief aan leveranciers huismerk’

MPs De Liefde and Lodders asked the ministers of Economic Affairs about reports that Daymon unilaterally imposed a 3% discount on Jumbo's private-label suppliers and how this relates to the unfair trading practices code and related motions. The minister said commercial negotiations are a matter between firms, that the government facilitates a self-regulatory code with dispute resolution, that legislation would only be considered if self-regulation fails, and that the motions will be addressed by letters before summer.
The government should in principle interfere as little as possible in this.
De overheid hoort zich daarmee in beginsel zo min mogelijk te bemoeien.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Liefde over de postbezorging op de BES-eilanden

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about the postal service on the Caribbean Netherlands islands and whether the current operator, Nieuwe Post NV, is claiming about 2 million guilders in compensation for losses. The minister answered that no adequate accountant-backed evidence of losses was given and no legal basis for compensation exists, that an external exploration found alternative operators interested, and that the concession will be extended only up to one year while a new tender is prepared, with Parliament to be informed of the outcome.
I will inform your House of the outcomes of this tender process.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van dit gunningsproces.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Lodders en De Liefde over het terugvorderen van toegezegde middelen bij de voedingstuinbouwsector

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs about reclaiming GMO fruit and vegetable subsidies from the horticulture sector, including the environmental measure, and the resulting penalties and effects on accountant opinions. The State Secretary answered that the EU rules require the subsidies to be recovered, that no fine is imposed for not carrying out the programme, and that she sees no room to waive recovery.
European law therefore gives me no room in this situation to waive recovery.
Het Europees recht biedt mij dan ook in deze situatie geen ruimte om af te zien van terugvordering.
Antwoord vragen Lucas en De Liefde over het gegeven dat NWO en AMOLF een tafel hebben gekocht bij een fundraising-diner van Museum Boerhaave

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary why NWO and AMOLF (FOM) bought a €2,500 table at a fundraising dinner for Museum Boerhaave, given the ministry's policy of more private funding for that museum, and whether these costs were efficient spending. The state secretary acknowledged the purchase (about €2,082.50), agreed it is not efficient use of public money, said NWO will not use its funds for such purposes again, and declined to reclaim the amount given its small size.
I do not regard the expenditure on the fundraising dinner as an efficient use of public funds.
Ik beschouw de uitgaven voor het fundraising-diner niet als doelmatige besteding van overheidsmiddelen.

m: Motie van het lid Westerveld c.s. over de begrotingssystematiek voor de subsidieregeling abortusklinieken tot de volgende wetsevaluatie niet verder wijzigen
Asks the government not to change the budget method for the abortion clinic subsidy before the next evaluation of the Termination of Pregnancy Act, and to monitor financial effects.
requests the government, until the next evaluation of the Termination of Pregnancy Act, not to further change the budgeting method for the abortion clinic subsidy scheme

verzoekt de regering tot de volgende evaluatie van de Wet afbreking zwangerschap de gehanteerde systematiek voor de begroting van de middelen voor de subsidieregeling abortusklinieken niet verder te wijzigen
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over uitgewerkt beleid om het aantal abortussen en ongewenste zwangerschappen te verminderen
Asks the government to elaborate policy and measures to reduce abortions and unwanted pregnancies and report by 1 May.
requests the government to elaborate these goals into policy and measures and make proposals for this
verzoekt de regering deze doelen uit te werken in beleid en maatregelen en hiertoe voorstellen te doen
Motie van het lid Bikker c.s. over onderzoek naar de beweegredenen van vrouwen die een afbreking van zwangerschap overwegen
Asks the government to commission scientific research into the reasons women consider terminating a pregnancy.
requests the government to commission further in-depth (scientific) research into the reasons women considering termination of pregnancy
verzoekt de regering nader verdiepend (wetenschappelijk) onderzoek uit te laten voeren naar de beweegredenen van vrouwen die een afbreking van een zwangerschap overwegen
Amendement van het lid Hermans over het vervangen van Wzd-arts door Wzd-functionaris
Amendment replaces the term Wzd-arts with Wzd-functionaris, allowing non-physicians to give the external advice required under the Wzd, and removes the related extra paragraph.
The Wzd-functionaris can be either a physician or a health psychologist or orthopedagogue-generalist.
De Wzd-functionaris kan zowel een arts zijn als een gezondheidszorgpsycholoog of orthopedagoog-generalist.
Motie van het lid Hijink c.s. over knelpunten bij een deugdelijke uitvoering van het abonnementstarief
Asks the government to take measures with municipalities if monitoring shows implementation problems with the Wmo subscription tariff.
requests the government, based on the monitor results and in consultation with municipalities, to take measures
verzoekt de regering, om aan de hand van de uitkomsten van de monitor in samenspraak met gemeenten maatregelen te treffen
Motie van het lid Sazias c.s. over richtlijnen voor voeding- en maaltijdvoorziening op de goede plek laten landen
Asks the government to ensure that nutrition and meal guidelines reach older people, their supporters and carers.
requests the government to ensure that the guidelines, knowledge and information reach older people and their supporters and carers

verzoekt de regering, in het kader van het Pact voor de Ouderenzorg en de programma's die daar onderdeel van uitmaken en in overleg met Voedingscentrum, Stuurgroep Ondervoeding, gemeenten en verzekeraars, te zorgen dat de richtlijnen, kennis en informatie bij ouderen en hun ondersteuners en verzorgers terechtkomen
Amendement van de leden Slootweg en Hermans over 1,2 miljoen euro voor uitbreiding en verlenging van de technologie challenge
Shifts 1.2 million euro within the long-term care budget to extend and expand a technology challenge for nursing homes.
For this, 1.2 million euro is included in article 3 Long-term care and support, to be covered within the transition funds available there.
Hiervoor wordt 1,2 miljoen euro opgenomen in artikel 3 Langdurige zorg en ondersteuning, te dekken binnen de transitiemiddelen die daar beschikbaar zijn.
Motie van de leden Ellemeet en Hermans over belemmeringen voor kennisuitwisseling tussen verpleeghuis en de wijkverpleging
Asks the government to investigate barriers to knowledge exchange between nursing homes and district nursing and to find solutions.
requests the government to investigate what hinders knowledge exchange between the nursing home and district nursing
verzoekt de regering, te onderzoeken wat de kennisuitwisseling belemmert tussen het verpleeghuis en de wijk(verpleging)
Motie van de leden Hermans en Bergkamp over bevorderen dat mensen doorstromen naar een passende plek
Asks the government to explore how people with mild intellectual disabilities can move to the most suitable work or day-care place, linked to the Breed Offensief.
requests the government to map out how it can be promoted that people move on to the place most suitable for them
verzoekt de regering, in beeld te brengen op welke wijze bevorderd kan worden dat mensen doorstromen naar de voor hen meest passende plek
Amendement van de leden Bergkamp en Hermans ter vervanging van nr. 16 over 3,5 miljoen euro extra voor innovatieve gehandicaptenzorg
Moves €3.5 million within the health budget to increase the 2019 Innovation Impulse for disability care.
This impulse is increased by €3.5 million for 2019 with this amendment.
Deze impuls wordt met dit amendement opgehoogd met € 3,5 miljoen voor 2019
Amendement van de leden Bergkamp en Hermans over 3,5 miljoen euro extra voor innovatieve gehandicaptenzorg
Amendment moving 3.5 million euros within the long-term care article to fund an innovation impulse for disability care in 2019.
The coverage for this amendment for 2019 is found in the non-legally mandatory expenditures of article 3.
De dekking van dit amendement wordt voor 2019 gevonden in de niet-juridisch verplichte uitgaven van artikel 3.
Motie van het lid Bergkamp c.s. over de kwaliteit van zorg thuis

Asks the government to explore how good-quality home care can be preserved alongside nursing-home improvements, covering housing adaptations and neighbourhood services, and report to the House by end Q1 2018.
requests the government to carry out an exploration that does justice to demographic, social and technological developments
verzoekt de regering om, een verkenning uit te voeren, die recht doet aan de demografische, maatschappelijke en technologische ontwikkelingen
Motie van het lid Hermans c.s. over het verbeterprogramma
Asks the government to explain in the upcoming improvement programme and monitoring how nursing home quality will be benchmarked, rewarded, and linked to procurement and management assessment.
requests the government, in the improvement programme coming to the House in early 2018 and the periodic monitoring afterwards, to make clear with concrete measures how
verzoekt de regering, in het verbeterprogramma dat begin 2018 naar de Tweede Kamer komt en de periodieke monitoring daarna aan de hand van concrete, heldere maatregelen duidelijk te maken hoe
Motie van het lid Slootweg c.s. over afspraken over kwaliteit en prijs in meerjarencontracten
Asks the government to agree with care offices on multi-year contracts that set quality and price, to reduce administrative burden under the Wlz.
requests the government, in consultation with care offices, to reach concrete agreements on multi-year contracts
verzoekt de regering om, in overleg met zorgkantoren tot concrete afspraken te komen over meerjarencontracten
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tielen en Hermans over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

Two VVD MPs asked the health minister about a report that at least 172 people died from taking suicide powder Middel X, and about prevention, registration and legal options. The minister says the research shows diverse victims, keeps the current access-limiting code rather than tightening it, and promises further study, a Wtl evaluation and changes to forensic autopsy powers.
I do not intend to further tighten the threshold-raising policy.
Gelet hierop ben ik niet voornemens om het drempelverhogend beleid verder aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Hermans en Erkens over de vergunningverlening bij DOW naar aanleiding van het artikel 'Hoe een groen megaproject muurvast zit door ruzie Dow en overheid’

MPs Erkens, Hermans and Thijssen asked ministers about stalled permitting for Dow Chemical's planned hydrogen-based decarbonisation investment, reportedly blocked by nitrogen emission limits and conflict with government. The minister answered that talks continue, that initial plans exceeded the 80 mg/Nm3 nitrogen limit, that Dow is preparing revised plans, and that a permitting solution will be sought before further updates to parliament.
I will inform your House further about progress via the progress report on the tailor-made approach.
Ik zal uw Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang via de voortgangsrapportage maatwerkaanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt en Van der Plas over het bericht 'Ingrijpend miljardenpakket voor opkoop boeren moet koude sanering veestapel voorkomen'

MPs Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the agriculture minister about press reports of a multi-billion buyout package to prevent a cold clearance of livestock, and whether the government would refrain from announcing buyout schemes during the formation period. The minister says a broad action plan responding to the Van Campen motion is being prepared, that a buyout scheme is only one component, that the European Commission has ruled out a new derogation, and asks the Chamber to debate the plan urgently.
This cabinet considers the situation very urgent and intends to send an action plan to the House at short notice after final decision-making.
Dit kabinet vindt de situatie zeer urgent en is voornemens om, na definitieve besluitvorming, op korte termijn een plan van aanpak aan de Kamer te sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Rajkowski en Rahimi over de berichten 'Naaktbeelden borstkankerpatiënten VS gepubliceerd om ziekenhuis af te persen' en 'Paspoorten van dokters op straat na hack bij oudereninstel

MPs Hermans, Rajkowski and Rahimi (VVD) asked about reports of ransomware attacks on Dutch healthcare institutions, leaked patient and staff data, and how the sector and Z-CERT protect against cyber threats. The minister answered that five ransomware incidents were registered in 2022, outlined existing security norms, Z-CERT support, awareness measures and the National Cybersecurity Strategy, and promised to answer the earlier related questions before the 30 March debate.
I am not aware of how many of these incidents involved patient or staff data being stolen.
Het is mij niet bekend bij hoeveel van deze incidenten er gegevens van patiënten of (zorg-)medewerkers zijn ontvreemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het artikel ‘Animo voor test baarmoederhalskanker stagneert’

An MP asked the state secretary about falling participation in the cervical cancer screening programme, its causes, information campaigns and whether the self-test request via DigiD is a barrier. The state secretary reported participation figures, a target-group study on barriers, and said the government will examine how to remove barriers without setting a high-uptake goal as such.
I consider a decline in participation worrying when it is caused by unnecessary barriers to participation.
Ik vind een daling in de deelname zorgelijk wanneer die veroorzaakt wordt door onnodige belemmeringen om deel te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en Veldman over het artikel ‘Nieuwe Wuhan-virus overdraagbaar van mens op mens’
