MPs Hermans and Veldman asked the Minister of Health about a news report that the new Wuhan coronavirus spreads person to person, covering monitoring, travel advice, airport measures and preparedness. The minister answered that the RIVM monitors the situation, that airport screening is not advised, that travel to neighbouring countries need not be discouraged, and that public information and hospital isolation protocols are in place.
I have kept your House informed about the outbreak of the new coronavirus in Wuhan and elsewhere through several letters to parliament.
Ik heb uw Kamer over de uitbraak van het nieuwe coronavirus in Wuhan en elders op de hoogte gehouden middels verschillende Kamerbrieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het artikel '14 doden per dag: 'Verlaag leeftijd oproep darmkankeronderzoek naar 50 jaar''

An MP asked the state secretary whether an EU recommendation requires bowel cancer screening from age 50 and why the Netherlands starts at 55, and what the pros and cons of lowering the age are. The state secretary answered that the EU guidance sets a 50-74 band as a benchmark, that the Dutch age limit follows a 2009 Health Council advice, and that he is open to lowering it after a 2021 evaluation and a Health Council opinion.
Based on the evaluation of the programme, I will ask the Health Council to give an opinion on this.
Op basis van de evaluatie van het programma zal ik de Gezondheidsraad vragen hier een oordeel over te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Hermans en Laan-Geselschap over het af en toe in een instelling kunnen verblijven van ouderen en gehandicapten

Three MPs asked the minister about respite and part-time residential care (logeerzorg and deeltijdverblijf) for elderly and disabled people, including pilot results, administrative burden, and the fixed co-payment from 1 January 2020. The minister answered in detail on pilots, bureaucracy reduction for carers, and the Wlz co-payment change, while deferring the final pilot results to November and not addressing the Wmo case fully.
For that reason, research is currently being conducted via the national panel of MantelzorgNL and ANBO into the need for structural respite care.
Om die reden wordt momenteel onderzocht via het landelijke panel van MantelzorgNL en ANBO wat de behoefte is aan structurele logeerzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het bericht 'Vrouwen hebben genoeg aan veel lagere dosis medicijn tegen hartfalen'

MPs Rutte and Hermans asked the minister about a report that women may need a much lower dose of a heart failure drug, and whether guidelines, personalised medicine, clinical trials and the Gender and Health knowledge agenda will address sex differences. The minister replied that guidelines are the responsibility of professional groups, outlined how sex differences matter in drug development, and gave a progress update on the ZonMw programme with no new binding commitments.
Drawing up and observing treatment guidelines is the responsibility of the relevant professional groups.
Het opstellen en naleven van behandelrichtlijnen behoort tot de verantwoordelijkheid van de betreffende beroepsgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het artikel ‘Zorgfraudeurs hebben vaak al een strafblad’

MPs Rutte and Hermans (VVD) asked the Health Minister about a report linking healthcare fraud to prior criminal records, including how criminal records of care managers are handled in licensing, PGB fraud enforcement, Bibob checks and vetting of managers. The minister says the IKZ findings are valuable, that licensing under the Wtza already allows refusal or revocation based on VOG and Bibob, that the Wtza need not be tightened now, and that the licensing requirement will be extended in a separate future bill.
As indicated in the letter of 9 July 2019, we will in the future further extend the licensing requirement in the Wtza.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief van 9 juli 2019 2 zullen we de vergunningplicht in de Wtza in de toekomst wel verder uitbreiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Hermans over de monitoring van de afschaffing BPM-teruggaaf voor taxi’s en openbaar vervoer

MPs Lodders and Hermans asked the State Secretary of Finance how the monitoring of the abolition of the BPM refund for taxis and public transport (including accessible transport) is being carried out, and about zero-emission vehicle availability, range, weight-related licence issues, and the absence of greening in the 'Iedereen Onderweg' agenda. The government answered that monitoring of supply is underway, that zero-emission options exist but are more limited for wheelchair taxis, that the rolstoelbusje refund for care institutions remains, and that greening is already covered by a separate convenant.
For the debate on the Tax Plan 2020, the cabinet will return in more detail to the supply of very low-emission and zero-emission vehicles for targeted transport.
Voor de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2020 komt het kabinet uitgebreider terug op het aanbod van zeer zuinige en emissievrije voertuigen voor doelgroepenvervoer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en De Lange over zorgfraude als verdienmodel voor criminelen

MPs Hermans and De Lange asked the Minister of Health about reports of care fraud as a criminal earning model, including recruitment of vulnerable people and misuse of personal budgets (PGB). The minister acknowledged the problem and outlined measures: more inspection capacity, automated checks in PGB 2.0, PGB-competence frameworks, a planned information-sharing bill delayed to early 2020, and municipal support programmes.
To tackle fraudsters as quickly and as firmly as possible, forces must be pooled even better.
Om fraudeurs zo snel en zo stevig mogelijk aan te pakken moeten de krachten nog beter gebundeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het artikel 'Of mevrouw Bastiaansen (93) uit Breda maar even 20 mille wil terugbetalen'

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a case where a 93-year-old was asked to repay about 20,000 euros in under-paid care contributions after CAK data errors, and about how often CAK recovers or refunds such amounts. The minister reported five comparable cases, no reporting on causes or totals, and decided to shorten the retroactive recovery period to twelve months for CAK-caused errors and to give CAK more discretion for tailored solutions.
Therefore I have decided to shorten the retroactive effect of revisions arising from a serious shortcoming or serious delay on the part of the CAK to twelve months.

Daarom heb ik besloten de terugwerkende kracht van herzieningen, welke ontstaan naar aanleiding van een ernstige tekortkoming of ernstige vertraging aan de kant van het CAK zijnde, te verkorten naar twaalf maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het fors toenemend aantal ZZP’ers in de zorg

An MP from the VVD asked the health minister about the rapid rise of self-employed (ZZP) workers in care and its effects on quality, continuity and staff workload. The minister answered that quality obligations and inspection apply equally to self-employed workers, and pointed to the workforce action programme and the regulatory-burden programme as responses.
The Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) supervises the quality, safety and accessibility of care and does not distinguish by the type of employment relationship.
De Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd (IGJ) houdt toezicht op de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toegankelijkheid van de zorg en maakt daarbij geen onderscheid naar de aard van het dienstverband.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arno Rutte en Hermans over het bericht 'Haperende ICT in de Zorg: verkeerde medicatie, foute beslissingen'

MPs Rutte and Hermans asked the health minister about NOS reports of faulty ICT in healthcare causing dangerous medication errors, asking who is responsible and whether the Inspectorate can oversee it. The minister said information exchange agreements are a shared responsibility of care providers coordinated through the Informatieberaad, that the Inspectorate has carried out exploratory inspections and publishes findings, and that the VIPP programme deadlines are being pursued with a possible deadline extension for some clinics.
On the question of whether government should take more control on this point, I will return to it in the letter you receive at the end of this year on electronic data exchange.
Over de vraag of de overheid op dit punt meer regie zou moeten voeren kom ik terug in de brief die u aan het eind van dit jaar ontvangt over elektronische gegevensuitwisseling
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Hermans over het bericht dat ouderen zich niet bewust zijn van toeslagen

VVD MPs Lodders and Hermans asked the government about reports that many elderly people do not claim the healthcare and rent allowances they are entitled to, and what steps will be taken. The government acknowledges non-take-up, says it cannot confirm the healthcare-allowance figures, and defers concrete measures to an IBO review of the allowance system due in spring and autumn 2019.
The cabinet will, as mentioned above, start an IBO study into the allowance system.
Het kabinet zal, zoals hierboven reeds vermeld, een IBO onderzoek starten naar het toeslagenstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het beleid van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd bij inspecties bij thuiszorginstellingen

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Health about the Inspectorate's (IGJ) approach to inspecting home-care providers, including its intervention powers, the handover of providers to another department, the 15 quality conditions, and follow-up on improvements. The Minister answered that the IGJ has sufficient powers, applies a risk-based approach with a dedicated team for new providers, and will intensify home-care supervision this year, while stating that signals should be reported to the national complaints point.
The IGJ has sufficient options to intervene when it finds shortcomings.
De IGJ heeft voldoende mogelijkheden om in te grijpen wanneer zij tekortkomingen constateert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Hermans over het bericht dat publiek zorggeld van Stichting Buurtzorg naar privébedrijfjes zou zijn gesluisd

MPs Slootweg and Hermans asked whether Stichting Buurtzorg funnelled over a million euros of public care money to private companies linked to its founder, and about oversight, a tax repayment arrangement and foreign activities. The minister answered that providers are responsible for their own governance, that the inspectorate sees no quality problems and is gathering information, that the NZa does not oversee such flows, and that tax confidentiality prevents disclosure of the arrangement.
The NZa does not supervise money flows between care providers and affiliated legal entities.
De NZa houdt geen toezicht op geldstromen tussen zorgaanbieders en gelieerde rechtspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over het bericht dat de zorg heeft te kampen met verlies

MP Hermans asked the Minister of Health about reports that care providers, especially nursing and residential homes, are running losses, including whether wage and property costs, accountant costs and reporting explain it, and how to ensure extra funds for nursing homes are not used to fill budget gaps. The minister acknowledged rising costs driven mainly by wage increases and a retroactive allowance, said the NZa is studying care tariffs and cost prices, and committed to contract provisions that allow clawback of funds not spent on the agreed quality-framework investments.
From the 2019 care purchasing round onward, the contracts must allow funds to be reclaimed if they are not used for the agreed investments in implementing the quality framework.

De contracten moeten met ingang van de zorginkoop 2019 mogelijk maken dat de middelen worden teruggevorderd, indien deze niet zijn ingezet voor de afgesproken investeringen in de implementatie van het kwaliteitskader.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Hermans over de berichten 'Honderdduizenden ouderen houden dure ziekenhuisbedden bezet' en 'Veel 65-plussers liggen onnodig in ziekenhuis'

VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports that hundreds of thousands of elderly patients occupy costly hospital beds without medical need and that about 1.4 billion euro is spent on unnecessary care. The ministers acknowledge the problem, describe alternative options such as short-stay facilities and regional coordination points, but say most figures from the ActiZ-commissioned study cannot be verified.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over de signalen het meeverhuizen naar een verpleeghuis niet altijd mogelijk is

An MP asked the minister whether care institutions must offer partner co-admission to spouses moving into nursing homes and how the surviving partner is treated after death. The minister confirmed that the Wlz allows a non-eligible partner to be admitted and retain residence after the eligible partner dies, while noting institutions may lack suitable rooms and are not obliged to help find a new home.
It is not possible to determine how often this occurs.
Het is niet mogelijk na te gaan hoe vaak dit voorkomt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Hermans en De Lange over het bericht 'Wachttijden onacceptabel'

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the causes of waiting times across healthcare sectors, whether insurers and providers have agreed to reduce them, and what the NZa can enforce. The minister answered that the NZa has an action plan, that insurers can be sanctioned under their duty of care, and that concrete follow-up such as reports to the House is planned.
Health insurers must make efforts to ensure that their insured persons receive good quality, accessible and timely care.
Zorgverzekeraars moeten zich inspannen om ervoor te zorgen dat hun verzekerden kwalitatief goede, bereikbare en tijdige zorg ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans en Van der Linde over het bericht dat er een studentenstop is aan de verpleegkunde opleidingen

MPs Hermans and Van der Linde asked the ministers of Health and Education about reports of a student intake cap (numerus fixus) for nursing programmes despite a nursing shortage, including its causes, internship availability and the Utrecht case. The minister answered that fixus programmes fell from 56 to 33, that caps protect quality and internship places, that internship capacity has grown, and that the Utrecht university of applied sciences is moving to a cap of 400 full-time students.
The main reason for a programme to introduce a numerus fixus is to maintain the quality of the programme and to offer students sufficient and good-quality internship places.

De voornaamste reden voor een opleiding om een numerus fixus in te stellen is om de kwaliteit van de opleiding te behouden en om voor de studenten voldoende en kwalitatief goede stageplekken te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hermans over de signalen dat gemeenten geen alfahulpen meer mogen inzetten

MP Hermans asked the state secretary about signals that municipalities may no longer deploy or broker alfahulpen (home help via the Regeling dienstverlening aan huis), and about the legal interpretation under the Wmo 2015 following Centrale Raad van Beroep rulings. The state secretary answered that no municipal signals of difficulty had reached him, maintained that such arrangements fall outside the Wmo 2015 so that clients can use alfahulpen mainly via a pgb, and said he will not take additional measures beyond following municipalities in adjusting policy.
I do not intend to take additional measures, except to follow municipalities in adjusting current policy where necessary.
Ik ben niet voornemens aanvullende maatregelen te treffen, behoudens het volgen van gemeenten in het waar nodig aanpassen van het huidige beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Hermans over de controle van topinkomens in zorginstellingen

MPs Middendorp and Hermans asked whether the detailed WNT rules on top-income control in healthcare institutions cause high compliance costs and asked for a quick remedy. The minister acknowledges complexity and admin burden, agrees to consult the NBA on reducing the audit protocol burden, and will review controls in the WNT evaluation.

I am happy to consider, together with the parties involved, whether there are possibilities within the aim and framework of the WNT to reduce the audit burden on accountants and thereby the costs for all WNT institutions.

Ik ben graag bereid om samen met betrokken partijen te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om binnen het doel en de kaders van de WNT de controlelast voor accountants en daarmee de kosten voor alle WNT-instellingen te verminderen.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het FD-bericht 'Klimaateconoom: opwarming kan leiden tot een nieuwe kredietcrisis'

An MP asked the ministers how climate damage affects financial stability in Europe, whether the government will act further, and how insurance premiums and Dutch climate finance are affected. The government answered that DNB and the ECB supervise climate-related financial risks, that current measures are sufficient to address these risks, and that it already contributes to clean electricity in developing countries.
The cabinet believes that appropriate mitigation and adaptation measures are necessary.
Het kabinet vindt dat passende mitigatie- en adaptatiemaatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosterhout over de opname van scope 3 uitstoot in Nederlandse milieueffectbeoordelingen naar aanleiding van de recente Noorse rechtszaak hieromtrent

MP Van Oosterhout asked the minister about Norwegian and EFTA court rulings requiring scope 3 emissions in environmental impact assessments for oil and gas permits, and whether Dutch permitting should change. The minister said the rulings are still being studied, scope 3 is currently not systematically included, and results will be shared by end of Q1 2026, while noting no new gas extraction is allowed in the Wadden Sea.
By the end of the first quarter of 2026 at the latest, the results of the further analysis will be shared with the House.
Uiterlijk einde eerste kwartaal 2026 zullen de uitkomsten van de nadere analyse met de Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder en Grinwis over de oproep voor effectievere ondersteuning van mensen met hoge energiekosten via het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

MPs Lahlah, Kröger, Ceder and Grinwis asked about the G4 call to support high-energy-cost households via the Temporary Emergency Energy Fund (TNE) and whether a publicprivate route can be revived this winter. The State Secretary answers that private co-financing fell short, so the route is not responsible; instead €30 million goes via the Municipal Fund to existing local services, with no direct income support, citing legal and state-aid risks.
It has been established that it is not feasible to realise a public-private construction this coming winter.
Er is geconstateerd dat het niet haalbaar is om aankomende winter een publiek-private constructie te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht ‘Nederland is een ontbossingsland’

MP Teunissen asked the government about reports that the Netherlands contributes to global deforestation via finance, ports and consumption, including Rabobank's ranking and the adequacy of EU deforestation rules. The minister answered that companies and financial institutions must follow OECD and UN standards, that existing EU sustainability rules apply but are being simplified, and that the EUDR enforcement details remain uncertain pending final EU text.

How a financial institution gives effect to compliance with these international guidelines, and what choices it makes regarding investments or engaging with companies, is the responsibility of the institutions themselves.

Hoe een financiële instelling invulling geeft aan de naleving van deze internationale richtlijnen, en welke keuzes zij maakt ten aanzien van investeringen of het aangaan van gesprekken met bedrijven, is de verantwoordelijkheid van de instellingen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het bericht ‘Kabinet negeert alarmbellen rond nieuwe Zeeuwse kerncentrales’

An MP asks the minister why warnings about once-through cooling risks for new nuclear plants in the Westerschelde (Deltares, Commissie mer reports) were not shared with parliament, and whether cooling-tower alternatives, costs, ecological risks and irreversible steps like founding NEO NL are being properly disclosed. The minister answers that the reports were already public, that intermediate studies are not published, that the full location picture and the decision will come to parliament after summer 2026, and that NEO NL's establishment is planned in Q1 2026 in parallel with the plan-MER.
It is not customary, and not useful for overview, to publish every interim step or send it to the House.
Het is niet gebruikelijk, en voor het overzicht niet zinvol, om elke tussentijdse stap te publiceren of naar de Kamer te sturen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gabriëls, Thijssen, Kröger, Kostić en Teunissen over de Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel, de fors hogere uitstoot van Tata Steel, staalslakken en de forse salarisverhogingen van direc

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA and the Partij voor de Dieren asked about Tata Steel's higher emissions in 2024, the Joint Letter of Intent with the state, executive pay rises amid job cuts, and steel slag use across the Netherlands. The government answered that the emission rise may reflect new measurements and reporting, that the permit procedure is still pending, that a steel slag taskforce and a reporting obligation are being set up, and that pay policy is for the company to decide, though the JLoI requires a reasonable pay policy to be specified later.
The cabinet understands that this article and its headline raise questions.
Het kabinet snapt dat dit artikel en deze kop vragen oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Flach over het bericht ‘Nederland heeft de kleinste gasvoorraad in jaren en dat komt door goedkoop gas’

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that the Netherlands has its smallest gas storage in years and has missed the EU and national fill targets, and asked how the government assesses this and what risks exist. The minister answered that supply is stable, there are no current security-of-supply concerns, the 2 extreme-winter risks are manageable, and the government cannot prevent price spikes but monitors affordability and points to decarbonisation.
Based on current insights, there are at present no concerns regarding security of supply.
Op basis van de huidige inzichten zijn er op dit moment geen zorgen ten aanzien van de leveringszekerheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Oosterhout over het nieuws dat er een deal is gesloten tussen het kabinet en de NAM over de gaswinning bij Ternaard

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth how the deal with NAM over the Ternaard gas field was reached, how it was valued, whether it sets a precedent and what it means for other mining and the Wadden Sea. The minister answered that the deal was negotiated bilaterally, valued at 163 million euro as a market-conform transaction, withholds the negotiation records and legal advice, and promised a letter on sector agreements in January 2026.
No minutes were made of the meetings.
Van de overleggen zijn geen verslagen gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de brief ‘Uitnodiging bewonersonderzoek’

An SP MP asks why the government sent a resident survey on a possible nuclear plant in Eemshaven despite strong opposition in Groningen, why Eemshaven was kept in the site study despite a motion to exclude Groningen, and how much the survey costs. The minister answers that Eemshaven must remain in the site assessment for legal reasons, that it has been removed as a safeguarding location for nuclear plants, that the survey costs €56,240 excluding VAT, and that the government will continue to engage with Groningen.
Eemshaven is removed as a safeguarding location for the establishment of nuclear power plants.
Eemshaven wordt geschrapt als waarborgingslocatie voor de vestiging van kerncentrales.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Koekkoek over de getekende Joint Letter of Intent met Tata Steel

MPs Kostić and Koekkoek asked about the signed Joint Letter of Intent with Tata Steel, covering government liability, the closure of the coke-oven plant KGF2, enforcement, health protection for residents, emissions history, and the €2 billion subsidy risk. The ministers answered that the JLoI contains only inspanningsverplichtingen with opzeggronden, that binding result obligations will follow in a later maatwerkafspraak, and that health goals and public consultation are part of the process.
Through the JLoI the parties can be held to the inspanningsverplichtingen, but the results cannot yet be enforced.
Door de JLoI kunnen partijen aan de inspanningsverplichtingen worden gehouden, maar kunnen de resultaten nog niet afgedwongen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het bericht 'Woningbouw in gevaar door nieuwe regels netcongestie'

Two CDA MPs asked the Ministers of Climate and Green Growth and of Housing about press reports that new grid-congestion priority rules could endanger housing construction, and about the four municipalities' warnings. The minister answered that the ACM will publish a new priority framework by 1 January 2026 keeping housing priority, that interim rules apply until 1 July 2026 with gradual release of reserved capacity, and that municipalities and provinces will be involved in further talks.
As mentioned in the annex 'progress grid congestion policy' to the parliamentary letter of 6 October, grid operators currently reserve capacity for connecting all (future) small consumers.

Zoals genoemd in de bijlage «voortgang beleid netcongestie» bij de Kamerbrief voortgang netcongestie van 6 oktober 4 , reserveren de netbeheerders momenteel capaciteit voor het aansluiten van alle (toekomstige) kleinverbruikers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over opgelegde dwangsommen voor het niet halen van klimaatdoelen uit het Klimaatfonds betalen

An MP asked whether Climate Fund money could be used to pay possible court-imposed penalties for missing 2030 climate targets, and questioned the government's legal analyses and its view of those targets as non-binding. The minister denied that such payments are lawful or intended, declined to publish an internal legal memo citing litigation interests, and said the 2030 target is a non-directly enforceable goal.
The cabinet has not made this note public because it contains information that could harm the State's litigation interests, then and now.
Het kabinet heeft deze notitie niet openbaar gemaakt, omdat die, toen en nu, informatie bevat die het procesbelang van de Staat kan schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over Bonaire en klimaatmaatregelen

Teunissen (PvdD) asks the ministers about the climate crisis on Bonaire, including protection measures, consultation with local bodies, Dutch emission targets, fossil subsidies and climate policy for the Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The government answers that climate adaptation work is ongoing, including a Bonaire climate plan due in early 2026, the national adaptation strategy being revised, and various flood and ecological projects, while stating it will not prevent every flood but will prepare better.
The cabinet is working on climate policy for the Caribbean Netherlands, just as it is for the European Netherlands.
Het kabinet werkt – net als in Europees Nederland – aan klimaatbeleid voor Caribisch Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over de sluiting van fabriek Fibrant op Chemelot

Wingelaar asked the government about the planned closure of Fibrant's caprolactam plants at Chemelot, the subsidies Fibrant received, effects on the cluster, and past closures. The minister responded that the decision is not yet final, that the government is in close contact with the company and province and is pursuing a plan for the cluster, and that it cannot yet say whether subsidies would be reclaimed.
At this moment, however, it is premature to speak of a definitive decision.
Het is op dit moment echter te voorbarig om te spreken over een definitief besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Dassen over “de gelekte brief waarin Tata Steel 685 miljoen euro moet betalen vanwege trage verduurzaming”

MPs Teunissen and Dassen asked about a leaked letter saying Tata Steel must pay 685 million euros for emissions rights due to slow decarbonisation, and whether subsidies undermine the ETS incentive, the company's risks and competitiveness, and the financial prudence of the support. The minister answered that the costs were foreseeable but affected by delayed Hoogoven 6 work, that the Dutch policy mix is intended, that the business case uses current 2025 forecasts validated by the state and the European Commission, that subsidies are tranched with clawback, and that the Chamber will be informed about maatwerk talks.
Because of commercial confidentiality, no statements can be made about specific figures or, in this case, provisions.
Vanwege de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over specifieke cijfers of, in dit geval, voorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over zonnevelden op landbouwgrond en risico's voor bodem, water en gezondheid

MP Vermeer asked why solar and wind projects continue despite RES targets and grid congestion, whether solar fields on farmland should be restricted, whether chemical leakage and EMF risks have been studied, and whether projects should pause until these are clear. The minister answered that renewable energy on land remains needed, that the tightened solar priority order discourages solar fields on farmland except for listed exceptions, that some panels contain hazardous substances but pose no serious risk in normal use, that EMF is handled under precautionary policy, and that independent research continues.
Solar fields on these lands are in principle undesirable, unless one of the following exceptions applies
Zonnevelden op deze gronden zijn in principe ongewenst, tenzij het gaat om één van de volgende uitzonderingsmogelijkheden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het mijnbouwbedrijf dat sneller wil beginnen met het mijnen in de Stille Oceaan

MP Teunissen asked the government about commercial deep-sea mining plans in the Clarion Clipperton Zone, the ecological risks, Dutch involvement (Allseas), sanctions for unlicensed mining, and critical metals supply. The government answered that the science is not yet sufficient, that Dutch involvement is not known beyond Allseas which it cannot comment on individually, that it opposes licences before a mining code exists, and that it has discussed the integrity of UNCLOS with Allseas without committing to specific sanctions.
Of course, the cabinet will, should developments give rise to it, consider possible steps to take, within the framework of the Authority.
Uiteraard zal het kabinet zich, wanneer de ontwikkelingen daar aanleiding toe geven, beraden op eventuele te nemen stappen, binnen de kaders van de Autoriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de nieuwsberichten over Duitse windturbines aan de grens bij Noord-Brabant, Limburg en Gelderland

An MP asked the minister about German wind turbines near the Dutch border, the number of affected households, whether Espoo and Aarhus obligations are breached, and what the government will do to support Dutch municipalities and citizens. The minister answered that the matter lies with the provinces and German authorities, that no clear breach of treaties is established, and that the government will keep discussing the issue with German authorities through existing channels without committing to new action.
Because I am not the competent authority in this matter, I do not know exact figures on how many households are involved.
Omdat ik geen bevoegd gezag ben in dezen ken ik geen exacte cijfers over hoeveel huishoudens het betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch en Kröger over het artikel 'Door creatief boekhouden hoeven we voorlopig geen euro extra te betalen voor klimaatschade in arme landen'

MPs Hirsch and Kröger asked the ministers about a Follow the Money article claiming the Netherlands pushed for a low, vague climate finance target at COP29 to avoid paying extra. The government denied this characterization, stated its position was a broad target with a public core, rejected the idea of a burden-sharing key, and said it will consider the questions in its legal analysis of the ICJ advisory opinion.
This is not a correct representation of the Dutch position.
Dit is geen juiste weergave van de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over ‘drijvende zonnepanelen voor de kust van Egmond aan Zee’

An MP asked the minister about a floating solar park planned among wind turbines off Egmond aan Zee, covering its proven status, financing, risk allocation, durability, safety, ecological impact, cumulative effects, monitoring and evaluation. The minister answered that no direct public subsidies or guarantees are given, the developer bears all risks, ecological effects are largely unknown and will be monitored under a multi-year programme, and the project will be evaluated over its one-year term with the Chamber to be informed.
The cabinet undertakes to inform the Chamber about the follow-up to this.
Het kabinet zegt toe de Kamer over de opvolging hiervan te zullen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over winningsvergunningen

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth to explain the government's position on the 'hand-on-the-tap' principle for gas and salt extraction under the Wadden Sea, and whether extraction could be intensified or new permits granted. The minister replied that the principle is unchanged for now, that a future cabinet must decide on the new scientific findings, that new permits in the Wadden Sea Natura 2000 area have not been granted since 1 May 2024, and that the principle is conservative so subsidence is compensated by natural sedimentation.
For now, the hand-on-the-tap principle is therefore not being changed.
Vooralsnog wordt het hand-aan-de-kraan-principe dus niet aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hirsch, Kröger en Teunissen over de verplichtingen van staten met betrekking tot klimaatverandering

MPs Hirsch, Kröger and Teunissen asked the government how the ICJ's July 2025 climate advisory opinion affects Dutch fossil fuel subsidies, corporate regulation, adaptation finance, loss and damage funding, and EU climate commitments. The government answered that the opinion does not create new obligations, that its fossil support and climate policies comply with international law, that it sees no need for a new analysis of fossil support, and that it will share a fuller legal reaction later.
The ICJ advisory opinion requires a careful legal analysis, which is currently taking place.
Het advies van het IGH vergt een zorgvuldige juridische analyse, die momenteel plaatsvindt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kostić over alternatieve plannen voor Tata Steel Nederland

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the government about the Wijmond business case for alternative uses of the Tata Steel IJmuiden site, including financial risks of the Green Steel plan, reductions of pollution, soil remediation liability and housing and nature scenarios. The state secretary answers that the government remains committed to the Green Steel plan and ongoing negotiations, does not consider new research necessary, and declines to disclose negotiation details.
The cabinet cannot make further public statements about what forms part of the negotiations on tailored agreements.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen verdere mededelingen doen over wat onderdeel is van de onderhandelingen over maatwerkafspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over Nieuwe fossiele boringen op de Noordzee en het sectorakkoord gaswinning

The MP Teunissen (PvdD) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about new fossil drilling in the North Sea and the 2025 gas extraction sector agreement, including its compatibility with the Paris Agreement, the ICJ advisory opinion, legal risks, EBN's role and stranded-asset risk. The minister rejected the claim of incompatibility, argued that expanded North Sea production stays within the most progressive gas demand reduction scenario, defended EBN's public role and said the questions could not be answered within the requested timeframe.
No, no further analysis has been made of the legal aspects you mention.
Nee, er is geen verdere analyse gemaakt op de juridische aspecten die u benoemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić, Thijssen, Rooderkerk, Bamenga, Postma, Gabriëls, Wingelaar, Teunissen en Koekkoek over de MER Tata Steel en misleidende communicatie over uitstootcijfers

MPs asked the government about the Tata Steel HeraCless environmental impact report (MER), including rising fine particulate, NOx and dioxin levels, unclear emission reduction figures, EAF slag risks, CO2 reduction claims, the pending health impact assessment, job cuts and conditions for state subsidy. The state secretary largely deferred to the competent authority (Province of Noord-Holland) and the ongoing procedure, while stating that negotiations on the maatwerk agreement continue and that binding, enforceable terms and monitoring will be included.
The national government cannot yet take positions, because the competent authority still has to interpret and assess the MER.
Er zijn door de Rijksoverheid nog geen stellingen in te nemen, omdat het bevoegd gezag de MER nog moet interpreteren en beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de toekenning van de extra middelen voor het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie

An MP asked how the €50 million amendment for the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie would be implemented, how many of the 227,000 applications could now be honoured, what budget remains, and whether the amendment would be carried out in 2025 respecting parliament's budget right. The government replied that adding public money to the private-public fund is legally and financially risky, so it is exploring whether the €50 million can go to a planned public energy fund under the Social Climate Fund instead, and that nearly all of the €56.3 million has been paid out.
It is being explored whether the €50 million can be added to the available funds for the planned public energy fund supporting households with their energy bills.
Er wordt verkend of de € 50 miljoen kan worden toegevoegd aan de beschikbare middelen voor het te ontwikkelen publieke energiefonds voor de ondersteuning van huishoudens op de energierekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Welzijn over berichtgeving over bijbetalen aan verwarming door ‘slecht onderhoud flat’

An NSC MP asked the Ministers of Housing and Climate about reports of residents in IJmuiden protesting high district-heating bills linked to poor building maintenance, asking about transparency, verification, cost structure, overpayments and whether the government will publish data and act. The minister answered that current rules (Warmtewet, Wcw, tenancy law) already provide sufficient safeguards, that data on back-payments is not held by government, and promised only limited further steps such as reporting on complaints via the ACM and monitoring the upcoming Wcw implementation.
The cabinet is of the view that the policy to safeguard transparency, reliability and affordability is in order.
Het kabinet is van oordeel dat het beleid om de transparantie, betrouwbaarheid en betaalbaarheid te borgen op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de Kamerbrief 'Voortgang Maatwerkafspraken Verduurzaming Industrie' van 30 juni 2025 en het artikel van FTM over het afschaffen van de CO2-heffing

An MP (Thijssen, GroenLinks-PvdA) asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth why the sustainability maatwerk agreements with industry are stalling, what economic and geopolitical conditions are meant, and whether the abolition of the CO2 levy weakens the incentive to decarbonise. The Minister attributes the stall mainly to high energy costs, grid and infrastructure bottlenecks, permitting and nitrogen problems, and says a plan B will be developed, with the levy's financial effects still under study and clarity promised before Prinsjesdag.
The cabinet remains committed to getting the preconditions for sustainability in order and is investing in steps towards a level playing field for our industry.
Het kabinet blijft zich inzetten om de randvoorwaarden voor verduurzaming op orde te krijgen en investeert in stappen richting een gelijk speelveld voor onze industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over ‘een integrale audit van ideologisch gedreven overheidsuitgaven en mogelijke systeemfraude in de overheidsadministratie’ aan

An FvD MP asked for a full audit of ideologically motivated government spending, including subsidies to organisations that have sued the state, checks on ghost employees and unused payment cards, and a DOGE-style taskforce. The government declined to create a list of litigating organisations or a taskforce, citing existing audit bodies (ADR, Algemene Rekenkamer) and disproportionate cost, while providing partial data on payroll ages and payment cards.
The Internal Audit Service of the State (ADR) and the Netherlands Court of Audit (AR) are both independent auditors that oversee lawful and efficient use of public funds.
De Auditdienst Rijk (ADR) en de Algemene Rekenkamer (AR) zijn beide onafhankelijke controleurs die toezien op rechtmatig en doelmatig gebruik van overheidsmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over de reactiebrief van de brancheorganisaties op het gepubliceerde Windenergie Infrastructuurplan Noordzee

MP Thijssen asks the minister why offshore wind and industrial electrification deals failed despite joint industry calls, whether prices and renewable hydrogen costs were discussed, and whether correspondence can be shared. The minister acknowledges risks materialised, reduces the 2040 offshore wind ambition to 30–40 GW with an action plan due in September, defends confidentiality of maatwerk talks, and declines to release that correspondence.
The talks within the maatwerk approach are confidential, partly because companies share business-confidential information.
De gesprekken in het kader van de maatwerkaanpak zijn vertrouwelijk, onder andere omdat de bedrijven bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Netversterking midden-Nederland jaren vertraagd'

An MP from the ChristenUnie asks the Ministers of Climate and Green Growth and of Housing and Spatial Planning about the reported multi-year delay of grid reinforcement in central Netherlands, its effects on households and businesses, site selection, land acquisition, municipal planning and the grid check in spatial policy. The minister answers that the delay is disappointing, that several questions depend on forthcoming grid forecasts and studies, and that the government will take concrete steps such as a planned Nota Ruimte, an exploration of proactive spatial steering, and letters to Parliament on progress.
The cabinet is doing its utmost, together with all parties involved with TenneT and the province of Utrecht in the lead, to seize every opportunity to accelerate the realisation of this project.

Het kabinet spant zich tot het uiterste in om, samen met alle betrokken betrokken partijen, TenneT en de provincie Utrecht voorop, iedere mogelijkheid om de realisatie van dit project te versnellen aan te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de waardedalingen van woningen nabij windturbines naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving over geplande windturbines in de gemeente Stichtse Vecht

An MP asked the minister about resident opposition to planned 240-metre wind turbines in Stichtse Vecht, the claimed property value losses and whether planning-damage compensation is adequate. The minister answered that the Omgevingswet's 4% normal social risk and planning-damage compensation are sufficient, declined new independent research, and said the province and RES regions decide on wind siting within the agreed targets.
The cabinet considers that the current planning-damage compensation provides sufficient compensation.
Het kabinet vindt dat de huidige planschadevergoedingen voldoende compensatie bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het artikel 'EU-klimaatchef Wopke Hoekstra komt met ambitieus klimaatdoel voor 2040: 90 procent reductie; onbetaalbaar zeggen critici'

An MP from JA21 asked the minister about press reports on an EU proposal for a 90% emissions cut by 2040, including whether the Netherlands supports a new target, the economic and regulatory burden, and what steps the cabinet will take to block it. The demissionary minister answered that the Netherlands supports timely agreement on the 2040 target and the EU NDC, cites the Commission's impact assessment, and states it will not oppose the proposal through concrete steps beyond sharing the BNC-fiche and pressing for an implementation package.
The cabinet contributes to the European goals of achieving climate neutrality by 2050 at the latest and at least 55% net greenhouse gas emission reduction by 2030.
Het kabinet levert zijn bijdrage aan de Europese doelen om uiterlijk in 2050 klimaatneutraliteit te bereiken en ten minste netto 55% broeikasgasemissiereductie te realiseren in 2030.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Boswijk over de berichten ‘Ov-beelden al gewist, onderzoeken naar Maccabi-supporters gestaakt’ en ‘Politie worstelde met 'wezenlijk andere vorm van geweld' tijdens Maccabi-rellen’

The CDA MP Boswijk asked the Justice Minister about reports that transit footage of the Maccabi riots was erased and that investigations into supporters were dropped, and about the police and Public Prosecution Service response. The Minister says the prosecution sent complaints to police on 14 November 2024, that the GVB camera footage had already been overwritten during a camera replacement the prosecution was not told about, that no relevant footage or open-source leads were found, and that camera retention is a matter for the independent GVB, so no minimum retention period is proposed.
The GVB is an independent company for which the national government is not the concession grantor.
Het GVB is een zelfstandig bedrijf ten aanzien waarvan de Rijksoverheid geen concessieverlener is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over Nederlandse subsidies voor waterstofprojecten waarvan het klimaatvoordeel in het buitenland belandt

An MP asked whether Dutch hydrogen subsidies (OWE) produce CO2 savings abroad, notably the Air Liquide plant whose output largely serves Belgium, and whether subsidies should be halted. The minister answered that CO2 reduction is credited where fossil hydrogen production is displaced (here mainly in the Netherlands), that no export-restricting conditions can legally be imposed, and declined to stop the subsidies.
Imposing a condition that, for example, the fully renewable hydrogen produced may only be used in the Netherlands may qualify as such a measure.
Het stellen van een voorwaarde dat bijvoorbeeld de geproduceerde volledig hernieuwbare waterstof uitsluitend in Nederland mag worden gebruikt, kan kwalificeren als een dergelijke maatregel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid El Abassi over de flinke toename van energiearmoede door het wegvallen van overheidssteun

An MP from DENK asked the ministers whether the rise in energy poverty to 510,000 households in 2024 reflects the end of crisis support measures, and why those measures were withdrawn without structural alternatives. The government acknowledges the increase, argues that targeted structural measures (Social Climate Fund, insulation, a noodfonds subsidy) are preferable to the broad energy allowance, and declines to reinstate a price cap or allowance now.

The cabinet therefore chooses to focus on structural targeted measures, such as the Social Climate Fund approach described under question 2 and targeted insulation of homes in specific neighbourhoods.

Het kabinet kiest er daarom voor om in te zetten op structurele gerichte maatregelen, zoals de bij vraag 2 beschreven inzet vanuit het Social Climate Fund en gerichte verduurzaming van de woningen in specifieke wijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wingelaar over het Eindrapport Plastic Tafel

An MP asks whether the Plastic Table package reaches the 30% circular plastics goal for 2030, and about investment losses, bank confidence, the binding nature of measures, and industry 'game changers'. The government answers that the 30% figure is now an aspiration rather than a norm, that most measures are voluntary and effects uncertain, and that it is studying which proposals to legislate, while promising to report back on Prinsjesdag.
No overview is available of the number of investments, patents and capacity in chemical recycling and bio-based plastics production.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van het aantal investeringen, patenten en capaciteit van chemische recycling en biogebaseerde productie van plastics.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het IPCC-rapport en weersextremen

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth to explain IPCC statements on low confidence in long-term trends in tropical cyclones and in human influence on high river flows, and whether the minister still holds that weather extremes are increasing and human-caused. The minister confirmed the quoted passages, explained that low confidence reflects limited data and studies rather than absence of trends, and reaffirmed that human-caused climate change has increased extremes, as the IPCC AR6 states.
Yes, and that is entirely in line with what the IPCC states.
Ja en dat is geheel in lijn met wat IPCC stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de betrokkenheid van Extinction Rebellion bij het Nationaal Burgerberaad Klimaat

An MP asked the Minister whether Extinction Rebellion was involved in preparing the National Citizens' Climate Assembly, whether its input shaped the process, and what safeguards exist against activist influence. The Minister answered that XR contacted the secretariat on its own initiative without leading to changes, that the independent secretariat made the selection choices under the agreed conditions, and that the final report will be presented in November rather than before the elections.
XR's input to the secretariat was on XR's own initiative and did not lead to any adjustments by the secretariat.
De input van XR richting het secretariaat was op eigen initiatief van XR en heeft niet geleid tot aanpassingen door het secretariaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het bericht ‘Uitbreiding hoogspanningsnet jaren vertraagd in Gelderland, Utrecht en Flevopolder’

An MP asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reported multi-year delays to the high-voltage grid expansion in Gelderland, Utrecht and Flevopolder, including the Utrecht-Noord station, and what will be done to speed it up. The minister acknowledges the delay, attributes it to planning, land acquisition and technical problems, and points to a project approach, a shared action programme and a forthcoming update, but commits to no concrete new binding step beyond these existing measures.
In particular, the construction of the high-voltage station in Utrecht Noord is taking longer than planned.
Met name de bouw van het hoogspanningsstation in Utrecht Noord duurt langer dan gepland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht dat de uitbreiding van het hoogspanningsnet is vertraagd

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that the expansion of the high-voltage grid in Gelderland, Utrecht and Flevopolder is delayed by at least four years, and about measures to prevent further delays, grid congestion in Noord-Holland and Vijfhuizen, reserved but unused capacity for data centres, and the prioritisation code. The minister acknowledges the delay, attributes it to planning, land-acquisition and technical problems, and lists existing and planned measures, committing to continued efforts while offering no new binding guarantees.
The cabinet is making every effort, together with all parties involved, with TenneT and the province of Utrecht in the lead, to seize every opportunity to accelerate the realisation of this project.

Het kabinet spant zich tot het uiterste in om, samen met alle betrokken betrokken partijen, TenneT en de provincie Utrecht voorop, iedere mogelijkheid om de realisatie van dit project te versnellen aan te grijpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de uitbreiding van het hoogspanningsnet in Gelderland, Utrecht en de Flevopolder met jaren is vertraagd

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked why the Utrecht/Gelderland/Flevopolder high-voltage grid expansion has been delayed to 2033 or later, and about acceleration options such as location choice, expropriation, a new Raad van State chamber and taking over competence. Minister Hermans attributes the delay to a complex site, land acquisition and technical problems, outlines the Versnellingspakket measures, and explains why Rijk takeover would currently slow the decision, while committing to a location choice after the summer.
A takeover of the competent authority by the central government could delay the location choice by several months, because the project is already far advanced.
Het overnemen van het bevoegd gezag door het Rijk kan de locatiekeuze met enkele maanden vertragen, doordat het project al ver gevorderd is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over verziltingsrisico’s bij het voorkeurstracé, het negeren van regionale voorstellen en het ontbreken van de tunnelvariant Programma Aansluiting Wind Op Zee (PAWOZ) – Eemshaven

Vermeer (BBB) asks the minister about salinisation risks of the preferred PAWOZ-Eemshaven route, why the regional tunnel variant was left out of the project MER, and related questions on modelling, timing and the lack of an initiating party. The minister defends the Schiermonnikoog Wantij route as the only feasible option for timely grid connection, says the tunnel is being studied for future projects, and argues that directional drilling and the modelling used keep the salinisation risk small.
The Schiermonnikoog Wantij route is the only reliable, feasible route that ensures offshore wind makes landfall on time.
De Schiermonnikoog Wantij route is de enige betrouwbare, haalbare route die zorgt dat wind op zee tijdig aanlandt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger en Thijssen over de aangenomen motie voor het afschaffen van de CO2-heffing industrie

Two MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the adopted motion to abolish the industrial CO2 levy, covering its impact on companies, revenue, legal consequences, the Herstel- en Veerkrachtplan funding, and climate policy credibility. The government replied that the levy will be temporarily suspended for the period up to 2030 pending further study, an independent Overlegtafel will advise on post-2030 options by 1 November, and it will assess legal, revenue and funding consequences and explore alternative measures.
The cabinet will investigate the extent of the negative impact that a possible suspension of the industrial CO2 levy would have on companies that have already invested in sustainability.

met de Kamer is gedeeld gaat het kabinet onderzoeken in welke mate er sprake is van een negatieve impact van het eventueel opschorten van de CO 2 -heffing industrie op bedrijven die reeds hebben geïnvesteerd in verduurzaming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het voorkeurstracé voor de aansluiting van windpark Doordewind (DDW)

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth why the government prefers the western cable route through the Wadden area over less harmful eastern alternatives, and how it handles the Commission for EIA's critical advice, the 287 objections, Germany's refusal of a route, UNESCO obligations and Natura 2000 concerns. The minister answers that three routes are permittable, that the Schiermonnikoog-Wantij route is the only feasible one in time, that an addendum will address the Commission's points, and that objections and German consultations will be shared with the House.
It was agreed with the Commission that an addendum to the environmental impact report is sufficient to provide the requested information.
Met de Commissie is afgesproken dat een addendum bij het milieueffectrapport voldoende is om de gevraagde informatie te leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en De Hoop over het artikel 'Premier Schoof moet mogelijk ingrijpen om stroomkabel door Schiermonnikoog tegen te houden'

MPs Kröger and De Hoop asked why the government could not secure German agreement for a cable through the Eems-Dollard area and why it signed a gas-field treaty with Germany while the Schiermonnikoog cable remains blocked. The minister explains that the gas treaty is separate from the Eems-Dollard treaty, that German authorities refuse the cable route on shipping-safety grounds, and that the treaty is planned for signature in August with provisional application, without parliamentary debate first.

Because provisional application serves the general interest of gas production, energy supply, security of supply and reducing import dependence for both the Netherlands and Germany, the Council of Ministers also approved such provisional application on 20 September 2024.

Omdat de voorlopige toepassing in het algemeen belang is van de gaswinning, de energievoorziening, de leveringszekerheid en het beperken van de importafhankelijkheid van Nederland en Duitsland, is tevens met een dergelijke voorlopige toepassing ingestemd in de ministerraad van 20 september 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over extra windturbines op land

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether onshore wind expansion is needed given the 2050 energy demand estimates, offshore alternatives, costs, and the Klimaatakkoord targets. The minister answers that the figures are indicative, a broad mix of sources is planned, onshore wind remains useful for local demand, and no separate cost-benefit analysis is planned because existing programmes cover the comparison.
The cabinet sees no added value in doing this separately.
Het kabinet ziet geen toegevoegde waarde om dit apart te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'SodM vindt zoutwinning Zuidwending onveilig, maar Minister Hermans wil door met Nobian. 'Essentieel''

MP Beckerman asks the minister why he proceeds with the Nobian salt mining permit at Zuidwending despite SodM considering the cavern closure risks too high, and questions safety, precedent from Groningen, and public involvement. The minister replies that SodM, TNO and the Mijnraad consider continued mining safe, that closure risks are addressed through binding conditions requiring five years of further research, and that no nuclear waste site is currently designated; he refuses to suspend the permit but commits to further study and publication of risk analyses.
The cabinet did not choose to set aside SodM's advice, but has examined it carefully and involved it in the decision-making.
Het kabinet heeft er niet voor gekozen om het advies van SodM naast zich neer te leggen, maar heeft hier zorgvuldig naar gekeken en betrokken bij de besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het Groningen gasveld

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the closure of the Groningen gas field has increased import dependence and gas prices, and whether the field should be kept as a strategic reserve despite a report warning against permanent closure. The minister acknowledged rising import dependence but attributed the 2022 price spike to Gazprom's conduct and Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and declined to keep the field as a reserve, citing the statutory end of extraction and the public's trust in that commitment.
No, the cabinet does not share the conclusion that it is unwise to permanently close the Groningen field.
Nee, het kabinet deelt de conclusie niet dat het onverstandig is om het Groningenveld definitief te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veltman over het bericht 'Reiziger vrijdag opnieuw de dupe van NS-staking: wanneer kunnen we weer «normaal' met de trein?'

An MP asked the minister about NS strikes disrupting rail travellers, the economic impact, the possibility of a mandatory basic timetable during strikes, and regional strike spillover. The state secretary said a mandatory basic timetable would be a serious restriction of the right to strike under the European Social Charter, and committed to talks with NS on a voluntary basic timetable.
That is why it was promised during the debate of 26 June to discuss this with NS.
Daarom is tijdens het debat op 26 juni jl. toegezegd hierover in gesprek te gaan met NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de wederom uitgestelde windturbinenormen

MP Eerdmans (JA21) asked about the repeatedly postponed wind turbine standards, alleging RIVM omitted foreign research on wind turbine noise nuisance and that an integrity complaint against RIVM was upheld by LOWI. Minister Hermans replied that RIVM does track international literature, that the LOWI only ruled on procedure, that definitive standards are expected by 1 January 2027, and that a moratorium on new permits is refused.
The LOWI did not rule on the substance of the complaint, but only on the procedure.
Het LOWI heeft zich niet over de inhoud van de klacht uitgesproken, maar uitsluitend over de procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over NAVO-doelstellingen

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the Netherlands is bound by NATO objectives, whether those obligations can be sent to parliament, and why a VWS answer named her ministry among those bound by NATO Resilience Objectives. The minister replied that these resilience objectives are non-binding guidelines that each member state implements through national policy, and that the ministry contributes to the whole-of-government resilience effort set out in a December 2024 letter.

These resilience objectives are, as the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport indicated in her answer 17 of the same parliamentary document, guidelines for member states, which each country fills in through national policy.

Deze weerbaarheidsdoelen zijn, zoals de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport aangaf in haar antwoord 17 van datzelfde Kamerstuk 4 , richtlijnen voor lidstaten, die elk land zelf invult middels nationaal beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Boswijk over het bericht dat Amerikaanse experts geheime communicatieapparatuur hebben aangetroffen in Chinese zonne-omvormers

MPs Bontenbal and Boswijk asked the ministers about a report that rogue communication devices were found in Chinese solar inverters, and about risks to the grid, AIVD's role, EU measures, inverter numbers in the Netherlands, detection controls and follow-up to a 2023 RDI report. The government answered that the report is based on anonymous sources and cannot be verified, outlined existing and forthcoming EU and Dutch cybersecurity rules enforced by the RDI, and described ongoing industrial and supervisory initiatives.
The cited article states that secret components have been installed in solar panel inverters, allowing China to switch inverters on and off remotely and change settings.
In het aangehaalde artikel staat dat er geheime componenten in omvormers voor zonnepanelen zijn aangebracht, waarmee China op afstand omvormers aan en uit kan schakelen en instellingen kan aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Veltman over het artikel “Dankzij Marcus (67) kunnen blinden hier veilig oversteken”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a tactile edge marking installed at a rail crossing in Vught for blind and visually impaired pedestrians, and whether such guidance lines should be extended nationally and prioritised near schools and stations. The minister answered that the Vught marking is a temporary, non-standard measure whose effectiveness is still being assessed, that no nationwide extension is planned, and that municipalities are primarily responsible for accessible public space.
For the time being there are no plans to take such measures at more locations.
Voorlopig zijn er geen plannen om op meer locaties dergelijke maatregelen te treffen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de berichten 'Grond schudt in Warffum door beving met kracht van 2.1: 'Dreun en trillingen door het hele huis'' en 'Hartenkreet van actievoerders om gaswinning Wa

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked about a 2.1 earthquake in Warffum and protests against continued gas extraction from the small Warffum field, pointing to SodM's refusal to tolerate extraction and the province's and municipality's appeal. The Minister answers that extraction can proceed safely based on TNO, SodM and Mijnraad advice, that the seismic risk management plan was tightened with an earlier shutdown threshold, that a Council of State interim ruling allowed resumption, and that no meeting with residents is planned.
SodM did not reject the extraction plan. In its advice on the extraction plan, SodM stated that extraction can technically take place safely.
SodM heeft het winningsplan niet afgewezen. SodM heeft in het advies op het winningsplan aangegeven dat de winning technisch veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Flach en Grinwis over de invulling van de klimaatmaatregelen voor de glastuinbouw

MPs Flach and Grinwis asked the government about the impact of ETS-2 and the green gas blending obligation on greenhouse growers, whether the sector agreed to an opt-in, why an exemption for glasshouse horticulture is not feasible, and how compensation and the CO2 levy will be set. The minister answered that an opt-in with full cost compensation is unavoidable for enforceability reasons, that the blending obligation is reduced and delayed, that a new tariff study is pending, and that a compensation scheme and SDE++ adjustments are still being worked out.

The cabinet remains in discussion with the covenant partners, trusting that the sector's concerns about reasonable and timely compensation can be resolved on the basis of the compensation scheme being worked out.

Het kabinet blijft hierover in gesprek met de convenantspartijen in het vertrouwen dat de zorgen vanuit de sector over de redelijke en tijdige compensatie weg te nemen zijn op basis van de uitgewerkte compensatieregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma  over de stop van de bouw van een biobrandstoffabriek door UPM in de Rotterdamse haven

An NSC MP asked the ministers about UPM's decision to abandon a biofuel plant in the Rotterdam port, its impact on the energy transition, and calls for a Deltaplan, a coordination table, conditional subsidies and strategic industrial choices. The minister acknowledged the withdrawal as illustrative of investment-climate problems, pointed to existing cluster approaches and Groene Groei measures, declined a new Deltaplan or coordination table, and promised forthcoming industry and energy-intensive-industry letters to parliament.
An additional coordination table is not a solution to the current problems regarding the absence of investment decisions in the industrial clusters.
Een extra regietafel is geen oplossing voor de huidige problemen ten aanzien van het uitblijven van investeringsbeslissingen in de industrieclusters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat miljoenen zonnepaneelhouders ook na het vervallen van de wettelijke salderingsregeling in 2027 recht blijven hebben op salderen

An MP asked the minister whether consumers keep a contractual right to net metering (salderen) after the statutory scheme ends in 2027, and how this relates to a court ruling and consumer protection. The minister answered that the statutory duty ends on 1 January 2027, that the private contractual position is for the parties and courts to decide, and that the government urges suppliers to communicate clearly with customers.
That is up to the contracting parties, because it is an arrangement that forms part of the contract between the supplier and the end user.
Dat is aan de contractpartijen, omdat het een afspraak betreft die onderdeel vormt van de overeenkomst tussen de leverancier en de eindafnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het Berenschot Rapport: De effecten van energiebesparende maatregelen op de energierekening van huishoudens in energiearmoede

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a Berenschot report on energy-saving measures and energy poverty, and a TNO scenario study on energy poverty in 2025, asking whether structural insulation and heat-pump measures are preferable to repeated temporary support and how the government will act. The minister answered that structural measures are preferred but temporary support is still needed, cited the Energiefonds, Social Climate Fund plans and subsidies, and declined to commit to a cost-benefit analysis or to guarantee halving bills.
It is not easy to fully isolate the budgetary cost and impact of measures for the group of households in energy poverty.
Het is niet eenvoudig om het budgettaire beslag en de impact van maatregelen volledig te isoleren voor de groep huishoudens in energiearmoede.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht ‘Uniper stopt met veel investeringen in Nederland vanwege onduidelijk beleid’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that Uniper is halting major Dutch investments due to unclear energy policy, including effects on hydrogen, green gas, CO2 reduction and security of supply. The minister answered that details of the projects and amounts are unknown, that Uniper continues its Maasvlakte hydrogen project and keeps its power plants, and that the cabinet will address dispatchable capacity via a possible capacity mechanism with a decision planned in the first half of 2026.
The cabinet does not have details regarding Uniper's specific projects or the scale of the associated investments.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over details met betrekking tot de betreffende projecten van Uniper of de omvang van de hiermee gepaard gaande investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het Nationaal Burgerberaad Klimaat

MP Vermeer asked ministers about a children's climate summit run under the National Citizens' Climate Assembly, questioning the factual accuracy and one-sidedness of its video and materials, the role of government, costs, and whether climate education for children should be regulated. The minister responded that the independent chair commissioned and reviewed the summit, acknowledged that the video needed nuance and a fact-check was added, stated government does not produce school materials given freedom of education, and gave a cost of about 61,000 euro.
The chair acknowledged that as commissioner she should have been sharper about the examples and facts presented.
De voorzitter heeft erkend dat zij als opdrachtgever scherper had moeten zijn op de gepresenteerde voorbeelden en feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de plannen voor nieuwe kerncentrales, kosteninschattingen en veiligheid Borssele

MP Teunissen (PvdD) asked the government about its plans for new nuclear plants, cost estimates versus other studies, and the safety implications of dropping the Borssele benchmark. The ministers defended nuclear power as a necessary part of a robust energy mix, acknowledged cost uncertainty pending TNO studies, and argued that dropping the benchmark does not reduce safety requirements, with no new MER needed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de CO2-heffing

Conservative MP Bontenbal asked the minister how the government will implement the motion to remove national taxes ('koppen') and what this means for the national CO2 levy on industry, given a study finding unilateral levies mainly cause leakage and questioning the post-2030 price path. The minister replies that the levy is retained as a 'stick behind the door', the reduction target shifts from 2030 to 2032, the rate rises to 216 euro/ton by 2035, and the government will consult industry and propose alternatives with PBL advice.
The cabinet will discuss this with industry and other stakeholders.
Het kabinet gaat hierover in gesprek met de industrie en andere stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Postma over het tekort aan installatiehavens voor wind op zee

MPs Kröger, Thijssen and Postma asked the minister about a shortage of installation ports for offshore wind, the government's position relative to other North Sea countries, and support for the Energiehaven IJmond project, including whether the state would close an unprofitable business case gap before summer recess. The minister acknowledged the port capacity shortage and said the cabinet supports the project and signed a convenant committing to seek solutions, but will only inform parliament on concrete state support around Prinsjesdag.

As soon as there is clarity on whether the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth and the Ministry of Economic Affairs can support the project, the cabinet will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Zodra er duidelijkheid is of het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei en het Ministerie van Economische Zaken het project kunnen ondersteunen zal het kabinet daar de Kamer over informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de CO2-heffing en het verduurzamen van de Nederlandse industrie

Deputy MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the pace of industrial decarbonisation, the expected yield of the CO2 levy, the risk of carbon leakage and the treatment of cluster 6 firms. The minister answered that emissions fell with production cuts and that the levy yield of around 291 million euro is outdated, with a new estimate to follow with the bill on Prinsjesdag.
A new estimate will form part of the bill on the CO2 levy for industry to be presented on Budget Day (Prinsjesdag).
Een nieuwe raming zal onderdeel uitmaken van het wetsvoorstel voor de CO 2 -heffing industrie dat wordt gepresenteerd met Prinsjesdag.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de Verenigde Staten en The Metals Company om diepzeemijnbouw mogelijk te maken, buiten het internationale rechtskader van de Internationale Zeebodemautoriteit (ISA) om

An MP asked the government how it views the US executive order and TMC's plan to mine the deep seabed outside the ISA framework, and whether the Netherlands will join calls for a moratorium. The government says it finds these developments worrying, upholds UNCLOS and the ISA's exclusive competence, but declines to adopt the 'moratorium' label, saying its substantive position matches the countries that use it.
The cabinet finds these developments worrying and is following them closely.
Het kabinet vindt deze ontwikkelingen zorgelijk en volgt deze nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het de overheidscampagne “Zet Ook De Knop Om”

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the government's 'Zet Ook De Knop Om' campaign, which urges households to use less electricity between 16:00 and 21:00, is a voluntary appeal and what its effects on grid overload would be. The minister confirmed the campaign is voluntary, explained it targets grid congestion through shifting appliance use, and said the government bears responsibility for structural grid expansion.
Yes, I can confirm that. The campaign aims to raise awareness and encourages households to voluntarily adjust their behaviour where this is easily possible.
Ja, dat kan ik bevestigen. De campagne is gericht op het vergroten van bewustwording en stimuleert huishoudens om op vrijwillige basis hun gedrag aan te passen waar dat eenvoudig mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de kosten van de energie-infrastructuur

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth how fully options to reduce the projected 219 billion euro grid investment need to 2040 have been explored, whether the NPE constrains the IBO, and questions the robustness of the FIEN+ and IBO analyses including the role of nuclear energy, offshore wind costs, heat pumps and grid-tariff measures. The Minister responds that the IBO tested sensitivities, that a public knowledge programme and a later NPE update in 2026 are planned, that a dedicated nuclear systems study is due in autumn, and that grid-tariff reforms are being pursued, while noting ACM holds exclusive tariff powers.
In the cabinet's response to the IBO, the cabinet has announced a targeted public knowledge programme.
In de kabinetsreactie op het IBO heeft het kabinet dan ook aangekondigd een gericht publiek kennisprogramma op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over hervorming van de Europese elektriciteitsmarkt en het oprichten van een e-faciliteit

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about an EESC proposal for a state-created e-facility acting as a market maker in electricity, and about EU coordination and market reform. The minister answered that the cabinet opposes creating such a facility, judging the current market model adequate and the proposal risky, while supporting EU coordination and planned capacity-mechanism policy.
The cabinet therefore sees, given the currently well-functioning European electricity market and the intervention options already available to it, no reason to establish an e-facility.

Het kabinet ziet daarom, in de context van de huidige goed functionerende Europese elektriciteitsmarkt en de interventiemogelijkheden die het kabinet op dit moment al tot zijn beschikking heeft, geen reden tot het oprichten van een e-faciliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'EPZ wil snel duidelijkheid over de toekomst van de kerncentrale: slopen of doorgaan?'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Energy about the future of the Borssele nuclear plant, including steps taken, remaining steps, timing, contact with operator EPZ and the state's possible takeover of shares. The minister answered in detail on the amendment to the Nuclear Energy Act, feasibility studies, shareholder talks, and timelines, while withholding details of the share-acquisition talks as confidential.
Given the confidentiality of the talks, the cabinet cannot, as indicated, go into substance on the possible takeover of the shares at this time.
Gegeven de vertrouwelijkheid van de gesprekken kan het kabinet, zoals aangegeven, op dit moment niet inhoudelijk ingaan over de mogelijke overname van de aandelen.
