Antwoord op vragen van de leden Postma en Six Dijkstra over de stroomstoring in Spanje en Portugal

Two MPs asked the government about the April 2025 blackout in Spain and Portugal, including the risk of a similar outage in the Netherlands, the protection of the grid, emergency plans, and public preparedness for long outages. The government answered that such a blackout is unlikely in the Netherlands, described existing grid safeguards, crisis plans and the coming Cbw/Wwke rules, and said citizens should be prepared for 72 hours of self-reliance.

In mid-2025 a multi-year public campaign (national government, other authorities, businesses and social organisations) starts to further increase societal resilience to long-term failure of daily services.

Medio 2025 start een meerjarige publiekscampagne (rijksoverheid, andere overheden, bedrijven en maatschappelijke organisaties) om de maatschappelijke weerbaarheid bij langdurige uitval van dagelijkse voorzieningen (ongeacht de aard van de dreiging) verder te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het bericht ‘Netbeheerders vrezen rampscenario: 200.000 huizen zonder stroom’

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that grid operators fear a scenario in which 200,000 homes could lose power due to grid congestion, and about related questions on investment, permitting, substations, and mitigation measures. The minister answered that such a scenario must be avoided, outlined existing and planned measures (congestion management, acceleration programme, substation and transformer-house expansion, a waiting list as fallback), and said more detail on regional risks will follow.
The cabinet therefore asks the grid operators to draw up a plan for in-depth grid analyses per province, prioritised by the current estimate of the scale of the problem.
Het kabinet verzoekt de netbeheerders daarom een plan van aanpak te maken voor diepe netanalyses per provincie, geprioriteerd naar de huidige inschatting van de omvang van de problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Saris en Postma over de ‘crisismodus’ bij Apollo Vredestein in Enschede

MPs Saris and Postma asked the ministers about the 'crisis mode' at Apollo Vredestein in Enschede, including prior engagement, energy costs, subsidies, and possible support for affected workers. The minister answered that the closure is a business decision mainly for the company, described past government efforts to keep production in the Netherlands, listed received support, and declined to commit to visits or EU funding requests until the company clarifies its next steps.
This information is not public and is not known to me.
Deze informatie is niet openbaar en is niet bij mij bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de internationale component van de kosten van het elektriciteitsnet

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the share of grid investments (up to 195 billion euro) linked to cross-border interconnection and exports, cost allocation with Germany and Belgium, TenneT's governance and oversight, and whether foreign users should pay. The minister answered in detail that only minor interconnector upgrades are in TenneT's current plan, that cross-border costs are being negotiated via North Seas cooperation, that TenneT Germany is funded by German tariffs, and that further assessment will come in the WIN plan.
It is being examined how the capacity of the offshore grid can be better used by also routing electricity exchanges with neighbouring countries via the offshore grid.
Er wordt gekeken naar de mogelijkheden om de capaciteit van het net op zee beter te benutten door ook uitwisseling van elektriciteit met buurlanden via het net op zee te laten verlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann, Lahlah en Kröger over “het sluiten van het Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie”

Three GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the government about the closure of the Tijdelijk Noodfonds Energie after a rush of applications, technical problems, and the mandatory DigiD requirement. The State Secretary acknowledged the frustration and access problems, but said no additional public or third-party funds were available, the fund had to close, and a DigiD was required to verify income.
To prevent administrative risks, the central government can only contribute funds when third parties also contribute more than one third of the total sum.
Het Rijk kan om bestuurlijke risico's te voorkomen enkel middelen inleggen wanneer derde partijen ook meer dan één derde van de totale som financieel bijdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de brandbrief ‘bezorgde (oud-)ambtenaren

An MP from BBB asks the Climate and Interior ministers about an open letter by (former) civil servants urging climate policy such as coal plant closure, questioning whether signatories' public action fits political neutrality, the oath of office, the integrity code and conflict-of-interest rules. The minister replies that civil servants are politically neutral but may express views within the functioning norm, that the integrity code applies only to active staff, that only a very small number of signatories are active at the relevant departments, and that assessment is a personnel matter for each employer.
Whether the 'functioning norm' is exceeded cannot be said in general terms or for whole groups.
Of de «functioneringsnorm» wordt overschreden kan niet in algemene zin, of voor hele groepen worden gezegd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie overweegt om gebruik te maken van internationale koolstofkredieten voor de invulling van het Europese klimaatdoel voor 2040

Bontenbal (CDA) asked the minister whether the EU's consideration of international carbon credits for its 2040 climate target is a missed opportunity, and whether the Dutch Climate Act would need changing to allow such credits. The minister opposes using foreign credits for the existing 2030 and 2050 targets, critically approaches a possible EU proposal for 2040, and says a change to the EU and possibly Dutch climate law would be needed.
The cabinet awaits the European Commission's proposal before taking a position and will share its negotiating stance with you as usual through the BNC procedure.
Het kabinet wacht voor een standpunt hierover het voorstel van de Europese Commissie af en zal de inzet zoals gebruikelijk met u delen aan de hand van de BNC-procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Toch ruimte op stroomnet, flexibele bedrijven sneller aangesloten'

MP Erkens (VVD) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a news report that TenneT found about 9 GW of spare grid capacity for flexible connections, questioning its origin, allocation, monitoring and whether batteries would crowd out businesses. The minister answered that the capacity is 'restruimte' already known but newly made available via the time-limited transport right (TDTR), allocated first-come-first-served, with flexible contracts, monitoring by TenneT and regional operators, and ongoing improvements in grid data.
This capacity did not newly arise or become available, but concerns so-called 'restruimte' (spare capacity).
Deze ruimte is niet ontstaan of beschikbaar gekomen, maar betreft zogenoemde «restruimte».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rooderkerk en Vijlbrief over een kapitaalstorting voor Tennet om de energierekening van mensen en bedrijven te verlagen

MPs Rooderkerk and Vijlbrief (D66) asked whether public investment in the electricity grid should be financed by cutting other public services or by letting national debt rise, and whether future generations should share the cost. The minister answered that options were weighed in the spring decision-making (raising the energy tax reduction on electricity, the IBO options), that grid investment is financed by public grid operators recouped via tariffs, and that all users, present and future, pay through tariffs, without committing to a specific cut or debt choice.
The cabinet endorses that it is desirable for all users of the electricity grid to contribute to the investments in, and maintenance of, the grid.
Het kabinet onderschrijft dat het wenselijk is dat alle gebruikers van het elektriciteitsnet meebetalen aan de investeringen in, en het onderhoud van het net.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Gabriëls over het bericht dat er meer 'zombiebranden' zijn door klimaatverandering

MPs Kröger and Gabriëls asked the government about reports that climate change is causing more 'zombie fires' and what the Netherlands is doing on climate adaptation, drought, water management and spatial planning. The minister replied that such overwintering fires have not been documented in the Netherlands, cited existing funding and planned measures including a new National Climate Adaptation Strategy due in 2026, and gave substantive answers on most questions while declining to provide the strategy draft before year-end.
According to the current planning, the draft NAS will be opened for public consultation at the end of this year.
Volgens de huidige planning zal de ontwerpNAS eind dit jaar opengesteld worden voor publieke consultatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de betrokkenheid van multinationals bij omstreden fracking-operaties voor de productie van plastic verpakkingen

An MP asked the ministers about multinationals such as Unilever, Coca-Cola and Nestlé allegedly linked to fracking for plastic packaging feedstock in Texas, and about Dutch measures on fossil plastics, EU and global rules, transparency and a fracking ban. The government said it promotes recycled and bio-based plastic, points to EU packaging rules and the CSRD/CSDDD for transparency, maintains the ban on shale gas, and wants an ambitious global plastics treaty.
The cabinet is currently not considering additional national obligations.
Het kabinet overweegt op dit moment geen aanvullende nationale verplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het artikel 'Local fossil fuel ad ban as a catalyst for global change' gepubliceerd in Nature Climate Change op 21 maart 2025

An MP (Teunissen, PvdD) asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a Nature Climate Change article arguing that a ban on fossil fuel advertising can catalyse climate action, and why such a ban was left out of the final Climate Plan 2025-2035 despite the government's earlier acknowledgement of its role. The Minister replies that a ban is not yet feasible without a workable, legally robust definition, that a standalone ban is insufficient so an 'aanpak duurzaam leven' will examine measures, and that the government does not recognise the claim that it misused the researchers' advice.
It is therefore premature to state, as the authors do, that a ban would come with relatively low costs and implementation requirements.
Het is dus prematuur om, zoals de auteurs doen, te stellen dat een verbod met relatief lage kosten en implementatie-eisen gepaard zal gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de veiligheid van klimaatwetenschap

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth what is being done at European level to protect climate science and climate data threatened by US federal cuts, and what options exist for Europe and the Netherlands. The minister answered that consultations are ongoing with European colleagues and national institutions, that the US situation is still unclear so no concrete action can yet be decided, and that options such as copying datasets and supporting IPCC work are being explored.
Due to (commercial) confidential information, the cabinet cannot yet make statements about Dutch and European institutions and organisations engaged in climate science and using this data.

Vanwege (bedrijfs)vertrouwelijke informatie kan het kabinet op dit moment nog geen uitspraken doen over Nederlandse en Europese instituties en organisaties die zich bezighouden met, klimaatwetenschap en gebruik maken van, deze data.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Stoffer naar aanleiding van het artikel in de Telegraaf ‘Recyclingsector in actie tegen extra plasticheffing: ’Kabinet zoekt geld, afvalsector wordt gepakt’’

MPs Pierik and Stoffer asked the government whether a planned plastic levy would fall on the waste and recycling sector, why recycling is struggling, and what the cost burden is. The State Secretary answered that the levy's design is still under review in spring budget decisions, that recyclers face high energy prices and EU rules, and gave tax-rate tables and Belgian and German comparisons, without committing to a final design.
The design of this is part of the spring budget decision-making. One cannot anticipate this.
De vormgeving hiervan is onderdeel van de voorjaarsbesluitvorming. Hier kan niet op worden vooruitgelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het artikel 'Consumenten betalen een toeslag voor groen gas, maar dat is er nog niet'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that households pay a surcharge for green gas blending that is not yet in place, the delayed bill, and affordability. The minister confirmed the timeline is uncertain pending the European Commission and Council of State, said suppliers may revise contracts, and pointed to existing support measures without committing to refunds.
The cabinet considers it undesirable that energy suppliers charge costs that may not need to be incurred.
Het kabinet vindt het onwenselijk dat energieleveranciers kosten in rekening brengen die mogelijk niet gemaakt hoeven te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid vragen van het lid De Vos over de wetenschappelijke onderbouwing voor en weerlegging van de zogeheten “hockeystick” grafiek van het IPCC

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth to substantively address the McIntyre and McKitrick critique of the IPCC hockey stick graph and to explain why the minister cited the Berkeley Earth 2024 temperature report, which does not address that graph. The minister answered that the critique was already rebutted, cited a National Center for Atmospheric Research review and later independent reconstructions that confirm recent warmth is unprecedented, and said one graph is not a pillar of climate policy though IPCC reports as a whole are.
However, the criticism of McIntyre and McKitrick of the hockey stick graph has already been extensively refuted.
Kritiek van McIntyre en McKitrick op de hockeystickgrafiek is echter al uitgebreid weerlegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht 'New shipyard for TenneT's German offshore platforms is being built in Spain'

An MP asked whether TenneT's German offshore platform shipyard being built in Spain, financed partly through Dutch state-owned TenneT, conflicts with the Maritime Manufacturing sector agenda and whether Dutch taxpayer money is involved. The minister answered that the Dutch state holds TenneT Holding indirectly, that the EU tender was awarded on price, quality and delivery time without a Dutch consortium bidding, and that the sector agenda was not a criterion, promising only a Q2 2025 progress letter.
The Siemens Energy and Dragados Offshore consortium awarded the tender for building the shipyard on the basis of various criteria.
Het consortium Siemens Energy en Dragados Offshore heeft de aanbesteding voor de bouw van de werf op basis van verschillende criteria gegund.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Grinwis over het bericht 'Zonnestroom is in 2027 geen cent meer waard, dus paneelbezitters zijn de dupe'

MPs Erkens and Grinwis asked the minister about reports that feed-in compensation for solar power will fall sharply from 2027 and whether Greenchoice's terms comply with the legal 50% floor and fairness rules. The minister answered that Greenchoice meets the 50% minimum, that fairness and cost questions are for the ACM regulator to examine, and that the ACM is reviewing feed-in costs and will get extra tools from 2027.
The ACM already supervises this and can enforce where necessary.
De ACM houdt hier nu al toezicht op en kan daar zo nodig op handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de agressieve en misleidende telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen

An MP asked the ministers about aggressive and misleading telephone sales of home batteries, including threatened fees, withdrawal rights, repeat offenders and privacy of phone numbers. The minister answered that the ACM is autonomous and handles enforcement, that consumers keep a 14-day cooling-off right extended if misinformed, that the stricter ban on unsolicited calling applies from 1 July 2026, and that the government will talk with the ACM but cannot urge enforcement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het artikel 'Zonnestroom is in 2027 geen cent meer waard, dus paneelbezitters zijn de dupe'

An MP asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a newspaper report that feed-in tariffs for solar power will become nearly worthless from 2027, whether suppliers may charge exit fees, and how to prevent solar owners from removing panels, and about storage incentives. The Minister argues the feed-in compensation is about 5.4 cents, that exit fees are not allowed for contracts concluded before the law, that studies on tenants are underway, and that home-battery incentives will be considered after network congestion conditions are set.
As regards the consequences for tenants, research is being carried out in cooperation with Aedes and Woonbond.
Voor wat betreft de gevolgen voor huurders wordt een onderzoek uitgevoerd in samenwerking met Aedes en Woonbond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bamenga en Rooderkerk over de economische kansen van verduurzaming op Curaçao

Two D66 MPs asked about a Curaçao solar park, EV charging and electric buses, including a 13.2 million euro financing gap and Dutch funding commitments. The minister says Curaçao is responsible for procurement and financing, that Dutch SDE funds cannot be used directly but grid and storage costs may be eligible, and that a feasibility study and a May visit to Curaçao are planned.
It is up to Curaçao to shape the implementation and financing.
Het is aan Curaçao om de uitvoering en financiering vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Kostić over “de onbetrouwbaarheid van de inschatting van saneringskosten voor de grond vanTata Steel”

MPs Teunissen and Kostić asked the government about the reliability of the estimated remediation costs of up to 12 billion euros for Tata Steel's land, including the assumptions, possible bankruptcy liability and the absence of a parent company guarantee. The minister answered that the underlying analysis is confidential, that remediation costs depend on future land use, that the polluter-pays principle applies, and that a maatwerkafspraak is being pursued to avoid a bankruptcy scenario.
No. Wijers and Blom, supported by BCG, conducted independent research.
Nee. Wijers en Blom hebben, ondersteund door BCG, onafhankelijk onderzoek gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over mijnbouwherstel in Limburg

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the timeline, organisation, funding and oversight of the Limburg mining-damage compensation scheme, including whether the scheme can open in 2025. The minister answered that a temporary organisation will be set up, the scheme is planned to open at the end of 2025, a permanent body will be created later, the regional advisory role is not yet guaranteed, and a pilot by the Limburg commission will be reported to the House.
The cabinet will open the scheme at the end of 2025.
Het kabinet zal de regeling eind 2025 openstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de afhandeling van mijnschade in Limburg

MP Beckerman (SP) asked the Minister for Climate and Green Growth why mining damage compensation in Limburg is delayed to late 2025, whether the presumption of causation will apply, and how the scheme is financed and organised. The minister answers that a temporary body will open the scheme at end-2025 in postcode tranches, that the Limburg commission will assess plausibility of damage, that a motion on the presumption for all mining is being addressed later, and that budget and organisation details will follow in June.
The cabinet will inform you shortly about how effect is given to the motion by the members Beckerman and Bushoff.
Het kabinet zal u op korte termijn informeren over hoe invulling wordt gegeven aan de motie van de leden Beckerman en Bushoff.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over slimme gestuurde warmtebatterijen

An MP (BBB) asked the minister whether heat batteries like NEStore, and energy storage generally, are undervalued in building rules and subsidies, and whether the government would support a Dutch gigafactory. The minister replied that storage is being valued in the upcoming NTA8800 method under the EPBD, that existing subsidies already cover storage, and that the government will inform parliament on innovation instruments in Q3 2025.
In the third quarter of 2025 the Minister of EZ will inform the House of his intentions.
In het derde kwartaal van 2025 informeert de Minister van EZ de Kamer over zijn voornemens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het mogelijk maken van meer aansluitingen op het laagspanningsnet door een flexibele backstop

Bontenbal (CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a flexible backstop that would curtail grid-intensive devices during overload, allowing more low-voltage connections, and about Germany's comparable system and next steps. Minister Hermans answered that the government is exploring this 'netbescherming' technically and legally with grid operators, will report by year-end, and will consider it in requirements for grid-intensive devices, without committing to a decision.
The cabinet will inform the House at year-end about the outcomes of this exploration.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer einde jaar informeren over de uitkomsten van deze verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Grinwis over de hoge warmtetarieven

MPs Kröger and Grinwis asked why heat tariffs stayed high in 2025 despite the emergency heat-tariff law, and whether the government fulfilled its earlier commitment on maintenance-cost calculation. The minister answered that the amended methodology lowered the total heat bill, that the fixed-cost reduction was smaller than estimated and the all-in maintenance benchmark was deliberately chosen to protect heat companies' returns, and that further measures will follow the Wet collectieve warmte.
The cabinet is of the view that the intention of the 'emergency law' has been followed, but that further steps are needed in the reform of tariff regulation.
Het kabinet is van mening dat de bedoeling van de «spoedwet» is gevolgd, maar dat er verdergaande stappen nodig zijn in de hervorming van de tariefregulering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het bericht 'Tienduizenden huishoudens kunnen energierekening niet betalen: waarom is aardgas zo duur?'

MP Eerdmans asks why gas is expensive, whether energy tax and VAT should be cut, whether the Groningen field closure reduced security of supply, and why a relief fund targets only the poorest households. The minister answers that tax and wholesale prices both drive gas tariffs, the 2025 tax cut is small, the fund reflects that not all households face rising prices, Groningen closure did not cause supply problems, and gas storage is being monitored with an update promised in April.
In April the cabinet will provide a further update on gas security of supply.
In april komt het kabinet met een volgende update over de gasleveringszekerheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de berichten ‘Groningen schrikt wakker van aardbeving (2.2) bij Usquert: 'Het bed schudde'’, ‘Verzoek NAM om gas te winnen in Warffum afgewezen’ en ‘toezichthoude

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked about an earthquake near Usquert, the controversial extension of gas extraction at Warffum, and reports that the SodM supervisor had changed its advice. The government answered that the Warffum decision was taken after advice from TNO, SodM and the Mijnraad, that no new SodM advice exists, and that SodM's refusal to tolerate continued extraction was its own competence.
These advisers indicate that the extraction can take place safely.
Deze adviseurs geven aan dat de winning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over het behoud en de verduurzaming van de Nederlandse industrie

An MP from the CDA asks how the government responds to industry calls and the EU Clean Industrial Deal for relief, including lower energy taxes, the revenue and effects of the CO2 levy on industry, expected ETS and other revenues, subsidy support, and the risk of industrial decline. The minister answers that the government supports EU energy tax reform and an ETS-aware approach, will evaluate the CO2 levy later this year, and shares revenue and subsidy figures, but declines to model the tax loss from industrial shrinkage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Boeren, bedrijven en milieuclubs: kabinet, kom snel met stabiel klimaatbeleid'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether a spring climate package will be made, how it will be financed, how the process is organised, and whether the climate targets could be dropped without funding. The minister answered that alternative climate and energy measures are being prepared for the spring decision-making, financed mainly from the Climate Fund, and that the government is holding to its climate targets while preparing alternative policy if they are missed.
For the spring decision-making, the cabinet is working on alternative climate and energy measures as set out in the Climate Note.
Het kabinet werkt ten behoeve van de voorjaarsbesluitvorming aan alternatieve klimaat- en energiemaatregelen zoals aangegeven in de Klimaatnota.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over extra klimaatmaatregelen naar aanleiding van de Klimaat- en Energieverkenning 2024

MPs asked whether extra climate measures are being drafted, whether any measures fall outside the IBO report, and whether ministry fiches and PBL/TNO reflections on the Meerjarenprogramma can be shared before the KEV debate. The Minister answers that the cabinet is still deciding alternative policy for the spring Voorjaarsnota, that it draws on many sources including the IBO and a pricing study, and that fiches and PBL/TNO reflections will be shared with the concept-Meerjarenprogramma.
The cabinet will share these fiches with the Chamber when it presents the draft Meerjarenprogramma.
Deze fiches zal het kabinet bij het aanbieden van het concept-Meerjarenprogramma met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het Nationaal Klimaat Platform

An MP asked how the National Climate Platform (NKP) is funded, why it is not covered by the Open Government Act (Woo), how its finances and salaries are accounted for, and whether its mandate will be extended. The minister replied that it receives up to 2.4 million euro per year via the I&W directorate, that the Woo exclusion was legally wrong and the website adjusted, promised publication of the financial report by 10 March, and said a decision on continuation will follow an evaluation expected in Q2.
The NKP is now preparing publication of the financial accountability for the past two years and will publish it on its website before 10 March.
Het NKP is publicatie van de financiële verantwoording van de afgelopen twee jaar nu aan het voorbereiden en zal deze voor 10 maart op hun website publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer naar aanleiding van de Kamerbrief wijzigingen ontwikkelkader wind op zee

An MP from BBB asked why the offshore wind development framework ignores fisheries impacts, how fisheries are protected and involved, cumulative ecological effects, compensation, nature compensation, cable security, decommissioning and costs. The minister replied that fisheries policy trade-offs are made in the North Sea Programme rather than the framework, listed the technical changes made, and described existing consultation, mitigation, monitoring and funding measures, while committing to further studies on active fishing in wind farms.
The policy trade-off between fisheries and offshore wind is made in the North Sea Programme, not in the Development Framework.
De beleidsmatige afweging tussen visserij en windenergie op zee wordt gemaakt in het Programma Noordzee, niet in het Ontwikkelkader.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Van der Lee over het rapport "Dutch financial institutions decarbonising their energy portfolios. Analysing financial flows to fossil fuels and renewable energy" van de Eerlijke

MPs Kröger and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a report showing Dutch financial institutions invest only about 20 cents in renewables per euro in fossil fuels, and how the 6:1 renewable-to-fossil ratio by 2030 will be achieved, including prudential supervision, disclosure and reporting obligations. The Minister, Heinen, answered that the government relies on climate policy, the Klimaatcommitment and existing EU rules, rejects additional national obligations, says prudential supervisors already expect climate risk management, and argues full public disclosure of portfolios is disproportionate due to commercial and privacy concerns.
Mandatory full public disclosure on a large scale is also not proportionate because commercial, business-sensitive information could end up in the public domain.
Verplichte algehele openbaarmaking op grote schaal is ook niet proportioneel omdat commerciële, bedrijfsgevoelige informatie op straat kan komen te liggen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie subsidies heeft verstrekt aan milieuorganisaties om specifieke wetgevingsvoorstellen te promoten, zoals de Natuurherstelwet

An MP asked the Dutch ministers whether EU Commission subsidies to environmental NGOs to promote legislation such as the Nature Restoration Law raise transparency concerns, and asked for an overview, conditions, and publication of Dutch subsidies to such groups. The minister denied that Dutch subsidies fund lobbying, declined a full overview and publication of individual subsidy agreements, and stated no changes to subsidy policy are planned.
No. The cabinet does not keep a central overview of all national government subsidies.
Nee. Het kabinet houdt geen centraal overzicht bij van alle rijkssubsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eerdmans en Vermeer over het bericht 'Minister wijst verder onderzoek naar eilanden met zonnepanelen in IJsselmeer definitief van de hand'

MPs Eerdmans and Vermeer asked whether the Wieringerhoek floating solar project in the IJsselmeer can still proceed despite the minister halting it, and whether the Rijk should stop further steps by the province and municipality. The minister answered that no procedures are running, the cabinet refused the Meerlicht B.V. project application, insufficient prospects for permits exist, and the cabinet sees no reason to act on the call to halt local efforts.
Given this, and since the cabinet has already rejected the Meerlicht B.V. application for the project procedure, the cabinet sees no reason at this time to act on your call.

Gezien dit gegeven en het kabinet de aanvraag van Meerlicht B.V. tot toepassing van de projectprocedure reeds heeft afgewezen, ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen aanleiding om gevolg te geven aan uw oproep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over “de toenemende klimaatschade in Nederland”

Teunissen (PvdD) asked the minister about rising climate damage in the Netherlands, including sector-level damage estimates, regional risk, fair distribution of costs and how economic policy weighs climate damage. The minister answered that no sector-level overview of past damage exists, pointed to PBL and climate damage estimates, said a new adaptation strategy and a second Climate Plan are coming, and described existing tools for weighing well-being and climate costs.
No overview is available of the estimated climate damage over the past five years, broken down by sector.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van de geschatte klimaatschade over de afgelopen vijf jaar, uitgesplitst per sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het NOS-artikel ‘Regionale industrie krijgt geen stroom, maar betaalt wel voor CO2-uitstoot’

MP Erkens asks why regional industrial firms that cannot get grid connections to decarbonise must still pay the CO2 levy, and whether the levy could be deferred or differentiated. The minister acknowledges the problem, outlines grid congestion and permitting measures, and says additional flexibility options are being studied but differentiation and a lower levy are ruled out.
However, this request in essence corresponds to introducing a hardship clause, which is legally and technically not feasible.
Dit verzoek komt in de kern echter overeen met het introduceren van een hardheidsclausule, wat juridisch en uitvoeringstechnisch niet mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thijssen over het bericht dat de maatwerkafspraken met Nobian zijn getekend

An MP from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth 23 questions about the signed tailor-made climate agreements with chemical company Nobian, covering scope 3 emissions, residual emissions, state subsidy design and clawback, force majeure, the possible sale of the company, and nitrogen rights. The minister answered in detail, defending the subsidy structure and stating that the agreements were designed to secure additional CO2 reduction and remain binding even if the company is sold.
The exact WACC used is commercially confidential and therefore cannot be made public.
De exacte WACC die is gehanteerd is bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kan daarom niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over de stijgende kosten voor duurzame warmteopwekking met vloeibare biomassa

An MP asked the minister about rising excise duties on heavy fuel oil that have made liquid-biomass heat installations under SDE++ subsidy unprofitable, and whether the subsidy calculation will account for this. The minister acknowledged the problem for existing projects, said the subsidy basis cannot be adjusted, and offered affected firms the option to withdraw and re-apply in the 2025 round.
It is not possible to adjust the base amount for existing decisions because it is fixed in regulations.
Het is niet mogelijk om het basisbedrag voor de bestaande beschikkingen aan te passen omdat dit vastligt in regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over de uitspraken van de CEO van ASML over het Nederlandse vestigingsklimaat

An MP asked the ministers about ASML's CEO's remarks on the Dutch investment climate, including grid congestion, nitrogen rules, talent shortages, export controls and policy predictability. The minister answered each question, outlining the Beethoven package, grid and talent measures, ministerial committee on nitrogen, and commitments to continued dialogue with ASML.
I am in continuous dialogue with ASML about the measures needed to keep growing and investing in the Netherlands.
Ik ben voortdurend in gesprek met ASML over de maatregelen die nodig zijn om in Nederland te kunnen doorgroeien en doorinvesteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over vertraging bouw kerncentrales

An MP (Erkens, VVD) asked why construction of two new nuclear plants is delayed, why alternative sites such as Eemshaven were only now being examined, and what costs, legal routes and acceleration options exist. The minister answers that the site decision is delayed, the first plant is unlikely to be operational by 2035, legally robust siting requires examining reasonable alternatives, and no legislative change or special project law is considered necessary or useful.
As soon as possible this year the cabinet will announce which location alternatives it will investigate.
Zo snel mogelijk dit jaar maakt het kabinet bekend welke locatiealternatieven het gaat onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het Nationaal Burgerberaad Klimaat

MP Eerdmans asked whether the National Citizens' Climate Assembly is representative given self-registration after a lottery, who formulated its central question, why the new cabinet kept the process, what it costs, what funds exist for implementing its recommendations, and how outcomes are secured. The minister answers that participants were selected on five characteristics, that the question was jointly set with parliament and the previous cabinet and re-confirmed, that the process continues with a 10-15% extra cost claim under review, and that the cabinet commits to a substantive response within six months and a follow-up meeting after twelve months.
This additional claim is currently being assessed by both responsible ministries and will be handled in the regular budget cycle.
Deze aanvullende claim wordt op dit moment beoordeeld door beide verantwoordelijke ministeries en zal meelopen in de reguliere begrotingscyclus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over het bericht 'Noodfonds Energie stopt in 2025 door gebrek aan bedrijfssteun'

An MP from D66 asked ministers whether the Noodfonds Energie (emergency energy fund) should end in 2025 for lack of business contributions, and whether other parties such as grid operators could contribute. The government answered that talks with energy suppliers and grid operators continue, that the fund is needed for 2025, and that the sector's contribution to administrative costs is required to avoid state aid risk, with a request under the Comptabiliteitswet to start disbursement quickly.
The cabinet is actively looking for a solution to make this possible.
Het kabinet zoekt actief naar een oplossing om dit mogelijk te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Nederlandse gasvoorraden raken razendsnel leeg: Energiecrisis is allerminst voorbij'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about reports that Dutch gas storage is emptying fast, whether the target fill level should be raised, and how supply and prices are protected. The minister answers that supply is secured for this winter per GTS, cites EBN's filling task and a forthcoming bill, and says a fill target will be set in law and a letter follows.

The cabinet intends to include in the proposed Energy Supply Crisis Combating Act that the Minister for Climate and Green Growth sets an annual filling target, in other words a minimum fill level at the start of winter, for gas storage.

Het kabinet is voornemens om in het voorstel voor de Wet bestrijding energieleveringscrisis op te nemen dat de Minister voor Klimaat en Groene Groei jaarlijks een vuldoelstelling – met andere woorden: een minimale vulgraad bij aanvang van de winter – voor de gasopslagen vaststelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de implementatie van REDIII ten aanzien van het onderdeel 'biomassaverbranding voor energie'

MP Teunissen asked the minister why the EU's REDIII is implemented purely without stricter national rules on biomass burning for energy, how cascading use and phase-out of wood combustion will be ensured, and related questions on subsidies, BECCS and carbon sinks. The minister answered that the government sees no need for stricter national criteria, that pure implementation was chosen to meet EU deadlines, and that cascading and subsidy phase-out measures are still being worked out, with further information to follow.
This means that the implementation does not include any rules beyond those strictly necessary for implementation.
Dit betekent dat bij de implementatie geen andere regels worden opgenomen dan voor de implementatie strikt noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Sneller over het gebruik van de Wet Bibob bij subsidieverlening

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Sneller asked about the use of the Bibob Act in subsidy grants by central government, including RVO's practice, data sharing with municipalities, and LBB advice requests. The minister answers that Bibob use is left to each state body and is risk-based, describes the RVO advisory group and ten LBB requests, and promises further evaluation and updates.
Because of the confidentiality duty in the Bibob Act, the LBB only shares figures on advice requests where they cannot be traced back to individual cases.
Het LBB deelt in verband met de geheimhoudingsplicht in de Wet Bibob alleen cijfers over adviesaanvragen als deze cijfers niet te herleiden zijn naar individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over Agri-PV

MP Vermeer (BBB) asked the ministers whether the definition of agri-PV (combined agriculture and solar energy) should leave room for innovation, whether the agricultural land designation stays agricultural, and about tax, fertiliser, GLB subsidy and ANLb nature-payment rules. The government answered yes to most questions, committed to a WEnR study and to possibly amending the GLB regulation, but declined general statements on tax treatment and fertiliser quantities, citing case-by-case assessment.
Within taxation, it must be assessed case by case whether entitlement to the various schemes can be claimed.
Binnen de fiscaliteit moet per geval worden beoordeeld of er aanspraak kan worden gemaakt op de verschillende regelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over hoe het groene beleid van de Europese Unie kwalijke emissies buiten de EU veroorzaakt

An MP asked the government whether EU Green Deal policies such as afforestation, bioenergy and organic farming cause harmful spillover emissions and food production shifts outside the EU, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges the study's findings, says the government takes such spillovers into account and will assess the forthcoming EU agriculture vision, but does not commit to specific new measures.
The cabinet will assess this vision in due course and inform the House of Representatives about it.
Het kabinet zal deze visie te zijner tijd beoordelen en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Grinwis over internationale koolstofmarkten

MPs Bontenbal and Grinwis asked the minister what COP29 agreed on Article 6 carbon market standards, how these make climate action cheaper, when the PACM becomes operational, how companies and Dutch government could use PACM and ITMOs. The minister answered that standards for Article 6.4 credits were adopted, first credits expected mid-2025, companies can buy credits, and the Netherlands does not currently intend to use Article 6 credits for its own targets.
The cabinet is therefore currently not intending to use the options that Article 6 offers.
Het kabinet is daarom momenteel niet voornemens om gebruik te maken van de mogelijkheden die artikel 6 biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over “de schimmige telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen”

An MP asked the Minister whether telephone sales of home batteries are shady, the regulatory position on leases and bundled energy contracts, and whether the Energiewet will curb such sales. The Minister answered that the ACM handles enforcement, that existing tools seem sufficient, that new telecom rules will bar unsolicited sales calls to existing customers, and that stakeholders will be consulted.
The cabinet has taken note of the article reporting shady telephone sales of home batteries.
Het kabinet heeft kennisgenomen van het artikel waarin wordt gesproken over schimmige telefonische verkoop van thuisbatterijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over geothermiebronnen en het maatschappelijk prioriteringskader netcongestie

MP Bontenbal (CDA) asked whether geothermal heat sources, which reduce electricity demand for heating, should be given priority under the ACM's grid congestion prioritisation framework, and why ACM has not classified them as congestion mitigators or basic needs. Minister Hermans answers that geothermal supply reduces electricity demand and that heat networks get priority as basic needs, while geothermal connections are not direct congestion relievers; the government says the ACM is responsible for the framework and will raise the point in its planned evaluation.
It is up to the ACM to adapt the prioritisation framework.
Het is dus aan de ACM om het prioriteringskader aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het amendement over middelen voor de ontwikkeling van Small Modular Reactors (SMR’s)

The MP asks the minister about progress on the SMR amendment, including the status of programme lines 1 and 2, the number of provinces involved, and timelines for simulations. The minister reports that five simulations start in February to June 2025 with results mid-2025, that both lines run in parallel, and that most provinces joined via the IPO working group.
The cabinet will soon inform the House further about the steps taken since publication of the SMR programme.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer binnenkort verder informeren over de stappen die gezet zijn sinds publicatie van het SMR programma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Peter de Groot over het artikel 'Verzoek NAM om gas te winnen in Warffum afgewezen'

An MP asks the minister about SodM's decision not to tolerate gas extraction at Warffum after 31 December 2024, the criteria for postponing enforcement, the basis for weighing public unrest, and differences for residents if extraction were tolerated. The minister answers that SodM is responsible, describes the timeline for the definitive licence decision (earliest March 2025), and notes SodM's 2022 criteria while stating the decision lies with SodM.
The authority to make this decision lies entirely with SodM. I have no role in this and I respect the decision.
De bevoegdheid om deze beslissing te nemen ligt geheel bij SodM. Ik heb hierin geen rol en respecteer de beslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Eerdmans over het diversiteits-, gender- en inclusiebeleid van de ministeries

An MP asked all ministries about spending, design, training, quotas, success metrics, external consultants and the government's view of 'woke' policy on diversity and inclusion in the civil service. The government answered that diversity and inclusion policy aims at a representative civil service, sets numerical ambitions for gender and cultural diversity, and says no artworks were removed and no quota beyond the statutory banenafspraak applies.
For an overview of the money earmarked for diversity and inclusion policy per ministry for the coming year, as far as now known, I refer to the annexes.
Voor een overzicht van het geld dat het komende jaar geoormerkt is voor diversiteit en inclusiebeleid per ministerie, voor zover nu bekend, verwijs ik naar de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koekkoek over de herkomst van budgetten voor maatwerkafspraken

The MP asks how much budget is reserved for maatwerkafspraken (tailored agreements with large emitters), whether NIKI and SDE++ funds and unallocated Klimaatfonds money will be used, and how a level playing field for other firms is ensured. The minister gives budget figures (about EUR 1,004 million plus EUR 66 million for implementation, EUR 222 million for waste incinerators), says NIKI and SDE++ are generic schemes with allocation by tender, and defers the unallocated funds decision to the spring budget process.
The House will be informed about this simultaneously with the Voorjaarsnota (spring budget memorandum).
De Kamer wordt hierover gelijktijdig met de Voorjaarsnota geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Bontenbal over de opschaling van groene, blauwe en andere koolstofarme waterstof in Nederland

Two MPs (Erkens, VVD, and Bontenbal, CDA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about scaling up blue, green and other low-carbon hydrogen, including infrastructure, the REDIII industry obligation, Norwegian import contracts, nuclear-based hydrogen and cost competitiveness. The minister answered that hydrogen policy is largely technology-neutral, that the government is exploring barriers for low-carbon hydrogen, and that the industry quota and a demand subsidy are still being designed, with several points deferred to a later letter and studies.
The cabinet will also examine whether and how companies can be facilitated in jointly purchasing low-carbon and renewable hydrogen.
Het kabinet zal daarnaast onderzoeken of en hoe bedrijven gefaciliteerd kunnen worden bij het gezamenlijk inkopen van koolstofarme en hernieuwbare waterstof
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Hirsch over de uitkomsten van de COP29

Two MPs asked the Climate and Foreign Trade ministers whether they were satisfied with COP29's outcomes, including the climate finance goal, fossil fuel phase-down, and the protection of human rights and gender equality. The ministers answered that the Netherlands is partly satisfied, commits to the Paris goals and to a meaningful climate finance contribution, and points to further discussion in 2025 without committing to new funding.
The cabinet has chosen to first send the letter to the Chamber appraising the outcomes of COP29.
Het kabinet heeft ervoor gekozen om eerst de Kamerbrief met de appreciatie van de uitkomsten van COP29 te versturen.
Beantwoording op vragen van de leden Kröger c.s. over het gaswinningsproject bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, PvdD and D66 asked why the government will not share TNO and Mijnraad advice, the official appraisal of those advice, the Wnb permit, and why not all relevant documents were published under Awb 3:11 and the Aarhus Convention, plus questions on Waddenzee World Heritage Outstanding Universal Value. The minister refused to publish the advice before the decision, citing negotiating position with NAM and protection of a careful decision-making process, offering only confidential inspection by the Kamer, and asserted procedures were correctly followed.
Once the decision-making is complete, the cabinet will of course make the advice public and inform the Kamer about it.
Zodra de besluitvorming is afgerond zal het kabinet de adviezen uiteraard openbaar maken en de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Boswijk over het bericht dat scheepsbouwer Damen schepen opknapt die Russisch gas vervoeren

Two MPs from D66 and CDA asked ministers whether Dutch shipbuilder Damen's maintenance of Russian LNG-transport vessels breaches EU sanctions and how the government will tighten measures against Russian LNG imports. The ministers answered that sanctions prohibit servicing vessels linked to Russian entities unless they are used to evade sanctions, that enforcement follows signals of breaches, that the Netherlands pushes for an EU roadmap to phase out Russian gas and LNG, and that it will press for stronger measures in the next sanctions package, but they gave no case-specific details.

The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but in general supplying parts and/or carrying out maintenance (technical assistance) to vessels of Russian persons and entities or vessels used in Russia is prohibited.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele gevallen, maar in zijn algemeenheid geldt dat het leveren van onderdelen en/of uitvoeren van onderhoud (technische bijstand) aan schepen van Russische personen en entiteiten of schepen die in Rusland gebruikt worden verboden is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens, Vermeer, Bontenbal, Postma en Beckerman over de misleidende praktijken van energieleverancier Hollandse Energie Maatschappij (HEM)

MPs from several parties asked the minister about misleading and intimidating practices by energy supplier HEM, what consumer protection and enforcement tools exist, and whether firms like HEM can be barred from supplying energy. The minister said the Energy Act will give the ACM stronger powers (integrity screening, supply stops, licence revocation), noted bailiff-threat issues fall under the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and answered all ten questions in turn.
In the Energy Act, the ACM is given sufficient new tools to act firmly when it deems this necessary.
In de Energiewet krijgt de ACM voldoende nieuwe handvatten om stevig op te treden als zij dat nodig acht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de opschaling van groen gas

An MP asked the minister how biogas expansion is coordinated with municipalities and regional energy strategy regions, how the 2030 targets will be reached, how regional spread is steered, whether a regional target is planned, how price increases will be monitored, what grid maintenance agreements exist, and how Guarantees of Origin could be kept domestic. The minister answered that the government is developing new cooperation agreements with subnational governments and supports provinces, does not steer regional spread, relies on CBS monitoring and sector consultation, relies on grid operators for network adaptation, and considers domestic reservation of guarantees of origin not possible within the EU internal market.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen, Teunissen en Rooderkerk over de uitspraak van het Gerechtshof over de rechtszaak tussen Milieudefensie en Shell

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, PvdD and D66 asked the minister how the Hague appeal court's ruling in the Milieudefensie v. Shell climate case affects climate targets, corporate duties, and whether new oil and gas fields should be restricted. The minister replied that the case is a private civil dispute, that corporate responsibility is addressed through EU CSDDD and existing climate policy, and that no new measures on new fossil licences will be taken.
This concerns a civil case between private parties. The government is not a party to this case.
Het betreft een civielrechtelijke zaak tussen private partijen. De overheid is geen partij in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Beckerman, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over gaswinning bij Ternaard

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA, SP, D66 and PvdD asked whether the gas extraction permit at Ternaard was properly re-tested in light of SodM advice, Waddenacademie and UNESCO warnings, MER commission input and undisclosed advice, and whether all studies would be shared. The minister replied that the permit was granted in February 2024 under the Nature Protection Act, that the relevant advice gave no reason to revoke or amend it, that the Landsadvocaat advised UNESCO's position falls outside the legal test, and that the government would share some advice confidentially and publish others after final decision-making.

In line with my commitment in the debate of 11 December, I am willing to make the advice of TNO, SodM and Mijnraad available confidentially for inspection, so that committee members can read the content of this advice.

Conform mijn toezegging in het debat van 11 december, ben ik bereid de adviezen van TNO, SodM en Mijnraad vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen, zodat de commissieleden van de inhoud van deze adviezen kennis kunnen nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het bericht ‘BBB geeft signaal aan provincies en is tegen windmolens op het land: ‘Wij gaan tot het gaatje’’

Kröger (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a BBB MP's claim that the coalition agreement rules out new onshore wind and whether the government will accelerate wind turbine construction to meet climate targets. The minister denies the coalition agreement bans onshore wind, states onshore wind is necessary for climate and energy-security goals, acknowledges the RES targets are out of reach, and commits to ongoing consultation with local governments and RED III acceleration areas.
No agreements were made in the coalition programme to stop onshore wind.
In het regeerprogramma zijn geen afspraken gemaakt om te stoppen met wind op land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het rapport 'Het Windmolendrama' van Clintel

An MP asked the minister, in 18 numbered questions, about the Clintel report on wind turbines covering health effects, noise norms, ecological impact, costs, participation, EU law and turbine safety. The government answered that it takes health concerns seriously, is developing new noise and environmental norms with a plan-MER, rejects a moratorium, and points to ongoing RIVM research and existing compensation schemes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over ‘De verduurzaming Rotterdamse haven en fossiele lock-in

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth how the Rotterdam port will phase out fossil activities, whether the planned measures and SDE++ subsidy rules avoid fossil lock-in from CCS, and what concrete steps will be taken. The Minister answers that NOVEX Rotterdamse haven is preparing a development perspective and investment agenda, that a letter on fossil phase-out follows in Q2 2025, and that CCS remains necessary while lock-in risks are limited, but gives few specific figures or firm commitments.
In addition, the House will receive a letter in Q2 2025 addressing the overall responsible phase-out of fossil energy carriers in the energy system.
Daarnaast ontvangt de Kamer in Q2 2025 een brief die in zal gaan op de algehele verantwoorde afbouw van fossiele energiedragers in het energiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Gabriëls over de faillissementen van steeds meer koplopers in onze circulaire economie

MPs from D66 and GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government what it had done after several Dutch circular plastics recyclers went bankrupt, what caused the failures, and how the government responded to cheap Chinese and virgin plastic. The state secretary answered that individual cases cannot be discussed, outlined market causes and EU trade measures, and set out planned measures including a plastic levy from 2028, a recyclate norm from 2027 and EUR 267 million in subsidies.
The cabinet cannot go into individual cases, but can confirm that the Ministry of KGG has had contact with a number of plastic recycling companies to explore options for support.

Het kabinet kan niet ingaan op individuele casus, maar wel bevestigen dat het Ministerie van KGG contact heeft gehad met een aantal plasticrecyclingbedrijven om mogelijkheden voor ondersteuning te bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal, Erkens, Vermeer en Grinwis over de overstap van de industrie naar groene waterstof en de raffinageroute

Four MPs asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth and the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about the proposed 0.4 correction factor for the refinery route for green hydrogen, which they feared would undermine hydrogen investment and rely on uncertain market assumptions. The minister defended the correction factor as a balance between CO2 reduction, pump prices and hydrogen stimulation, acknowledged investment risks and committed to a study under a parliamentary motion on the refinery route's impact.

After the parliamentary questions were asked, the House adopted the motion by MPs Bontenbal and Vermeer calling for a study into how the refinery route should be designed to contribute maximally to the industry's sustainability goals.

Na het stellen van Kamervragen heeft de Kamer de motie van de leden Bontenbal en Vermeer aangenomen over een onderzoek naar hoe de raffinageroute eruit moet zien om maximaal bij te dragen aan de verduurzamingsdoelstellingen van de industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Bontenbal over het potentiële valmeerproject bij de Haringvlietmonding

MPs Grinwis and Bontenbal asked the government about the proposed Delta21 valmeer (storage reservoir) at the Haringvliet mouth, its energy value, flood safety, ecological impact, strategic autonomy, and whether it should be included in the grid security plan and a cost-benefit analysis. The minister answers that the project has potential value as large-scale electricity storage but faces large uncertainties and ecological drawbacks, and commits to a broader cost-benefit comparison of flexibility options and an update of the energy storage roadmap.

As promised during the budget debate of the Ministry of Climate and Green Growth (7 November 2024), the cabinet is willing to map the pros and cons of a valmeer project for the energy system, including a comparison with other flexibility applications.

Zoals is toegezegd tijdens de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Klimaat en Groene Groei (7 november 2024) is het kabinet bereid om in kaart te brengen wat de voor- en nadelen zijn van een valmeerproject voor het energiesysteem, inclusief een vergelijking met andere flexibiliteitstoepassingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over wachttijden voor stroomaansluitingen

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Green Growth about waiting times of up to 70 weeks for household electricity connections, the causes, the measures to speed up grid expansion and permitting, and how these fit the coalition agreement. The minister acknowledges several thousand customers face delays of 40 to 70 weeks, attributes them to local grid works and staff shortages, and points to planned measures including a grid checker, legal changes to speed permitting, and a joint action programme with local governments and grid operators.
The cabinet is firmly steering the resolution of grid congestion problems and making the electricity grid future-proof, as agreed in the coalition agreement.
Het kabinet voert stevig regie op het oplossen netcongestieproblemen en het toekomstbestendig maken van het elektriciteitsnet, zoals afgesproken in het hoofdlijnenakkoord.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over de berichten ‘Nederlandse gasvoorraden de laagste van Europa: hebben we nog genoeg voor deze winter?’ en ‘Moet Europa zich zorgen maken over slinkende gasvoorraden met stren

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether Dutch gas storage levels, which are the lowest in Europe, are sufficient for the coming winter, and about the effects on prices, consumption and energy saving. The minister answered that storage is commercial, that current levels plus infrastructure are expected to suffice even in a cold winter, that a structural filling obligation via EBN and a bill are being prepared, and that other questions are pending.
For now, however, the expectation is that there is enough gas in the storage facilities to get through the winter, even if it is a cold winter.
Vooralsnog is het echter de verwachting dat er voldoende gas in de opslagen zit om de winter door te komen, ook als sprake is van een koude winter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de tegenwerking van verduurzaming door woningbouwvereniging deltaWonen te Zwolle

An MP asks whether housing corporation deltaWonen in Zwolle is blocking tenants' sustainability measures such as quiet air conditioning and solar panels, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister says tenants can go to the Huurcommissie or the courts, that the corporation's objections to some measures are reasonable in individual cases, and that a bill on tenants' initiative rights is expected in 2025.
If discussions with deltaWonen do not lead to the desired result, residents can turn to the Huurcommissie or the court.
Bewoners kunnen zich, als de gesprekken met deltaWonen niet tot het gewenste resultaat leiden, tot de Huurcommissie of de rechter wenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Gabriëls en Stultiens over de uitspraken van de minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat in het wetgevingsoverleg Water van 18 november 2024

MPs Kröger and Gabriëls asked the government to respond to remarks by the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management that the Valencia floods could not be directly linked to climate change and that climate science is not fully settled, and whether this conflicts with IPCC findings and the collective-government principle. The Minister of Climate and Green Growth answered that climate change increased the rainfall but flood damage depends on several factors, that the minister's remarks are not to be addressed as they were made on behalf of the cabinet, and that the answers were delayed due to a climate summit.
Statements made by ministers are always on behalf of the cabinet, unless explicitly indicated otherwise.
Uitspraken gedaan door bewindspersonen zijn altijd namens het kabinet, tenzij expliciet aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over NAVO-verplichtingen

An FVD MP asked the Climate minister about references to NATO obligations on pandemic preparedness by a health minister, the One Health concept linking climate and health, whether the minister was briefed by NATO, and whether climate duties bind the Netherlands under NATO. The minister confirmed awareness of the references and the One Health concept, denied any NATO briefing, and said NATO's 2021 climate action plan imposes no binding obligations on allies.
Where there are guidelines for allies on countering climate change, these are not binding.
Waar er richtlijnen zijn voor de bondgenoten voor het tegengaan van klimaatverandering, zijn deze niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Hirsch en Thijssen over het bericht 'Nederlands bedrijfsleven omarmt strengere Europese klimaatregels'

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the government about the CSDDD climate duty for large companies, enforcement resources, business support and level-playing-field concerns. The minister said the Netherlands supports uniform EU implementation, funds supervision via HGIS resources, has ACM test enforceability, and will support companies with guidance while pushing for harmonised implementation abroad.
At the 2024 Spring Decision-Making, HGIS funds were allocated in the BHO budget for implementing and supervising the CSDDD legislation.
Bij Voorjaarsbesluitvorming 2024 zijn er HGIS-middelen gealloceerd op de BHO-begroting voor implementatie van en toezicht op de IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostić en Teunissen over het voornemen van dit kabinet om Tata Steel in de verduurzaming te ondersteunen en de benodigde investeringen daarvoor

MPs Kostić and Teunissen asked the minister why the state should subsidise Tata Steel IJmuiden's decarbonisation given the company's weak finances, low investment and limited emissions cuts before 2045. The minister answered that a maatwerk agreement is under negotiation to accelerate decarbonisation and health gains beyond legal requirements, that the terms are confidential, and that viability and subsidy amounts cannot yet be disclosed.
As indicated, I cannot publicly discuss the ongoing negotiations and any possible contribution from the state.
Zoals aangegeven kan ik niet in het openbaar ingaan op de lopende onderhandelingen en een eventuele bijdrage van de staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rooderkerk over snel aanvullende klimaatmaatregelen nemen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether new climate measures will be decided in the spring 2025 budget memorandum, why not sooner given the Raad van State's advice, and whether the measures will be sufficient to reach the 2030 targets. The minister answered that alternative policy will be decided in spring 2025 under the regular budget cycle, that the Climate Act sets no decision date, that preparations are underway, and that PBL can only model the package after that decision, while committing to publish the KEV on Prinsjesdag.
It is correct that the Climate Act nowhere states when the decision-making must take place.
Het klopt dat in de Klimaatwet nergens staat wanneer de besluitvorming moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bushoff en Beckerman over de aangespannen arbitragezaak tegen de Staat van ExxonMobil

MPs Bushoff and Beckerman asked the government about ExxonMobil's new arbitration claim against the Dutch state over the Groningen gas field closure, including whether talks with Shell and ExxonMobil would continue, whether the companies should pay for Groningen damage and the ereschuld, and whether levies on NAM could be widened. The minister answered that talks are under review and will not resume without prior notice to parliament, that the arbitration does not affect damage settlement, that levies on NAM are constrained by the constitution and ECHR, and that the answers were delayed.
The talks will not be resumed without informing the House in advance.
De gesprekken zullen niet hervat worden zonder de Kamer hierover vooraf te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de investeringsclaim die ExxonMobil indient vanwege het dichtdraaien van de Groningse gaskraan

An MP asked the government about ExxonMobil's investment arbitration claim under the Energy Charter Treaty over the closure of the Groningen gas field, including damages, transparency, third-party participation and parliamentary information. The government answered that it cannot yet disclose the claim amount, will seek maximum transparency subject to agreement or a tribunal decision, will keep parliament informed at key procedural moments, and rejects the claim as unfounded and overbodig.
The cabinet will inform the House at important procedural moments, as has also happened in earlier investment arbitration procedures against the State.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op belangrijke procesmomenten informeren, zoals ook in eerdere investeringsarbitrageprocedures tegen de Staat is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Kröger en Rooderkerk over de kosten van de bouw van twee kerncentrales die volgens experts aanzienlijk hoger uitpakken dan de kostenraming van het kabinet

MPs Teunissen, Kröger and Rooderkerk asked the minister why cost estimates for two new nuclear plants (potentially 35-40 billion euro according to Follow the Money) differ from the cabinet's figure, and about financing, risk allocation and cost comparisons. The minister replied that no construction cost estimate has been made, only a reservation for the state share, that a cost indication will follow in spring 2025 after third-party review, and that cost commitments and risk allocation will be settled only in contract negotiations, while largely deflecting comparisons and the sunk-cost question.
The cabinet has not estimated costs for the construction of the nuclear power plants, but has set aside money for the government contribution to financing the total costs.
Het kabinet heeft geen kosten geraamd voor de bouw van de kerncentrales, maar heeft geld gereserveerd voor de overheidsbijdrage in de financiering van de totale kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de berichten 'Kennisgeving besluit omgevingsvergunning waterinjectie Schoonebeek-447' en 'Kennisgeving besluitwinningsplan Schoonebeek-Gas'

An SP MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the safety of wastewater injection and oil/gas extraction at Schoonebeek, monitoring, implementing the parliamentary motion on the statutory presumption of damage for all mining activities, groundwater and water-system effects, public participation, and Dutch oil demand. The minister answered that SodM can halt injection if unsafe, that monitoring is being expanded, that the motion's application is being referred to the Raad van State for advice, that water-supply risks fall to other authorities, and that domestic oil production remains justified.
The cabinet understands the concerns residents have, such as around Schoonebeek, about possible damage from mining and how it is handled.
Het kabinet begrijpt de zorgen die er bij bewoners zijn, zoals rond Schoonebeek, over mogelijke schades door mijnbouw en de afhandeling daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het onderzoek van het Nibud, in opdracht van de Mobiliteitsalliantie

MP Postma asked the government about a Nibud study commissioned by the Mobiliteitsalliantie showing that low and middle incomes face transport poverty, and what measures will restore affordable mobility and how ETS-2 affects transport costs. The Staatssecretaris acknowledged the study, gave no precise figure, pointed to past tariff measures, discount products and a planned Social Climate Fund, but did not commit to a specific new measure or timeline.
There is no precise figure to give on this.
Hierover is geen precies getal te noemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Bushoff, Kröger, Bamenga en Teunissen over een werkbezoek van Tweede Kamerleden aan Drenthe

MPs from SP, GroenLinks-PvdA, D66 and PvdD asked the government about damage handling for Groningen gas-extraction damage in Drenthe, including the vibration tool, expert independence, the presumption of causation, and the Norg gas storage and Schoonebeek projects. The government answered that improvements are underway, that the presumption of causation covers the Norg area, that the Raad van State ruling is under review, and that it will monitor implementation costs and review the Schoonebeek consultation process.
The cabinet considers it important to emphasise that the cabinet only consents if gas extraction can take place safely.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk om te benadrukken dat het Kabinet alleen instemt als de gaswinning veilig kan plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het klimaatrapport onderschreven door meer dan 15000 klimaatwetenschappers

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about a 2024 scientific report on climate tipping points, the lack of progress despite decades of climate action, and whether Netherlands will tighten its climate targets and adopt more radical measures. The minister answered that the government will keep to existing climate targets aligned with Paris, pointed to international initiatives and EU-level steps, and said further attention to circularity would appear in the new climate plan.
The cabinet is sticking to implementing the existing climate targets.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan de uitvoering van de bestaande klimaatdoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over het stopzetten van leningen aan bedrijven die zich alleen richten op het oppompen van olie en gas en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe velden

MP Vermeer asked the government whether ING's halt on new loans to pure-play oil and gas exploration companies is allowed, what its economic and financial effects would be, and whether other banks follow. Minister Heinen answered that ING's decision is its own commercial choice, that effects on the Dutch economy are expected to be very limited, that the bank's counterparties are confidential, and that gas remains needed during the transition.
Which parties financial institutions enter into financing relationships with is commercially confidential information.
Met welke partijen financiële instellingen financieringsrelaties aangaan, is bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden de Aukje de vries en Erkens over de financiering van kernenergieprojecten

MPs Aukje de Vries and Erkens asked about international banks' pledge to support nuclear energy, how the government will engage banks and COP29 for financing new Dutch nuclear plants, and how to keep gas extraction in the North Sea financed. Minister Hermans answered that a market consultation is ongoing with results to follow, that the government will engage the financial sector including via the climate commitment, and that the sector must make its own financing decisions while a sector agreement on North Sea investment is being prepared.
Within a few weeks the cabinet will inform the House about the results of the market consultation, a cabinet appraisal of them and the follow-up process.
Binnen een aantal weken zal het kabinet de Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de marktconsultatie, een kabinetsappreciatie daarvan en het vervolgproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over PV-panelen en PFAS

An MP asked the minister about PFAS in solar panels, Chinese competition, domestic production, recycling and whether PFAS-free panels or recycling norms should be mandated. The minister answered that SolarNL and EU measures support domestic manufacturing, that PFAS content is uncertain, and that MVI criteria will be reviewed next year.
Various measures are being implemented, prioritising those with the greatest short-term impact.
Verschillende maatregelen worden uitgevoerd waarbij prioritering wordt gegeven aan maatregelen met de meeste slagkracht op korte termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over ETS2

An MP from the CDA asks the Climate and Growth minister and the State Secretary of Finance about the expected costs and revenues of the EU ETS-2 carbon pricing for households and businesses, including the Social Climate Fund, compensation options and fairness of the burden. The minister answers that the government expects ETS-2 revenues to flow into general funds, rejects cutting energy tax and excise as compensation given the climate targets, and states that costs are estimated and kept under review.
Dutch budget policy is based on the principle of separating revenues and expenditures.
Het Nederlandse begrotingsbeleid is gebaseerd op het principe van scheiding van inkomsten en uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het doel «een doelmatige energievoorziening en beperking van de klimaatverandering» te realiseren

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth what the EUR 4.5 billion climate and energy budget for 2025 aims to achieve, and asked for definitions of 'doelmatige energievoorziening', climate mitigation, ideal temperatures and CO2 levels, and how success would be measured. The Minister gave conceptual definitions, pointed to IPCC and Paris Agreement targets of well below 2°C with 1.5°C as the aim, and said the effect in degrees cannot be stated because emissions mix globally.
What that yields in degrees Celsius cannot be said, because the temperature rise is the result of total greenhouse gas emissions across the whole world.
Wat dat in graden Celsius oplevert is niet te zeggen, omdat de temperatuurstijging het gevolg is van het totaal aan broeikasgasuitstoot over de hele wereld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over de salderingsregeling

The MP Kröger asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the planning agency PBL warned of the climate impact of abolishing the net-metering scheme and whether assessments were made of its effects on rooftop solar and CO2 emissions. The minister answers that the KEV does not model individual measures, that no CO2 impact estimate is possible, that rooftop solar growth will slow but not stop, and that the cabinet will decide on alternative measures in spring.
The cabinet maintains the agreed climate targets and will therefore decide on alternative measures in the spring.
Het kabinet houdt vast aan de afgesproken klimaatdoelen en neemt daarom in het voorjaar een besluit over alternatieve maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Buijsse over het verminderen van regeldruk in circulaire processen

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reducing regulatory burden and advancing the circular economy, including how circularity affects competitiveness, emissions and the definition of waste. The State Secretary answered that Dutch circular policy is being developed at EU level, that the national programme will be updated in September 2025, and that the definition of waste follows EU law.
