A new ICER will be published in early 2025. Partly on that basis, I will send an updated NPCE to the House in September of that year.
Begin 2025 komt een nieuwe ICER uit. Mede op basis hiervan zal ik in september van dat jaar een geactualiseerd NPCE aan de Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘GBB en Warffum-Alert trekken aan de bel in brief aan minister Sophie Hermans’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth how she weighs local concerns from Warffum and the GBB about extending gas extraction from the Warffum field after 2024, including subsidence, earthquake risk, and calls to end small-field extraction equally. The minister answered that the NAM extension request is still under assessment with advice from SodM, TNO and others, that she cannot prejudge the outcome or stop extraction without statutory grounds, and that a decision is expected by end of year with a draft decision open to public objection.
Currently the NAM request for extension of the gas extraction period is being assessed.
Momenteel wordt de aanvraag van NAM voor verlenging van de periode van gaswinning beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht 'Meerderheid Amsterdammers tegen verkoop van Afval Energie Bedrijf, wethouder noemt runnen afvalverwerking ‘geen kerntaak’'

An SP MP asked ministers about the City of Amsterdam's planned sale of the waste-processing company AEB, public opposition to it, guarantees for public interests, and whether the national government would take a majority stake. The government answered that the municipality handles the sale and has secured public interests through contract conditions, that the national government sees no reason to take a majority stake, and that it will take no steps on the matter.
The national government sees no reason to take a majority stake in AEB.
Het Rijk ziet geen aanleiding om een meerderheidsaandeel te nemen in AEB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over de leveringszekerheid van elektriciteit

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked whether the Monitor Leveringszekerheid 2024 shows electricity supply reliability problems by 2033 due to falling dispatchable capacity, and what the government will do before the costs of action rise. The minister confirms the projected 2033 shortfall, calls it an early warning rather than a certainty, and promises a letter by year-end on options including a strategic reserve, without a concrete timetable.
I will inform the House about this at the end of this year.
Hierover zal ik de Kamer eind dit jaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Rooderkerk en Teunissen over het bericht 'Klimaatminister voorspelt dat haar eigen beleid niet voldoende is'

MPs Kröger, Rooderkerk and Teunissen asked the climate minister about a newspaper report that her own policy would not be sufficient to meet the 2030 climate target, and why this was not stated in parliament, and about the expected CO2 effects of several scrapped or retained measures. The minister confirmed the warning, said the impact of individual measures cannot be quantified separately, deferred the full assessment to the KEV projection and the Klimaatnota, and declined to name new measures before the spring decision-making.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate the political decision-making in spring 2025 on possible alternative climate measures.
Het kabinet wil niet op de politieke besluitvorming in het Voorjaar 2025 over mogelijke alternatieve klimaatmaatregelen vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen, Gabriëls, Kostić en Koekkoek over het bericht dat vertraging dreigt voor Tata Steel’s verduurzamingsplannen

MPs asked whether Tata Steel's delayed submission of the environmental impact report (MER) and the health effects report (GER) for its green steel plans could hold up permits, and whether parliament will see these documents before a Joint Letter of Intent is signed. The government says the company intends to submit everything in one go at year-end despite repeated warnings from the environmental service, that the GER methodology is still being developed, that negotiation details cannot be disclosed publicly, and that parliament will be briefed confidentially and may see the MER/GER if finalised before the JLoI.

Given the State's negotiating position and the possible market sensitivity of information on the negotiations, I cannot publicly address the conditions of the possible agreements between TSN and the State.

Gezien de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat en de mogelijke koersgevoeligheid van de informatie over de onderhandelingen, kan ik in het openbaar niet ingaan op de voorwaarden van de mogelijke afspraken tussen TSN en de Staat.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Rooderkerk, Podt en Bamenga over het schrappen van het Nationaal Programma Landelijk Gebied (NPLG)

MPs from D66 asked whether the National Programme for the Rural Area (NPLG) remains government policy, what the quantitative effects of scrapping it are on climate, nature, and Water Framework Directive goals, and how alternative measures and the decision-making process were handled. The minister answers that the cabinet is ending the NPLG in favour of an implementation-focused, area-specific approach with contours due by year-end, while stating that the international targets stay in place, and that scrapping was agreed in inter-ministerial consultation and in the Regeerprogramma.
As a cabinet we are taking a different course and ending the NPLG, as the draft had been adopted by the previous caretaker cabinet.
Als kabinet slaan we een andere koers in en stoppen met het NPLG, zoals dat als ontwerp nog door het vorige demissionaire kabinet was vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het waarderen van de zonnestroomboiler ofwel PV-zonneboiler in de NTA 8800

An MP asked whether PV-solar boilers (electric boilers fed by own solar power) are a proven technique, whether they help with grid congestion and self-consumption, and why they cannot be credited in the NTA 8800 energy performance calculation for new buildings, asking for a fix before a committee debate. The minister answers that such boilers suit some homes with panels but heat pumps are more efficient, that grid-congestion benefits are limited, and that NTA 8800 will be revised in the EPBD-IV implementation, where own storage valuation will be assessed.
In NTA 8800, the calculated annual yield of the PV panels is fully offset against the calculated total fossil energy use of the building-related installations.
In de NTA8800 wordt de berekende jaaropbrengst van de PV-panelen geheel verrekend met het berekende totale fossiele energiegebruik voor de gebouwgebonden installaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het recente NRC-artikel 'Coalitie vreest dat de staat zelf moet opdraaien voor bouw nieuwe kerncentrales.'

An MP asked the minister about private investor reluctance to finance new nuclear plants, Dutch energy policy credibility, and options such as majority state ownership and guarantees. The minister acknowledged the financing challenge, said a decision on financing is due in 2025, and committed to sending market consultation results to parliament within weeks.
Within a few weeks I will inform the House of Representatives further about these results, accompanied by a cabinet appraisal.
Binnen een aantal weken zal ik de Tweede Kamer nader informeren over deze resultaten vergezeld van een kabinetsappreciatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Nederlandse inzet op bij de Energieraad ter bepaling van de Europese inzet op de COP29

An MP asked the minister about Dutch positioning on climate goals, deforestation, gender and climate finance ahead of COP29 and the Energy Council, including whether Netherlands will pursue Oil Change International's financing options. The minister replied that the government follows the regular climate cycle, is committed to its 2030 goals and the deforestation pledge, but declined to pursue most of the listed financing options and deferred the deforestation-law question to a separate letter.

On the cabinet's position regarding the European Commission's proposal to postpone application of the Deforestation Regulation by twelve months, you will be informed by the State Secretary for LVVN and the Minister for BHO by Wednesday 16 October.

Over de kabinetspositie aangaande het voorstel van de Europese Commissie om de toepassing van de Ontbossingsverordening met twaalf maanden uit te stellen wordt u door de Staatssecretaris van LVVN en de Minister voor BHO voor woensdag 16 oktober geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht ‘Staatstoezicht op de Mijnen: kans op sinkholes bij afsluiten zoutcavernes Oost-Groningen. 'Klinkt als een echo van het aardbevingsdossier'’

An SP MP asked the minister about SodM's warnings that closing very large salt caverns in Groningen may not be safe, and about risks of instability, sinkholes, compensation and possible reconsideration of salt mining. The minister confirmed the concerns, said a SodM advice on Nobian's new winning plan and closure research is still pending, promised closure only if safe, and pointed to monitoring, existing compensation arrangements and a possible further study.
That advice does not yet exist. I therefore cannot anticipate the results.
Dit advies is er nog niet. Ik kan dan ook niet op de resultaten vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over ‘Gaswinning op de Noordzee blijft achter bij verwachtingen’

An MP asks the minister why North Sea gas production lags expectations despite faster permitting, what the impact on energy security and state revenue is, and whether a sector agreement or carbon takeback obligation could help. The minister attributes the shortfall to the late-life phase and operator concerns about investment risk, political support and permit predictability, says a sector agreement is being pursued, and rejects a carbon takeback obligation for now.
I am in discussion with Element-NL and EBN to examine which bottlenecks exist and which measures are needed to stimulate gas extraction in the North Sea.
Ik ben hierover in gesprek met Element-NL en EBN om te bezien welke knelpunten er zijn en welke maatregelen nodig zijn om de gaswinning op de Noordzee te stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'TenneT wil regels zien voor apps voor zonnepanelen en waarschuwt voor black-outs'

An MP asked the minister about press reports that TenneT wants rules for solar-panel management apps and warns of black-outs, including IT security rules for manufacturers and whether Dutch hackers breached such software. The minister acknowledged the vulnerabilities, pointed to upcoming EU cybersecurity rules (RED from August 2025, CRA from about 2027), and stated that the risk of a large-scale black-out is very small.
The cabinet recognises a number of the vulnerabilities mentioned and therefore is working to strengthen the resilience of the (vital) energy sector.
Het kabinet herkent een aantal van de genoemde kwetsbaarheden en daarom werkt het kabinet aan de versterking van de weerbaarheid van de (vitale) energiesector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bamenga  over de faillissementen in de plastic recyclingindustrie

MP Bamenga asked about plastic recycling bankruptcies, rising plastic incineration, CO2 effects, job losses, the EU plastic levy, the circular economy law, and support measures for recyclers. The government attributes the downturn to low virgin plastic prices and expects a temporary dip, pointing to planned EU and national measures, a 267 million euro subsidy package, and anti-dumping tools, while declining to provide job-loss figures and saying the data on incineration trends are unreliable.
The cabinet does not have this information.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over deze informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Grinwis over het tariefsysteem voor de kosten van het elektriciteitsnet voor kleinverbruikers

MPs Bontenbal and Grinwis asked the minister about Flemish and Walloon time-based grid tariffs for small consumers and whether the Dutch flat-capacity tariff is fair. The minister said network operators will publish an alternative tariff study this autumn, that the ACM decides on tariffs, and that a proposal will be sent to parliament before the 28 November debate.

After Netbeheer Nederland publishes the study on an alternative grid tariff for small consumers, I will share my appreciation of it with your House ahead of the Electricity Grid, Energy Infrastructure & RES committee debate on 28 November.

Na publicatie door Netbeheer Nederland van het onderzoek naar een alternatief nettarief voor kleinverbruikers zal ik mijn appreciatie daarvan met uw Kamer delen, voorafgaand aan het Commissiedebat Elektriciteitsnet, Energie-infrastructuur & RES op 28 november a.s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Kröger over het bericht ‘Afkicken van Russisch gas blijkt lastiger dan gedacht: één lng-tanker per maand werden er plots twee'

MPs Klaver and Kröger asked whether the 14th sanctions package has increased Russian LNG imports into the EU and the Netherlands, how sanctions are enforced, and whether the government will press for tighter measures. The minister answered that Russian LNG imports into the Netherlands have doubled monthly since July, that this reflects rerouting rather than new purchases, that enforcement and sanctions are limited until March 2025, and that stronger EU-wide measures depend on a forthcoming Commission roadmap.
This concerns commercially confidential information on which I cannot make statements.
Dit betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie waarover ik geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het bericht 'Eneco kijkt over de grens bij investeren in opslag en opwek'

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about grid congestion, grid tariffs and incentives for large-scale battery storage in the Netherlands after Eneco's reported investments abroad. The Minister answered that batteries help with feed-in congestion but are not yet a reliable solution for consumption congestion, that tariff harmonisation is pursued at EU level, and that no new battery tariff or additional subsidy is currently planned.

I am in favour of a level playing field regarding network tariffs to prevent battery storage investments taking place in other countries when the most favourable storage locations are in the Netherlands.

Ik ben voorstander van een gelijk speelveld ten aanzien van netwerktarieven om te voorkomen dat investeringen in batterijopslag in andere landen plaatsvinden wanneer de meest gunstige opslaglocaties in Nederland bevinden.
Antwoord op de leden Kröger en Piri over het bericht 'Russisch staatsbedrijf sluist honderden miljoenen aan uraniumwinst door Nederland'

MPs Kröger and Piri asked the government about reports that Russian state company Rosatom earns hundreds of millions from uranium trade through the Netherlands, and how Russian dependence in nuclear energy and medical isotopes can be ended. The minister answered that the government opposes this revenue, pushes for EU sanctions on Russia's civil-nuclear earnings and LNG imports, notes residual dependence through legacy contracts and enriched ytterbium for medical isotopes, and says alternatives are being explored.
In line with the Klaver et al. motion, the cabinet advocates at EU level for sanctions that hit Russia's earnings in the civil-nuclear domain.
Het kabinet pleit conform de motie Klaver c.s. (Kamerstuk 36 476, nr. 3 ) in Europees verband voor sancties die het Russische verdienvermogen in het civiel-nucleaire domein raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Bushoff en Kröger over gaswinning nabij de Wadden

MPs Chakor, Bushoff and Kröger asked about the gas drilling at field N05-A near the Wadden Sea, including the suspended German cable permit, alternatives to the cable, biodiversity impacts and UNESCO risks. The minister answered that ONE-Dyas is seeking an amended permit, that no alternative powering the platform is feasible in time, that the project is judged not to significantly affect the Wadden Sea, and that ONE-Dyas will proceed with preparatory work regardless of pending procedures.
The goal is still to be able to produce the first natural gas this winter.
Het doel is nog steeds om deze winter het eerste aardgas te kunnen produceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kröger over het vonnis van het EHRM over de Klimaseniorinnenzaak

Kröger (GroenLinks-PvdA) asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the ECtHR Klimaseniorinnen judgment requires a carbon budget, CBDR-based allocation, and certainty on meeting the 55% 2030 target, and asked about the PBL reports and the ITLOS advisory opinion. The minister answered that the judgment does not require a quantified cumulative budget or certainty on the 2030 target, pointed to existing EU instruments and the annual monitoring cycle, and said the KEV 2024 will assess whether new measures are needed.
No. The ECtHR judgment does not impose an obligation on states to limit cumulative emissions with a budget.
Nee. Uit de EHRM-uitspraak volgt niet de verplichting voor staten om met een budget de cumulatieve uitstoot te begrenzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over de Nederlandse uitbreiding van de scope voor ETS2

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about the Dutch opt-in extending the EU ETS2 carbon pricing scope, including its fit with the coalition agreement, competitiveness, administrative burdens for farmers and growers, and next steps toward the European Commission. The minister answered that the opt-in excluding horticulture is an existing commitment, that a decision on greenhouse horticulture will be taken by spring 2025, and that a formal request to the Commission will follow if horticulture is included.
The cabinet will abide by this agreement.
Het kabinet zal zich aan deze afspraak houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Erkens over het bericht ‘Energiereus Engie vreest tekort aan stroom in Nederland: ’Binnen vijf jaar al gebrek’’

MPs Bontenbal and Erkens asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth about Engie's warning of a near-term electricity shortage, including capacity changes, a capacity mechanism and possible gas plant guarantees. The Minister answered that the latest monitoring shows no security-of-supply risk until 2030, that no capacity mechanism is needed yet, and that options will be explored and reported to parliament by year-end.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Postma over het opnemen van vliegtuigen en schepen in de EU-taxonomie als «duurzame investering»

An MP asked whether aircraft and ships are being included in the EU taxonomy as sustainable investments, given environmental litigation and doubts about their contribution to Green Deal goals. The minister answered that the taxonomy rules were already adopted, that the Netherlands supported including transition activities for private capital while seeking a separate transition category, and that LNG ships meeting design criteria can qualify.
At the same time, the Netherlands has taken a general critical stance in the EU towards the current application of transition activities in the EU taxonomy for climate mitigation.
Nederland heeft zich tegelijkertijd in algemene zin kritisch in de EU opgesteld tegenover de huidige toepassing van transitieactiviteiten in de EU taxonomie voor klimaatmitigatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Maatoug over het bericht «650 miljoen belastingschuld en toch dividend uitkeren: zo werkt kunstmestfabriek Yara»

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers about reports that fertiliser producer Yara pays dividends despite a large tax debt, receives green subsidies, and used transfer pricing to shift profit abroad. The minister answered that companies are free to decide their profit use within legal frameworks, that subsidies are capped to avoid overcompensation via claw-back mechanisms, and that the Tax Authority rejects profit shifting without real activity changes.
Nevertheless, the maatwerk agreements aim to prevent oversubsidy of projects, for example by including a claw-back mechanism.
Wel wordt er binnen de maatwerkafspraken op ingezet oversubsidiëring van projecten tegen te gaan, bijvoorbeeld door het opnemen van een terugvorderingsmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de brief 'Stand van zaken openstelling SDE++ 2024 en resultaten SDE++ 2023

An MP from the Party for the Animals asks the Minister of Climate and Green Growth why the SDE++ 2024 letter does not mention the scope RED-III gives member states to tighten biomass rules, why BECCS is presented as a route to negative emissions, and how the Netherlands will meet targets if that route fails, among other questions about biomass subsidies and ETS financing. The government answers that it chose pure implementation of RED-III without additional national rules, that negative emissions are needed and BECCS is one route supported by PBL and others, and that subsidies for biomass power plants will not be reopened in SDE++ 2025 while a biomass strategy is developed.
This was not taken into account in the decision-making, because pure implementation was chosen.
Dit is niet meegenomen in de besluitvorming, omdat is gekozen voor zuivere implementatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma, Bamenga en Rooderkerk over het nieuws dat omwonenden van zware industrie structureel hogere zorgkosten hebben

MPs from D66 asked the government to react to news that residents near heavy industry have higher healthcare costs, and about health data, pollution, legal enforcement of permits and the Tata Steel negotiations. The government answered that health depends on many factors so the link to industry is not direct, that no specific national data exists but further research (RIVM studies, a health impact method for permits under the Omgevingswet) is underway, and that enforcement tools lie with provinces and municipalities.
No, such insight specifically for residents of industry does not exist, and this possible link cannot simply be demonstrated, because it depends on many factors.
Nee, dergelijk inzicht speciaal voor omwonenden van de industrie bestaat niet en dit eventuele verband is ook niet zomaar aan te tonen, omdat het afhangt van veel factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over het vullen van de gasopslagen

An MP asks why Dutch gas storage lags behind the EU average, whether commercial motives or the Groningen field closure play a role, how much Russian gas is imported, and whether storage will reach 90% by 1 October 2024. The minister answers that storage is ambitioned at 90% by 1 November, that current fill is already around 90%, that the Groningen revenue drop refers to 2023 rather than 2024, and that an update on supply security will follow before 1 October.
Before 1 October 2024 I will provide an update on gas supply security, setting out a broader picture and addressing ongoing policy.
Voor 1 oktober 2024 kom ik met een update over de gasleveringszekerheid, waarin ik een uitgebreider beeld schets en inga op het lopende beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gabriëls over het overnemen van de adviezen van de Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond als harde voorwaarde bij de onderhandelingen over de maatwerkafspraken

MPs Thijssen and Gabriëls asked how health of residents and workers is systematically included in the Tata Steel maatwerkafspraak negotiations, and whether the government's commitments go beyond the motion on adopting the Expertgroep Gezondheid IJmond advice. The government answers that health is an integral part of the negotiation mandate, that a health paragraph will be included in the Joint Letter of Intent, that the health impact assessment (GER) is delayed and expected in 2025, and that most correspondence cannot be shared because it would harm the state's negotiating position.
Many of the documents and correspondence contain information that could harm the State's negotiating position.
Veel van de documenten en correspondentie bevatten informatie die de onderhandelingspositie van de Staat kunnen benadelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´, Teunissen, Koekkoek, Thijssen, Gabriëls, Bamenga, Rooderkerk en Zeedijk over de analyse van de toekomstplannen van Tata Steel door CE Delft

MPs from several parties asked the government to respond to a CE Delft analysis (commissioned by Greenpeace) comparing Tata Steel's transition plans with the Gezondheidsultimatum scenario on health, CO2, costs and feasibility. The government answered that the Gezondheidsultimatum is not feasible, that it will pursue a negotiated maatwerkafspraak based on Tata's plan with accelerated nuisance reduction, and that many details remain confidential due to ongoing negotiations.
The cabinet cannot make negotiated agreements on unfeasible plans and has chosen to pursue Tata Steel's plans with accelerated nuisance reduction.
Het kabinet kan geen maatwerkafspraken maken over onhaalbare plannen en heeft gekozen om in te zetten op de plannen van Tata Steel met versnelde overlastreductie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over het artikel 'Alliander loopt tegen grenzen bij versnellen netuitbreiding'

An MP asked the minister about grid-expansion delays at Alliander, the number of cable and transformer kilometres built, how to steer grid operators, and whether windfall proceeds from selling Kenter should be invested in grid reinforcement. The minister acknowledges delays caused by labour and material shortages, points to existing reporting, the LAN programme and ACM oversight, and states the Kenter proceeds mostly strengthen Alliander's equity.
The Ministry of KGG checks whether the investment plans of the national grid operators sufficiently account for developments in the energy market.
Het Ministerie van KGG toetst of de investeringsplannen van de landelijke netbeheerders voldoende rekenschap hebben gegeven aan ontwikkelingen in de energiemarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kostic´ en Teunissen over dierlijk vet in biobrandstof

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the government about animal fat used in biofuel, its links to intensive livestock farming, palmoil deforestation and fraud in imported used cooking oil. The state secretary answered that the fat is a low-value waste product, that limits apply and that Dutch oversight by independent certifiers and the Netherlands Emissions Authority is robust, while promising to press the Commission on inspections in Asia.
The Netherlands has a robust system that oversees the supply chain of biofuels.
Nederland staat voor een robuust systeem dat toeziet op de toeleveringsketen van biobrandstoffen.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van het lid Postma over het ‘EU-Coronaherstelfonds’

An MP asks the government how much the Netherlands contributes to the EU Recovery Fund, what reforms were agreed for the first disbursement and the remaining 4.1 billion, whether the road pricing measure will be implemented, and whether replacement measures are possible. The ministers answer that EU borrowing is repaid via the EU budget, list the milestones per payment request, note several measures are under pressure including road pricing, and explain that plan changes are possible only under strict objective conditions.
The cabinet will keep the House informed of developments on this, including through the half-yearly progress report.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer op de hoogte houden van de ontwikkelingen hieromtrent, o.a. door middel van de halfjaarlijkse voortgangsrapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Erkens over de voortgang van de Delta Rhine Corridor

An MP asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth why the Delta Rhine Corridor delay of about four years emerged only now, what lessons apply, and how industry, Germany, decentralised governments and Gasunie are affected. The minister acknowledges the planning was too ambitious, admits the Rijk's own limited steering instruments, promises further reflection and a return to the house after summer, but gives no firm figures on emissions or costs.
My ministry will therefore also examine which steering instruments the central government can still (additionally) deploy to strengthen steering of this project in future.
Mijn ministerie zal daarom ook onderzoeken welke sturingsinstrumenten het Rijk nog (aanvullend) kan inzetten om de sturing op dit project in de toekomst te versterken.

m: Amendement van de leden Idsinga en Six Dijkstra ter vervanging van nr. 13 over zware nahang procedures
Adds a heavy follow-up procedure so that general administrative measures under the UBO-register bill are laid before both chambers and can be turned into a bill on request of one fifth of members.
A heavy follow-up procedure provides that conversion of the AMvB into a bill can be demanded by one fifth of both chambers of the States General.
Een zware nahang voorziet er in dat omzetting van de AMvB in een wetsvoorstel kan worden gevorderd door 1/5 van beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal.
Motie van het lid Idsinga over uitspreken dat de Kamer een zwaar gewicht toekent aan ATR-adviezen
Declares that the House attaches great weight to advice from the ATR regulatory burden advisory body and should strengthen its oversight of follow-up.
declares that the House, in its daily work and especially in legislative processes, attaches great weight to the advice of the Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk
spreekt uit dat de Kamer in haar dagelijkse werkzaamheden, en met name in wetgevingstrajecten, een zwaar gewicht toekent aan de advisering door het Adviescollege toetsing regeldruk
Motie van de leden Six Dijkstra en Idsinga over een nieuwe vorm van gegevensdeling niet laten leiden tot een weigerlijst van (rechts)personen die de toegang tot het betalingsverkeer wordt ontzegd
Asks the minister to ensure a new bank data-sharing arrangement does not produce a refusal list that cuts off payment account access for persons.
requests the Minister to ensure that a new form of data sharing does not lead to a refusal list
verzoekt de Minister ervoor zorg te dragen dat een nieuwe vorm van gegevensdeling niet leidt tot een weigerlijst
Amendement van de leden Idsinga en Six Dijkstra over zware voorhang procedures
Adds a parliamentary heavy pre-consultation procedure: AMvB on UBO register access is laid before both Houses and can be turned into a bill if one fifth of members request it.
A heavy pre-consultation provides that conversion of the AMvB into a bill can be demanded by one fifth of both Houses of the States General.
Een zware voorhang voorziet er in dat omzetting van de AMvB in een wetsvoorstel kan worden gevorderd door 1/5 van beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal.
Amendement van het lid Idsinga over dat ook een groep van minimaal een vijfde van het grondwettelijk aantal leden van een der beide Kamers een adviesverzoek kan doen
Allows a group of at least one-fifth of the constitutional number of members of either chamber to request advice from the regulatory burden advisory body (ATR), not only the chambers as a whole.
By laying down in law that one-fifth of the constitutional number of members of one chamber is enough to request ATR advice, the threshold is lowered
Door in de wet vast te leggen dat een vijfde van het grondwettelijk aantal leden van een der Kamers voldoende is om ATR om advies te verzoeken, wordt de drempel verlaagd
Motie van het lid Idsinga c.s. over twee jaar na inwerkingtreding van het belastingverdrag met Malta in samenwerking met Curaçao een evaluatie naar de Kamer sturen
Asks the government to send parliament an evaluation two years after the Malta tax treaty enters into force, covering economic effects and possible revision.
requests the government to send parliament an evaluation two years after entry into force and in cooperation with Curaçao
verzoekt de regering twee jaar na inwerkingtreding en in samenwerking met Curaçao een evaluatie naar de Kamer te sturen
Motie van het lid Idsinga c.s. over de ongewenste gevolgen van het gewijzigde amendement op stuk nr. 11 (36421) terugdraaien
Asks the government to reverse the unintended effects of an amendment that gave large tax benefits in business succession to a small group.
requests the government, for example as part of the upcoming fiscal omnibus bill and/or no later than the Tax Plan 2025, to reverse the unwanted effects of this amendment
verzoekt de regering, bijvoorbeeld als onderdeel van de aanstaande fiscale verzamelwet en/of uiterlijk bij het Belastingplan 2025, de ongewenste gevolgen van dit amendement terug te draaien
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Idsinga c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over het invoeren van een zware voorhangprocedure voor de implementatie van richtlijnen

Requires that draft general administrative orders implementing EU directives in the Civil Code be submitted to both chambers with a four-week period, during which either chamber can insist the matter be regulated by statute.
The draft general administrative order to be adopted under paragraph 2 is submitted to both chambers of the States General.
Het ontwerp van een krachtens lid 2 vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt aan de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal overgelegd.
Amendement van het lid Idsinga c.s. over het invoeren van een zware voorhangprocedure voor de implementatie van richtlijnen
Replaces the light advance-consultation procedure for AMvB implementing directives with a heavy procedure giving both chambers four weeks to request legislation instead.
The draft of a general administrative order to be adopted under paragraph 2 is submitted to both chambers of the States General.
Het ontwerp van een krachtens lid 2 vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt aan de beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal overgelegd.
Motie van de leden Idsinga en Stoffer over niet langer onderscheid maken tussen de wijzen waarop oudedagsvoorzieningen worden opgebouwd
Asks the government to stop distinguishing between ways old-age provisions are built up in future wealth statistics and policy reports.
requests the government, in future periodic reports on wealth statistics, to no longer distinguish between the ways old-age provisions are built up
verzoekt de regering om bij toekomstige periodieke rapportages over vermogensstatistieken en het daaruit voortvloeiende beleid, niet langer een onderscheid te maken
Amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 84 over het schrappen van de verhoging van de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken
Scraps the planned 2023 excise increase on soft drinks, moves the increase to 2024 at a higher rate, and adjusts the beer excise minimum accordingly.
With this amendment the proposed increase in the consumption tax on non-alcoholic drinks from 1 January 2023 is scrapped.
Met dit amendement wordt de in het wetsvoorstel voorgestelde verhoging van de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken per 1 januari 2023 geschrapt.
Motie van het lid Stoffer c.s. over onderzoeken of de belastingheffing in de categorie "overige bezittingen" realistischer vormgegeven kan worden

Asks the government to study whether tax on the 'other assets' category of box 3 can be made more realistic, including a forfait asset-mix, a counter-proof rule and realistic yields for capped assets, and report by 1 May 2023.
requests the government to investigate whether taxation in the 'other assets' category can be designed more realistically
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of de belastingheffing in de categorie «overige bezittingen» meer realistisch vormgegeven kan worden
Motie van het lid Idsinga c.s. over een brief over de hervorming en vereenvoudiging van het belastingstelsel
Asks the government to send a letter in spring on reforming and simplifying the tax system, based on principles that work should pay and more work should pay more.
requests the government to come up in spring with a letter on the reform and simplification of the tax system
verzoekt de regering om in het voorjaar met een brief te komen over de hervorming en vereenvoudiging van het belastingstelsel
Amendement van het lid Inge van Dijk c.s. over het schrappen van de verhoging van de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken
Removes the 2023 increase in the excise duty on alcohol-free drinks and instead raises it from 2024, with matching changes to the beer excise minimum.
With this amendment the proposed increase in the consumption tax on alcohol-free drinks from 1 January 2023 is removed.
Met dit amendement wordt de in het wetsvoorstel voorgestelde verhoging van de verbruiksbelasting van alcoholvrije dranken per 1 januari 2023 geschrapt.
Motie van de leden Idsinga en Stoffer over de noodzaak evalueren van de verfijning van de categorie "overig"
Asks the government to evaluate, and if needed propose, further refinement of the 'overig' category of the box 3 tax under the Overbruggingswet.
requests the government to evaluate within the coming year the need for this refinement
verzoekt de regering om in het komende jaar de noodzaak van deze verfijning te evalueren
Motie van het lid Idsinga c.s. over bij toekomstige fiscale beleidswijzigingen de effecten daarvan op het vestigingsklimaat beschrijven
Asks the government to describe the effects of future fiscal policy changes on the investment climate so the House can weigh them.
requests the government, for future fiscal policy changes that may affect our investment climate, to describe these effects so the House can weigh them in its assessment

verzoekt de regering om bij toekomstige fiscale beleidswijzigingen die effect kunnen hebben op ons vestigingsklimaat, deze effecten te beschrijven, zodat de Kamer deze in haar beoordeling kan meewegen
Motie van het lid Idsinga c.s. over een uitgebreide en geactualiseerde marktverkenning naar nieuwe zero-emissiebusjes
Motion asks the government for an updated market survey of zero-emission delivery vans before abolishing the registration tax exemption, sent before summer 2024.
requests the government to conduct a comprehensive and updated market survey
verzoekt de regering een uitgebreide en geactualiseerde marktverkenning te doen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 10 over een extra schijf voor gas in de energiebelasting
Amendment introducing a new first band in the energy tax for natural gas up to 1,200 cubic metres, with a lower rate, and adjusting the other bands and related rates.
This amendment introduces from 2024 a new first band in the energy tax for natural gas.
Dit amendement introduceert per 2024 een nieuwe eerste schijf in de energiebelasting voor aardgas.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Grinwis c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over een extra schijf voor elektriciteit in de energiebelasting
Introduces a new first electricity tier in the energy tax (0 to 2,900 kWh) with a matching rate for the second tier and adjusts the other tier rates accordingly.
This amendment introduces from 2024 a new first bracket in the energy tax for electricity.
Dit amendement introduceert per 2024 een nieuwe eerste schijf in de energiebelasting voor elektriciteit.
Amendement van de leden Grinwis en Idsinga ter vervanging van nr. 8 over een evaluatie van de anti-peildatumarbitragebepaling
Adds a requirement that the Finance Minister report to the States General within two years on the effectiveness and effects of the anti-reference-date arbitrage provision in the income tax act.
sends the States General a report within two years of this act entering into force on the effectiveness and effects of article 5.24
zendt binnen twee jaar na de inwerkingtreding van deze wet aan de Staten-Generaal een verslag over de doeltreffendheid en de effecten van artikel 5.24
Amendement het lid Romke de Jong c.s. over laadpalen
Changes energy tax rates for electricity supplied to EV charging points and adjusts excise on tobacco to fund the extension of the reduced charging-point regime.
With this amendment this tax regime is extended by two years.
Met dit amendement wordt dit belastingregime met twee jaar verlengd.
Motie van het lid Idsinga over inzichtelijk maken wat relevante landen nog meer doen ten aanzien van start- en scale-ups
Asks the government to map what other relevant countries do for start-ups and scale-ups and sketch policy options.
requests the government, in addition to the measures in the Act adjusting the tax treatment of stock option rights, to further map what several relevant countries do in tax or other areas

verzoekt de regering, naast de maatregelen in de Wet aanpassing fiscale regeling aandelenoptierechten, verder inzichtelijk te maken wat een aantal relevante landen op fiscaal of ander gebied nog meer doen
Motie van het lid Idsinga over de effecten van de verlaging van de brandstofaccijns in Duitsland in kaart brengen en de afstemming met buurlanden versterken
Motion asking the government to map the effects of Germany's fuel excise cut on Dutch border-region sales and tax revenue and to strengthen coordination with neighbouring countries.
requests the government to map these effects, examine options to strengthen coordination with neighbouring countries
verzoekt de regering deze effecten in kaart te brengen, te onderzoeken welke mogelijkheden er zijn om de afstemming met buurlanden te versterken
Motie van de leden Inge van Dijk en Idsinga over voorstellen om beleggingsvermogen aangehouden in box 2 beter in kaart te brengen
Asks the government to propose better mapping of investment assets held in box 2, including whether a distinction can be made for real businesses held via BVs.
requests the government to come with proposals to better map investment assets held in box 2, excluding pension reserves
verzoekt de regering met voorstellen te komen om beleggingsvermogen, niet zijnde pensioenreserveringen, aangehouden in box 2 beter in kaart te brengen
Motie van de leden Stoffer en Idsinga over ondernemingen met toekomstperspectief de mogelijkheid bieden hun terugbetaaltermijn te verlengen
Asks the government to develop scenarios allowing viable companies to extend their corona tax repayment period to ten or twenty years.
requests the government to make scenarios to offer companies with future prospects the option to extend their repayment period
verzoekt de regering om scenario's te maken om ondernemingen met toekomstperspectief de mogelijkheid te bieden hun terugbetaaltermijn te verlengen
Motie van het lid Romke de Jong c.s. over voorstellen voor het hervatten van de belastingheffing op vermogen
Asks the government to present proposals by 1 April on how the taxation of wealth (box 3) can be resumed after the Supreme Court ruling.
requests the government to come up with proposals by 1 April on how taxation of wealth can be resumed
verzoekt de regering om voor 1 april met voorstellen te komen voor hoe de belastingheffing op vermogen weer kan worden hervat
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Idsinga ter vervanging van nr. 7 over verduidelijking van de toepassing van artikel 9, eerste lid, onderdeel e
Clarifies in the Corporate Tax Act that the deductibility of open limited partnership profits is limited where the secondary hybrid mismatch rule applies.
The proposed amendment clarifies that the application of article 9, first paragraph, under e of the Corporate Tax Act is limited insofar as article 12ab applies.
Het voorgestelde amendement verduidelijkt dat de toepassing van artikel 9, eerste lid, onderdeel e Wet Vpb beperkt is voor zover artikel 12ab, eerste lid Wet Vpb van toepassing is
Amendement van het lid Idsinga over verduidelijking van de toepassing van artikel 9, eerste lid, onderdeel e

Amendment to the Vpb tax act clarifies that the deductibility of open cv partners' profit share under article 9(1)(e) is limited where the secondary linking rule of article 12ad applies, to prevent hybrid mismatch avoidance.
The proposed amendment clarifies that the application of article 9(1)(e) of the Vpb Act is limited insofar as article 12ad(1) applies.
Het voorgestelde amendement verduidelijkt dat de toepassing van artikel 9, eerste lid, onderdeel e Wet Vpb beperkt is voor zover artikel 12ad, eerste lid Wet Vpb van toepassing is
Amendement van het lid Idsinga over het wegnemen van de overkill wat betreft hybridemismatches
Amends the Dutch hybrid mismatch rules to remove double-deduction overkill for certain payments between related entities and persons.
The proposed amendment removes the overkill arising from the Dutch implementation of the hybrid mismatch directive.
Het voorgestelde amendement neemt de overkill weg die zich voordoet met betrekking tot de Nederlandse implementatie
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Kouwenhoven over de aangekondigde reductie van 500 regels in het actieprogramma regeldruk

MPs Idsinga and Kouwenhoven asked the Minister of Economic Affairs how the 500-regulation reduction target in the regulatory burden action programme is defined, which measures make up the first tranche, how reductions are calculated and reported, and how it relates to the Kisteman motion. The minister answered that the list of 500 regulations is still being compiled, that reductions will be calculated under the standard cost model, and that progress will be shown in real time on the regeldrukmonitor website, with timelines and legal instruments to follow later.
At present the cabinet is compiling a list of the intended 500 regulations, which will be shared with the House by the end of the year.
Op dit moment maakt het kabinet een lijst met de beoogde 500 regels die voor het einde van het jaar met de Kamer zal worden gedeeld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vroonhoven en Idsinga over het behoud en exploitatie van de bruine vloot

MPs Van Vroonhoven and Idsinga asked about the preservation and commercial viability of the historic brown fleet (bruine vloot), including support for safety and sustainability upgrades and recognition as heritage. The minister acknowledged the sector's value and its safety and environmental pressures, but said the government supports it only through the Regio Deal, declined to revive the NBTC storylines or involve provinces and municipalities further, and found further exploration of UNESCO heritage status unnecessary.
No. The storylines are no longer applied.
Nee. De verhaallijnen worden niet langer toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘PostNL dreigt briefbezorging te versoberen, als het kabinet niet ingrijpt’

Rep. Idsinga asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether PostNL will scale back mail delivery after its request to withdraw the universal postal service designation, and how vulnerable groups, urgent post and continuity will be protected. The minister replied that he will not grant PostNL's request, is consulting on a Postbesluit change to lengthen delivery times, judges risks limited, and says the ACM is responsible for enforcement.
It is the responsibility of the ACM to act as an independent regulator when PostNL does not comply with the law.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de ACM om als onafhankelijk toezichthouder op te treden wanneer PostNL de wet niet naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de uitvoering van een aangenomen motie over strategische autonomie

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs why a motion on economic security and strategic autonomy has not yet been implemented and when it will be. The minister says it is already being acted on and refers to a letter of 1 July 2025 for the status.
I am aware of this motion. However, further implementation has already been given to it.
Ik ben op de hoogte van deze motie. Hier is echter al wel nader uitvoering aan gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de uitvoering van een aantal aangenomen moties

An MP asked the Finance Minister why several adopted motions on savings markets and the Volksbank remain unimplemented, including a ban on tied sales (koppelverkoop). The minister answered that a PwC study found mandatory standalone savings accounts not in consumers' interest, contrary to the ACM recommendation, that a verkenning on direct savings-rate regulation is ongoing, and that a letter with an integrated response will follow in autumn.
I consider it important to weigh the findings of the study carefully and to discuss them with the ACM, in conjunction with the follow-up to its other recommendations, before I decide on them.

Ik vind het van belang om de bevindingen van het onderzoek zorgvuldig te wegen en in samenhang met de opvolging van haar andere aanbevelingen te bespreken met de ACM, voordat ik daarover een besluit neem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kahraman en Idsinga over het nieuwsbericht 'Brussels approves Poland's use of post-COVID funds for defence'

MPs Kahraman and Idsinga asked the Finance and Foreign Ministers about the Commission's approval of Poland reallocating nearly EUR 6 billion of recovery fund money to defence and whether the Netherlands would seek similar changes. The minister answered that the Dutch plan contains only already-budgeted defence spending, that no contact on reallocating funds to defence has taken place with the Commission, and that remaining payments face implementation risks.
So far, Poland is the only member state that has explicitly added a measure to its original plan allocating funds to defence-related purposes by amending its recovery plan.

Tot op heden is Polen de enige lidstaat die middels een aanpassing van het HVP expliciet een maatregel heeft toegevoegd aan het originele plan om middelen toe te wijzen aan defensie-gerelateerde doeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de herstel- en veerkrachtfaciliteit

An MP from NSC asks the Finance Minister about the European Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF) following the European Court of Auditors' criticism: whether the government agrees, who controls spending, whether it is unclear where money goes and what results it has produced, whether the EU's role amounts to interference in national policy, and whether such funds should be discontinued. The minister answers that the Court's analysis is largely a summary of earlier reports, that payments are milestone-based and oversight rests with the Commission, member states and anti-fraud bodies, that results are premature to assess, and that the government favours not repeating joint-loan financing but is open to results-based budgeting.
The cabinet is not in favour of repeating the financing of the instrument through joint loans.
Het kabinet is geen voorstander van een herhaling van de financiering van het instrument middels gemeenschappelijke leningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Waveren en Idsinga over de bezorging van overheidspost

MPs Van Waveren and Idsinga asked ministers about the National Ombudsman's warning that late or failed delivery of government post harms citizens. The minister answered that complaint data is kept centrally via PostNL under the Rijksbrede postcontract, that responsibility for mail delivery and legal consequences is shared across departments and courts, and that the ACM study on the postal market will inform further policy.
There is no record within the Ministry of Economic Affairs or the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations of such internal reports.
Er is binnen het Ministerie van Economische Zaken en het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties geen registratie waarin dergelijke interne meldingen staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Stultiens over Onderzoek Lucratiefbelangregeling

MPs Idsinga and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance about the lucrative interest regime, under which private equity managers' carried interest is taxed in box 2 at a lower rate than box 1, and about its size, administrability and alternatives. The State Secretary answered that the number of affected taxpayers and the revenue effects cannot be precisely determined, that the regime provides legal certainty and fits neighbouring countries, and that alternatives (box 1 taxation, a higher box 2 rate) are being consulted on, with a further measure planned in the Belastingplan 2026.
It is currently not possible to determine how often taxpayers with a lucrative interest use the substantial-interest variant.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk vast te stellen hoe vaak belastingplichtigen met een lucratief belang gebruikmaken van de aanmerkelijkbelangvariant
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘ACM wil dat energiebedrijven klanten helpen met nieuw energiecontract’

An MP asked the minister whether energy suppliers should be obliged to help consumers choose suitable contracts, and what powers the ACM has to act against non-transparent suppliers. The minister answered that the new Energy Act strengthens transparency and comparability rules, that the ACM has enforcement powers, and that no additional regulation is needed yet while the new rules are monitored.

The cabinet first wants to see the effects of the new rules (in force from 1 January 2026) in practice for consumers and therefore sees no immediate reason to prescribe additional protection beyond what the Energy Act already provides.

Het kabinet wil eerst bezien wat de effecten zijn van de nieuwe regels (die per 1 januari 2026 van kracht zijn) in de praktijk voor de consument en ziet daarom niet direct aanleiding om, naast hetgeen de Energiewet reeds regelt, extra bescherming voor te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Idsinga over de MLT ramingen (tekort en schuldquote) na ieder regeerakkoord

MPs Omtzigt and Idsinga asked the Finance Minister to compare the EMU deficit and debt projections after each coalition agreement (2012, 2017, 2021, 2024) with realised outcomes, and whether projections show structural bias. The minister provided tables comparing Startnota projections with FJR outcomes, noted growing uncertainty over a four-year horizon and that an independent expert group on realistic forecasting will report in March.
The report of the expert group will be sent to parliament in mid-March.
Het rapport van de expertgroep zal medio maart naar het parlement worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Idsinga over de ramingen van het Centraal planbureau en de grote ramingsfouten die daarin zijn gemaakt de afgelopen jaren

MPs Omtzigt and Idsinga asked the Finance Minister about large forecasting errors in government and CPB deficit and tax-revenue projections, and about whether the new expert group on forecasting would receive their initiative note and report by March 2025. The Minister answered that the note will be forwarded, the expert group's findings await, and forecast errors are attributed to volatile conditions, while declining to commit to legal anchoring of forecast accuracy.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Omtzigt over de lobby van grote familiebedrijven om de bedrijfsopvolgingsregeling (BOR) te verruimen

MPs Idsinga and Omtzigt asked why the requested lobby letters from large family firms seeking to widen the business succession scheme (BOR) had not yet been sent to Parliament, and asked for their timely delivery along with all related correspondence. The State Secretary answered that the request could not be met in the short term, supplied a search of correspondence from the Finance, Economic Affairs and General Affairs ministries as an annex, and said the letters would be attached to the tax bill Wet aanpassing fiscale bedrijfsopvolgingsfaciliteiten 2025.
A copy of the lobby letters has been included as an annex to that bill.
Een afschrift van de lobbybrieven is opgenomen als bijlage bij dat wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Aartsen over de keuzehulp van het ministerie van SZW over schijnzelfstandigheid

MP Aartsen asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the SZW webmodule for assessing employment relations (schijnzelfstandigheid), its legal status, its fit with the Deliveroo criteria, its relation to the entrepreneur check and proposed VBAR law, and consultation with self-employed groups. The minister replies that the webmodule is only an indication offering no legal certainty, that it is being reviewed in light of pending Supreme Court questions, and that the Rijk is tightening its approach to false self-employment.
No certainty can be derived from this indication.
Aan deze indicatie kan geen zekerheid worden ontleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven en Omtzigt over een plan om het verhuren van een kamer aan studenten veel gemakkelijker te maken

MPs Welzijn, Van Vroonhoven and Omtzigt asked the government about making it easier to rent rooms to students through hospita arrangements, covering housing shortages, mortgage and bank consent, the WWSO rent rules, the kostendelersnorm, huurtoeslag and the income-dependent rent increase. The minister answered that the rent-rule and hospita exception is already in place, that a bill to end hospita contracts on sale is being prepared, that banks' consent is being pursued, and that several questions (MKBA, huurtoeslag, exemption thresholds) are under study or not feasible now.
At present I am preparing a legislative amendment that should allow the rental contract to be terminated upon sale, only in the case of hospita rental.
Op dit moment bereid ik een wetswijziging voor die er toe moet leiden dat het huurcontract – alleen in het geval van hospitaverhuur – bij verkoop kan worden beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Staat moet Holland Casino afstoten’

An MP asked whether the state should divest its stake in Holland Casino and whether online gambling legalisation should be reversed, citing rising addiction concerns. The government answered that the casino stake is under review, that the 2023 evaluation found state shareholding not strictly necessary but not to be ruled out, that talks with Holland Casino on the gambling tax increase are ongoing, and that a decision and update are expected around summer 2025.
I aim to inform you around summer 2025 about developments at Holland Casino.
Ik streef ernaar om u rond de zomer van 2025 te informeren over de ontwikkelingen bij Holland Casino.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontenbal over ETS2

An MP from the CDA asks the Climate and Growth minister and the State Secretary of Finance about the expected costs and revenues of the EU ETS-2 carbon pricing for households and businesses, including the Social Climate Fund, compensation options and fairness of the burden. The minister answers that the government expects ETS-2 revenues to flow into general funds, rejects cutting energy tax and excise as compensation given the climate targets, and states that costs are estimated and kept under review.
Dutch budget policy is based on the principle of separating revenues and expenditures.
Het Nederlandse begrotingsbeleid is gebaseerd op het principe van scheiding van inkomsten en uitgaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het (niet) openbaar maken van zakelijke belangen

MP Sneller asked whether the State Secretary for Finance holds shares in listed companies and whether the formateur approved not disclosing them, and whether integrity rules for ministers are adequate, citing GRECO and the Huberts critique. The government answered that all ministers declared their interests under the fixed rules, that the decision to name companies rests with the minister concerned, that a recusal rule covers conflicts, and that no external sanction mechanism will be created.
It is up to the minister approached to weigh, given the business and financial interests and the arrangement to be made, whether the names of the companies concerned can be made public.

12 ) is het aan de aangezochte bewindspersoon om te wegen, gelet op de zakelijke en financiële belangen en de te treffen voorziening, of de namen van de betrokken vennootschappen openbaar gemeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Peter de Groot en Van Eijk (allen VVD) over het artikel 'Enorme ozb-verhoging Amsterdam ’Middenklasse maximaal uitgekleed”

VVD MPs asked the government about a steep property tax (OZB) increase proposed by Amsterdam, its effect on household costs, parking charges and erfpacht, and whether the government would engage Amsterdam to cap OZB rises. The minister declined to comment on Amsterdam's local tax decision as a matter for the municipal council, provided cost data, and committed to talks with municipalities on capping OZB increases.
It is up to the municipal councils to make choices here, weighing among other things the tax burden, service levels and other matters.
Het is aan de gemeenteraden hierin keuzes te maken, waarbij onder meer belastingdruk, voorzieningenniveau en andere zaken tegen elkaar worden afgewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Werkgever ‘mist kans’ met werknemersaandelen: ‘Dit is de manier om werkeneden te laten profiteren van welvaart’

An MP asked whether the government would investigate financial employee participation, including fiscal obstacles, comparisons with the UK and Germany, a national policy plan, and information provision. The Secretary of State answered that the government is positive about such schemes but sees them as a matter for employers and employees, identifies four practical obstacles, denies any current fiscal barrier, and points to the Stichting van de Arbeid process and ongoing startup tax research without committing to new studies or a national plan.
Given the various advantages and disadvantages, it is up to employers and employees to weigh these and see whether financial employee participation offers added value for them.
Gegeven de verschillende voor- en nadelen is het aan werkgevers en werknemers om deze samen te wegen en te kijken of financiële werknemersparticipatie voor hen meerwaarde biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over de btw-verhoging op logies

Sneller (D66) asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about the expected revenue, sector effects, border competition, fiscal neutrality, and the lack of an impact analysis for the VAT increase on accommodation. The State Secretary defends the revenue estimate of 1,110 million euro, rejects claims of large shortfalls and border effects as not quantifiable, and says monitoring and an ex-post evaluation in 2028 will follow.
Immediately after introduction, the cabinet will carry out a first analysis of the short-term impact of these measures.
Direct na invoering zal het kabinet een eerste analyse doen van de korte-termijnimpact van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Vroonhoven over de Belastingdruk op middenhuurwoningen

MPs Omtzigt and Van Vroonhoven asked the government to calculate the costs and returns of a private landlord's rental home in box 3 for 2016 to 2025, including the effects of tax and rent regulation measures, and whether mid-rent housing is in shortage and how box 3 burdens could be eased. The government answered that the example is illustrative only, showed the 2023 and 2024 figures, explained the box 3 tax rate rise to 36%, the updated leegwaarderatio and the Wet betaalbare huur, and said the Supreme Court's June 2024 rulings will lead to a counter-evidence scheme for actual returns.
No figures are kept on the number of homes rented out in box 3.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden van het aantal woningen dat in box 3 wordt verhuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Zanten over de problematiek rond het innen van de eigen bijdragen van Oekraïense ontheemden met een baan en eigen inkomsten

An MP asks the government about municipalities struggling to collect own contributions from working Ukrainian displaced persons, retroactive charges, the tax exemption for motor vehicle tax and BPM, housing, and security in Ukraine. The minister answers that the government supports municipalities with a guide and reimbursed costs, allows retroactive charges not before 1 July 2024 but advises restraint, and says the vehicle exemption expires on 4 March 2025 without committing to further changes.
We have advised municipalities to exercise restraint, so as not to confront displaced persons at a later time with an accumulated arrears.
Wij hebben gemeenten geadviseerd terughoudendheid te betrachten, om ontheemden niet op een later moment met een opgebouwde achterstand te confronteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Thijssen en Maatoug over het bericht «650 miljoen belastingschuld en toch dividend uitkeren: zo werkt kunstmestfabriek Yara»

MPs from GroenLinks-PvdA asked the ministers about reports that fertiliser producer Yara pays dividends despite a large tax debt, receives green subsidies, and used transfer pricing to shift profit abroad. The minister answered that companies are free to decide their profit use within legal frameworks, that subsidies are capped to avoid overcompensation via claw-back mechanisms, and that the Tax Authority rejects profit shifting without real activity changes.
Nevertheless, the maatwerk agreements aim to prevent oversubsidy of projects, for example by including a claw-back mechanism.
Wel wordt er binnen de maatwerkafspraken op ingezet oversubsidiëring van projecten tegen te gaan, bijvoorbeeld door het opnemen van een terugvorderingsmechanisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vijlbrief, Paternotte, Rooderkerk, Paulusma en Sneller  over de btw-verhogingen op boeken, cultuur, sport en logies

D66 MPs asked the government what it aims to achieve by raising VAT on books, newspapers, culture, sport and accommodation, and about impact analyses, exemptions, legal risks, household purchasing power, sector and education effects, regional effects and the 40-organisation appeal. The state secretary answers that the rate change yields about 2.3 billion euros structurally, that no specific impact analysis was done and none is planned (only monitoring), that some reduced-rate categories are kept for policy-weighing reasons, and that most distributional, sectoral and regional effects cannot be quantified.
I do not intend to carry out a further impact analysis, but the effect of the tariff increase will be monitored.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een nadere impactanalyse uit te voeren, wel zal het effect van de tariefsverhoging worden gemonitord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Welzijn en Idsinga over het bericht ‘Britse belegger sluist uitpondwinst Nederlandse woningen weg naar Bermuda’

Two MPs asked whether Dutch rental homes bought by a British investor and sold off to owner-occupiers via Luxembourg and Bermuda vehicles constitute tax avoidance, and what the government will do. The minister says Dutch treaties allocate tax on Dutch property income to the Netherlands, sees no reason for intervention or new rules, and declines to discuss individual tax files.
Due to the tax confidentiality obligation under Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het artikel 'Hoe chemiebedrijf OCI zijn aandeelhoudersmiljarden uitkeert en de fiscus met lege handen achterblijft'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press report that chemicals company OCI returned capital to shareholders, avoiding dividend tax, and whether this constitutes tax avoidance and should be curbed. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual tax files, said returning recognised capital is not dividend and not avoidance by itself, and saw no reason for new measures, while noting work on taxing high net worth individuals at OECD level.
Due to article 67 of the General Tax Act, I cannot discuss individual tax files.
Vanwege artikel 67 AWR kan ik niet ingaan op individuele fiscale dossiers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Eijk over de kamerbrief van 11 maart 2024 inzake het rapport ‘VAT Gap in the EU, report 2023’

MPs Idsinga and Van Eijk-Nagel asked the State Secretary of Finance about the VAT gap report, including the size of the gap, its main causes, fraud versus other causes, and Commission follow-up. The State Secretary answered that the 2022 gap is €3.6bn (4.9%), that causes include fraud, optimisation and administrative errors, and pointed to VIDA package measures, evaluation of the reduced VAT rate and questions about the Ecofin discussion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijk en Idsinga over het bericht 'A historic step’: G20 discusses plans for global minimum tax on billionaires'

MPs Van Eijk and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about a proposed global minimum tax on billionaires discussed at the G20, about how billionaires avoid tax, the revenue lost in the Netherlands, and national enforcement options, with 10 questions in total. The government answered that it is prioritising taxation of high net worth individuals in the OECD, will explore the issue step by step, and listed existing and planned anti-avoidance measures, while providing no revenue estimate and declining to commit to joining the initiative.
There is no estimate of the revenue of a minimum tax for billionaires in the Netherlands.
Er is geen raming van de opbrengst van een minimumbelasting voor miljardairs in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen en Omtzigt over een advies van de landsadvocaat

MPs Idsinga, Palmen-Schlangen and Omtzigt asked why the landsadvocaat's advice on the childcare benefits affair was released late, what changed between two versions of the letter, and how the 'Heidi' logging system worked, when it breached GDPR and how it linked to the Fraud Signalling Facility. The State Secretaries answered that the version was not final, explained Heidi's purpose and its suspension in 2017 and December 2023, and promised a further letter within three weeks on wider Tax Authority use of Heidi.
Your House will be informed within 3 weeks at the latest about how other parts of the Tax and Customs Administration used Heidi, for what purposes and which data were processed.
Uw Kamer wordt uiterlijk over 3 weken geïnformeerd over hoe andere onderdelen van de Belastingdienst gebruik hebben gemaakt van Heidi, voor welke doeleinde en welke gegevens hierbij verwerkt werden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het artikel ‘Hoge Raad oordeelt in nadeel van de fiscus, boetes dividendstrippen onzeker’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a Supreme Court ruling that narrows the 'ultimate beneficiary' exception against dividend stripping, the number and value of pending cases, and whether the law or enforcement should be tightened. The State Secretary says the ruling clarifies the rules, the case is remitted to the Hague Court of Appeal, further anti-stripping research is underway with results expected in spring 2025, and no new measures are committed yet.
The House is expected to be informed of the outcomes of this research in spring 2025.
Naar verwachting zal de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2025 geïnformeerd worden over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga, Postma en Six Dijkstra over de berichten 'Verkopen op Vinted of Marktplaats? De Belastingdienst kijkt mee', 'Fiscus kijkt mee met verkoop op Vinted en Marktplaats: dit betekent he

MPs Idsinga, Postma and Six Dijkstra asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that the Tax Authority will receive data on private online sellers on Vinted, Marktplaats and Bol under DAC7, raising concerns about tax burdens, unclear entrepreneur status, and privacy risks from collecting citizen service numbers. The State Secretary replied that DAC7 creates no new tax obligations, that the 30-transaction/2,000-euro threshold balances enforcement with feasibility, that personal data collection is necessary for proper taxation and protected under GDPR, and that the Tax Authority will expand public information rather than new rules, though several questions were answered only in part.
In addition, the Tax Authority is intensifying information provision to private individuals who sell, rent out or offer their services via online platforms.
Daarnaast intensiveert de Belastingdienst de voorlichting aan particulieren die verkopen, verhuren of hun diensten aanbieden via online platformen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de artikelen ‘Fiscus belast betaaltegoed oneerlijk, bedrag loopt op naar 130 miljoen euro’ en ‘Spaarders betalen hogere box 3-heffing na definitieve belastingaanslag’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that the tax authority taxes current-account balances unfairly under the box 3 flat-rate system and about higher box 3 charges for savers after final assessments. The State Secretary defended taxing current accounts as bank deposits, refused a carve-out and a finer subcategory for bank balances, and promised a future actual-return box 3 system.
I am not willing to make an exception for current accounts.
Ik ben niet bereid om voor betaalrekeningen een uitzondering te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de artikelen ‘Amerikaanse multinationals ontwijken Nederlandse bijheffing minimumbelasting' en ‘OECD Pillar Two Impleme Dilemma'

Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that US multinationals restructured to avoid Dutch and European top-up taxes under Pillar Two, and whether this reflects a prisoner's dilemma and an unwanted transitional safe harbour. The State Secretary said the number of firms is unknown, the impact is not expected to be large, the safe harbour is temporary and EU-agreed, and the Netherlands is bound by EU and OECD rules with built-in leverage.
I am not aware of how many companies this concerns.
Het is mij niet bekend om hoeveel bedrijven dit gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Idsinga over het artikel 'Aantal huishoudens met schulden door toeslagen in vijf jaar verdubbeld'

Two MPs asked the government about a news report that the number of households with problematic debts from childcare and other benefit allowances (toeslagen) doubled in five years, and about the causes, support for affected households, and the future of the allowance system. The State Secretary answered that the rise is mainly due to the pause in toeslag debt collection during COVID and to rising allowance payments, outlined support measures and the upcoming final report on the future of the system, and declined to give a firm timetable for quick fixes.
The cabinet has announced that from 2025 the 27-year age limit for first-degree blood relatives in the allowance partnership will be abolished.
Het kabinet heeft aangekondigd om per 2025 de 27-jaarsgrens voor eerstegraadsbloedverwanten in het toeslagpartnerschap af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over de stichting de Vrienden van XR

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about the Stichting Vrienden van XR, its alleged role funnelling money to Extinction Rebellion, government subsidies to related organisations, its ANBI status, and civil liability for disruptive actions. The Minister answered that the government has no subsidy relationship with XR or the foundation, that ANBI status is assessed neutrally by the tax authority, and that civil liability for unlawful acts is for courts to decide.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to assess such statements.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om hier in de beoordeling te treden van dergelijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Grevink over de uitspraak van Gerechtshof ’s-Hertogenbosch over forse verhoging van de forensenbelasting in 2020

MPs Idsinga and Grevink (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior whether the government shares concern about a court ruling on a sharp municipal forensenbelasting increase and whether municipalities are overstepping their powers. The minister replied that municipal taxation is an autonomous competence, that the courts and municipal politics provide sufficient safeguards, and declined to assess the case or propose new limits.

The tax levy concerned is an autonomous competence of the municipality and, given the role of the independent judge, it is not for me to give a judgment on the assessment and/or the court ruling on it.

De betreffende belastingheffing is een autonome bevoegdheid van de gemeente en gegeven de rol van de onafhankelijke rechter, is het niet aan mij om een oordeel te geven over de aanslag en/of de rechtelijke uitspraak daarover.
Antwoord opvragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘Monaco: belastingparadijs voor topsporters’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Monaco is a tax haven for top athletes, including how many Dutch residents live there, the revenue lost, and options to counter tax avoidance by high-income Dutch citizens abroad. The government answered that 12 of 75 examined Monaco cases yielded over 31 million euro in corrections, that residence is taxed on the basis of habitual residence rather than nationality, and that it would explore international measures for high net worth individuals while tempering expectations.
The Tax Administration has no current overall picture of this; this information is not systematically recorded.
De Belastingdienst heeft geen actueel totaalbeeld hiervan; deze informatie wordt niet systematisch bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het artikel ''Huiseigenaren geschokt door hoge WOZ-taxaties: 'Makkelijk scoren door schuld bij bezwaarbureaus te leggen"

MP Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about a news report claiming four in ten homeowners who object to WOZ valuations win their case, and asked whether oversight of municipalities and the Waarderingskamer should be tightened. The State Secretary confirmed the figures, acknowledged the rate is high, said informal pre-objection contact may be made legally mandatory and the Waarderingskamer's oversight is being examined, but rejected the claim that homeowners are structurally overtaxed and said no direct link exists between the Waarderingskamer's ratings and successful objections.
As indicated in answering the previous questions, I do not share the conclusion that homeowners are structurally overtaxed.
Zoals bij de beantwoording van voorgaande vragen is aangegeven, deel ik de conclusie dat huiseigenaren structureel veel te hoog worden aangeslagen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Idsinga over de door de fiscus gestuurde aanmaning naar ondernemers

MPs Aartsen and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about the tax authority's letters warning entrepreneurs of payment arrears on corona tax debts, asking how many were sent, why the arrears amount was not stated, and how to avoid unnecessary warnings. The State Secretary answered that about 80,000 entrepreneurs received a letter, that the arrears amount was omitted because the system cannot compute it in mass mailings, and described a phased process including debt overviews, a helpline, and eventual withdrawal of payment arrangements.
The exact amount of the payment arrears was not included, because it is not possible for the Tax Authority to process this amount in mass messages.
Daarbij is niet het exacte bedrag van de betalingsachterstand opgenomen, omdat het voor de Belastingdienst niet mogelijk is dit bedrag in massale berichten te verwerken
