Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Rahimi over het bericht ‘Oude ict kost fiscus miljoenen’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that outdated ICT costs the tax authority millions, requesting yearly ICT spending, modernisation ratios, timelines, tender plans, and the link to tax morale. The State Secretary gave detailed budget and portfolio figures, a 2026 modernisation target, and declined to reveal the timing of upcoming tenders for commercial and legal reasons while promising to answer each question.
For tenders that are in preparation or will be brought to the market in the near future, the Tax Authority gives no advance insight.
In aanbestedingen die in voorbereiding zijn of in de nabije toekomst op de markt zullen worden gebracht, wordt door de Belastingdienst geen inzage vooraf gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het WODC-rapport ‘Bestuursorganen in hoger beroep’

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary of Finance about a WODC report showing how often the Tax Authority loses on appeal, the reasons for appeals, mediation and other dispute-resolution options. The State Secretary answered at length, arguing the report's figures are limited to published rulings and not fully representative, providing appeal outcome tables and mediation numbers, and describing the Tax Authority's appeal and cassation criteria.
The Tax Authority's systems only record the number of appeal cases, without distinguishing whether the taxpayer or the inspector lodged the appeal.
In de systemen van de Belastingdienst wordt alleen informatie over de aantallen zaken in hoger beroep bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over Operation Admiral en de handhaving op btw-carrouselfraude

The MP asked about the EPPO's Operation Admiral on VAT carousel fraud, the size of the VAT gap, enforcement capacity, and whether digital reporting obligations like those in Italy and Spain should be adopted. The State Secretary answered that Dutch VAT gap is relatively low (2.8%), that enforcement capacity is about 70 FTE plus FIOD, and declined to adopt digital reporting for now, citing costs and a low gap, while committing to continue current enforcement and a pending bill on payment data.
The Netherlands has a relatively small gap between expected and collected VAT revenue of 2.8% (1.7 billion euros).
Nederland heeft een relatief klein verschil tussen verwachte en geïnde btw-inkomsten van 2,8% (1,7 miljard euro).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘BelastingTelefoon blijkt onbereikbaar; burgers konden er 900.000 keer hun vragen niet kwijt’

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about reports that the Tax Phone was unreachable for 900,000 callers, and about waiting times, staffing, a contingency plan, and coulance for taxpayers harmed by poor reachability. The State Secretary gives reachability figures (71.7% through November, a two-day technical outage), describes recruitment and efficiency initiatives, agrees to consider redeploying staff and to act coulantly toward affected taxpayers, but gives no firm timeline for recovery.
Yes, I am willing to do that.
Ja, daar ben ik toe bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht ‘Corruptie is bij de Belastingdienst lastig te traceren’

MPs Idsinga and Michon-Derkzen asked about reports that corruption at the Tax Authority is hard to trace, since systems do not log which data staff access. The State Secretary admits systems do not log data queries, outlines integrity measures, and says the Minister will raise corruption in the MCAO and inform parliament in later letters.
It is correct that the Tax Authority's computer systems do not record (log) which information employees query, because these systems were not designed to capture such information.
Het klopt dat computersystemen van de Belastingdienst niet registreren (loggen) welke informatie medewerkers opvragen omdat deze systemen niet zijn opgezet om dit soort informatie vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Heinen over de uitspraken over mogelijk loslaten unanimiteitsbeginsel en de ontwikkelingen rondom 'Pijler 2' van de OESO

MPs Idsinga and Heinen asked the State Secretary of Finance about statements on possibly dropping unanimity for tax decisions and developments around OECD Pillar 2, and why the joint declaration with four other states was signed by only five countries. The State Secretary answered that the cabinet position is unchanged, that Pillar 2 should ideally be agreed by all 27 member states, and that alternatives such as enhanced cooperation or coordinated implementation are being explored while unanimity remains required.
The cabinet's position on this point has not changed.
Het kabinetsstandpunt is op dit punt niet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de opinie "Henk Bluemink: Alimentatie toont aan dat belastingstelsel anders moet"

An MP asked the state secretaries of Finance about an opinion arguing that partner alimony under the tax and benefits system can leave both ex-partners worse off, and whether the system should be reformed. The government acknowledged the very high marginal burden as a known unintended effect of the tax and benefits system, said it is not easy to solve, and pointed to planned adjustments such as independent childcare contributions and gradual abolition of benefits.
The cabinet is taking a number of measures to counter this.
Het kabinet neemt een aantal maatregelen om dit tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Paul over het bericht 'Ook personeelstekorten bij uitvoeringsorganisaties als UWV, fiscus en IND'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretaries of Finance about reported staff shortages at the Tax Authority and Customs, including long Belastingtelefoon waiting times, staffing for the box 3 ruling and childcare benefits aftermath, sick leave and pension outflow. The government answered that waiting times averaged about 17-20 minutes, listed measures to keep access, explained recruitment difficulties and prioritisation trade-offs that reduce supervision capacity, and projected extra staffing needs, promising further information in the autumn.
In the stand-of-affairs letter 2 I, State Secretary of Finance – Fiscal Affairs & Tax Authority, stated that I will inform you further in the autumn about the level of supervision.
In de stand-van-zakenbrief 2 heb ik, Staatssecretaris van Financiën – Fiscaliteit & Belastingdienst, opgenomen dat ik u in het najaar nader zal informeren over het niveau van toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht 'Advocaat-generaal: verplichte eHerkenning bij belastingaangifte mag'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of an Advocate-General's opinion that mandatory eHerkenning for tax filing is lawful, including support for businesses, transition measures, and free login options. The State Secretary says the government keeps its eHerkenning policy, offers a limited annual compensation of 24.20 euro, and that a public login alternative is being studied, without committing to a timetable beyond a progress report.
The cabinet therefore for now continues to adhere to the government-wide line of using eHerkenning as the authentication means.
Het kabinet houdt daarom vooralsnog vast aan de overheidsbrede lijn van het gebruik van eHerkenning als authenticatiemiddel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Strien over het bericht 'Vertrek DSM is signaal voor politiek'

MPs Idsinga and Van Strien asked the ministers about reports that the DSM headquarters move signals a wider political problem for large multinationals, including their contribution to society, job numbers and what the government will do about the investment climate. The minister defends the contribution of multinationals, admits concern about the investment climate and promises a second investment-climate letter before the EZK budget debate, while saying the DSM-Firmenich dual headquarters decision was taken by the companies without government involvement.
DSM is a listed company and legally may not share this information before it is made public.
DSM is een beursgenoteerde onderneming en mag wettelijk gezien deze informatie niet voorbeurs delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht 'Belastingadviseurs kritisch: veel zoekgeraakte post bij de fiscus; e-mailen niet mogelijk'

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that post sent to the Tax Authority goes missing, that e-mail communication is not formally available, and about rising fines, the relationship with tax advisers, and the future of Horizontal Supervision. The State Secretary acknowledged that lost post is undesirable but that its extent cannot be measured, explained that e-mail is only formally allowed in some situations, and promised a letter on the fines policy and continued dialogue with tax advisers.
It is indeed an undesirable situation that post goes missing or is processed with delay.
Het is inderdaad een onwenselijke situatie dat post zoekraakt of met vertraging wordt behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht "Grensarbeider kan thuiswerken vergeten: ‘Dit is pure discriminatie’'

MP Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that cross-border workers cannot telework without tax consequences, and whether the temporary telework arrangements with Germany and Belgium will be extended. The government answered that the arrangements expire on 1 July 2022, that renewal is not suitable, and that talks on a possible permanent telework rule with both neighbours are ongoing without a guaranteed outcome.

Before the summer recess, the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment, on my behalf too, will send a letter to your House to inform it about the progress of our talks with neighbouring countries and within the EU.

Voor het zomerreces zal de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid mede namens mij een brief aan uw Kamer sturen om uw Kamer te informeren over de voortgang van onze gesprekken met buurlanden en binnen de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de tax governance code van VNO-NCW

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about the new Tax Governance Code by VNO-NCW, its appreciation, international reach, and whether transparency duties extend to tax advisers, academics and government. The State Secretary welcomes the code, promises a roundtable and an evaluation later, and commits to further attention on advisers' conduct and independence in advisory committees.
I therefore want to let this code do its good work first, and at a later point I want to evaluate whether more is needed.
Ik wil deze code dan ook eerst zijn goede werk laten doen, en wil op een later moment evalueren of meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Inge van Dijk over de gevolgen van een recent gewezen arrest over letselschadevergoedingen

MPs Idsinga and Inge van Dijk asked the State Secretary of Finance about the consequences of a 25 March 2022 Supreme Court ruling on wage tax treatment of injury compensation from workplace accidents, including refund rights and possible financial impact. The State Secretary answered all ten questions, arguing the ruling is new case law that adds a new condition to the 1983 Smeerkuil doctrine, so no ex officio reduction of past assessments and no compensation or specific policy change is required.
I am of the opinion that this is new case law.
Ik ben van mening dat sprake is van nieuwe jurisprudentie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD schorst speciale eenheid ‘onaanvaardbaar lang'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance ministry about the suspension of the FIOD's Team Specialistische Operaties and a court's finding that the suspension was unacceptably long. The state secretary answered that mediation is ongoing, the suspension was justified by serious circumstances, the FIOD does not intend to dissolve the team, and investigations were not hindered.
In its ruling, the court pointed to an unacceptably long suspension.
In zijn uitspraak heeft de rechter gewezen op een onaanvaardbare lange schorsing.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Belastingexpert: 'Compensatie spaartaks kost maar € 3 miljard en kan rap worden opgelost'' en het artikel 'Een voorstel voor een goed uitvoerbaar

Two MPs (Idsinga, VVD and Inge van Dijk, CDA) asked the State Secretary for Finance about press reports proposing a quick, flat-rate compensation scheme for taxpayers wrongly taxed under box 3 (the savings tax). The State Secretary answered questions 2 to 12 by referring to a separate preparatory letter for a technical briefing, providing no substantive answer in this document.
Questions 2 to 12 are answered, as proposed in question 13, in the 'preparatory letter' sent to the House simultaneously with this reply.
De vragen 2 tot en met 12 worden, zoals voorgesteld in vraag 13, beantwoord in de «voorbereidingsbrief» die gelijktijdig met deze beantwoording aan uw Kamer is gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Van Strien over het artikel van Constantijn van Oranje in het Financieel Dagblad met als titel ‘We hadden de ster van Europa kunnen zijn’

MPs Idsinga and Van Strien asked the minister about a newspaper article claiming the Netherlands missed chances to become Europe's startup star, and about startup policy, venture capital, the Growth Fund and the tax bill on stock option rules. The minister rejected the claim that the Netherlands is lagging, described existing policy instruments and knowledge gaps, and gave a status update on the delayed stock option bill with no firm new timeline.
I agree with the envoy that we must remain alert to new opportunities and keep working to solve bottlenecks in our startup climate.
Ik ben het eens met de envoy dat we alert moeten zijn op nieuwe kansen en ons moeten blijven inzetten voor het oplossen van knelpunten in ons startup klimaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about reports that the FIOD suspended its Team Specialistische Operaties over an allowance dispute, and about the team's role, the cause, and the atmosphere within the FIOD. The Secretary of State declined to give details, citing an ongoing labour and court dispute and the employer's duty of care, while saying investigations continue with partner agencies and that the directorate seeks a swift resolution.
No statement is made on the specific content. The matter is before the court.
Over de specifieke inhoud wordt geen mededeling gedaan. De zaak is onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Idsinga over het bericht 'Meer dan miljoen spaarders lopen fiscale teruggave mis door wetswijziging'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that over a million savers may miss box 3 tax refunds because of the 2016 change to the mass objection procedure, asking about objection numbers, budgetary effects, and how the government will handle the Supreme Court ruling and pending ECtHR cases. The State Secretary answered that about 120,000 objections were lodged, the scope of the group eligible for redress is not yet determined, budget impacts are being mapped, and the government will inform parliament once options are clear.
Once the elaboration is clear, I will inform the House about this.
Zodra de uitwerking helder is, zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘Onderzoeker: truc met dividend hield zeker 12 miljard euro weg van Nederlandse Belastingdienst’

MP Idsinga asked the State Secretary of Finance about press reports that dividend stripping cost the Dutch tax authority up to 12 billion euro, including whether the government has contact with other EU countries and what the scale and remedies are. The State Secretary confirmed awareness of dividend stripping, said the 2001 anti-abuse rule is hard to enforce, identified about 250 million euro in corrections over 2000-2020, declined to estimate total losses as unreliable, and promised a consultation document on alternative measures by year-end.
It is very difficult to make visible how much tax revenue is not paid due to fraud and avoidance.
Het is heel moeilijk inzichtelijk te maken hoeveel belastinggeld door fraude en ontwijking niet wordt betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over de berichten ‘Hulp blijkt moeilijk’: Stad krijgt niet alle gegevens toeslagenslachtoffers’ en ‘Rechter deelt tik uit aan Belastingdienst’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that Rotterdam lacks complete data on childcare-benefit scandal victims and that a court ruled against the Tax Authority over delayed advance payments. The State Secretary acknowledged occasional data gaps, defended the consent-based data-sharing procedure, and explained the Commission Actual Damage backlog, committing to report further in upcoming progress reports and a review.
In general terms I cannot discuss individual parents with your House.
In algemene zin kan ik niet met uw Kamer in gesprek over individuele ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Idsinga over het artikel 'De Tweede Kamer opnieuw geschoffeerd…'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Idsinga asked why the State Secretary no longer responded integrally to comments from the NOB and RB on tax bills, and whether this practice would continue, asking for prompt answers before the debate. The State Secretary defended selective answering as avoiding duplication with MPs' own questions and promised a reply to the NOB and RB comments shortly.
The cabinet will respond to the comments of the NOB and the RB in the short term.
Het kabinet zal de commentaren van de NOB en het RB op korte termijn van een reactie voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Aartsen over het bericht ‘Ondernemers met betalingsregeling voor corona-belastingschulden aan de goden overgeleverd’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about tax-debt payment arrangements for entrepreneurs hit by COVID, including loss of the arrangement for missed payments, the lack of a judicial appeal route, and possible hardship relief. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority may end arrangements in limited cases with a 14-day cure period, that appeal to the tax court is planned but postponed, and that relief and a more lenient restructuring approach are being examined.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Idsinga en Erkens over de fiscale behandeling van thuiswerkdagen in relatie met Duitsland en België

Two VVD MPs asked whether the temporary tax arrangements with Germany and Belgium on home-working days during COVID, currently valid until 30 September 2021, would be extended and whether a permanent arrangement is possible. The State Secretary answered that extension to the end of 2021 is sought but depends on the partner countries, no changes are expected if extended, and a permanent arrangement is being raised in talks without any outcome yet.
I am partly dependent on Belgium and Germany for this.
Ik ben hiervoor mede afhankelijk van België en Duitsland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over brieven die de Belastingdienst in Heerlen heeft gestuurd aan Nederlandse pensioengerechtigden die wonen in België en pensioen- en lijfrente-uitkeringen ontvangen uit Nederland

An MP asked why the Heerlen tax office sent pre-announcement letters to Dutch pensioners living in Belgium about possible back taxation for 2016-2018, and whether this conflicts with earlier correspondence and the 2018 bilateral agreement. The State Secretary answered that the letters concern 2018 with requests for 2016-2017 information, that case-by-case assessment applies, that double taxation can be addressed via the mutual agreement procedure, and that renegotiation details cannot be disclosed.
Regarding ongoing negotiations, in the interest of confidentiality (including towards treaty partners) I do not make substantive statements.
Over lopende onderhandelingen doe ik in het belang van de vertrouwelijkheid (ook richting verdragspartners) geen inhoudelijke mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Idsinga en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Arbeidsmigrant krijgt belastingkorting die Nederlander niet krijgt’

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance why foreign taxpayers (mostly Polish labour migrants) can claim the income-dependent combination tax credit (IACK) that Dutch families in the same situation may not get, and why a loophole identified in 2015 and 2018 was not fixed. The State Secretary acknowledges an unintended effect of the non-partner exception, provides claim figures, says the legislation will be amended with a bill before Prinsjesdag and in force 1 January 2022, and rejects reopening past assessments.
I intend to amend the legislation so that the treatment of foreign taxpayers and of domestic taxpayers married to a partner living abroad is equated with that of domestic taxpayers.

Ik ben voornemens de wetgeving zodanig aan te passen dat de uitwerking voor de buitenlandse belastingplichtige en voor de binnenlandse belastingplichtige die gehuwd is met een partner woonachtig in het buitenland, wordt gelijkgesteld met die van de binnenlandse belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Idsinga over het bericht ‘Janet Yellen calls for global minimum corporate tax’

The MP Idsinga asked the state secretary of Finance how the US proposals for a global minimum corporate tax and a new profit allocation regime affect the Netherlands, whether the government will use the momentum to reach an OECD agreement, what obstacles exist, and the state of EU and OECD talks. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands supports the Inclusive Framework's aim of agreement by mid-2021, sees the US proposals as a major step, and described the remaining obstacles and timetable, promising to inform the House before the next plenary.
Prior to the plenary meeting of the Inclusive Framework, I will inform your House further on this matter.
Voorafgaand aan de plenaire vergadering van het Inclusive Framework zal ik uw Kamer daarover verder informeren.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Maatoug over het bericht dat de staatssecretaris belangen in bedrijven geheim houdt

MPs Dijk and Maatoug asked the State Secretary for Finance whether his business shareholdings, reported in the formateur's report, could influence his policy and why he has not disclosed them openly. The State Secretary answered that his interests are placed at arm's length under the Landsadvocaat's assessment and that disclosure of company names is a matter for the official to weigh, while not fully committing to publish the holdings.
It is likewise for the official approached to weigh, given the business and financial interests and the arrangement to be made, whether the names of the companies concerned can be reported.

Het is eveneens aan de aangezochte bewindspersoon om te wegen, gelet op de zakelijke en financiële belangen en de te treffen voorziening, of de namen van de betrokken vennootschappen gemeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vlottes over het bericht ‘Belastingdienst sluit nieuwe vermogenstaks in 2027 uit’

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance why the new Box 3 wealth tax based on actual returns may not take effect on 1 January 2027, when this was first communicated, and about the revenue loss and possible delays. The government answers that Tax Authority capacity is consumed by the restoration operation after the June 2024 Supreme Court rulings, that a delay could cost about 2 billion euros a year, and that alternative implementation options are still being studied with results expected by year end.
My intention is to inform the House once the study is completed and I can brief it on the dilemmas and pros and cons of the various options.
Mijn voornemen is om uw Kamer te informeren zodra het onderzoek is afgerond en ik uw Kamer kan meenemen in de dilemma’s en voor- en nadelen van de verschillende opties.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Maatoug, Stultiens, Grinwis, Teunissen, Dijk, Van Baarle, Vijlbrief en Dassen over de kosten van het afschaffen van de belasting op de inkoop van eigen aandelen

MPs from several parties asked the State Secretary of Finance about a SOMO study criticising the revenue estimate for abolishing the share buyback tax facility, including its data basis, behavioural assumptions and whether a new CPB estimate should be requested. The State Secretary answered that the estimate used the best available data at the time, explained the 70% behavioural discount, noted the cabinet has since kept the facility so no new study is needed, but will discuss updating the research with SOMO and SEO.
I will discuss this with both SOMO and SEO.
Ik zal hiervoor met zowel SOMO als SEO in gesprek treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens ver structureel verlieslatende bedrijven

Two GroenLinks-PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about the discrepancy between a 6% and a 13% share of structurally loss-making companies, the growth and debt patterns of conduit companies, dividend flows, and the EU UNSHELL directive. The State Secretary attributed the difference mainly to different research periods, outlined anti-abuse measures such as the minimum tax and a possible open-norm replacement for the safe harbour, and said Dutch support for UNSHELL continues while agreement remains uncertain.
In the autumn I will inform the House, in the annual monitoring letter on the approach to tax avoidance by multinationals, about the effectiveness of the general interest deduction limitation.
In het najaar zal ik uw Kamer in de jaarlijkse monitoringsbrief over de aanpak van belastingontwijking door multinationals informeren over de effectiviteit van de generieke renteaftrekbeperking
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Grinwis over het bericht 'Holland Casino maakt forse verliezen en dreigt met agressieve gokcampagnes'

MPs Bikker and Grinwis asked whether state-owned Holland Casino would pursue aggressive gambling advertising to offset losses, how this squares with public health responsibility, and whether closures or reduced hours were planned. The State Secretary of Finance replied that Holland Casino has no plans to significantly increase marketing, that aggressive campaigns are unacceptable, that the government expects a role model from the state-owned company, and that the advertising framework will be assessed in an evaluation due in October 2024.
Holland Casino has confirmed to the Ministry of Finance that it has no plans to significantly increase its marketing expenditure.
Holland Casino heeft richting het Ministerie van Financiën bevestigd dat het geen plannen heeft om zijn marketinguitgaven significant te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Stultiens over belastingverdragen

MPs Maatoug and Stultiens asked the State Secretary of Finance why tax treaties with low-tax jurisdictions Bahrain, Barbados and Panama still block the withholding tax, the three-year renegotiation deadline having lapsed, and about Panama's EU blacklist status and the Netherlands' stance on a UN tax convention. The State Secretary replied that treaties prevail over national law, that renegotiation will restart if Bahrain and Barbados do not introduce a qualifying 9% profit tax, that Panama is cooperating and no deadline is set, and that the Netherlands abstained rather than voted against the UN tax convention terms.
I do not have the requested data.
Ik beschik niet over de gevraagde gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeer over btw-teruggave consumenten

An MP asks the State Secretary of Finance about a court ruling that found against a non-EU consumer's VAT refund claim and about whether retailers can be required to cooperate with such refunds. The State Secretary answers that refunds must run through the retailer under the VAT Directive conditions, that retailers cannot be compelled to participate, and that the Tax Authority has no direct role.
I note that a retailer cannot be obliged to apply the zero VAT rate or to facilitate the VAT refund to the non-EU traveller.
Daarbij merk ik op dat een winkelier niet kan worden verplicht om het btw-nultarief toe te passen respectievelijk de teruggave van btw aan de niet-EU-reiziger te faciliteren.

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs whether Dutch economic opportunities in Taiwan are being missed, whether any official trade mission has gone to Taiwan recently, and whether one will be organised. The government answered that Dutch trade and investment with Taiwan is already substantial, that official missions led by a minister would conflict with its one-China policy, and that missions led by senior officials or organised by the NCH are possible and have taken place.
Official trade missions (led by a minister) are contrary to the Dutch one-China policy.
Officiële handelsmissies (aangevoerd door een bewindspersoon) zijn in strijd met het Nederlandse één China beleid.

An MP asked the health minister about medical self-tests found to lack scientific basis, their risks, and whether a quality mark should be introduced. The answering state secretary for Economic Affairs referred most questions to earlier letters and a debate, and addressed only the SMS-service advertising question with a promise to tighten codes and inform parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over geblokkeerde bankrekeningen van Nederlandse burgers, onder wie veel jongeren

An MP asks the Finance and Justice ministers about bank accounts of citizens, many young people, being blocked, often under anti-money-laundering rules, and about whether legal protection and oversight are adequate. The minister acknowledges signals, says no figures are kept on blocked accounts, explains the grounds for blocking and the complaint routes (bank complaint procedure, Kifid, courts), and promises to ask the banks and Betaalvereniging to record blocking data better.
I do not have figures on the number of blocked accounts, the specific number of young people whose payment account has been (or was) blocked, and the reasons why these accounts were blocked.

Ik beschik niet over cijfers van het aantal geblokkeerde rekeningen, het specifieke aantal jongeren waarvan de betaalrekening geblokkeerd is (geweest) en de redenen waarom deze rekeningen dan geblokkeerd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de gebrekkige concurrentie in de Nederlandse bankensector en achterblijvende spaarrentes

An MP asked the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers why savings rates lag behind mortgage and ECB rates, whether banks should be pressed to raise them, and what instruments exist such as ACM market scrutiny, state bonds for savers and windfall-profit measures. The minister answered that Dutch savings rates have risen more than the EU average, that the ACM is investigating the savings market, and that further policy options will await the ACM report.
I see no reason at this moment to hold new talks.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om opnieuw gesprekken te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijk over het bericht 'Belastingdienst blijft wet overtreden met mogelijk discriminerende fraude-algoritmen'

The MP asks why the Tax Authority kept using fraud risk models (OBCF, ABN, OB Negatief) that may breach the GDPR, whether they discriminate, and how public trust can be restored. The State Secretary replies that the models were reactivated after a risk assessment, that some were modified and will get impact assessments and transparency registration, and that discrimination checks and monitoring are in place, but gives no firm date or stop for OB Negatief.
The OB Negatief model will be given a data protection impact assessment, and the models are to be entered in the Tax Authority's algorithm register to promote transparency.
Het model OB Negatief wordt voorzien van een GEB en van de modellen wordt voorzien dat zij in het algoritmeregister van de Belastingdienst worden opgenomen ter bevordering van de transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Resultaten MOB-vergadering 28 november 2023’

MP Inge van Dijk asked the Ministers of Finance and Economic Affairs about the MOB's reachability monitor showing falling business satisfaction with payment services, bank information points, de-risking standards, bank tariff increases, and public cost-sharing for payments. The minister said he will report to parliament on the MOB's further analysis (expected autumn 2024), that bank information point pilots are continuing, that the NVB risk-based standards are non-binding and will be evaluated, and that he sees no reason for public subsidies for payments infrastructure.
When the outcomes of this are known, I will inform your House of the conclusions.
Wanneer de uitkomsten hiervan bekend zijn, zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Omtzigt over “de chatberichten van bewindspersonen en topambtenaren die niet zijn opgenomen in de hotspot archief”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Finance why chat messages of ministers and senior officials were not included in the COVID-19 hotspot archive, and whether they are preserved and available for the parliamentary inquiry. The minister answered that chats are now secured for current ministers and senior officials, that some former officials' messages were not secured and contact is being sought, and that selection and archiving will follow once national archiving guidelines are ready, with delays acknowledged.
The aim was to answer within the usual three-week period, but interdepartmental coordination meant it took longer.
Het streven is geweest te antwoorden binnen de gebruikelijke termijn van 3 weken, wegens interdepartementale afstemming heeft dit langer geduurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het verwerpen van het ESM-verdrag door Italië

MP Van Hijum asked the Finance Minister about Italy's rejection of the ESM treaty reform, its effects on Dutch guarantees, ESM conditionality, euro stability governance, and ECB instruments. The minister confirmed the rejection, said the reform's common backstop for the Single Resolution Fund cannot be introduced and the government regrets it, and argued that existing ESM conditionality and debt sustainability rules remain in force, while answering most questions substantively and offering no new oversight measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Olger van Dijk over het activistisch aandeelhouderschap van Schiphol door de gemeente Amsterdam en de inzet op krimp tot maximaal 440.000 vluchten

Two NSC MPs asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers how the state views Amsterdam's activist shareholding in Schiphol and its push to cap flights at 440,000, and how the state's shareholder strategy and public-interest criteria apply. The minister welcomed Amsterdam's focus on the living environment, explained that the state's strategy review and MVO criteria cover sustainability and environmental quality, and said a new strategy process would start this year while shareholders act independently.
For that I refer you to the shareholding policy of the respective shareholders.
Ik verwijs u daarvoor graag door naar (het deelnemingenbeleid van) de desbetreffende aandeelhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Thijssen en Van der Lee over de Rabobank en de ontbossers

MPs asked the government about Rabobank financing deforestation actors, whether financial services should be regulated like deforestation-free products, and whether Dutch and EU policy on livestock reduction and financing is consistent with the Paris goals. The ministers answered that banks are responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines, that the Commission will assess regulating financial institutions by mid-2025, and that the Finance Minister will report on financial-sector measures by year end.
The cabinet expects financial institutions to act in line with international standards for responsible business conduct.
Het kabinet verwacht van financiële instellingen dat zij handelen conform de internationale standaarden voor internationaal verantwoord ondernemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tjeerd de Groot en Van Raan over het rapport van bureau Profundo 'Rabobanks share in the Brazilian bill, accountable for € 9,5 billion to € 61 billion'

MPs Tjeerd de Groot and Van Raan asked how bank financing of Brazilian deforestation-linked projects fits Rabobank's climate commitment, and how the polluter-pays principle, supervision, transparency and pricing of climate and nature risks apply to financial institutions. The minister answered that the climate commitment sets no concrete measures, that the government expects alignment with 1.5 degrees, that a sustainable finance policy and consultation on legislation are underway, and that some questions (consumer switching data, pricing of past damage) fall outside its information or legal reach.
I do not have this information and, to my knowledge, it is also not publicly available.
Deze informatie heb ik niet en is naar mijn weten ook niet openbaar beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Thijssen over het faciliteren van fossiele investeringen door banken

MPs Van der Lee and Thijssen asked the Finance Minister whether banks that underwrite fossil-fuel bonds share responsibility for green-washing and the failure to green bond markets, and why a motion on sustainability legislation for the financial sector had not been implemented. The minister acknowledged the findings and said underwriting would be discussed with the financial sector and its umbrella bodies, but ruled out a ban and said the legislative exploration is still ongoing, with an update promised by year-end.
I aim to inform your House further on the progress before the end of the year.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer voor het einde van het jaar nader te informeren over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het nalaten om juridische vervolgstappen tegen KLM te ondernemen

MP Van der Lee (GroenLinks) asked why the government did not pursue legal action against KLM for failing to comply with conditions attached to its COVID-19 support package, and why the state agent was not informed of the decision. Minister Kaag answered that legal analyses by two external advisers found little chance of success, that the package ended in April 2023, that the evaluation of the package will address compliance and enforcement, and that the legal analyses will be made available confidentially to parliament.
I will therefore make the legal analyses available to parliament on a confidential basis.
Ik zal de juridische analyses daarom vertrouwelijk ter inzage leggen bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Sjoerdsma over de beantwoording van vragen

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked the ministers to convey appreciation to civil servants for timely, careful answers to parliamentary questions. The Prime Minister answered yes, a brief acknowledgement with no substantive commitment.
Are you willing to convey great appreciation to your civil servants for answering all written, factual and oral questions that the questioner has asked in recent years
Bent u bereid de grote waardering over te brengen aan uw ambtenaren voor de beantwoording van alle schriftelijke, feitelijk en mondelinge vragen die vragensteller de afgelopen jaren stelde
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over een aanvullende randvoorwaarde over het invaren van pensioenen in het coronaherstelfonds

Omtzigt asks the Finance and Pensions ministers about an added condition in the Dutch recovery plan requiring that 66% of participants' pensions be transferred (invaren) to the new pension system by 2026, and why this was not communicated to parliament earlier. Minister Schouten answers that the condition is an operationalisation of existing recovery-plan commitments needed because the pension transition was extended to 2028, that the decision on invaren remains with social partners and fund boards, and that a list of legal advice on invaren will be shared in November.
On 4 July there was not yet an agreed proposal that could be shared with the Chamber.
Op 4 juli lag er nog geen afgesproken voorstel dat gedeeld kon worden met de Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Teunissen, Alkaya, Dassen en Thijssen over fossiele subsidies

MPs asked the government about a report estimating fossil fuel subsidies at 37.5 billion euro per year, the reconciliation with the Miljoenennota annex, EU constraints, revenue use, and effects on competitiveness and the budget. The minister answered that the annex gives a range of 39.7 to 46.4 billion euro, that concrete tax measures were proposed in Belastingplan 2024, and that further proposals await a cabinet with full powers.
Given its caretaker status, the cabinet will not make further proposals for phasing out fossil fuel advantages.
Het kabinet zal, gezien zijn demissionaire status, geen verdere voorstellen doen voor afbouw van fossiele voordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de antwoorden op eerdere vragen inzake het 'eindrapport onderzoek regeldruk bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen'

An MP from the CDA asks the government why its acknowledgement that red tape for volunteer organisations is a serious problem has not led to concrete measures, how the Beleidskompas ensures volunteer organisations are consulted, whether the AVG obligations and the volunteer allowance should be changed, and what a further volunteer allowance increase would cost. The government replies that it is working on a plan of action with the sector, that the Beleidskompas will be evaluated before any changes, that banks have adopted a new sector standard reducing checks on non-profits, that AVG obligations will not be reduced, and that raising the volunteer allowance by 500 euro would cost about 3 million euro a year, while promising a further policy response in December 2023.
We are therefore holding talks with various departments, the sector and other relevant stakeholders to arrive at concrete and serious measures to counter the red tape.
Wij zijn daarom met verschillende departementen, de sector en andere relevante betrokkenen gesprekken aan het voeren om tot concrete en serieuze maatregelen te komen om de regeldruk tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Belgische Minister van Financiën schiet spaarders te hulp: 'Dit is een wake-up call''

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance about a Belgian proposal for a state bond to attract savers, the low savings rates offered by banks, and the banks' large profits. The minister answered that savings rates are lagging behind ECB rate rises, referred the competition question to the ACM, said DNB and the ECB monitor bank profits, and promised a letter on policy options including the state bond within months.

As I indicated in the committee debate of 13 September, I will inform your House within a few months in more detail about my assessment of the pros and cons of possible policy options, including the state bond.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in het commissiedebat van 13 september jl. zal ik uw Kamer binnen enkele maanden nader informeren over mijn appreciatie van de voor- en nadelen van mogelijke beleidsopties, waaronder de staatsbon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Kat en Van der Laan over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken

D66 MPs asked how young people can be protected from influencers who lure them into scams around match-fixing sports betting, including crypto flows, gambling-addiction protection, advertising oversight and cross-border enforcement. The minister answered that prevention campaigns, platform obligations and existing regulators (Ksa, ACM, AFM, Commissariaat voor de Media) cover the issue, and promised a campaign, a ministry review of labelling edited ads and a werkagenda by year-end.
As previously promised, the House will receive the work agenda by the end of this year, setting out ongoing and future activities on addiction prevention.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt de Kamer eind dit jaar de werkagenda waarin lopende en toekomstige activiteiten op het gebied van verslavingspreventie een plek krijgen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de berichten 'China-led AIIB’s communications chief quits, criticises bank’s management' en 'Canada freezes ties with China-led AIIB, probes allegations of Communist domina

A GroenLinks MP asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers about reports that the AIIB's communications chief resigned alleging Chinese Communist Party domination, and that Canada froze ties and launched a probe. The government replied that an internal review found no evidence of covert CCP influence, identified governance and HR improvements to pursue as a shareholder, and defended delegated decision-making at the bank as common among multilateral development banks.
The Netherlands will work to ensure proper follow-up on these recommendations.
Nederland zal zich inzetten voor een gedegen opvolging van deze aanbevelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Inge van Dijk, Temmink, Van der Plas en Dekker-Abdulaziz over de RAM database bij de Belastingdienst

Five MPs asked the government about the RAM database at the Belastingdienst, including whether privacy impact assessments were done, whether parliament was misinformed, and why an external investigation is needed. The State Secretary answered that an external investigation and an investigation by the Dutch Data Protection Authority are pending, so definitive answers and the legality question cannot yet be given, and that memos and documents will be sent later.
I wish to emphasise that definitive answers can only be given after the external investigation and the investigation by the AP.
Ik wil daarbij benadrukken dat pas na het externe onderzoek en het onderzoek door de AP definitieve antwoorden gegeven kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat een onverwachte strop dreigt voor ABN AMRO als de staat haar aandelen verkoopt

Tony van Dijck (PVV) asked the Finance Minister whether reducing the state's ABN AMRO stake below 50 percent could force the bank to buy out insurer NN under a change-of-control clause, and why parliament was not informed earlier. Minister Kaag answered that NN will not invoke the clause now that the state stake is below 50 percent, so ABN AMRO suffers no loss, and that the bank, not the shareholder, is responsible for its contractual arrangements.
I informed your House on 25 September 2023 that the state's stake has indeed fallen below 50% and that I will inform the House further once the sales programme is fully completed.

Ik heb uw Kamer op 25 september 2023 geïnformeerd dat het staatsbelang daadwerkelijk onder de 50% gedaald is en dat ik de Tweede Kamer nader zal informeren wanneer het verkoopprogramma volledig is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Amhaouch over het bericht 'Niet-afgedekt renterisico maakt private equity opeens kwetsbaar'

Two CDA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether unhedged interest rate risk threatens private equity funds and their portfolio companies, and what regulation or monitoring is needed. The minister answered that PE funds and portfolio firms are responsible for hedging their own rate risk, that additional rules are not currently warranted, and that DNB and the AFM will discuss the economic impact with the minister.
I will discuss the possible impact on the Dutch economy of interest rate rises for PE funds and their companies with DNB and the AFM.
Ik zal de mogelijke impact op de Nederlandse economie als gevolg van rentestijgingen voor PE-fondsen en hun bedrijven bespreken met DNB en de AFM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de verwachte grenseffecten van de stijgingen van de accijnzen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the expected cross-border effects of excise increases on petrol and diesel, including how much revenue is lost and what the acceptable excise gap with neighbouring countries is. The government answered that a study estimates lower excise revenue of roughly EUR 122-207 million per year for petrol and EUR 32-136 million for diesel, but declined to give a reasonable maximum excise gap or to answer the hypothetical half-increase scenario, pointing to forthcoming study updates.
On the basis of the current cross-border effects study, that is not possible.
Op basis van het huidige grenseffectenonderzoek is dat niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van het lid Van Haga over de problemen bij het afschaffen van btw op groente en fruiover het btw-nultarief op leveringen van groente en fruit

An MP asked the Finance and Health ministers about the problems with abolishing VAT on fruit and vegetables, including costs, legal definition issues, and the Tax Administration's enforceability concerns. The government answered that no decision has been taken, that budgetary impact ranges from 500 to 950 million euros depending on the variant, and that a legally defensible demarcation is difficult, leaving the choice to a future cabinet.
No decision has yet been taken on whether to introduce a zero VAT rate on fruit and vegetables and/or alternative health measures.
Er heeft nog geen besluitvorming plaatsgevonden over het al dan niet invoeren van een btw-nultarief op groente en fruit en/of alternatieve gezondheidsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Ontslagen bij KPMG om toetsfraude, commissaris Van Boxtel stapt op'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that KPMG dismissed staff over examination fraud and whether the Ministry, the AFM, the audit firms and the sector's culture and quality indicators should respond. The Minister answered that the sector bears primary responsibility, that the firms' investigations are ongoing and awaited, that the AFM has enforcement tools and a bill strengthening them is in preparation, and that the cultural reform reports will follow in autumn 2023.
I am awaiting the results of these investigations.
Ik wacht de resultaten van deze onderzoeken af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het 'eindrapport onderzoek regeldruk bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen'

An MP from the CDA asks the government to respond to the final report on administrative burden for volunteer organisations and philanthropic institutions, including whether the AVG and Wwft obligations should be relaxed for small organisations and how departments coordinate. The State Secretary answers that burden is a serious problem, points to ongoing talks with the sector, and declines to exempt small organisations from the AVG while promising a fuller response in December.

The cabinet considers it very important to reduce the administrative burden on volunteer organisations and philanthropic institutions given the important social value of these organisations in our society.

Het kabinet vindt het erg belangrijk om de regeldruklasten bij vrijwilligersorganisaties en filantropische instellingen te verminderen gezien de belangrijke maatschappelijke waarde in onze samenleving van deze organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over ‘de snel stijgende dierenartskosten, waardoor essentiële dierkundige zorg voor velen onbetaalbaar wordt’

MP Wassenberg asks the government about rising veterinary costs that may make animal care unaffordable, linking this to the duty of care in the Animal Welfare Act, the 21% VAT rate, takeovers of clinics by foreign chains, and possible regulation. The minister acknowledges the concerns, announces a study of price increases, states VAT rules and competition law limits, and rejects intervention in the free market for now.
I want to set up this study carefully, which requires the cooperation of many parties and takes time.
Ik wil dit onderzoek gedegen opzetten waarbij de medewerking van vele partijen nodig is, wat tijd kost.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat, Sneller en Van Weyenberg over het piramidespel van IM Academy en Finfluencers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers of Justice, Finance and Economic Affairs about the IM Academy pyramid scheme, its recruitment of young people, and the regulation of finfluencers. The government said the supervisors (Ksa, ACM, AFM) are responsible, explained existing rules and enforcement tools, and said it sees no need for major new rules beyond pressing for stronger European investor protection.
The supervisory authorities are independent in their supervision and make no statements about ongoing or possible future investigations.
De toezichthouders zijn onafhankelijk in hun toezicht en doen geen mededelingen over lopende of eventueel te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Nijboer over de handelspraktijken van de IM Academy

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the business practices of IM Academy, including whether its model amounts to a prohibited pyramid scheme, whether it is being investigated, and whether an AFM warning is enough to protect consumers. The minister answered that the regulators (Ksa, ACM, AFM) assess pyramid schemes case by case, that no enforcement against IM Academy in the Netherlands is known so far, that investigations cannot be disclosed, and pointed to consumer campaigns and the Acquisition Fraud Act as protection.
However, the supervisory authorities involved cannot share information about ongoing or possibly future investigations.
Betrokken toezichthouders kunnen echter geen informatie delen over lopende of eventueel te starten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van der Plas over het aanpakken van piramidespellen voor jongeren

MPs Van der Lee and Van der Plas asked the government about IM Academy, a pyramid-style scheme targeting young people, including whether it should be banned and whether regulators should investigate. The Minister of Finance replied that the company is not yet proven to have breached Dutch law, that enforcement is for the competent regulators (ACM, AFM), and that no investigations can be announced.
At this moment I see no reason to conduct further research.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over de berichten 'Beleggers verliezen €5 mln op platform, na promotie door 'finfluencers' en 'Meesters of misleiders? Finfluencers maken vaak vooral zichzélf rijk'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Finance about reports that investors lost money on a platform promoted by finfluencers, the AFM's 2021 exploration of finfluencer risks, EU rules on promotion, and whether finfluencers should fall directly under the commission ban. The Minister answered that the AFM has enforced against some finfluencers, that the EU proposal makes investment firms liable for finfluencer promotion, that finfluencers fall indirectly under the existing commission ban, and that no separate national rules will be considered while EU negotiations continue.
The supervisory authority cannot give insight into all measures taken due to the statutory duty of confidentiality and cannot comment on ongoing investigations.
De toezichthouder kan geen inzicht geven in alle genomen maatregelen vanwege de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht en kan ook geen uitspraken doen over lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de accijnzen per 1 januari 2024

MP Omtzigt asked about the scheduled 2024 excise duty increases on petrol and diesel, indexation, EU comparisons, cross-border price differences, and the tax-free mileage allowance. The state secretary confirmed the scheduled increases under unchanged policy, noted the government would not anticipate the August budget decision, and said a higher allowance would be considered in that decision.
During the treatment of the Tax Plan 2023 I promised to consider raising the tax-free mileage allowance from 2024 to €0.23 per kilometre.
Tijdens de behandeling van het Belastingplan 2023 heb ik toegezegd om een verhoging van de onbelaste reiskostenvergoeding per 2024 naar € 0,23 per kilometer te bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Griekenland gaat staatsschuld eerder aflossen als gebaar naar beleggers’

An MP from the CDA asked the Finance Minister about Greece's plan to repay part of its bilateral eurozone loans early, whether credit rating agencies should feed into the SGP, whether a credible debt reduction conflicts with countercyclical policy, and whether Greece should serve as a model for Italy, France, Spain and Portugal. The minister welcomed the Greek move as a positive signal, rejected a role for rating agencies in the SGP, argued debt reduction and countercyclical policy are compatible, and said Greece's experience cannot simply be transferred to other countries.
Your House will be informed about this as usual.
Uw Kamer wordt daarover zoals gebruikelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het migratiepakket

An MP asks the state secretary of Justice and Security for a list of migration measures considered during failed coalition talks, of measures the four parties could agree on, and of measures the demissionary cabinet plans to implement, and whether a package can still be agreed. The government answers that no list of agreed measures exists, that the demissionary cabinet is exercising restraint so no list can be given, and that agreement on a package is not expected, while pointing to earlier letters containing internal documents.
Anticipating that, it is not possible to provide a list of measures or to give a precise date.
Vooruitlopend daarop is het niet mogelijk een lijst van maatregelen te bieden of een precieze datum aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de oorzaken van Inflatie en het feit dat volgens een recente IMF studie stijgende bedrijfswinsten de grootste oorzaak zijn

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether an IMF study finding that rising profits drove about half of euro area inflation applies to the Netherlands, and what policy lessons and measures follow. The minister says the Dutch contribution of profits to inflation cannot yet be established, that the study may not be representative of the Netherlands, and that price-intervention measures used abroad carry serious costs, while promising to address income distribution and purchasing power in the August decision-making.
The cabinet shares the conclusion that part of the inflation is caused by higher profits, as also previously stated in answers to parliamentary questions.
Het kabinet deelt de conclusie dat een gedeelte van de inflatie wordt veroorzaakt door hogere winsten, zoals ook eerder aangegeven in de beantwoording van Kamervragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over ambitieuze implementatie van standaarden voor duurzaamheidsverslaggeving

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister about the Commission's draft ESRS sustainability reporting standards, which weaken EFRAG advice by making biodiversity transition plans voluntary, making all disclosures subject to materiality, and widening phase-in exceptions. The Minister broadly supports the materiality approach but says she regrets the lower ambition, will argue in the consultation for mandatory biodiversity transition plans, retained phase-ins and a justification for non-material themes, and will not push other member states to object now.
I therefore advocate maintaining the reporting obligation on the biodiversity transition plan from the EFRAG advice in the ESRS.
Ik pleit daarom voor het handhaven van de rapportageverplichting ten aanzien van het transitieplan voor biodiversiteit uit het EFRAG-advies in de ESRS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over treinen tussen Groningen en Zwolle

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether the government would block extra NS intercity trains between Groningen and Zwolle, and whether open-access operators such as Arriva are a 'test ground' for the North. The State Secretary answered that the new concession will stay within financial limits and that the volume is still being specified in a draft to be sent in August, and denied any test-lab intent while listing ACM access notifications.
By August 2023 at the latest, I will present the draft concession to the House.
Uiterlijk in augustus 2023 bied ik de ontwerpconcessie aan uw Kamer aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maatoug over een bailout voor banken in de stikstofaanpak

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about whether banks should be required to contribute to the nitrogen-reduction costs, including how this relates to the Landbouwakkoord, transition risks, supervision of banks, and how buyout subsidies interact with bank security rights. The government replies that it is integrally studying options for a non-voluntary bank contribution, to be reported around September, while declining to pre-empt the outcome and explaining the legal and supervisory limits on such measures.

The cabinet is studying in an integrated and coherent way, following the aforementioned motions, the possible policy options through which a financial contribution from banks to the agricultural transition and the nitrogen challenge can be secured.

Het kabinet onderzoekt integraal en in samenhang – ter opvolging van de hiervoor genoemde moties – de mogelijke beleidsopties waarmee een financiële bijdrage van banken aan de landbouwtransitie en de stikstofopgave kan worden geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over “Portugese accountant moet klein beursfonds uit de brand helpen” en “Beroepsorganisatie accountants heeft toch zorgen over Portugese firma in Nederland”

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Minister of Finance why only six Dutch audit firms hold the license to audit public-interest entities, why Value8 could not find an auditor, and whether the AFM can review a Portuguese firm's audits and whether the Dutch quality requirements should apply to foreign firms. The Minister answered that audit firm choices are individual, that the AFM can review files of foreign firms but cannot apply the same license test, that the Netherlands will keep its extra national requirements, and that the government will propose an appointment power for the NBA.
I am not considering abolishing the additional national requirements that apply to Dutch audit firms wishing to audit public-interest entities here.
Ik overweeg niet om de aanvullende nationale eisen, die gelden voor Nederlandse accountantsorganisaties die hier organisaties van openbaar belang willen en mogen controleren, te laten vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Deepfakes op TikTok maken illegale reclame voor leningen’

An MP from the CDA asked the Finance Minister and the State Secretary for the Interior about deepfake TikTok advertisements luring young people to loan sites, and about legal responsibilities, bank claims, shareholder action and protection measures. The government answered that enforcement is for courts and independent regulators, listed the applicable consumer, financial, e-commerce and DSA rules, said banks have had ads removed, and pointed to media-literacy and awareness campaigns and the EU AI Act.
It is for the courts or supervisory authorities to establish violations, not for the cabinet.
Het is aan de rechter of toezichthouders om overtredingen vast te stellen, en niet aan het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Mr. Frank Visser wil onterechte BKR-registraties aanpakken' en de bijbehorende uitzending van Radar

An MP asks the Finance Minister about BKR credit registrations, including whether consumers are adequately warned, whether a five-year retention period is proportionate, the use of code 9, and whether an independent overseer is needed. The minister answers that the AVG and existing supervisors apply, points to a draft law in consultation that would give the government conditions and oversight powers over the BKR, and declines to extend the AP's or AFM's role beyond current remits.
With this bill, the Minister of Finance will be given a power to set conditions for the BKR and for credit institutions' connection to the BKR.
Met dit wetsvoorstel wordt een mogelijkheid voor de Minister van Financiën gecreëerd om voorwaarden te stellen aan het BKR en de aansluiting van kredietinstellingen bij het BKR.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat het BKR de bewaartermijn van BKR-registraties bekort

The MPs asked why the BKR shortens registration of debt-relief only to six months after a completed debt-relief trajectory while full debt repayment keeps credit data for five years, and why that is not equal treatment. The minister confirmed the change, explained that debt-relief registrations are separate from credit registrations, said the credit retention period will be set in a bill to be shortened from five to three years, and rejected a general shortening for everyone who repays in full.
Keeping credit registered for a longer period allows credit providers to consult this data when assessing whether granting a new credit is responsible.
Het langere tijd geregistreerd laten staan van krediet stelt de kredietverstrekkers in staat om deze gegevens te raadplegen bij de beoordeling of het verstrekken van een nieuw krediet verantwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ’Nieuw toeslagenschaal’ ontstaan in de omgang van banken met moslims'

MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Finance Minister whether banks structurally discriminate against Muslims through anti-money-laundering (Wwft) risk profiling and whether an independent investigation is needed. The minister said discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to DNB supervision and an ongoing DNB study, and committed to talks with stakeholders and to reporting to parliament in the autumn.
In response to these signals, among others, I want to investigate the presence of discriminatory elements in the approach to money laundering, terrorist financing and fraud.
Ik wil naar aanleiding van, onder andere, deze signalen de aanwezigheid van discriminerende elementen in de aanpak van witwassen, financieren van terrorisme en fraude onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over discriminatie van moslims door banken

Azarkan asks the Finance Minister about reported discrimination of Muslims by banks under anti-money-laundering rules, including reports to a complaints point, account refusals, extra questioning based on names or purchases, and whether the Wwft is too strict. The minister responds that discrimination is unacceptable, that DNB will examine whether banks control discrimination risks, and that an investigation into discriminatory elements will be announced in an autumn report, while largely defending the risk-based Wwft framework.
To get more clarity following the signals, I want to investigate the presence of discriminatory elements in the approach to money laundering, terrorist financing and fraud.
Om naar aanleiding van de signalen meer duidelijkheid te krijgen, wil ik de aanwezigheid van discriminerende elementen in de aanpak van witwassen, financieren van terrorisme en fraude onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Racismecoördinator: 'Structurele discriminatie van moslims bij banken'

MPs Westerveld and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Finance about reports that the national anti-racism coordinator found structural discrimination of Muslims by banks under the anti-money-laundering law (Wwft), and whether the Wwft is applied in a discriminatory way. The minister said she is shocked, is investigating discriminatory elements with banks, DNB and AFM, will report back in an autumn update, and will first gain a better picture before considering changes to Wwft guidelines.
Following the signals from the NCRD, I want to investigate the presence of discriminatory elements in the approach to money laundering, terrorist financing and fraud.
Mede naar aanleiding van de signalen van de NCRD, wil ik de aanwezigheid van discriminerende elementen in de aanpak van witwassen, financieren van terrorisme en fraude onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Bilderbergconferentie in Lissabon

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about their attendance at the 2023 Bilderberg conference in Lisbon, including whether they attended in a personal capacity, why travel costs were borne by the state, and whether the Chamber could receive the invitations and a summary of positions put forward. The government confirmed both attended, that invitations would not be made public like other diplomatic correspondence, that costs are publicly disclosed under the travel-cost regulation, and that the conference is informal under Chatham House Rules with no summary of positions provided, referring to the conference website.
These invitations will, as is usual with diplomatic correspondence with other states or international organisations, not be made public.
Deze uitnodigingen zullen, net als gebruikelijk met diplomatieke correspondentie met andere staten of internationale organisaties, niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Nijboer en Van der Plas over de schadeafhandeling van het beleggingsproduct Sprintplan door Aegon

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether victims of Aegon's Sprintplan product are still uncompensated, whether settlement is too slow, and what compensation and timelines are appropriate. The minister answered that Aegon has paid out the 2021 settlement to those who accepted it, that one individual court case remains, and that a review of compensation procedures is underway, while declining to set a timeframe for Aegon and stressing the separation of civil and supervisory domains.
I expect Aegon to also act constructively towards consumers who did not accept the settlement proposal.
Ik verwacht van Aegon dat zij zich ook constructief opstelt ten opzichte van consumenten die het schikkingsvoorstel niet hebben geaccepteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boutkan en Dassen over het bericht ‘Nederland laat miljoenen liggen om de wolf te weren’

MPs Boutkan and Dassen asked why the Netherlands does not use EU funds such as LIFE to protect livestock from wolves, and whether it systematically leaves EU money unused. The minister answered that LIFE targets wild species rather than livestock, that conflict prevention could qualify, that the Netherlands uses LIFE relatively well, and that the unused-funds question depends on fund-specific conditions, attaching an overview table.
The Netherlands makes relatively good use of the LIFE fund, about EUR 159 million in the period 2014 to 2021.
Nederland maakt relatief goed gebruik van het LIFE-fonds, circa € 159 miljoen in de periode van 2014 tot en met 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Krul over het bericht ‘Laat KLM zich aan de afspraken over miljarden aan coronasteun houden’

MPs Slootweg and Krul asked whether the government will enforce KLM's compliance with corona aid conditions, including legal action, use of the 2 billion NOW aid and tax deferral, and pressure via the shareholder Air France-KLM. Minister Kaag answered that the contract could not be terminated for partial non-compliance, litigation was judged uncertain, generic measures cannot be used as leverage, and the government will assess compliance and consider further steps.
The cabinet will use its shareholder powers to keep questioning and assessing KLM's board and supervisory board on this matter.
Het kabinet zal zijn aandeelhoudersbevoegdheden inzetten om het bestuur van KLM en de raad van commissarissen hierover te blijven bevragen en te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over gedupeerden van Triodos-certificaten

An MP asks the Finance Minister about Triodos Bank certificate holders unable to sell their holdings for years, including the capital structure, supervision by DNB and AFM, sales practices and possible duty-of-care breaches. The Minister acknowledges the problems and the uncertainty, but says the ministry lacks insight into individual cases, refers duty-of-care and compensation questions to civil courts, and points to existing supervision and the planned tradability via a trading platform.

The Ministry of Finance has no insight into individual cases, and I therefore cannot say how many of the people who invested in the Triodos Bank share certificates may have got into financial difficulties as a result.

Het Ministerie van Financiën heeft geen zicht op individuele gevallen en ik kan dus ook niet zeggen hoeveel van de mensen die belegd hebben in de certificaten van aandelen van Triodos Bank hierdoor mogelijk in de financiële problemen zijn komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboeren Van der Lee over private deelname in TenneT Duitsland na verkoop door de Nederlandse Staat

MPs Nijboer and Van der Lee asked the ministers of Finance and Climate about possible private participation in the German TenneT grid after the Dutch state's sale, and about the risks to the energy transition. The ministers answered that the Dutch TenneT stays fully state-owned, that the sale is negotiated and not yet concluded, and that the government cannot guarantee the future ownership of German TenneT.
We will inform your House before the summer about the status of the negotiations.
Wij zullen uw Kamer voor de zomer informeren over de status van de onderhandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jansen over het belasten van de eigen woning in box 3

An MP from FvD asked the Finance ministers whether they were aware of DNB and IMF analyses recommending moving the owner-occupied home into box 3, and whether they intended to do so. The Staatssecretaris answered that a vision on the owner-occupied home scheme will be presented in 2024, but no move to box 3 is planned because the box 3 reform is not yet settled and takes effect only in 2027.
I aim to send my vision to your House in 2024.
Ik streef ernaar om mijn visie in 2024 aan uw Kamer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het schrappen van de Amsterdamse beurs van notering van 6 bedrijven

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether six companies were delisted from Euronext Amsterdam only because they could not find an auditor, and what this means for investors and the market. The minister confirmed the planned delisting for failing to deposit an audited annual report, said the reasons are unknown to her, and pointed to a planned auditor-designation power for the NBA as a partial remedy.
I am not familiar with the specific circumstances of the companies concerned.
Ik ben niet bekend met de precieze omstandigheden van de betreffende bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de Nederlandse invloed binnen Euronext

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether an agreement that the COO of Euronext would be Dutch, and that Euronext Amsterdam would hold board seats, was made at the 2014 licence stage, and whether Dutch influence over Euronext is adequate. The Minister replied that the 2014 agreement only concerned the initial board and a geographic balance requirement, that no Dutch national currently sits on the board, and that she intends to keep the existing arrangements.
As indicated in answer 1, no agreement was made about the second position within Euronext N.V.
Zoals bij vraag 1 aangegeven is er geen afspraak gemaakt over de tweede positie binnen Euronext N.V.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Five MPs asked the government about progress toward its 2030 targets, including a halving of nitrogen emissions and 15% organic farmland. The ministers answered that the nitrogen target is set as deposition thresholds rather than halving, that the latest projection shows only 43% of nature area meeting the norm with a risk of missing the target, and that a new projection will follow in late 2023 with additional measures and a 15% organic farmland plan under monitoring.
The cabinet indicated in 2021 that it wanted to respond to the call.
Het kabinet heeft in 2021 aangegeven gehoor te willen geven aan de oproep.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het bericht dat Japan weigert verantwoordelijk te nemen voor de onmenselijke behandeling van 'troostmeisjes' – die gedwongen werden tot prostitutie – gedurende de Tweede Wereld

An MP asked the government about Japan's refusal to acknowledge responsibility for forced prostitution of 'comfort women' in WWII, and whether Dutch state and royal family profited from the liquidation of Japanese wartime bank funds that held their earnings. The government answered that archives (Foreign Affairs, Finance, NEFIS, National Archives) do not allow verification of such profit, sees no reason for further research, and cited archival access restrictions and the Archives Act.
At this moment the Dutch State sees no reason to conduct further investigation into the money flows, beyond the archival research already carried out.
Op dit moment ziet de Nederlandse Staat geen aanleiding om, naast het verrichte archiefonderzoek, nader onderzoek te doen naar de geldstromen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Nijboer over de registratie van fraudeurs door verzekeraars naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Nederlandse verzekeraars spelen voor aanklager en rechter tegelijk'

MPs Mutluer and Nijboer asked whether insurers may keep their own lists of fraudsters, how insured persons learn of their registration and can object, how often Kifid upheld complaints, whether insurers should report fraud to prosecutors rather than register it, and whether stronger rules are needed. Minister Kaag answers that insurers may register under the PIFI protocol approved by the Dutch data protection authority, that complaints are upheld in about 17-21% of cases, that reporting to prosecutors is decided case by case on proportionality, and that no stricter rules are needed.
Kifid does not have such (reliable) information on the number of complaints from data subjects for the years 2018, 2019 and 2020.
Kifid beschikt niet over dergelijke (betrouwbare) informatie over het aantal klachten van betrokkenen voor de jaren 2018, 2019 en 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de registratie van fraudeurs door verzekeraars naar aanleiding van het bericht 'Nederlandse verzekeraars spelen voor aanklager en rechter tegelijk'

An MP asks the Finance and Interior ministers about insurers registering suspected fraudsters in a shared warning system without court review, including limits on listing duration, notification, objections, and age/occupation-based refusals. The ministers defend the PIFI protocol as approved by the Dutch data protection authority, describe objection and complaint routes, and say they see no need for new regulation on uninsurability or refusals.
So I do not share your view that fraudsters should only be placed on a list after a judge or another independent body has examined the evidence.
Ik deel dus niet met u dat fraudeurs pas op een lijst moeten kunnen komen nadat de rechter of een andere onafhankelijke instantie naar het bewijs heeft gekeken.
