Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het ECB beleid om de positie van 'green bonds' in haar portefeuille actief te vergroten en het financiële systeem te vergroenen

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the ECB's plan to tilt its corporate bond holdings toward firms with better climate performance, questioning its political character, independence, and legitimacy. The minister answers that the ECB's climate tilt is consistent with its mandate, rejects the claim that the scoring is political, and declines to raise the matter with DNB or the ECB.
No, I do not intend to do that, for the reasons above.
Dat ben ik niet van plan vanwege bovenstaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Peelland Truckrun afgelast vanwege verzekeringskwestie’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg asked the Finance Minister about truckruns cancelled over insurance problems, and whether event insurance is becoming scarce for volunteer organisers. The minister answered that the problem stems from an insurance uncertainty about passengers without seatbelts, that insurers cover the trucks and seated, belted passengers, and that there is no sign of a broad insurance problem, so no new government measures are proposed beyond monitoring.
I have no indications that insuring events organised by volunteers in a broad sense is increasingly becoming a problem.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat het verzekeren van evenementen die worden georganiseerd door vrijwilligers in brede zin steeds vaker een probleem is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht ‘Brussel zint op nieuwe Europese belastingen’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the EU's Recovery Fund faces interest-rate shortfalls prompting new own resources, and whether spending shortfalls should be absorbed within expenditure. The minister acknowledged that reserved interest funds may be insufficient, said the Commission will report in its mid-term review, and stated the Netherlands will assess any new own-resource proposals on their merits.
After publication of the MTR, the House will be informed about this, including a cabinet appraisal.
Na de publicatie van de MTR zal de Kamer hierover geïnformeerd worden inclusief een kabinetsappreciatie.
Uitstel beantwoording vragen van de leden Boutkan en Dassen over het bericht 'Nederland laat miljoenen liggen om de wolf te weren'

Two Volt MPs asked the Minister of Finance about a newspaper report that the Netherlands leaves EU funds unused for wolf protection, including whether LIFE funds are used, and requested a detailed overview of EU funds, their uses, Dutch claims and communication. The government replied only that the answers cannot be provided within the usual deadline due to interdepartmental coordination and will follow as soon as possible.
cannot be answered within the usual period as a result of interdepartmental coordination
kunnen als gevolg van interdepartementale afstemming niet binnen de gebruikelijke termijn worden beantwoord
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kat en Van Weyenberg over het niet kunnen openen van een betaalrekening door kwetsbare mensen

MPs Kat and Van Weyenberg asked whether vulnerable people, including young victims of money mules, can open a payment account and why banks demand debt counselling or guardianship first. The Minister of Finance explains the Basic Bank Account Convenant and the EU directive, says the requirements are for banks to judge case by case, and promises to discuss improved communication and tailored treatment with banks.
Yes, I will discuss this with banks and will inform the House of Representatives about it.
Ja, ik zal hierover met banken in gesprek gaan en zal uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over documenten in het kader van het Digital Currency Governance Consortium

An MP asked the Minister of Finance for all written documents from the past three years concerning the World Economic Forum and the Ministry of Finance in relation to the Digital Currency Governance Consortium. The Minister replied that the only documents are an advice on Queen Máxima's participation as UN special advocate in the consortium's steering group and talking points for one meeting, and that these will not be shared because ministerial deliberation with the Queen and internal documents of an international organisation must remain confidential.
In line with established policy on this matter, the cabinet will not share the relevant documents with your House.
Conform het staande beleid hieromtrent zal het kabinet de betreffende documenten niet met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Kuiken, Ouwehand, Azarkan, Dassen en Sylvana Simons over de voortgang van de kabinetsdoelstellingen voor 2030

Six opposition MPs asked the cabinet for the latest 2030 forecasts on its policy targets, including road-death halving, and whether each target will be met. The minister answers only the road-safety item, citing SWOV research that halving serious injuries is likely too ambitious, and gives no answers on the other targets, apologising for the delay.
Unfortunately it has not been possible to answer within the three-week period.
Helaas is het niet gelukt om de beantwoording binnen de termijn van drie weken te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Akerboom en Van Raan over Nederlandse investeringen in een oliepijplijn in Oeganda met grote risico’s voor mens, dier en natuur

MPs Akerboom and Van Raan asked the government about Dutch investment in the EACOP oil pipeline in Uganda, covering land displacement, arrests of protesters, CO2 emissions, and Dutch financial institutions' investments in TotalEnergies. The minister answered that the government does not assess the project itself, relies on companies and financial institutions to apply due diligence, and defers to Uganda's sovereignty, while promising to raise human rights concerns and pursue EU and national IMVO legislation.
The cabinet does not make its own assessment of the consequences of this project.
Het kabinet maakt geen eigen appreciatie van de gevolgen van dit project
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de macro-financiële bijstand van Moldavië

An MP from FvD asked the Finance Minister whether the EU-level case for macro-financial assistance to Moldova is justified and whether IMF support is sufficient, asking seven questions. The Minister answered that EU-level assistance is more efficient than separate member-state aid, that the IMF programme does not cover the full financing gap, and that the EU's additional support is therefore needed.

The Commission can borrow more cheaply than most member states individually, and administrative burdens on the Moldovan authorities are limited as much as possible because they deal with only one party (the European Commission).
De Commissie kan namelijk goedkoper lenen dan de meeste lidstaten afzonderlijk en daarnaast worden de administratieve lasten voor de Moldavische autoriteiten zo veel mogelijk beperkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een klip en klaar onderzoek van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) aangaande het invoeren van een niet-effectieve gedragstaks

Van Haga asks the Finance Minister whether the government will drop its plan for extra taxes on meat, dairy and flying after a CPB study found behavioural taxes ineffective. The state secretary acknowledges the tax system has become complex and that tax instruments are not a cure-all, and says the government weighs effectiveness before new taxes and cites an impact analysis for the flight tax increase, without committing to drop the plans.
Fiscal arrangements can only be justified if they do what they are intended to do, that is, if they are effective and efficient.
Fiscale regelingen zijn alleen te verantwoorden als ze doen wat ze beogen, oftewel doeltreffend en doelmatig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht 'Medewerkers op Schiphol krijgen deze zomer 840 euro per maand extra'

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland (CDA) asked about reports that Schiphol staff would receive extra pay via a summer bonus and an allowance rather than a raised collective wage, and about how these payments affect net income, benefit entitlements and repayment risk. The government gave a detailed answer with example calculations showing high marginal tax burdens for some groups, and said it was in contact with Schiphol and the unions, with no new binding commitment beyond existing ones.
I have asked Schiphol whether it is aware of this.
Ik heb Schiphol gevraagd of hier oog voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de vragenlijst Wwft Sw voor beleggingsondernemingen van de AFM en de Vragenlijst integriteitsrisico van DNB

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether AFM and DNB questionnaires that list religious institutions, charities and churches as higher-risk sectors for money laundering, and that lead banks to apply enhanced due diligence, deter these organisations and conflict with GDPR and equal treatment rules. The minister replies that the questionnaires reflect sector-level risk assessments, that a sector risk must not be applied automatically to individual clients, that the FIU data cited are limited, and that regulators are not required to act on the requests for an Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens investigation or for a judgement on discrimination.

I consider it important that institutions apply the individual approach required by law correctly. It is not intended that individual clients be refused by institutions on the basis of a sector-wide risk.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat de instellingen de door de wet gevraagde individuele benadering juist toepassen. Het is niet de bedoeling dat individuele klanten geweerd worden door instellingen op basis van een sectorbreed risico.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontenbal en Slootweg over het bericht dat miljoenen overheidsgeld op het spel staan na het stilleggen van een biomassacentrale in Gelderland

Two CDA MPs asked why the Primco biomass plant in Duiven stopped operating, whether public money is at risk, and what measures prevent further subsidised biomass projects from failing. The minister answered that the company bears the price risk, that the state's subsidy and investment support total about 6 million euro so far, that the state would be a creditor for overpaid SDE+ subsidy in bankruptcy, and that the government has no active role in restarting the plant, while declining to answer the question on how many projects are affected.
No. It concerns many projects with very specific business operations and agreements on both costs or revenues for the use of biomass and revenues for the supply of heat.
Nee. Het betreft veel projecten met zeer specifieke bedrijfsvoeringen en afspraken zowel qua kosten of inkomsten voor de inzet van biomassa als qua opbrengsten voor de levering van warmte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht ‘Megaclaim gloort in slepend arbeidsgeschil bij de KLM’

An MP asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about a reported 478 million euro legal claim against KLM by Martinair pilots, and whether the state knew of it when approving a loan and state aid. The government answered that KLM, not the state, assesses and provides for the claim (22 million euro provision), that the state is not a party, and that it will monitor cost reductions under the aid conditions without taking a direct role.
The Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management are not parties to this legal dispute and its aftermath; it is a matter between KLM and the Martinair pilots group.

Het Ministerie van Financiën en het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat zijn geen partij in dit juridische conflict en de nasleep daarvan, dat is iets tussen KLM en de groep Martinair-piloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg en Heinen over de berichtgeving in de media naar aanleiding van het omvallen van de Amerikaanse banken SVB en Signature

MPs Slootweg and Heinen asked the Finance Minister about media coverage of the failures of SVB and Signature Bank, their exposure to Dutch savers, pension funds and banks, and systemic risks from interest rate policy. The minister answered that Dutch exposure is small, that the US banks had specific business-model weaknesses and lighter US regulation, and that Dutch banks are well capitalised, while acknowledging some global vulnerability and defending existing bank regulation.
I do not know how many Dutch savers and businesses held money at Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) or Signature Bank.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse spaarders en bedrijven geld bij Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) of Signature Bank hadden staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over Nederlandse banken die in de vuurlinie liggen door problemen in Silicon Valley

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister about the exposure of Dutch banks to the problems at Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank, including rate-rise risks and buffers. The minister answered that direct exposure is small, that US failures stemmed from atypical business models and deregulation, that Dutch banks are well capitalised and supervised under EU rules, and that no new measures are needed.
I am confident that European laws and regulations and our good supervision are adequate to address these risks appropriately.
Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat de Europese wet- en regelgeving en ons goede toezicht adequaat zijn om deze risico's op een passende wijze te adresseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slootweg over het bericht “Miljardensteun voor Credit Suisse, beleggers reageren opgelucht

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Finance about the rescue of Credit Suisse, the risks to Dutch and European banks, the state's ABN AMRO sell-down, and possible effects on the construction sector. The Minister answered that Switzerland's own authorities are responsible, that Dutch and European banks are more resilient, and that the sell-down continues under an agreed floor price, but did not disclose that price.
I cannot make public statements about the level of the floor price, as this could negatively affect the success of the sales programme.
Over de hoogte van de bodemprijs kan ik geen openbare uitspraken doen aangezien dit een negatieve impact kan hebben op het succes van het verkoopprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Aanjagers accountancy zien heel langzaam zelfbewustzijn in sector groeien'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the pace of culture change in the accountancy sector, how costs and oversight have evolved, and whether small organisations can access accountants. The minister answers that culture change is under way but slow, that oversight costs have risen and shifted to the AFM, and that the number of accountancy firms has fallen from 429 to 261.
I will await these activities and reports in order to then weigh whether additional actions and measures are necessary.
Ik wacht deze werkzaamheden en rapportages af om vervolgens een afweging te kunnen maken of aanvullende acties en maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over de herziening van de Capital Requirements Regulation (CRR) door de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the government about the EU revision of the CRR requiring banks to provide for non-performing loans even when fully guaranteed by the state, which affects NWB and BNG lending to housing corporations via the WSW guarantee fund, and whether a carve-out can be pursued in trilogue. The minister acknowledges the cost and financing risks for housing corporations, says the impact cannot be quantified because the data is confidential, and commits to pursuing a targeted exemption in the trilogue.
Information on expected NPLs that have been or could be on the balance sheets of the banks for more than seven years is not public, competitively sensitive information.
Informatie over de verwachte NPL's die langer dan zeven jaar op de balans van de betreffende banken staan of in de toekomst zou kunnen staan is niet publieke, concurrentiegevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht ‘Rekening geblokkeerd na gift aan kleinzoon, bank belooft beterschap'

Opposition MP Slootweg (CDA) asked the Finance Minister whether Rabobank's automatic blocking of a private account after a transfer to an unknown account, reportedly without notifying the customer and possibly reflecting ethnic profiling, was proportionate and how such practices are governed. The minister answered that the case itself cannot be assessed, that banks block accounts only on fraud indicators with customer notification being important, that no agreements with banks exist on automatic blocking or algorithmic profiling, and that the matter will be considered in implementing a related motion.
I cannot make statements about this individual case, because I am not familiar with the details of the matter.
Over deze individuele casus kan ik geen uitspraken doen, omdat ik niet bekend ben met de details van de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het salaris van de topman van Havenbedrijf Rotterdam

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the salary of the Port of Rotterdam Authority's chief executive, whether pay above the WNT norm should be capped in state holdings, and how this fits with strike-driven wage demands. The minister said the WNT does not apply to state holdings, pay is for the holding's board and shareholder oversight is limited, and declined to set a cap or commit to change.
It is up to the holdings themselves to structure their pay scales so that they can attract employees with the right knowledge and skills.
Het is aan de deelnemingen zelf om hun loongebouw zo in te richten dat zij werknemers met de juiste kennis en vaardigheden aan kunnen trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Slootweg over het bericht ‘Overheidsfinanciën in gevaar door verouderde ict van Belastingdienst’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Slootweg (CDA) asked whether the outdated Cool:Gen ICT systems behind income and wage tax could be replaced in time, and whether the risks to tax collection were real. The State Secretary answered that the continuity risk is unfounded, the systems are stable but costly to change, a multi-year modernisation portfolio and mitigation measures are in place, and the planning to finish by end 2026 is still feasible.
The fear that the continuity of tax collection is at stake is unfounded.
De vrees dat de continuïteit van de belastingheffing op het spel staat is ongegrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat de staat miljoenen verdient dankzij de aandeleninkoop van ABN AMRO

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the state's gains from the ABN AMRO share buyback and whether savers and taxpayers should benefit more, and about banks' savings and mortgage rates and the total cost and revenue of the rescue. The minister defends participation in the buyback to avoid a relative increase in the state's stake, reports cost and revenue figures, and says further sell-off steps will be communicated to parliament.
As usual, I will inform the House (confidentially if necessary) when there are new developments.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal ik uw Kamer (indien nodig vertrouwelijk) informeren op het moment dat er nieuwe ontwikkelingen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wilders over het niet-vervolgen van doodsbedreigers

An MP asks why the Public Prosecution Service declined to prosecute people who threatened him with death, and whether this undermines his safety and the rule of law. The Minister of Justice answers that individual prosecutorial decisions cannot be discussed to avoid political interference, that threats against MPs are assessed with great care regardless of political affiliation, and that the AIVD monitors threats to protected persons.
As Minister of Justice and Security I cannot address individual cases, in order to prevent political interference.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken, dit om politieke bemoeienis te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het Italiaanse tekort en de subsidieregeling voor het isoleren van woningen die meer dan 100 miljard lijkt te gaan kosten

Omtzigt asks the Finance Minister whether Italy's superbonus and related housing subsidies, worth over 100 billion euro, were kept outside the deficit, and why the Eurogroup and Eurostat did not prevent this. Minister Kaag answers that Eurostat's methodology clarification forces full upfront recording of these tax credits, raising Italy's 2020-2021 deficits without changing total costs, and that the Eurogroup did not discuss it.
The revision of Italy's budget deficit results from a clarification of the methodology by Eurostat, following questions from Istat in 2021.
De bijstelling van het Italiaanse begrotingstekort komt voort uit een verduidelijking van de methodologie door Eurostat, naar aanleiding van de vragen hierover van Istat in 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis en Nijboer over het feit dat er nog altijd flitskredieten worden aangeboden in Nederland

MPs Grinwis and Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether flash-credit providers such as saldodipje.nl, which impose penalties for missing guarantor documents that push costs above the legal maximum, are acceptable and whether the AFM can act against them. The minister said the 2020 flash-credit regulation caps such costs, a Rotterdam court ruling found insufficient evidence of a cap breach, and the government will review the rules when the revised EU consumer credit directive is transposed.
For that reason the Flash Credit Approach Regulation entered into force on 1 January 2020.
Daarom is op 1 januari 2020 de Regeling aanpak flitskrediet in werking getreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat er sinds begin deze eeuw 93 procent van de bankenkantoren is gesloten

An MP asks the Finance Minister about the closure of 93 percent of bank branches since 2000, whether customers' declining visits explain it, bank profits, the SME-failure warning, the motion for a national branch network, and the Accessible Payments Action Plan. The minister attributes closures mainly to digitalisation and declining demand for physical services, provides branch figures and profit data, says she lacks insight into SME failure causes, and notes ongoing talks with banks but declines to commit to a branch-count norm.
I consider it important that banks get to work promptly on implementing the stated intentions.
Ik vind het daarom belangrijk dat banken voortvarend aan de slag gaan met het uitvoeren van de uitgesproken intenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'Bankkantoren met een loep zoeken: ABN heeft er nog maar 27'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that bank branches have fallen sharply, and whether this leaves vulnerable groups excluded from banking. The minister answered that banks should offer non-digital alternatives, that banks have committed to keep non-digital basic services available and expanded pilots, and that the minister is in talks with banks and will report back in June 2023.
I am already in talks with the banks about the availability of physical financial service points for customers.
Ik ben reeds in gesprek met de banken over de beschikbaarheid van fysieke financiële dienstverleningspunten voor klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Slootweg over het bericht 'EY-accountants leveren licentie in vanwege Wirecard-echec'

An MP asked the Minister of Finance about voluntary licence surrender by accountants after the Wirecard affair, the frequency of licence withdrawal, lessons for supervision, rules on board seats at former clients, and whether accountants can keep their title while barely practising. The minister answered in detail that the Netherlands has titles rather than licences, that AFM can only file disciplinary complaints, and that existing rules and oversight are considered adequate.

I am of the view that the requirements for licensing by the AFM, the NBA's codes of conduct, the operation of disciplinary law and possible civil liability sufficiently guarantee the adequate performance of assignments by accountants.

Ik ben van mening dat de eisen die worden gesteld aan de vergunningverlening door de AFM, gedrags- en beroepsregels van de NBA, de werking van het tuchtrecht en eventuele civielrechtelijke aansprakelijkheid voldoende waarborgen bieden voor een adequate uitvoering van opdrachten door accountants.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ‘De latente stikstofruimte en extern salderen’

An MP (Omtzigt) asked the ministers about buy-outs of farms for nitrogen permit space, unregistered latent permit capacity, the unrecorded 30% deduction in external netting, and the AERIUS model update, requesting lists and data. The minister answered that the external netting evaluation is ongoing with results expected mid-2023, that stricter external netting rules and registration of freed space are being pursued, and that a complete picture of latent space cannot be obtained.
I expect to be able to share the results of the evaluation with the House around mid-2023.
Ik verwacht de resultaten van de evaluatie medio 2023 met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azarkan over dividendstripping door de staatsbank Fortis

Opposition MP Azarkan asked the Finance Minister about dividend stripping (CumEx and CumCum) by state-owned Fortis/ABN AMRO, including what the bank, supervisors, the tax authority and accountants knew. The minister answered that the Dutch anti-stripping rules do not cover German dividend tax, that the internal document could not be verified, that tax confidentiality and supervisory confidentiality prevent comment on individual cases, and that measures to strengthen the fight against dividend stripping are being prepared.

The Tax Administration has a duty of fiscal confidentiality. Therefore I cannot make any statements about the actions the Tax Administration does or does not take with respect to individual taxpayers.

De Belastingdienst kent een fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht. Derhalve kan ik geen mededelingen doen over de handelingen die de Belastingdienst al dan niet uitvoert ten aanzien van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sneller over het zo snel mogelijk starten met de volgende fase van het experiment gesloten coffeeshopketen

An MP from D66 asks the ministers how to speed up the closed coffeeshop cannabis experiment, including bank accounts for growers, BIBOB screening delays, imports from Canada, transport rules and oversight. The government answers that a start in early 2024 is expected, that a small-scale transition phase is being considered, that imports are barred by UN treaty, and that banks must keep their gatekeeping role under the Wwft.
Annex 5 is not public and is available for inspection at the Ministry of Justice and Security.
Bijlage 5 is niet openbaar en ligt ter inzage bij het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Maatoug over de aangenomen motie om uitgekochte bedrijven ruimhartig te compenseren, maar financiële instellingen niet

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Finance Minister how the adopted motion on fairly compensating buyout of farms, while not burdening financial institutions, will be followed up, and whether mandatory buyout and compulsory expropriation affect bank collateral claims and risk responsibility. The government answers that a study into binding contributions from banks and supply-chain actors is underway, due before summer, and that legal rules on pledges and expropriation compensation are explained but offer no room for redistribution.
Once this study is completed, expected before the summer, I will inform your House of the outcomes.
Na het afronden van dit onderzoek – naar verwachting voor de zomer – zal ik uw Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over de nevenfunctie van de Minister als GPMB-bestuurslid tijdens haar ministerschap

An MP asked whether Minister Kaag's board membership of the GPMB during her ministership was a side position that should have been declared under the Handbook for Ministers, and whether she had been transparent to parliament. The government answered that it was not a side position in the sense of the Handbook because it was carried out as part of her ministerial policy work, that parliament had been informed, and that the minister had no other side positions.
There has been no side position within the meaning of the Blue Book, Handbook for Ministers.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een nevenfunctie in de zin van het Blauwe Boek, Handboek voor Ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Romke de Jong, Sneller en Kat over het bericht 'Gokbedrijven probeerden ondanks verbod via wk-pools nieuwe klanten te lokken'

MPs Romke de Jong, Sneller and Kat asked the government about reports that gambling firms, including state holding Nederlandse Loterij, advertised via World Cup pools despite a ban, and about the state's oversight as shareholder. The government answered that it was unaware of the World Cup pool ads, that the Gaming Authority fined Nederlandse Loterij for advertising aimed at young adults, that it has voiced concerns to the holdings, and that it is evaluating the shareholding while declining to disclose the number of young players.
This information is not known to me or to my colleague the Minister for Legal Protection because it concerns confidential business information.
Deze informatie is bij mij of mijn collega de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming niet bekend omdat dit vertrouwelijke bedrijfsinformatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger en Bromet over het bericht 'Schiphol gaf al ruim 16 miljoen euro uit in jacht op stikstofrechten'

GroenLinks MPs asked whether Schiphol's purchases of farms for nitrogen rights (over EUR 16 million) were known to ministries, whether more purchases are planned, and how this relates to parliamentary motions and state-aid rules. The minister confirms awareness, says ministries were not involved, says Schiphol's external netting is allowed under current rules, and promises new policy to gain more regie over nitrogen space.
Private transactions have been concluded. I cannot comment on those.
Er zijn private transacties gesloten. Ik kan daar niet in treden.
Antwoord op vragen van Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat het kabinet de Duitse tak van Tennet wil verkopen

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the cabinet wants to sell TenneT's German arm, the size of its capital need, investment and sale proceeds, the negotiation status, and whether Dutch taxpayers should bear foreign ventures of state holdings. The minister says talks with Germany are at an early stage with no irreversible steps, that a German stake is being explored, that sale proceeds cannot yet be disclosed, and that the state only injects capital into Dutch grid investments.
We will continue to inform your House about the scenarios now under consideration and the trade-offs involved (confidentially where necessary and publicly where possible).
Wij zullen uw Kamer blijven informeren over de nu voorliggende scenario's en de daarbij te maken afweging (vertrouwelijk waar nodig en publiek waar dat kan).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over het bericht 'Minister Kaag en haar stichting in de fout met eigen anti-witwasregels

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether she wrongly failed to register herself as ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) of her own foundation and what sanctions apply for non-compliance. The minister answered that after notarial advice she does not qualify as UBO because she has no control over the foundation, that its board members are correctly registered, and that no correction is needed.
Based on this advice and the relevant laws and regulations with the accompanying parliamentary explanation, the conclusion is that I do not qualify as UBO of the foundation I established.
Op grond van dit advies en gelet op de relevante wet- en regelgeving met bijbehorende parlementaire toelichting is de conclusie dat ik niet kwalificeer als UBO van de door mij opgerichte stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen, Boswijk en Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'Ook Lelystad Airport omstreden stikstofmarkt op: vliegveld is op zoek naar boeren voor opkoop'

CDA MPs asked ministers whether buying up nitrogen rights by Lelystad Airport and the state-linked Schiphol Group, while PAS-melder farmers remain unresolved, is acceptable, and whether the government should stop it and apply the motion on a transparent nitrogen bank. The minister answered that the airport acts within the principle that initiators must mitigate their own emissions, that it only bought from farms that volunteered, that a nitrogen bank does not yet exist, and that Schiphol's operational permit matters are for its board.
The airport's conduct is in line with the nitrogen policy principle that initiators are themselves responsible for mitigating nitrogen emissions.
Het handelen van de luchthaven is in lijn met het uitgangspunt van het stikstofbeleid dat initiatiefnemers zelf verantwoordelijk zijn om stikstofuitstoot te mitigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over uitspraken van een eurocommissaris over het maken van meer gezamenlijke schulden

MP Van Haga asked the Finance Minister whether she endorses Commissioner Gentiloni's call for more joint debt and whether concrete eurobond or joint-debt emergency proposals exist, and asked about the euro's stability, fiscal discipline and exit from the eurozone. The minister answered that the government opposes structural eurobonds, sees no concrete Commission proposals yet, supports only carefully conditioned temporary crisis instruments, and maintains rules-based fiscal discipline while rejecting a taboo-free view on euro exit.
The cabinet's view is that the existing financial instruments should primarily be fully used.
Het kabinet is van mening dat in de eerste plaats het bestaande financiële instrumentarium optimaal benut moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht dat BKR actief hypotheekgegevens wil registreren

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Finance whether the credit registration body BKR's plans to register mortgages at origination, not only at payment arrears, go beyond the law, are disproportionate, and whether the minister will intervene. The minister confirms BKR is consulting on positive registration for specific mortgage types, says she is preparing a bill giving public guarantees and a statutory role for the Minister of Finance over credit registration, and that she sees no reason to register all owner-occupied mortgages.
The bill I am preparing provides for more public safeguards for data processing in credit registration and regulates which agreements are registered.
Het wetsvoorstel dat ik in voorbereiding heb regelt meer publieke waarborgen voor gegevensverwerking bij kredietregistratie en regelt welke overeenkomsten worden geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Boulakjar en Kat over het bericht 'BKR wil hypotheken registreren en gegevens delen met belwinkels en postorderbedrijven'

MPs from D66 asked the Finance Minister, on behalf of other ministers, about BKR's plan to register mortgages and share data with phone-shop and mail-order firms, including its legal basis, public oversight, proportionality and privacy. The minister answered that no positive mortgage registration is planned for now, that a bill will be consulted on in early 2023 to give credit registration a statutory basis and ministerial powers, and that the government is in talks with BKR.
In the bill, credit registration becomes a statutory task, with corresponding powers for the Minister of Finance.
In het wetsvoorstel wordt kredietregistratie een wettelijke taak, met overeenkomstige bevoegdheden voor de Minister van Financiën.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Besparing is beter dan financiële compensatie'

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asked the Finance Minister about a Catshuis expert roundtable on the budget, its attendees, topics, whether a report would be issued, how the House would be informed, and whether more such sessions are planned. The minister confirmed attendance, explained the expert selection and themes, said no official report would be made but that the spring budget decision would reflect the input, and noted more expert talks are routine before the spring memorandum.
No official report of this Catshuis session will be drawn up.
Er wordt geen officieel verslag van deze Catshuissessie opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee inzake ‘fossiele investeringen met Europees geld

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister whether the EU REPowerEU negotiations were in their final stage, whether Do No Significant Harm exceptions should be subject to Commission review, whether oil should be excluded from REPowerEU financing, and whether the Commission should assess EU supply-security needs first. The minister answered that a provisional agreement was reached on 14 December 2022, that the Netherlands pushed for justification and narrower exceptions, that oil is excluded except for states exempted under the sixth and ninth sanctions packages, and that the Commission assesses how plans contribute to REPowerEU goals.
The Netherlands kept arguing in the negotiations for proper justification by member states if the Do-No-Significant-Harm exception is used within the REPowerEU chapter.

Nederland is in de onderhandelingen blijven pleiten voor een goede onderbouwing door lidstaten als binnen het REPowerEU-hoofdstuk van de Do-No-Significant-Harm -uitzondering (hierna: DNSH) gebruik gemaakt wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het aanbieden van verzekeringsproducten aan alleen hoger opgeleiden

MP Nijboer asked the Finance Minister whether insurers such as Promovendum may offer policies only to higher-educated people, whether this is lawful under acceptance duties and premium differentiation rules, and how this bears on social inequality and risk pooling. The minister answered that such differentiation is largely lawful outside basic health insurance, that she monitors developments closely with AFM and DNB, sees no need for new rules now, and will intervene if inequality grows.
I am therefore closely monitoring whether this effect occurs. If it does, I will act against it.
Ik houd dan ook nauwlettend in de gaten of dit effect zich voordoet. Als dat zo is, dan zal ik daar tegen optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over de uitspraak van het Hof van justitie van de Europese Unie over het UBO-register

An SGP MP asked the Finance Minister how the government would respond to the EU Court of Justice ruling invalidating the public-access provision of the UBO register directive. The minister answered that the register was closed for all parties pending a legal analysis, that access for competent authorities will be restored, and that the consequences for obliged entities and for legitimate-interest access, including journalists, remain unclear.
Once the above analysis has been further developed and it is clear which measures will be taken, I will inform your House.
Zodra bovenstaande analyse verder uitgewerkt is en duidelijk is welke maatregelen genomen zullen worden, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het arrest van het Hof van justitie van de Europese Unie inzake de ongeldigheid van het openbaar UBO-register

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the CJEU ruling invalidating public access to the UBO register, its compatibility with fundamental rights, the planned implementation, the closure date, and the cost to the Netherlands. The minister answered that the register was closed for information provision on 22 November, that competent authorities will be reconnected quickly while access for the wider public will be limited to those with a legitimate interest, and that the financial impact is not yet clear.
Once the legal analysis is clear and it is evident which measures will be taken, I will inform your House of this directly.
Zodra de juridische analyse helder is en duidelijk is welke maatregelen genomen zullen worden, zal ik uw Kamer hierover direct informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over de uitspraak van het Hof van justitie van de Europese Unie over het UBO-register

An MP asked the Finance Minister how the government would respond to the EU Court of Justice ruling invalidating public access to the UBO register, and whether fines would be lifted and information sharing limited. The minister answered that the register was closed to information requests, that a legal analysis is underway, that competent authorities will be reconnected first, and that risk-based enforcement continues pending a decision.
As soon as the ruling became known, it was decided to close the register to information provision.
Zodra de uitspraak bekend werd, is besloten om het register te sluiten voor informatieverstrekkingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de LSI (Landelijke Stuurgroep Interventieteams) en vele tot nu toe onuitgevoerde toezeggingen over privacy, risicoscores van heel veel burgers, onuitgevoerd onderzoek, niet opg

MP Omtzigt asks about the LSI joint intervention-team data sharing, including DPIAs, promised but unpublished documents, a planned external review of risk scores, an advisory analytics committee that is still not set up, and possible GDPR violations. The government answers that DPIAs and a privacy protocol are being prepared, that LSI risk scores were stopped in July 2020, that the advisory committee is still being recruited, and that the requested documents are attached or promised later.
Once the DPIA of the LSI cooperation has been completed, it will be sent to the House.
Zodra de DPIA van de LSI-samenwerking is opgeleverd zal deze aan de Kamer worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Inge van Dijk over bankzaken op Saba

CDA MPs asked about banking access on Saba, including the Eilandsraad motion, bank and ATM presence, DNB supervision, mortgage access and ATM costs. The State Secretary acknowledged problems, pointed to agreements and a task force, and explained that supervision and market conditions limit options, without committing to a specific new measure.
Due to the confidentiality of supervision, I do not have institution-specific information about PSB at my disposal.
In verband met de vertrouwelijkheid van toezicht heb ik geen instelling specifieke informatie over PSB tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Nieuwe penningmeester? ‘Door procedures bank al maanden geen pasje

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Finance about long bank processing times, caused by customer due-diligence under anti-money-laundering rules, that prevent newly appointed association treasurers from obtaining a bank card and account. The minister acknowledged the problem, said banks should be more risk-based, and announced talks with the banking association and DNB, without changing the rules themselves.
I agree with DNB that banks' risk-based approach can and must be improved.
Ik ben het met DNB eens dat de risicogebaseerde aanpak van banken beter kan en moet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over Onderzoek naar financiële transacties van/naar Stichting Open Nederland

An MP asked ministers whether they knew of a private investigation report into financial transactions of Stichting Open Nederland and why the Chamber was not informed, and whether the report was forwarded to ministries and press. The government answered that the report was unreliable, that VWS commissioned its own check finding no evidence of the transactions, that the report cannot be published pending possible legal proceedings, and that it was not informed of the investigation when it took place.
Pending possible legal proceedings and measures, the research report commissioned by VWS cannot currently be made public.
In afwachting van mogelijke juridische procedures en maatregelen kan het in opdracht van VWS opgeleverde onderzoeksrapport nu niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Van der Lee over het duurzaamheidsrisicobeheer van banken

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Finance Minister about an ECB study finding that 96% of banks have blind spots in managing environmental risks, and about monitoring of the financial sector's climate commitment. The Minister agreed the findings are worrying, said DNB received a better picture of Dutch banks but the results are confidential and not publishable, and promised a letter on the first progress report and a later report on 2030 targets.
The research results are based on supervisory-confidential information and I do not have authority over that.
De onderzoeksresultaten zijn gebaseerd op toezichtvertrouwelijke informatie en daarover beschik ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de motie-Omtzigt inzake vergoedingen voor energiebedrijven (Kamerstuk 36200, nr. 118)

MP Omtzigt asks the government how it implements two motions on the energy price cap: margin-based compensation for energy suppliers and handling of shared connections (blokaansluitingen), plus questions on tax changes and the timing of the cap. The minister answers that talks on margin testing are ongoing, a solution for shared connections has top priority under coordination by the Tax Authority, the 2023 cap is intended to start on 1 January 2023, and no further change to energy tax rates is currently planned.
Talks are currently being held with energy suppliers on how to arrive at some form of margin testing in implementing the 2023 price cap scheme.
Op dit moment worden gesprekken gevoerd met de energieleveranciers over hoe te komen tot een vorm van margetoetsing bij de uitvoering van de prijsplafondregeling voor 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Van der Molen, Knops en Inge van Dijk over studeren op kosten van een brievenbusfirma

MPs asked whether Dutch universities should be subject to anti-money-laundering checks on tuition payments from foreign students, including screening for PEPs and cash payments. The government replied that universities are not obliged institutions under the Wwft, that the National Risk Assessment shows no indication of laundering risk in university services, and that cash tuition payments may be justified in some cases, with the Rijksuniversiteit Groningen receiving about 300,000 euro in cash in 2022.
It is therefore not desirable to make the obligations under the Wwft apply to universities.
Het is daarom niet wenselijk de verplichtingen uit de Wwft voor universiteiten te laten gelden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Molen en Inge van Dijk over universiteitsfondsen nemen meer beleggingsrisico

MPs Van der Molen and Inge van Dijk asked the ministers about university funds taking on more investment risk, including staff paid by universities working for the funds, and the transparency of donations. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that public funds must not pay for fund activities, that the minister's role is to clarify the rules via a policy rule, and that the funds are not covered by the higher education act, so transparency cannot be tightened through it.
I think that in these cases state-funded universities should, when asked, have to demonstrate that no public funds are used for staff costs for university funds.
Ik vind dat in deze gevallen rijksbekostigde universiteiten desgevraagd dienen aan te tonen dat er geen publieke middelen worden aangewend voor personeels-kosten ten behoeve van universiteitsfondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eerdmans over de potentieel desastreuze gevolgen van de gascrisis voor de industrie

An MP from JA21 asked ministers about the risk that the gas crisis could cause uncontrolled industrial shutdowns, including whether gas shortages can be ruled out at a 90 percent storage fill level and what contingency measures apply. The minister answered that the GTS conditions for avoiding shortages are currently met, that the Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas is being operationalised, and that a study of the impact of high energy prices on industry will be shared before year-end, though several questions were answered only in part or deferred.
By the end of the year I will come with a new update on the Gas Protection and Recovery Plan.
Voor het einde van het jaar kom ik met een nieuwe update rond het Bescherm- en Herstelplan Gas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grinwis over het DNB-rapport ‘Van herstel naar balans' en signalen dat PEPs door Wwft-instellingen worden geweerd als klant

MP Grinwis asked the Finance Minister about DNB's report on a risk-based anti-money-laundering approach and about reports that Wwft institutions refuse or drop PEPs as clients without concrete risk. The minister largely agreed with a risk-based approach, promised a policy agenda, dialogue with the sector and guidance, and said refusing PEPs solely for their status is improper, though he provided no formal complaint mechanism.
I therefore believe that the application of the regulations to PEPs can be improved.
Ik vind dan ook dat de toepassing van de regelgeving op PEPs beter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het World Economic Forum (WEF)

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Finance whether the cabinet ignores World Economic Forum letters and invitations, and whether answers were sent to the WEF. The minister replied that invitations were answered via the Permanent Representation in Geneva rather than directly, and that the communication with the PV can be requested.
Invitations from the WEF were not answered directly to the WEF organisation. This went through the Permanent Representation (PV) of the Netherlands in Geneva.
Uitnodigingen van het WEF zijn niet rechtstreeks beantwoord aan de organisatie van het WEF. Dit verliep via de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging (PV) van Nederland te Genève.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over 'Begroting Kaag niet verantwoord'

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the 2023 budget is responsible given a possible shortfall of 10 to 40 billion euros, whether civil servants called the ministry chaotic, and how the CPB can monitor spending and the cumulative support packages. The minister answers that the energy-price measures are unprecedented, cites a 2.6 billion (2022) and 11.2 billion (2023) cost estimate, says the remaining cover will be decided in spring, and provides overviews of the packages.
Decisions on the additional cover will be taken in the spring.
Over de aanvullende dekking wordt besloten in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de werking van de technische regeling tussen de EU en Israël

MP Kuzu asked whether products from Israeli settlements in occupied territories are excluded from EU preferential tariffs, how Dutch customs checks origin claims, and what enforcement data exist for 2017-2021. The Staatssecretaris confirmed exclusion, described risk-based and sample-based checks (0.4% physical, 2.8% document checks), reported no refusals or verification requests, and stated no Commission monitoring information was given.
The customs declaration for free circulation does not contain information on the postcode of the place where a product underwent its origin-conferring processing.
In de aangifte voor het vrije verkeer (de invoeraangifte) wordt geen informatie opgenomen over de postcode van de plek waar een product zijn oorsprongsverlenende be- of verwerking heeft ondergaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht dat veel Oekraïense vluchtelingen geen Nederlandse bankrekening kunnen openen

MP Stoffer asked the Finance Minister about reports that many Ukrainian refugees could not open Dutch bank accounts, due to invalid or non-biometric passports, and what would be done to fix it. The minister answered that about 7,000 adults lacked accounts, that banks from 3 October would accept such documents, and that DNB had been asked to act flexibly.
On 30 September the banks announced that from 3 October they could also provide a bank account to persons with these documents.
Op 30 september hebben de banken bekend gemaakt dat zij vanaf 3 oktober ook personen met deze documenten een bankrekening kunnen verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van der Molen over het bericht 'Arbonormen bagagepersoneel Schiphol jarenlang overschreden, deel heeft gezondheidsklachten'

MPs Palland and Van der Molen (CDA) asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Infrastructure and Finance about reports that baggage handling staff at Schiphol worked beyond Arbo limits for years and that the Labour Inspectorate had not inspected these firms for twelve years. The government replied that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate has started investigations and will report further, and that sector CAO, access restrictions on handlers and talks with Schiphol and KLM are underway.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible. Parliament will be informed further on this.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn. Hierover wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en De Hoop over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en arbeidsomstandigheden bij bagagepersoneel op Schiphol

MPs Alkaya and De Hoop asked ministers whether baggage staff at Schiphol had for years been required to lift beyond health limits despite a 2009 inspection demand, and what the government would do. The ministers answered that the employers are primarily responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has launched inspections and will report, and that Schiphol and the ministries are pressing for structural improvements including limiting the number of handlers, though no independent new investigation will be set up.
The Minister of SZW sees no reason to set up a new independent investigation on top of everything already underway.
De Minister van SZW ziet geen aanleiding om naast alles wat nu al loopt een nieuw onafhankelijk onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over investeringsplannen van de fossiele industrie

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government about fossil fuel companies' investment plans (the 'carbon bombs' reported by The Guardian) and whether the government would act internationally to stop them, given the Paris Agreement. The minister acknowledges the climate risks, says the plans are incompatible with Paris if the figures hold, and lists existing policy and coalitions, but declines to provide an overview of Dutch-linked investment plans and does not join the Beyond Oil and Gas Alliance.
That data is not public and the cabinet therefore does not keep track of it.
Die data zijn niet openbaar en houdt het kabinet dus ook niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het PAX rapport betreffende foute investeringen van de ING en andere grote banken in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about a PAX report finding that major European banks, including ING, financed arms producers supplying states with high risk of using weapons against civilians, such as Saudi Arabia. The government answered that banks must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and UNGP, that exporters with valid licences operate within legal frameworks, and that it sees no reason to meet ING, while pointing to forthcoming due diligence legislation.

The government expects Dutch banks such as ING, in line with the OECD Guidelines and the UN Guiding Principles, to map risks to people and the environment in their value chain for their investments in the defence industry.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse banken zoals ING dat zij, conform de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen (OESO-richtlijnen) en UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights (UNGP's), voor hun investeringen in de defensie-industrie de risico's voor mens en milieu in hun waardeketen in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Peter de Groot over het bericht 'Banken blokkeren meeverhuizen lage hypotheekrente'

MPs Heinen and Peter de Groot asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks block portability of low mortgage rates when homeowners move, causing higher monthly costs. The government answered that the portability rule and a 5% test rate for shorter fixed periods explain the situation, that rate-averaging is optional for lenders, and that it sees no need to mandate it, relying on consumer advice and a competitive market.
I consider it important that consumers who do not need or want the flexible conditions of a mortgage can still take out a suitable mortgage (with a correspondingly lower price).
Ik vind het belangrijk dat consumenten die de flexibele voorwaarden van een hypotheek niet nodig hebben of willen, toch een passende hypotheek (met bijbehorende lagere prijs) kunnen afsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Maatoug over het bericht 'Brussel duldt geen inmenging in besteding coronamiljarden'

MPs Dassen and Maatoug asked whether the government supports the Commission's claim that disclosing documents on informal talks about the Dutch recovery plan would undermine decision-making, and how the decision-making process is defined. Minister Kaag answered that disclosure of pre-2022 documents no longer undermines the process, that the formal decision-making only started after the final plan was submitted on 8 July 2022, and that Parliament was kept informed throughout, while deferring the Commission-related questions to the Commission.

As regards the documents on the talks between the Dutch cabinet and the European Commission for this period that are in our possession, I am of the view that disclosing these documents no longer undermines the decision-making process surrounding approval of the Dutch plan.

Voor wat betreft de documenten over de gesprekken tussen het Nederlandse kabinet en de Europese Commissie voor deze periode die in ons bezit zijn, ben ik van mening dat openbaarmaking van deze documenten het besluitvormingsproces rondom de goedkeuring van het Nederlandse plan niet langer ondermijnt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Vestering en Teunissen over investeringen in de intensieve veehouderij door ABP

MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the ministers whether ABP's investments in intensive livestock farming conflict with animal welfare, climate and Paris goals, and what the government can do to steer the pension fund. The government replied that the ABP board is independently responsible for investment policy, that the government has no formal control over it, and pointed to existing voluntary IMVB and climate commitments with review later.
The cabinet, as one of the sector employers involved with ABP, has no formal means to steer the implementation of the pension scheme.
Het kabinet heeft, als één van de sectorwerkgevers betrokken bij het ABP, geen formele mogelijkheden ter sturing op de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het verhogen van de tarieven door energiemaatschappijen

MP Omtzigt asked the ministers whether energy suppliers raising tariffs from 1 October on only 10 days' notice break the 30-day notice rule, whether consumers must pay higher direct-debit amounts, and how consumers can enforce their rights. Minister Jetten answered that the ACM was asked to enforce the rules, that most large suppliers reversed their increases, that consumers can complain or go to the Geschillencommissie or court, and that the ACM cannot order refunds.
They can also report to the ACM that the supplier is not complying with the rules.
Ze kunnen ook bij de ACM melding maken dat de leverancier zich niet aan de regels houdt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het prijsplafond energie en de toegezegde voorbeelden tijdens de Algemene Politieke Beschouwingen

MP Omtzigt asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about how the energy price cap would work for various household types, including large families, the chronically ill, heat network users, residents of apartment blocks with central heating, heat pump users, monument residents and holiday parks, and about the compensation paid to suppliers. The minister answered with estimated bills with and without the cap, said suppliers would receive at most the gap between their advertised price and the cap, and listed existing support measures while admitting some cases (heat networks, shared connections) remain difficult to resolve.
The cabinet will ensure in the design of the scheme that any excessively paid compensation can be recovered if the planned audit gives cause for it.
Het kabinet zal in de vormgeving van de regeling waarborgen dat eventueel te veel vergoede middelen terug kunnen worden gehaald indien de beoogde accountantscontrole hier aanleiding toe geeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over het rapport 'What is a fair emissions budget for The Netherlands'

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan asked the government to respond to an NCI report arguing that the Netherlands' fair share of the carbon budget requires near-zero emissions by 2030, and whether current climate targets are consistent with the Paris Agreement. The minister rejected the report's conclusions and methodology, maintained that the national targets are in line with the 1.5°C goal and the Paris Agreement, and committed to aligning public export credit support with the COP26 declaration without giving a firm new date.

No. According to the cabinet, the tightened Dutch climate targets for 2030 (at least 55% and aiming for 60% reduction) and 2050 (climate neutral, i.e. net-zero greenhouse gas emissions) are, based on the IPCC, in line with the 1.5-degree goal of the Paris Agreement.

Nee. Volgens het kabinet zijn de aangescherpte Nederlandse klimaatdoelen voor 2030 (ten minste 55% en streven naar 60%-reductie) en 2050 (klimaatneutraal oftewel netto-nul-broeikasemissies) op basis van het IPCC in lijn met het 1,5 gradendoel van het Akkoord van Parijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ginneken over het arbeidsconflict bij NS

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Finance Minister why NS cancelled trains nationwide on 9 September 2022 due to a regional strike, how the affected area was expanded, and what criteria NS applied. The State Secretary answered that the nationwide cancellation was undesirable, that the strike area was larger than before, and that NS judged it could not guarantee a safe and reliable timetable, promising to ask NS for an explanation to be shared with parliament.

As I promised in the committee debate on Public Transport and Taxis of Wednesday 14 September, I will ask NS to reflect on the strikes and to set out again the reasons for the nationwide impact of the strike on 9 September, which I will share with your House.

Zoals ik heb toegezegd in het commissiedebat Openbaar Vervoer en Taxi van woensdag 14 september jl., zal ik NS vragen te reflecteren op de stakingen en om de redenen voor de landelijke uitstraling van de staking op 9 september nog eens op een rij te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'ING te druk met witwasonderzoek, weert stichtingen en verenigingen'

An MP asks the Finance Minister about ING's temporary refusal to open bank accounts for foundations and associations due to anti-money-laundering workload, and whether banks can keep serving such clients. The minister answers that ING's stop is temporary and due to capacity, that banks should apply risk-based customer due diligence without categorical exclusion, and that she is discussing de-risking with banks and DNB, though no signals were received that a foundation cannot open an account anywhere.
I am in discussion with representatives of banks and DNB about the risk-based approach of the Wwft and de-risking.
Ik ben met de vertegenwoordigers van banken en DNB in gesprek over de risicogebaseerde aanpak van de Wwft en de-risking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het bericht 'ING te druk met witwasonderzoek, weert stichtingen en verenigingen'

MP Van Raan asked the Finance Minister about reports that ING was temporarily refusing new accounts for foundations and associations due to anti-money-laundering workload, and about PEP-related scrutiny, costs and proportionality. The minister answered that banks must do client due diligence, called for risk-based approaches and dialogue with client groups, said the government will examine exclusion of client groups and review PEP rules (including an EY study), but did not deem the ING measure discriminatory.

I have also asked, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, the researchers revising the National Risk Assessments whether it is possible to identify factors or circumstances that make risks for a particular legal form, such as foundations and associations, higher or lower.

Ik heb verder, samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, aan de onderzoekers die werken aan de herziening van de National Risk Assessments (NRA's) gevraagd of het mogelijk is om factoren aan te wijzen of omstandigheden te benoemen die maken dat risico's voor een bepaalde rechtsvorm of binnen en bepaalde rechtsvorm, zoals stichtingen en verenigingen, hoger of lager zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Marijnissen over de prijscap op energie

MPs Omtzigt and Marijnissen asked the government about the planned energy price cap, its costs, who it covers, safeguards against excess profits by energy companies, and related consultations. Minister Jetten answered that a price cap from 1 January 2023 is planned with volume limits and maximum tariffs, costs are not yet exact and will be funded partly from energy tax cuts, and the government intends to bar disconnections this winter, while many answers refer to a separate letter and some consultation details are not shared.
Given the short deadline for answering, for further explanation of this answer I refer briefly to my letter of 20 September 2022.
Gegeven de korte termijn die is gesteld voor beantwoording, verwijs ik voor verdere uitleg van dit antwoord kortheidshalve naar mijn brief van 20 september 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over gaswinning in Nederland

An MP asked why GasTerra, 50% state-owned, sold almost all Dutch gas to foreign buyers under long-term contracts, and asked for the contracts and prices to be made public. The minister answered that the contracts are private, commercially sensitive, and cannot be shared with MPs, while explaining the legal constraints, market pricing and the government's energy-bill support measures.
No. These are contracts between private parties containing commercially sensitive information.
Nee. Het betreft hier contracten tussen privaatrechtelijke partijen met commercieel gevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het bericht ‘Het uitkopen van boeren is wéér een bail-out voor banken’

MPs Beckerman and Alkaya asked whether banks such as Rabobank, which hold large food and agri loans, share responsibility for the nitrogen crisis and whether buy-out schemes for farmers amount to a bail-out for banks. The minister answered that banks share a joint responsibility, that the buy-out schemes are financed from state funds and may be used to repay bank loans, and that the government will inform parliament further on expecting a non-voluntary contribution from banks.
It is not for the government to intervene in the settlement of these financial obligations between private parties.
Het is niet aan de overheid om in de afhandeling van deze financiële verplichtingen tussen private partijen te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het artikel ‘Lidstaten saboteren toezicht op de honderden miljarden van het Europese coronaherstelfonds’ van Follow the Money

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether EU recovery fund (RRF) beneficiaries can be made public, given reports that member states resist transparency and oversight of the funds. The minister replied that EU rules require member states to collect beneficiary data accessible to EU audit bodies, that publication is for national governments to decide, and that a privacy-related review of publishing beneficiary data is due in Q3 2022.
The cabinet wants to carefully weigh the public disclosure of the data.
Het kabinet wil een zorgvuldige afweging maken voor wat betreft de publieke openbaring van de gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de stakingen van NS-medewerkers

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister, as shareholder, what she could do about the NS strike, whether she supports the staff's pay demands, and whether state participations should guarantee a 15 euro minimum hourly wage and disclose wage data. The minister replied that CAO negotiations are a matter for NS management and unions, that she expects good employer conduct and monitors NS finances, but declined to provide hourly wage data citing commercial confidentiality.
As a shareholder I do not have information on the hourly wages of the participations' employees. Moreover, this often concerns (business) confidential information.
Als aandeelhouder beschik ik niet over informatie over het uurloon van medewerkers van de deelnemingen. Dit betreft bovendien vaak (bedrijfs)vertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht 'hoge prijzen leiden tot miljardenwinst voor olie- en gasbedrijf Shell'

An MP from the CDA asked the government how it views Shell's large profits and share buybacks during the energy price crisis, whether a solidarity levy should be introduced, and how state participation EBN could be expanded. The minister answered that a levy on fossil producers is being examined with a decision due on Prinsjesdag, that the state already receives about 70% of domestic oil and gas profits, and that Shell has committed to investing in the energy transition in the Netherlands.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Minhas over de Kamerbrief ‘Afschalen dienstregeling vanwege personeelstekorten NS’ en ‘NS’ers willen meer geld, ja. Maar ze willen vooral waardering’

An MP from the VVD asks the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management and the Minister of Finance about NS's planned timetable cuts of 10 to 15 percent due to staff shortages, including consultation, accountability, concession incentives and sanctions. The government answers that it finds the cuts undesirable, is monitoring NS and seeking to limit the impact, but says the shortages cannot be fully prevented and that it sees no direct link to shareholder decisions.
As concession grantor for the main rail network, I expect the concession holder to do everything it can to run trains as agreed.
Als concessieverlener voor het hoofdrailnet verwacht ik van de concessiehouder dat NS alles in het werk stelt om conform afspraak treinen te laten rijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouchallikh en Maatoug over het afschalen van de dienstregeling van NS vanwege personeelstekorten en de stakingen bij NS

GroenLinks MPs Bouchallikh and Maatoug asked the ministers about NS cutting its timetable by 10-20% due to staff shortages and strikes, including effects on passengers, car use, wages and state responsibility as shareholder. The government answered that it shares concern, is pressing NS in talks, will inform parliament on relevant developments, and says wage and funding decisions rest with NS's board.
We will inform your House of relevant developments regarding the scaling back of the timetable due to staff shortages at NS.
Wij zullen uw Kamer informeren bij relevante ontwikkelingen ten aanzien van het afschalen van de dienstregeling vanwege personeelstekorten bij NS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de gelekte maatregelen naar aanleiding van het bereikte begrotingsakkoord in aanloop naar Prinsjesdag

MP Omtzigt asks the Prime Minister and Finance ministers whether leaked pre-Budget Day measures (air ticket tax, corporate tax, box 3, student grants and others) are accurate, who leaked them, and why a leak by an opposition MP was punished while government leaks are not. The Prime Minister declines to confirm or deny specific leaked measures because the Prinsjesdag proposals are still under Council of State advice and CPB calculation, confirms the coalition agreement's rise in air passenger tax, says he regrets the breach of the confidentiality rule, but does not say who leaked or what the ministerial discussion concluded.
The decision-making process on the Prinsjesdag documents has not yet been completed.
Het besluitvormingsproces over de Prinsjesdagstukken is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het UBO-register

An MP asked the Finance Minister about backlogs at the UBO register, whether banks may refuse accounts over missing registrations, and whether guidance is clear. The minister explained the backlog from late registrations, announced a temporary tolerance rule extended to 1 January 2023, and pointed to existing guidance and consultations.
This prevents the temporary peak in processing times from leading to an obstacle to entering into a business relationship.
Dit voorkomt dat de tijdelijke piek in verwerkingstijden zou leiden tot een belemmering voor het aangaan van een zakelijke relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het artikel ‘Sancties tegen Russen bleven maand liggen.’

An MP asked the ministers why Dutch enforcement of Russia sanctions was delayed by more than a month after the Chamber of Commerce held relevant data, and whether the delay was caused by legal issues and how recurrence will be prevented. The minister answered that the data could not be shared without a legal basis, that the legal gaps are being closed through changes to the sanctions regulation and modernisation of the sanctions system, and that a permanent sanctions team has been set up.

The sharing of these personal data was partly addressed with the amendment of the sanctions regulation in April, but it became clear that a more structural modernisation of the sanctions system would be needed.

Het delen van deze persoonsgegevens is met de wijziging van sanctieregeling territoriale integriteit Oekraïne 2014 in april deels ondervangen, maar duidelijk werd dat een meer structurele modernisering van het sanctiestelsel nodig zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Dassen, Azarkan en van der Plas over de stukken van de aandeelhoudersvergadering van 2022 van Schiphol

MPs Omtzigt, Dassen, Azarkan and Van der Plas asked why the government refused to share the minutes and documents of Schiphol's 2022 shareholders' meeting, and how parliament can scrutinise the state's shareholder role. Minister Kaag answered that the minutes are confidential business information, provided a summary of operational challenges, promised confidential inspection of the draft minutes, and said parliament has no power to review individual shareholder meetings.
The report of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) is classified as commercially confidential information and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over ’het gebruik van Energie en de plek waar de miljardenwinsten terecht komen, terwijl de Nederlandse huishoudens in Energie-armoede vervallen’

Omtzigt asked the ministers how much gas is extracted in the Netherlands in 2022, where it goes, what long-term contracts and prices the state and its companies have, how much the state earns from gas, and whether consumers are overcharged, including whether electricity producers' profits and subsidies are fair. The government answered that the gas cannot be traced to a final destination, that contract terms are confidential, that the state earns gas revenue through specified channels, and that it is examining targeted relief for vulnerable households.
The content of these contracts is confidential, and this confidentiality is also agreed in the contracts themselves.
De inhoud van deze contracten is vertrouwelijk en deze vertrouwelijkheid is ook in de contracten zelf afgesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over stikstof

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about internal Finance Ministry calculations showing that a 39-kton ammonia reduction target for the national rural area programme exceeds what is needed, and about the number of farms affected, withheld or unpublished modelling, and whether the targets could change. The minister answered that the calculations are unvalidated internal advice not equal to government policy, promised to share them with RIVM and to inform parliament on final figures, but declined to publish the figures now.
These are internal calculations by the Ministry of Finance with an indicative character that have not yet been scientifically validated.
Het betreffen ambtelijke berekeningen van het Ministerie van Financiën met een indicatief karakter en die nog niet wetenschappelijk zijn gevalideerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over terugfluiten ECB-president in aanpak inflatie

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB is doing enough to fight eurozone inflation, whether governments should pressure it, and whether political interference with the ECB should be allowed. The minister answered that the ECB is independent, that the government will not comment on the ECB president or try to influence ECB policy, and that it only notes the ECB's tightening path.
The cabinet attaches great importance to the independence of the ECB.
Het kabinet hecht grote waarde aan de onafhankelijkheid van de ECB.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sylvana Simons over verslag van staatskasfraude in Suriname

An MP asks the government whether it accepts the findings of a report on alleged state-treasury fraud in Suriname, whether Suriname's economy has collapsed, and whether the Prime Minister should make a state visit given these allegations. The minister answers that prosecution of alleged fraud is for the Surinamese prosecutor, that IMF and Paris Club debt steps are underway, and that the visit is a working visit within good bilateral relations.
It is not for the Netherlands to establish the truth regarding a matter occurring in another sovereign country and to pass judgment on it here.
Het is niet aan Nederland om aan waarheidsvinding te doen ten aanzien van een zaak die in een ander, soeverein land speelt en hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Bromet over de analyse van het ministerie over de aanpak van de stikstofcrisis

MPs Maatoug and Bromet (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Finance about the ministry's analysis of the nitrogen crisis approach, including its methodology compared with Erisman and Strootman, the 39 kton ammonia reduction target, budgetary costs, farmers' debts and financial-sector risks.
