The government answered at length, stating the analysis is a tentative, non-binding working result shared with the RIVM, that an integral approach is preferred over nitrogen-only optimisation, and that forced write-offs of farmers' loans are legally and prudentially unacceptable.
The Cabinet will inform the House about the follow-up with the RIVM.
Over het vervolg met het RIVM zal het Kabinet uw Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het ECB-persbericht 'The Transmission Protection Instrument'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the ECB's new Transmission Protection Instrument, its conditions, and whether it weakens fiscal discipline and the ECB's independence. The minister answered at length, stressing ECB independence, the instrument's conditions, the continued role of OMT, and that fiscal discipline remains a national responsibility, while offering no concrete new national action beyond supporting SGP modernisation.
Let me start by stating that the ECB is independent in determining monetary policy in the euro area.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat de ECB onafhankelijk is in het bepalen van het monetaire beleid in de eurozone.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘De Kamer van Koophandel moet meer doen aan fraudebestrijding’

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether many companies registered at one address indicate illegal trust services, how the Chamber of Commerce and DNB detect such activity, and how data access and enforcement can be improved. The minister explained that domicile provision is regulated under the Wwft and supervised by BTWwft, that DNB acts mainly on signals with limited proactive enforcement, and that a registration obligation for domicile providers is being explored but is difficult to implement.
I will send the study, including my assessment, to your Chamber in the short term.
Ik zal het onderzoek inclusief mijn appreciatie op korte termijn aan uw Kamer sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over de belasting op leidingwater

An MP from DENK asked ministers whether the leidingwaterbelasting (tap water levy) is too favourable to large water users, since a capped levy gives them little incentive to save water, and whether raising it for large firms would help. The minister confirmed the levy's capped structure, acknowledged reduced incentives for large users, said a raise combined with a higher cap could promote saving, and promised to inform parliament in the autumn after an ongoing study.
A study is underway into measures and instruments to promote water saving by households and businesses.
Er loopt een onderzoek naar de maatregelen en instrumenten om waterbesparing door huishoudens en bedrijven te bevorderen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over berekeningen over stikstof van het Ministerie van Financiën, die een totaal ander beeld op de stikstofproblematiek werpen en over de bemiddelingspoging van dhr

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about unpublished Ministry of Finance nitrogen calculations showing smaller agricultural reductions needed if climate targets are met, and why these were not shared with parliament, plus the role of mediator Remkes and the basis of the NPLG targets. The government answered that the calculations are unvalidated, indicative internal advice, that they were shared with LNV and interdepartmentally and later published, and that targets will be adjusted as new projections (KEV 2022) come in.
The cabinet considers publishing unvalidated calculations that are still part of policy preparation not in the interest of good and democratic governance.
Het kabinet acht het openbaar maken van niet-gevalideerde berekeningen die nog onderdeel zijn van de beleidsvoorbereiding niet in het belang van goede en democratische bestuursvoering.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Alkaya over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Financiën naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informatiehuishouding

SP MPs Leijten and Alkaya asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister what measures the Finance Ministry took after the childcare benefits scandal on harsh outcomes of rules and on information management. The minister answered that inventories of harsh rules are underway across departments, that results will be sent later, and that chat-message retention guidance for ministers will be clarified.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het Kremlin aan de Zuidas

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether law firm Houthoff profited from work for sanctioned Russian state banks such as Sberbank, whether it should have done client due diligence, and whether prosecution, confiscation, and a legal framework for supervising lawyers are possible. The minister answered that the Amsterdam bar supervisor found no sanctions breach, declined to comment on the individual case, said prosecution depends on concrete signals, and said a legal framework for lawyer sanctions supervision is being prepared with an outline letter promised before the budget debates.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het bericht ‘Achterstanden Kamer van Koophandel frustreren financiële sector’.

An MP asks the Finance Minister about reports that backlogs at the Chamber of Commerce delay UBO-register entries, leaving financial institutions unable to onboard clients, and whether the 1 September 2022 transitional arrangement should be extended and the register redesigned. The minister answers that institutions can temporarily rely on proof of submission, that the backlog is expected to clear by 1 September, that extension would be announced at least a month ahead, and that the register's privacy impact will be evaluated while the EU proposals are being negotiated.
Should an extension of the aforementioned arrangement prove necessary, this will be announced at least one month before 1 September 2022.
Mocht eventuele verlenging van voornoemde regeling nodig zijn, dan zal dit minimaal een maand voor 1 september 2022 worden aangekondigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Goudzwaard over de ILO-uitspraak met betrekking tot de arbeidsvoorwaardelijke eisen voor KLM

An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister about an ILO Committee on Freedom of Association ruling finding the Dutch state wrongly failed to consult unions over labour conditions tied to the KLM rescue, and about whether a letter to KLM contradicted public statements on wage conditions. The minister replied that the state imposed no independent labour conditions, that the agreements stay binding until the aid is repaid, and that the ILO report has no legal effect, while largely declining to give details on the staff-reduction savings.
Information on the wage cost savings at KLM is commercially confidential and therefore, insofar as I have any such information, cannot be shared.
Informatie over de besparingen op de loonkosten van KLM is bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en kan daarom, in zoverre ik daar al over beschik, niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het omzeilen van regels door cryptobedrijven

An MP asked the Finance Minister about foreign crypto firms offering products to Dutch consumers without DNB registration, enforcement gaps, and whether crypto advertising should be restricted like gambling ads. The minister answered that registration is mandatory, DNB handles cases on signals, MiCA will address third-country providers and advertising at EU level, and a youth awareness campaign is planned.
If there is a suspicion that a crypto service provider does not comply with the registration obligation, DNB starts a case.
Indien het vermoeden bestaat dat een cryptodienstverlener niet aan de registratieplicht voldoet start DNB een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht dat de ECB Zuid-Europese lidstaten met hoge schulden gaat helpen

An MP from the VVD asks the Finance Minister whether the ECB's planned instrument to curb euro-area spread divergence fits its mandate under the TFEU, and whether an independent legal review will be commissioned. The minister replies that the instrument's design is not yet known, that the Court of Justice (Gauweiler, Weiss) sets the legal test, and that she sees no reason to commission her own legal analysis given the need for national restraint toward ECB policy.
It is the exclusive role of the Court to review ECB decisions against its treaty mandate.
Het is de exclusieve rol van het Hof om besluiten van de ECB aan haar verdragsrechtelijke mandaat te toetsen.
Antwoord op van het het lid Jasper van Dijk over het gebrekkige toezicht op Russische bedrijven

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Foreign and Finance Ministers about weak oversight of Russian-linked companies, illegal trust services and sanctions enforcement capacity, citing a newspaper article and a 31-50% estimate of unlicensed trust providers. Minister Hoekstra replied that the government is aware of the issues, announced six measures and a trust-sector study, explained that DNB enforces mainly on signals, and said capacity is being reallocated pending new staff.
The outcome of the study will be communicated to the House as soon as possible after the summer.
Over de uitkomst van het onderzoek wordt uw Kamer na de zomer zo snel mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Bromet over de beloning van topinkomens

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about top-income rules under the WNT: how many executives and supervisors fall under it, whether they exceed the cap, how enforcement works, and whether accountants' fees and supervisory pay are adequately controlled. The government answered that the WNT is broadly effective, that some overruns persist and are enforced through reclaim and penalties, and that a limited amendment to simplify the act is being prepared.
Following the evaluation, a limited amendment of the WNT is being prepared, and the House of Representatives will receive a letter on it shortly.
Naar aanleiding van de evaluatie wordt een beperkte wetswijziging van de WNT voorbereid, op korte termijn ontvangt de Tweede Kamer daarover een brief.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Azarkan, Dassen, Van der Plas en Eerdmans over de situatie op Schiphol

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol's management had lost control of operations, whether shareholders could face claims and dividend losses, and whether shareholders should call an extraordinary meeting, a letter of objection, or an Enterprise Chamber inquiry. The minister attributed the problems to staff shortages and rising demand, pointed to Schiphol's summer action plan and a passenger cap, said operational responsibility lies with the board, and declined to share the confidential AGM documents while rejecting an extraordinary meeting or formal written objection for now.
The minutes of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) are classified as commercially confidential and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eppink en Eerdmans over het gunnen van een groot offshore windproject aan Chinese staatsbedrijven

JA21 MPs Eppink and Eerdmans asked why TenneT awarded the BorWin6 offshore wind grid connection to a consortium including Chinese state-owned firms and what safeguards exist against Chinese control of critical energy infrastructure. The ministers answered that TenneT retains ownership and control of the grid, that the project is German and not directly linked to Dutch critical infrastructure, that the contract is binding under EU procurement rules, and that the government is working on the Energiewet to give TenneT more tools to exclude suppliers in future tenders.
Organising tenders and then awarding contracts to market parties is the responsibility of TenneT's executive board.
Het organiseren van aanbestedingen en vervolgens de gunning van contracten aan marktpartijen is de verantwoordelijkheid van de raad van bestuur van TenneT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het zelfsturend vermogen van banken in de klimaatcrisis

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether banks like ING, which still finance fossil fuel activity, are moving fast enough under the self-regulatory climate commitment, and whether stronger government steering or a climate duty is planned. The minister says the sector's voluntary commitment will be assessed through progress reports at year end and early next year, after which she and the climate minister will decide whether more binding action is appropriate, while declining to judge individual banks' policies.

Depending on the results of the progress reports and whether the targets are met, I will decide together with the Minister for Climate and Energy whether more normative intervention is appropriate and possible.

Afhankelijk van de resultaten van de voortgangsrapportages en het behalen van de doelstellingen, besluit ik samen met de Minister voor Klimaat en Energie of meer normerend optreden gepast en mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over 'het bericht KLM stelt vaccinatieplicht in voor nieuwe piloten en stewardessen'

An MP asks the ministers whether KLM may require vaccination of new pilots and cabin crew and whether such refusal-based rejection constitutes unlawful discrimination, and how the government will enforce against employers demanding vaccination status. The minister answers that vaccination is voluntary and employers may not require it, notes a Amsterdam court ruled KLM may not ask candidates about vaccination status, and states no specific legal basis exists but existing labour law protects workers, while declining to create new legislation.
In the Netherlands vaccination is and remains voluntary.
In Nederland is en blijft vaccinatie vrijwillig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over verre reizen naar pinautomaten

An MP asks the Finance Minister why the 5-km cash machine accessibility norm is not met in parts of the North, such as Oldambt, and whether the government will ensure enough ATMs in rural regions. The minister answers that the norm applies nationally, that Geldmaat sets placement policy and monitors rural gaps, and that DNB monitors compliance monthly under the Cash Convenant.
I consider it important that there is good access to cash and that Geldmaat, when placing its cash machines, maintains the five-kilometre norm and pursues a balanced distribution.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat er een goede toegang is tot contant geld en dat Geldmaat bij het plaatsen van haar geldautomaten de vijfkilometernorm aanhoudt en een evenwichtige spreiding nastreeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over een mogelijk antisemitisch Wob-verzoek van The Rights Forum

An MP asked whether a Wob information request by The Rights Forum about university ties with Israeli and Jewish institutions is antisemitic under the IHRA definition, whether the group has links to designated terrorist organisations, whether it remains a ministry interlocutor, and whether its ANBI tax status should be reviewed. The government rejected the antisemitism framing, said it has no evidence of terror links, said the group remains a legitimate dialogue partner, and explained in general terms ANBI criteria while citing tax secrecy and declining to comment on the individual organisation.
Under the tax authority's confidentiality obligation (Article 67 General Tax Act), it is however not possible to make statements about the handling of an individual organisation.

Ingevolge de geheimhoudingsplicht van de Belastingdienst (Artikel 67 Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen) is het echter niet mogelijk om mededelingen te doen over de behandeling van een individuele instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het artikel ' Fonds van 250 miljard moet eurozone versterken'

Dassen (Volt) asked the finance minister about a proposed 250 billion euro eurozone stabilisation fund inside the ESM, and whether reforms should be tied to access. Minister Kaag answered that the cabinet is sceptical of a central stabilisation function, citing doubts about need and risk, and that the fund would reduce ESM lending capacity and ease pressure on states to reduce debt, while noting reforms are generally valued but not a condition in the ESM discussion paper.
The cabinet is reluctant about proposals for a central stabilisation function for the eurozone, due to doubts about the need and concerns about the risks.
Het kabinet is terughoudend waar het gaat om voorstellen voor een centrale stabilisatiefunctie voor de eurozone, vanwege twijfels over de noodzaak, en zorgen om de risico's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bevriezen van tegoeden in Nederland van Russen op de sanctielijst

An MP asked the Finance Minister why far more Russian sanctioned assets are frozen in Belgium than in the Netherlands, how assets are categorised, who can freeze them, and what the government will do to speed up freezing. The minister replied that Dutch frozen assets total 640.8 million euro in the financial sector, that differences reflect specific circumstances in each state, that obliged entities must freeze and report, and that a broader reporting duty and a policy letter on strengthening the sanctions regime are being prepared.
Reports from Belgium indicate that this concerns 2.7 billion euro in frozen assets of persons or entities on sanctions lists.
Uit de berichtgeving uit België blijkt dat het om 2,7 miljard euro gaat aan bevroren tegoeden van personen of entiteiten op sanctielijsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de naleving van sancties tegen Russische oligarchen

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Finance Ministers about the enforcement of sanctions against Russian oligarchs, including a halted investigation, trust-sector oversight, reporting frequency and a sanctions coordinator. The minister declined to comment on individual investigations, pointed to existing and pending transparency and anti-money-laundering measures, and committed to further letters and the appointment of a coordinator's recommendations, without giving a timetable for a single contact point.
I cannot give a judgement on individual criminal investigations, as I do not have information about them.
Ik kan geen oordeel geven over individuele opsporingsonderzoeken, aangezien ik niet beschik over informatie daarover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marijnissen en Alkaya over ongelijkheid en herverdeling via het belastingstelsel

MPs Marijnissen and Alkaya asked the Finance Minister about inequality and redistribution through the tax system, citing a CPB study showing top incomes pay relatively low tax rates and questioning the shift from direct to indirect taxes. The government answered that the tax system does reduce inequality, that the top 1% face a lower burden due to capital income treatment, that it will consider measures before Prinsjesdag, and that it stands by its planned tax measures on capital income.
In the run-up to Budget Day the cabinet will look at how the balance between burdens on wealth and on labour can be brought more into balance.
Het kabinet zal in aanloop naar Prinsjesdag kijken naar de wijze waarop de verhouding tussen lasten op vermogen en arbeid meer in balans kan worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD schorst speciale eenheid ‘onaanvaardbaar lang'

Two VVD MPs asked the Finance ministry about the suspension of the FIOD's Team Specialistische Operaties and a court's finding that the suspension was unacceptably long. The state secretary answered that mediation is ongoing, the suspension was justified by serious circumstances, the FIOD does not intend to dissolve the team, and investigations were not hindered.
In its ruling, the court pointed to an unacceptably long suspension.
In zijn uitspraak heeft de rechter gewezen op een onaanvaardbare lange schorsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over het voornemen van de NS om de boa-bevoegdheid weg te halen bij hoofdconducteurs

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the government about NS's plan to remove the boa (special investigating officer) powers from its 2,800 head conductors, including the role of cost savings, staff shortages, safety impacts and consultation with staff. The state secretary answered that NS is responsible for safety and the decision, that the change saves about 5.7 million euro a year with little boa use, that safety is preserved through Veiligheid & Service staff, and that NS is exploring keeping boa powers for willing conductors.
NS is responsible for the safety of its passengers and staff. It is up to NS to decide on the necessary safety measures, such as the deployment of boas, in consultation with the works council.

NS is verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid van haar reizigers en personeel. Het is aan NS om over de benodigde veiligheidsmaatregelen, zoals de inzet van boa's, te besluiten in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Recordboete voor Belastingdienst vanwege zwarte lijst’

An MP asks whether the record fine imposed by the Data Protection Authority on the Tax Authority over the blacklist can be earmarked to strengthen taxpayers' legal protection, and how the fine flows through the budget. The State Secretary confirms the fine is paid from the Tax Authority budget, reaches the Justice budget via the CJIB, and that the cabinet may propose uses for these funds, but declines to commit to earmarking them for taxpayer legal aid.
I am therefore, ahead of final decision-making, exploring what possible situations a compensation would be appropriate in and what that compensation could be.
Ik ben daarom, vooruitlopend op definitieve besluitvorming, aan het verkennen wat mogelijke opties van situaties zijn waarin een tegemoetkoming passend is en wat dit voor tegemoetkoming kan zijn.
Antwoord op op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportsteun uit Nederlands Belastinggeld voor een omstreden project op de Filipijnen (deel 2)

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers about Dutch export credit insurance (ekv) for the contested New Manila International Airport project, covering biodiversity, flood and subsidence risks, the Boskalis dredging role, the absence of independent review and the lack of an environmental impact assessment. The state secretary answered most questions by defending the ekv due diligence, stating that the project's ESIA was adequate and that mangrove loss and forced resettlement are considered acceptable if mitigated, while committing to no new action.
I am of the view that the CSR assessment and testing against the CSR standards for the ekv was carried out carefully.
Ik ben van mening dat de IMVO-beoordeling en toetsing aan de IMVO-standaarden voor de ekv zorgvuldig heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over dreigende olietekorten en compensatie voor visserij

An MP asks the ministers whether a diesel and oil shortage linked to Russian oil sanctions threatens sectors such as fishing, and whether compensation for fishers should be paid and the pulse-fishing ban reconsidered. The government answers that it has released diesel from strategic stocks, will not compensate businesses for high energy prices, and sees no reason to revisit the decision.
The cabinet's position is that compensation of businesses for high energy and fuel prices resulting from the war in Ukraine is not on the table.
Het kabinetsstandpunt is dat compensatie van bedrijven vanwege hoge energie- en brandstofprijzen als gevolg van de oorlog in Oekraïne niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat de Nederlandse Staat diverse deals met vertrouwelingen van Poetin verzekerde

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether state-backed export insurance by Atradius covered deals with associates of Putin on US sanctions lists, and whether this undermined sanctions and why those persons were not on the EU list. The government answered that due diligence found no unacceptable risks, refused to share risk analyses or details of individual cases for commercial confidentiality, and said it follows EU, UN and Dutch sanctions rather than US ones.
Given commercial confidentiality, I cannot provide your House with more information on individual cases than is already known.
Gezien de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid, kan ik uw Kamer niet meer informatie geven over individuele zaken dan reeds bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel ‘Duidelijke koers staatsbanken gewenst’

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Finance Minister about the government's strategy for privatising state stakes in ABN AMRO and the Volksbank, and whether the EU required privatisation. Minister Kaag answered that the ABN AMRO stake will be sold again (NLFI advising on timing, with limited public detail due to share-price sensitivity), that the Volksbank is not yet ready for privatisation, and that the Netherlands committed to returning both banks to the market when conditions allow.
Partly because of share-price sensitivity, I am limited in what I can say about this publicly.
Mede vanwege de koersgevoeligheid ben ik beperkt in wat ik hier in het openbaar over kan zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over “het gebrek aan handhaving op bedrijven buiten de EU die ook in Nederland diensten met cryptomunten aanbieden”

An SP MP asks the Finance Minister why DNB does not enforce against foreign crypto service providers serving the Dutch market without registration, despite many signals and complaints from Dutch firms. The minister answers that DNB has received signals on 36 possible unregistered providers, started cases against 18, and taken formal enforcement in only two, and defends the process as time-consuming while declining to name the parties under enforcement.
Due to the confidentiality of supervision, DNB cannot share details about which parties are currently subject to enforcement or which enforcement measures are being applied.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid van het toezicht kan DNB geen details delen tegen welke partijen op dit moment handhaving loopt of welke handhavingsmaatregelen daarbij precies ingezet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht 'Volgend jaar mogelijk 30 procent minder metro’s, bussen en trams'

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether a possible 20-30% cut in public transport service for 2023 is acceptable and what the government will do about it, including whether the availability compensation (BVOV) will continue into 2023. The State Secretary answered that the BVOV is extended to end-2022, that the KiM forecasts 97% ridership recovery for 2023 with an update due in June, and that regional timetables are the responsibility of provinces and transport regions, while the government will keep monitoring and consulting the sector.
Responsibility for drawing up regional timetables lies with the provinces and transport regions.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het opstellen van regionale dienstregelingen ligt bij de provincies en vervoerregio's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Weyenberg over problemen bij het inschrijven van vluchtelingen uit Oekraïne in Nederland

MPs Podt and Van Weyenberg asked about problems registering Ukrainian refugees in the Netherlands, including slow municipal registration, identity documents, financial access, and bank accounts. The government answered that it is working with municipalities, banks and the Ukrainian embassy, describes temporary flexibilities and a planned Hryvnia exchange scheme, but gives little detail on definitive fixes.
It is good that we also gain insight into this group.
Het is goed dat we ook zicht krijgen op deze groep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Van Weyenberg over het faillissement van RCCS, waardoor coffeeshophouders problemen ervaren om hun kasgelden te verwerken en hun reguliere bedrijfsvoering daardoor niet kunnen v

MPs Sneller and Van Weyenberg asked about the RCCS cash-transport bankruptcy and banks' de-risking of coffeeshops, which struggle to deposit and withdraw cash. The Minister of Finance answered that banks must apply risk-based customer due diligence under the Wwft, that a Convenant Contant Geld and case law set limits on refusing cash access, and that the sector is being consulted, while declining to change the Wwft guidance and giving only partial information on the RCCS takeover.
I encourage banks and coffeeshop operators to make mutual agreements on their cash needs and expect banks to take the court's considerations into account when making agreements.

Ik stimuleer dat banken en coffeeshophouders onderling afspraken maken over de contantgeldbehoeft en ga ervanuit dat banken bij het maken van afspraken rekening houden met de overwegingen van de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gebrekkige uitvoering van sancties

An SP MP asked why Dutch authorities have not seized real estate of Russians on the sanctions list and how the sanctions enforcement is organised. The government answers that sanctioned property is frozen rather than seized, that the Kadaster found no matches, and that a data team, a national sanctions coordinator and additional capacity are being set up.
Voor inbeslagname is een strafvorderlijke titel nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Minhas, Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht "Sanctie-experts: Nederland niet doeltreffend met opsporen Russisch vastgoed"

VVD MPs asked the government why sanctions enforcement on Russian-linked real estate in the Netherlands was unclear, whether other countries were more effective, and when concrete results would be reported. The minister answered that roles are divided among ministries, the Kadaster checks found no sanctioned persons as registered owners so far, and the government will continue reporting on progress.
From time to time the cabinet will continue to do this.
Op gezette tijden zal het kabinet dit blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Van der Lee en Omtzigt over de stroperige implementatie van sancties in Nederland

MPs Klaver, Van der Lee and Omtzigt asked why sanctions implementation in the Netherlands is slow and fragmented, covering ministerial responsibility, the tax secrecy exemption, APA/ATR rulings linked to sanctioned persons, frozen assets held by trust offices, and supervision gaps for non-financial assets. The government answered that sanctions coordination and enforcement are split across ministries and the OM, that the Belastingdienst obtained an exemption from tax secrecy and is reviewing rulings, and that a national coordinator's report with recommendations will follow in May.
The national coordinator is preparing a report with recommendations, to be submitted in mid-May and shared with your House.
De nationaal coördinator is bezig met een rapport met aanbevelingen dat medio mei zal worden aangeboden en met uw Kamer zal worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de bonus van 3,3 miljoen euro voor Air France-KLM topman Ben Smith

An SP MP asked the Finance and Infrastructure ministers about the EUR 3.3 million bonus paid to Air France-KLM CEO Ben Smith despite state support, and what the government had done to prevent it. The ministers said the bonus is unacceptable, that they lobbied the company and the European Commission, but that the final decision lies with shareholders where the Netherlands holds 9.3% and is unlikely to block it.
Ultimately, the final decision on awarding the bonus rests with the general meeting of shareholders.
Uiteindelijk ligt het definitieve besluit over het toekennen van de bonus bij de algemene vergadering van aandeelhouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht topman Air France-KLM pakt 3 miljoen aan bonus

Heinen (VVD) asks the Finance and Economic Affairs ministers about a reported 3 million euro bonus for the Air France-KLM chief executive despite state aid and staff wage concessions, and what the government did after its earlier motion to tighten the EU temporary state aid framework on bonuses. The ministers say they pressed the European Commission to tighten bonus rules, which the Commission did not change, and that they will keep opposing the bonus at the shareholder meeting while the state holds 9.3% of shares.
I, the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate, have argued that in addition to paying out bonuses, it should also not be possible to promise bonuses as long as the state aid has not been repaid.

Ik, de Minister van Economische Zaken en Klimaat, heb ervoor gepleit dat naast het uitbetalen van bonussen het ook niet mogelijk moet zijn om bonussen toe te zeggen zolang de staatssteun niet is terugbetaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht dat 45 miljard euro Russisch vermogen van personen en organisaties op sanctielijsten in Nederland staat

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the government about a report that EUR 45 billion of Russian assets held by sanctioned persons and entities sits in the Netherlands, and why freezes have been limited, how other countries compare, what has been done to clarify sanctions implementation, and how evasion is prosecuted. Minister Hoekstra rejected the EUR 45 billion estimate as overstated because ownership runs through layered foreign structures, stated that over half a billion euro has been frozen and that prosecutors and the FIOD act on evasion, and described outreach to businesses and a new steering group, while noting that some implementation questions remain.
Twenty yachts under construction are also under enhanced Customs supervision.
Ook staan er twintig jachten in aanbouw onder verscherpt toezicht van de Douane.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the public agendas of cabinet members and how the motion on publishing them is being implemented. The Finance ministers answered that they will follow the agreed guidelines, have updated their agendas, and can answer individually for them.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of cabinet members was discussed several times in the Voorlichtingsraad.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tony van Dijck over het bericht dat banken contant geld van bedrijven weren

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether banks are restricting cash transactions of businesses to curb money-laundering risks, and what should be done to keep cash a legal tender. The minister confirmed signals of banks asking clients to reduce cash use, promised clarifications to the anti-money-laundering guidance and an independent study on safeguarding the public interest in cash.
I agree with the position that cash is a legal tender and remains so.
Ik ben het eens met de stelling dat contant geld een wettig betaalmiddel is en blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht 'Banken weren contant geld, bedrijven radeloos'

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that banks are restricting cash for small businesses, whether digital payment is being forced, the legal basis for cash limits, and the state of cash deposit networks. The minister answered that no law requires cash restrictions, banks may apply proportionate AML measures under the Cash Convenant, and she will raise the concerns with banks.
I will emphasise in the Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer that I expect banks to apply proportionality when implementing mitigating measures under the Wwft.

Ik zal in het Maatschappelijk Overleg Betalingsverkeer benadrukken dat ik van banken verwacht dat zij proportionaliteit toepassen bij het implementeren van mitigerende maatregelen in het kader van de Wwft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de berichten 'Banken weren contant geld, bedrijven radeloos' en 'Hoe een metaalhandelaar tot wanhoop wordt gedreven door de bank'

CDA MP Inge van Dijk asks the Finance Minister about reports that banks are restricting cash use by businesses, forcing them to cut cash transactions quickly and facing high costs, and about the tension with DNB supervision. The Minister acknowledges the tension, says mitigating measures must be client-specific and proportionate, points to the Convenant Contant Geld with DNB, and commits to no new concrete step beyond advising clients to talk to their bank.
I do not have a complete overview of the banks that take mitigating measures regarding cash.
Ik beschik niet over een volledig overzicht van de banken die mitigerende maatregelen nemen op het gebied van contant geld
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het toezicht op de naleving van de sancties tegen Rusland op de Zuidas

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether a 2019 Houthoff case breached Russia sanctions, who supervises sanctions compliance across four bodies, whether capacity is sufficient, and why only 14 administrative fines but no criminal action since 2015. The minister answered that law firms lack supervision and a statutory regulation is being prepared, that prosecution is for the OM, that additional capacity is being assessed, and that a national sanctions coordinator was appointed.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that criminal action was taken against violations of sectoral sanctions measures concerning the sanctioned flow of goods.
Het OM heeft aangegeven dat strafrechtelijk is opgetreden tegen overtreding van sectorale sanctiemaatregelen aangaande de gesanctioneerde goederenstroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over de problematiek rondom het Sprintplan van Aegon

An MP asked the Finance Minister about AEGON's Sprintplan investment-lease product and reports that AEGON offered victims a 750 euro settlement to waive all claims. The minister explained the product, said the settlement was agreed with Consumentenclaim and was for the affected participants to judge, and noted that affected participants can still go to court, to Kifid, or negotiate with AEGON.
I do not have an overview of cases in which the consumer's claim was wholly or partly granted and for what amount.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van zaken waarin de vordering van de consument geheel of gedeeltelijk is toegekend en voor welk bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda’s

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the handling of the motion on public agendas of ministers and whether the 2022 guidance and the Open State findings on non-compliance would be acted upon. The Minister of Defence answered that the guidance has been adopted, that agendas will be retroactively updated and kept compliant, and that each minister can answer individually.
We will update the public agendas with retroactive effect.
Wij zullen de openbare agenda’s met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de dag van het Natuurlijk Kapitaal

Two Party for the Animals MPs asked the government about the Dutch Natural Capital Day, Dutch ecological footprint overshoot and how to reduce it. The minister answered that the footprint is too high, that the Netherlands cannot be self-sufficient but is working on transitions, and promised further information in later letters.
It goes too far to list all the cabinet's measures here.
Het voert te ver om hier alle maatregelen van het kabinet op te sommen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het feit dat de Nederlandse Ontwikkelingsbank FMO voor €230 miljoen leningen heeft uitstaan in Oekraïne en buurland Wit-Rusland

An MP asked the ministers about FMO's EUR 230 million in loans in Ukraine and Belarus, the specific activities funded, the financial risks, and the implications for the Dutch state as shareholder. The ministers answered that FMO is monitoring risks, has written down part of its loans, is considering payment suspensions with clients, and that FMO's capital position remains strong, though the full impact is too early to assess.
The Minister of Finance and I will of course keep a close eye on the situation and remain in close contact with FMO about it.
De Minister van Financiën en ik zullen de situatie uiteraard goed in de gaten houden en hierover in nauw contact blijven met FMO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de uitspraak van de Hoge Raad over beleggingsverzekeringen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Finance about a Supreme Court ruling on information duties for investment insurance policies (woekerpolissen), compensation adequacy, collective claims, insurers' activation duties, financial stability risks, implications for other financial products, and when sector rules will be revised. The minister answered that the case is still before the Court of Appeal, declined to judge the adequacy of compensation or what insurers should do, pointed to existing activation duties and ongoing review of cost transparency, and saw no direct financial-stability risk.
It is now up to the Court of Appeal in The Hague, the trial court, to assess whether such additional information duties exist and, if so, what they are.
Het is nu aan het Gerechtshof Den Haag, de feitenrechter, om te beoordelen of dergelijke aanvullende informatieverplichtingen bestaan, en zo ja, welke dat dan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over de uitzending 'Verenigingen bezwijken onder strenge regels’

MP Inge van Dijk (CDA) asks the Finance Minister about regulatory burden on voluntary associations after a broadcast on their struggles with strict rules, and asks for an overview of relevant laws and dialogue with volunteer organisations. The minister acknowledges the value of associations, lists recent rules (UBO register, VAT for mind sports, GDPR, WBTR) and commits to discuss the impact with the Chamber and volunteer organisations while noting that responsibility is spread across several departments.
The cabinet is willing to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication and completeness of their public agendas under the motion on ministerial agendas. Minister Schreinemacher answered that she accepts the motion and the 2022 guidance notes, will update her agenda retroactively to her appointment, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether the requirements were being met and whether agendas would be corrected retroactively. Minister Hoekstra answered that he accepts the guidance, acknowledges his agenda is not yet fully compliant, and will update it retroactively to his appointment.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht "Tuchtraad zet morrend punt achter schending bankierseed"

An MP asked the Finance Minister about a report that the banking disciplinary board could not fully judge a breach of the banker's oath because of limited insight into conduct, and about strengthening that regime. The minister said banks should cooperate with investigations, that the sector itself should shape the disciplinary and code framework under DNB supervision, that suitability vetting is confidential, and that the anti-money-laundering bill will be submitted soon.
Because of supervisory confidentiality, the competent supervisor (DNB, AFM or ECB) may not disclose anything about suitability and reliability assessments of policymakers in the financial sector.

In verband met de toezichtsvertrouwelijkheid kan en mag de bevoegde toezichthouder (DNB, de AFM of de ECB) geen mededelingen doen over toetsingen op geschiktheid en betrouwbaarheid van beleidsbepalers in de financiële sector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Tuchtraad Banken het onderzoek naar de voormalig topman van ING noodgedwongen heeft moeten stopzetten

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the Finance Minister whether the Banking Disciplinary Board's halted investigation into former ING chief Ralph Hamers, caused by bank non-cooperation, shows the banking disciplinary system is failing and should be anchored in law with enforcement powers. The minister said the system works through sector self-regulation under DNB supervision, that banks are obliged to cooperate, and that she will stress active cooperation with the sector without proposing legislative changes.
It is primarily up to the supervisor to judge compliance with the norms of the Wft
Het is primair aan de toezichthouder om een oordeel te vellen over de naleving van de normen uit de Wft
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over "hun openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including whether agendas are complete and whether they will be retroactively corrected. Ministers Van Gennip and Schouten answered that the Voorlichtingsraad handbook now serves as the instruction, that agendas are published a week ahead with corrections for the past week, and that they will answer jointly rather than individually.
That is why it was chosen to publish one week ahead and to correct the past week so that the picture afterwards is correct.
Daarom is ervoor gekozen een week vooruit te publiceren en de afgelopen week te corrigeren zodat het beeld achteraf correct is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de aangenomen motie om binnen 48 uur de fiscale gegevens van de personen op de sanctielijst te beschikking te stellen aan de autoriteiten die de sancties moeten opleggen

MP Omtzigt asked the government about the adopted motion requiring tax data, including APA and ATR rulings, of persons on the sanctions list to be shared within 48 hours with sanctions enforcement authorities, and about the Tax Authority's data sharing, asset freezing and contacts with listed persons. The State Secretary answered that a tax secrecy exemption was granted and a legal basis is being pursued, that the ruling inventory of 3,400 requests is ongoing, and that contacts with listed persons are not tracked.
No overview is kept of contacts that ministers and officials have with persons on sanctions lists.
Er wordt geen overzicht bijgehouden van contacten die bewindspersonen en ambtenaren hebben met personen die op sanctielijsten staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Kaag wil extra sancties trustkantoren, grote gevolgen voor Zuidas'

MPs Klaver and Van der Lee asked the Finance Minister about Russian assets held through Dutch letterbox companies, the effectiveness of sanctions and enforcement, possible bans on trust services, asset confiscation, a global asset registry, anti-abuse and transparency measures, and treaty safe harbours. The minister answered that the government will consider further sanctions including a ban on trust services to Russian and Belarusian clients, that a working group and a trust-sector study are underway, and that EU-level measures and registers are being pursued, while deferring several questions to the State Secretary and other departments.
As Minister of Finance, I do not have data on Russian assets held in Dutch letterbox companies.
Als Minister van Financiën beschik ik niet over data betreffende Russisch vermogen in Nederlandse brievenbusfirma’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Geurts over het bericht 'Hallo, wij hebben 125 mille studieschuld, hoeveel hypotheek krijgen we?'

Two CDA MPs asked whether student debt under the loan system, which reduces mortgage capacity, is fair, whether students were aware it counts, and whether municipalities could guarantee student loans. The minister acknowledged students were not always aware, defended including student debt under the consumer-protection rules, said guarantees add little, and saw no clear state role.
I find it important that the student debt is still taken into account.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de studieschuld wel wordt meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het bericht dat er geen uitstel komt voor UBO-registratie ondanks protesten van werkgevers

An MP asked the Finance Minister why answers on postponing the UBO register deadline came only a week before the deadline, whether many UBOs were still unregistered, whether registration problems and enforcement warranted a moratorium, and whether the questions could be answered before the deadline. The minister replied that the register has run since 2020 with an 18-month period, that about 36.75% of entities had registered by 24 March with a large backlog, that enforcement will be risk-based and no moratorium is planned, and that Parliament will be informed further after 27 March.
I hereby repeat the commitment to inform your House by letter after 27 March about the status of the UBO register.
Bij dezen herhaal ik de toezegging om na 27 maart uw Kamer per brief te informeren over de stand van zaken van het UBO-register
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on public ministerial agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required standards. The minister answered that EZK largely follows the guidance, will improve some points, will backdate its public agenda to the start of office, and that the answers are given jointly for all EZK ministers.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over onze openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked the ministers and state secretary of OCW and PO about how their public agendas are kept and whether they comply with the motion and the Rijksvoorlichtingsdienst guidance on public agendas. The government answers that agendas are kept systematically and categorised, acknowledges incomplete entries such as missing contact persons and topic descriptions, and commits to correcting agendas retroactively and to consistent future compliance.
We will update the public agenda retroactively in line with the previously mentioned improvement points.
Wij werken de openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bij volgens de eerder genoemde verbeterpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maatoug en Van der Lee over het CEP 2022

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the 200 euro energy allowance is enough, what minimum wage indexation alternatives would do to purchasing power, whether a one-off healthcare allowance increase is possible, and for answers before the debate. The government raised the municipal energy allowance reference amount to 800 euro, declined to deviate from the statutory minimum wage indexation method or submit the decision to parliament, and said a one-off care allowance increase is costly and slow to implement.
The cabinet proposes raising the reference amount of the energy allowance to 800 euro and has made 480 million euro extra available for this.
Het kabinet stelt voor om het richtbedrag van de energietoeslag te verhogen naar 800 euro en heeft hier 480 miljoen euro extra voor beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was raised, whether it will be implemented, and how compliance will be improved after a study found most agenda entries lack required information. Minister Helder answered that she will update her agenda retroactively, add contact details and descriptions, follow the agreed guidelines, and confirm she can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, including the low share of agenda entries meeting the required information standard. The Secretary of State answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details, descriptions and categorisation, that past entries will be updated retroactively, and that the individual ministerial responsibility principle applies.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about compliance with the motion and guidance on publishing their public agendas, citing a study finding most agenda entries lack required information. The Prime Minister answered that the government will improve agenda transparency, update his agenda retroactively, and that each minister can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Prime Minister of the current cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister-President van het huidige kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda van bewindspersonen

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether the RVD guidance is followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Kuipers says he will follow the motion, update his agenda retroactively, and that ministers answer individually, while acknowledging some agenda gaps were already being corrected.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister in the Rutte IV cabinet.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van kabinet-Rutte IV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Inge van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ik dacht dat beleggen voor vermogende mannen was

An MP asked the Finance Minister about research by ABN Amro and McKinsey showing women invest less, feel less supported by banks, and face more difficulty obtaining financing, and asked whether action and greater financial literacy were needed. The minister agreed the situation is undesirable, pointed to the Wijzer in geldzaken partnership and its toolkit, and said banks can improve their treatment of female clients, without committing to a concrete new step.
I find it very undesirable that women relatively experience more barriers in financial services and have fewer opportunities to obtain financing.
Ik vind het zeer ongewenst als vrouwen relatief meer barrières ervaren in de financiële dienstverlening en minder kansen krijgen bij het aantrekken van financiering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nijboer over het bericht dat Dexia nog altijd onder adequate schadevergoedingen voor de woekerpolisaffaire probeert uit te komen

An MP asked the Finance Minister about reports that Dexia, in winding down its Duisenberg-scheme leasing cases, uses bailiff summonses with short deadlines, obstructs legal representation, pressures claimants into low settlements and may be unfit to run a financial institution. The minister answered that Dexia has been asked to act properly and respect client interests, that toezicht on individual cases lies with DNB and AFM, and that the minister shared the signals with them but cannot instruct them.
I may not give instructions to the AFM and DNB in a specific case.
Ik mag de AFM en DNB geen instructies geven in een specifiek geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Rahimi over het UBO-register

MPs Heinen and Rahimi asked the Finance Minister about privacy and safety concerns for UBOs in the public beneficial ownership register, the pending CJEU case and Advocate General Pitruzella's opinion, and whether the registration deadline should be postponed. The minister acknowledged the concerns, defended the existing privacy safeguards, said the AG's points largely align with Dutch practice and that no postponement is warranted, while promising to follow the final CJEU ruling.
In view of the AG's conclusion, which largely aligns with the Dutch implementation, I see no reason to postpone the registration deadline.
Gelet op de conclusie van de A-G, welke in belangrijke mate in lijn ligt met de Nederlandse implementatie, zie ik geen aanleiding tot uitstel van de deadline tot registratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk en Palland over het bericht ‘Ondernemers: Stel UBO-register uit tot uitspraak Europese Hof’

MPs Inge van Dijk and Palland asked the Finance Minister whether the UBO register registration deadline should be postponed pending a CJEU ruling, and about privacy protection of beneficial owners. The minister answered that the Advocate-General's opinion is not binding, that Dutch practice already largely follows its points, that no grounds exist to postpone the deadline, and that the privacy impact will be evaluated after one and four years.
I therefore see no reason, or legal basis, to postpone the legally established registration deadline.
Daarmee zie ik dan ook geen reden, of grondslag, tot uitstellen van de wettelijk vastgelegde registratiedeadline.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Baarle over een verlaging van de benzineprijs, zoals in België

MP Van Baarle asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch petrol prices could be cut as in Belgium, through lower excise duty and VAT, and why the Netherlands must wait for the Spring Memorandum. The state secretary answered that the cabinet announced a temporary 21% cut in fuel excise from 1 April and a VAT cut on energy from 1 July, and estimated the revenue cost of an excise cut to reach the EU average at 315 to 505 million euros.
Last Friday, 11 March, the cabinet therefore announced its intention to temporarily reduce the excise duty on petrol and diesel by 21% from 1 April.
Afgelopen vrijdag 11 maart jl. heeft het kabinet daarom aangekondigd voornemens te zijn om per 1 april de accijns voor benzine en diesel tijdelijk te verlagen met 21%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het UBO-register

An MP asked the Finance Minister about the low UBO-register registration rate, the privacy risks for beneficial owners, and the pending CJEU case on public access. The minister answered that registration lags but the legal deadline stands, that enforcement will follow, and that the existing privacy safeguards are sufficient for now, pending the Court's judgment.
After the deadline of 27 March I intend to send your House a letter with the state of affairs after the statutory transition period.
Na de deadline van 27 maart ben ik voornemens uw Kamer een brief te sturen met de stand van zaken na de wettelijke overgangstermijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over oplossingen voor de stijgende brandstofprijzen

Member Stoffer (SGP) asked whether rising fuel prices burden households and firms, whether excise on fuel should be temporarily cut, whether VAT revenue from higher prices should be frozen, and whether the proposed higher untaxed travel allowance can be brought forward. The State Secretary answered that the government will cut fuel excise by 21% for nine months from 1 April, denied automatic extra VAT windfalls, refused to freeze VAT revenue citing budget rules, and said the travel allowance cannot be raised mid-year for technical reasons.
To cushion the effects, the cabinet announced last Friday, 11 March, that it intends, among other things, to temporarily lower the excise duty on petrol and diesel by 21% from 1 April.
Om de gevolgen te dempen heeft het kabinet afgelopen vrijdag 11 maart aangekondigd dat het onder andere voornemens is om per 1 april de accijns voor benzine en diesel tijdelijk te verlagen met 21%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of ministers was raised and implemented, whether the notes on public agendas are followed, and how compliance will be improved. Minister De Jonge replied that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with adjusted agenda practices, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that all ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister for Housing and Spatial Planning.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister voor Volkshuisvesting en Ruimtelijke Ordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet de openbare agenda van de bewindspersonen van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about implementing the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas, and the notice on compliance with the Open State finding that only 14% of agenda entries met the guideline. The ministers answer that they endorse the seven agreements, have updated their agendas retroactively, and that each minister answers individually.
Yes. Our public agendas are now fully updated.
Ja. Onze openbare agenda's zijn nu volledig bijgewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on publishing ministers' public agendas was implemented, whether it is being followed, and whether ministers answer individually. Minister Bruins Slot replied that the agendas will be improved via a guidance note, that his own agenda will be updated retroactively, and that ministers can answer individually.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers about the publication of their public agendas, including compliance with the motion and the 2022 guidance note. The state secretary answered that the agenda will be improved with contact details and descriptions, that her agenda will be brought up to date retroactively, and that individual ministerial responsibility allows each minister to answer.
I will update my public agenda retroactively to the moment of my appointment as State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik zal mijn openbare agenda met terugwerkende kracht bijwerken tot aan het moment van mijn aantreden als Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public ministerial agendas was implemented, whether they will comply with the 2022 agreements, and whether their agendas meet the rules. The minister replied that the motion is being implemented through a 2022 notice, that her agenda has already been updated and complies, and that all ministers can answer individually.
Yes. In the run-up to the Rutte IV cabinet taking office, the public agenda of ministers was repeatedly discussed in the Information Council.
Ja. In aanloop naar het aantreden van het kabinet-Rutte IV is de openbare agenda van de bewindslieden meermaals onderwerp van gesprek geweest in de Voorlichtingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller en Bromet over de openbare agenda

MPs Sneller and Bromet asked all ministers how the motion on public agendas of office-holders was handled, whether it will be implemented, and whether agendas comply with the guidelines. Minister Staghouwer answered that the motion is being implemented through a VoRa note with improvements such as contact details and categorisation, that his own agenda is already updated and compliant, and that he will continue to comply.
I already keep my agenda as far as possible in line with the agreements in the note 'Public agenda office-holders' and will continue to do so for the rest of this cabinet period.
Ik houd mijn agenda op dit moment al zoveel mogelijk bij conform de afspraken uit de notitie «Openbare agenda bewindslieden» en zal dit ook voor de rest van deze kabinetsperiode blijven doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het meedoen van het Ministerie van Financiën aan de Nationale Week Zonder Vlees & Zuivel en het invoeren van het principe «Carnivoor? Geef het door!»

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Finance Minister about the ministry's participation in a national week without meat and dairy, and about adopting a 'plant-based by default' catering principle. The minister replied that the catering at the ministry's offices promotes plant-based options during that week, and that the ministry follows the government-wide circular catering vision with protein transition in new tenders.
Regarding this question I refer to the answer from the Ministry of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality dated 7 March 2022.
Met betrekking tot deze vraag verwijs ik graag naar het antwoord van het Ministerie van LNV d.d. 7 maart 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Idsinga over het bericht 'FIOD-speurders thuis na vergoedingenruzie'

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Idsinga asked about reports that the FIOD suspended its Team Specialistische Operaties over an allowance dispute, and about the team's role, the cause, and the atmosphere within the FIOD. The Secretary of State declined to give details, citing an ongoing labour and court dispute and the employer's duty of care, while saying investigations continue with partner agencies and that the directorate seeks a swift resolution.
No statement is made on the specific content. The matter is before the court.
Over de specifieke inhoud wordt geen mededeling gedaan. De zaak is onder de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de dreigende teloorgang van de autonome positie van KLM binnen Air France-KLM

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether KLM will keep its autonomous position within Air France-KLM, whether it will lose its Dutch base and head office, and about planned state funding flows to KLM. The minister answered that KLM operates autonomously within the holding, that the public interest is protected by shareholder rights and state guarantees whose notice period was extended to five years, and that closing the Amstelveen head office is not on the table.
The cabinet is of the view that the public interest is best safeguarded by KLM remaining part of the AFKL holding.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het publieke belang het beste geborgd blijft door KLM onderdeel te laten blijven van de holding AFKL.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het gewenste nieuwe bedrijfsmodel van KLM

An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister whether she supports a new KLM business model that would drop long-haul routes and reduce Schiphol's hub role, and whether she would inform parliament about such plans. The minister replied that business model choices lie with KLM itself, that she had proposed no new model, and therefore could share no plans or scenarios.
The design of the business model and strategy is up to KLM itself.
De vormgeving van het bedrijfsmodel en de strategie is aan KLM zelf
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Maeijer over de berichten dat Nederland miljarden minder ontvangt en meer mag betalen aan de EU

MPs Tony van Dijck and Maeijer asked whether Dutch receipts from the EU recovery fund (RRF) will fall and whether the Dutch EU contribution will rise through the Social Climate Fund and MFF revision, and whether the government will oppose higher contributions. The ministers answered that the RRF allocation will be finalised by the Commission by 30 June and the Dutch plan will then be fixed, provided tables of allocations and disbursements, and that the government is cautious about higher contributions but will assess the total package and aims for prudent EU budget development.
The cabinet is pursuing a prudent development of the EU budget, with more attention to policy areas that are a priority for the Netherlands.
Het kabinet zet in op een prudente ontwikkeling van de EU-begroting, met meer aandacht voor beleidsterreinen die voor Nederland prioritair zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heinen over het toezicht op uitgaven uit het Europees herstelfonds

An MP asked the Finance Minister how the EU Recovery Fund plans were checked for fraud risk, including Italy's fraud-prone superbonus, and whether the Commission's refusal to release documents is acceptable. The minister answered that member states and the Commission carry fraud-control duties, that no Ecofin discussions arose over fraud risks, and that transparency of EU documents should be modernised, but the answers largely restate existing frameworks and leave several questions unanswered.
The cabinet considers it very important that transparency of governance, including access to documents, is further increased at EU level.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat ook in EU-verband de transparantie van bestuur onder meer d.m.v. toegang tot documenten verder wordt vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Maatoug over het EU herstelfonds

MPs Dassen and Maatoug asked the Finance Minister why the Dutch EU recovery fund (RRF) spending selection was prepared behind closed doors without parliament and local governments, and about the timeline, consultation and Commission contacts. The minister answered that spending choices were set in the coalition agreement, that consultation has occurred and will continue via two draft plans shared with parliament, and that some correspondence will be released later via a pending FOI request.
In the process leading to submission of the final plan, the House, sub-national governments and other stakeholders will be involved.
In het proces dat leidt tot indiening van het definitieve plan zullen de Kamer, medeoverheden, en andere belanghebbenden meegenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de  antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het geweld in Chora in juni 2007

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about earlier answers on the 2007 fighting in Chora, Uruzgan, including artillery accuracy, civilian casualties, self-defence claims and the Dutch role. The Minister of Defence defended the troops' conduct, gave partial answers, withheld details citing ongoing legal proceedings and referred several questions to earlier answers or to NATO, Australia and other bodies.
On details that are still under discussion or assessment by the court in the legal case, no statements are made in the interest of the legal proceedings.
Over details die in de rechtszaak nog onderwerp zijn van discussie of van beoordeling door de rechter, worden in het belang van de rechtsgang geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en van der Lee over het bericht ‘Wij waren hun enige hoop’ van de Groene Amsterdammer

MPs Piri and Van der Lee asked about a Groene Amsterdammer report on the end of Dutch funding to the White Helmets via Mayday Rescue, including the IOB review, the Grant Thornton audit and the withheld final payment. The ministers answered that the contract simply expired in November 2018 due to changed security conditions, defended the IOB process and the withholding of EUR 57,435, and said resumption of stabilisation support is not appropriate, while noting humanitarian funding via Grand Challenges Canada.
There was no decision to stop Dutch support to the foundation Mayday Rescue: the contract for the activity expired on 30 November 2018.
Er is geen sprake geweest van een besluit tot stopzetting van de Nederlandse steun aan de stichting Mayday Rescue: het contract van de betreffende activiteit liep af per 30 november 2018.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Fritsma en Markuszower over ‘een jaar stilte rond de inspectie van een koopvaardijschip door marineschip de Zr. Ms. De Ruyter’

PVV MPs asked why, a year after a Dutch navy ship inspected a merchant vessel for possible sanctions violations, the government still withholds the ship's name, flag and inspection location, and how long the prosecution will take. The Minister of Justice declined to give details of the individual criminal investigation, then said the case was closed without any sanctions violation found and that neither the EU nor the UN was involved.
As is known, I do not provide information of this kind from individual criminal investigations.
Over dergelijke informatie uit individuele strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik zoals bekend geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat een Nederlander in Angola onder verdachte omstandigheden is overleden

Segers (CU) asked the Foreign Minister how the government will respond to reports that a Dutch national died under suspicious circumstances in Angola, and whether it will press Angolan authorities for an autopsy, repatriation, and cooperation with a criminal complaint. Minister Knapen confirmed the death, said the embassy requested repatriation but Angola refused, noted the body was buried locally, and said a relative had filed a complaint in Angola while the ministry can only advise and mediate.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot file a complaint abroad on behalf of a citizen.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan niet namens een burger aangifte in het buitenland doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heinen en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘Wordt Evergrande China’s Lehman Brothers’

MPs Heinen and Brekelmans asked the Finance and Foreign Affairs ministers about the risks of the Evergrande debt problems for Chinese and global financial markets, Dutch institutions and Dutch crisis scenarios, and about contact with China. Minister Hoekstra answered that risks are mainly contained in China with limited direct Dutch exposure, outlined DNB and CPB scenario analyses, and said there was no reason yet to contact China beyond FSB discussions.
My ministry has no insight into individual (foreign) exposures of Dutch institutions.
Mijn ministerie heeft geen inzicht in individuele (buitenlandse) blootstellingen van Nederlandse instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder en Van der Staaij over een luchtbrug voor vluchtelingen uit kwetsbare groepen uit Afghanistan

MPs Ceder and Van der Staaij asked whether the government would help vulnerable Afghan refugees (women in public roles, Afghan contractors, Christians) leave Kabul via a proposed airlift and admit some into the Dutch asylum procedure, and whether Christians' religion recorded in identity documents exposes them to greater risk. The minister replied that the Dutch evacuation ended on 26 August, that the government continues efforts to bring eligible people out and cooperates with regional countries and allies, and that it cannot yet assess the extra danger to Christians.
The cabinet will continue to actively make efforts to bring people who qualify out of Afghanistan or via neighbouring countries to the Netherlands in the coming period.
Het kabinet blijft zich actief inspannen om ook de komende periode mensen die daarvoor in aanmerking komen uit Afghanistan of via de buurlanden naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet, Van der Lee en Ellemeet over de voortgang van evacuaties uit Afghanistan

MPs Bromet, Van der Lee and Ellemeet asked the government how people covered by the Belhaj motion can still contact the Dutch state after the evacuation mailbox closed, what further evacuation efforts are planned, and how the Taliban treat those groups. The government answered that it continues limited evacuations, a special scheme for two groups is planned, about 20,000 unique emails were received, and it cannot yet confirm the Taliban's conduct clearly.
It is difficult to obtain a clear picture of the situation in Afghanistan and the conduct of the Taliban.
Het is moeilijk een eenduidig beeld te krijgen van de situatie in Afghanistan en het handelen van de Taliban.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Eppink over de rechterlijke uitspraken van Azerbeidzjaanse rechters en openbaar aanklagers inzake Azerbeidzjaanse oppositie, en Armeense krijgsgevangenen en burgers

Deputy Eppink (JA21) asked the Foreign Minister about Azerbaijani courts and prosecutors sentencing Armenian prisoners of war and civilians and political opponents, and about detention conditions and NGO blacklists. Minister Knapen answered that the independence of Azerbaijani justice is doubted, that the EU urges release of detainees, and that a sanctions proposal would not find EU support, without committing to new measures.
In general, question marks are placed over the independence of the judicial process in Azerbaijan.
Over het algemeen worden vraagtekens gezet bij de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtsgang in Azerbeidzjan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Heinen over het bericht dat Belarus bijna USD1 miljard krijgt toegekend van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds (IMF), in de vorm van speciale trekkingsrechten

MPs Brekelmans and Heinen (VVD) asked why Belarus would receive nearly USD 1 billion in IMF special drawing rights when countries like Venezuela and Myanmar do not, and whether the government would oppose or block this allocation given sanctions. The government answered that the SDR allocation was generic, proportional to quota, and followed IMF procedures recognizing the Belarusian executive, so Belarus is eligible; it said it cannot revoke the allocation for one country and would instead work with partners to limit Belarus's ability to convert SDRs into hard currency, though it made no firm commitment to block conversion.

In contacts with the EU, the US and other international partners, the Netherlands is working to limit as much as possible Belarus's options for converting SDRs, in line with existing sanctions policy.
Nederland zet in contacten met de EU, de VS en andere internationale partners erop in om, in lijn met het staande sanctiebeleid, de mogelijkheden daartoe voor Belarus zoveel mogelijk te beperken.
