Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het afwijzen van de asielaanvraag van MH17-getuigen

SP MPs asked why the IND rejected asylum applications from two witnesses in the MH17 case and whether they are adequately protected. The Secretary of State declined to discuss individual cases, explained that IND and witness-team assessments follow different frameworks, and said the OM handles relevance of witness testimony and protection.
I do not provide information about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over het bericht dat Belarus ongeveer 1 miljard euro ontvangt van het Internationaal Monetair Fonds

MPs Van der Staaij and Stoffer asked whether the IMF's SDR allocation to Belarus, its conditions, monitoring and sanctions impact were acceptable given Dutch sanctions. Ministers Hoekstra and Knapen answered that SDR allocations are unconditional and generic, that the Netherlands will try to limit Belarus's ability to convert SDRs on capital markets, and that no reversal of the allocation is planned.

The Netherlands will seek, in line with existing sanctions policy and in contacts with the EU and other international partners, to limit as far as possible Belarus's options to convert SDRs on the capital market.

Nederland zet erop in om, in lijn met het staande sanctiebeleid, in contacten met de EU en andere internationale partners de mogelijkheden voor Belarus om SDR's te verzilveren op de kapitaalmarkt zo veel mogelijk te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de medische uitzondering voor het dragen van een mondkapje in het buitenland

An MP asked whether a medical exemption from mask-wearing exists abroad, whether the Dutch self-declaration form is valid there, why it is not uniform in the EU, and why the government website does not say so. The minister answered that mask rules are national, foreign requirements vary and travellers should check local rules via Wijs op Reis, without committing to new steps.
Listing all the countries where the medical exemption applies would produce an unworkable list.
Het noemen van alle landen waar de medische uitzondering geldt, levert een niet werkbare lijst op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de Nederlandse houding t.o.v. China

An MP asked the government about the Dutch stance towards China, including COVID-19 origins, lockdown models, Chinese social credit systems, Huawei and 5G security, and Chinese espionage and space ambitions. The ministers answered that no evidence of a lab origin was found by the WHO, that Dutch research on the origin should be internationally coordinated, and that the Netherlands is pursuing an integrated approach to state threats, though many answers referenced existing policy without new commitments.
The cabinet does not make public statements about the knowledge level of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over het kennisniveau van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over de publicatie van de juridische definitie van ecocide door een internationaal panel van experts

Two MPs (Van Raan and Teunissen, PvdD) asked the government for its view on an expert panel's proposed legal definition of ecocide and whether the Netherlands would engage with it. Minister Knapen replied that the proposal is a useful starting point for discussion but that ecocide is not recognised in international law, there is no current negotiation or consensus, and the government will follow developments and participate in relevant fora while focusing on other interventions for nature and biodiversity.
The government closely follows further developments and discussions on this.
Het kabinet volgt de verdere ontwikkelingen en discussies hierover nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over onteigening in Zuid-Afrika van land of bezit zonder compensatie

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a proposed South African constitutional amendment allowing expropriation without (proportionate) compensation amounts to state theft, its effects on farmers and the economy, and whether the Netherlands would seek international pressure. The minister declined to speculate on foreign law, stressed South Africa's democratic checks and independent courts, said the Netherlands has raised concerns bilaterally and in EU and OECD fora, and promised to keep monitoring the process.
The government will continue to monitor the process of land reform and the respect for property rights in South Africa.
De regering zal het proces van landhervorming en de eerbiediging van eigendomsrechten in Zuid-Afrika blijven volgen.
Antwoord op vragen de vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de export van giftige benzine

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about the export of polluting, carcinogenic petrol from the Netherlands to poorer countries, including whether companies could be stopped and which countries received it. The State Secretary answered that the ILT has told companies the exports breach the Environmental Management Act, demanded measures by 1 September with a penalty order possible, named West African destination countries where traceable, and described diplomatic and UNEP efforts on fuel standards.
Companies were asked by the ILT to state by 1 September at the latest which measures they have taken and/or will take to fulfil their duty of care.
Bedrijven zijn door de ILT verzocht om uiterlijk per 1 september aan te geven welke maatregelen zij hebben genomen en/of zullen nemen om invulling te geven aan hun zorgplicht.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Sjoerdsma over de pilot voor DigiD-activeringscode ontvangen via videobellen en toegankelijkheid van het Digitaal Corona Certificaat voor Nederlanders in het buitenland

MPs Brekelmans and Sjoerdsma asked about extending the pilot for issuing DigiD activation codes via video call to Dutch citizens abroad, its lessons, and access to the Digital Corona Certificate for citizens without BSN or DigiD. The minister said the pilot continues until structural arrangements, targeted for early 2022, are in place, reports strong demand and satisfaction, and notes the system does not record citizens' nationality or residence, so usage by group cannot be given.
The system used for the DCC does not record, for privacy reasons, to whom the DCC is issued, and therefore also not nationality or place of residence.
Het systeem dat voor DCC wordt gebruikt slaat in verband met privacy niet op aan wie het DCC wordt uitgegeven en dus ook niet de nationaliteit en woonplaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dassen en Koekkoek over de Conferentie over de Toekomst van Europa

Two Volt MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Conference on the Future of Europe is organised in the Netherlands, covering citizen representativeness, the choice of external contractor, themes, youth dialogues, coordination with provinces and municipalities, and how results will be used. The minister answered in detail, describing representative survey panels, online and in-person dialogues, a communication campaign, reports to the Conference and a planned timeline, without declining to provide requested information.
The cabinet will convey the outcomes of the national citizen consultations to the Conference and ensure they are taken into account in the Conference's final report.
Het kabinet zal de uitkomsten van de nationale burgerconsultaties overbrengen in de Conferentie, en er zorg voor dragen dat deze worden meegenomen in het eindverslag van de Conferentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over het sluiten van de grenzen in Groot-Brittannië voor de invoer van pootgoed uit de Europese Unie

An MP asked whether the UK's closure of its border to EU seed potatoes, and the resulting harm to Dutch growers, traders and cooperatives, would be addressed, including damage estimates, mitigation, use of the Brexit Adjustment Reserve and keeping Parliament informed. The minister agreed the closure is harmful, said the solution must come from EU-UK talks, gave only rough trade estimates, pointed to existing export support and Brexit Adjustment Reserve funding still being worked out, and considered the questions answered.
With the answers to the questions above, I trust I have informed you sufficiently.
Met de antwoorden op de vragen hierboven vertrouw ik erop u voldoende te hebben geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Piri en Jasper van Dijk over het Follow the Money artikel over Nordstream 2 en de Werkgroep Energie

MPs Van der Lee, Piri and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about a Follow the Money report on the Dutch-Russian Energy Working Group, its restart, possible agreements linked to Nord Stream 2, and the protocol and sanctions implications. The minister replies that the working group made no agreements on specific projects such as Nord Stream 2, that the 2018 protocol has no formal status, and that the government keeps a neutral position on Nord Stream 2 as a commercial project.
There was (and is) no question of agreements on specific energy projects, such as Nord Stream 2.
Er was (en is) geen sprake van afspraken over specifieke energieprojecten, zoals Nord Stream 2.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit ongeveer dertig Palestijnen heeft gearresteerd in Ramallah

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Palestinian Authority's arrest of about thirty protesters in Ramallah after activist Nizar Banat's death, including detention of activists, hunger strikes, Dutch security cooperation and calls for an independent investigation. The minister answered that the detainees were released, Nizar Banat's death had been raised with the PA via EU and bilateral demarches, and that the Netherlands has no direct cooperation with Palestinian security services beyond two missions.
On 24 June I called on the Palestinian Authority to have an independent and impartial investigation carried out into the death of Nizar Banat.
Op 24 juni jl. heb ik de Palestijnse Autoriteit opgeroepen onafhankelijk en onpartijdig onderzoek te laten verrichten naar de dood van Nizar Banat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over Afghanistan

An MP asked the foreign minister about a proposed EU emergency plan for evacuations and refugee reception following Afghanistan, including the mandate for the informal Gymnich meeting, possible non-paper, and coordination with migration ministers on shelter capacity. The minister replied that lessons from Afghanistan will be discussed at EU level, that refugee reception falls under the migration pact talks, and that the government will coordinate with the justice ministry but has not yet decided on a non-paper.
What precise form of steering or influence over this process the cabinet chooses or deems necessary cannot yet be said at this stage.
Welke precieze vorm van sturing dan wel beïnvloeding van dit proces het kabinet kiest of nodig acht valt in dit stadium nog niet te zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ephraim over vluchtactie Nederlands ambassadepersoneel Kabul

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch embassy staff in Kabul abandoned their post against instructions, leaving Afghan staff and interpreters behind, and whether this delayed evacuations. The minister answered that the on-site leadership judged staying unsafe, that a replacement team was sent immediately, that no evacuation flights were possible at the time, and that the move to the airport followed US advice with safe-passage letters deliberately left for local staff.
However, it is up to the leadership on the ground to determine whether this is responsible given the security situation, since they are best placed to assess the situation locally.
Het is echter aan de leiding ter plekke om te bepalen of dit ook verantwoord is gezien de veiligheidssituatie, aangezien zij de situatie ter plaatse het beste kunnen inschatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop, Ceder, Segers en Van der Staaij over de situatie van Afghaanse christenen

Four MPs asked the government about the situation of Afghan Christians and converts under the Taliban, and whether asylum policy should be loosened. The government said the situation of religious minorities was already concerning, that information is limited, and that a moratorium on decisions and departures has been imposed with a new country report and further consultation with parliament promised.
After receiving the country report, the House will be further informed about the conclusions that can be drawn from it for the country-based asylum policy.
Na ontvangst van het ambtsbericht wordt uw Kamer nader geïnformeerd over de conclusies die uit dat ambtsbericht kunnen worden getrokken voor het landgeboden asielbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het (mogelijke) stopzetten van het National Agriculture Edcuation College

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the possible termination of Dutch funding for the National Agriculture Education College in Kabul, citing its track record, student numbers, and role for women. The minister confirmed the funding would be extended one year instead of ending, but stated that all aid to Afghanistan is now on hold and that the future of the project is uncertain.
The cabinet therefore decided to extend the expiring contract by another year.
Het kabinet heeft hierom besloten het aflopende contract met nog een jaar te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen en Valstar over het bericht ‘Frankrijk ziet Taliban-banden bij gevluchte Afghanen’

Members Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen and Valstar asked the ministers whether evacuated Afghans with Taliban, Al Qaeda or IS ties could enter the Netherlands, how security screening was done before and after evacuation, and whether the Taliban can be treated as a terrorist organisation. The State Secretary answered that all asylum applicants are screened under standard procedures, that pre-evacuation screening was largely not possible given the time pressure, and that individuals can be excluded under article 1F or prosecuted, while the Taliban as an organisation is not on UN or EU terrorism lists.
For other persons who did not work directly for Dutch officials as part of an international military or police mission, such screening was in most cases not carried out by the Netherlands in advance.

Voor de andere personen die niet rechtstreeks voor (een) Nederlandse functionaris(sen) als onderdeel van een internationale militaire of politiemissie werkten is een dergelijke screening in de meeste gevallen niet vooraf door Nederland uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het terugsturen van vluchtelingen naar Afghanistan

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the deteriorating situation in Afghanistan under the Taliban justifies humanitarian measures, asylum eligibility, and a halt to forced returns. The government answered that it is seriously concerned, outlined humanitarian funding, and announced a decision and departure moratorium for Afghan asylum seekers, with no forced returns to Afghanistan in 2021.
This means in principle that no decisions will be taken on pending and new asylum applications and that Afghan asylum seekers already rejected will not be returned to Afghanistan.
Dit betekent in beginsel dat er geen besluit wordt genomen op lopende en nieuwe asielaanvragen en dat reeds afgewezen Afghaanse asielzoekers niet zullen worden teruggestuurd naar Afghanistan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de evacuaties en repatriëring vanuit Afghanistan

An MP from JA21 asked the Foreign Minister why the count of Dutch passport holders in Afghanistan rose from 700 to 1,250, why registration was incomplete, why many Dutch Afghans stayed despite travel advice, and how evacuation affected other eligible people. The minister explained the count reflects late registrations, that registration is voluntary, that the reasons for staying are unknown, and that the main evacuation challenges were security and airport access.
Your House will be informed prior to the plenary debate on Afghanistan through a status letter, which will include the figures.
Uw kamer wordt voorafgaand aan het plenaire debat over Afghanistan geïnformeerd middels een stand van zakenbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een online informatiebijeenkomst over de mogelijke samenwerking tussen Elbit en Nederlandse bedrijven

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a planned online information meeting on cooperation between Israeli arms maker Elbit and Dutch firms, and whether the government would halt it given Palestinian civilian deaths and possible complicity in violations. The minister replied that the government saw no reason to suspend the meeting, and that any future exports would be subject to Dutch export controls that refuse licences where there is a clear risk of serious human rights violations.
The cabinet saw no reason to suspend this information meeting.
Het kabinet zag geen reden om deze informatiebijeenkomst op te schorten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de exportkredietverzekering rond een groot gasproject in Mozambique

An MP asked the government about export credit insurance issued for a large gas project in northern Mozambique, including the insured values, the decision process, the armed-violence risk, and the force majeure situation. The state secretary answered that the decisions followed national policy and due diligence, acknowledged the mitigation proved inadequate in hindsight, and said conditions will be set before any resumption of the project.
The cabinet agrees that, in hindsight, the risk analysis and mitigating measures on security proved inadequate.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat de risicoanalyse en mitigerende maatregelen op veiligheidsgebied achteraf gezien ontoereikend zijn gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over de exportkredietverzekering voor het omstreden gasproject in Mozambique

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan ask whether export credit insurance granted for the Total Mozambique LNG project was justified given escalating violence, human rights abuses and climate concerns, and why the policy was not withdrawn. The government answers that the risk assessment was careful and based on the information then available, that the force majeure situation was not foreseen, that the policy is not currently withdrawn, and that a new security, human rights and environmental review plus remedial action plan will be required before the project resumes.
The cabinet asks the multilateral development banks to systematically test for Paris alignment from 2023 onwards.
Het kabinet vraagt de multilaterale ontwikkelingsbanken om uiterlijk vanaf 2023 systematisch te toetsen op Paris alignment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de gevolgen voor Nederland van het Pegasus-hack-schandaal

MPs Van Dijk asked whether the government knew of Pegasus spyware abuse against Dutch politicians, journalists, lawyers and human rights defenders, whether Dutch institutions use the software, and how it views the conviction of Moroccan journalist Omar Radi. The ministers said they were unaware of any list of Dutch targets, that Dutch agencies may use special powers under legal safeguards without disclosing details, that they cannot verify the basis of Radi's conviction, and that they find the surveillance unacceptable while pursuing export controls and cybersecurity norms.
In general, Dutch institutions are not permitted to hack into automated systems.
In het algemeen geldt dat het Nederlandse instellingen niet is toegestaan binnen te dringen in geautomatiseerde werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid de Roon over steun van de Palestijnse autoriteit voor antisemitisme

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how she views Palestinian Authority support for demonstrations featuring burning Stars of David and swastikas in Samaria, and whether she will condemn it. The minister answered that the Netherlands condemns antisemitism, raised the matter with the Palestinian authorities in Ramallah on 1 September, and says the Netherlands and the EU keep pressing responsible parties to stop hatred and violence.

Following the mentioned events at the demonstrations on the West Bank, the Dutch representative in Ramallah conveyed this message again on 1 September in a bilateral conversation with the Palestinian authorities.

Naar aanleiding van de genoemde gebeurtenissen bij de demonstraties op de West Bank heeft de Nederlandse vertegenwoordiger in Ramallah op 1 september jl. in een bilateraal gesprek met de Palestijnse autoriteiten deze boodschap nogmaals overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Boswijk over de bijdrage van Nederlandse bedrijven aan de wereldwijde voedselvoorziening

MPs Amhaouch and Boswijk (CDA) asked whether US sanctions block food, seed and planting-material exports and cause hunger, and what Dutch banks and the EU are doing about it. The minister replies that no signals show US sanctions hindering such exports, that hunger is mainly driven by poverty, conflict, climate and Covid-19, and describes EU humanitarian carve-outs, the INSTEX vehicle and ongoing dialogue with the Dutch banking association.
No signals have been received that US sanctions affect the specific sectors and companies in the Netherlands referred to in the question.
Er zijn geen signalen ontvangen dat door de VS ingevoerde sancties de in de vraag bedoelde specifieke sectoren en bedrijven in Nederland raken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Van der Staaij en Segers over de zoektocht naar Samuël Boujadi

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister why Italian authorities searched inadequately for missing Dutch national Samuël Boujadi, whether the ministry would support further searches or reimburse the family's search costs, and what it would do to help recovery of his body. The minister answered that Italian authorities have jurisdiction and say they searched longer than usual, that the Netherlands cannot intervene without invitation, that specific assistance was offered but not used, and that no reimbursement was promised.
The Netherlands may not and cannot interfere in investigation and legal proceedings in another state without an invitation or permission.
Nederland mag en kan zich niet zonder uitnodiging c.q. toestemming mengen in de opsporing en rechtsgang in een andere staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de schade aan mens en milieu door de winning van mangaan in Zuid-Afrika

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development about human and environmental harm from manganese mining in South Africa, global manganese markets, company responsibility, and Dutch due diligence legislation. The minister answered at length, acknowledging the report's findings, citing EU and national IMVO initiatives, and stating the government would not raise the South African findings with Pretoria but would prepare national due diligence legislation if EU progress stalls.
The Netherlands has no own research available on the global manganese market.
Nederland heeft geen eigen onderzoek beschikbaar naar de wereldwijde mangaanmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over een exportkredietverzekering voor een baggerschip van IHC in Myanmar

Two MPs (Van Raan and Teunissen, PvdD) asked why the Dutch state gave export credit insurance for an IHC dredger to a Myanmar ministry after the 2021 coup and given the Rohingya genocide allegations, and whether due diligence and the parliamentary motion against such cover were respected. The state secretary answered that the deal was insured before the coup, that the risks were judged acceptable under OECD and IFC standards, that Myanmar's country policy was tightened to exceptional cover in May 2021, and that the insurance was not retroactively withdrawn.
Legally it is not possible to retroactively withdraw a cover commitment as a result of a change in country policy.
Juridisch gezien is het niet mogelijk om met terugwerkende kracht een dekkingstoezegging in te trekken als gevolg van een wijziging van het landenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wuite en Sjoerdsma over het verdwijnen van BVN

MPs Wuite and Sjoerdsma asked why BVN satellite broadcasting ended on 1 July 2021, leaving many Dutch citizens abroad without access to public broadcasting, and whether the government would restore it or renegotiate with Flanders. The minister answered that funding cuts forced the end of worldwide satellite coverage, that content remains available via app, website and NPO Start, and that no legal obligation requires BVN to remain fully accessible worldwide.
There is no legal obligation that BVN programming must remain fully and effectively accessible to all Dutch citizens worldwide.
Er is geen wettelijke verplichting dat de BVN-programmering volledig en daadwerkelijk bereikbaar moet blijven voor alle Nederlanders wereldwijd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen en Van Raan over ernstige misstanden bij 'duurzame' palmoliebedrijven in Liberia

MPs Teunissen and Van Raan ask the government about serious abuses on palm oil plantations in Liberia (Golden Veroleum, MOPP) that are linked to RSPO membership and FMO financing, including land grabs, labour and environmental violations, and FMO's due diligence. The minister answers that FMO applies due diligence standards, RSPO is a private initiative outside government, FMO's action plan for SIFCA/MOPP is being monitored with an independent review planned, and the government is pursuing broader mandatory due diligence rules at EU level.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies, including those in the palm oil sector, to apply due diligence in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.

Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven, waaronder bedrijven in de palmoliesector, dat zij gepaste zorgvuldigheid (due diligence) toepassen in lijn met de OESO-Richtlijnen voor Multinationale Ondernemingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over het klachtenmechanisme voor de naleving van duurzaamheidsafspraken in handelsverdragen

An MP asked the foreign trade minister about the Single Entry Point complaint mechanism for sustainability commitments in trade agreements, questioning its enforceability, timelines, transparency, and the consultation process. The minister replied that the mechanism strengthens monitoring of binding sustainability chapters, that complaints are all taken up by the Commission, and that timelines, publication practice and an evaluation are still being worked out.
The complaints mechanism is not toothless.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over mogelijkheden om Hongarije aan te spreken op de anti-lhbti-wet

An SP MP asks the Foreign Minister about options to pressure Hungary over its anti-LGBTI law and rule-of-law decline, including a legal scholars' report urging immediate use of the EU rule-of-law conditionality regulation. The minister answers that the Commission should first adopt guidelines and await the CJEU ruling, that the Commission has opened two infringement cases on LGBTI rights, and that the Netherlands will support action in the Article 7 procedure and bilateral channels.
The Netherlands will continue to call Hungary to account at EU level for compliance with the principles of the rule of law, democracy and fundamental rights within the Article 7 procedure.
Daarnaast zal Nederland Hongarije in EU-verband blijven aanspreken op naleving van de beginselen van rechtsstaat, democratie en grondrechten in het kader van de artikel 7-procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van der Werf over het bericht dat experts van de Verenigde Naties melden dat er orgaanhandel plaatsvindt in China

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van der Werf asked the government about UN and China Tribunal reports of forced organ harvesting from prisoners of conscience in China, including Chinese legislation, Dutch links to the trade, and whether the issue will be raised in the EU and UN Human Rights Council. The government said it cannot verify the allegations, pointed to Chinese laws of 2007 and 2009-2011, reported no concrete Dutch links, declined a blacklist of Chinese hospitals, and promised a letter on the Council of Europe convention by end 2021.
The cabinet is unable to verify or refute these allegations.
Het kabinet is niet in staat om deze aanklachten te verifiëren noch te ontkrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over de positie van Nederland als financiële draaischijf in de wapenindustrie

Two SP MPs asked whether Dutch tax rules let major arms manufacturers route large sums through the Netherlands to avoid tax, and whether substance requirements and arms-export presumptions of denial should be tightened. The State Secretary of Finance acknowledged that the Dutch tax system has been used for avoidance structures, pointed to existing and planned anti-avoidance measures and a committee on conduit companies, but declined to comment on individual taxpayers and did not commit to tightening substance requirements.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot address the tax position of individual taxpayers.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht dat het ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken actief naar argumenten voor het ontkennen van de Armeense genocide zocht

Segers (ChristenUnie) asks whether the Foreign Ministry asked its Ankara embassy for scientific arguments denying the Armenian genocide, and why the government applies recognition conditions that could never be met in this case. Minister Kaag confirms a 2018 information request to the embassy on publications disputing the genocide label, says the government is still deciding on the Voordewind motion, and states it will reach its own independent decision on recognition.

From the core department in The Hague, contact was made with the Dutch embassy in Ankara on 7 February 2018 about possible scientific publications that would conclude the large-scale massacre of 1915 does not meet the legal term 'genocide'.

Vanuit het kerndepartement in Den Haag is op 7 februari 2018 contact geweest met de Nederlandse ambassade in Ankara over mogelijke wetenschappelijke publicaties die zouden concluderen dat de grootschalige moordpartij van 1915 niet voldoet aan de juridische term «genocide».

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de lobby en vertragingen in zowel het Internationaal Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen op Europees niveau als de Wet Zorgplicht Kinderarbeid op nationaal niveau

An SP MP asked the Minister of Foreign Trade about business lobbying against IMVO due diligence legislation at EU and national level, the balance of stakeholder consultations, and the delayed implementation of the Dutch Child Labour Due Diligence Act. The Minister denied concrete evidence of a change in VNO-NCW's position, said the EU route is preferred over the national child labour law, and gave no firm timeline for either.
The cabinet considers it necessary that Dutch diplomats in Brussels speak with various stakeholders to obtain as broad a picture as possible of interests relevant to decision-making.

Het kabinet acht het noodzakelijk dat de Nederlandse diplomaten in Brussel met verschillende stakeholders spreken om een zo breed mogelijk beeld te krijgen van belangen die relevant zijn voor besluitvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een lading onderschepte munitie op vliegveld Beek

MP Van Dijk asked the government about a shipment of 500,000 pistol cartridges intercepted at Maastricht Aachen Airport in January 2021 that lacked Dutch permits. The government answered the facts of the seizure and consent, but declined to say whether any criminal investigation exists, citing the Justice Minister's policy.
As you know, the Minister of Justice and Security makes no statements on whether criminal investigations (against certain persons) are ongoing.
Zoals u weet, doet de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid geen uitspraken over de vraag of er strafrechtelijke onderzoeken (tegen bepaalde personen) lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Van der Woude over het bericht 'Pride optocht Georgië afgeblazen na bestorming LHBTI-kantoor

MPs Brekelmans and Van der Woude asked the government how it judged the violence against the Tbilisi Pride march, what it had done to protect participants and journalists, and what it would do next. The Minister condemned the violence, said police deployment was insufficient, described diplomatic demarches and joint statements calling for protection and investigation, and promised continued pressure on Georgia.
The Netherlands will continue to press bilaterally and within the EU for an investigation by the Georgian authorities into the violence of 5 July.
Nederland zal bilateraal en in EU-verband blijven aandringen op onderzoek door de Georgische autoriteiten naar de gewelddadigheden op 5 juli.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klink over aandacht voor het buitenland bij Pride Amsterdam

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs about Pride Amsterdam's attention to LGBTI rights abroad, including how many countries criminalise homosexuality, whether Dutch aid goes to such countries, and what the government does to improve LGBTI people's position. The Minister confirmed that homosexuality is criminal in 71 countries, said Dutch aid still funds civil society there because rights work is needed most in such places, and listed diplomatic and funding instruments for LGBTI rights.
The human rights situation in a country is no reason not to finance activities there.
De mensenrechtensituatie in een land is geen reden om daar geen activiteiten te financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de aanwezigheid van de Nederlandse ambassadeur Jaap Werner bij de beëdiging van de Iraanse president Raisi

An MP from JA21 asked the Foreign Minister why the Dutch ambassador attended the inauguration of Iranian president Raisi, given that Hamas, Hezbollah and PIJ representatives were present, and whether this legitimises the regime despite alleged 1988 mass executions. The minister answered that attendance was standard practice shared by all EU states in Iran, that relations allow raising human rights concerns, and that there was no legitimisation or diplomatic blunder.
The ministry instructed the ambassador to attend the inauguration and report back.
Het ministerie heeft de ambassadeur de instructie gegeven de inauguratie bij te wonen en verslag te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van der Staaij over onderdrukking van religieuze minderheden in India naar aanleiding van onderzoek door de London School of Economics

MPs Segers and Van der Staaij asked the Foreign Minister about reported persecution of religious minorities in India, including disinformation and incitement described in an LSE/Open Doors report, and whether the Netherlands would support an international inquiry, act on media platforms, and hold officials accountable. The minister acknowledged the concerns, described existing Dutch projects, human rights dialogues and planned UN review, but did not commit to an international inquiry or to holding Indian officials accountable.
The Netherlands conveys its concerns about these developments to the Indian authorities.
Nederland brengt de zorgen over deze ontwikkelingen over bij de Indiase autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over risico’s voor het MH17-onderzoek

MP De Roon asks the government whether reports of the dismissal of the Ukrainian prosecutor leading the MH17 investigation put the investigation at risk, and what it will do about it. The minister answers that cooperation with Ukraine remains good, that personnel changes have not affected the investigation's priority or progress, that the government will not interfere in Ukraine's internal personnel matters, but will keep stressing the importance of cooperation.
It is not for the cabinet to interfere in the internal personnel matters of the Ukrainian Public Prosecution Service.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om zich te mengen in de interne personele aangelegenheden van het Oekraïense Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Stoffer over haatzaaien in (nieuwe) Palestijnse lesmethoden

Two SGP MPs asked the Foreign Minister about incitement and intolerance in new Palestinian school textbooks, including martyr-counting exercises, the omission of Israel from maps, altered wording about Jewish history and people, and whether Dutch or EU funds finance these materials. The minister answered that the EU-commissioned Georg Eckert Institute study finds a mixed picture with some problematic and antisemitic passages but improvements in 2020 editions, that incitement is unacceptable and should be removed, that the Netherlands does not fund textbooks directly, and that UNRWA continuously screens materials.
The cabinet considers it of great importance that such examples are removed by the Palestinian Authority as quickly as possible and that it continues to carry out strict review of this.
Het kabinet acht het van groot belang dat dergelijke voorbeelden door de Palestijnse Autoriteit zo snel mogelijk worden verwijderd en dat het hier een strikte toetsing op blijft uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over de bosbranden in Turkije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the EU and the Netherlands respond to the deadly wildfires in Turkey, including whether more EU aid should be pressed for and whether Dutch firefighting help can be offered. The minister answered that EU Civil Protection Mechanism assistance was already provided, that no extra EU request is currently warranted, and that the Netherlands has no firefighting aircraft of the type Turkey requested.
There is currently no reason to advocate extra help within the EU.
Er is op dit moment geen aanleiding om in EU verband te pleiten voor extra hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de situatie in Zuid-Afrika

MP Kerseboom asked the Foreign Minister about the July 2021 unrest in South Africa, including state capture, the causes of the violence, attacks on infrastructure, food security, and the safety of minorities. Minister Kaag answered at length, describing the ongoing Zondo commission and prosecutions, the restoration of order with army deployment, and that minority protection is South Africa's own responsibility, without addressing any Dutch oversight of executive power.
South Africa is a constitutional state with independent judicial bodies.
Zuid-Afrika is een rechtsstaat met onafhankelijke rechterlijke instanties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over twijfels over verdere samenwerking van Nederland met Iran na de beëdiging van president Ebrahim Raisi

The MP asks whether the government will reconsider cooperation with Iran after Ebrahim Raisi's inauguration, citing his alleged role in 1988 mass executions, UN calls for an independent inquiry, Iranian protest repression, JCPOA prospects, sanctions, EU aid and INSTEX. The minister acknowledges the allegations and the UN request, says accountability is a Dutch priority, rules out a visit, raises human rights concerns, keeps a critical engagement strategy with sanctions, and defends EU aid and INSTEX as serving JCPOA goals.
Accountability and combating impunity for international crimes are important parts of the international legal order and a priority in Dutch human rights policy.

Verantwoording afleggen (accountability) en het bestrijden van straffeloosheid voor internationale misdrijven zijn belangrijke onderdelen van de internationale rechtsorde en een prioriteit in het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de VS Turkije op een lijst heeft geplaatst van landen die betrokken zijn bij de inzet van Syrië

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about the US listing Turkey over child soldiers linked to the Sultan Murad Brigade, which the Netherlands had supported, and asked when the government knew, what materiel was supplied, and whether the external inquiry into the NLA programme examines child recruitment. The minister confirmed awareness of the report, declined to publicly name or detail support to specific groups, and pointed to the inquiry's independent mandate without committing to add this aspect.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over de sancties tegen Cuba

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the impact of the US embargo on Cuba, Dutch positions on UN resolutions against it, Dutch companies' role in US sanctions, and aid to Cuba during the crisis. The minister said domestic policy and COVID weigh more than the embargo, that Dutch opposition operates mainly via EU channels and the antiboycott regulation, and that Cuba receives no bilateral aid but indirect support via UN and EU programmes.
The Netherlands and other EU member states oppose the undesirable consequences of the extraterritorial effect of third-country sanctions.
Nederland en andere EU-lidstaten zijn tegen de onwenselijke gevolgen van de extraterritoriale werking van sancties van derde landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van Dijk, Piri en Van der Werf over de situatie van de door Nederland naar Bahrein uitgezette asielzoeker A.S.

MPs asked how the government monitors the detention of asylum seeker A.S. in Bahrain, whether he is isolated and mistreated, and what steps Netherlands and the EU take to secure his release. The minister says the embassy follows the case through regular human rights work, has raised concerns with Bahraini authorities, cannot confirm the reported conditions yet, and will continue to press for better detention conditions.
The Netherlands nevertheless follows A.S.'s case as part of the embassy in Kuwait's regular human rights work.
Nederland volgt evenwel de zaak van A.S. als onderdeel van het reguliere mensenrechtenwerk van de ambassade in Koeweit.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brekelmans over de berichten ‘Severe financial crisis threatens the STL’s ability to fulfil its mandate’ en ‘Start of trial in the Ayyash case (STL-18-10) on 16 June cancelled due to lack o

MP Brekelmans asked the Foreign Minister about reports that the Special Tribunal for Lebanon faces a severe funding shortfall that threatens three related cases (Hamade, Hawi and Murr), and why the government would fund only the Hariri main case and closure. Minister Kaag answered that the related cases were suspended by the Tribunal itself due to lack of funds, that Nederland and other donors added money to finish the main appeal, and that no further voluntary contributions are currently feasible.
Over the coming months the Netherlands will work with the other donors and the STL to achieve an orderly completion.
Nederland zal de komende maanden samen met de andere donoren en het STL werken aan een ordentelijke afronding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de protesten in Cuba tegen het communistische regime

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Foreign Minister about the 2021 protests in Cuba, including the regime's use of force, arrests of protesters, and EU policy toward Havana. The minister acknowledged disproportionate force and arbitrary arrests, pointed to economic and freedom grievances, and said the Netherlands and EU had raised concerns and urged reform, while largely declining to comment on the political statements in questions 5 and 10.
There has been disproportionate violence by the Cuban authorities against demonstrators and arbitrary arrests and detentions of peaceful protesters and journalists.
Er is sprake geweest van disproportioneel geweld door de Cubaanse autoriteiten tegen de demonstranten en arbitraire arrestaties en detenties van vreedzame protestanten en journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Stoffer, Kuik en Van Haga over de brief van 14 januari betreffende vrijwilligersreizen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Foreign Trade and Development about orphanage tourism, development policy on orphan care, the UN Child Rights resolution, ANBI charity status rules, timelines for regulatory follow-up, and sector campaigns. The minister answered that orphan care is not a separate policy focus, that ANBI rules are neutral and offer no basis for extra checks, that further regulatory options will be decided in Q4 2021, and that the sector should self-organise with government in an information role.
Several ministries are currently examining which of the listed courses of action are realistic, desirable and feasible, and which concrete actions could be attached to them.
Er wordt momenteel met verschillende ministeries bezien welke van de genoemde handelingsperspectieven realistisch, wenselijk en haalbaar zijn en welke concrete acties hieraan verbonden kunnen worden.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Ellian, Brekelmans en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Asielzoeker waarschuwde voor moordplan Iraanse geheime dienst'

VVD MPs asked whether the IND and AIVD were warned in advance about an Iranian-directed assassination plot and what Dutch and EU responses to Iran and to Iranian dissidents are. The state secretary declined to comment on individual cases or on AIVD working methods, pointed to existing reporting structures and the sanctions and diplomatic measures already taken, and gave no concrete new commitment.
As you know, I do not comment on individual cases.
Zoals u weet doe ik over individuele zaken geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Boswijk, Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Bromet, Ceder, Kuzu en Dassen over Afghaanse tolken

MPs asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs how the government would support Afghan interpreters and their families to evacuate as security collapsed, including whether passport requirements would be waived and a charter flight arranged. The government said it is doing everything possible to bring the group to safety, explained that Afghan authorities and airlines required passports and that airport access depends on verifiable identity, and promised a further letter on the consequences of recent developments.
The cabinet will shortly send a further letter to address the consequences of the recent developments.
Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een nadere brief sturen om in te gaan op de consequenties van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Bromet, Ceder en Kuzu over het beschermen van Afghanen die werkzaam waren voor Nederland tijdens de Afghanistanmissies

MPs from six parties asked the cabinet why it is not doing more to quickly bring Afghan interpreters and other former local staff who worked for Dutch missions to safety, including questions on the asylum process, document problems, non-interpreter staff, and a deportation moratorium. The ministers answered that additional staff were deployed, interpreters' remaining requirements were dropped, about 43 interpreters had arrived since June, non-interpreters are assessed individually and generously, and the moratorium's extension will be decided later.
The cabinet is taking all steps within its own power to bring the interpreters and their families to the Netherlands as quickly as possible.
Het kabinet onderneemt alle stappen die binnen het eigen vermogen liggen om de tolken en hun gezinnen op een zo kort mogelijke termijn naar Nederland over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Roon over inhuldiging van Raisi als president van Iran

De Roon (PVV) asked whether the EU and the Dutch government should refrain from sending representatives to the inauguration of Iranian president Raisi, whom he called a mass murderer. Minister Kaag answered that the EU sends its deputy secretary-general for the nuclear talks as a mediator, and that the Dutch ambassador will attend as with all EU states represented in Iran.
Like all EU countries represented in Iran, the Netherlands will be represented at the inauguration of the Iranian president by the ambassador.
Net als alle in Iran vertegenwoordigde EU-landen zal Nederland bij de inauguratie van de Iraanse president vertegenwoordigd worden door de ambassadeur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat de VS achter het voorstel staat om de patenten van de coronavaccins vrij te geven

MPs Hijink and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked whether the government supports the US position backing a waiver of COVID-19 vaccine patents, the EU's role as a blocker in the WTO, and whether Netherlands will back patent suspension. The minister answered that the government supports broad vaccine access, will press the European Commission to engage constructively in the WTO, but does not endorse the India/South Africa waiver as proposed and rejects several premises of the questions.

In line with the Piri et al. motion (Kamerstuk 35 663, no. 21), the cabinet will urge the European Commission to engage constructively within the WTO on proposals for temporary suspension of patents on COVID-19 vaccines.

In lijn met de motie Piri c.s. (Kamerstuk 35 663, nr. 21 ) zal het kabinet er bij de Europese Commissie op aandringen dat de EU constructief engageert binnen de WTO wat betreft voorstellen tot tijdelijke opschorting van patenten op coronavaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht ‘Kaag wilde Kamer informeren over fraudemelding bij stichting, ambtenaren hielden brief tegen’

Rep. Paul (VVD) asked Minister Kaag why she initially planned to inform parliament about possible fraud at Stichting Mayday Rescue, which supports the White Helmets in Syria, then dropped that plan, and asked about oversight of the funds and of partner organisations' financial administration. The minister answered that she followed advice to wait for an independent investigation, which found no proven malversation, and that under the Nota Beheer en Toezicht only proven malversations are reported to parliament, while defending the financial control measures and noting that 0.12 percent of ODA over five years was subject to proven malversation.
The advice from my officials was, in line with established policy on this, not to inform the House on the basis of suspicions, but first to await the independent investigation
Het advies van mijn ambtenaren was, conform staand beleid hieromtrent, de Kamer niet in te lichten op basis van vermoedens, maar eerst het onafhankelijke onderzoek af te wachten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het Holodomor-genocidevraagstuk

An MP asked the Foreign Minister why the Netherlands has not recognised the Holodomor as genocide, and about recently surfaced Soviet documents on the famine. The minister acknowledged the documents and scholarship but declined to label the Holodomor genocide, citing the absence of the legal norm in 1932-33 and the UN Genocide Convention definition.
For the Dutch government, when recognising genocides, rulings of international courts and tribunals, unambiguous conclusions from scientific research and findings by the UN are decisive.

Voor de Nederlandse regering zijn bij de erkenning van genocides uitspraken van internationale gerechts- en strafhoven, eenduidige conclusies volgend uit wetenschappelijk onderzoek en vaststellingen door de VN leidend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht 'Volgens Olga Karatsj is geen Wit-Russische activist nog veilig: Het regime bereidt operaties voor binnen de EU'

MP Piri asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers whether they knew of reports that the Belarusian regime is preparing operations inside the EU against activists, and about the safety of Belarusians in the Netherlands. The government says it has no signals of such planned operations, has received some reports of insecurity that are being examined, points to existing contacts with the diaspora, diplomatic protest options and the OBI (unwanted foreign interference) approach, but sees no need for a special reporting point.
The cabinet has no signals that the Belarusian authorities are preparing to arrest Belarusian activists within the EU.
Bij het kabinet zijn geen signalen bekend dat de Belarussische autoriteiten voorbereidingen treffen om binnen de EU Belarussische activisten op te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Bisschop over invoer van producten uit de Westelijke Sahara via Marokko naar de EU

MPs Segers and Bisschop asked why the Israel Producten Centrum was fined for labelling wine from the West Bank, whether such fines have occurred before, which occupied territories the rules apply to, and about export data for Western Sahara products imported via Morocco. The government answered that the labelling was misleading under EU food information rules, that the rules apply regardless of territory, that no overview of occupied areas exists, and provided tables of Moroccan export data, while stating that the NVWA's enforcement must remain objective.
It occurs very infrequently that a company is fined for an incorrect description of a product's origin.
Het komt zeer incidenteel voor dat een bedrijf wordt beboet voor een verkeerde omschrijving van de herkomst van een product.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht 'Kaag wilde Kamer informeren over fraudemelding bij stichting, ambtenaren hielden brief tegen'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether senior civil servants obstructed her from informing parliament in time about suspected subsidy fraud at Stichting Mayday Rescue, and about related recovery and internal meetings. The minister denied obstruction, explaining that the policy was to report only proven malversations and to await the independent Grant Thornton investigation, which found no proven fraud; she did not recover the full EUR 3.6 million, only withholding the final payment of EUR 57,435.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over zich, tegen de wil van de Kamer, niet uitspreken namens Armeense krijgsgevangenen

An MP asked why the government did not put the Chamber-supported Eppink motion on releasing Armenian prisoners of war onto the agenda of the 21 June Foreign Affairs Council, and what steps it was taking to implement it. The minister acknowledged the motion, said she raised it through other channels and reported on implementation, and listed bilateral, EU and multilateral appeals to Azerbaijan for release.
During the two-minute debate of 17 June I indicated that I support the intent of the motion.
Tijdens het tweeminutendebat van 17 juni jl. heb ik aangegeven dat ik de strekking van de motie steun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over vermeende sponsoring van terreurorganisaties

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch funds support Palestinian NGOs with alleged links to the PFLP and what checks exist to prevent terrorism financing. The minister replied that the Israeli information lacks concrete evidence for indirectly funded organisations, that Nederland has suspended UAWC funding and commissioned an external investigation, and that a government response will follow after the summer recess.

After it emerged that the salary of two suspects in a fatal bombing was partly paid from the Dutch contribution to UAWC's overhead costs, the Netherlands suspended funding to UAWC and commissioned an external investigation.

Nadat bleek dat het salaris van twee verdachten van een dodelijke bomaanslag deels betaald werd uit de Nederlandse bijdrage aan de overheadkosten van UAWC, heeft Nederland de financiering aan UAWC opgeschort en een extern onderzoek ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht 'Nederlandse ontwikkelingshulp vloeide naar Palestijnse terreurgroep'

An MP asked the minister about reports that Dutch development aid reached a Palestinian group linked to a terrorist organisation, and why Israeli intelligence was shared only with an EU team and whether funding to the organisations would be recovered. The minister answered that the Israeli information was too general to support the claim, that payments were suspended and partly resumed via an independent auditor, that the matter was referred to OLAF, and that recovery is not currently warranted.
The ministry takes reports of possible links with terrorist organisations and/or fraud seriously.
Het ministerie neemt berichten over mogelijke banden met terroristische organisaties en/of fraude serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Ceder over misbruik van Europese donorgelden door Palestijnse Ngo’s

MPs Stoffer and Ceder asked the minister whether Dutch and EU donor funds reach Palestinian NGOs linked to the PFLP, and what controls exist to prevent this. The minister says Dutch and EU funding is subject to risk analysis, audits and monitoring, that Israel's evidence so far is general and unsubstantiated, that OLAF has been asked to look, and that the UAWC contribution stays suspended pending a study to be sent after the summer recess.
The cabinet is awaiting the outcome of the EU request to OLAF.
wacht het kabinet het resultaat van het EU-verzoek aan OLAF af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over corruptie rond de kobaltwinning in de Democratische Republiek Congo (DRC)

An MP asked the government about corruption in Congolese cobalt mining, ABP's Glencore investments, Glencore's human rights standards, and Dan Gertler-linked companies in the Netherlands and possible sanctions. The minister answered that ABP's investment decisions are for the pension board, that prosecutors do not comment on ongoing cases, that Glencore's compliance with OECD and UN guidelines is not officially checked, and that sanctions and anti-corruption listing criteria are being studied.
The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements on whether criminal investigations or lawsuits are ongoing against particular legal entities.
Het Openbaar Ministerie doet geen uitspraken over de vraag of er strafrechtelijke onderzoeken of rechtszaken tegen bepaalde rechtssubjecten lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Piri over het bericht ‘Marokko neemt wraak op Spanje door migranten door te laten.’

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Morocco let migrants pass into Ceuta as revenge on Spain, including the situation of minors, one death, and alleged mistreatment at the border. The minister confirmed the crisis and the deaths, said the Netherlands shares the view that migrant rights must be respected, raised the issue through diplomatic channels and EU statements, and pointed to EU migration partnerships with Morocco without committing to a specific new step.
The cabinet does not have independent information about what happened at the border, but if mistreatment did occur, the cabinet rejects this way of treating irregular migrants.

Het kabinet beschikt niet over eigenstandige informatie over wat er zich aan de grens heeft afgespeeld, maar mochten zich mishandelingen hebben voorgedaan, dan verwerpt het kabinet deze wijze van behandeling van irreguliere migranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over mogelijke blootstelling van Nederlanders in de Dominicaanse Republiek aan de chemische stof Lewisite (L)

An SGP MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Dutch nationals in the Dominican Republic may have been exposed to the chemical agent Lewisite, whether this constitutes a chemical weapon, and whether the government, the OPCW or the state should investigate and support the victims. The minister answered that lewisite is a Schedule 1 chemical weapon, that no evidence currently shows use of a chemical weapon, that no further investigation or OPCW involvement is warranted now, and that the victims can seek assistance from competent bodies in the Netherlands.
From the currently known facts and circumstances, it cannot be concluded that there would have been use of a chemical weapon.
Uit de thans bekende feiten en omstandigheden kan niet worden geconcludeerd dat er sprake zou zijn geweest van gebruik van een chemisch wapen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Simons over het verbreken van de wapenstilstand door Israël

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Israel's airstrike breaking the Gaza ceasefire was proportionate, who was behind the incendiary balloons, and what Dutch measures were planned for de-escalation and humanitarian aid. The minister said the government lacks operational information to judge the use of force, that Hamas likely allowed or carried out the balloons, and listed an additional EUR 4 million for UN humanitarian response.
The cabinet does not have sufficient operational information required to assess the use of force by the parties to this conflict, in which the Netherlands is not itself involved.
Het kabinet beschikt over onvoldoende operationele informatie die vereist is voor de beoordeling van geweldgebruik door de partijen bij dit conflict, waarbij Nederland niet zelf is betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paternotte over vaccinatiebeleid van Nederlanders in het buitenland

MP Paternotte asked whether Dutch nationals living outside the EU without a BRP registration can be vaccinated in the Netherlands, what options exist where vaccines are unavailable, how other EU states handle this, and what happens to second doses. Minister De Jonge answered that since 18 June 2021 Dutch nationals with a passport and BSN can be vaccinated in the Netherlands without a one-month stay, that vaccine supply is limited so donations via COVAX are the primary route, and that other member states' rules are for them to decide.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Ceder over de vrijlating van het Pakistaanse echtpaar Shagufta en Shafqat

Two ChristianUnion MPs asked whether the released Pakistani Christian couple Shagufta Kausar and Shafqat Emmanuel face danger, whether the Netherlands will admit them as refugees, and what pressure is applied on Pakistan to repeal its blasphemy laws. The minister answered that the risk cannot be determined in advance, that asylum cannot be applied for at an embassy, and that the government raises the issue bilaterally and in EU channels while preferring quiet diplomacy.
It should be noted that the starting point of Dutch asylum policy is that a person can only apply for asylum in the Netherlands.
Hierbij dient aangetekend te worden dat het uitgangspunt van het Nederlandse asielbeleid is dat iemand enkel in Nederland asiel kan aanvragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Van der Plas, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder en Eppink over het bericht dat Indonesië dreigt met 'uitroeiing' separatisten op Papoea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Indonesia threatened to 'eradicate' Papuan separatists, the killing of an intelligence officer, fears of disproportionate military violence and displacement, Papuans' political rights, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that Indonesia has security duties but concerns about military presence, civilian harm and rights restrictions are shared, and said the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue without intervening in foreign court cases.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indonesian authorities for a meaningful dialogue between all parties involved.
Nederland zal bij de Indonesische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op een betekenisvolle dialoog, tussen alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Lee over het bericht dat de Franse president Macron Mali waarschuwt Franse troepen terug te trekken

MP van der Lee asks the Ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about reports that Macron warned he would withdraw French troops from Mali if it slides into jihadism, and about the consequences of the coup for MINUSMA and Dutch contributions. The ministers answer substantively on each point, noting ECOWAS mediation, the EU's conditions, unchanged MINUSMA legal basis and Dutch C-130 contribution, and that a parliamentary letter will follow after the summer.
Your House will receive the promised supplementary Article 100 letter after the summer and well before the planned deployment, which will also cover the latest developments in Mali.

Uw Kamer zal na de zomer en in ieder geval ruim voor aanvang van de voorziene inzet de toegezegde aanvullende artikel 100-brief toekomen, waarin ook de laatste ontwikkelingen in Mali worden meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Segers over Nederlandse deelname aan Durban IV-conferentie

MPs Van der Staaij and Segers asked whether the Netherlands will boycott the Durban IV conference, citing antisemitism at earlier Durban conferences and disproportionate focus on Israel. Minister Kaag answered that the Netherlands will not attend, citing the risk of antisemitic abuse and one-sided focus on Israel, while pledging continued anti-racism work at the UN.
The Netherlands does not intend to participate in the Durban IV meeting, given the historical burden of the Durban process.
Nederland is niet voornemens om deel te nemen aan de Durban IV-bijeenkomst, gelet op de historische belasting van het Durban-proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het bericht dat meer dan 50 landen seksuele misstanden binnen de WHO melden

An MP from the CDA asked the Foreign Minister about reports that 53 countries expressed concern over sexual abuse by aid workers, including at the WHO, and about Dutch involvement, the independent inquiry, and actions by WHO, UNICEF and IOM. The minister answered most questions substantively, sharing the statement, describing the inquiry and organisational measures, and promising a further letter, while declining to answer all 25 questions before the debate.
As promised during the recent Humanitarian Aid committee debate, I will send the House a letter on the current state of affairs.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het recente Commissiedebat Noodhulp zal ik de Kamer een brief sturen over de huidige stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brekelmans en Michon-Derkzen over het bericht ‘EU-leiders willen sancties tegen Wit-Rusland en eisen vrijlating Protasevitsj’

MPs Brekelmans and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the government would go further than the EU's announced measures against Belarus after the forced landing and arrest of Roman Protasevich, including sanctions on state firms, diplomats, airlines and airspace. The minister answered that the EU adopted a fourth package of targeted sanctions, sectoral sanctions, a flight ban on Belarusian airlines, and that Dutch law was amended, while further national unilateral measures were judged ineffective.
The cabinet cannot share information on the total number of Belarusian diplomats accredited in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet kan geen informatie delen over het totaalaantal Belarussische diplomaten dat in Nederland geaccrediteerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ceder over de samenwerking tussen de ministeries en religieuze actoren

The ChristenUnie MP asked the Foreign Minister how religious actors are considered in development cooperation, including their role in policy, programme analysis, staff knowledge and gender work. The minister answered that religious actors are treated as part of civil society, that cooperation is judged on effectiveness, and listed existing networks and embassy engagements.
Religious actors, such as religious institutions or individuals, are classed under civil society as in the policy framework Strengthening Civil Society and the Human Rights Policy.

Religieuze actoren, zoals religieuze instituties of individuen, worden geschaard onder het maatschappelijk middenveld zoals in het beleidskader Versterking Maatschappelijk Middenveld en het Mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de Nederlandse deelname aan een militaire oefening in de Westelijke Sahara

An MP asked whether Dutch participation in the military exercise African Lion 21 takes place partly in Western Sahara, whether this conflicts with the Dutch neutral stance, whether the Sahrawi population was consulted, and whether parliament was informed in advance. The government answered that the exercise is organised by USAFRICOM and, according to them, does not take place in Western Sahara, that Dutch participation has no consequences for the Dutch position, that Morocco was notified by note verbale, that parliament is not usually informed about exercises, and that participation will be assessed per exercise.
The cabinet does not comment on the deployment of partners.
Het kabinet laat zich niet uit over de inzet van partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een onderzoek van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad naar aanleiding van het recente geweld in Gaza

MPs Jasper van Dijk asked why the Netherlands abstained on a UN Human Rights Council resolution to investigate the Gaza violence, and questioned impunity, aid and settlement expansion. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports independent investigation but abstained because the mandate was broad, permanent and overlapping with existing bodies, and set out aid contributions and opposition to settlements.

For these reasons the Netherlands, together with 13 other countries including France, Denmark, Italy and Poland, abstained from the vote and explained this during the Human Rights Council in an Explanation of Vote.

Nederland heeft zich vanwege deze redenen samen met 13 andere landen, waaronder Frankrijk, Denemarken, Italië en Polen onthouden van stemming en dit tijdens de Mensenrechtenraad toegelicht in een Explanation of Vote.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Belhaj over het gebruik van explosieve wapens in dichtbevolkte gebieden

An MP asked the ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs about the high civilian share of casualties from explosive weapons in populated areas, and what the Netherlands is doing about it. The government answers that it deplores civilian harm, stresses better compliance with international humanitarian law and transparency, and says it will keep the Chamber informed on the EWIPA political declaration negotiations, while declining to commit to stronger national measures.
Yes. Once the negotiations have concluded, the cabinet will inform the Chamber of the outcome and provide further explanation of the Dutch position.
Ja. Op het moment dat de onderhandelingen geconcludeerd zijn, zal het kabinet de Kamer op de hoogte brengen van de uitkomst en nadere toelichting geven op de Nederlandse inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Fritsma over het bericht dat Nederland deelneemt aan een militaire oefening in de Westelijke Sahara

Two PVV MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether Dutch troops were taking part in the African Lion 2021 exercise, whether it took place in Western Sahara, and why parliament was not informed. The minister confirmed Dutch participation at US invitation but stated the exercise does not take place in Western Sahara according to USAFRICOM, and that it is not customary to inform parliament about participation in exercises.
Moreover, it is not customary to inform the House about Dutch participation in military exercises.
Daarnaast is het niet gebruikelijk om de Kamer over de Nederlandse deelname aan militaire oefeningen te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de arrestatie van de leider van de Russische oppositiegroepering

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of a Russian opposition leader after his plane was stopped in Saint Petersburg, about EU and US coordination on sanctions against Belarus, and about whether proposed sanctions go far enough. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises repression bilaterally and multilaterally, that the EU adopted a fourth package of targeted sanctions and sectoral economic sanctions, and that the Netherlands is working for effective EU measures.
The Netherlands raises this bilaterally and multilaterally.
Dit stelt Nederland bilateraal en multilateraal aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dijk en Alkaya over ‘het oliebedrijf Pluspetrol dat belasting ontwijkt in Nederland en het milieu vervuilt en mensenrechten schendt in Peru’

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the minister about Pluspetrol, which allegedly avoids tax in the Netherlands, pollutes and violates human rights in Peru, and refused OECD National Contact Point mediation. The minister answered that tax matters of individual firms cannot be discussed, that the NCP has declared the complaint admissible while Pluspetrol declined mediation, and that the government is pursuing stronger IMVO due diligence legislation.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act, the cabinet cannot comment on the tax position of an individual company.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan het kabinet niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individueel bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paul over het bericht 'Wetenschappers: Overheid weet niet welke ontwikkelingshulp werkt'

An MP (VVD) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch aid money is used effectively, given a Trouw report that the government does not know which aid works, and asked about evaluation, results measurement and the role of IOB. The minister answers that evaluation is intensive but tailored to project type and budget, cites existing tools (IOB, MEL reserve, systematic reviews, IATI), and states that results measurement has practical limits, without committing to a new concrete step.
That is why the cabinet continues, unchanged, the good practice of intensive evaluation within development cooperation to gain insight into what does and does not work.
Daarom zet het kabinet de goede gewoonte, waarbij binnen Ontwikkelingssamenwerking intensief wordt geëvalueerd om zicht te krijgen op wat wel en niet werkt, onverminderd voort.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over mensenrechtenschending, milieuvervuiling en belastingontwijking door oliebedrijf Pluspetrol

Two MPs asked the Dutch government about alleged human rights violations, pollution and tax avoidance by Pluspetrol, including its refusal to cooperate with the Dutch OECD National Contact Point and whether business misconduct should be sanctioned or made legally enforceable. The ministers answered that OECD guidelines are voluntary, that CSR policy is being strengthened toward a due diligence obligation (preferably at EU level), and that enforcement options are still being worked out.
The cabinet is currently developing building blocks for CSR legislation.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment bouwstenen uit voor IMVO-wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over de oproep uit Suriname om hulp te bieden met vaccineren

MPs from D66 and the ChristenUnie asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Affairs about Suriname's request for vaccination help amid a COVID-19 surge and the Indian export ban. The minister answered that Nederland has responded with oxygen containers, medical supplies, 90,000 AstraZeneca doses and a planned 500,000 to 750,000 doses, sent a special envoy, and donated EUR 70 million to COVAX.
The Netherlands has also committed that from week 25, provided supplies allow, vaccines will be delivered to Suriname.
Nederland heeft tevens toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Hammelburg, Boucke, Sjoerdsma en Ceder over het aanbod van het Diaspora Medisch Team Nederland om steun aan het vaccinatieprogramma in Suriname te faciliteren

MPs from D66 and ChristenUnie asked the health and foreign affairs ministers about the Diaspora Medical Team's offer to support Suriname's vaccination programme, whether the minister had contacted Suriname's health minister, and whether vaccines would be supplied. The minister replied that talks with Suriname's health minister had taken place, that 90,000 AstraZeneca doses were sent with further deliveries promised from week 25, and that a coordinator was deployed to match Surinamese needs with Dutch medical staff offers.
Furthermore, the Netherlands has committed that from week 25, provided deliveries allow it, vaccines will be supplied to Suriname.
Verder heeft Nederland toegezegd dat er vanaf week 25, mits de leveringen het toelaten, vaccins worden geleverd aan Suriname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het verlenen van een wapenexportvergunning voor Brazilië

The SP MP Jasper van Dijk asked whether a Dutch arms export licence for radar and C3 systems to the Brazilian navy (Thales, Tamandaré-class ships) was granted despite Brazil's Covid-19 crisis, human rights concerns and political turmoil in the military. Minister Kaag declined to give details on commercially confidential matters, said the licence was checked against the EU criteria with extra attention to human rights and regional stability, and saw no reason to reconsider it.
No statements can be made about the details of the application. That concerns commercially confidential information.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de details van de aanvraag. Dat betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over de ontbossing van het Amazonegebied door soja-invoer van Nederland

MPs Thijssen and Gijs van Dijk asked the Ministers of Agriculture and Foreign Affairs whether Dutch soy imports drive deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon, including whether soy from post-2008 cleared land is imported and whether importers will be held to account. The ministers answered that about 5% of Brazil's soy exports go to the Netherlands, most Dutch-bound soy is covered by sustainability certificates, and the government will push for EU-level measures such as legislation, with a proposal expected in summer 2021.

The cabinet expects companies established in the Netherlands that operate internationally to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.

Het kabinet verwacht van in Nederland gevestigde bedrijven die internationaal opereren dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de UN Guiding Principle's on Business and Human Rights naleven
