Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Bromet, Thijssen en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland een grote aanjager is van wereldwijde ontbossing

MPs asked the ministers whether the Netherlands is a major driver of global deforestation per a WNF report, and about its links to nitrogen, climate, EU trade deals (Mercosur) and import tariffs. The ministers largely contest the report's attribution to the Netherlands, cite certification schemes and EU-level measures, and promise continued EU engagement on deforestation-free supply chains.
The Netherlands faces a major task in reducing nitrogen deposition.
Nederland heeft een stevige opgave om de neerslag van stikstof terug te dringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en van der Lee over duurzaamheidsrisico’s van staatsobligaties

MPs Snels and Van der Lee asked the Finance and other ministers about the climate and sustainability risks of sovereign bonds, transparency on those risks, and how Nederland compares internationally on green recovery spending. The government answered that it supports transparency and integrating climate risks into IMF and World Bank debt analyses, that no current sovereign debt runs past 2060 and climate risks do not yet directly affect Dutch creditworthiness, and that it will raise climate risks more proactively with investors.
The Agency will therefore also proactively address climate risks and how the Netherlands tackles them in future presentations to prospective investors.
Het Agentschap zal daarom ook in de toekomst proactief in de presentaties voor beoogde investeerders aandacht besteden aan klimaatrisico’s en de wijze waarop Nederland deze risico’s adresseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het verder escalerende geweld in Noord-Mozambique

An MP asked the government about escalating violence in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, including the Palma attack, human rights abuses, the Total gas project, export credit insurance and humanitarian access. The government answered at length, largely describing the situation and EU and SADC responses, stating it is concerned, that Total declared force majeure, and that Atradius DSB monitors the situation without committing to a change in insurance policy.
The cabinet is closely monitoring the situation.
Het kabinet volgt de situatie nauwlettend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over de aanslagen in Mozambique en de rol van de Nederlandse overheid bij gaswinningsprojecten in deze regio

SP MPs asked why the Dutch government still provides export credit insurance for a Mozambique gas project amid jihadist violence and human rights concerns, and whether it will withdraw. The government answered that the insurance was granted under international standards, that the situation is being monitored, and that the abuses were committed by insurgents rather than the project, so it will continue to monitor and act within policy conditions.
The State and Atradius DSB are closely monitoring the situation and will act appropriately within the terms of the policies, depending on what the situation requires.
De Staat en Atradius DSB volgen de situatie nauwgezet en zullen op passende wijze handelen binnen de voorwaarden van de polissen en al naargelang waar de situatie om vraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Teunissen over exportkredietverzekeringen voor omstreden gasprojecten in Mozambique

MPs Van Raan and Teunissen asked the Dutch government about export credit insurance for the contested Mozambique LNG gas project in Cabo Delgado, including security, human rights, status of policies and climate compatibility. The government answered that policies were issued in March 2021 after financial close, that the state would not recover losses from Mozambique, that a new security analysis would be needed for any restart, and that the project was assessed against OECD/IFC standards.
We therefore cannot provide you with information on this, insofar as it is not already public.
Wij kunnen u hierover dus geen informatie verstrekken voor zover niet reeds openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over schadelijke beleggingen van pensioenfondsen

An MP from GroenLinks asks ministers whether pension funds investing in harmful sectors such as weapons, alcohol, cannabis and firms linked to land rights violations breach statutory duties on sustainability and beneficiary preferences, and whether the IMVB covenant is adequate. The minister replies that funds decide their own investments, points to the IMVB covenant, the Pensioenwet and IORP II reporting duties, and EU non-financial reporting reform, and promises no new binding measures.
Pension funds decide for themselves what they invest in; the cabinet does not decide that.
Pensioenfondsen bepalen zelf waarin zij beleggen, daar gaat het kabinet niet over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over etikettering van producten uit illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An SP MP asked the government about a fine imposed on a wine importer for mislabelling products from Israeli settlements, whether duties are correctly levied on them, and how much is imported from settlements. The minister confirmed the fine, explained that origin labelling is enforced by the NVWA and customs on the basis of EU rules, and said neither the government nor the Commission has figures on settlement trade.
Customs cannot provide information on individual declarations because of its duty of confidentiality under EU customs legislation.
De Douane kan vanwege haar geheimhoudingsplicht op basis van EU-douanewetgeving geen informatie verstrekken over individuele aangiften
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het WK voetbal in Qatar

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about implementing a parliamentary motion to avoid official government representation at the 2022 Qatar World Cup over labour abuses, the labour conditions, the 6,500 worker deaths, compensation for victims, and why trade promotion with Qatar continues. The ministers answered that qualification is not yet settled, outlined Qatari labour reforms and continued dialogue, and said a digital trade mission was postponed while Dutch firms can still get support.

Following the worrying reports about migrant workers building football stadiums in Qatar, the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development decided to postpone the digital trade mission to Qatar, which was planned from 22 March to 1 April 2021.

Naar aanleiding van de zorgelijke berichten over arbeidsmigranten bij de bouw van voetbalstadions in Qatar heeft de Minister voor BHOS besloten om de digitale handelsmissie naar Qatar, die gepland stond van 22 maart tot en met 1 april 2021, uit te stellen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van den Hul, Karabulut en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het beleid van de Rijksdienst voor Ondernemend Nederland om Nederlandse bedrijven te stimuleren tot investeringen in de sp

Four MPs asked the minister why the Netherlands' trade agency RVO encourages Dutch investment in Qatar's sports sector given reported deaths and poor conditions of migrant workers building World Cup stadiums, and whether this conflicts with CSR policy. The minister acknowledges the abuses, notes Qatari labour reforms and ongoing concerns, says RVO warns firms of IMVO risks, and postpones a trade mission to Qatar while refusing to end RVO support.

Following the worrying reports about migrant workers building football stadiums in Qatar, the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development decided to postpone the digital trade mission to Qatar planned for 22 March to 1 April 2021.

Naar aanleiding van de zorgelijke berichten over arbeidsmigranten bij de bouw van voetbalstadions in Qatar heeft de Minister voor BHOS besloten om de digitale handelsmissie naar Qatar, die gepland stond van 22 maart tot en met 1 april 2021, uit te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuizen over de productie van zonnepanelen met Oeigoerse dwangarbeid

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about solar panels in the Netherlands possibly made with Uyghur forced labour, including whether subsidies went to such panels and how the OECD guidelines apply. The Minister said the government lacks data on Xinjiang content, that it cannot exclude subsidised panels being linked to forced labour, and that it will pursue a broader due-diligence obligation and industry dialogue.
The cabinet has no insight into the amount of subsidy granted to solar panels where forced Uyghur labour may have been involved in the supply chain.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de hoeveelheid subsidie verstrekt aan zonnepanelen waarbij in de keten mogelijk sprake is geweest van Oeigoerse dwangarbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over de executie van ruim tien onbewapende mannen door Ethiopische soldaten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about the reported execution of more than ten unarmed men by Ethiopian soldiers in Tigray, the G7 and EU condemnation, possible ethnic cleansing and sanctions, humanitarian aid, and gathering evidence for accountability. The minister confirmed awareness, stated Dutch and EU condemnation, backed an independent EHRC/OHCHR investigation with Dutch funding, and said humanitarian contributions totalled about EUR 9.5 million for 2021.
The Netherlands has declared itself willing to contribute financially to the costs of such an investigation.
Nederland heeft zich bereid verklaard financieel bij te dragen aan de kosten van een dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Ophef over het gebruik van ‘foute’ Chinese zonnepanelen’

Rep. Van der Lee asked the ministers about reports that solar panels sold in the Netherlands may use polysilicon produced with Uyghur forced labour in Xinjiang, and about Dutch dependence on Chinese supply. The government said it lacks data on Xinjiang content, will raise IMVO due-diligence obligations with the solar sector and the EU, and cannot confirm forced labour beyond cited reports.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies operating internationally to comply with the OECD Guidelines and the UNGPs.
Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven die internationaal ondernemen dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen en de UNGP’s naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Nederlandse zonnepanelen gebouwd door Oeigoerse dwangarbeiders'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Dutch solar panels were made with forced Uyghur labour, including whether public procurement and the solar sector's supply chains are adequately checked. The government says it lacks independent verification, points to existing due diligence and procurement measures and planned revisions, and rules out a temporary suspension of solar panel sales as disproportionate.
It must be stated at the outset that the cabinet does not have data on the extent to which the panels used in the Netherlands contain polysilicon processed in Xinjiang.
Vooropgesteld staat dat het kabinet niet over gegevens beschikt in hoeverre de in Nederland gebruikte panelen polysilicium uit Xinjiang is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nederlandse zonnepanelen komen van Chinese bedrijven die worden verdacht van dwangarbeid’

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch solar panels are linked to Chinese firms suspected of forced labour in Xinjiang, and what the government would do about it. The government says it lacks data on Xinjiang content in Dutch panels, urges companies to apply due diligence under the OECD Guidelines and UN Guiding Principles, and says it will raise the issue at EU level and engage the sector.
It must be stated at the outset that the cabinet does not have data on the extent to which polysilicon from Xinjiang is processed in the panels used in the Netherlands.
Vooropgesteld staat dat het kabinet niet over gegevens beschikt in hoeverre de in Nederland gebruikte panelen polysilicium uit Xinjiang is verwerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over het bericht 'Vaccineer zo snel mogelijk ook in armere landen om mutaties te voorkomen'

An MP from GroenLinks asked the health and trade ministers about COVAX vaccine targets, a TRIPS waiver, C-TAP technology sharing and EU contract negotiations, and whether the government would act on these. The minister answered that Nigeria-style supply shortfalls are understandable, that the government supports COVAX financially and in kind, is cautious about a TRIPS waiver and C-TAP, and is consulting Belgium and the EU, without firm commitments.
The cabinet will argue within the EU that Europe contributes constructively to this discussion.
Het kabinet zal binnen de EU bepleiten dat Europa constructief aan deze discussie bijdraagt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Hammelburg over Europese hulp aan het zwaar door het coronavirus getroffen India

MPs Paternotte and Hammelburg asked whether the government would help India during its severe COVID-19 wave with medical supplies, vaccine production support, genome sequencing and lifting US export restrictions. The minister answered that Nederland is sending oxygen concentrators, ventilators and antivirals, funding Red Cross and Global Fund support, and that US export restrictions were lifted on 25 April.
In response, the Netherlands is sending oxygen concentrators, ventilation equipment and antiviral medicines.
In reactie daarop stuurt Nederland zuurstof-concentratoren, beademingsapparatuur en anti-virale middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over ontmijningsprojecten in Nagorno-Karabach

An MP asked why the Netherlands refuses to fund HALO Trust demining in Nagorno-Karabakh despite funding it elsewhere, and why it stopped funding in 2009. The minister answers that access and political conditions are lacking, that the Netherlands is exploring a regional demining fund, and that funding was ended in 2007-2009 for priority reasons and because Armenia and Azerbaijan are not parties to the Ottawa Convention.
The Netherlands is exploring with international partners the possibilities for a contribution to a possible regional demining fund.
Nederland onderzoekt samen met internationale partners de mogelijkheden voor een bijdrage aan een eventueel regionaal fonds voor ontmijning
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Teunissen over de toename van het bosverlies in het afgelopen jaar

MP Teunissen asked the minister about rising deforestation, Dutch soy imports from Brazil, the Netherlands' role as a transit hub for agricultural commodities, FMO investments in the Congo basin, and whether the Netherlands should impose a boycott. The minister answered that the government relies on outside data, explained the soy import increase through market factors, said trade flows are hard to attribute, and pointed to EU-level measures and dialogue with Brazil rather than a unilateral boycott.
The cabinet has no independent information on global deforestation figures and therefore relies on reports from reputable knowledge institutions.
Het kabinet heeft geen zelfstandige informatie over mondiale ontbossingscijfers en baseert zich dan ook op rapporten en berichten van gerenommeerde kennisinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden in de kledingindustrie

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the expiring binding Bangladesh Accord, fatal factory incidents in Morocco and Egypt, supply-chain responsibility, transparency and mandatory due diligence legislation. The Minister answers that the government is not a party to the Accord negotiations, supports a binding successor agreement and due diligence rules at EU level, but does not plan separate import transparency legislation.
The Netherlands is working to increase awareness among Dutch companies of risks in the garment industry and their responsibility in this regard.
Nederland spant zich in om het bewustzijn onder Nederlandse bedrijven op risico's in de kledingindustrie en hun verantwoordelijkheid daarbij te vergroten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dassen over het bericht ‘Kabinet maakt vertrouwelijke notulen ministerraad openbaar.’

Volt MP Dassen asked whether the ministers of Finance and Foreign Trade, who also sit in parliament, would take part in the urgent debate on publicised cabinet minutes, and how this dual role affects the separation of power and countervailing power amid the childcare benefits scandal. The government answered that the dual role is permissible under article 57(3) of the Constitution during the caretaker period, that the questions about party-group deliberations cannot be answered by the cabinet, and that the ministers will participate in the debate as cabinet members.

Parliamentary questions are addressed to members of the cabinet. Questions concerning meetings of parliamentary party groups cannot be answered by the cabinet and must be raised in the parliamentary debate.
Kamervragen worden gesteld aan leden van het kabinet. Vragen die zien op de vergaderingen van Kamerfracties, kunnen niet door het kabinet beantwoord worden en moeten gesteld worden in het Kamerdebat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Palland over hoe baggeraars zich verweren tegen Chinese concurrentie

MPs Amhaouch and Palland asked the Ministers of Foreign Trade and Economic Affairs about unequal competition from Chinese dredging firms in EU tenders and the lack of reciprocal market access. The government acknowledged the problem and pointed to existing tools and EU instruments under development (IPI, foreign subsidies white paper) without committing to new sector-specific measures.
The cabinet is increasingly concerned about an unequal playing field between European and Chinese companies.
Het kabinet maakt zich in toenemende mate zorgen over een ongelijk speelveld tussen Europese en Chinese bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Lee over het bericht dat Nederland nog steeds een claimparadijs is voor brievenbusfirma’s

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch investment treaties allow letterbox companies to bring ISDS claims against states, and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that the renegotiation of bilateral investment treaties on the modernised model text is largely stalled due to COVID-19 restrictions, that the government is committed to resuming it, and that the Energy Charter modernisation includes excluding letterbox firms.
The cabinet is committed to modernising the Dutch BITs and is looking at ways to resume the (re)negotiations as soon as possible.
Het kabinet is gecommitteerd aan de modernisering van de Nederlandse IBO's en bekijkt de mogelijkheden om de (her-)onderhandelingen zo snel mogelijk te hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Nederland nog steeds een claimparadijs is voor buitenlandse bedrijven

MPs Alkaya and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked why the Netherlands remains a 'claim paradise' for foreign companies under investment treaties, why renegotiation has stalled, how many ISDS claims have been filed from the Netherlands, and whether investors should first exhaust domestic courts. Minister Kaag answered that renegotiations with six countries are slow due to COVID restrictions, reported 114 ISDS claims per UNCTAD without further monitoring, rejected mandatory exhaustion of domestic remedies, and committed to resuming renegotiations as soon as partners allow.
The cabinet does not have more information or more means to collect and report on ISDS claims than UNCTAD.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over meer informatie c.q. meer mogelijkheden om informatie te verzamelen en te rapporteren over ISDS claims dan de UNCTAD.
Antwoord op het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de ondersteuning van het onderwijs in ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the effects of COVID-19 on education in developing countries, the EUR 50 million extra for the Global Partnership for Education, and the stalled International Finance Facility for Education (IFFEd). The minister explained that the GPE contribution partly reallocated 2020 funds, that no further EUR 100 million can be committed, and that IFFEd stalled because the World Bank's threshold for trust-fund capital was not met, with Nederland aiming for operation in 2021 or 2022.
The Netherlands aims for IFFEd to become operational in 2021 or 2022 after all.
Nederland streeft ernaar dat IFFEd in 2021 of 2022 alsnog operationeel wordt.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld van de leden Van den Hul, Van Ojik en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de stelselmatige verkrachting van Oeigoerse vrouwen in Chinese kampen

MPs Van den Hul, Van Ojik and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported systematic rape and torture of Uyghur women in Chinese camps, what action the government would take, whether it would press China on human rights and sanctions, and what it was doing about Dutch companies profiting from Uyghur forced labour. The ministers answered that they condemn these abuses, raised them with the Chinese ambassador and in joint EU and UN statements, supported independent UN investigation and EU sanctions, held talks with business and organised a sector session on due diligence, while stating the government has no overview of companies linked to Xinjiang supply chains.
The cabinet has no overview of companies that are linked to the situation in Xinjiang through their supply chain.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van bedrijven die via hun toeleveringsketen zijn gelinkt aan de situatie in Xinjiang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over noodhulp naar aanleiding van gewelddadigheden in Myanmar

Stoffer (SGP) asked the minister about the military coup in Myanmar, the situation of minorities and the Rohingya, and humanitarian needs and Dutch aid. The minister answered that the coup undermines the whole population, that local aid organisations should be supported, and that the Netherlands gives unearmarked funding to UN and Red Cross partners without yet knowing how much goes to Myanmar.
It is currently not known how much of the Dutch humanitarian contributions can be attributed to the humanitarian response in Myanmar.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel van de Nederlandse humanitaire bijdragen toegerekend kunnen worden aan de humanitaire respons in Myanmar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Buitenweg over het bericht dat Huawei in technologie investeert voor de etnische profilering van Oeigoeren

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether Huawei and other Chinese tech firms are developing facial recognition to identify Uyghurs, and what Dutch and EU responses, export controls and standards safeguards could address this. The government answered that it cannot confirm Huawei's denial, raised the issue with the company, noted that Dutch export controls do not cover ethnic-identification technology, and said it will consider EU human rights sanctions and due diligence obligations.
The cabinet cannot confirm this explanation from Huawei on the basis of its own information.
Het kabinet kan deze uitleg van Huawei op basis van eigen informatie niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het transparantiebeleid van ontwikkelingsbank FMO en door FMO gefinancierde misstanden in de Democratische Republiek Congo

MPs Van Raan and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked about FMO's transparency policy and alleged abuses (land rights, wages, complaints handling) linked to the Feronia-PHC palm oil plantations in DR Congo. The minister's answers largely describe FMO's ESAP, debt write-down conditions, the complaints mechanism process and monitoring, while declining to share the confidential due diligence report and stating there is no list of companies guilty of land grabbing.
This study contains confidential business information and for legal reasons FMO cannot share or publish this document.
Dit onderzoek bevat bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en om juridische redenen kan FMO dit document niet delen of openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over met Nederlands geld gefinancierde pick-uptrucks in Oeganda

Dutch MP Kuik (CDA) asked the minister whether Dutch-funded pick-up trucks were used by Ugandan police against the opposition, and about Dutch support to the JLOS justice sector including monitoring and whether aid should continue. The minister answered that the trucks are under investigation and the police cooperation component is on hold, that JLOS aid is earmarked and monitored with payments partly delayed, and that the Netherlands is pursuing diplomatic engagement with Uganda.
The ministry is still determining exactly what happened and is in contact with the Ugandan authorities and the police for this purpose.
Het ministerie zoekt nog uit wat er precies is gebeurd en is daarvoor in contact met de Oegandese autoriteiten en de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Den Nieuwenhuijzen over de positie van de LHBT+ gemeenschap in Ghana

An MP asked the minister about the raid and closure of the LGBT+ Rights Ghana community centre, whether Dutch or EU actors co-financed it, the security of its director, and the wider position of LGBT+ people in Ghana. The minister answered that the centre was not raided by police but that police escorted a landlord amid threats, that no Dutch or EU funding was given, that the issue is raised in bilateral human rights dialogue, and that Dutch support continues without concrete new commitments.
Information about his specific security situation and any protection cannot be shared for obvious reasons.
Over zijn specifieke veiligheidssituatie en eventuele bescherming kan om voor de hand liggende redenen geen informatie worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Graaf, Van der Staaij en Van Helvert over het rapport 'Same Faith, Different Persecution' van Open Doors

MPs from four Christian parties asked the government about an Open Doors report on gender-specific religious persecution of women and girls, and what came of earlier commitments to raise it with UN envoys. The minister said the Special Envoy's talks with UN officials led to closer cooperation on religion and gender, that the government recognises the problem, and that it will be addressed through existing human rights channels and funding without committing to new concrete measures.
The cabinet recognises that women and girls from religious minorities are subjected to forced marriage and human trafficking.
Het kabinet herkent dat vrouwen en meisjes uit religieuze minderheden onderworpen worden aan gedwongen huwelijken en mensenhandel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bevindingen van het Panel of Experts on Yemen dat Nederlandse wapenexportvergunningen zijn misbruikt

Karabulut (SP) asked whether Dutch components found in intercepted Iranian air-defence missiles bound for Yemen reflect misuse of Dutch export licences, what the government shared with the UN Panel of Experts, and what it will do to prevent recurrence. The government confirmed the components were of Dutch origin, said the firms acted in good faith as targets of covert procurement, stated licences were conditioned on no re-export, and promised tightened company practices, EU information sharing and an export-control proposal, while declining to name other firms.
We cannot make any statements about this in public.
Wij kunnen hierover in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de virtuele handelsmissie India, de omstreden landbouwwetten, de repressie van de maatschappelijke protesten en mogelijke gevolgen voor Nederlandse bedrijven

MP Voordewind asked whether the February 2021 virtual Dutch trade mission to India discussed Indian farm laws, farmer protests, forced and child labour, Dalit discrimination, journalists' prosecution and internet shutdowns, and the state of EU-India trade talks. The ministers replied that no talks with the Indian government took place during the mission, that CSR was stressed to participants, and that human rights concerns are raised regularly bilaterally and in the EU, with trade negotiations on hold since 2013.
During the virtual trade mission, no talks took place with the Indian government.
Tijdens de virtuele handelsmissie hebben geen gesprekken met de Indiase regering plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smeulders over het IMVB-convenant Pensioenfondsen

An MP asked the ministers about the slow implementation of the IMVB pension fund covenant, including the monitoring commission's findings, passive investments and accountability. The minister acknowledged the shortfall, attributed it partly to the late toolkit, promised an action plan and enhanced support, and said the covenant has no legal consequences.
Failing to meet the agreed commitments has no legal consequences.
Het niet halen van vastgelegde afspraken heeft geen juridische consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Gerven over het rapport ‘The Sobering Truth: Incentivizing Alcohol Death and Disability’

MPs Alkaya and Van Gerven asked whether Dutch subsidies to development projects involving alcohol producers such as Heineken, which allegedly worsen alcohol harm and conflict with SDG 3.5, should be stopped. The minister replied that the projects support farmers' food and income security, that EUR 300,000 was added in 2018 with no new subsidies since, that additionality was met, and that the government will not exclude such partnerships.
Question 7: Are you willing to stop providing support to projects in developing countries involving Dutch alcohol producers and instead invest in projects reducing alcohol problems?
Vraag 7 Bent u bereid voortaan geen steun meer te verlenen aan projecten in ontwikkelingslanden waar Nederlandse alcoholproducenten bij betrokken zijn

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over pogingen van de Europese Commissie om kritische EU-lidstaten en nationale parlementen buitenspel te zetten bij het EU-Mercosur-verdrag, naar aanleiding van berichtgeving in Po

An MP asks the trade minister whether the Commission is trying to bypass critical member states and national parliaments by possibly splitting the EU-Mercosur agreement into separate trade and political parts, which would remove the Dutch veto and parliamentary ratification over the trade part. The minister answers that no Commission proposal exists yet, that the agreement's nature is determined only once the text is final, that the Council decides on any split, and that the government will not take a position before definitive texts are presented.
The cabinet is accountable to the Chamber for the position it takes in the Council.
Het kabinet legt verantwoording af aan de Kamer over de positie die wordt ingenomen in de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over UNRWA-studiematerialen

Parliamentarian Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about IMPACT-SE findings that UNRWA home-schooling materials contained incitement to violence and denial of Israel and Jewish history, and whether the government would reconsider its UNRWA funding and raise the issue with UNRWA and the Palestinian Authority. The minister answered that UNRWA removed the material and is conducting an internal review, that the government raised the matter with UNRWA and the PA, and that the government does not intend to revise its UNRWA funding.

In that light, taking into account the corrective measures UNRWA has taken and in the interest of the overall continuity of UNRWA's services, the cabinet does not intend to revise Dutch funding of UNRWA.

In dat licht, rekening houdend met de corrigerende maatregelen die UNRWA heeft genomen en in het belang van de gehele continuïteit van UNRWA’s dienstverlening, is het kabinet niet voornemens de Nederlandse financiering van UNRWA te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over vertraging in het onderzoek naar oorzaak, verloop en omvang van de knikkebolziekte in Oost-Afrika

An MP asks the foreign aid minister about delays in the research into the cause, course and extent of nodding disease in East Africa, including whether a final extension of 200,000 euro should be granted to keep following about 500 patients. The minister says the research is on track to finish by 31 July 2021 after a third extension, that no signal was received that more time or money is needed, and that a request for follow-up research does not fit ministry priorities.
I assume the research can be concluded in this way and do not want to anticipate the results of this ongoing research.
Ik ga ervan uit dat het onderzoek op deze manier kan worden afgerond en wil niet vooruitlopen op de resultaten van dit lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht 'EU still firmly opposed to lifting intellectual property rights on vaccines'

MP Van Gerven (SP) asked the ministers of Health and Foreign Trade whether the EU's opposition to suspending intellectual property rights on COVID-19 vaccines is justified, and why the government backs the C-TAP initiative and opposes the India/South Africa waiver. Minister De Jonge answers that IP suspension would not expand production, that voluntary cooperation and licensing are preferred, that a vaccine envoy has been asked to inventory domestic capacity, and that the government will not support the TRIPS waiver.
The Cabinet has received no information that would prompt it to revise its position that the existence of patents is not the reason for the current shortage of Covid-19 vaccines.
Het Kabinet heeft geen informatie ontvangen om het standpunt te herzien dat het bestaan van octrooien niet de reden is voor de huidige schaarste aan Covid-19 vaccins.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Stoffer over het artikel 'If poor countries go unvaccinated, a study says, rich ones will pay'

An SGP MP asked the ministers about a study estimating large global economic losses from unequal COVID-19 vaccine distribution, and about Dutch responsibility and economic impacts. The minister acknowledged the importance of equitable global vaccine access, pointed to Dutch contributions to COVAX and ACT-A, and said exact economic consequences cannot yet be predicted, while committing only to considering such scenarios in future decisions.
In future decisions on the COVID-19 approach, the cabinet considers a wide range of information and possible scenarios.
Het kabinet betrekt bij toekomstige besluiten met betrekking tot de inzet tegen COVID 19 een veelheid aan informatie en mogelijke scenario's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over klimaatfinanciering voor ontwikkelingslanden

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Climate Adaptation Summit 2021, the lack of clear definitions for climate finance, the use of loans, additionality, the private finance share and the Netherlands' fair share of the USD 100 billion goal. The Minister answered that the summit discussed adaptation finance without concrete agreements, that the Netherlands is open to loans in some cases, and that a new cabinet would set the next target and whether an extra calculation is desirable.
It is up to a new cabinet to set a next target and to decide whether an additional calculation is desirable.
Het is aan een nieuw kabinet om een volgende doelstelling te bepalen en of een extra calculatie wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over schade die de Palestijnse NGO UAWC lijdt door opschorting van Nederlandse financiering

An MP asked the ministers about harm suffered by the Palestinian NGO UAWC after Dutch funding was suspended pending an investigation into alleged PFLP links. The government confirmed about USD 1.08 million in payments were withheld, said it will take no steps to ensure UAWC's continuity until the external investigation concludes, and answered the remaining questions largely by restating policy on Area C and Israeli settlement activity.
Pending the external investigation into UAWC, the cabinet will not take any steps to guarantee UAWC's continuity.
Het kabinet zal hangende het externe onderzoek naar UAWC geen stappen zetten om de continuïteit van UAWC te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de gaswinning en het escalerende geweld in Noord-Mozambique

An MP from GroenLinks asked the ministers about escalating violence in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, linked to gas extraction, including Dutch export credit insurance for the project. The government answered that it monitors the situation, pressures Mozambique and the EU, supports humanitarian aid, and that Atradius DSB has issued a cover commitment for the gas project while withholding details of the insured parties and amounts as commercially sensitive.
Information on which companies and/or financial institutions are involved and for which insured amounts cannot yet be shared with the House because the insurance policies have not yet been issued.

Informatie over welke bedrijven en/of financiële instellingen dit betreft en voor welke te verzekeren bedragen kan echter nog niet met uw Kamer gedeeld worden omdat de verzekeringspolissen nog niet zijn afgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind en Van Helvert over de Ranglijst Christenvervolging 2021 van Open Doors

Three MPs (Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert) asked the foreign minister about the Open Doors 2021 Christian persecution ranking, covering FoRB envoy vacancy, persecution in Nigeria, China, India and Turkey, COVID aid, and export controls. The minister answered at length, mostly restating policy and concerns, while declining to commit to specific new initiatives beyond existing diplomacy.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de situatie in Oeganda

An MP from the CDA asked the Dutch government about the social media and internet blockade in Uganda around the January 2021 elections, the security situation, EU engagement, civil society restrictions, the detention of human rights lawyer Opiyo, and Bobi Wine's house arrest. The minister answered that social media was blocked and internet restored only slowly, that the EU has raised concerns through political dialogue and statements, that Dutch embassy staff attended hearings and visited Wine, and that international observers were largely limited to the AU, IGAD and EAC.
The Netherlands will work within the EU to ensure that the mentioned topics remain high on the EU dialogue agenda with Uganda.
Nederland zal zich er in EU-verband voor inspannen dat de genoemde onderwerpen hoog op de agenda van de EU-dialoog met Oeganda blijven staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een veroordeelde terrorist die werkzaam is bij de Israëlische organisatie Shurat Hadin

An MP asked the ministers whether the government was concerned about a convicted terrorist working at Shurat Hadin, a conference appearance by its director, and whether NGO Monitor's conference framing was acceptable. The minister said the government had noted the reports, that freedom of expression applies to organisations like NGO Monitor within legal limits, and that the questions would be answered separately.
Freedom of expression applies in full, to everyone and without regard to persons, within the limits of the law.
De vrijheid van meningsuiting geldt onverkort, voor iedereen en zonder aanzien des persoons binnen de grenzen van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over administratieve lastendruk exporterend mkb

An MP from the CDA asked the ministers how administrative burden on exporting SMEs has grown since the COVID crisis, including translation and customs paperwork, support channels, monitoring, fraud labelling, and EU and bilateral action. The government answered that it does not systematically track whether burden rises, points to existing helplines, life-events tools and the Exportwijzer, and says the EU is working on trade barriers and better regulation.
In general, the cabinet does not keep track of whether administrative burden rises or falls.
In het algemeen wordt door het kabinet niet bijgehouden of de administratieve lastendruk stijgt of daalt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht Verzekeraars onder vuur om investeren in wapens

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether major Dutch insurers investing in arms makers breach the IMVO covenant for the insurance sector, whether they contribute to human rights abuses under UNPRI definitions, and whether they will be asked to show OECD due diligence. The minister answers that investment choices are individual insurer responsibilities, the covenant monitoring commission does not supervise individual investments, the UNPRI linkage question cannot be settled from the report, and offers a follow-up dialogue with insurers and expected transparency work.
However, this committee does not supervise the individual investments of individual insurers, since the covenant does not prescribe in which sectors or companies insurers may invest.

Deze commissie houdt echter geen toezicht op de afzonderlijke beleggingen van individuele verzekeraars, aangezien het convenant niet voorschrijft in welke sectoren of bedrijven verzekeraars mogen beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over maatschappelijk verantwoord investeren en wapenproductie

SP MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about insurers investing in arms producers, the implementation of the insurance sector IMVO covenant, and whether the government will act on the Eerlijke Verzekeringswijzer findings. The minister replied that insurers bear individual responsibility under OECD guidelines, pointed to a themakader and webinar, said a follow-up meeting with insurers is planned, and stated that broader mandatory due diligence legislation is the direction of policy.
The cabinet shares the conclusion that the outcome of the covenants alone is not sufficient.
Het kabinet deelt de conclusie dat het resultaat van de convenanten alleen niet voldoende is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat Afrika getroffen dreigt te worden door een tweede coronagolf

MP Alkaya asked the minister about reports of a second COVID-19 wave in Africa, whether extra funding would be provided for developing countries, how many vaccines Africa would receive via COVAX AMC, how the Netherlands would contribute to the additional USD 5 billion needed, and whether it would support suspending COVID vaccine patents. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to existing and additional funding (EUR 25 million for COVAX AMC plus earlier contributions), gave COVAX supply projections, and opposed patent suspension while supporting pragmatic EU and WTO discussion.
Apart from these contributions, and beyond the regular BHOS efforts already set out in the 2021 budget, no additional funds are currently foreseen.
Naast deze bijdragen zijn – naast de reguliere inspanningen van BHOS zoals ook vastgesteld met de begroting 2021 – momenteel geen aanvullende middelen voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen die in Nederland aankwamen, waren al statushouders in Griekenland’

MPs Kuiken, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked whether only 50 of the promised 100 children and vulnerable people had arrived from Greece, whether recent arrivals already held Greek status, whether the government would meet the Moria deal, and whether it would reverse returns and act on conditions on Lesbos. The government answered that it will not make an additional relocation offer, that status holders in the Netherlands are returned to Greece as lawful under EU rules, and that conditions at Mavrovouni are better than at Moria though still needing structural improvement.
The cabinet does not intend to make an additional relocation offer.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om een additioneel herplaatsingsaanbod te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de zorgelijke ontwikkelingen voor het maatschappelijk middenveld in Oeganda in aanloop naar de verkiezingen

An MP asked the minister about threats to civil society and press freedom in Uganda before elections, including deadly violence, the revoked accreditation of an electoral monitoring group, and calls for an EU statement. The minister answered that the Netherlands has voiced concern jointly with the EU and like-minded partners, called for press freedom and civil society space, and will monitor the situation, but did not address domestic accountability in the Netherlands.

The Netherlands has spoken out in various ways over the past months, including within the EU and with like-minded countries, about the situation in Uganda, sharing concerns about the shrinking space for media and civil society.

Nederland heeft zich de afgelopen maanden op verschillende manieren, onder meer in EU-verband en met gelijkgezinden, uitgesproken over de situatie in Uganda, waarbij zorgen zijn gedeeld over de krimpende ruimte voor de media en het maatschappelijk middenveld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Becker over subsidie aan de organisatie Islamic Relief

MPs Weverling and Becker asked the ministers why Islamic Relief was selected for Power of Voices subsidy despite alleged links to the Muslim Brotherhood and German funding being stopped, and what the government would do about subsidies to organisations opposing integration. The minister answered that no subsidy will be granted to Islamic Relief Worldwide, that the Dutch intelligence services assess the Muslim Brotherhood's presence in the Netherlands as limited, and that municipalities decide their own subsidies, with the Rijk informing them of problematic conduct.
Based on the information available to me, however, I have decided not to grant Islamic Relief Worldwide a subsidy.
Op basis van de mij beschikbare informatie heb ik evenwel besloten om Islamic Relief Worldwide geen subsidie te verlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over de uitzending van Zembla over de betrokkenheid van Shell-medewerkers bij het creëren van olielekkages in de Nigerdelta

MPs Alkaya and Karabulut asked the ministers about a Zembla broadcast alleging Shell staff paid youths to cause oil spills in the Niger Delta, whether the Dutch government knew, and related issues. The government answered that the allegations are a matter for Nigerian prosecutors, that the former ambassador was informed in 2018 but the matter was not passed on, and that no external inquiry is needed, while citing Shell's $900 million clean-up commitment.
An external inquiry into the relationship between the Dutch embassy and Shell would, in our view, produce no new relevant information and is therefore not desirable.
Een extern onderzoek naar de relatie tussen de Nederlandse ambassade en Shell zal naar onze mening geen nieuwe relevante informatie opleveren en is om die reden niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Roon over de Nederlandse positie ten aanzien van terreurorganisatie Ahrar al-Sham

An MP asks the foreign and development ministers whether Ahrar al-Sham should be treated as a terrorist organisation, whether it should be placed on the national terrorism list, whether former members should be prosecuted and residence permits revoked, and whether Non-Lethal Assistance funds reached the group. The government replies that the ministry relies on UN/EU lists and intelligence assessments, that the group is not considered a direct national security threat, that no NLA reached it, and that the national sanctions list lacks Dutch links so no listing is made.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has had no contact with the Syrian arrested recently in Rijssen.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft geen contact gehad met de onlangs in Rijssen gearresteerde Syriër.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het lopende onderzoek naar Knikkebolziekte in Oost Afrika

An MP asked the minister about the status of a government-funded study into nodding disease in Zuid-Soedan, including delays from unrest and whether funding should be extended to complete follow-up of affected children. The minister confirmed the study is ongoing, cited two earlier extensions and a third extension to July 2021 due to COVID-19 delays, and said the study should be completed.
To that end, at the request of the researchers, I already granted a third extension in August until July 2021.
Ik heb daartoe op verzoek van de onderzoekers in augustus reeds een derde verlenging toegekend tot juli 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat Oeganda 21 miljoen misloopt door Nederland

MPs Alkaya and Leijten asked whether the Netherlands-Uganda tax treaty lets companies such as Airtel and CNOOC avoid Ugandan tax, how much Uganda loses, and what the government will do. The Staatssecretaris answered that individual taxpayers cannot be discussed, that the treaty lacks anti-abuse rules that the government wants to add quickly, and that renegotiation has been pursued since 2013 with Uganda slow to respond.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act I cannot discuss the tax position of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan ik niet ingaan op de fiscale positie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over het bericht 'Oeganda loopt €21 miljoen mis door Nederland (en dat is het topje van de ijsberg)'

MPs Snels and Van den Nieuwenhuijzen asked the government about a Volkskrant report that Uganda loses tax revenue through Dutch structures, including dividend exemption under the Netherlands-Uganda treaty and the adequacy of anti-abuse rules. The Secretary of State answered all 12 questions substantively, defending the treaty's purpose, citing confidentiality limits for individual taxpayers, and committing to add anti-abuse provisions to the Uganda treaty and new conditional withholding taxes.
Under Article 67 of the General Tax Act (AWR) I cannot comment on the situation of an individual taxpayer.
Op grond van artikel 67 van de Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen (AWR) kan ik niet ingaan op de situatie van een individuele belastingplichtige.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Voordewind over kwetsbare kinderen die in arme landen door de coronacrisis uit beeld raken

MPs Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about vulnerable children in poor countries who risk falling out of view during the COVID-19 crisis, including school closures, child marriage, FGM, online abuse and child trafficking. The minister confirmed the figures in part, cited UNESCO, UNFPA, UNICEF and other sources, and pointed to existing programmes and a commitment to raise the issue in EU Council conclusions.
The Netherlands will also raise the position of vulnerable children in the context of EU Council conclusions on the consequences of the coronavirus pandemic for human rights.
Nederland zal de positie van kwetsbare kinderen ook aan de orde stellen in het kader van EU Raadsconclusies over de consequenties van de Coronapandemie op mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat Canada de Europese voedselveiligheid verwatert

An SP MP asked the government to respond to a media report that Canada was weakening EU food safety standards through CETA, including claims about pesticide import tolerances and EU concessions. The minister rejected the claims, saying the import tolerance rules have been unchanged since 2005, CETA does not affect EU food safety standards, and any future EU proposals would be shared with parliament.
If EU proposals are submitted that concern food safety standards, your House will be informed of this in the usual ways, for example through BNC fiches.

Als er EU-wijzigingsvoorstellen worden ingediend die betrekking hebben op voedselveiligheidsstandaarden, dan wordt uw Kamer daar op de gebruikelijke manieren, bijvoorbeeld door middel van BNC-fiches, over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Van Ojik en Bromet over het verzwakken van Europese standaarden voor landbouwgif onder Canadese druk via CETA

MPs from GroenLinks asked the trade and development minister whether CETA weakens EU pesticide safety standards, including reports of a shift to case-by-case risk assessment and Canadian pressure via CETA committees. The minister denied any abandonment of the precautionary principle, said the Netherlands opposed refusing import tolerances, and stated that CETA committees cannot change EU law and no concessions were made.
CETA does not affect the precautionary principle, which is anchored in EU law.
CETA tast het voorzorgsprincipe, dat is verankerd in EU-recht, niet aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het rapport 'Women’s rights violations in Dutch palm oil supply chains: the case of Guatemala'

The MP asks whether the government shares concerns about women's rights violations in Guatemala's palm oil sector and whether Dutch companies and the Port of Rotterdam (partly state-owned) are meeting due diligence expectations, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the concerns, says the government has no supervisory role over companies' OECD guideline compliance, and commits to new IMVO policy including a planned broad due diligence obligation, a Europe-first approach, a IMVO support desk, and a NAP revision expected in autumn 2021.
The cabinet strongly prefers a European broad due diligence obligation and will therefore make maximum efforts to influence developments in Europe to achieve one.
Het kabinet heeft een sterke voorkeur voor een Europese brede due diligence verplichting en zal daarom maximaal inzetten op het beïnvloeden van de ontwikkelingen in Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Deze beruchte militie uit Soedan krijgt «veiligheidstraining» betaald door de EU'

An MP asked the minister whether the EU was financing security training for the Rapid Support Forces in Sudan, a militia linked to Darfur war crimes and people smuggling. The minister denied EU funding for that training, said the EU-funded OHCHR programme excludes RSF members, and promised vetting of trainees and continued contact with human rights organisations.
The reporting is not correct. The EU does not provide financial support for the security training in question and does not intend to do so in the future.
De berichtgeving klopt niet. De EU geeft geen financiële ondersteuning aan genoemde veiligheidstrainingtraining en is ook niet van plan dit in de toekomst te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Kuik over het bericht dat de Soedanese paramilitaire groep RSF steun krijgt van de Europese Unie

Two MPs (GroenLinks and CDA) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the EU funds training for the Sudanese paramilitary RSF, and about the EU's role in Sudan's transition. The minister answers that the EU does not finance RSF training, that OHCHR activities exclude the RSF, that vetting measures apply, and that no further EU guidelines are deemed necessary.
Both claims are incorrect. The EU does not provide financial support for the said training and does not plan to do so in the future.
Beide stellingen kloppen niet. De EU geeft geen financiële ondersteuning aan genoemde trainingen en is ook niet van plan dit in de toekomst te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Sjoerdsma, Van den Hul en Van den Niewenhuijzen over het bericht dat Palestijnse kinderen worden mishandeld en vernederd in Israëlische gevangenissen

MPs from D66, PvdA and GroenLinks asked the ministers whether they knew of Save the Children reports of mistreatment of Palestinian children in Israeli detention, and what the government would do about military trial of minors. The minister acknowledged the reports, condemned the practices, said Nederland has raised the issue with Israeli authorities and will keep doing so, and mentioned support for NGO projects.
The Netherlands will continue to voice its concerns to the Israeli government.
Nederland zal haar zorgen blijven uitspreken naar de Israëlische regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van den Hul over een ten onrechte ontslagen klokkenluider op de ambassade in Nigeria

MPs Karabulut and Van den Hul asked about a whistleblower at the Abuja embassy whom a court found was wrongly dismissed, and about alleged leaking of confidential information to Shell and whether the ambassador was dismissed. The minister acknowledged the ruling, said lessons will be drawn and that the complainant's dismissal was not properly handled, but declined to give details of the investigation citing personnel confidentiality, and said no new embassy guidelines are needed.
Unfortunately, BZ did not succeed in convincing the judge that the employee's dismissal was not the result of the integrity report they had made.
Helaas is BZ er niet in geslaagd de rechter ervan te overtuigen dat het ontslag van de medewerker niet het gevolg was van de integriteitsmelding die zij had gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de geestelijke gezondheidszorg in ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports of people with psychosocial disabilities being shackled, and how Dutch development policy would address mental health care in developing countries. The minister said the Netherlands integrates mental health and psychosocial support into humanitarian, peace-building and health programmes, rejects funding for practices like shackling, and described WHO and other multilateral efforts, noting WHO's mental health share of its budget is 0.7%.
It is a harrowing report describing a degrading but unfortunately familiar situation.
Het is een heftig rapport dat een mensonterende, maar helaas bekende, situatie beschrijft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bergkamp, Özütok, Bouali en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over aandacht voor de kwetsbare positie van oa. LHBTI’s in de nationale en internationale COVID-19 respons

MPs asked the government about the vulnerable position of LHBTI people during the COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands and internationally, including healthcare access for transgender people and UN recommendations. The Minister answered that impacts are being studied (Movisie survey due in autumn), referred healthcare questions to another minister, said the UN refugee camp reports were not confirmed, and described Dutch advocacy at the UN.
This question falls under the policy area of the Minister for Medical Care and Sport (MZS).
Deze vraag ligt op het beleidsterrein van de Minister voor Medische Zorg en Sport (MZS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Amnesty legt activiteiten in India voorlopig stil na blokkade bankrekeningen'

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers about the Indian freezing of Amnesty International's bank accounts, which forced the organisation to halt activities, and whether the government shares concern about shrinking civil society space and about the Indian government's actions against human rights groups. The minister acknowledged concern about the pressure on human rights organisations, said the Indian investigation concerns foreign funding rules, declined to pre-judge its outcome, and said the Netherlands raised the matter with Indian and EU counterparts.
The Netherlands raised the matter together with EU partners with various Indian interlocutors in New Delhi and Brussels.
Nederland heeft de kwestie gezamenlijk met EU-partners aan de orde gesteld bij diverse Indiase gesprekspartners in New Delhi en Brussel.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bromet en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de artikelen 'Milieuwetten Brazilië versoepeld: bescherming kustbossen opgeheven» en «Import sojabonen uit Brazilië 40 procent hoger'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about Brazil loosening environmental laws, including protection of coastal forests, and about a 40 percent rise in Dutch soy imports from Brazil. The government acknowledged the reports, said Brazil's changes are being discussed through bilateral and EU dialogue, and argued the soy rise mainly serves other European markets while committing to EU-level deforestation-free import measures.

The Netherlands conducts, bilaterally and with European partners, an active dialogue with the Brazilian government on the importance of climate and environmental protection and combating deforestation.
Nederland voert, bilateraal en met Europese partners, een actieve dialoog met de Braziliaanse regering over het belang van klimaat- en milieubescherming en de bestrijding van ontbossing.
Antwoord op vragen va het lid Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over speculeren met schulden van ontwikkelingslanden door zogeheten ‘Aasgierfondsen’

An MP asked the minister about vulture funds speculating on developing-country debt, including whether Dutch aid ends up with them and whether anti-vulture-fund legislation should be introduced. The minister replied that Dutch support for the African Legal Support Facility and collective action clauses is helping, that no cases of Dutch aid reaching vulture funds are known though full exclusion is impossible, and that a multilateral approach via the IMF is preferred over national or EU legislation.
Although there is no unambiguous definition, vulture funds refers to a small part of bondholders investing in heavily discounted sovereign debt.
Hoewel er geen eenduidige definitie bestaat, wordt met aasgierfondsen gedoeld op een klein deel van de obligatiebeleggers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over het artikel ‘Behind China’s Decade of European Deals, State Investors Evade Notice’

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about reports that Chinese state investors evade notice in European deals, including in the Netherlands. The ministers acknowledge close Chinese state involvement and state risks to national security, outlining a planned investment screening law (Toetsing Economie en Veiligheid) and EU FDI screening regulation, but give no concrete findings on specific Chinese investments.
The cabinet is currently working on establishing a system of investment screening.
Het kabinet werkt op dit moment aan de totstandkoming van een stelsel van investeringstoetsing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en De Groot over het bericht dat een onomkeerbare ontwikkeling van regenwoud naar savanne dreigt voor de Amazone

Two MPs from D66 asked whether the government is aware of a study warning the Amazon is nearing a tipping point toward savannah, whether this warrants intensified forest protection, and what measures can keep deforestation-linked products out of the European market. The minister confirmed the study fits earlier warnings, said Dutch forest efforts were stepped up this year and will continue, pointed to EU-level legislative and non-legislative work on deforestation-free supply chains, and reported that Brazil has agreed to dialogue following the Amsterdam Declarations Partnership letter.

Within the European Union, legislative and non-legislative measures are being developed, partly under the Green Deal, to help reduce the ecological footprint of EU consumption and make supply chains deforestation-free.

Binnen de Europese Unie wordt, mede in het kader van de Green Deal, gewerkt aan wetgevende en niet-wetgevende maatregelen, die helpen bij het verkleinen van de ecologische voetafdruk van de EU-consumptie en het ontbossingsvrij maken van handelsketens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Snels over belastingontwijking ten koste van ontwikkelingslanden

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether developing countries lose money to tax avoidance via the Netherlands, citing a ActionAid estimate of 1.8 billion euros a year, and asked about policy goals, coherence, and specific recommendations. The government disputes the estimate's basis, says it has no reliable measure of avoidance, and describes existing and planned anti-avoidance measures while rejecting several recommendations such as broader withholding taxes and a UN tax body.
The government itself does not make estimates of lost tax revenue in other countries.
Het kabinet maakt zelf geen schattingen van misgelopen belastinginkomsten in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, Wilders en Van Weerdenburg over ‘nog meer Nederlands hulpgeld voor Palestijnse terroristen’

MPs De Roon, Wilders and Van Weerdenburg (PVV) asked why Dutch aid money goes to Palestinian NGO Al-Mezan, alleged to have ties with PFLP and Hamas, and demanded vetting of all Palestinian aid recipients and suspension of aid. The government denied evidence of links, said it will await an external investigation into UAWC, promised to remove posts from individual staff, and refused to halt aid or close the Ramallah mission.
The cabinet does not provide support to organisations that have ties with terrorist organisations and checks whether the Dutch contribution to these organisations is spent on the agreed objectives.

Het kabinet geeft geen steun aan organisaties die banden hebben met terroristische organisaties en controleert of de Nederlandse bijdrage aan deze organisaties wordt besteed aan de afgesproken doelstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Dik-Faber over het besluit Nr. 1/2020 van het Associatiecomité EU-Marokko van 16 maart 2020

ChristenUnie MPs asked whether the EU-Morocco association committee decision on annual information exchange, and the trade preferences extended to products from Western Sahara, has led to exports to the EU and the Netherlands, whether such products are correctly labelled, and whether a list of exported products will be requested and enforced by the NVWA. The government confirmed the exports and the operational information mechanism, said food labelling rules apply regardless of origin and enforcement lies with the NVWA on a risk basis, but did not commit to a new list or specific enforcement.
Part of the agreed information exchange between the EU and Morocco is that Morocco shares with the EU data on exports of products originating in Western Sahara to the EU.

Onderdeel van de overeengekomen informatie-uitwisseling tussen de EU en Marokko is dat Marokko gegevens over de uitvoer van producten van oorsprong uit de Westelijke Sahara naar de EU deelt met de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Bouali, Karabulut en Van Ojik over het bericht 'Israël martelde verdachte Palestijnen van een NGO gesteund door Nederland'

MPs asked whether the Israeli detention and alleged torture of two former staff of the Palestinian NGO UAWC, which the Netherlands supports, breaches international law, and about military trial, access to counsel and administrative detention. The ministers say the Netherlands is concerned, has raised torture and fair-trial rights with Israel and the EU, notes an Israeli Justice Ministry inquiry without published results, and will keep monitoring the case.
The Netherlands will continue to follow the progress.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over Canadese wetgeving die het openbaar maken van misstanden in de dierindustrie strafbaar stelt (Bill 156) en over de dood van de Canadese dierenrechtenactiviste Regan Russell

An MP asked the Dutch ministers about Ontario's Bill 156, which criminalises exposing animal abuse in farming, and about the death of activist Regan Russell, along with Canadian animal welfare commitments under CETA. The government says Bill 156 is not a response to the abuse cases, that protest rights are not affected, that the Russell death was investigated with a careless-driving charge, and that it will keep the Russell investigation under watch and raise animal welfare within CETA dialogue.
The cabinet cannot confirm that the Canadian province of Ontario adopted Bill 156 in response to the aforementioned cases.
Het kabinet kan niet bevestigen dat de Canadese Provincie Ontario Bill 156 heeft aangenomen in reactie op de eerder genoemde zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over investeringen van ontwikkelingsbanken in de vee-industrie

MP Van Raan asks the Finance and Foreign Trade and Development ministers why development banks such as IFC and EBRD finance industrial livestock, which he considers harmful to climate goals and to developing countries. The minister replies that such investments are limited, are screened against strict environmental and climate criteria, serve food security, and that Nederland pushes banks to align portfolios with Paris goals; he gives a detailed overview of Dutch shareholdings and sector financing by other banks, without committing to halting livestock investments.
The Netherlands exerts influence through its representation on the institutions' executive boards, participation in replenishment negotiations for the banks' funds, and contributions to Trust Funds.

Nederland oefent onder meer invloed uit via de vertegenwoordiging in de uitvoerende raden van de instellingen en door deelname aan overlegrondes over middelenaanvullingen van de fondsen van de banken en door bijdragen aan Trust Funds.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘China weert Nederlands varkensvlees om coronavirus’

An MP asked the minister whether China's suspension of four Dutch pork exporters over COVID-19 was justified, given WHO/FAO findings that food does not transmit the virus, and whether the government would act on it. The minister confirmed awareness, said two of the four plants had been reinstated, that the affected export value is still unclear, and that the government has raised the issue with China and, via the European Commission, with a joint EU response.
This subject has been discussed with the European Commission at various levels. Pressure has been applied for a joint response towards China.
Dit onderwerp is op verschillende niveaus besproken met de Europese Commissie. Er is aangedrongen op een gezamenlijke reactie richting China.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Ngo’s: hele modewereld betrokken bij dwangarbeid Oeigoeren'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about reports that the fashion industry is linked to forced labour of Uyghurs in China, including what concrete steps were taken, whether companies should be mapped, and whether further international reactions would follow. The ministers answered that the Netherlands raises Xinjiang human rights bilaterally, in the EU and at the UN Human Rights Council, that companies bear primary due diligence responsibility, that no overview of linked companies exists, and that further raising of the issue is planned.
The cabinet has no overview of companies that are linked through their supply chain to the situation in Xinjiang.
Het kabinet heeft geen overzicht van bedrijven die via hun toeleveringsketen zijn gelinkt aan de situatie in Xinjiang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Van den Hul en Voordewind over de rapportering van de bedrijven aangesloten bij het textiel convenant

MPs Alkaya, Van den Hul and Voordewind asked the minister about a SOMO and Schone Kleren Campagne report finding weak public CSR reporting by textile covenant firms, including on access to remedy and living wage. The minister acknowledged the shortcomings, outlined steps via the SER secretariat and steering group, and largely deferred to the covenant's own monitoring.
Companies themselves are responsible for the content and form of their reporting.
Bedrijven zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de inhoud en vorm van hun rapportage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Kuik over de arrestatie en gevangenneming van mensenrechtenverdedigers in Niger

MPs Van Helvert and Kuik asked the ministers about the detention of human rights defenders in Niger, including two trade union leaders, and whether Dutch aid to youth employment programmes is hindered as a result. The ministers said they raised the case with Nigerien authorities through several diplomatic channels, will keep following it while respecting judicial independence, and that the detentions are hindering one part of the programme but the Dutch youth employment efforts continue.
The Netherlands will continue to follow this matter closely, with respect for the independent judicial process in Niger.
Nederland blijft deze kwestie nauwlettend volgen, met respect voor de onafhankelijke rechtsgang in Niger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de leefomstandigheden van overlevers van de genocide in Srebrenica

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about living conditions for Srebrenica genocide survivors still housed in collective centres 25 years later. The minister confirmed about 5,000 displaced persons remain in centres, acknowledged poor conditions, and listed past Dutch and EU support including housing projects and an ongoing centre-closure programme, committing only to continued pressure on Bosnian authorities.
After years of intensive support, the Netherlands urges the Bosnian authorities to ensure adequate housing and, where desired, return of displaced persons.
Na jarenlang intensieve steun, spoort Nederland de Bosnische autoriteiten aan om te zorgen voor adequate huisvesting en -desgewenst- terugkeer van ontheemden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de handelsbetrekkingen met Suriname

MP Weverling (VVD) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about trade and investment ties with Suriname, including trade volumes, Dutch support for business climate and diaspora involvement. Minister Kaag answered that trade could get a new impulse, reported 2019 imports of 29 million euro and exports of 223 million euro, and largely deferred responsibility for Suriname's business climate and resource development to the Surinamese government.
It is up to the Surinamese government to decide whether and which foreign expertise and foreign companies it involves in developing the natural resources and the associated value chains.

Het is aan de Surinaamse overheid om te besluiten of en zo ja, welke buitenlandse deskundigheid en buitenlandse ondernemingen het bij de ontwikkeling van de natuurlijke hulpbronnen en de daarbij behorende waardeketens betrekt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Weverling, Van der Staaij en De Roon over het bericht dat twee terreurverdachten indirect salaris hebben ontvangen met behulp van Nederlandse financiële steun aan de Palestijns

Four MPs asked why the government kept funding the Palestinian NGO UAWC after learning that two suspected terror-linked employees received salary via Dutch-funded overhead, and whether this shows inadequate vetting and BDS-related risks. The minister admitted the earlier conclusion was wrong, suspended payments, commissioned an external investigation, but largely defended the vetting process, rejected reconsidering funding for BDS-adjacent organisations, and answered each question.
Because careful action on this point is extremely important, I have decided to commission an external investigation into possible links between PFLP and UAWC.
Omdat zorgvuldig handelen op dit punt uiterst belangrijk is heb ik besloten om een extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar eventuele banden tussen PFLP en UAWC

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de betrokkenheid van door Nederland betaalde UAWC-medewerkers bij de terreurorganisatie PFLP en het feit dat zij verdacht worden van een terreuraanslag, waarbij

MPs Van Helvert and Omtzigt asked the foreign and development ministers what the government knew about Dutch-funded UAWC staff allegedly linked to the PFLP and a 2019 bombing, and about the funding involved. The ministers answered that the staff were paid partly from Dutch project funds, that payments were suspended, that audits were not yet shared due to data protection, and that an external investigation has been commissioned.
Our intention is to share these documents with you as soon as possible.
Onze intentie is om deze documenten zo spoedig mogelijk met u te delen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Omtzigt over de financiering van UAWC met Nederlands belastinggeld en de overeenkomst tussen Nederland en de UAWC nadat bekend geworden was dat twee hooggeplaatste medewerke

Two CDA MPs asked why Dutch funding to UAWC continued after two former staff were suspected of a terrorist bombing, and about the subsidy agreement's reporting and sanction clauses. The ministers answered that funding was suspended, that no irregularities were formally reported under article 6, that UAWC is not listed as terrorist by the EU, UN or Netherlands, and that an external investigation will be commissioned.
The cabinet nonetheless considers it necessary to commission further external research into UAWC in light of the recent developments.
Het kabinet acht het niettemin noodzakelijk nader extern onderzoek naar UAWC te laten doen op grond van de recente ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de verlening van vergunningen voor wapenexport naar landen die een VN-wapenembargo schenden

An MP asked the minister why an arms export licence was granted to Egypt for €114 million of naval radar and C3 systems despite Egypt's alleged breaches of the UN Libya arms embargo, Egypt's human rights record, and its role in Yemen, and whether the Chamber could be informed before such licences are issued. The minister answered that Egypt is not under an arms embargo, that no clear diversion or misuse risk was identified under the EU criteria, and refused to revoke the licence or pre-inform parliament, while stating ongoing monitoring of the situation.
No. For the sake of legal certainty for companies, it is important that the assessment framework is fixed when the licence is applied for and that it is applied objectively.

Nee. Omwille van de rechtszekerheid voor bedrijven is het van belang dat het toetsingskader vast staat op het moment dat de vergunning wordt aangevraagd en dat dit toetsingskader objectief wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de afgifte van een vergunning voor export militair materieel naar Egypte

An SP MP asked the government about an export licence for military radar and C3 equipment to Egypt, including its possible use in the Yemen blockade, human rights concerns and Libya tensions. The minister declined to give details on the licence and product for confidentiality reasons, said the licence was assessed under the EU Common Position, and refused to suspend it.
No statements can be made about the details of the application. That concerns commercially confidential information.
Er kunnen geen uitspraken worden gedaan over de details van de aanvraag. Dat betreft bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het evaluatierapport van de schoonmaak van Ogoniland

An SP MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on the stalled clean-up of Ogoniland in the Niger Delta, including drinking water, complex sites, Shell's role in HYPREP, and whether Shell should be excluded from trade missions.
