The minister acknowledged the slow progress, pointed to Nigerian and UNEP responsibility, and said exclusion from trade missions is aimed at improving conduct rather than excluding firms, with no sector-wide IMVO plan yet delivered.
The assessment framework for trade missions is aimed at improving the situation and not at excluding companies.
Het toetsingskader voor handelsmissies is gericht op het verbeteren van de situatie en niet op het uitsluiten van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Tunisia: Two-Year Sentence for Homosexuality’

Two PvdA MPs asked the foreign ministers about a Tunisian court sentence of two years for homosexuality, including whether the Netherlands had raised concerns, condemned forced anal examinations as torture, and what the Tunisian LGBTI equality commission's stalling means for the relationship. The minister answered that the embassy monitors the case, the Netherlands opposes criminalisation and forced anal examinations and raises LGBTI rights in bilateral and multilateral fora, and that progress on the equality commission has been slow, with the Netherlands continuing to press for implementation.

The embassy is in close contact with the NGO supporting the two convicted men with legal advice and will decide in consultation with those involved whether contact with the Tunisian authorities is desirable.

De ambassade staat in nauw contact met de NGO die de twee veroordeelden bijstaat met juridisch advies en zal in samenspraak met betrokkenen besluiten of contact met Tunesische autoriteiten wenselijk is.
Nader antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de 100 miljoen euro extra aan de WHO

An MP asked about cliniclown salaries versus nurses, the 100 million euro extra to the WHO, Dutch IC capacity and which WHO advice the Netherlands followed. The minister said the salary comparison is misleading due to different funding and CAO systems, that the cost of testing and ICU expansion is not yet known or still being calculated, and that the Netherlands applies WHO guidance within its national context.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over “subsidieverlening aan een Palestijnse organisatie met terreurbanden”

Two PVV MPs asked whether the Netherlands gave about 23 million dollars in subsidies to the Palestinian NGO UAWC, whether its staff were linked to terrorism, why a petition to stop funding was ignored, and whether funding will stop immediately. The ministers confirmed funding of roughly 11.7 million euros plus earlier programmes, said two staff members arrested for an alleged bombing had received overhead salary payments, paused further payments, and ordered an external investigation before deciding on continued cooperation.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, De Roon en Voordewind over het bericht dat de Nederlandse regering waarschuwingen zou negeren over het financieren van een NGO met banden met terrorisme

MPs Van der Staaij, De Roon and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch funding to the Union of Agricultural Work Committees (UAWC) was linked to a terror group, after reports that the government ignored warnings. The minister answered that no evidence of links to listed terror organisations was found, but that after two former UAWC staff were arrested over a bombing, payments were suspended and an external investigation was commissioned.
Because careful action on this point is so important, I have decided to commission external research into possible links between the PFLP and UAWC.
Omdat zorgvuldig handelen op dit punt dermate belangrijk is heb ik besloten om extern onderzoek te laten verrichten naar eventuele banden tussen PFLP en UAWC
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over misstanden bij hulporganisatie ZOA

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reported misconduct at aid organisation ZOA, including alleged corruption and conflicts of interest in its Sudan office, and whether an investigation would be launched. The minister confirmed ZOA receives development funds, said internal and DfID reviews found the allegations unfounded so far, and said the Netherlands is discussing a further joint review with Sweden and the EU, with the House to be informed if warranted.
The Netherlands is in discussion with Sweden and the European Union about a joint further review of ZOA's country office in Sudan.
Nederland is in gesprek met Zweden en de Europese Unie over gezamenlijke verdere doorlichting van het landenkantoor van ZOA in Soedan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het sluiten van het consulaat in Nador

CDA MPs asked why the Netherlands is moving visa application services from Nador to Tanger, and whether the Nador honorary consulate is closing. The minister answered that the honorary consulate stays open and only the external visa service provider's office moves, to speed up and improve visa processing, a decision already final though paused by COVID-19.
The honorary consulate remains open and the current tasks of the consulate do not change.
Het honorair consulaat in Nador blijft geopend en de huidige taken van het consulaat veranderen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Kabinet gebruikt drukmiddelen niet om asielzoekers terug te sturen’

MP Weverling asked the minister whether the Netherlands uses leverage to secure return cooperation with countries of origin, and asked for effectiveness assessments and trade and aid overviews for fourteen countries. The government replied that Dutch return performance is relatively good, that it assesses each country individually, and referred to a letter to parliament of 10 July 2020 for details.
For each country the cabinet considers what the most effective approach is and weighs its options.
Per land bekijkt het kabinet wat de meest effectieve aanpak is en maakt het een afweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen, Van den Hul en Alkaya over het opstappen van de CEO van ontwikkelingsbank FMO

MPs asked the government about the reported toxic work culture at development bank FMO, the use of confidentiality agreements, and the departure of its CEO, including the selection of a successor. The minister replied that the state, as majority shareholder, has no direct supervisory role over FMO's work culture, that the supervisory board oversees the management board, and that the government is monitoring the situation closely while promising to follow up on the evaluation and the appointment process.
The government has no supervisory relationship with FMO and therefore also does not (directly) supervise a healthy work environment within FMO.
De regering heeft geen toezichtsrelatie met FMO en houdt dus ook geen (direct) toezicht op een gezonde werkomgeving binnen FMO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over het bericht dat de president van de Verenigde Staten de banden met de WHO verbreekt

An FvD MP asked the minister about the US withdrawal from the WHO and alleged WHO failures in favour of China early in the COVID-19 crisis, and whether Dutch funding should be suspended. The minister supported an independent evaluation after the crisis, noted the WHO's own oversight committee's view that inquiry now would weaken the response, and said funding could be reconsidered only if clear evidence of serious failings emerged.
The Netherlands supports an independent evaluation of the international corona response, including the conduct of the WHO, at an appropriate moment once the situation is under control.
Nederland steunt een onafhankelijke evaluatie van de internationale corona response, inclusief het handelen van de WHO, op een daarvoor geëigend moment wanneer de situatie onder controle is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Van den Nieuwenhuijzen over de situatie in Noord-Mozambique

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers about the insurgency in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique, including casualties, displacement, funding sources, Mozambican government conduct, press access and the case of a missing journalist. The minister answered that the situation is serious, that Dutch embassy and EU channels have raised concerns about army abuses and press freedom, and that Nederland supports development programmes and a multi-stakeholder platform, without committing to a new concrete step beyond existing diplomacy.
It is unclear whether he was actually taken away by the army.
Het is onduidelijk of hij daadwerkelijk door het leger is meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut en Van den Hul over de doorvoer van ruim 10 miljoen kogelpatronen naar Turkije

Opposition MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a transit of over 10 million cartridges from Czechia through Rotterdam to Turkey despite Dutch restrictions, and about prior assurances on Czech export checks. The minister confirmed the transit without transhipment, said no Dutch licence was required, explained that end-use details are confidential and not held in the Netherlands, and said the government would not require standard customs checks on Czech consignments.

Since the goods require a licence in Czechia rather than in the Netherlands, and given the confidential nature of the information, the cabinet cannot provide additional information on the end use of the goods.

Aangezien de goederen niet in Nederland maar in Tsjechië vergunningplichtig zijn, en gelet op de vertrouwelijke aard van de informatie kan het kabinet geen aanvullende informatie verstrekken aangaande het eindgebruik van de goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht dat er in Oekraïne honderden draagmoederbaby’s wachten tot ze opgehaald worden door hun wensouders

Van der Staaij (SGP) asked the Justice and Foreign Trade ministers about reports of hundreds of surrogacy babies in Ukraine waiting to be collected by intended parents, asking about child welfare, coercion, trafficking, Dutch involvement, nationality and whether Dutch rules can be tightened. Minister Dekker answered that Ukraine is responsible for the facts and prosecution, that Dutch surrogacy legislation is in preparation with safeguards and a ban on child-buying, and that Dutch involvement in the Hague Conference expert group continues.
It is not for me or the Netherlands but for the Ukrainian authorities to establish the actual circumstances and, where relevant, investigate and prosecute criminal offences.
Het is niet aan mij of Nederland maar aan de Oekraïense autoriteiten om de feitelijke omstandigheden vast te stellen en waar relevant strafbare feiten te onderzoeken en te vervolgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanhoudende mensenrechtenschendingen en ontbossing in Brazilië

An MP asked the government about deforestation, rights violations and a Brazilian bill legalising land grabs, and whether the Netherlands would boycott Brazil or withdraw support for the EU-Mercosur deal. The minister confirmed the reported rise in deforestation (without independent verification), described the bill's history and criticism, and said the Netherlands keeps raising concerns through dialogue, while stating boycott decisions belong to companies and consumers and that no position on Mercosur has yet been taken.
The cabinet will not take a position until the necessary documents are available.
Het kabinet zal geen standpunt innemen voordat de daartoe benodigde stukken beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat Nederlandse ambassadeur in Nigeria informatie lekte naar Shell

MPs asked whether the former Dutch ambassador to Nigeria leaked confidential information about a corruption investigation into Shell, and about the integrity investigation, handling and reasons for replacing him. The ministers refused to disclose the integrity findings and related documents citing privacy and integrity-reporting concerns, rejected the claim that he favoured Shell, and gave a limited account of the Niger Delta cleanup.
The answers to questions 1 through 7 and question 9 will be sent to your House on a confidential basis.
De antwoorden op vraag 1 t/m 7 en vraag 9 zullen uw Kamer vertrouwelijk toegaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Voordewind over het rapport 'The burning question' van Tearfund en overige berichtgeving over het verbranden van plastic afval in ontwikkelingslanden en de verantwoordelijkhei

MPs Dik-Faber and Voordewind asked the government about the Tearfund report on plastic waste burning in developing countries, corporate responsibility of major beverage and food companies, export of plastic waste, and whether Dutch plastic waste is incinerated instead of recycled. The State Secretary answered that companies should map and address risks in line with OECD guidelines, outlined existing pacts, export rules and pilot projects, and said a study on banning incineration of recyclable waste is underway, promising to inform parliament later.
I am conducting an exploration into a ban on incinerating recyclable waste.
Ik voer een verkenning uit naar een verbod op het verbranden van recyclebaar afval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Nieuwenhuijzen en Van den Hul over de verslechterende positie van LHBT+ mensen als gevolg van de COVID-19 pandemie

Two MPs asked the foreign trade and development minister and the foreign affairs minister how COVID-19 has worsened the position of LGBT+ people in developing countries, what the government knows of the situation, and what it is doing to protect them. The ministers answered that LGBTI people are especially vulnerable during the pandemic, describe support for local LGBTI organisations and advocacy through the Equal Rights Coalition and multilateral fora, while noting that public criticism is not always effective.
The Netherlands nevertheless remains, publicly or behind the scenes, a vocal advocate for equal rights for LGBTI people.
Nederland blijft echter, voor of achter de schermen, een vocale pleitbezorger voor gelijke rechten van LHBTI’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over de berichten ‘VS van plan uit WTO-onderdeel te stappen‘ en ‘Chinese bussen kunnen bij aanbesteding niet worden geweerd‘

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Dutch and provincial authorities can exclude bidders from non-GPA countries such as China from public tenders, and about reports the US may leave the WTO procurement agreement. The government replied that exclusion of non-GPA bidders is legally possible under EU and WTO rules, that the Noord-Holland and Overijssel bus cases involved private purchases rather than tenders, and that it is pursuing an International Procurement Instrument while supporting the GPA.
It is possible for Dutch and other European contracting authorities to reject bids from third countries that are not party to the WTO Government Procurement Agreement.
Het is voor Nederlandse en andere Europese aanbestedende diensten mogelijk om inschrijvingen te weigeren uit derde landen die geen partij zijn bij de Overeenkomst inzake overheidsopdrachten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het voorgenomen uitstel van nieuwe btw-regels voor e-commerce van de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the government about the EU proposal to postpone new VAT e-commerce rules, which would delay VAT on low-value parcels from outside the EU, and whether Nederland would contest this and restore the level playing field. The government confirmed the postponement, said Nederland is not ready for 1 January 2021 and benefits from delay, and gave no concrete commitment to change the EU timetable.
For these reasons, the Netherlands benefits from the proposed postponement.
Nederland is dan ook om die redenen gebaat bij het voorgestelde uitstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Snels en Bruins over de maatregelen om handelsstromen op gang te houden

MPs Sneller, Snels and Bruins asked how the COVID-19 export credit insurance (ekv) relaxation measures were designed, including their composition of the Rijkscommissie, links to debt relief, green transition, and fossil-fuel financing, and whether France's approach should be followed. State Secretary Vijlbrief answered substantively on most points, stating the measures are temporary, open to all sectors, additional to the private market, and that the government will pursue greening of ekv internationally without committing to a fossil-fuel phase-out scenario.
The cabinet will study with interest the French report focusing on scenarios for a full stop of ekv coverage for fossil-fuel-related projects.

Het kabinet zal het Franse rapport dat zich concentreert op scenario's voor volledige stopzetting van dekkingsmogelijkheden vanuit de ekv voor fossiel-gerelateerde projecten met belangstelling bestuderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over Nederlandse kritiek op vermeende onderdelen van het Israëlische regeerakkoord

Baudet (FvD) asked the ministers about Dutch criticism of the Israeli coalition plans, embassy involvement, the location of diplomats' residences, and funding of Israeli and Palestinian NGOs including Al-Mezan and projects marked confidential. The ministers defended the criticism as consistent with international law, stated they do not withhold funding from organisations merely supporting BDS, and declined to name some confidential projects.
This concerns one of the reconciliation projects through which the cabinet implements the coalition agreement's commitment to improving relations between Israelis and Palestinians.

Dit betreft een van de verzoeningsprojecten waarmee het kabinet uitvoering geeft aan het regeerakkoord om zich in te zetten voor verbetering van de onderlinge relaties tussen Israëliërs en Palestijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand, Wassenberg en Van Esch over een alomvattend aanvalsplan om het risico op toekomstige overspringende zoönotische infectieziekten drastisch te verkleinen

MPs Ouwehand, Wassenberg and Van Esch asked about zoonotic disease risks, intensive livestock farming, wildlife trade, deforestation and a comprehensive action plan to reduce spillover risk. The ministers answered that risks are recognised and managed through the Dutch zoonosis structure, but declined to commit to new bans, a dedicated action plan or additional wildlife-trade enforcement, saying existing measures are sufficient.
The cabinet will continue to work to keep the risks as small as possible or make them smaller.
Het kabinet zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat de risico's zo klein mogelijk zijn of kleiner worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Alkaya over de onderhandelingen over visserijsubsidies

Two MPs asked the government whether it would pause WTO fisheries subsidies negotiations after 150 NGOs requested a halt due to inclusiveness and transparency concerns during COVID-19. Minister Kaag answered that talks are stalled, the government does not consider the process non-transparent, supports resuming talks by end-2020, and does not back halting all trade and investment negotiations.
The cabinet does not agree with this claim.
Het kabinet is het niet eens met deze stelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de invoer van een lading visolie afkomstig uit West-Sahara

An MP asked the minister whether a tanker's cargo of fish oil from Western Sahara was entered as Moroccan origin, whether NVWA checked it, and whether EU rules and the 2016 Court ruling make such imports unlawful. The minister said customs cannot disclose declarations, NVWA relies on the EU-approved establishment list which includes Western Sahara firms, and the trade extension was legally supported, with a Court case pending.
Customs cannot provide information on the declarations submitted for the cargo on that ship due to its statutory confidentiality obligation under EU customs law.
De Douane kan vanwege haar geheimhoudingsplicht op basis van EU-douanewetgeving geen informatie verstrekken over de aangiften die zijn ingediend voor de lading op het desbetreffende schip
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over het mondiale tekort aan vaccinaties

Kuik (CDA) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the global shortage of vaccinations during COVID-19, including which countries face shortages, the impact of physical distancing, and the risk of excess deaths from HIV, TB and malaria. Minister Kaag answered that vaccination campaigns are being suspended rather than vaccine supply, that Dutch funding is directed at strengthening health systems, but declined to answer the questions for the scheduled written consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over modeketens die de kosten van de coronacrisis afwentelen op kledingfabrieken in Azië

MP Diks (GroenLinks) asked whether Dutch fashion chains such as C&A are cancelling orders from Bangladeshi factories during the COVID-19 crisis, leaving workers unpaid, and whether the minister will hold these chains to account. The minister confirmed the practice is widespread, said cancelling placed orders is undesirable, called on companies to act responsibly in their supply chains, and committed only to monitoring responsible purchasing practices and raising the issue with industry groups.
Cancelling orders that have already been placed is undesirable.
Het intrekken van reeds geplaatste orders is onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht 'Wereld op rand van hongerpandemie'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report warning of a global hunger pandemic, including whether the Netherlands would front-load WFP funding and support local food production and reaching marginalised groups. The minister answered that the core WFP contribution of EUR 36 million was already paid in early 2020, an additional EUR 15 million goes to the UN CERF, and the government will keep advocating for reaching the most vulnerable and supporting local agriculture.
I have no information about the position of other countries.
Over de positie van andere landen heb ik geen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht dat de VN waarschuwt voor een hongerpandemie

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a UN warning of a hunger pandemic, including the WFP projection of extra hungry people, early release of pledged funds, food export risks, the desert locust plague in East Africa, and a request to the advisory council AIV. The Minister answered that the government shares the concern, cites the unearmarked multi-year funding and EUR 36 million paid early, the WTO export-restraint statement, the locust response contribution, and the AIV request already submitted.
The cabinet leaves it to the AIV to give that the place in the advice it deserves.
Het kabinet laat het aan de AIV om dat in het advies de plek te geven die het toekomt.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Alkaya over de geheimhoudingsclausules in IMVO-convenanten

An MP asked the minister about confidentiality clauses in IMVO covenants after a broadcast on forced labour in Italian tomato farms, including supermarkets' refusal to engage and whether the confidentiality protocol blocks publication of misconduct investigation results. The minister replied that the protocol protects competition and privacy law, that the steering group has agreed to share some documents for publication, and that the covenant's confidentiality does not prevent individual companies from reporting on risks.

The parties therefore commit to treat as confidential all information and documents exchanged within the framework of the activities and not to disclose them to any third party other than the Secretariat.

Partijen verbinden zich er daarom toe alle informatie en documenten die zijn of worden uitgewisseld in het kader van de activiteiten, vertrouwelijk te behandelen en niet aan een derde, niet zijnde het Secretariaat, te openbaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Becker en Koopmans over de Europese Afrikastrategie

MPs from the VVD asked the government about the new EU-Africa strategy, its migration section, conditionality linking migration cooperation to returns, the EIB president's remarks on open procurement, Chinese contractors in African infrastructure, and untied aid. The minister's answers largely defend the Commission's approach as balanced and consistent with Dutch policy, while declining to press for the specific linkages the MPs proposed and rejecting a shift away from untied aid.
The cabinet assesses the migration section of the Commission communication on the EU-Africa Strategy as balanced
Het kabinet beoordeelt de paragraaf over migratie in de Commissiemededeling over de EU-Afrika Strategie als gebalanceerd
Antwoord op vagen van de leden Kuik, Bouali en Voordewind over de opschorting van de steun van de VS aan de WHO

Three MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the Netherlands was warned about the US suspension of WHO funding, what consequences it has for COVID-19 response, and whether the EU will press the US to reverse it. The minister answered that the Netherlands learned of it via media, opposes suspension, will press US counterparts and coordinate an EU resolution, and pledged additional funds to the WHO.
On behalf of the Dutch government I have expressed support for the WHO.
Namens de Nederlandse regering heb ik steun uitgesproken voor de WHO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Voordewind over het bericht dat Corona de armoede versterkt

Two MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about the effects of COVID-19 on poverty and health systems in developing countries, the overview of EU and other donor funding, the impact of the expected economic crisis on the 0.7% ODA budget, and what Dutch action is planned. The minister answered that Nederland has released EUR 100 million, supports Team Europe coordination, asked the Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken for urgent advice, and that the ODA budget will be assessed later once economic forecasts are clearer.
I have immediately earmarked EUR 100 million from my budget as part of this internationally coordinated effort.
Om die reden heb ik per direct EUR 100 mln vrijgemaakt op mijn begroting als onderdeel van deze internationale gecoördineerde inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de extra maatregelen om handelsstromen op gang te houden

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the State Secretary of Finance about the expanded COVID-19 export credit insurance measures, including consultation with businesses, environmental and human rights screening by Atradius DSB, pricing, and state risk exposure. The government answered that consultation went through the Rijkscommissie voor Export, that documents are not disclosed because they are internal and contain commercial information, that sustainability screening continues under existing policy, and that the measures run until 31 December 2020 with the state taking on risks the private market will not cover.
To the extent minutes of these consultations were made, they were intended for internal use and contain personal policy views of officials and possibly commercially sensitive information.

Voor zover er verslaglegging van deze overleggen is gemaakt, is deze voor intern gebruik bedoeld geweest en bevatten deze persoonlijke beleidsopvattingen van ambtenaren en mogelijk bedrijfsgevoelige informatie.
Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden van Van Raan, Alkaya, Van den Hul, Nijboer, Diks en Snels over schending van de OESO-richtlijnen door Pluspetrol

MPs asked the government about an OECD guidelines complaint against Pluspetrol over pollution and indigenous rights in the Peruvian Amazon, the Dutch oil and gas sector's responsible business conduct plan, Tax Authority transparency requirements on financial flows to low-tax jurisdictions, and binding due diligence legislation. The government acknowledged the concerns, said the sector had not published the promised plan and it would reach out again, and described existing tax transparency measures and a study on enforceable due diligence instruments.
The oil and gas sector has not published an action plan. The cabinet cannot establish whether any improvement has taken place.
De olie- en gassector heeft geen plan van aanpak gepubliceerd. Het kabinet kan niet vaststellen of er verbetering heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baudet over de 100 miljoen euro extra aan de WHO

An MP asked whether the Netherlands was giving an extra 100 million euro to the WHO, where the money goes, why it is spent abroad rather than at home, and whether the government will criticise the WHO over China and Taiwan. The minister replies that the 100 million is a multi-purpose budget for the poorest countries, of which only 7.5 million goes to the WHO, that the Netherlands always serves its own interest, and that a broad evaluation of the response will follow, while several questions on domestic spending are answered only by reference to an accompanying letter.
The cabinet of course supports a broad evaluation of the international corona response, as the standard procedure prescribes.
Het kabinet steunt vanzelfsprekend een brede evaluatie van de internationale coronabestrijding, zoals de standaardprocedure voorschrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver, Ellemeet, Renkema, Kröger, Diks en Snels over de coronacrisis

GroenLinks MPs asked the government about COVID-19 testing supplies (the Roche lysis buffer recipe and shortages), protective equipment, support for healthcare and other vital workers, homeless shelter rules, transport measures, and international debt relief and aid for developing countries. The minister answered in detail: the Roche recipe was made available to government, testing capacity is being coordinated through a taskforce and special envoy, and Nederland committed EUR 100 million to COVID-19 response in developing countries.
One of the first concrete results of the Special Envoy's efforts is that the company Roche has made the recipe available to the government.
Eén van de eerste concrete resultaten van de inzet van de Speciaal Gezant is dat de firma Roche het recept ter beschikking heeft gesteld aan de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Koopmans over de gezondheidszorg in Afrikaanse landen om een uitbraak van het coronavirus het hoofd te bieden

Two VVD MPs asked the foreign trade/development and foreign affairs ministers about the capacity of African health systems to handle COVID-19, the economic and political risks, the scope for development budgets, and whether European aid should be coordinated. The ministers answered that health systems are weak and the crisis is severe, that Netherlands has allocated EUR 100 million largely via multilateral organisations, and that a Team Europe coordinated approach is pursued.
The cabinet does not yet have a complete picture of the funds available from other EU member states; the European Commission is working on an overview.
Het kabinet heeft op dit moment nog geen compleet beeld van beschikbare middelen van andere EU-lidstaten; de Europese Commissie werkt aan een overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over wapenimporten uit Turkije

An MP asked whether Turkish military imports cost the Netherlands over 16 million dollars in two months, which systems were bought and whether the government would press allies to stop imports from Turkey given Syria and human rights concerns. The government could not verify the figures, said the Ministry of Defence only bought maintenance and modification services for Stinger launching systems, and refused to ask allies for an import ban, arguing that export controls are the more effective tool.
No independent figures are available on imports of military goods from Turkey in the first two months of 2020.
Er zijn geen onafhankelijke cijfers beschikbaar ten aanzien van de import van militaire goederen uit Turkije in de eerste twee maanden van 2020.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Alkaya over de impact van coronavirus (COVID-19) op de internationale ontwikkelingssamenwerking

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the impact of COVID-19 on development cooperation, covering water and hygiene in refugee camps, debt relief, IMF SDR allocations, World Bank financing conditionality and supply-chain workers. The minister answered at length, describing Dutch funding of EUR 100 million, support for debt moratoria and World Bank crisis lending, while declining to commit to specific positions on SDR allocation and deferring to other bodies on some points.
Do you agree that World Bank financial injections into developing countries should currently be free of political and economic conditions?
Vraag 13 en 14 Deelt u de mening dat financiële injecties van de Wereldbank in ontwikkelingslanden momenteel vrij moeten zijn van politieke en economische voorwaarden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de schrijnende humanitaire situatie op de Griekse eilanden

MP Voordewind asked the government about the humanitarian crisis on the Greek islands, what the EU and the Netherlands could do to ease it, and whether the Netherlands would relocate vulnerable migrants and unaccompanied minors. The State Secretary answered that the issue was discussed in EU Justice and Home Affairs councils, that the Dutch line focuses on enforcing the EU-Turkey Statement with support for Greece, that material and financial aid was sent, and that ad hoc relocation is not currently envisaged.
Accelerated relocation procedures are currently not under consideration.
Van versnelde relocatieprocedures is momenteel geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over schaliegas en plastic

MPs Van der Lee and Diks asked about plastic pellet pollution, shale gas-driven plastic production, bank and insurer investments in shale gas and plastics companies in Argentina, and whether damages can be recovered from polluters. The minister answered that the government shares concern about plastic pollution, points to EU and national initiatives, says it has no oversight of the investments or the claimed harms, leaves responsibility for IMVO due diligence and compensation with companies and financial institutions, and confirms that polluters bear restoration costs under Dutch law.
The cabinet has no insight into the investments of the named banks and insurers in shale gas and plastics companies and therefore cannot confirm the investment figures.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de investeringen van de genoemde banken en verzekeraars in schaliegas- en plasticbedrijven en kan investeringscijfers dan ook niet bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over noodhulp aan Syriërs

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the source and channels of extra humanitarian aid for north-west Syria, EU and member state efforts, Dutch diplomacy, and obstacles to aid for internally displaced people. The minister answered that the funds come from the BHOS aid budget, are spent via the Dutch Relief Alliance and the Syria Cross-Border Humanitarian Fund, and outlined diplomatic efforts and remaining aid obstacles.
The Netherlands is in active contact with the European Commission and other member states on this.
Nederland onderhoudt actief contact met de Europese Commissie en andere lidstaten hierover.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Wiersma over het bericht ‘Chipsector onderuit na uitlekken Amerikaanse plannen‘

Two MPs asked whether the government would raise with the US a planned licensing requirement on exports to China of chip-making equipment containing US components, and how it fits international law and EU policy. The minister said the US De Minimis Rule already applies, that the government will await the formal US position before commenting, and that it aims to secure good international arrangements for the semiconductor value chain.
The cabinet does not want to anticipate unconfirmed reports and for now awaits the formal position of the US government and any changes to US legislation.
Het kabinet wil niet vooruitlopen op onbevestigde berichtgeving en wacht vooralsnog het formele standpunt van de Amerikaanse regering en eventuele wijzigingen in de Amerikaanse wetgeving af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Groothuizen over de situatie in Kameroen

An MP asked the government about the humanitarian, security and political situation in Cameroon, including refugee flows, human rights, the February 2020 elections, education, and Dutch and EU support. The ministers answered in detail on the crises, Dutch aid of 2 million euros, EU pressure for dialogue, and Cameroon-related asylum figures.
The Netherlands contributed 2 million euros to the emergency aid programme of the Dutch Relief Alliance in Cameroon.
Nederland heeft 2 miljoen euro bijgedragen aan het noodhulpprogramma van de Dutch Relief Alliance in Kameroen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht dat Afrika geteisterd wordt door een sprinkhanenplaag

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Netherlands would contribute to the FAO's USD 138 million appeal against the desert locust plague in Africa, and how Dutch-funded food security projects were affected. The minister answered that the Netherlands pledged EUR 1 million plus EUR 10 million via CERF, that the impact on Dutch projects was not yet clear, and that additional emergency funding would be reconsidered if the situation worsened.
The Netherlands, like 10 other countries, responded positively to these requests and makes EUR 1 million available from the food security programme.
Nederland heeft net als 10 andere landen positief gereageerd op deze verzoeken en stelt EUR 1 miljoen beschikbaar vanuit het voedselzekerheidsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Tienduizenden Oeigoeren slachtoffer van dwangarbeid voor bekende merken‘

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether the government would investigate Dutch companies using Uyghur forced labour, press China for access and act in the EU and UN. The ministers say the government is raising Uyghur rights bilaterally and multilaterally, expects firms to conduct due diligence under OECD guidelines without government investigation, and plans a business information session postponed due to coronavirus.
It is the responsibility of these companies to map whether they are linked to companies where Uyghurs are employed. The cabinet does not investigate this.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van deze bedrijven om in kaart te brengen of zij gelinkt zijn aan bedrijven waar Oeigoeren tewerkgesteld worden. Het kabinet doet hier geen onderzoek naar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Karabulut over het bericht dat Oeigoeren worden tewerkgesteld in Westerse bedrijven

MPs Alkaya and Karabulut asked the foreign and trade ministers about reports that Uyghurs are employed under forced-labour conditions in Western company supply chains, and whether Dutch firms are involved. The government confirmed awareness, said it cannot independently verify the ASPI findings, pointed to business information sessions and EU/UN diplomacy, and said firms failing IMVO conditions can be excluded from trade missions.
The cabinet cannot confirm the conclusions of the ASPI report on the basis of its own independent information.
Het kabinet kan de conclusies van het ASPI-rapport niet op basis van eigenstandige informatie bevestigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, Van Helvert en Kuik over seksueel geweld tegen christelijke vrouwen

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about reported sexual violence against Christian women and the Open Doors gender-specific persecution report, including what Dutch foreign and development policy can do about it. The ministers condemn such persecution, describe existing programmes on women's legal equality, child marriage, religious freedom and a EUR 750,000 contribution to psychological care for persecuted believers, but do not change any institutional check.
Persecution on account of a belief or conviction deviating from the majority is considered unacceptable by the cabinet.
Vervolging wegens een (van de meerderheid afwijkende) geloofs- of levensovertuiging vindt het kabinet onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Alkaya over het Oxfam rapport The EU Trust Fund for Africa

MPs Van Dijk and Alkaya asked the minister about an Oxfam report arguing that EU Trust Fund for Africa aid is increasingly used to pressure countries into stopping migrants and that it violates aid principles and human rights. The minister rejects the claims of coercion and rights violations, says the EUTF is being evaluated and will inform the next budget, and acknowledges some useful recommendations.
In 2019 an external evaluation of the EUTF instrument was started. It is expected to be published mid-2020.
In 2019 is een externe evaluatie van het instrument EUTF gestart. Naar verwachting zal deze medio 2020 uitkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bijna een miljoen Syriërs zitten als ratten in de val in Idlib – of is er nog hoop?‘

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in Idlib, Syria, and what it is doing to protect displaced civilians and secure aid access. The minister outlined Dutch humanitarian funding channels, EU and UN diplomacy, and the Turkey-Russia ceasefire arrangements, without committing to new national measures beyond existing funding.
The Netherlands provides humanitarian aid in several ways to alleviate the needs of the refugees in Idlib.
Nederland levert op verschillende manieren humanitaire hulp om de noden van de vluchtelingen in Idlib te lenigen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Leijten over het bericht dat ontwikkelingsgeld van de Wereldbank deels bij belastingparadijzen belandt

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether World Bank aid to 22 highly aid-dependent countries is leaking to tax havens, how widespread this is, which countries and elites are involved, and what the government will do. The minister acknowledges concern, notes the study is preliminary and not causal, describes Dutch and World Bank anti-corruption measures, and says the findings will be used to push for stronger action, without announcing a policy change.
It does not lend itself to drawing conclusions about individual countries, specific persons or bilateral aid flows.
Het leent zich niet om conclusies te trekken over individuele landen, specifieke personen of bilaterale hulpstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over de cofinanciering door ING van een Indonesische kolencentrale

MP Van Raan asks the ministers whether ING's financing of a new Indonesian coal plant in Cirebon breaches international responsible business standards, whether ING should have refused the contract and handle complaints from local NGOs, and how this fits with climate goals. The government answers that banks are expected to follow the OECD guidelines and UN guiding principles, that ING monitors projects and handles complaints under the banking covenant, that binding measures are being considered, and that ING intends to phase out coal financing, while declining to judge ING's specific case.
I expect ING (and other banks) to take investigations such as the FFGI study into account in their considerations.
Ik verwacht van ING (en andere banken) dat zij onderzoeken zoals het onderzoek van FFGI meenemen in hun afwegingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Diks, Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het VN-rapport waarin wordt geconstateerd dat diverse landen het VN-wapenembargo tegen Libië schenden

MPs from GroenLinks and D66 asked the government about a UN Panel of Experts report finding that several states violated the Libya arms embargo, including the possible Dutch role of Van der Kamp Shipsales in a warship sale. The minister said the Netherlands raised enforcement at EU level, is investigating the company without yet deciding on measures, and sees no need for additional rules, while noting the limits of post-export controls.
Further investigation is currently ongoing, so the cabinet cannot now say whether there is cause to take measures against the company.
Nader onderzoek loopt op dit moment, daarom kan het kabinet nu geen uitspraak doen over de vraag of er aanleiding bestaat om maatregelen tegen het bedrijf te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse betrokkenheid bij bewapening Libië

An SP MP asked the government about Dutch involvement in arming Libyan factions, including ships sold by a Dutch intermediary and Damen Shipyards vessels later armed, and about possible prosecution and export permit misuse. The minister declined to comment on prosecutions, denied permit misuse since the unarmed ships needed no permit, and outlined reinforced monitoring of the Libya arms embargo.
The cabinet makes no statements about which cases are or are not investigated criminally.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraken over de vraag welke zaken al dan niet strafrechtelijk worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Bouali over het bericht ‘Hoe aquaria wereldwijd het koraalrif bedreigen; Vissen op Nemo’s’

MPs De Groot and Bouali asked ministers about imports of tropical aquarium fish and coral through Schiphol, possible illegal wild capture, and EU enforcement under CITES. The minister answered with 2019 import figures for CITES-listed species, described CITES permit and customs controls, and said the EU and Switzerland and the US had proposed a CITES study of unprotected species trade.
For species not protected under CITES, no figures are available.
Voor de soorten die niet beschermd zijn onder CITES zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het bericht ‘Groeiend verzet tegen Saudisch vrachtship Bahri Yanbu vol wapens’ en ‘Don't let Saudi arms ship dock in UK, say campaigners’

MPs Bouali and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether a Saudi cargo ship carrying arms bound for Yemen would be allowed to dock in EU ports, and whether EU states should refuse it under the Arms Trade Treaty and EU Common Position. The government said it lacks information on transit through other EU ports, would not have granted a Dutch transit licence to this ship, and will keep raising the matter with EU partners.
The cabinet continues to point EU member states on several occasions to the tightened Dutch policy and to call on other countries to adopt comparable measures.
Het kabinet blijft EU-lidstaten bij meerdere gelegenheden wijzen op het aangescherpte Nederlandse beleid en andere landen oproepen vergelijkbare maatregelen te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht ‘Baggerbedrijf Van Oord betrokken bij mensenrechtenschendingen in Angola’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Van Oord, ING and Atradius DSB were linked to forced evictions of about 3,000 families in Angola and whether due diligence failed. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said the evictions were in a separate sub-project in 2013 unknown to those parties, defended the due diligence process while promising a general evaluation of the CSR policy for export credit insurance, and declined to assign any liability or compensation to the Dutch state.
After this evaluation, the 'CSR policy document for export credit insurance' will be adjusted where necessary and presented to your House.
Na deze evaluatie wordt het «mvo-beleidsdocument voor de exportkredietverzekering» waar nodig aangepast en aan uw Kamer aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Snels en Diks over de over recente berichtgeving omtrent het Marginal da Corimba-project in Angola

MPs Snels and Diks asked about press reports on the Marginal da Corimba project in Angola, including Atradius export credit insurance due diligence, forced evictions, the Dutch embassy's knowledge, trust office supervision and Dutch anti-bribery enforcement. The state secretary answered that the state's involvement in the evictions could not be established, that due diligence did not include commercial pricing, and that the government would evaluate CSR policy and enforcement measures, with some questions referred to later reports.
Based on its own investigation, the Dutch state has not been found to be directly involved, via Atradius DSB, in the alleged human rights violations in June 2013 in Luanda.
Op basis van eigen onderzoek is niet gebleken dat de Nederlandse staat via Atradius DSB rechtstreeks betrokken is bij de vermeende mensenrechtenschendingen in juni 2013 in Luanda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat duizenden families in Angola verjaagd zijn voor project van Nederlandse bedrijven

An SP MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that thousands of families in Angola were forcibly evicted for a Dutch-backed land reclamation project, questioning the state export credit guarantee, due diligence by Atradius, Van Oord and ING, and the effectiveness of the IMVO covenants. The minister defends the due diligence as adequate, says responsibility for criminal conduct lies with the Public Prosecution Service, promises continued dialogue and compensation efforts with the companies, and declines to exclude them from trade missions.
An assessment in individual cases of whether there may be criminally culpable conduct is not my responsibility but that of the Public Prosecution Service.
Een beoordeling in individuele gevallen of er mogelijk sprake is van strafrechtelijk verwijtbaar handelen, is niet mijn verantwoordelijkheid maar die van het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht VN publiceert lijst van bedrijven met banden Israëlische nederzettingen

An MP asked the government about the UN list of companies linked to Israeli settlements, the consequences for Dutch firms, whether they comply with responsible business guidelines, what steps could be taken, and whether the UN would be asked to explain its findings. The government reiterated its opposition to the database and its view that settlements are contrary to international law, while stating that companies themselves decide their partners and that it would not comment on specific cases or contact the UN.
The cabinet does not comment on specific cases.
Het kabinet doet geen uitspraak over specifieke casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over een VN-database met bedrijven actief in Israëlische nederzettingen

An MP asks the Dutch government about the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights' database of companies active in Israeli settlements, including whether the government supports its publication and related criticism. The government answers that it opposed creating the database but must implement the Human Rights Council's mandate, that companies themselves decide their activities under IMVO/OECD standards, and that it declines to comment on the statements of Israeli ministers and the AJC.
The cabinet sees no reason to assume that the High Commissioner did not act carefully.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding om aan te nemen dat de Hoge Commissaris niet zorgvuldig te werk is gegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de huidige betrekkingen tussen Nederland en Taiwan

An MP asked the minister about Netherlands-Taiwan investment levels, sector breakdown, support for Taiwan, a supposed EU-Taiwan investment agreement, Chinese pressure, and why the Trade Agenda lacks separate attention to Taiwan. The minister confirmed the investment figures, said there is no EU-Taiwan investment agreement or negotiation, and stated the government remains committed to its one-China policy and monitors Chinese pressure.
There is no bilateral investment agreement between the EU and Taiwan, and no negotiations on such an agreement are taking place.
Er is geen bilaterale investeringsovereenkomst tussen de EU en Taiwan en er wordt ook niet onderhandeld over een dergelijke overeenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het Emergency Trust Fund for Africa (EUTF)

MP Diks asked the minister about the EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa, including whether the 2015 Commission decision declaring crisis situations in many African countries allowed bypassing public tender rules, and about transparency and local ownership. The minister defended the fund as a flexible complement to regular instruments, said crisis is broadly defined and not the sole selection factor, and reported on funding sources, coordination in Nigeria, and transparency reporting, without committing to amend the Commission decision.
The cabinet considers it important that the EU has flexible instruments at its disposal to respond quickly to crises and changing circumstances.
Het kabinet vindt het belangrijk dat de EU flexibele instrumenten tot haar beschikking heeft om snel in te kunnen springen op crises en veranderende omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de gevolgen van CETA voor onze rechtsstaat, onze soevereiniteit en de landbouw

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about the consequences of CETA for the rule of law, sovereignty and Dutch arable farming, covering pesticide residue standards, investor protection, MFN clauses and Brexit. The minister answered that EU import standards apply to all products, that CETA's investment protections are comparable to Dutch law, and that the government sees no reason to reconsider its support.
Investment protection in CETA offers a similar level of protection to investors as Dutch law does.
Investeringsbescherming in CETA biedt een soortgelijk niveau van bescherming aan investeerders als het Nederlands recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de Bilateral Investment Agreement tussen de EU en Taiwan

An MP from D66 asked whether the EU and Taiwan are negotiating a bilateral investment agreement, about trade and investment flows, and whether the government would press the Commission to start talks. The minister answered that no negotiations are under way, the Commission has no Council mandate, and the government sees no urgent need to press for talks.
No negotiations are taking place between the EU and Taiwan on an investment agreement.
Er wordt niet onderhandeld tussen de EU en Taiwan over een investeringsovereenkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling, Wiersma en Aartsen over de berichten ‘Alibaba zwemt in het geld na beursgang in Hongkong’ en ‘Tarieven voor pakjes uit China verhogen’

Three VVD MPs asked about Alibaba's Hong Kong listing and higher postal tariffs for China parcels, raising unfair competition, product safety and CE-marking enforcement. The state secretary replied that tariff harmonisation applies from 2020 with a phased self-declared rate system to 2021, that the EU should use its market power and possibly stricter oversight of platforms, and that the government is consulting the SER and the Commission on platform liability.
The cabinet believes the EU should better use its market power to enforce a level playing field in trade with third countries through new and existing instruments.
Het kabinet vindt dat de EU haar marktmacht beter moet inzetten om met nieuwe en bestaande instrumenten een gelijk speelveld in de handel met derde landen af te dwingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Weverling over de berichten 'Nederlandse bedrijven geraakt door VS-sancties tegen Nord Stream 2' en 'Allseas trekt zich terug uit Oostzee, Russen bouwen omstreden gaspijpleidin

MPs Koopmans and Weverling asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that US sanctions targeting Nord Stream 2 hit Dutch firms such as Allseas, and what the government would do to protect them. The minister said the cabinet considers the US sanctions undesirable, has raised this with US counterparts and will keep doing so, and is in close contact with the EU and business, but is not considering countermeasures such as a Special Purpose Vehicle.
The cabinet considers these sanctions undesirable, given the consequences for business in the Netherlands and other EU member states.
Het kabinet acht deze sancties onwenselijk, vanwege de gevolgen voor het bedrijfsleven in Nederland en andere EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over mogelijke sluipende bevoegdheidsoverdracht door CETA

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade whether CETA's committees, which can amend certain annexes and protocols, pose a constitutional legitimacy problem as argued by Prof. Weiss. The Minister rejected this, arguing that amendments follow democratic procedures, are limited to technical matters, require consensus, and that Parliament approves the agreement.
The Cabinet does not share this assessment. Amendments to CETA follow procedures that contain sufficient democratic safeguards.
Het Kabinet deelt dit oordeel niet. Wijzigingen van CETA verlopen volgens procedures die voldoende democratische waarborgen bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de lagere dierenwelzijnsstandaarden in Canada, naar aanleiding van het rondetafelgesprek over het EU-Canada-vrijhandelsverdrag CETA van 6 november 2019

An MP asked the trade and agriculture ministers whether lower animal welfare standards in Canada (transport durations, sow housing, cattle branding) undermine a level playing field under CETA, and whether EU import requirements can enforce equivalence. The government answered that EU import rules cover only plant/animal health, food safety and labelling, that animal welfare import conditions are limited under WTO rules, and that the CETA Regulatory Cooperation Forum is discussing long-distance animal transport.
Through CETA it is possible to keep talking with Canada about animal welfare requirements.
Via CETA is het mogelijk om in gesprek te blijven met Canada over dierenwelzijnseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het Joint Management Committee on Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures in het CETA-verdrag

An MP asked the ministers about the CETA Joint Management Committee on SPS measures, including whether it can amend CETA without parliamentary control and how the EU position is set. The minister answered that amendments to annexes and protocols follow a simplified procedure, that the Council sets the EU position and Parliament is informed, and that Parliament must approve treaty amendments under article 91 of the Constitution, but many questions were answered only by reference to earlier answers or to the European Commission website.

Deviating from that, article 5.14(2)(d) of CETA and article 30.2(2) determine that the Joint Management Committee on SPS measures and the CETA Joint Committee respectively may decide to amend the protocols and certain annexes to the agreement.

In afwijking daarvan bepalen artikel 5.14, lid 2, onder d, van CETA en artikel 30.2, lid 2, dat het Gemengd Comité van beheer voor sanitaire en fytosanitaire maatregelen respectievelijk het CETA Gemengd Comité kunnen besluiten om de protocollen en een aantal bijlagen bij het akkoord te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over het bericht ‘Miljoenen aan EU-steun voor Marokko hebben weinig effect’

An MP asks the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that EU budget support to Morocco had little effect, and whether EU development spending should be halted, including Morocco's obstruction of EU visibility and the migration/return clauses in the NDICI and post-Cotonou negotiations. The Minister acknowledges the European Court of Auditors findings, says the Netherlands will push for implementation of recommendations and keep a constructive-critical stance, and points to ongoing negotiations on migration and return clauses.
The cabinet does not have a complete overview of all cases of fraud within EU budget support programmes.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een volledig overzicht van volledige malversaties binnen begrotingssteunprogramma's van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de mogelijke claim tegen de Nederlandse staat van Uniper en RWE, op basis van de ISDS-clausule in het Energie Charter Treaty

An MP asked the ministers about threatened ISDS claims by Uniper and RWE against the Dutch state under the Energy Charter Treaty after the coal ban, and about the treaty's future. The government answered that no formal claim exists yet, that intra-EU ISDS is not possible after Achmea, that a 10-year transition period compensates the plants, and that modernisation negotiations are underway rather than withdrawal.
On that basis the Netherlands is not considering withdrawing from the Energy Charter Treaty and is focusing in the coming period on modernising the treaty.
Nederland overweegt op grond daarvan niet om uit het Energiehandvestverdrag te stappen en zet de komende tijd in op de modernisering van dit verdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van den Hul over het bericht dat arbeidsmigranten slavenarbeid verrichten op Italiaanse tomatenplantages

MPs Alkaya and Van den Hul asked the government about reports of exploitative, near-slavery labour conditions for migrant workers on Italian tomato farms and whether such products reach Dutch shelves. The ministers answered that exploitation is condemned, that enforcement in Italy is for Italian authorities, that companies bear due diligence responsibility, and that sector parties under the food convenant will investigate and report back.
The steering group agreed that the sector parties that signed the convenant will investigate further the possible involvement of their members
In de stuurgroep is afgesproken dat de branchepartijen die het convenant hebben getekend nader onderzoek doen naar mogelijke betrokkenheid van hun leden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weverling over de Europese investeringstoets en Chinees investeringsgedrag op de EU-markt

MP Weverling asked the minister about the EU investment screening framework, whether the Commission has capacity to probe Chinese investments, and coordination against market-distorting Chinese investment. The minister replied that screening is limited to national security by design, that the EU regulation mainly provides information sharing, and that further steps will be considered at evaluation and in the level-playing-field work.
The regulation will be evaluated no later than three years after it becomes fully applicable.
De verordening wordt geëvalueerd uiterlijk drie jaar na het volledig van toepassing worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de kritiek van NGO’s op de concept-duurzaamheids-impactanalyse van het EU-Mercosur-verdrag en de status van het akkoord

An MP asked the government about NGO criticism of the draft sustainability impact assessment of the EU-Mercosur agreement, including its timing, data gaps on Brazilian deforestation and CO2, the mixed-competence status of the deal, and animal welfare conditions. The minister answered that the draft SIA is not final, the final version is expected mid-2020, a separate impact study on Dutch agriculture will be carried out, and the government will assess the deal before the Council decides.

The cabinet will, in accordance with the Voordewind et al. motion referring to the Koopmans/Snijder-Hazelhoff motion, commission a study into the impact of the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement on the Dutch economy, in particular Dutch agriculture and horticulture.

Het kabinet zal conform de motie Voordewind c.s. waarin verwezen wordt naar de motie Koopmans/Snijder-Hazelhoff een onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de impact van het EU-Mercosur Associatieverdrag op de Nederlandse economie, in het bijzonder de Nederlandse land- en tuinbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders, Diks en Van Ojik over de investeringen van Nederlandse pensioenfondsen in controversiële wapenhandel

MPs Smeulders, Diks and Van Ojik asked the government about a PAX report showing Dutch pension funds invest over 1 billion euros in arms companies supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt, and what the government can do about it. The minister answered that pension investment policy is for funds and supervisors (AFM, DNB), that arms export rules were tightened for Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and that compliance with the IMVB pension covenant is voluntary but monitored.
It is not my task to supervise the investment policy of pension funds. That is for the supervisors, the Authority for the Financial Markets (AFM) and De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Het is niet mijn taak om toezicht te houden op het beleggingsbeleid van pensioenfondsen. Dat is aan de toezichthouders Autoriteit Financiële Markt (AFM) en De Nederlandsche Bank (DNB).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Snels over de UN Climate Action Summit van 23 september

GroenLinks MPs asked whether the government knows banks and insurers invest heavily in shale gas and plastics, whether it will press for action at the UN Climate Action Summit, and whether it will pressure financial institutions to restrict such financing. The minister confirmed awareness, pointed to national climate policy, the ban on new shale gas exploration permits, plastics programmes, and the Platform for Sustainable Finance, but made no commitment to restrict financing directly.

It is a good thing when insurers, banks and other financial institutions are open about the environmental and climate effects of their investments, so that their customers can make an informed choice.

Het is een goede zaak wanneer verzekeraars, banken en andere financiële instellingen open zijn over de milieu en klimaateffecten van hun investeringen, zodat hun klanten een gefundeerde keuze kunnen maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht 'Leaked letter suggests US is rallying UN member states top oppose abortion'

An MP asked the minister whether a leaked US letter urging UN states to oppose sexual and reproductive health rights and abortion had been received by the Netherlands, and how the government views this trend. The minister answered that the Netherlands did not receive the letter, that 19 countries backed a US-led statement on UHC, and that the Netherlands will keep actively defending SRGR and women's rights in UN and EU forums.
The Netherlands did not receive this letter.
Nederland heeft deze brief niet ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Regenwoudmaffia’ vermoordt en bedreigt inwoners Amazone’

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul ask the ministers how the government responds to reports of violence and threats against Amazon forest defenders by illegal logging networks, and to Bolsonaro's criticism of conservation groups. The ministers say they have raised deforestation and rights concerns with Brazil, note that the legal framework exists but enforcement and political will fall short, and describe trade and sustainability initiatives.
It must be noted that the legal framework to act against criminal organisations exists, but the financial resources and political will to enforce that framework are lacking.
Geconstateerd moet worden dat het wetgevend kader om op te treden tegen criminele organisaties aanwezig is, maar de financiële middelen en de politieke wil om dat kader te handhaven tekort schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de aardbeving op de Molukken

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the minister about the humanitarian situation after the earthquake and aftershocks on the Moluccas, and whether Indonesia had requested international aid. The minister answered that Indonesia made no international aid request, that local authorities lead relief, and that the Netherlands supports EU satellite mapping and standing humanitarian channels if requested.
However, he confirmed to me that the Indonesian provincial and local governments have themselves taken up the relief efforts, together with local organisations.
Wel heb ik van hem bevestigd gekregen dat de Indonesische provinciale en lokale overheden zelf de hulpverlening ter hand hebben genomen, samen met lokale organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Aartsen over het bericht dat een Chinees bedrijf een aanbesteding voor het aanleggen van een metrolijn in Stockholm heeft gewonnen

MPs Weverling and Aartsen asked whether Chinese state-owned firms bidding below cost on European public tenders, such as a Stockholm metro contract, distort competition and whether the government will act on reciprocity. The government answered that existing EU procurement rules allow abnormally low bids to be rejected, that it supports the EU International Procurement Instrument and a level playing field instrument, but gave only general commitments and referred to earlier letters.
The cabinet is currently pursuing a non-discriminatory instrument aimed at promoting a level playing field to address this problem.
Het kabinet zet momenteel in op een non-discriminatoir instrument gericht op het bevorderen van een gelijk speelveld om dit probleem wel te adresseren.
Antwoord op het lid vragen van  het lid Diks over de Nederlandse soja-import uit Zuid-Amerika

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Dutch soy imports from South America linked to deforestation in the Cerrado and Amazon, and whether RTRS standards and EU forest legislation should be required. The minister answered that all soy used in Dutch animal products is RTRS-certified, that Dutch-only measures are insufficient, and that the government will push the European Commission to examine ways to make supply chains deforestation-free.
The Netherlands is therefore working towards EU policy to increase market demand for certified sustainable and deforestation-free products within the Union and beyond.
Nederland spant zich daarom in om te komen tot EU-beleid om de marktvraag naar gecertificeerd duurzame en ontbossingsvrije producten binnen de Unie en daarbuiten te vergroten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over beleggingen in wapenproducerende bedrijven die exporteren naar Turkije

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the partial arms-export embargo on Turkey affects the 631 million euro in loans and investments by ING, ABN Amro and Van Lanschot in eleven arms-supplying firms, whether banks should be pressed to divest, and about progress on a thematic framework and talks with banks. Minister Kaag answered that the embargo has no direct effect on banks, that banks decide themselves under the UNGP and OECD guidelines, that a thematic framework is being developed by the insurance-sector convention parties and is not yet finished, and that the government will share it with banks once ready.
Banks and investors make their own assessment of whether to invest in or provide financing to the defence industry.
Banken en investeerders maken hun eigen afweging of zij beleggen in of financiering verlenen aan de defensie-industrie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Karabulut, Van Oijk en Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Israëlisch hooggerechtshof keurt uitzetting HRW-directeur goed'

MPs from PvdA, SP, GroenLinks and D66 asked how the government responds to the Israeli Supreme Court's approval of the expulsion of Human Rights Watch director Omar Shakir, and whether it fears this chills civil society and human rights defenders. The minister says the government raised concerns with the Israeli ambassador and at senior official level, its embassy monitored the hearings, and the EU urged Israel to reverse the decision.

Because of the government's and the EU's concern about increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, and specifically this case, the Minister of Foreign Affairs emphatically raised concerns about this threatened expulsion with the Israeli ambassador on 7 November.

Vanwege de bezorgdheid van het kabinet en de EU over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, en specifiek deze zaak, heeft de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met de Israëlische ambassadeur op 7 november jl. de zorgen over deze dreigende uitzetting nadrukkelijk opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan, Diks, Bouali en Van de Hul over de moord op de Braziliaanse activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara

Four MPs asked the government about the murder of Brazilian indigenous activist Paulo Paulino Guajajara, whether Brazil's environment and indigenous rights are deteriorating under Bolsonaro, and what concrete action the Netherlands will take. The government said illegal loggers likely were involved but could not confirm it, said violence against indigenous people appears to have grown, and outlined diplomatic dialogue, EU-Mercosur review and support for rights defenders without committing to a new concrete measure.
It seems very likely that illegally operating loggers were involved in his death, although we cannot confirm that.
Het lijkt zeer waarschijnlijk dat illegaal opererende houthakkers betrokken waren bij zijn dood, hoewel wij dat niet kunnen bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat FMO landroof en andere misstanden financiert

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Trade and Development and of Finance how FMO, the Dutch development bank, could finance projects linked to killings, land grabs and other abuses, which projects were investigated, and whether the exit strategy and due diligence are adequate. The minister answered that these projects are known and in dialogue with FMO, that existing standards and recent policy tightening apply, that the list of watch-list projects is confidential, and that the next five-yearly evaluation (2013-2018) is due in Q2 2020.
FMO closely monitors which projects may be experiencing problems.
FMO houdt intensief in de gaten bij welke projecten zich mogelijk problemen voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de aanwezigheid van informatie op ministeries over de burgerdoden bij het Nederlandse bombardement op Hawija

MP Diks asked ministers whether ministries had been informed about the outcome of the CENTCOM investigation into civilian deaths at Hawija and whether the Defence Minister misinformed parliament in 2015. The government answers that ministries received only general, non-numerical information in 2015 meetings, the initial CENTCOM report was not shared with other departments, and the 2015 statements to parliament were found to be incorrect.
The initial CENTCOM report as such was never provided to other departments, in line with standing practice.
Het initiële CENTCOM-rapport als zodanig is nooit verstrekt aan andere departementen, conform staande praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Wassenberg over het «Special Report on the Ocean and Cryosphere in a Changing Climate  (SROCC)» van het IPCC

Two MPs from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about the IPCC special report on oceans and the cryosphere, covering glacier loss, marine heatwaves, ocean acidification, marine protected areas and fisheries. The government answered at length, mostly restating the IPCC findings and pointing to the forthcoming cabinet appraisal and international negotiations, with few concrete commitments.
A comprehensive cabinet appraisal of the IPCC report on oceans and the cryosphere has been sent to the House.
Een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie van het IPCC-rapport over oceanen en de cryosfeer is aan de kamer toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de verwoesting van de Amazone in Brazilië

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the destruction of the Amazon under President Bolsonaro, including the role of Dutch and EU trade and whether Dutch companies are linked to deforestation. The minister answered that the government pressures Brazil on enforcement and sustainability, expects Dutch firms to follow OECD guidelines without active supervision of Amazon-specific links, and will assess the Mercosur deal once impact studies are available.
Active supervision of the application of the guidelines by Dutch companies, and specifically regarding possible involvement in deforestation of the Amazon, is not provided for.
Actief toezicht op de toepassing van de richtlijnen door Nederlandse bedrijven, en specifiek met betrekking tot eventuele betrokkenheid bij ontbossing van de Amazone, is niet voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van den Hul over misstanden bij projecten mede gefinancierd door FMO

MPs Diks and Van den Hul asked the minister about alleged misconduct in FMO-cofinanced projects, including inadequate due diligence on the Feronia land titles, the murder of activist Imbangola Lunea, weak complaint procedures, and unpaid or sub-living wages. The minister answered that FMO's due diligence and policies have been strengthened, that the Feronia land issue was handled by DEG and found acceptable at the time, that the Lunea investigation is complete with findings to follow, and that a new evaluation covering 2013-2018 is expected in Q2 2020.
In the case of serious incidents, the cabinet presses for independent investigation.
In het geval van ernstige incidenten dringt het kabinet aan op onafhankelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Amhaouch over het bericht over misstanden in projecten van FMO

CDA MPs Kuik and Amhaouch asked the minister, following a Trouw report, about alleged abuses (including land grabbing) in FMO-financed projects, FMO's risk management, the ministry's role, and whether local authorities prosecute. The minister confirmed the projects are known and under policy dialogue, explained the ministry's oversight role and risk monitoring, but declined to share FMO's problem list citing ongoing investigations and commercial confidentiality.
It is generally not in the interest of the ongoing investigation to share information about this with external parties.
Het is doorgaans niet in het belang van het lopende onderzoek om informatie hierover te delen met externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden en Weverling over de artikelen ‘Asielzoekers uit veilige landen terroriseren Harderwijk’ en ‘Harderwijk is diefstallen door asielzoekers beu’

MPs Van Wijngaarden and Weverling asked about press reports of crime by asylum seekers from safe countries in Harderwijk, their nationalities, unknown-destination departures, and returns. The State Secretary declined to address Harderwijk specifically, gave national figures showing nearly half of suspects were from Algeria and Morocco, and described efforts to improve returns, including conditional cooperation with origin countries.
Each year I inform the House about incidents through the incident overview in the Aliens Chain Report (RVK).
Jaarlijks informeer ik uw Kamer over incidenten door middel van het incidentenoverzicht in de Rapportage Vreemdelingenketen (RVK).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over door de Nederlandse Ontwikkelingsbank FMO gefinancierde misstanden

An MP asks the ministers whether they know of reports that the Dutch development bank FMO finances land grabbing, tax avoidance and non-transparent arbitration, and what they will do about it, including independent investigation and transparency on land-rights risks.
