The minister answers that the cases are known and discussed with FMO, that independent evaluations and a complaints mechanism exist, but declines to share a list of land-grabbing companies citing client confidentiality and commits only to ongoing dialogue and policy tightening.
It is generally not in the interest of the ongoing investigation to share information about this with external parties.
Het is doorgaans niet in het belang van het lopende onderzoek om informatie hierover te delen met externe partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht dat door het anti-abortusbeleid van president Trump het aantal abortussen in ontwikkelingslanden toeneemt

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Trump administration's expanded Mexico City Policy is raising abortion rates in developing countries and reducing US-funded health services, and what the Netherlands and the EU could do to offset the gap. The minister confirmed the reports, described harmful effects on about fifty health projects including HIV, maternal care and cancer screening, and listed Dutch diplomatic efforts on sexual and reproductive health rights without committing to new funding.
In addition to the financial support to organisations in the field of sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRGR) as set out in my answers
Naast de financiële steun aan organisaties op het terrein van seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten (SRGR) zoals uiteengezet in mijn antwoorden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Oeganda komt opnieuw met wet voor doodstraf homoseksualiteit’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Dutch ministers whether they condemn Ugandan statements and the reported new bill on the death penalty for homosexuality, and what Dutch action is taken. The government condemns the statements, says Uganda's foreign minister assured EU ambassadors no such bill is planned, and describes Dutch LGBTI rights support without committing to new concrete steps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over samenwerking tussen scheepsbouwer Damen en de Nederlandse staat naar aanleiding interne memo’s op het gebied van een corruptieaffaire bij Damen

An SP MP asked the state secretaries whether Damen breached anti-corruption rules after incorrect information on agent payments in 14 cases, whether such conduct is systematic, whether Damen should be excluded from Atradius DSB guarantees, and whether corruption should weigh in the submarine tender. The government declined to judge while the criminal investigation runs, described corrective measures (reassessed cases, lifted World Bank listing, enhanced supervision), and saw no reason to exclude Damen from guarantees or the tender.
Because a criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make further statements about that.
Omdat er nog sprake is van een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kan ik daar geen verdere uitspraken over doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de aanhoudende mensenrechtenschendingen in het Amazoneregenwoud, de plannen van president Bolsonaro van Brazilië om het Amazonewoud verder te vernietigen en de dubbele moraal

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about human rights violations and deforestation in the Brazilian Amazon under President Bolsonaro, the EU-Mercosur trade deal, and the perceived double standard of the EU. The Minister acknowledged the incidents and concerns, stated that the Netherlands and the EU keep raising human rights and forest protection with Brazil, and said the government will take a position on the trade deal once the Commission's sustainability impact assessment and the required documents are available.
The House will be informed in advance of the Cabinet's position.
De Kamer zal vooraf worden geïnformeerd over het standpunt van het Kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya , van den Hul, Ouwehand en Diks over de bosbranden in het Amazonewoud en het Mercosur-verdrag

MPs from SP, PvdA, PvdA-adjacent PvdD and GroenLinks asked whether the Netherlands would side with France and Ireland in opposing ratification of the EU-Mercosur agreement while Amazon fires continue, and whether it would support G7 aid for the Amazon. The minister replied that the government will take a position only once all texts and the Sustainability Impact Assessment are available, expected late 2019, with the Commission expecting a Council decision no earlier than November 2020, and that it will press Brazil bilaterally and within the EU on sustainable forest policy and will report separately on a possible Dutch contribution.
The cabinet will take a position once all necessary texts on the EU-Mercosur Association Agreement are available.
Kabinet zal een standpunt innemen als alle daarvoor noodzakelijke teksten over het EU-Mercosur-Associatieverdrag beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Thieme en Ouwehand over de Amazonebranden en de westerse verantwoordelijkheid bij de branden

MPs Thieme and Ouwehand asked the government whether Amazon fires are human-caused, whether the EU-Mercosur trade deal incentivises deforestation, and whether Dutch firms and trade partners should face sanctions or procurement exclusion. The minister replied that the fires are likely set deliberately, pointed to Brazil's primary responsibility, promised diplomatic pressure within the EU-Mercosur process, and said the Dutch government does not support the soy corridor while the procurement exclusion of named firms is not legally straightforward, so it will only explore aligning procurement with OECD guidelines.
Excluding parties from public procurement is not straightforwardly legally possible.
Het uitsluiten van partijen van overheidsaanbestedingen is niet zonder meer juridisch mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de vrijwaringsmaatregelen op walsdraadstaal

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the EU's revised steel safeguard quota that lowered the progressive quota increase for wire rod from 5% to 3%, and its effects on Dutch firms, asking whether the matter could be taken to the competition commissioner and what the effects were. The Minister confirmed the vote and the change applying to all 26 steel categories, referred the Chamber to the comitology register for the meeting minutes, justified the safeguards as a balance between steel producers and steel users, pointed companies to the competition directorate, and said the Commission will review the effects next year.
I therefore refer you to that register.
Ik verwijs u derhalve naar dat register.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het schenden van mensenrechten door een Nederlands bedrijf bij de sloop van een schip

An MP asked the minister whether a Dutch company, SBM Offshore, breached OECD guidelines and human rights in a ship-breaking project in India, and whether the government would act and suspend its support. The minister said the company was engaged in talks and internal review, that the OECD National Contact Point is the proper channel, that no government funding was involved in the India project, and that the company is not currently applying for trade missions.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs itself cannot investigate working conditions abroad.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken kan zelf geen onderzoek doen naar arbeidsomstandigheden in het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over het ontslag van de directeur van het Braziliaanse instituut dat versnelde ontbossing van Amazone aantoonde

An MP asked the minister whether Brazil's president had dismissed the director of INPE after it published accelerated Amazon deforestation figures, and how the Netherlands would respond. The minister said the dismissal would be worrying if motivated by the figures, that the Netherlands and EU consistently raise Amazon protection with Brazil, and declined to back the INPE workers' protest or urge the Commission to do so.
To the extent this dismissal would be related to the publication of the deforestation figures, this would be a worrying development
Voor zover dit ontslag verband zou houden met de publicatie van de ontbossingscijfers, zou dit een zorgwekkende ontwikkeling zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Haga over de antwoorden op de vragen over het bericht 'Chinese webgigant AliExpress in strijd met Europese regels'

MPs Wörsdörfer and Van Haga asked how many imported products fail consumer and product safety rules, what ACM and NVWA have investigated and enforced against platforms like AliExpress, and how enforcement can be improved. The state secretary answered that no reliable percentage can be given because inspections are risk-based, described enforcement actions, new EU market surveillance rules, and planned consumer awareness campaigns, but declined to give exact counts of investigations or violations.
Because their investigations are targeted, it often turns out that there is a violation.
Omdat hun onderzoeken gericht worden uitgevoerd, blijkt daarom vaak dat er sprake is van een overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over uitspraken van de Minister inzake het vrijhandelsverdrag met de Mercosur-landen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the EU-Mercosur trade agreement actually contains enforceable production, environmental and pesticide standards, and when the government would assess the agreement. The Minister answered that the agreement commits both sides to existing standards and dialogues, but that the EU cannot force Mercosur countries to adopt EU rules, and promised a government position only once all formal texts are available.
The House will be informed of the Cabinet's position before the Council decides on the agreement.
De Kamer zal over het standpunt van het Kabinet worden geïnformeerd voordat de Raad besluit over het akkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raan over het "Special Report on Climate Change and Land" van het IPCC

An MP asks the government about the IPCC Special Report on Climate Change and Land, including the links to diet, livestock, forest and the Schijf van Vijf. The government answers that the report shows effective strategies exist, that a full appraisal will follow in November, and that it does not draw the conclusions the MP attributes to the IPCC.
A comprehensive appraisal of the IPCC report will be sent to you in November (together with that of the forthcoming special report on Oceans and Ice).
Een uitgebreide appreciatie van het IPCC-rapport ontvangt u in november (tezamen met die van het nog te verschijnen speciale rapport over Oceanen en IJs).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over onvoldoende draagvlak voor het verduurzamen van goud

An MP asked the trade and development minister why Dutch gold industry lacks support for fairtrade gold certification and what the government's role is. The minister answered that the gold agreement contains no commitments on fairtrade, that the government regards the withdrawal of the label as regrettable, and that she will ask the steering group to discuss it with Max Havelaar.
Therefore I will ask the steering group of the gold agreement to discuss this with Stichting Max Havelaar.
Daarom zal ik de stuurgroep van het goudconvenant vragen hierover in gesprek te gaan met Stichting Max Havelaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de ontbossing van de Amazone

An MP from D66 asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about deforestation of the Amazon, including the Corredor Centro-Norte infrastructure, Dutch companies' involvement, and support for a WWF protected-area initiative. The Minister answered that the Netherlands does not fund the corridor's development, that policy has not changed, and that the government is studying an additional contribution to be reported to parliament this autumn.
This autumn the House will be informed about this in a letter.
Dit najaar zal de Kamer daar per brief over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over de verkoop en distributie van pakketjes door Alibaba in Nederland

VVD MPs Weverling and Van Haga asked the government about Alibaba/AliExpress parcel distribution, unfair competition from China, Universal Postal Union tariffs and US proposals. The State Secretary answered at length, largely defending the 2016 tariff reform and EU/WTO tools, while withholding PostNL commercial figures as confidential.
Information about commercial agreements between parties is confidential, and making it public would harm PostNL's international competitive position.
Informatie over commerciële afspraken tussen partijen zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk en het publiek maken daarvan zou de internationale concurrentiepositie van PostNL schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het drastisch versnellen van het tempo waarop het Amazoneregenwoud wordt vernietigd

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the sharp rise in Amazon deforestation, its climate consequences, the EU-Mercosur deal, Dutch company involvement, and measures to stop the destruction. The Minister answered that deforestation matters greatly for climate, that the Mercosur deal includes deforestation provisions and a sustainability impact assessment is pending, and described ongoing cooperation and IMVO measures, while declining to provide a list of Dutch companies linked to deforestation.
Dutch companies are not obliged to report to the Dutch government which activities they carry out abroad.
Nederlandse bedrijven zijn niet verplicht om aan de Nederlandse overheid te melden welke zaken zij in het buitenland doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Van Haga over het opschorten van de hulp aan UNRWA

MPs Voordewind and Van Haga asked whether the UNRWA leadership should be replaced and whether Dutch payments should resume only after the ethics investigation, citing alleged misconduct, nepotism and procurement bypassing. Minister Kaag replied that Dutch funding is suspended pending the UN's independent inspection, that payments will require the usual preconditions, and that the government will not pre-empt the UN findings or the outcome on the Commissioner-General.
It is up to the UN to provide clarity and to act adequately.
Het is aan de VN om opheldering te geven en toereikend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van den Hul over sancties tegen bedrijven die gelieerd zijn aan het militaire regime in Myanmar

An MP asked whether Dutch companies such as Shell, linked to Max Energy Myanmar, could be sanctioned for ties to the Myanmar military and the Rakhine atrocities, and what the government would do about it. The minister said the government backs targeted sanctions against responsible individuals, will examine the UN fact-finding report, will raise Shell's exposure with the company, and that no Dutch public money went to Max Energy Myanmar.
Companies are not obliged to report to the Dutch government in which countries and with which parties they do business.
Bedrijven zijn niet verplicht om bij de Nederlandse overheid te melden in welk land en met welke partijen zij zakendoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuik over de onrechtmatige financiering van Soedanese veiligheidstroepen uit het European Union Emergency Trust Fund (EUTF)

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about alleged EU funding of Sudanese security forces via the EUTF, including the status of the BMM programme, monitoring, and whether EU-funded materials reached the RSF. The minister answered that BMM was not stopped but training was paused, that the Netherlands is not a direct financier, that EU safeguards exclude RSF participation and repressive-use equipment, and that no further investigation was deemed necessary.
I do not consider further investigation into this necessary.
Verder onderzoek hiernaar acht ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over de ontbossing van het Braziliaanse Amazonegebied

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers whether they share concern over rising Amazon deforestation under Bolsonaro, whether the Netherlands has raised it, and whether Germany's suspension of environmental aid should be matched. The government says it shares the concern, has raised deforestation with Brazil through several channels, will keep doing so, but declines to match Germany's aid suspension and is still deliberating on further steps.
The Netherlands expresses its concern about the increasing deforestation at every suitable opportunity, both when it is in the news and when it is not.
Nederland uit bij alle in aanmerking komende gelegenheden zijn zorgen over de toenemende ontbossing, zowel wanneer dit in het nieuws is, als wanneer dit niet in het nieuws is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over het kabinetsbeleid ten aanzien van de defensie-industrie

MPs Van Haga and Bosman ask the government to reconcile its support for the domestic defence industry with its strict arms-export policy and with the FMO exclusion list that bars firms earning 10% or more from weapons from trade-promotion and financing instruments such as DTIF. The ministers confirm the policy tension, state that generic trade instruments are now open to defence firms, and say the government will review remaining aspects of defence trade support by Prinsjesdag 2019 while denying any intent to penalise the sector.
At present, however, the cabinet is considering whether trade support for the defence sector can be adjusted on this point in light of the DIS.
Op dit moment beziet het kabinet echter of de handelsinzet voor de defensiesector op dit punt in het licht van de DIS kan worden aangepast
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over de impact van het eenzijdig aangescherpte wapenexportbeleid voor de concurrentiepositie van de Nederlandse defensie-industrie

MPs Van Haga and Bosman asked about the impact of the Dutch tightened arms export policy toward the UAE, Egypt and Saudi Arabia on the competitiveness of the Dutch defence industry, including comparisons with German, French, Spanish and Czech practice, the Dutch military presence in the UAE, and whether defence firms can join trade missions. The government answered that the Netherlands is not acting alone since Germany and Finland also restricted exports, that the policy is justified by international obligations and humanitarian law, and that it regrets the negative effects on Dutch defence firms while pursuing harmonisation within the EU and opening trade missions to defence firms.
Arms export control is a national competence. EU member states are themselves responsible for assessing arms export applications against the eight criteria of the EU Common Position on arms exports.

Wapenexportcontrole is een nationale bevoegdheid. EU-lidstaten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de toetsing van wapenexportaanvragen aan de acht criteria van het EU Gemeenschappelijk Standpunt inzake wapenexport.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özütok, Diks en Van Ojik over Venezolaans conflictgoud dat via Curaçao en Aruba wordt verhandeld

Three GroenLinks MPs asked the government about Venezuelan conflict gold being traded via Curaçao and Aruba, and how this fits with Dutch recognition of Guaidó and the gold covenant. The State Secretary answered that Curaçao and Aruba have banned Venezuelan gold trade, that no Venezuelan gold import was declared in Caribbean Netherlands in five years, and that the EU conflict minerals regulation applies from 2021, with the gold covenant and due diligence as the main tools.
Regarding the nature and scale of gold trade on Sint Maarten, despite inquiries with the Sint Maarten government, I currently have no figures available.
Van de aard en omvang van de handel in goud op Sint Maarten zijn mij, ondanks navraag bij de regering van Sint Maarten, op dit moment geen cijfers bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Diks over de export van cybersurveillance technologie

Two MPs from GroenLinks asked whether Dutch firms should supply emotion-recognition and surveillance technology used by China's Ministry of Public Security, and what controls apply to cybersurveillance exports. The minister says such use is unacceptable, firms must exercise due diligence, export licences are refused where human-rights concerns exist, and the Netherlands keeps pushing for EU-level controls while declining to pre-empt the stalled dual-use regulation revision.
The Netherlands will continue to work to keep the subject on the agenda.
Nederland zal zich ervoor blijven inzetten dat het onderwerp op de agenda blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht 'Berucht Chinees veiligheidsministerie gebruikt Nederlandse software die emoties leest'

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch firms supplied emotion-recognition software to Chinese public security bodies, whether such software and surveillance enable abuses in China, and whether export controls on cyber-surveillance technology should be tightened. The minister confirmed one joint delivery by two Dutch firms, acknowledged serious rights risks, said Dutch export controls cover certain cyber-surveillance goods but not facial or emotion recognition, and reported that the EU dual-use revision failed to include cyber-surveillance controls, which the Netherlands continues to support.
The Netherlands will work to ensure the subject remains on the agenda in the future.
Nederland zal zich ervoor inzetten dat het onderwerp in de toekomst op de agenda blijft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer, Ouwehand, Voordewind en Bouali over het bericht ‘de zwarte kant van het voetbal’

Four MPs from SGP, PvdD, ChristenUnie and D66 asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about reported deaths of migrant workers building World Cup facilities in Qatar and what the government is doing about labour abuse there. The ministers answered that every death is one too many, that Qatar has begun reforms with the ILO and that the Netherlands raises the issue bilaterally and multilaterally, while declining to boycott the tournament.
It does not fit Dutch policy to boycott sporting events because of political situations.
Het past niet in het Nederlandse beleid om sportevenementen te boycotten vanwege politieke situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het voornemen van Japan om de commerciële walvisjacht te hervatten

An MP from GroenLinks asked the minister whether JEFTA offers ways to pressure Japan over resuming commercial whaling and how Iceland and Norway could be moved to stop whaling. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposes Japan's whaling, will raise it under the trade and sustainable development chapter in early 2020, and that the EU has made diplomatic demarches and Council conclusions calling on Iceland and Norway to respect the moratorium.
The Netherlands will press within the EU for discussing Japan's resumption of whaling under the sustainability chapter at the Trade and Sustainable Development Committee in early 2020.

Nederland zal binnen de EU aandringen op het bespreken van de Japanse hervatting van de walvisjacht in het kader van het duurzaamheidshoofdstuk tijdens het Comité inzake handel en duurzame ontwikkeling begin 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het financieren van belastingontwijkende bedrijven door FMO

MP Diks (GroenLinks) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether FMO's financing of companies using tax avoidance structures via Mauritius, including the Kenmare/Moma mine in Mozambique, is acceptable and whether rules or shareholder influence should change. The minister answered that FMO's policy already excludes financing through tax-avoidance structures, that no regulatory change is needed, and that the government sees no reason to press FMO for policy change.
Given that FMO policy already is not to provide financing through structures aimed at tax avoidance, the cabinet currently sees no reason to engage with FMO on a possible adjustment of this policy.

Gezien het feit dat het FMO-beleid reeds is om geen financiering te verstrekken middels structuren gericht op belastingontwijking ziet het kabinet op dit moment geen reden om met FMO in gesprek te gaan over mogelijke aanpassing van dit beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Diks over het door de Chinese autoriteiten oppakken van activist(en) die zich onder meer inzetten voor hiv-/aidspatiënten

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Diks asked the ministers whether they would seek clarity on the charge against Chinese NGO workers detained for alleged subversion, and how this relates to China's UNAIDS chairmanship. The ministers answered that the embassy follows the case, raises it through the EU and the bilateral human rights dialogue, and that the chair is performing correctly, while concerns about NGO pressure will continue to be raised.
Concerns about individual cases, such as the arrest of Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze and Xiao Wu, are raised through the bilateral human rights dialogue or in meetings of the UN Human Rights Council.

Zorgen over individuele gevallen, zoals de arrestatie van Cheng Yuan, Liu Yongze en Xiao Wu, worden via de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog overgebracht of in vergaderingen van de VN-Mensenrechtenraad aan de orde gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het corruptieschandaal bij de UNRWA

PVV MPs asked the minister about an ethics report alleging abuse of power, corruption and excessive travel at UNRWA, and asked for an account of Dutch funds lost, a halt to all Dutch funding, and a repayment of transferred money. The minister answered that she awaits the UN OIOS findings, that Dutch funding is held back pending UN clarification, that no fraud is established in UNRWA's core tasks, and that the annual contribution of 13 million euro will likely continue.
I am awaiting the judgment of the independent inspectorate of the United Nations in New York.
Ik wacht het oordeel van de onafhankelijke inspectie van de Verenigde Naties in New York af
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van den Hul over leefbaar loon in de kledingindustrie

MPs Alkaya and Van den Hul asked the minister about the Schone Kleren Campagne finding that major fashion brands cannot show their workers earn a living wage, whether the government is pushing living wages in producing countries, whether living wages are enforceable under the textile covenant, and how garment prices would be affected. The minister acknowledged the problem, described cooperation with the ILO and other partners and the textile covenant's living wage goal for 2020 with monitoring and a complaints mechanism, said the covenant evaluation will inform possible further measures, and noted that a living wage need not raise retail prices significantly.
The cabinet therefore currently sees no reason to change the course of its policy.
Het kabinet ziet daarom op dit moment geen aanleiding om de koers van haar beleid te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de bestorming van de al-Aqsa compound door honderden kolonisten gesteund door Israëlische militairen

Dutch MP Kuzu (DENK) asked the ministers about the storming of the al-Aqsa compound by settlers escorted by Israeli forces, and whether the government condemns it, will act, and supports a UN mission. Minister Blok answered that the Temple Mount status quo is important, that the Netherlands and the EU have repeatedly urged its preservation, but that the Netherlands plays no mediating role and does not support an independent UN monitoring mission.

No. In recent years Israel, the Palestinian Authority and Jordan have shown they are able, sometimes with difficulty and sometimes with external help, to make arrangements about the holy sites in Jerusalem.

Nee. De afgelopen jaren hebben Israël, de Palestijnse Autoriteit en Jordanië aangetoond dat zij in staat zijn, soms met moeite en soms met externe hulp, om afspraken te maken over de heilige plaatsen in Jeruzalem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over een rapport over beleggingen in wapenproductie en wapenhandel

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked the ministers whether Dutch banks ING, ABN AMRO and Van Lanschot Kempen investing in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, the UAE and Egypt is compatible with Dutch arms export policy, and whether the IMVO banking covenant and the government should act. The government answered that banks are individually responsible for due diligence under OECD guidelines and UN principles, that export licensing is a national competence, and that it would not ban such investments or add covenant commitments.
The cabinet therefore does not consider it necessary to prohibit the said investments.
Het kabinet acht het verbieden van de genoemde investeringen daarom niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het economische deel van het Israëlisch-Palestijnse vredesplan

Two CDA MPs asked the government about a US-organised economic conference in Bahrain on the economic part of the Israeli-Palestinian peace plan, its participants, Dutch and EU contributions, and barriers to Palestinian economic growth. The government answered that it attended at senior civil-servant level, outlined EU and Dutch aid and World Bank growth estimates, and called for a two-state solution and donor involvement, while noting the US plan lacked attention to occupation's effects.
The Netherlands will continue to press for this and keep seeking dialogue in other forums such as the Ad Hoc Liaison Committee.
Nederland zal daar op aan blijven dringen en de dialoog blijven zoeken in andere fora zoals de Ad Hoc Liaison Committee
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Nijboer en Van den Hul over Nederlandse verzekeraars die meer kunnen doen om medicijnen betaalbaar te maken

Three PvdA MPs asked whether Dutch insurers such as Aegon and Allianz, which invest heavily in pharmaceutical firms, should press those firms on medicine prices, tax payment and the Access to Medicine Index investor pledge. The minister answered that insurers are responsible for their own investment policy, pointed to existing IMVO covenant commitments and the OECD guidelines, encouraged signing the pledge, and saw no reason for further measures on transparency.
Institutional investors, including insurers, are responsible for their own investment policy and decide themselves in which companies to invest.
Institutionele beleggers, waaronder verzekeraars, zijn verantwoordelijk voor hun eigen beleggingsbeleid en bepalen zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Malmström – Finalizing Mercosur deal is ‘priority number one’

MPs Lodders and Van Haga asked about the state of the EU-Mercosur trade negotiations, the urgency of concluding them, whether farm and chemical standards would be weakened, and what concessions on agriculture were on the table. The ministers answered that a political agreement had been reached, that EU standards will not be lowered, that the cabinet will assess the balance once consolidated texts are available, and that they would not disclose other ministers' reactions.
Once the consolidated texts become available, the cabinet can assess the balance of the advantages and disadvantages of the trade agreement for the Netherlands.
Als de geconsolideerde teksten beschikbaar komen, kan het kabinet de balans op te maken van de voor- en nadelen van het handelsakkoord voor Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Ploumen, Van den Hul, Voordewind, Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht ‘IND stuurt yezidi’s terug naar kampen in Noord-Irak, VN ongerust’

MPs asked the State Secretary whether Iraqi Yezidis are being returned to camps in Northern Iraq despite UNHCR concern, and whether Kurdish camps can absorb them. The State Secretary answered that Yezidis from other parts of Iraq who fled to the Kurdistan Region and lived there long-term are no longer treated as having a normal residence there, so the vulnerable minority policy applies, and that the Kurdish shelter situation is not generally inadequate.
I have asked the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to give extra attention to the Yezidis in the upcoming general country report on Iraq, which I expect early next year.
Ik heb het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken gevraagd bij het komende algemeen ambtsbericht over Irak, dat ik begin volgend jaar verwacht, extra aandacht te besteden aan de jezidi’s
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Futselaar en Alkaya over het ontnemen van toegang van Huawei tot Google-software door de Verenigde Staten

MPs Futselaar and Alkaya asked the government about the US decision to restrict Huawei's access to Google Android, its effects on Dutch users, the justification for it, and whether Dutch policy should shift. The government answered that the effects are not yet clear, that current Huawei phones keep working, that Dutch risks are assessed case by case, and that it rejects the need for a US strategy while pursuing multilateral trade reform.
The cabinet does not share this view and therefore sees no reason to draw up an American strategy.
Het kabinet deelt deze mening niet en ziet hierin derhalve geen aanleiding een Amerikastrategie op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wörsdörfer en Van Haga over het bericht 'Chinese webgigant AliExpress in strijd met Europese regels'

Two MPs asked whether AliExpress's terms breach Dutch and EU consumer rules, what the government will do to protect Dutch consumers buying from non-EU sellers, and why China strategy omitted this. The Secretary of State said enforcement lies with the ACM and courts, outlined EU cooperation, WTO e-commerce talks, product safety pledges, and an awareness campaign, and argued the share of purchases from Chinese webshops is still small.

It is up to the supervisory authority Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) and the courts to assess whether a company complies with the consumer rules in force in Europe and the Netherlands and, if not, which rules have been breached.

Het is aan de toezichthouder Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) en de rechter om te beoordelen of een bedrijf zich aan de in Europa en Nederland geldende consumentenregels houdt en zo nee, welke regels zijn overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over het bericht 'Aanval op WTO door Trump dwingt Europa tot noodgreep'

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade about reports that US obstruction of WTO Appellate Body appointments will leave the body inoperative from December 2019, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing about it. The minister confirmed the risk, said the EU is working on an interim appeal arrangement with other WTO members, and said the Netherlands supports the Commission in pressing to lift the blockage.
The Netherlands supports the European Commission in conveying the importance of the multilateral trading system, with a system of binding dispute settlement.
Nederland steunt de Europese Commissie in het uitdragen van het belang van het multilaterale handelssysteem, met een systeem van bindende geschillenbeslechting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Nigerian fishers hit by criminals, imports and climate change’

An MP asked the government about reports of Nigerian fishers being hit by criminals, imports and climate change, including whether the Netherlands or the EU has fisheries agreements with Nigeria or Sao Tome and Principe, the scale of Dutch fish exports to Nigeria, the consequences of possibly illegal overfishing, and whether a Dutch company owns a Nigerian shrimping venture. The minister answered that there is no Dutch or EU fisheries agreement with Nigeria, gave details of the Sao Tome protocol and export figures, and confirmed a joint venture by Cornelis Vrolijk without committing to any new action.
The company Atlantic Shrimpers is a joint venture of the Dutch company Cornelis Vrolijk.
Het bedrijf Atlantic Shrimpers is een joint venture van het Nederlandse bedrijf Cornelis Vrolijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over de vernietiging van Hollandse uien in Hongarije

MPs Amhaouch and Geurts asked the government about Hungarian authorities destroying a Dutch onion consignment that lacked origin labelling, and whether this was lawful and avoidable. The minister answered that the missing label breached rules, that the consignment was sent to biogas digestion after a spot check, that Hungarian law permits such measures, and that talks with Hungary will be held to prevent recurrence.
I will discuss with the relevant Hungarian authorities whether agreements are possible to prevent this in the future.
Ik zal met de betreffende Hongaarse autoriteiten bespreken of afspraken mogelijk zijn om dit in de toekomst te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Ploumen over het bericht dat er nieuw bewijs is van China's missie om de moskeeën in Xinjiang te verwoesten

MPs Kuzu and Ploumen asked the government about reports that China is demolishing mosques and shrines in Xinjiang, whether this violates universal human rights, and what the Netherlands and the EU have done to press China. The ministers answer that the demolitions fit a broader pattern of restricted freedoms in Xinjiang that they consider contrary to international human rights norms, list bilateral, EU and UN initiatives, and say they will keep pressing for meaningful access for UN experts to Xinjiang.
The cabinet continues to call for meaningful access to Xinjiang for UN (human rights) experts, including the High Commissioner for Human Rights.
Het kabinet blijft pleiten voor betekenisvolle toegang tot Xinjiang voor (mensenrechten)experts van de VN, waaronder de Hoge Commissaris voor de Mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat het leger van Myanmar opnieuw mensenrechten schendt

An MP asked the Foreign and Development Ministers about Amnesty International's report on new Myanmar army abuses in Rakhine State, including demands for sanctions, an ICC referral and a arms embargo. The ministers condemned the violence, said Netherlands keeps pressing for ICC referral, sanctions and an investigation mechanism, but noted UN Security Council deadlock blocks action.
On 17 June, Minister Blok again called in the Foreign Affairs Council for additional sanctions against those responsible for the human rights violations.
Minister Blok heeft op 17 juni in de RBZ nogmaals opgeroepen tot aanvullende sancties tegen de verantwoordelijken voor de mensenrechtenschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food- Council of Europe’

MPs Van den Hul and Kuiken asked the ministers whether the government was aware of, and shocked by, the Council of Europe Commissioner's report on Hungary depriving asylum seekers of food, and whether it had raised this with Hungary or the EU. The government answered that it knows the report, shares the concerns, raises them bilaterally and in the EU, notes Commission infringement procedures, and supports a formal Article 7 dialogue with Hungary.
The cabinet will continue to raise the concerns both bilaterally and at European level with the Hungarian authorities.
Het kabinet blijft de zorgen in zowel bilateraal als Europees verband uitspreken richting de Hongaarse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Kuiken en Voordewind over het bericht ‘VVD en CDA zien geen heil in terughalen IS-kinderen’

MPs Ploumen, Kuiken and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade and Development about the situation of Dutch IS women and children held in Syrian camps, their ability to reach Dutch consulates, the Red Cross offer to bring children to Erbil, and calls for an international tribunal. The government answered that it does not actively pursue repatriation of adult jihadist travellers and their children, that conditions in Al-Hol are very poor, and that it is working on options for prosecution with international partners while stating no tribunal has yet been agreed.
The cabinet sees the children in this matter first and foremost as victims.
Het kabinet ziet de kinderen in deze kwestie in de eerste plaats als slachtoffer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van Ojik over het bericht ‘Western firms get tangled in China’s Uighur crackdown’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the ministers whether forced labour in Xinjiang re-education camps and a surge in yarn production is linked to garments sold in the Netherlands, and what the government will do about supply chains and the textile covenant. The government condemns forced labour, says it cannot confirm or deny that Xinjiang yarn ends up in Dutch clothing, and promises to raise the issue within the covenant and with China, without committing to talks with individual brands.
The government therefore can neither confirm nor deny that yarn from Xinjiang, produced with forced labour, has been processed into clothing sold in the Netherlands.
Het kabinet kan daarom bevestigen noch ontkennen dat garen uit Xinjiang, geproduceerd met gedwongen arbeid, is verwerkt in kleding die in Nederland wordt verkocht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht dat de VS een steeds steviger abortusbeleid voert

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers about reports that the US is tightening anti-abortion funding rules abroad, asking for the government's reaction, diplomatic steps, and ways to offset the effects. The minister said the government regrets the measures, has raised concerns with US officials, and points to continued SRGR funding and several parliamentary amendments being implemented.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het bericht ‘UNHCR evacueert honderden vluchtelingen uit kamp bij Tripoli’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about UNHCR evacuating hundreds of refugees from a camp near Tripoli, including the dangers in Libyan detention centres, Amnesty's call for an investigation into injuries to migrants, and whether Italy's EU request was received. The minister referred back to earlier answers on several points, expressed regret about the incident at Qasr Ben Ghasir and stressed the need for accountability, and said the government follows the situation closely without committing to a new concrete step.
I refer you to the answers given to your House's questions to the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of Foreign Affairs on 23 April.
Graag verwijs ik u naar de beantwoording van gestelde vragen door uw Kamer aan de Staatssecretaris van Justitie en Veiligheid en de Minister van Buitenlandse Zaken op 23 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Lodders over haar bewering dat gebonden hulp verleden tijd is

MPs Van Haga and Lodders asked the minister about her claim that tied aid is a thing of the past, including notification obligations, transaction-level data on tied aid notifications, and ODA tied/untied breakdowns. The minister confirmed the claim, explained OECD notification rules, withheld transaction-level notification data as confidential under the Arrangement but offered aggregated figures, and stated the government supports untied aid while still promoting Dutch firms where they have a comparative advantage.
However, I offer you non-traceable, aggregated data regarding questions 3d and 3e, which gives an impression of the scale of this trade-related tied aid.
Wel bied ik u met betrekking tot de vragen 3d en 3e niet herleidbare, geaggregeerde data aan, waarmee een beeld ontstaat van de omvang van deze handelsgerelateerde gebonden hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over het bericht ‘Wise persons' to scrutinize EU development finance’

An MP asked the minister about an EU High-Level Group of Wise Persons scrutinizing EU development finance architecture, including fragmentation and China's role. The minister said the group will assess EU external investment architecture and that Nederland will use its recommendations in negotiations on the EFSD+, and promised to inform parliament of the conclusions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ploumen over maatregelen tegen Amerikaanse sancties tegen Iran

MPs Karabulut and Ploumen asked whether the EU anti-boycott regulation against US sanctions on Iran is effective and whether the US sanctions are unlawful, and what steps can protect the JCPOA and trade with Iran. The ministers answered that the regulation is in place but unused by Dutch firms, that INSTEX is being developed, that Dutch firms decide independently to cut trade, and that the Netherlands remains committed to the JCPOA.
The cabinet has no figures on the trading activities of individual Dutch companies with Iran.
Het kabinet heeft geen cijfers over de handelsactiviteiten van individuele Nederlandse bedrijven met Iran.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Weverling en Van Haga over de verkoop en distributie van pakketjes door Alibaba in Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate and the Minister for Foreign Trade about cheap Alibaba parcels shipped to the Netherlands, counterfeit goods, postal delivery fee rules under the Universal Postal Union, and the risk of unfair competition from China. The government answered at length, stating that many details are commercially confidential, that the postal fee system is being phased toward parity, that the US threat to leave the UPU is being addressed multilaterally, and that China trade issues will be pursued via the WTO and the new China strategy.
This concerns commercially sensitive and confidential business information.
Dit betreft commercieel gevoelige en bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht ‘Vijf jaar na de grote ontvoering door Boko Haram, zijn nog 112 schoolmeisjes niet vrij’

An MP asked why the government has made no concrete proposal to Nigeria to help find the 112 still-missing Chibok schoolgirls, and asked about trauma support, satellite imagery, NGO contacts and gender-violence programmes. The ministers answered that Nigeria has made no request for help, that Dutch psychosocial aid already reaches Boko Haram victims, and that other states are handling satellite sharing and support.
This is a matter between third countries and Nigeria, in which the Netherlands is not involved.
Dit is een zaak tussen derde landen en Nigeria, waar Nederland niet bij betrokken is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over de gevolgen van Braziliaans landbouwbeleid voor Nederland

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture and trade ministers about the effects of Brazil's farm policy under Bolsonaro, including deforestation, approval of 120 chemicals banned in the EU, residue controls on Brazilian imports, and the Dutch sugar beet seed derogation. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the Netherlands is raising them with Brazil and at EU level, noted that residue monitoring shows no reason for extra controls, and defended the refusal of a neonicotinoid derogation while confirming a temporary alternative pesticide exemption.
The Netherlands is intensifying dialogue with the Brazilian government on agriculture and climate, to convey our concerns on the one hand
Nederland is de dialoog met de Braziliaanse overheid op het gebied van landbouw en klimaat aan het intensiveren, om aan de ene kant onze zorgen over te brengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van den Hul en Voordewind over het bericht ‘De jezidi’s zijn hun familie en cultuur kwijt’

MPs Ploumen, Van den Hul and Voordewind asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and of Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Yazidi women and children remain missing or enslaved, the role of Yazidi support organisations, Syrian regime action, aid withdrawal from Duhok and psychosocial programmes. The ministers answered that about 3,083 Yazidis were still held or missing as of late 2018, outlined existing Dutch and EU support, and committed to no new concrete steps beyond ongoing programmes and an October 2019 conference.
The Netherlands has no diplomatic relations with the Assad regime and the cabinet has no independent information on regime actions to free possibly enslaved Yazidis.
Nederland onderhoudt geen diplomatieke betrekkingen met het Assad-regime en het kabinet heeft geen eigenstandige informatie over regime-acties om mogelijke tot slaaf gemaakte jezidi’s te bevrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Mozambique: Cyclone Victims Forced to Trade Sex for Food’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that cyclone victims in Mozambique were forced to trade sex for food, with local leaders abusing their power over aid distribution, and asked about protection, UN oversight and gender participation in distribution. The minister answered that the abuse is unacceptable, that the embassy and UN raised it with Mozambican authorities, that the UN tightened PSEA rules, and that the ambassador will raise it bilaterally and revisit the affected regions.
Abuse by local community leaders of their position of power in food distribution is wholly unacceptable.
Misbruik door lokale gemeenschapsleiders van hun machtspositie bij voedseldistributie is volstrekt onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Bowing to U.S. demands, UN waters down resolution on sexual violence in conflict’

Two MPs asked the Dutch ministers about reports that the UN Security Council watered down a resolution on sexual violence in conflict under US veto pressure, including the removal of sexual and reproductive health language and the weakened reference to the ICC. The government said it regrets the US threat, supports reproductive health language and the French position, sees no direct consequences for victim assistance or UNFPA funding, and explained the ICC reference change as a compromise.
The Netherlands explicitly spoke out for sexual and reproductive health and rights during its intervention in the open debate.
Nederland heeft zich tijdens de interventie in het open debat expliciet uitgesproken voor seksuele en reproductieve gezondheid en rechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ouwehand en Van Raan over het openbreken van de associatieovereenkomst met Oekraïne en het vervolgens fors verhogen van de importquota voor Oekraïens kippenvlees

MPs Ouwehand and Van Raan asked whether the EU-Ukraine association agreement quota for Ukrainian chicken meat was tripled through a loophole, which Dutch and other EU processors may have facilitated, and whether the government would act to stop it. The minister confirmed the loophole and a proposed quota increase, said the government will decide its position after reviewing the Commission proposal, and gave limited answers on the named companies and the EBRD loan, pointing to other bodies.
The cabinet will study the European Commission's proposal after publication and on that basis take a definitive position.
Het kabinet zal het voorstel van de Europese Commissie, na publicatie, bestuderen en op basis hiervan een definitief standpunt innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Bisschop over het voorlopig akkoord over de import van kippenvlees uit Oekraïne

MPs Stoffer and Bisschop asked whether the EU-Ukraine provisional deal raising the duty-free poultry quota from 20,000 to 70,000 tonnes would mean more Ukrainian chicken fillet on the EU market, and whether the government would push for tighter terms. The ministers answered that the Commission is still negotiating, that the government will assess the draft Council decision and the parliamentary motion before taking a final position, and that it has written to Commissioner Hogan raising concerns.
The cabinet will study the Commission's draft Council decision and on that basis take a definitive position.

Het kabinet zal het concept Raadsbesluit ten behoeve van goedkeuring met ondertekening en voorlopige toepassing van de Europese Commissie bestuderen en op basis hiervan een definitief standpunt innemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Bangladesh: Rohingya Refugee Students Expelled'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Bangladesh bars Rohingya refugee children from formal education and aid groups struggle to provide schooling. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said the government raises access to education with Bangladesh and donors, and pointed to Dutch funding for Education Cannot Wait.
I raised the lack of access to education with the authorities and asked them to be more open to solutions that offer Rohingya children the necessary education.
Ik heb het gebrek aan toegang tot onderwijs aan de orde gesteld en de autoriteiten gevraagd meer open te staan voor oplossingen die Rohingya-kinderen noodzakelijk onderwijs bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht ‘Meer dwangarbeid Eritrea door EU’

Diks (GroenLinks) asked the foreign trade and development minister whether a EU Africa Trust Fund investment in Eritrean road infrastructure contributes to forced labour and conscription, and asked for guarantees and suspension. Minister Kaag replied that the EU funds only materials and equipment through UNOPS, that workers are paid, that the EU agreed labour and wage conditions with Eritrea, and that Netherlands supports the project as part of a two-track approach while rejecting forced labour.
The Netherlands is opposed to the use of forced labour and slavery and critical of the way long-term conscription in Eritrea is implemented.
Nederland is tegen de inzet van dwangarbeid en slavernij en kritisch over de wijze waarop de langdurige dienstplicht in Eritrea gestalte krijgt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van Haga over het bericht ‘Europa pakt Oekraïense kippenvleesexport aan’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about reports that the EU was tackling Ukrainian chicken meat exports, including how a quota increase from 20,000 to 70,000 tonnes fits with the removal of duties on chicken parts and whether a provisional application of the Association Agreement amendment should proceed before European Parliament consent. The minister explained that Ukrainian exporters exploited an unforeseen tariff loophole, that renegotiation is underway and requires Council and European Parliament approval, and that the government will assess the Commission's proposal and raise concerns about the quota and SPS/animal welfare implementation.
In anticipation, the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality sent a letter on 25 April 2019 to Commissioner Hogan expressing concerns about the provisional outcome of the negotiations.

Vooruitlopend hierop heeft de Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit op 25 april 2019 een brief aan Commissaris Hogan gestuurd waarin zorgen worden geuit over de voorlopige uitkomst van de onderhandelingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over geweld tegen vrouwen in Vietnamese textielfabrieken

An MP asked the foreign trade and development minister about a Fair Wear Foundation and Care study finding that 43% of female garment workers in Vietnam faced violence or intimidation at work, and whether Dutch brands sourcing from such factories could be identified and held responsible. The minister acknowledged the problem, said brands should investigate their own sourcing practices and that the textile convenant and union cooperation are the channels for improvement, but gave no factory or brand identification.
The cabinet will soon inform the House of the Dutch position on the proposed convention.
Het kabinet zal de Kamer binnenkort informeren over de Nederlandse opstelling ten aanzien van de voorgestelde conventie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over doodstraf voor homo’s in Brunei

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether the Syariah Penal Code phases 2 and 3 in Brunei, including death by stoning, would take effect and what Dutch and international pressure could prevent this. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands and the EU raised concerns, issued statements and pressed Brunei, that a moratorium on the death penalty was announced, and that Dutch support for civil society and LGBTI rights continues.
The cabinet has taken note with great concern of Brunei's decision to introduce phases 2 and 3 of the Syariah Penal Code.
Het kabinet heeft met veel zorg kennisgenomen van het besluit van Brunei om fase 2 en 3 van de Syariah Penal Code in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de toename van geweld in Mali

An MP from GroenLinks asked the government about the rise in violence in Mali, MINUSMA's role, causes linked to natural resources, diplomatic and development responses, and the Fomi Dam in Guinea. The minister answered at length, describing MINUSMA's continued necessity, Dutch diplomatic and development efforts, and noting the Fomi Dam matter is handled mainly at technical level with the Niger Basin Authority.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Van Ojik en Karabulut over vervolging van de Palestijnse mensenrechtenverdediger Issa Amro

MPs Van den Hul, Van Ojik and Karabulut asked the government about prosecutions of Palestinian human rights defender Issa Amro by Palestinian and Israeli authorities, including criticism of Amnesty and Front Line Defenders reports and whether the EU and the Netherlands support him. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concern over shrinking civic space, urges both authorities to respect free expression and drop charges covered by that right, and that the EU and member states have attended hearings, with the next hearing set for 22 May.
The EU and the Netherlands both follow the two legal cases against Amro closely, including by attending hearings.
De EU en Nederland volgen beide rechtszaken tegen Amro nauwgezet, onder andere door het bijwonen van hoorzittingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Niger, part 1: At the centre of a brewing militant storm’

Two Dutch MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about rising displacement, violence and instability in Niger's Tillabéri and Tahoua regions and the Dutch response. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares the concerns, is supporting UNHCR and Niger with EUR 100 million for 2019–2022, and is focusing on stability, youth and governance, without any institutional or oversight change.
The Netherlands supports UNHCR with an unearmarked contribution of EUR 33 million.
Nederland steunt UNHCR met een ongeoormerkte bijdrage van EUR 33 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het voortbestaan van het Bangladesh Akkoord voor veilige textielfabrieken

An MP asked the minister whether the Bangladesh Accord on factory fire and building safety could keep operating after its funds were blocked, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister replied that a payment had been received and the problem was resolved, that building safety remains a problem in other sectors, and that Dutch efforts continue, including a gradual handover to the Bangladeshi labour inspectorate.
The Netherlands is making every effort to keep the Accord operating effectively in Bangladesh for the time being.
Nederland spant zich maximaal in om het Akkoord voorlopig op effectieve wijze in Bangladesh te laten voortbestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat het Rode Kruis Venezuela mag betreden met hulpgoederen

MPs Bouali and Sjoerdsma asked whether the government knows that the Red Cross received permission from Maduro to deliver emergency aid to Venezuela, and about shortages of medicine and food, the scale of the operation and Dutch funding. Minister Kaag confirmed the crisis and noted that Dutch contributions since 2018 total over EUR 1.6 million, with an additional EUR 2 million, while stressing that aid must be neutral and reach those most in need.
The Netherlands has contributed at various moments over the past year to Red Cross relief efforts in Venezuela and the region.
Nederland heeft het afgelopen jaar op verschillende momenten bijgedragen aan de hulpverlening van het Rode Kruis in Venezuela en de regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koopmans en Van Haga over de miljardendeals van Frankrijk met China

MPs Koopmans and Van Haga asked the government about Italy's and Luxembourg's signing of China's Belt and Road memoranda and whether this undermines a common EU China policy and screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that member states may maintain bilateral ties, that the EU investment screening regulation enters into force on 19 April, and that member states remain committed to EU-level consensus on China.
EU member states are free to maintain bilateral relations with China, as the Netherlands also does.
Het staat EU-lidstaten vrij bilaterale relaties te onderhouden met China, dat doet Nederland ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Vijf jaar na grote ontvoering Boko Haram, zijn nog 112 schoolmeisjes niet vrij’

An MP asked whether the government knows the testimony of escaped Chibok schoolgirls, has contacted Nigeria on the still-missing girls, is willing to help the search, and will raise the case at the UN. The government condemns the abductions, says it has raised the issue with Nigeria since 2014, will assist if Nigeria asks, and will keep drawing attention to the case in UN and EU settings.
The Netherlands will continue to draw attention to these schoolgirls and other Boko Haram victims in the UN for as long as necessary.
Nederland blijft ook in VN-verband, zo lang als nodig is, aandacht vragen voor deze schoolmeisjes en andere slachtoffers van Boko Haram.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de mate waarin China profiteert van Europese ontwikkelingsgelden

Van Haga asks the minister whether China benefits from European development aid, citing a DAC report showing Chinese firms win a significant share of tenders and questioning the claim that Chinese firms have no access to EU aid funds. The minister answers that Chinese parties generally lack direct access to EU external-action instruments, that indirect management can allow wider participation, and that exact tender data and World Bank/ADB loan figures are provided or not centrally available.
I cannot provide the Chamber with such an overview.
Ik kan de Kamer geen dergelijk overzicht doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de voortgang van het VN-verdrag over mensenrechten en bedrijven

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether the European Commission's withdrawal from negotiating a UN treaty on business and human rights is accurate, whether the EU should participate in the October round, and whether the Netherlands would participate independently. The Minister confirmed the Commission deferred the mandate decision to the next College, explained EU concerns about the process and chair Ecuador, and said the Netherlands is reluctant to negotiate independently while pursuing an EU position and an EU action plan.
The Netherlands is reluctant to participate independently in the negotiations because of the lack of clarity about the mandate of the intergovernmental working group.
Nederland is terughoudend met zelfstandige deelname aan de onderhandelingen vanwege de onduidelijkheid over het mandaat van de intergouvernementele werkgroep.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het vervolgen, martelen en vermoorden van lesbiennes, homoseksuelen, biseksuelen, transgenders en mensen met een intersekse-conditie (LHBTI’s) in Tsjetsjenië

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the government what it has done since April 2018 to raise persecution, torture and killings of LGBTI people in Chechnya, including follow-up with Benedek, the Equal Rights Coalition, UN bodies and the question of quiet diplomacy. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the issue through the OSCE Vienna and Moscow mechanisms, the EU, the Human Rights Council and the Equal Rights Coalition, that violence has not structurally decreased, and that quiet diplomacy has no general criteria but depends on context.
The Netherlands regularly raises the gross human rights violations in Chechnya, including violence against lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans and intersex persons (LGBTI), with Russia in various ways.

Nederland brengt de grove mensenrechtenschendingen in Tsjetsjenië, waaronder het geweld tegen lesbische, homoseksuele, biseksuele, trans en intersekse personen (LHBTI's), op diverse manieren regelmatig onder de aandacht bij Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeulders en Snels over het Eerlijk Pensioenlabel

MPs Smeulders and Snels asked ministers about the Eerlijk Pensioenlabel ranking of Dutch pension funds' sustainability policies, including the methodology, the poor grades, lagging disclosure, follow-up under the IMVB convenant, and whether climate reporting should be mandatory. The government defended the pension funds' own responsibility, pointed to the IMVB convenant and existing reporting duties, declined to assess the study's methodology, and said the sector would be given time to improve before any further regulation.
It is not for the government to assess the methodology of the research, nor to assess the outcomes of the research or come up with alternative grades.
Het is niet aan de overheid om de methodologie van het onderzoek te beoordelen, noch om de uitkomsten van het onderzoek te beoordelen of met alternatieve rapportcijfers te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Van den Berg en Van Helvert over het voornemen van Italië om zich aan te sluiten bij het Chinese Belt and Road investeringsprogramma

CDA MPs asked the government about Italy's planned accession to China's Belt and Road Initiative, its effect on EU unity, Dutch firms and EU screening of Chinese investment. The minister answered that Italy's MoU is a non-binding intention, that EU rules remain fully applicable, that the EU investment screening regulation was being finalised, and that the government would address China in a forthcoming note.
At this moment it is not possible to make an estimate of this.
Op dit moment is het niet mogelijk hiervan een inschatting te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Alkaya over maatschappelijk verantwoord investeren door levensverzekeraars en andere institutionele beleggers

MPs Karabulut and Alkaya asked whether Minister Kaag discussed the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights with insurers, whether she raised arms trade investment, and whether stricter monitoring is warranted. The minister answered that the talks covered controversial weapons within the IMVO insurance covenant, that a working group will develop due diligence questions, and that tightening the covenant is not currently warranted.
Additional agreements on monitoring the application of the UNGPs do not seem appropriate so soon after the covenant was signed.
Aanvullende afspraken met betrekking tot de monitoring van de toepassing van de UNGP's liggen zo kort na de ondertekening van het convenant niet voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over doorvoer van munitie naar de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten

An SP MP asked the minister whether transit of about 57 million 9mm cartridges from Czechia through the Netherlands to the UAE, despite the Netherlands' tightened policy on Yemen-involved states, was permitted without Dutch review and how it passed EU criteria. The minister answered that transit without transhipment from an ally is not licensable in the Netherlands, so Dutch authorities did not assess it, that Dutch policy would likely have blocked a comparable shipment, and that the government will press EU partners to adopt similar restrictions.
Transit shipments without transhipment originating from an ally are however not subject to a licence requirement, so responsibility for the assessment is not assigned to the Netherlands.
Doorvoerzendingen zonder overlading afkomstig van een bondgenoot zijn echter niet vergunningplichtig, waardoor de verantwoordelijkheid voor de toetsing niet bij Nederland is belegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de uitvoer van 57 miljoen kogelpatronen aan de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten

An MP asked the minister about 57 million cartridges transported via the Netherlands to the UAE, a country in the Yemen conflict, and why Parliament was not informed of the transit. The minister replied that transit without transhipment by an EU/NATO+ ally needs no Dutch licence, that the Czech authorities licensed the shipment, that Parliament was not informed because no Dutch licence existed, and that the Netherlands has urged other states to adopt its stricter policy.
Since this shipment does not require a licence in the Netherlands, Dutch export control authorities issued no licence. For that reason, Parliament was not informed.
Aangezien deze zending in Nederland niet vergunningplichtig is hebben de Nederlandse exportcontroleautoriteiten geen vergunning verstrekt. Om die reden is de Kamer niet geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul, Ploumen, Karabulut, Van Ojik en Sjoerdsma over de krimpende bewegingsruimte, democratische vrijheden en veiligheid van mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël

MPs from several parties asked the ministers about threats to human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, including an Israeli UN envoy's insult to B'Tselem, a law affecting Breaking the Silence, and the deportation order against Human Rights Watch's Omar Shakir. The government answered that it shares concern about intimidation and shrinking civic space, has protested at the UN and bilaterally, and will keep raising the issues with Israeli and Palestinian authorities together with the EU.

The government, together with the EU, is concerned about the increasing pressure on human rights organisations and defenders in Israel, partly caused by bills that restrict the space of civil society organisations.

Het kabinet is, samen met de EU, bezorgd over de toenemende druk op mensenrechtenorganisaties en -verdedigers in Israël, mede veroorzaakt door wetsvoorstellen die de ruimte van maatschappelijke organisaties beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg, De Roon en Markuszower over de financiering van een aanval op onafhankelijke Israëlische rechtspraak

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch government financed a critical B'Tselem report on Israel's High Court and whether this undermines judicial independence. The minister answered that the EUR 176,000 grant was given under a strategic plan with B'Tselem setting its own research aims and conclusions, that Nederland did not steer the report, and that it does not regard the funding as undermining judicial independence.
There has been no substantive steering by the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake geweest van inhoudelijke sturing door Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over spanningen tussen Pakistan en India

An MP asked the foreign and trade ministers whether the Netherlands had responded to the India-Pakistan clashes over Kashmir, what would end the conflict, whether Dutch arms exports to both countries should be halted, and whether the tensions justify action on nuclear weapons. The ministers replied that the Netherlands and the EU called for de-escalation, that arms exports are assessed case by case without a moratorium or embargo, and that they would not sign the nuclear weapons ban treaty.
The Netherlands voted against the text of the nuclear weapons ban treaty.
Nederland heeft tegen de tekst van het kernwapenverbodsverdrag gestemd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Moorlag over het bericht ‘Kritiek op Booking.com om aanbieden van bedden in Israëlische nederzettingen’

MPs Van den Hul and Moorlag asked the government whether Booking.com's listing of accommodations in Israeli settlements contributes to rights violations, whether the company meets the UN Guiding Principles, and what sanctions apply to misleading information. The government answered that businesses bear their own responsibility under OECD guidelines, that the ACM supervises misleading-practice rules, and that Booking.com has committed to labelling settlement accommodations as 'Israeli settlement'.
It is up to companies themselves to decide which activities they undertake and to account for them.
Het is aan bedrijven zelf om te bepalen welke activiteiten zij ontplooien en daar verantwoording over af te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over toeristische bedrijven die verdienen aan illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

An MP asked the government whether it condemns online booking firms such as Booking.com, Airbnb, Expedia and TripAdvisor for offering accommodation in Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory, and whether it would discourage such trade and ban settlement goods. The ministers answered that companies are responsible for their own human rights due diligence, that the government does not support import bans on settlement goods, and that it discourages economic ties with settlement businesses while Booking.com has agreed to label settlement listings.
The cabinet, in line with the EU, is not in favour of an import ban on goods from settlements or measures leading to a boycott of these goods.
Het kabinet is, in lijn met de EU, geen voorstander van een importverbod van goederen uit nederzettingen of maatregelen die leiden tot een boycot van deze goederen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over banden tussen BDS en terroristen

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked the government about alleged links between BDS organisations and Palestinian terrorists, whether Dutch subsidies could indirectly fund such organisations, and about an Amnesty campaign urging tourism platforms to boycott Israeli settlement businesses. The government rejected the general claims, said subsidy procedures and sanctions are adequate, maintained its opposition to BDS and its policy of not funding BDS-promoting activities, and referred to the company's own responsibility under international CSR norms.
Funds from both the Netherlands and the EU are only provided once careful selection procedures have been completed.
Fondsen van zowel Nederland als de EU worden pas verstrekt zodra zorgvuldige selectieprocedures zijn doorlopen.
Antwoord op ragen van het lid Ouwehand over de Week zonder vlees

MP Ouwehand asked the government about the Dutch 'Week zonder vlees' campaign, including whether ministries will promote it, whether meat externalities should be priced, and whether plant-based protein should be a trade and development priority. The answer, given by Minister Schouten on behalf of several ministers, refers the MP to earlier written answers (Aanhangsel Handelingen 1896) and does not engage the substance of the questions.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2019Z03355, on a week without meat, have been answered by means of Aanhangsel Handelingen, parliamentary year 2018–2019, no. 1896.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD), vraagnummer 2019Z03355 , inzake een week zonder vlees, zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr. 1896 .
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Futselaar over het bericht dat via CETA er gemanipuleerd voedsel de markt op komt

SP MPs Alkaya and Futselaar asked whether gene-edited (CRISPR-Cas) apples from outside the EU can enter the European market while EU farmers are supposedly barred from using the method, and whether CETA guarantees that EU food standards are respected. The minister answers that imports must meet EU GMO and food safety rules, that the CJEU ruling applies GMO rules to new breeding techniques, that CETA does not change EU standards, and that import controls may be adapted with EU-level discussions ongoing.
All exports from Canada to the EU must comply with EU standards, including EU rules on genetic modification and food safety.
Alle export van Canada naar de EU moet voldoen aan EU-standaarden, waaronder EU-regelgeving op het terrein van genetische modificatie en voedselveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het ontslag van textielarbeiders in Bangladesh

An MP asked the minister whether H&M and Zara suppliers in Bangladesh dismissed thousands of textile workers after protests, what buyers should do, and how the government responded to the protests and crackdown. The minister answered that H&M suppliers did dismiss workers while Zara's did not appear to, that buyers should seek reversal or compensation if dismissals were wrongful, that the embassy sought clarification on police and employer conduct, and that she hopes to meet her Bangladeshi counterpart.
The cabinet takes these signals seriously and has asked the government for clarification.
Het kabinet neemt deze signalen serieus en heeft opheldering gevraagd bij de overheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en van Haga over de berichten ‘Limburg genoemd als locatie voor megadistributiecentrum van Chinese webwinkelreus Alibaba’ en 'Rutte wil Alibaba binnenhalen, maar douane is e-com

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the growing role of online retail, the possible Alibaba distribution centre in the Benelux, cross-border goods flows, customs and product-safety gaps for non-EU online sellers. The government answered that data on cross-border flows is largely unavailable, customs and market supervisors already control non-EU imports, and it is pushing in EU negotiations for an EU-based contact point for third-country online sellers.
No figures are known on this, and well-founded estimates cannot be given.
Hierover zijn geen cijfers bekend, en goed onderbouwde schattingen zijn niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over Duitse wetgeving ten aanzien van bindende ketenverantwoordelijkheid

An MP asked the minister about reported German draft legislation on mandatory supply-chain due diligence, whether the government knew of it, and what it means for Dutch firms and EU-level harmonisation. The minister said the draft was an internal German document not previously known to her, that the Netherlands prefers a harmonised European approach, and that Dutch firms are assessed against voluntary OECD guidelines with a 2023 target, without committing to new legislation.
The cabinet advocates a European approach to International Responsible Business Conduct (IRBC).
Het kabinet pleit voor een Europese aanpak voor Internationaal Maatschappelijk Verantwoord Ondernemen (IMVO).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat het Duitse handelsministerie wetgeving voorbereidt die Duitse bedrijven tot gepaste zorgvuldigheid verplicht

An SP MP asked whether the government would prepare binding due diligence legislation like Germany's if voluntary IMVO covenants fail, and whether it would make covenants generally binding. The minister answered that the coalition agreement keeps the covenants, an evaluation starts in autumn 2019, and options including binding measures are being studied, while no legal basis yet exists for declaring covenants generally binding.
