In the autumn of this year an evaluation of the covenant policy will be started.
In het najaar van dit jaar zal een evaluatie van het convenantenbeleid worden gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht 'Bendes stropen Oeganda af om vrouwen genitaal te verminken'

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers about reports of female genital mutilation in eastern Uganda, its rising numbers, and the government's response with the Ugandan authorities, UNFPA, Equality Now, Reach and a trade mission. The ministers answered that the government takes the reports seriously, is engaged with Ugandan authorities, UNFPA and NGOs, and will brief trade mission participants on responsible business including eastern Uganda.
The cabinet takes the reporting, on the practice of genital mutilation as well as the cited numbers of girls and women, very seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de berichtgeving, over de praktijk van genitale verminking maar ook over de genoemde aantallen meisjes en vrouwen, zeer serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de humanitaire crisis in Venezuela en de erkenning van Juan Guaidó als interim-president

An MP from D66 asked the government about the humanitarian crisis in Venezuela, aid channels, the recognition of Juan Guaidó, and support to Caribbean parts of the Kingdom. The ministers answered that aid is limited without Maduro's cooperation, outlined Dutch contributions via UN and Red Cross channels, and announced in principle that Curaçao may serve as a logistics hub for humanitarian aid.
The Netherlands continues to press Venezuela to make this possible.
Nederland blijft er op aandringen dat Venezuela dit mogelijk maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het vervolgen, martelen en vermoorden van LHBTI’s in Tsjetsjenië

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the ministers whether they condemn the persecution, torture and killing of LGBTI people in Chechnya, how they will act toward Russia, and what diplomatic steps are taken. The minister answered that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the issue bilaterally and in the EU, OSCE, Council of Europe and Equal Rights Coalition, and will bring it to the UN Human Rights Council, while keeping some diplomatic steps non-public.
For effective influence, the Netherlands and like-minded countries will also need to use quiet diplomacy, where it is crucial that steps are taken outside the public domain.
Ten behoeve van effectieve beïnvloeding zullen Nederland en gelijkgezinden ook gebruik moeten maken van stille diplomatie, waarbij het cruciaal is dat stappen worden gezet buiten het publieke domein.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over bancaire investeringen in fossiele energie

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked whether banks should speed up green investment, how the government monitors fossil versus renewable financing, and whether a complaint was filed with the OECD National Contact Point over bank human rights concerns in oil and gas. The minister said DNB monitors financial sector exposure to CO2-intensive sectors, the sector committed to measuring and reporting CO2 emissions from 2020, no OECD complaint has been filed, and an oil and gas value chain analysis under the banking IMVO covenant is in preparation.
No, following the Eerlijke Bankwijzer research no complaint has been filed with the National Contact Point (NCP) for the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Nee, er is naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van de Eerlijke Bankwijzer geen klacht ingediend bij het Nationaal Contact Punt (NCP) voor de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over mogelijke sancties van de VS op Nederlandse bedrijven

MPs Amhaouch and Agnes Mulder asked the government whether it was informed about possible US sanctions on Dutch firms involved in Nord Stream 2 and what it would do to protect them. The minister answered that the government is in regular contact with the US and EU, raises concerns about disproportionate impact, rules out a Special Purpose Vehicle for now, but gives no concrete commitments beyond continued advocacy.
The Netherlands will nevertheless continue to actively raise its concerns bilaterally and within the EU, including about the consequences for Dutch business.
Nederland blijft in bilateraal en EU-verband evenwel actief zijn zorgen onder de aandacht brengen, inclusief over de gevolgen voor het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over de veroordeling in Egypte van Amal Fathy

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the government about the conviction in Egypt of women's rights defender Amal Fathy and whether it would press for her release and a presidential pardon. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands follows the case closely, has raised concerns bilaterally and within EU channels, will keep doing so, and that Fathy can still appeal to the Court of Cassation or seek a pardon, but did not commit to specific further steps beyond consultation with EU partners.
It is not for the ministry to provide information about this.
Het is niet aan het ministerie om hierover informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over het bericht dat Japan zich terugtrekt uit de internationale walvisvaartcommissie

The MP Wassenberg asked the government whether it shares concern about Japan's withdrawal from the International Whaling Commission, what consequences it has for relations and the trade agreement's sustainability chapter, and whether the government will raise the matter with Japan, summon its ambassador, or seek EU pressure or sanctions. The government answered that it regrets the decision, raised it with Prime Minister Abe, notes the sustainability chapter allows annual dialogue, and sees no EU sanctions basis since Japan is acting within its rights.
Japan has also indicated it will only hunt in its own territorial sea and exclusive economic zone, whereby Japan does not violate international agreements.
Japan heeft tevens aangegeven enkel nog in hun eigen Territoriale Zee en Exclusieve Economische Zone te zullen jagen, waarmee Japan geen internationale afspraken schendt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ouwehand over de toespraak van Greta Thunberg tijdens de COP24 in Katowice

An MP asks the minister whether the government bears responsibility for climate policy and how it responds to Greta Thunberg's COP24 speech, including whether it will change its growth and trade stance and its own ministry's practices. The government answer, given jointly by several ministers, states the cabinet's climate commitments and says the questions were answered in an appendix to the parliamentary record.
The written questions from MP Ouwehand (PvdD), question number 2018Z24287, have been answered by means of Parliamentary Proceedings appendix 1305, session 2018–2019.
Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Ouwehand (PvdD) vraagnummer 2018Z24287 , zijn beantwoord middels Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2018–2019, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Europese wapens in handen van jihadisten in Jemen

Karabulut (SP) asks whether European arms supplied to Saudi Arabia and the UAE have ended up with jihadists in Yemen, whether EU export criteria bar supply where terrorist diversion is a risk, and whether the minister will push for independent investigation. Minister Kaag says the government has no own evidence of such diversion but cannot rule it out, points to the EU criterion on terrorist end-users, and says violations are investigated by UN bodies that the Netherlands will alert.
The Netherlands will draw the attention of both bodies to the reporting.
Nederland zal beiden instanties op de berichtgeving attenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Karabulut, Ploumen, Voordewind en Sjoerdsma over de repressie tegen Nicaraguaanse ngo’s

MPs from five parties asked the Dutch foreign and development ministers about Nicaragua's dissolution of NGOs including CENIDH, police raids on NGOs and the Confidencial newsroom, seizure of Dutch-funded assets, and the anti-terror law 977 used against civil society. The ministers confirmed the raids and seizures, said Nederland raised the issue with the Nicaraguan ambassador and within the EU, and shared the concern that civil society is under pressure.
The Netherlands will continue to closely monitor the situation and, where possible, including within the EU, continue to speak out against repression in Nicaragua.
Nederland zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en waar mogelijk zich, onder meer in EU-verband, blijven uitspreken tegen onderdrukking in Nicaragua.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over een malversatie in een Nederlands ontwikkelingsprogramma in Tanzania

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about a proven embezzlement in a Dutch-funded infrastructure programme in Tanzania, including why it was detected late, recovery of damages, prior cases and remaining Dutch projects. The minister answered that the programme's installations are being completed under an action plan with partial recovery, that the Tanzanian anti-corruption investigation is ongoing, and that the Dutch government has no bilateral programmes there but still has thematic ones.
Parliament is informed in an annex to the departmental annual report about proven cases of embezzlement and the sanctions imposed.
Het parlement wordt in een bijlage bij het departementale jaarverslag geïnformeerd over bewezen gevallen van malversaties en de daarbij getroffen sancties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over kinderarbeid en niet betalen van minimumlonen bij Nederlandse en in Nederland actieve zaadbedrijven die in India actief zijn

MP Voordewind asks the minister about child labour and non-payment of minimum wages at Dutch seed companies operating in India, citing a 2018 Landelijke India Werkgroep report, and asks about sector convenants, grievance mechanisms, living wage support and whether companies will be held to account. Minister Kaag answers that the government expects companies to follow OECD guidelines and monitor risks, has raised child labour bilaterally, has discussed a sector convenant that the sector declined in favour of its own OECD-based approach, and points to funding and ILO projects while leaving most follow-up to dialogue with the sector.
The cabinet expects companies operating in or from the Netherlands to conduct business in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Het kabinet verwacht van bedrijven die in of vanuit Nederland opereren dat zij ondernemen volgens de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik en Bouali over gedwongen huwelijken van vrouwen uit Myanmar in China

MPs Kuik and Bouali asked the minister about a John Hopkins/KWAT study on forced marriages of women and girls from Myanmar in China, Dutch support for victim protection, and whether Dutch aid and diplomacy address trafficking. The minister described the study's estimates as hard to verify, listed Dutch-funded projects in Kachin and China, and said the issue will be raised in the next human rights dialogue with China.
The Netherlands will raise the issue during the next round of the bilateral human rights dialogue with China.
Nederland zal de kwestie ter sprake brengen tijdens de eerstvolgende ronde van de bilaterale mensenrechtendialoog met China
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Bosman over de modernisering van de ODA-definitie en de toerekening van hulp voor de Nederlandse Bovenwindse eilanden aan ODA

MPs Van Haga and Bosman asked whether the UK's push to count disaster aid to richer territories as ODA could apply to the Dutch Caribbean islands, and why the Netherlands opposed the UK proposal. The minister answered that Saba, Sint Eustatius and Sint Maarten cannot count as ODA because they are not on the DAC list, and that the Netherlands opposes raising the income threshold while DAC support for the UK proposal is negligible.
Saba and Sint Eustatius are, as special municipalities, part of the Dutch state.
Saba en Sint-Eustatius zijn – als bijzondere gemeenten – onderdeel van de staat Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Haga over de felle kritiek van de Europese Rekenkamer op het EU-noodfonds voor Afrika

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the European Court of Auditors' criticism of the EU emergency trust fund for Africa, including its lack of focus, weak implementation, difficulty measuring results, Dutch contributions and complementarity with bilateral efforts. The minister acknowledged the criticism, pointed to planned focus shifts, monitoring and a 2019 evaluation, reported results and a Dutch contribution of EUR 26.4 million, and described coordination with EU partners.
The cabinet will urge the European Commission to apply these recommendations as well as possible.
Het kabinet zal er bij de Europese Commissie op aandringen dat deze aanbevelingen zo goed als mogelijk worden toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het feit dat er in Frankrijk een verbod is op reclame voor apotheken

An MP asked the government about France's ban on advertising by pharmacies and whether it creates a barrier to the EU internal market, and whether the Netherlands will submit input to a pending Court of Justice case and examine other internal-market barriers. The government said it will submit written observations to the Court because of the broader interest in a complete digital internal market, and committed to pursuing better enforcement of internal-market rules.
Because of the broader interest in ensuring a complete internal (digital) market, the Dutch government will submit written observations.
Vanwege het bredere belang van het verzekeren van een volledige interne (digitale) markt zal de Nederlandse regering schriftelijke opmerkingen indienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de investeringen van Nederlandse levensverzekeraars in wapenbedrijven die aan Saoedi-Arabië leveren

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Dutch life insurers investing in arms makers supplying Saudi Arabia, used in Yemen, conflicts with Dutch arms export policy and the insurers' covenant on responsible business, and whether the government will act to restrict such investments. The minister answered that insurers decide their own investments under OECD and UN guidelines, that no EU sanctions apply to Saudi Arabia, and that the government will continue talks with the insurers under the covenant, which sets a two-year deadline for controversial arms trade frameworks.
Insurers in principle decide for themselves in which companies to invest.
Verzekeraars bepalen in principe zelf in welke bedrijven belegd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over doorvoer van militaire goederen via Schiphol en anderen Nederlandse havens

The MP asks whether the government expects companies exporting or transiting dual-use and military goods to apply due diligence and to inform authorities of human rights risks. The minister answers that export licences check for military end use and human rights violations, that companies with global licences need an approved compliance programme, and that there is no general duty to report human rights risks to authorities.
A general obligation to inform authorities about possible human rights violations does not as such exist.
Een algemene verplichting om autoriteiten over mogelijke mensenrechtenschendingen te informeren bestaat als zodanig niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over export van 'dual use'-goederen en wapens naar Saudi-Arabië

An MP asks the government about Dutch exports of dual-use goods and weapons to Saudi Arabia, including whether 94 contracts worth 136 million euro are valid and whether the goods could be used in Yemen or for internal repression. The ministers answer that about 88 valid licences exist (133 million euro), that goods are civilian end-use, that military exports are now effectively presumed denied, and they list all licences issued since January 2016.
Following the latest report of the Group of Eminent Experts, the Cabinet decided to further tighten the arms export policy.
Naar aanleiding van het meest recente rapport van de Group of Eminent Experts, heeft het Kabinet besloten het wapenexportbeleid verder aan te scherpen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over doorvoer van militaire goederen via Schiphol en andere Nederlandse havens

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs, Trade, Finance and Justice about fines on airlines at Schiphol for illegally transporting strategic goods, prosecution figures, Customs capacity and procedures, and an alleged shipment of Dagaie missile defence parts to Saudi Arabia. The government answered that courts have fined some transporters since 2013 but that OM does not register such cases by sector, that Customs stopped 19 military shipments to Saudi Arabia since 2014 (two illegal exports found), that the current enforcement approach has been policy since 2013, and that carriers are legally obliged to assist Customs.

It is not possible to provide an overview of convictions by sector (such as transport companies) or an overview of the number of investigations per year, because the illegal transit of military goods is not registered as such in the OM's systems.

Het is niet mogelijk een overzicht te geven van veroordelingen per branche (zoals die van vervoersbedrijven) dan wel een overzicht van het aantal onderzoeken per jaar, omdat het illegaal doorvoeren van militaire goederen niet als zodanig wordt geregistreerd in de systemen van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Nederland Shell aan gaswinst helpt in straatarm Mozambique

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Dutch support helps Shell pursue gas profits in Mozambique, covering aid amounts, export credit insurance, transparency, land rights and a tax treaty. The minister replied that no Dutch development money benefits Shell, that OECD guidelines apply to Dutch firms, that export credit policy is published, and that the tax treaty is meant to fight avoidance, while answering most points on substance.
There are no indications that Shell in Mozambique acts in violation of the OECD guidelines and that land rights are being violated.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat Shell in Mozambique handelt in strijd met de OESO-richtlijnen en landrechten geschonden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het stelselmatig martelen van critici door de Palestijnse autoriteiten

An MP asked the government about HRW's findings that Palestinian security services systematically torture critics, and what Dutch and EU responses would be. The minister acknowledged the serious concerns, described diplomatic pressure, support for a national anti-torture mechanism, and continued but conditional donor support.
The Netherlands will closely follow this investigation, jointly with the EU and other donors.
Nederland zal dit onderzoek nauwgezet volgen, gezamenlijk met de EU en andere donoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Nijboer over het bericht dat Nederlandse grootbanken miljarden uitleenden aan bedrijven die betrokken zijn bij ernstige mensenrechtenschendingen

MPs Van den Hul and Nijboer asked the Finance and Foreign Trade ministers whether Dutch banks lend billions to firms implicated in serious human rights abuses, and what rules and enforcement apply. The government answered that banks must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and UN principles, that complaints go to bank grievance mechanisms or the National Contact Point, and that enforcement under the IMVO banking covenant relies on joint monitoring and voluntary dialogue rather than sanctions.
Banks generally do not inform third parties about the amount and conditions under which they agree financing with individual clients.
Banken informeren doorgaans geen derde partijen over de omvang en voorwaarden waaronder zij financiering met individuele klanten overeenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul, Bouali, Ouwehand en Stoffer over hongerlonen en schendingen van arbeidsrechten in H&M’s productieketen

MPs asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report on starvation wages and labour-rights violations in H&M's supply chain in Bulgaria, including whether H&M would be held to account, whether the textile covenant targets are slipping, whether the government will discuss freedom of association with covenant parties, and the state of a roadmap to extend covenants internationally. The minister said living wages are a human right, that H&M bears responsibility and should act and that she is willing to talk with H&M, pointed to covenant activities on living wages and union freedom and to ongoing EU-level IMVO coalition-building, but declined a separate meeting on union freedom.
I am willing to discuss this with H&M.
Ik ben bereid hierover in gesprek te gaan met H&M.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de Nederlandse en de Europese inzet in het kader van het VN-verdrag over mensenrechten en het bedrijfsleven

An MP from the SP asked the minister about the Dutch and EU role in the fourth UN negotiating round on a binding business and human rights treaty, including whether the EU was absent when conclusions were adopted, the status of an EU non-paper, and the UNGPs as basis. The minister explained the EU spoke on behalf of member states, that the EU distanced itself from the chair's conclusions, declined to share the non-paper as internal and confidential, and criticised the zero draft's scope and vagueness.
The EEAS indicated it regards the non-paper as an internal and confidential document, for which reason it is not attached to this reply.
De EDEO heeft aangegeven het non-paper als een intern en vertrouwelijk stuk te zien, om die reden wordt het niet bijgevoegd in deze beantwoording.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Amhaouch over toename import in de EU van legbatterijeieren

Two MPs from the CDA asked the ministers how much egg and egg-product imports into the EU have risen, whether imported eggs meet EU animal welfare standards, and what is being done about Ukraine's laying-hen housing and chicken fillet imports. The minister replied that imports must meet EU health and labelling rules but not EU production standards, that trade agreements contain limited welfare provisions, and that Ukraine has a phased implementation plan through 2021 which the Netherlands will keep pressing.
Products imported into the EU generally do not have to meet EU production requirements, such as housing systems and animal welfare standards, unless agreements have been made with third countries.

Door de EU geïmporteerde producten hoeven in het algemeen niet te voldoen aan productie-eisen van de EU, als houderijsystemen en dierenwelzijnsstandaarden, tenzij er met derde landen afspraken over zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over de levering van uit Nederland afkomstige wapens en patrouilleboten aan (para)militaire entiteiten in Libië

An MP asked whether arms and patrol boats supplied by Damen Shipyards to Libyan (para)military entities complied with the UN and EU embargoes, whether export licences were required, and how the ML list was applied to the boats' mountings. The minister answered that the deliveries were non-licensable under the then-applicable embargoes, that no licences were issued for military goods to Libya since 2011, that the ministry required prior contact from Damen after finding the boats were later armed, and that the generic mountings do not fall under the ML list.
In July 2016 the ministry contacted Damen and expressed concern about the arming of these ships.
Het ministerie heeft in juli 2016 contact gehad met Damen en zorg uitgesproken over de bewapening van deze schepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het bericht dat Tanzania het investeringsverdrag met Nederland opzegt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Tanzania's termination of its bilateral investment treaty with the Netherlands, including the reasons, ISDS protection for public-interest regulation, a most-favoured-nation clause, and whether the treaty was mutually beneficial. The minister replied that Tanzania gave no reason for termination, that the right to regulate is protected in both developing and developed countries, that the new model BIT clarifies this, and that Tanzania has requested a modern treaty with formal negotiations pending EU authorisation.
No reason was given for the termination.
Voor de opzegging is geen reden opgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de uitsluiting van maatschappelijke organisaties door de Pakistaanse overheid

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about Pakistan's refusal to re-register eighteen civil society organisations, including ActionAid and Plan, and what the Netherlands would do about shrinking civic space and GSP+ leverage. The minister answered that the government is in contact with the four Dutch-linked organisations, has raised the issue bilaterally and in EU channels, and will use GSP+ monitoring, but could not yet confirm whether the organisations may re-register.
Until these talks have taken place, it is too early to confirm whether the affected civil society organisations will be eligible for new registration within the sixty days.

Totdat deze gesprekken hebben plaatsgevonden, is het te vroeg om te kunnen bevestigen of gedupeerde maatschappelijke organisaties binnen de zestig dagen in aanmerking komen voor een nieuwe registratie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over het bericht 'Khashoggi vermoord op last koningshuis'

Ploumen asked whether the government had verified reports that journalist Khashoggi was killed on orders of the Saudi royal household, whether it had contacted Turkish and European counterparts, and whether a planned trade mission to Saudi Arabia would be postponed. The government answered that it contacted Turkey, that the EU and E3 called on Saudi Arabia to cooperate, and referred to letters of 18 and 30 October 2018 for its full position, without giving a substantive answer on the Saudi trade mission or the consequences for relations.
For a comprehensive cabinet appraisal, I refer the House to the letter on policy towards Saudi Arabia dated 18 October 2018.
Voor een uitgebreide kabinetsappreciatie, verwijs ik uw Kamer naar de Kamerbrief «Beleid ten aanzien van Saoedi-Arabië», dd. 18 oktober 2018
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Alkaya over het stopzetten van het Bangladesh Akkoord voor Brand- en Gebouwveiligheid in Bangladesh

Two MPs asked the minister why the Bangladesh Accord on fire and building safety may end on 30 November 2018 despite the assumed continuation to 2020, and what Dutch government and industry can do to keep it running and protect union freedom. The minister says diplomatic pressure, a joint EU/US/Canada letter, a planned personal push in Bangladesh, ILO capacity support and a call on the textile sector to act are aimed at keeping the Accord operational.
I will personally push the government of Bangladesh on this, both before and during my trip to Bangladesh in November.
Ik zal mij hier persoonlijk voor inzetten bij de overheid van Bangladesh, zowel voorafgaand aan als tijdens mijn reis naar Bangladesh in november.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over maatregelen van Duitsland, Frankrijk en het Verenigd Koninkrijk om Amerikaanse secundaire sancties te omzeilen

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked the minister about the German, French and British plan for a special purpose vehicle to circumvent US secondary sanctions on Iran, including Dutch participation and effectiveness for Dutch firms. The minister answered that the Netherlands supports and will join the technical work and possibly the SPV later, but that it is not a solution for firms active in the US market, leaving business decisions to companies.
If well elaborated, the Netherlands will in due course participate in the SPV to be set up.
Indien goed uitgewerkt zal Nederland t.z.t. participeren in de op te zetten SPV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over handel met illegale Israëlische nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

Karabulut (SP) asked how large trade with illegal Israeli settlements is, by product and over time, and whether the government would seek clarification from Israel where data is lacking. The government replied that neither it nor the European Commission has figures quantifying such trade, Israel does not keep them, and it points to EU origin rules, customs checks and NVWA labelling enforcement instead.
Neither the cabinet nor the European Commission has figures quantifying trade with illegal Israeli settlements in the occupied Palestinian territory.
Antwoord 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 en 6 Zowel het kabinet als de Europese Commissie 1 beschikken niet over cijfers die de handel met illegale Israëlische nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied kwantificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over wapenleveranties aan Oekraïne

MP Karabulut (SP) asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about US lethal weapons deliveries to Ukraine, their compatibility with the Minsk agreements, and Dutch arms export policy and past exports to Ukraine. The ministers answered that the conflict must be solved politically, that Ukraine has a legitimate security need, that exports are assessed case by case against the EU criteria, and listed Dutch export licences and refusals.
Since 2004 the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has published every month a detailed overview of all licences issued for military goods and dual-use goods with military end use.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken publiceert sinds 2004 elke maand een gedetailleerd overzicht van alle afgegeven vergunningen voor militaire goederen en dual-use goederen met militair eindgebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Nederlandse financiële stromen naar Nicaragua

Karabulut (SP) asked whether FMO's loan to Nicaraguan bank BanPro and the export credit insurance for two Damen patrol vessels to Nicaragua fit Dutch positions on the Nicaraguan human rights crisis, and what risk assessment applies. Minister Kaag answers that the loan is a private-sector investment, the insurance was granted under the policy then in force, Dutch cooperation with the Nicaraguan government is suspended, and export credit cover for Nicaragua has since been suspended.
For details on specific investments I am happy to refer you to FMO.
Voor details over specifieke investeringen verwijs ik u graag door naar FMO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kooten-Arissen over het bericht dat Japan de commerciële walvisjacht weer wil invoeren

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked ministers about Japan's bid to lift the ban on commercial whaling at the IWC, the government's position and efforts against it, and whether the EU-Japan trade agreement contains binding whaling and dolphin-hunting commitments. The minister answered that the Netherlands opposed Japan's proposal and actively lobbied against it, described its wider conservation efforts, and said the trade deal only allows partners to raise compliance with environmental agreements, with no specific whaling conditions beyond that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de brute werkwijze van de Libische kustwacht jegens bootvluchtelingen

An MP asked the minister whether Libyan coast guard units abandoned three boat migrants at sea and destroyed their boat, whether the EU funds this conduct, and what safeguards exist. The minister could not confirm the incident, said the coast guard does not systematically act brutally, and described monitoring mechanisms and efforts to improve detention centres.
On the basis of our information, it therefore cannot be concluded that the incident actually took place.
Op basis van onze inlichtingen kan dus niet geconcludeerd worden dat het incident ook daadwerkelijk heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Ojik en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Escalatie President Guatemala weert corruptie-aanklager VN’

MPs asked the ministers about Guatemala's refusal to renew the UN anti-corruption commission CICIG and about the government's response, protection of human rights defenders, and intimidation of NGOs. The ministers said they regret the non-renewal, cite Dutch funding, EU statements and the Shelter City programme, and promised continued monitoring and raising of the issue with Guatemalan authorities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will continue to closely monitor the situation and keep raising it with the Guatemalan government.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal de situatie nauwlettend blijven volgen en blijven aankaarten bij de Guatemalteekse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Van den Hul, Ploumen, Van Ojik en Van Raan over het bericht dat de VS alle hulp aan UNRWA stopt

MPs asked the government how it views the US decision to halt all funding to UNRWA, and whether it will press Washington, increase its own contribution, and address the wider political consequences. The government regrets the US decision, says it opposes politicising humanitarian aid, pledges to raise the issue with the US and other donors, and keeps its existing 13 million euro annual contribution while deferring any extra funding to year-end review.
As usual, at the end of the year the cabinet will assess, within existing humanitarian aid agreements, which additional Dutch contributions based on the humanitarian imperative are desirable.

Zoals gebruikelijk beoordeelt het kabinet aan het einde van het jaar binnen de bestaande afspraken over humanitaire hulp welke aanvullende Nederlandse bijdragen op basis van het humanitair imperatief wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuik, Omtzigt en Voordewind over de berichtgeving dat hulpgelden niet terechtkomen bij yezidi’s en christenen

MPs Kuik, Omtzigt and Voordewind asked the minister whether EU and Dutch aid reaches Yazidis and Christians in northern Iraq, how EU funds are controlled, and what is being done to free abducted Yazidi women and children. The minister disputed the reports, described Dutch and EU humanitarian funding and partner-vetting mechanisms, and gave overviews of projects, while pointing to the Iraqi government for inclusive governance and promising a country strategy and an annual letter on EU external financing.
Based on the GNI distribution key, the Dutch share of this contribution is approximately 4.7%.
Op basis van de BNI-verdeelsleutel is het Nederlandse aandeel in deze bijdrage circa 4,7%.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over ‘Supermarkten doen te weinig tegen uitbuiting van boeren in ontwikkelingslanden’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch supermarkets should do more to stop exploitation of farmers in developing countries, and whether farmer incomes have fallen. The government replied that the IMVO covenant for the food sector addresses these risks, that its evaluation is due in late 2019, and that it will report yearly to parliament on the covenant.
Oxfam's findings will be discussed by the parties to the IMVO covenant for the food sector, including the government, in the steering group and relevant working groups.
De bevindingen van Oxfam zullen door de partijen van het IMVO-convenant van de voedingsmiddelensector – waaronder de overheid – in de stuurgroep en relevante werkgroepen worden besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Palmolieproducent verstopt ‘foute’ plantage in schaduwbedrijf en maskeert ontbossing'

MPs Diks and Van der Lee asked whether palm oil firms use shadow companies to hide deforestation and whether rules and enforcement should be tightened. The Minister answered that the matter is largely for producer countries to regulate, that Dutch industry commitments are the key lever, and that existing certification and forest governance efforts continue.
Adjusting the legislation on this is up to these countries themselves and is currently no reason to tighten laws in the Netherlands or Europe.
Aanpassing van de wetgeving daar omtrent is aan deze landen zelf, en vormt nu geen reden om de wet- en regelgeving in Nederland of Europa aan te scherpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het handelsverkeer tussen de EU en Westelijke Sahara

An MP asked whether EU trade arrangements with Morocco extended to Western Sahara can proceed without consent from the Sahrawi people, whether the Commission genuinely consulted them given the Court of Justice ruling, and about a salt shipment entering duty-preferentially. The minister replied that the Commission took all reasonable steps to consult the population, that Morocco exercises effective control so the agreement is possible, and that customs will levy duties if the salt's true origin proves to be Western Sahara.
If these investigations show that the actual origin of the salt is not Morocco but, for example, Western Sahara, the relevant import duty will nevertheless be levied.
Als uit deze onderzoeken volgt dat de feitelijke oorsprong van het zout niet Marokko is maar bijvoorbeeld de Westelijke Sahara, zal het betreffende invoerrecht alsnog worden geheven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Helvert over het beëindigen van vluchten naar Teheran door KLM en de gevolgen van Amerikaanse secundaire sancties

MPs Amhaouch and Van Helvert asked whether KLM's halt of Tehran flights and the US secondary sanctions on Iran are related, and what the sanctions mean for Dutch firms. The ministers answered that KLM's decision was commercial, that Dutch firms face reputational, financial and legal risks from extraterritorial US sanctions, and that the Netherlands opposes such extraterritoriality while the EU has adopted countermeasures.
The Dutch government is not involved in internal considerations and motives regarding the business operations of Dutch companies.
De Nederlandse overheid is niet betrokken bij interne overwegingen en beweegredenen t.a.v. bedrijfsvoering van het Nederlandse bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het wangedrag van hulpverleners in Afrika

An MP asked the minister about aid workers allegedly trading medicines for sex with prostitutes in Africa, a reported blacklist targeting whistleblowers, and progress on the sector's action plan against misconduct. The minister condemned such conduct, said she knew of no whistleblower blacklist, described integrity-system improvements and a planned autumn progress report, and gave outcomes for Médecins Sans Frontières-Holland's cases.
As promised during the debate with your House on misconduct in the aid sector of 13 June, I will report on the progress made on the action plan in the autumn.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het debat met uw Kamer over misstanden in de hulpsector van 13 juni jl., zal ik in het najaar rapporteren over de geboekte voortgang van het actieplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over de tweede tranche van de Turkijedeal

SP MPs asked the government about a second tranche of the EU-Turkey deal, including a reported 50 million euro Dutch contribution, whether the funds would fund border control, how their use would be reported, and whether Turkey had been challenged over reports of shootings at the Syrian border. The minister said the first 2 billion euro is funded from the EU budget with no national request yet, that FRIT projects target refugees' living conditions under Commission reporting and Dutch committee seat, and that the Commission could not confirm the shooting reports, though it monitors the situation.
As often exchanged with your House, projects are financed from the Facility for Refugees in Turkey (FRIT) to further improve the situation of refugees in Turkey and the communities hosting them.

Antwoord 4, 6 Zoals vaker met uw Kamer gewisseld 2 , worden vanuit de Faciliteit voor vluchtelingen in Turkije (FRIT) projecten gefinancierd om de situatie van vluchtelingen in Turkije en de gemeenschappen die hen opvangen verder te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Van den Hul over het tekort van de VN voor vluchtelingenopvang in de regio

MPs Asscher and Van den Hul asked the government about the UN funding shortfall for Syrian refugee support in the region, Jordanian schools, employment for refugees (including women), the rules of origin, and whether denying aid workers access can be a war crime. Minister Kaag answered that Nederland commits EUR 400 million over four years, contributes to education and job programmes, supports EU flexibilisation of the rules of origin, and that the Wet Internationale Misdrijven now covers starvation and blocking aid in non-international armed conflicts.
The cabinet will allocate at least EUR 400 million over the next four years to improve prospects for refugees and host communities in the Syria region.
Het kabinet trekt de komende vier jaar ten minste EUR 400 miljoen uit voor de verbetering van de perspectieven van vluchtelingen en gastgemeenschappen in de Syrië regio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bereiken van de allerarmsten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether development policy should explicitly target the poorest and how results would be measured across gender, location, age and income. The minister answered that the SDGs guide policy, fragility and conflict are a main focus, and that results are reported via existing indicators, though disaggregating data further would be too burdensome.

Further breakdown of data and indicators would place a disproportionate burden on people and resources, because much of this data is hardly or not at all available worldwide and the number of indicators would rise sharply.

Verdergaande uitsplitsing van data en indicatoren zou een onevenredig beslag leggen op mensen en middelen, omdat veel van deze data wereldwijd niet of nauwelijks beschikbaar zijn en het aantal indicatoren sterk zou stijgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Ten Broeke en Van der Staaij over de brief van de Hoge Vertegenwoordiger van de EU Federica Mogherini aan de Israëlische minister van Strategische Zaken Gilad Erdan

MPs asked the government about an EU High Representative letter to Israeli minister Erdan and reports that a Palestinian NGO, Ma'an Development Center, employed a man allegedly linked to the PFLP, and whether Dutch funds reached it and whether NGO funding policy should change. The government answered that the man worked on a project basis and not in permanent employment, that it has no independent evidence of the alleged affiliation, that its selection criteria are adequate and it would act if subsidy conditions were breached, and that no policy revision is currently needed.
Revision of the Dutch policy towards NGOs is currently not on the agenda.
Herziening van het Nederlandse beleid ten aanzien van NGO's is op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de afspraken tussen de EU en de VS over de toekomstige handelsrelatie

Member Becker (VVD) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Juncker-Trump agreement on EU-US trade relations, including tariff reduction, WTO reform, China, steel and aluminium tariffs, and EU tariff levels. The minister answered that the agreement (industrial tariff and non-tariff barrier reduction, energy cooperation, standards dialogue, WTO reform) is a constructive step, that a high-level working group will elaborate it, and that EU and US tariff levels are comparable.
A high-level working group will be set up to further elaborate and concretise this common agenda in the coming months.
Een high-level werkgroep zal worden opgericht om deze gemeenschappelijke agenda in de komende maanden nader uit te werken en te concretiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Kuik en Voordewind over de opvang van Venezolanen in Colombia

MPs Bouali, Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister about the number of Venezuelan refugees in Colombia and neighbouring countries, Dutch contributions and support, and the situation of women and girls forced into prostitution. The minister replied with estimates of roughly 600,000 to 700,000 (UNHCR: about 1 million) Venezuelans in Colombia, a EUR 500,000 unearmarked contribution, and general statements on monitoring vulnerable groups, while stating that further support depends on priorities and available funds.
The cabinet is concerned about the humanitarian crisis in Venezuela and its consequences for the region, and will continue to closely monitor the situation.
Het kabinet is bezorgd over de humanitaire crisis in Venezuela en de gevolgen voor de regio, en blijft de situatie nauwlettend volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘The summon of Feminist and Woman Human Right Defender Mozn Hassan to investigation within the Context of the NGO Foreign Funding Case’ dd 18 juni 2

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked whether the government had raised concerns with Egypt over the summoning and questioning of human rights defender Mozn Hassan in the NGO foreign funding case, and about pressure on civil society. The ministers answered that the case is still under investigation, that concerns were raised bilaterally and at EU level, and that the embassy is monitoring it, without directly intervening in the court process.
The specific case of Mozn Hassan is still before the court, so direct political intervention is not opportune.
De specifieke zaak van Mozn Hassan is nog onder de rechter, waardoor directe politieke interventie niet opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over inhumaan optreden Franse grenspolitie jegens migrantenkinderen

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the government how it responds to reports of abuse of migrant children by French border police and whether it will raise child protection and EU burden-sharing at EU level. The State Secretary answered that the government monitors EU-acquis compliance, relies on the Commission to assess violations, and points to EU reform negotiations and existing child-specific safeguards, without committing to a new investigation.
The cabinet critically monitors both the implementation and compliance with the EU acquis, without assumptions, and uses bilateral and multilateral channels to raise our concerns where appropriate.

Het kabinet volgt, zonder aannames, zowel de implementatie als naleving van het EU-acquis kritisch, en maakt gebruik van bilaterale en multilaterale kanalen om onze zorgen, waar opportuun, over te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maeijer en Van Weerdenburg over meer dan 1 miljard euro voor het Europees solidariteitskorps

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about the EU European Solidarity Corps, its proposed expansion to 350,000 youth and over 1 billion euro, asking which organisations participate, how many Dutch youth joined, what it has cost, and whether the EU should fund it. The minister answered with figures on accredited organisations, registered Dutch participants, the 378 million euro budget under the current MFF, and said the Dutch appraisal of the new proposal will follow via a BNC-fiche.
There is no list available of organisations where young people currently participate or have participated.
Er is geen lijst beschikbaar van organisaties waar jongeren op dit moment aan deelnemen of aan deelgenomen hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'News: Open letter for the release of Human Rights Defenders in Niger'

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about arrests of human rights defenders in Niger, the closure of a television station, uranium-gate, press freedom and the Dutch embassy opening. The government answered that the EU monitors the court cases, that prisoner welfare projects exist, that it has no direct stake in uranium-gate, and that human rights can be raised in general terms.
The Netherlands and the various EU representations will continue to follow developments in this case closely.
Nederland en de verschillende EU-vertegen woordigingen blijven de ontwikkelingen van deze zaak op de voet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Alkaya over het bericht dat energiebedrijven met miljardenclaims klimaatbeleid tegenhouden

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that energy companies use multi-billion-euro claims under the Energy Charter Treaty to block climate policy, including whether Dutch letterbox firms exploit the treaty. Minister Kaag replied that the treaty gives investors limited protection, that the Netherlands opposes letterbox firms using it, and that renegotiation in 2019 will seek an explicit right for states to regulate in the public interest.
The cabinet will, among other things, advocate that letterbox companies be excluded from protection under the Energy Charter Treaty.
Het kabinet zal er daarbij onder meer voor pleiten dat brievenbusfirma’s worden uitgesloten van bescherming onder het Energiehandvestverdrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het steunen van initiatieven die onder de ambities van het Bangladesh Akkoord duiken

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the LABS fire and building safety initiative in garment factories, its relation to the Bangladesh Accord, and whether Dutch firms and the government should support the Accord and engage unions. The minister answered that the Accord was important, that LABS works in new countries with similar commitment mechanisms, that the government urges Dutch firms to join the Accord, and that IDH is engaging unions and the ILO has an advisory role.
The cabinet calls on parties to the Convenant for Sustainable Clothing and Textiles, including new signatories purchasing in Bangladesh, to support the new Bangladesh Accord.
Het kabinet roept partijen van het Convenant voor Duurzame Kleding en Textiel, inclusief nieuwe ondertekenaars die in Bangladesh inkopen, op het nieuwe Bangladesh Akkoord te steunen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat de Chinese overheid ambtenaren inzet om de Oeigoeren in Xinjiang te controleren en te indoctrineren

Dutch MP Kuzu asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade about reports that Chinese officials are staying with Uyghur families in Xinjiang to monitor and indoctrinate them, and about detention of a footballer and re-education camps, asking what the government will do and whether it will support an independent international inquiry. The government says it is seriously concerned about restrictions on religious and cultural freedoms, has raised the issue in the human rights dialogue, EU and UN channels, but declines to pursue an international investigation.
The cabinet does not consider it opportune to push for an international investigation and believes the current course is most appropriate.
Het kabinet acht het niet opportuun om op een internationaal onderzoek aan te sturen en is van mening dat de huidige koers
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de handelsmissie naar India

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about sustainable palm oil and soy promotion with India and China, whether it would be on the agenda of the India trade mission, and whether the minister would meet palm oil industry and civil society groups. The minister says current policy continues, the palm oil issue was raised with the Indian agriculture minister, and no meetings with palm oil companies or NGOs took place, though sustainability and child labour were discussed.
No talks took place with companies or civil society organisations from the palm oil sector, nor with representatives of the Round Table on Sustainable Palm Oil.
Er hebben geen gesprekken plaatsgevonden met bedrijven of maatschappelijke organisaties vanuit de palmoliesector, noch met vertegenwoordigers van de Ronde Tafel voor Duurzame Palmolie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de geheime EU-lijst van Amerikaanse producten waarop mogelijk importtarieven worden geïntroduceerd

MP Alkaya asked the minister about the secret EU list of US products that could face retaliatory import tariffs, its contents, the economic impact on the Netherlands, the Dutch role in the vote and steps to avoid the measures. The minister confirmed the draft list (cosmetics, spirits, tobacco, clothing, vessels, agricultural goods, steel), said the list was kept confidential pending US negotiations, estimated limited impact for most firms, and said the government is lobbying at high level for a permanent EU exemption.
This list is available for members of parliament to inspect in the reading room for confidential documents at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
Deze lijst is voor Kamerleden in te zien in de leesruimte voor vertrouwelijke stukken op het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Karabulut over de Nederlandse deelname aan de Iran Oil Show

MPs Beckerman and Karabulut asked whether Dutch government support for Dutch firms at the Iran Oil Show, including RVO and Dutch Energy Solutions programmes for the Iranian gas market, is consistent with Dutch climate policy, and what support is given to the oil and gas sector. The minister answered that participation is a matter for individual firms, that no direct financial aid is given, that the support is mainly embassy networking and export instruments, and that the government sees no reason to stop it.
It is up to individual companies to decide which international events they wish to attend.
Het is aan individuele bedrijven om te bepalen aan welke internationale bijeenkomsten zij willen deelnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de FMO een kolencentrale in Senegal heeft gefinancierd

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about FMO's financing of a coal power plant in Senegal, including the lack of community consultation between 2009 and 2014, pressure on the client, the complaints mechanism, compensation for residents, and how FMO's policy is enforced. The Minister acknowledged insufficient communication, said FMO has tightened its policy and publishes investment projects and complaint outcomes, and expressed confidence that FMO will follow up, while not committing to direct intervention or compensation.
FMO has committed to report publicly on the follow-up of the complaints.
FMO heeft zich gecommitteerd openbaar te rapporteren over de opvolging van de klachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over misstanden in een Colombiaanse haven

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about alleged abuses (intimidation, killings, forced resettlement, poor labour conditions, harm to fishers) linked to the TC Buen port project in Buenaventura, Colombia, financed partly by FMO, and how the government verified these claims. The minister answered that the government and FMO monitored the project, found no evidence of the alleged abuses or of TC Buen's involvement in violence, noted that the loan had been repaid, and said FMO's safeguards were adequate.
I have no indications that there is an escalation of a conflict with TC Buen and those involved.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen waaruit blijkt dat er een escalatie is van een conflict met TC Buen en betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over de betrokkenheid van de Nederlandse overheid bij de aanleg van de Corredor Centro-Norte in het Amazonegebied

An MP asked whether Dutch government involvement in the Corredor Centro-Norte in the Amazon went beyond diplomacy, given subsidised studies, a 2016 lunch meeting and alleged environmental and human rights abuses. The minister answered that Dutch involvement was limited to a funded preliminary study and knowledge exchange, that the government does not fund the corridor's development, and that responsibility for enforcement and CSR lies with Brazil and the companies.
No Dutch government money has been used for the concrete development of the Corredor Centro-Norte.
Er is geen Nederlands overheidsgeld gebruikt voor de concrete ontwikkeling van de Corredor Centro-Norte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de ebola-uitbraak in de Democratische Republiek Congo

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the 2018 Ebola outbreak in the DRC, covering case numbers, WHO funding and reforms, vaccine licensing and distribution, health systems, and whether a Dutch global health security strategy is needed. The minister answered substantively on each point, reporting case counts, funding, and vaccine rollout, and declined to commit to a new global health security strategy.
The mere fact of the recent Ebola outbreak is for me no reason for a Dutch global health (security) strategy.
Het enkele feit van de recente uitbraak van ebola vormt voor mij geen aanleiding voor een Nederlandse global health (security) strategie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Amnesty: duizenden vrouwen en meisjes verkracht door leger Nigeria’

MPs Van den Hul and Ploumen asked the Dutch government whether it knew of Amnesty's report on rape of women and girls by Nigerian soldiers in camps, and what it would do, including raising the matter at the UN Security Council and considering a thematic sanctions regime. The government said it is aware of the report, supports women's rights projects in Nigeria, will raise the allegations with the EU and in the EU-Nigeria human rights dialogue, and opposes a global thematic sanctions regime as ineffective.
Following Amnesty International's report, the EU plans to enter into dialogue with key actors in the federal government and security agencies.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport van Amnesty International is de EU van plan een dialoog aan te gaan met belangrijke actoren in de federale regering en veiligheidsagentschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raan en Ouwehand over het bericht dat het ABP 174 miljoen euro in de palmolie-industrie investeert

MPs Van Raan and Ouwehand asked whether the government finds the ABP's EUR 174 million investment in palm oil plantations in Papua, linked to rainforest clearance and human rights abuses, acceptable and whether it will press the fund to divest. The minister says the content is worrying, points to existing programmes on deforestation and land rights, and states that ABP decides its own investment policy while the government will pursue responsible-business covenants with the financial sector.
The pension fund ABP decides on its own investment policy and applies a specific responsible-investment policy.
Het pensioenfonds ABP gaat over het eigen beleggingsbeleid en hanteert specifiek beleid inzake verantwoord beleggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Voordewind, Kuik en Bouali over het bericht dat OS-ontvanger Rwanda de nieuwe shirtsponsor van voetbalclub Arsenal wordt

MPs from VVD, ChristenUnie, CDA and D66 asked the minister whether Rwanda, a development aid recipient, becoming Arsenal's shirt sponsor is consistent with aid dependency concerns and whether the government would raise this with Rwanda. The minister answered that the choice of partner is Rwanda's, that the Netherlands continues a transition relationship with bilateral aid being phased out, and that it will keep discussing the effectiveness of such tourism investments with Rwanda's development board.
The Rwanda Development Board has made no statements about the costs associated with this partnership.
De Rwanda Development Board heeft geen uitspraken gedaan over de kosten die gepaard gaan met dit partnerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over mensenrechtenschendingen in Ethiopië

An MP from the CDA asked the government about human rights violations in Ethiopia, including repression of protesters, detention and torture, the Maekelawi and Kaliti prisons, Dutch aid and dialogue, and an outdated country report used in asylum decisions. The government acknowledged serious past abuses, noted recent reforms under the new prime minister, described its diplomatic engagement, and said the updated country report would be delayed until summer 2018.
The government regrets that the country report could not be delivered on time.
De regering betreurt het dat het ambtsbericht niet tijdig kon worden aangeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over misbruik van belastinggeld door een Malinese NGO

MP Becker asked the minister about misuse of Dutch aid funds by a Malian NGO, including which NGO it was, how monitoring failed, and whether other projects will be reviewed. The minister confirmed about EUR 962,000 was misappropriated or mishandled, withheld the NGO's name because of ongoing litigation, and said existing risk management is adequate with no new review planned.
No, because the lawsuit is still ongoing. Once the judge has ruled, the name of the NGO will be made public.
Nee, omdat de rechtszaak nog loopt. Zodra de rechter een uitspraak heeft gedaan wordt de naam van de NGO openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over het bericht dat het aantal migranten dat wordt opgesloten in onmenselijke Libische detentiecentra sterk is toegenomen

Green Left MP Van Ojik asked the ministers about reports that the number of migrants detained in Libyan detention centres rose sharply, and whether Dutch support for the Libyan coastguard and alleged Italian direction amounted to unlawful pushbacks. The government replied that Libyan coastguard tasks are lawful, denied Italian direction beyond coordination, and described its efforts to improve conditions and close the centres, noting progress remains slow.
As previously shared with your House, the cabinet is working with the AU, EU and UN to improve the situation in the centres, including promoting access to medical care and food supplies.

Zoals eerder met uw Kamer gedeeld 6 , zet het kabinet zich in om samen met de AU, EU en VN de situatie in de centra te verbeteren, waaronder het bevorderen van de toegang tot medische zorg en voedselvoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat Oxfam weer in opspraak is geraakt en bonussen zou hebben uitgekeerd aan personeel verantwoordelijk voor de hulpoperatie in Haïti

MP Becker (VVD) asked whether Oxfam paid bonuses to Haiti relief staff and whether the high personnel share in a 2011 audit is normal. Minister Kaag answered that the spending split reflects project expertise, that the flagged payment was a pension gratuity for one person rather than a bonus, and that personnel policy is the organisations' own responsibility with the ministry checking against cost guidelines.
Inquiries show that no bonuses were paid by Oxfam Novib or Oxfam GB in Haiti.
Navraag leert dat er geen bonussen zijn betaald door Oxfam Novib of Oxfam GB in Haïti.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Bouali over voortdurende demonstraties in Marokko

MPs Sjoerdsma and Bouali asked the ministers about protests in Morocco, including police violence and arrests in Jerada and the Rif, and whether the government would raise these with Morocco. The ministers answered that violence and arrests had occurred, that the Dutch embassy and ministers have raised freedom of assembly and fair trial concerns with Moroccan authorities, and that Dutch programmes support socio-economic development in the north.
The right to peaceful demonstration is laid down in international human rights treaties and in the Moroccan Constitution.
Het recht op vreedzaam demonstreren is vastgelegd in internationale mensenrechtenverdragen en in de Marokkaanse Grondwet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk, Van den Hul en Dijksma over pensioenfondsen die beleggen in Aurobindo, het omstreden geneesmiddelenbedrijf, dat mensenrechten en milieuregels aan zijn laars lapt

MPs Van Dijk, Van den Hul and Dijksma asked whether pension funds investing in Aurobindo, a pharmaceutical company accused of human rights and environmental violations, should take steps, and what the government would do about ABP's investment. The minister answered that funds should follow OECD guidelines through engagement, that ABP decides its own investments and is accountable for them, and that the government is pursuing IMVO covenants with the financial sector.
No, I do not have that information, and furthermore ABP itself is responsible for its investment policy and investment choices.
Nee, die informatie heb ik niet en verder geldt dat het ABP zelf verantwoordelijk is voor het beleggingsbeleid en de beleggingskeuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijksma en Van den Hul over het bericht ‘Fabrikant van Nederlandse medicijnen buit werknemers uit en vervuilt milieu’

Two MPs asked ministers whether Aurobindo Pharma violates OECD guidelines by underpaying workers and polluting, and what they will do about it. The ministers said they expect compliance with OECD guidelines, will raise antibiotic-residue wastewater discharge through EU and GMP channels, and plan an official-level meeting with the Dutch office and talks with procurers and insurers, without confirming any violation.
A meeting at official level with the Dutch office of Aurobindo Pharma is already planned.
Een gesprek op ambtelijk niveau met het Nederlandse kantoor van Aurobindo Pharma is reeds gepland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het conflict met de Congolese regering over een mede door Nederland georganiseerde donorconferentie

Mr Becker (VVD) asked the minister about the Congolese government's objection to a donor conference co-organised by the Netherlands and what the Netherlands did to address it. The minister answered that the conference went ahead because of very large humanitarian needs, that the Congolese concerns were taken seriously through dialogue with the UN, and that Dutch aid to DRC in 2018 totals roughly EUR 10 million in direct emergency aid plus further amounts through multilateral channels.
The cabinet, the UN and the EU were of the view that the conference had to go ahead, because it concerned very large humanitarian needs of the Congolese population.
Het kabinet, de VN en de EU waren van mening dat de conferentie door moest gaan, omdat het hier ging om zeer grote humanitaire noden van de Congolese bevolking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over exportcontrole op cybersurveillancegoederen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about EU export controls on cyber-surveillance goods, the position of the Dutch government on brokering services, and the timeline of the negotiations on the dual-use regulation. The minister answered that Netherlands supports extending export controls to prevent human rights abuses, that its position on brokering is unchanged, and that negotiations are ongoing without a set end date.
The Netherlands cannot currently indicate how frequently this happens, because some cyber-surveillance goods are not yet subject to control.
Nederland kan op dit moment niet aangeven hoe frequent dit gebeurt, omdat een deel van cybersurveillancegoederen op dit moment nog niet gecontroleerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Diks, Van den Hul en Kuik over buitenlandse investeringen in Ethiopië

MPs asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about foreign investment in Ethiopia after a documentary on large-scale land grabs, and how Dutch investment, World Bank programmes and civil society support could prevent harm to people and the environment. The minister acknowledged the problems in large-scale projects, said Dutch investments are generally much smaller and that the embassy requires due diligence and IMVO compliance, and committed to pressing the World Bank on FPIC and civil society space.
Alleged violations of the OECD Guidelines can be reported to the National Contact Point for the OECD Guidelines (NCP).
Vermeende schendingen van de OESO-richtlijnen kunnen worden gemeld bij het Nationaal Contact Punt voor de OESO-richtlijnen (NCP).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over de overplaatsing van een wegens corruptie verdachte topman van Heineken in Nigeria

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether a Heineken subsidiary director in Nigeria, implicated in a corruption case, was transferred to Singapore, and whether Heineken's anti-bribery policy and Dutch support to Heineken should change. The minister confirmed the transfer report, stated that corruption is criminal under Dutch law and that OECD guidelines apply, noted small Dutch support of EUR 1.4 million to a cassava partnership, and explained that prosecution of bribery abroad depends on the circumstances.
How companies shape their anti-corruption policy is, however, up to the companies themselves.
Hoe bedrijven hun anticorruptiebeleid vormgeven is echter aan bedrijven zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya, Kuik en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Promotiemeisjes van Heineken verkopen bier met hun lichaam’

MPs Alkaya, Kuik and Voordewind asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Heineken promotion girls in Africa are subjected to sexual harassment, and about the responsibility of parent companies, legal options, and Heineken subsidies. The minister said companies must address abuses throughout their supply chain under UN and OECD guidelines, that the government lacks legal powers to compel them, that a call with Heineken's CEO produced a commitment to prioritise the issue, and that a 2019 evaluation of the IMVO covenants will determine whether legislation is needed.
The government has no legal means to compel Dutch companies to take measures in such cases.
De overheid heeft geen juridische mogelijkheden om Nederlandse bedrijven te dwingen tot het nemen van maatregelen in dergelijke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Syrische kindvluchtelingen steeds vaker niet naar school gaan door armoede

Karabulut (SP) asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that Syrian refugee children increasingly miss school due to poverty, and about work permits, school transport and book costs, donor funding, language of instruction and discrimination in the region. Minister Kaag acknowledged rising poverty, child labour and early marriage as causes, described work permit policies and donor programmes, gave funding figures, and said the cabinet will direct extra regional funds to education in the forthcoming BHOS policy note.
In the BHOS policy note that will be sent to your House soon, I will go into more detail on how the cabinet intends to give substance to this intensification.
In de BHOS-beleidsnota die uw Kamer binnenkort toegaat, zal ik nader ingaan op de manier waarop het kabinet invulling wil geven aan deze intensivering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Voordewind over een door Oxfam Novib en een Hamas-activist georganiseerde workshop

Two MPs asked whether a workshop organised with Oxfam Novib involving Abou Amin Rashed, linked by the government to Hamas-related fundraising, involved government participation or funding. The ministers answered that the event was organised by United Civilians for Peace without government involvement, that Dutch officials attended only as ordinary participants, and that government funding does not support BDS-promoting activities.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs was not involved in organising the meeting or in the invitation policy.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken is niet betrokken geweest bij de organisatie van de bijeenkomst of het uitnodigingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Maeijer over virulent antisemitisme via Palestijns persbureau

Two Dutch MPs asked the foreign and development ministers about an antisemitic opinion piece by a former Hamas figure published on the Palestinian news agency Ma'an's website, and whether Dutch or EU funding to Ma'an should end. The ministers answered that the piece was removed and Ma'an publicly distanced itself from it, so the government does not intend to seek an end to EU cooperation.
In this case, the cabinet is of the view that Ma'an News Agency acted adequately by removing the opinion piece from its website and publicly distancing itself from its content.
In dit geval is het kabinet van oordeel dat Ma'an News Agency adequaat heeft opgetreden door het bewuste opiniestuk te verwijderen van diens website en openlijk afstand te nemen van de inhoud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht dat de Nederlandse ontwikkelingsbank FMO landroof in Sierra Leone heeft gefinancierd

An MP asked whether the Dutch development bank FMO financed land grabbing in Sierra Leone, including unmet compensation promises, inadequate due diligence and its exit from the Addax project. The minister replied that FMO followed applicable standards, that Addax largely met its obligations, and that FMO's exit and complaints mechanism were in line with UN and OECD principles, while declining to expand the complaints mechanism.
I do not share the view that the complaints mechanism should be extended.
Ik deel de mening niet dat het klachtenmechanisme moet worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ploumen over ‘The Rohingya children trafficked for sex’.

An MP asked the foreign and development ministers about reports that Rohingya girls in Bangladeshi refugee camps are trafficked into sex work, what protective measures will be taken, and what concrete steps the Netherlands will take on UN calls to protect women in conflict, including a thematic sanctions regime. The ministers said the Netherlands will press Bangladesh, the UN and aid agencies for protection measures and raise the issue at the World Bank meetings, but they judged a global thematic sanctions regime unlikely to succeed and preferred adding sexual violence to country-specific sanctions regimes and using the International Criminal Court.
The Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation will attend a meeting in Washington on 21 April together with UNHCR and Bangladesh.
Zo zal de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking op 21 april in Washington samen met UNHCR en Bangladesh een bijeenkomst bijwonen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weerdenburg en De Roon over het bericht dat de Palestijnse Autoriteit voor 50 miljoen dollar een privéjet heeft aangeschaft voor Mahmoud Abbas

Two MPs asked the minister whether the Palestinian Authority bought a $50 million private jet for Abbas, whether that spending was needed, why the Netherlands rushed a 13 million euro UNRWA contribution, and whether all Dutch funding to the PA should stop. The minister confirmed a government aircraft was bought from PA and PLO funds with no Dutch or European money, defended the accelerated UNRWA payment, and rejected halting PA funding because it conflicts with the two-state goal.
No Dutch or European contributions were used for the purchase.
Er zijn geen Nederlandse of Europese bijdragen voor de aanschaf gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Veldman over het voorbereiden van de Rotterdamse haven op de Brexit

MPs Becker and Veldman asked how the government is preparing the Rotterdam port and business for a hard Brexit, and what the government is doing about it. The government answers that it shares concerns, is informing business and mapping consequences and measures with stakeholders, but leaves primary preparation responsibility with business.
The cabinet has begun informing governments, citizens and businesses about these changes.
Het kabinet is begonnen met het voorlichten van overheden, burgers en bedrijven over deze veranderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de ontwikkeling en het gebruik van ‘killer robots’

An SGP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about the development and use of 'killer robots' and the legal and ethical frameworks governing them. The government answered that meaningful human control must always be retained, that fully autonomous weapons are rejected in principle, and that existing international humanitarian law and weapons reviews under Article 36 provide the safeguards, while committing to revisit the advisory report in 2020.
According to the cabinet, people must always remain responsible and accountable for the use of weapon systems.
Volgens het kabinet moeten mensen altijd verantwoordelijk en aansprakelijk blijven voor de inzet van wapensystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de vervolging van milieuactivisten in Iran

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest on espionage charges and death in custody of Iranian environmental activists, and whether the Netherlands would press Iran for explanation, attend trials and investigate. The minister said he had no further information, that Iran had issued no official explanation, that Canada leads on the case and the EU raises detainee rights, and that the Netherlands supports human rights defenders through its fund.
Iran does not allow foreign diplomats to attend trials of Iranian citizens, even when they are dual nationals.
Iran staat niet toe dat buitenlandse diplomaten rechtszaken van Iraanse staatsburgers bijwonen, ook niet als het om bipatriden gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over de dreigende handelsoorlog tussen de Verenigde Staten en Europa

The MP asks the minister about the threatened US-EU trade war after US steel and aluminium tariffs, the size of Dutch trade exposure, and possible Dutch and EU responses. The minister answers that the EU is temporarily exempt, that trade policy is an exclusive EU competence, and that the government pursues dialogue and a permanent exemption while providing limited sector-level and legal detail.
This depends on the form and scope of the barriers.
Dit hangt af van de vorm en reikwijdte van de barrières.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Helvert over de sloop van klaslokalen in Abu a-Nawar door Israël

An MP from the CDA asked the Dutch government whether it knew of Israel's demolition of classrooms in Abu a-Nawar serving 26 Palestinian children, whether the Netherlands funded them, and what action it would take, including on compensation and on Area C demolitions in the EU. The government answered that it condemns the demolition, that the classrooms were funded by the EU and other member states rather than the Netherlands, that it will support joint EU steps including compensation if asked, and that it will keep raising Area C demolitions within the EU.
The cabinet condemns the demolition and confiscation of Palestinian property, regardless of whether it was financed by the EU or not.
Het kabinet veroordeelt de sloop en confiscatie van Palestijnse bezittingen, ongeacht of deze door de EU zijn gefinancierd of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over bewapening, corruptie, illegale bedrijfsovernames en de opkomst van extreem-rechtse paramilitaire groepen in Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Foreign Minister about US anti-tank weapons sales to Ukraine, far-right paramilitary groups such as the National Druzhyna, delays in Ukraine's anti-corruption court, and illegal corporate takeovers (raids) affecting Dutch and EU investors.
