The minister replied that the conflict must be solved politically, that the civilian Druzhyna has no state powers and is monitored, that the anti-corruption court will take time to set up, and that exact raid figures are unavailable, while support to companies is offered case by case.
It is not possible to give exact figures.
Het niet mogelijk exacte aantallen te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Leijten over nepnieuwsbestrijders van de EU die Nederlands nieuws beoordelen maar geen Nederlands spreken

SP MPs asked why the EU's EUvsdisinfo fake-news unit, which has no Dutch-speaking staff, rates Dutch news, how its volunteer numbers and €1 million budget add up, and whether the government would distance itself from it. The minister answers that the unit's Dutch-language articles were wrongly published and rectified, that the government opposes its method and has raised it with the EEAS, and that the EU Commission is not responsible for it.
No, the cabinet will therefore carry out the motion submitted by MPs Kwint and Yesilgöz-Zegerius (Parliamentary paper 21 501-34, no. 290).
Nee, het kabinet zal daarom de motie van de leden Kwint en Yesilgöz-Zegerius (Kamerstuk 21 501–34, nr. 290 ) uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen, Van Oijk en Karabulut over het bericht 'De onderkoning van Congo'

MPs Ploumen, Van Oijk and Karabulut asked about press reports on Dan Gertler, his listing on the US Magnitsky sanctions list, whether Dutch authorities investigated Fleurette Group, whether EU or Dutch sanctions are possible, and what Dutch measures exist against foreign corruption. The minister says the cabinet is concerned, is closely informed about the US investigation and sanctions, notes the EU has no Magnitsky-type regime, and describes the Dutch integrated anti-corruption approach with enforcement left to the OM and FIOD.
This matter now has the full attention of the Dutch enforcement authorities.
Deze kwestie heeft inmiddels de volledige aandacht van de Nederlandse handhavingsinstanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de Poolse wet die bepaalde uitingen over de rol van Polen in de Holocaust strafbaar stelt

Parliamentarian Voordewind asked the Foreign Minister how the Polish law criminalising statements attributing Polish complicity in Nazi crimes would affect public debate, whether the Polish ambassador and counterparts would be questioned, whether the EU Court of Justice should review it, and whether similar laws in Lithuania, Latvia and Ukraine exist. Minister Blok answered that the Netherlands has voiced concerns through the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance, will raise further clarification with Polish authorities if needed, sees no clear EU-law basis for CJEU review, and reported that Lithuania and Latvia have no comparable laws while Ukraine's 2015 decommunisation law is under amendment after Venice Commission criticism.
The cabinet will, if necessary, again contact the Polish authorities to request further clarification on the law, in addition to the concerns already expressed.
Het kabinet zal zich zo nodig opnieuw in verbinding stellen met de Poolse autoriteiten om, in aanvulling op de eerdergenoemde reeds geuite zorgen, nadere opheldering te vragen over de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Van Ojik over bedreigde mensenrechtenactivisten in Guatemala

Two GroenLinks MPs asked about threatened indigenous human rights activist Aura Lolita Chávez in Guatemala, her return risk, and Dutch efforts against corruption and attacks on activists. The ministers said the embassy supports her through a working group and funds anti-impunity and protection programmes, and that no Dutch palm oil or logging firms had contacted the embassies, though this could not be fully excluded.
Protection of human rights is a cornerstone of Dutch foreign policy.
Bescherming van mensenrechten is een hoeksteen van het Nederlands buitenlands beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht 'EU-geld vloeide naar familie Orban'

An SP MP asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about reports that EU funds flowed to Orban's family via the firm Elios, including OLAF findings of irregular tenders and fraud, and whether Hungary's response and EU sanctions are adequate. The minister said the OLAF report is not public, that Hungarian criminal investigation is ongoing so the government will not comment on the firms or persons, and pointed to Commission enforcement tools and Dutch proposals for publishing annual control reports and tougher MFF conditions.

The content of the relevant report of the European Anti-Fraud Office (OLAF) and the recommendations it contains are not public and not accessible to anyone other than the relevant Hungarian authorities.

De inhoud van het betreffende rapport van het Europees Bureau voor Fraudebestrijding (OLAF) en de daarin opgenomen aanbevelingen zijn niet openbaar en niet voor anderen dan de relevante Hongaarse autoriteiten inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de rapporten van het Amerikaanse Department of Commerce inzake de import van staal en aluminium

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade about US Commerce Department reports on steel and aluminium imports justified on national security grounds, including the effect on the Dutch sector, WTO compatibility, EU responses and consultation with industry. The minister answered that the US tariffs will hurt Dutch exporters, that the national security justification is insufficiently substantiated and a systemic risk to the WTO, and that the government is coordinating an EU three-track response and consulting industry.
The cabinet is of the view that, on the basis of the information currently available, the US invocation of national security in the report is insufficiently substantiated.
Het kabinet is van mening dat – op basis van de nu voorliggende informatie – een beroep van de VS op de nationale veiligheid in het rapport onvoldoende is onderbouwd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Leijten en Van Rooijen over het transparantie initiatief, ondertekend door 26 delegaties van commissies voor Europese aangelegenheden uit de parlementen van de lidstaten van de Eu

MPs Omtzigt, Leijten and Van Rooijen asked whether the Dutch representative handed the COSAC transparency report to the Bulgarian presidency, whether all member states received it, what comments exist, when it will be on the agenda, and whether the government has actively pushed for its proposals. The minister confirmed the handover, said the initiators were responsible for distribution, stated no comments had been made and the Council's reaction will come later, and said the government has raised the topic and will seek a suitable moment to put it on the General Affairs Council agenda.
The cabinet will endeavour to put the subject of transparency on the General Affairs Council agenda at a suitable moment, in consultation with the presidency.
Het kabinet zal zich inspannen om het onderwerp van transparantie, in samenspraak met het voorzitterschap, op een geëigend moment te agenderen voor de Raad Algemene Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de juridische basis voor militair optreden in Syrië

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the government still has a valid international-law basis for Dutch military action in Syria, given doubts about the collective self-defence claim tied to Iraq, and whether it would consult the external international-law adviser. Minister Blok replied that the legal basis of collective self-defence for Iraq still holds, though weaker than before, and declined to consult the external adviser, saying the government is sufficiently advised internally and externally.
No, I am not willing to do so because there is no need for it.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid omdat daar geen noodzaak toe bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht 'De staatsgreep van een briljant ambtenaar'

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Minister whether the appointment of Martin Selmayr as Secretary-General of the European Commission followed the rules and whether Dutch government would raise concerns about its transparency. The minister answered that the Commission says it followed all rules, that the European Parliament is examining the procedure, and that the Dutch government will not take over Parliament's role of scrutinising the Commission.
The cabinet notes that the European Parliament is currently exercising its treaty-based oversight task.
Het kabinet constateert dat het Europees parlement zijn verdragsrechtelijke controlerende taak op dit moment uitoefent.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Ouwehand over het transport –met dodelijke afloop- van 20.800 kalkoenkuikentjes per vliegtuig van Canada naar Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the transport by air from Canada to the Netherlands of 20,800 turkey chicks, about 90% of which died, was justified given animal welfare and climate impacts, and asked about inspection, enforcement and sanctions. The minister answered that air transport is allowed under IATA rules if followed, that the cause of death appears to be hypothermia, that the NVWA opened a criminal investigation and drew up a report, and that the case is ongoing so no further statements can be made.
In this specific case the matter is still ongoing and no further statements can be made.
In dit specifieke geval loopt de zaak nog en kunnen geen verdere uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Lodders over de Colombiaanse antidumpingprocedure tegen de Nederlandse aardappelsector

Two MPs asked whether Colombia's anti-dumping investigation into frozen potato products from Dutch, German and Belgian producers was procedurally and substantively sound, and whether the Netherlands would push the European Commission to take it to the WTO. The minister answered that the Netherlands shares concerns about the procedure and has lobbied Colombia and the Commission, but that a WTO case can only be brought by the Commission once definitive measures exist, with a decision expected in March 2018.
On the basis of the facts now available, the Netherlands already urged the European Commission at the trade policy committee of 16 February 2018 to seriously consider this step.
Nederland heeft er op basis van de nu voorliggende feiten in het handelspolitiek comité van 16 februari 2018 reeds bij de Europese Commissie op aangedrongen deze stap serieus te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over ‘weeshuistoerisme’ in Kenia

An MP asked the minister about orphanage tourism in Kenya, including whether the government supports NGOs linked to orphanage funding, and whether it will warn volunteers or act against such programmes. The minister answered that the government does not track volunteer numbers, does not fund orphanages as a policy goal, and relies mainly on awareness-raising and existing networks, promising only to update embassy website information.
The government has a limited role in this and does not keep figures on volunteer deployment in this area.
De overheid heeft daar een beperkte rol in en houdt geen cijfers bij over vrijwilligersinzet op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het bericht 'mining taxes’ van de Stichting Onderzoek Multinationale Ondernemingen (SOMO)

An MP from GroenLinks asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a SOMO report alleging that Rio Tinto-linked Dutch and Luxembourg conduit companies avoided large taxes in Mongolia and Canada, and asked about treaty renegotiation, anti-abuse rules, withholding taxes and conduit companies. The government answered that no treaty negotiations with Mongolia are ongoing, committed to BEPS-compliant anti-abuse provisions and to excluding conduit companies from investment-treaty protection, and said it would pursue treaty abuse firmly.
The cabinet considers it desirable that only investors carrying out substantial business activities in the Netherlands can use Dutch investment agreements.
Het kabinet vindt het wenselijk dat enkel investeerders die substantiële bedrijfsactiviteiten in Nederland verrichten, gebruik kunnen maken van Nederlandse investeringsakkoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over Noord-Koreaanse slaven die meewerken aan de bouw van Nederlandse schepen

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether Dutch ship-building supply chains use North Korean workers in conditions of exploitation, and what the government would do about the companies, the OECD guidelines and the workers. The minister acknowledged the reports, said companies bear primary responsibility under OECD due diligence, that officials contacted the companies and Poland was asked to enforce rules, and that involvement of North Korean workers is not banned under current sanctions while forced labour is.
The cabinet expects all Dutch companies to adhere to the principles of corporate social responsibility as set out, among others, in the OECD guidelines for multinational enterprises.
Het kabinet verwacht van alle Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij zich houden aan de principes van maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen zoals die onder meer zijn uitgewerkt in de OESO-richtlijnen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over Chinese gevangenen die kleding voor westerse modemerken produceren

An MP asked the minister whether Chinese prison forced labour is being used to make clothing for Western brands such as C&A and H&M, and how responsibility in the supply chain should be enforced. The minister acknowledges the concern, says companies must apply due diligence under OECD guidelines, notes the SER secretariat monitors the textile covenant, and says the government will raise systematic abuse with the ILO and EU if confirmed.
If signals from clothing companies and human rights organisations were to show systematic labour exploitation of prisoners in China, the cabinet will urgently raise this with the ILO and the EU.

Indien zou blijken uit de signalen van kledingbedrijven en mensenrechtenorganisaties dat er sprake is van systematische arbeidsuitbuiting van gevangenen in China, zal het kabinet dit met urgentie onder de aandacht van de ILO en de EU brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ‘Groeiende groep vluchtelingen uit Syrië wil terug naar huis’

MP Bisschop asked why IOM does not assist Syrian refugees who voluntarily want to return, whether asylum policy for Syria should be revised, how permits are reviewed, and what support for return is possible. The State Secretary answered that IOM's operational limits and UN considerations prevent its help, that DT&V can assist individuals, and that no policy change is planned before the new Syria country report expected in summer 2018.
On the basis of that country report I will determine whether a policy adjustment is needed.
Op basis van dat ambtsbericht zal ik bepalen of aanpassing van beleid aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bouali over de opvang van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen

An MP from D66 asked the Foreign Affairs and Development ministers about support for Venezuelan refugees, including UN aid to Colombia, the Netherlands' role, reception on the Caribbean islands, and Dutch citizens stranded in Venezuela. The minister answered that the government backs UN aid to Colombia, funds UN agencies through unearmarked contributions, sees no added value in raising the issue at the UN Security Council, and described reception arrangements and departure flights for stranded Dutch nationals.
The cabinet currently sees no added value in placing the reception of Venezuelan refugees on the agenda of the UN Security Council.
Het kabinet ziet op dit moment geen toegevoegde waarde in het agenderen van de opvang van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen in de VN Veiligheidsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over de onduidelijkheden die de EU-exportsancties met zich meebrengen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation about uncertainties in EU export sanctions against Russia, including whether the handbook and company checks are adequate, RVO's question desk, and bank due-diligence demands on SMEs. The minister replied that businesses have adequate tools, that the handbook is not outdated and will be updated as needed, that most export license applications are handled on time, and that the ministries will consult business associations and banks.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs will however contact the relevant trade associations and inquire about their experiences, with a view to possible further improvements where relevant.

Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken zal evenwel contact opnemen met de relevante brancheverenigingen en navraag doen naar hun ervaringen, met het oog op mogelijke verdere verbeteringen waar relevant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over misstanden in de Indiase kledingindustrie

An MP asked the minister about abuses against migrant women workers in Bangalore's garment industry, the slow pace of brand improvement plans, and whether the Dutch garment and textile covenant prevents such abuses. The minister answered that brands have taken steps under due diligence, that factory locations are now published, and that the covenant is being strengthened through international cooperation, while stressing its limited reach.
The cabinet expects participating companies, in line with the OECD guidelines, to start addressing the most urgent risks.
Het kabinet verwacht van de deelnemende bedrijven dat zij, conform de OESO- richtlijnen, starten met aanpak van de meest urgente risico’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Van Weerdenburg over de donorconferentie voor Irak

PVV MPs De Roon and Van Weerdenburg asked about Dutch participation and pledges at the February 2018 Iraq donor conference in Kuwait, including whether taxpayer money should go to Iraq rather than domestic needs, and whether a full list of pledges would be shared. The minister confirmed participation, cited a EUR 12 million stabilisation contribution and conditional aid, and said no full overview of pledges had been compiled, citing a roughly USD 30 billion total from the Kuwaiti chair.
No overview has been made of all the pledges made during the conference.
Er is geen overzicht gemaakt van alle toezeggingen gedaan tijdens de conferentie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht ‘Oxfam Novib: seksrapport ook in Nederland bekend’

An MP asked the minister about reports that Oxfam Novib knew of sexual misconduct by Oxfam GB staff in Haiti and whether Dutch public funds were involved and whether donors were aware. The minister confirmed Dutch money went to Oxfam GB activities, that audits found no programme fraud, and that she is reviewing the ministry's integrity requirements for NGOs while an inquiry into what the ministry knew is ongoing.
The aim is to establish what information the ministry received from Oxfam Novib at the time and what the ministry did with the information it received.
Doel is om na te gaan welke informatie het ministerie destijds heeft ontvangen van Oxfam Novib en wat het ministerie heeft gedaan met de ontvangen informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht dat Artsen zonder Grenzen medewerkers heeft ontslagen vanwege seksueel wangedrag

An MP asked the minister about MSF dismissing staff for sexual misconduct, including how many cases occurred, whether the ministry was informed, and whether aid funds would be cut or recovered. The minister said MSF has no reporting obligation to the ministry since 2016, promised to examine tightening subsidy frameworks with a zero-tolerance policy, and committed to a meeting on 6 March and to informing parliament.
MSF has had no funding relationship with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs since 2016 and therefore has no reporting obligations to the ministry.
Artsen zonder Grenzen heeft sinds 2016 geen financieringsrelatie met het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en heeft derhalve geen rapportageverplichtingen richting het ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Alkaya over het rapport '50 jaar ISDS'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about a report critical of investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS), including corporate claims via Dutch treaties, letterbox companies, and the EU-Canada/TTIP agreements. The Minister defended investment treaties as a stabilising tool, announced a modernised model BIT excluding letterbox companies and clarifying state regulatory rights, and said the government is exploring orderly termination of intra-EU BITs.
The government considers it desirable that only investors carrying out substantial business activities in the Netherlands can use Dutch investment agreements.
Het kabinet vindt het wenselijk dat enkel investeerders die substantiële bedrijfsactiviteiten in Nederland verrichten, gebruik kunnen maken van Nederlandse investeringsakkoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over Nederlandse medewerking aan Amerikaanse modernisering van Saoedische tanks

An MP asked whether Dutch firms performed work after 28 February 2017 on the US contract modernising Abrams tanks for Saudi Arabia, Australia and Kuwait, and how this fits Dutch restrictive arms-export policy toward Saudi Arabia. The minister answered that no Dutch companies performed licensable work under the contract, that customs found no licensable Dutch deliveries or support since that date, and that the Netherlands applies a strict case-by-case policy to Saudi Arabia.
Inquiries with Customs show that since 28 February 2017 there have been no licensable deliveries or technical support from the Netherlands in relation to Abrams tanks.
Navraag bij de Douane wijst uit dat er sinds 28 februari 2017 geen vergunningplichtige leveringen of technische ondersteuning vanuit Nederland in relatie tot Abrams-tanks hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Diks over het rapport «Human rights in windturbine supply chains» van ActionAid en SOMO

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government to respond to an ActionAid/SOMO report on human rights in wind turbine supply chains and whether Dutch wind park permits and subsidies require due diligence. The government acknowledged the report, said current permits lack supply-chain human rights criteria, pointed to the UN Guiding Principles and OECD guidelines, and committed to encouraging a sector IMVO covenant for wind energy without a firm binding timetable.
The cabinet encourages the wind energy sector to conclude an IMVO covenant; the government also wants to participate in that covenant itself.
Het kabinet moedigt de windenergiesector aan om een IMVO-convenant te sluiten; de overheid wil ook zelf deelnemen aan dat convenant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diks over het bericht dat Nederland een ISDS-claimparadijs is

An MP asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that the Netherlands is a hub for ISDS claims, including the role of letterbox companies, settlements, arbitrator independence and transparency. The minister says the government will seek to exclude letterbox companies from protection, pursue a modernised model treaty and a Investment Court System, and states it finds no proof of regulatory chill.
The cabinet will therefore seek to exclude letterbox companies from protection.
Het kabinet zal daarom pogen brievenbusmaatschappijen uit te sluiten van bescherming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker, Ten Broeke en Bosman over het bericht “Deal in Nederland onder de radar”

MPs Becker, Ten Broeke and Bosman asked about reports that a Dutch administration office became shareholder in a large Venezuelan oilfield, whether this breaches Venezuelan law and EU sanctions, and what risks and oversight apply. The government declined to discuss the specific case citing tax secrecy, stated the EU sanctions do not restrict oil-sector transactions, noted firms must self-check compliance, and said the OECD guidelines research by the National Contact Point will be sent to parliament before summer 2018.
Under the confidentiality obligation of Article 67 of the General State Taxes Act, individual taxpayers cannot, as is well known, be discussed.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht van artikel 67 Algemene wet inzake rijksbelastingen kan zoals bekend niet worden ingegaan op individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of Brexit for the Netherlands, focusing on a customs impact memo, customs staffing needs (500-800 extra staff), IT readiness and the timing of recruitment. The government answered that the Douane and NVWA are recruiting within existing frameworks, that analyses for internal deliberation will not be shared, and that preparations continue ahead of March 2019.
The analyses requested by your House were, however, prepared for internal deliberation and it is undesirable that they become the subject of political debate.
De door uw Kamer gevraagde analyses zijn echter opgesteld voor intern beraad en het is onwenselijk dat zij onderwerp zijn van politiek debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Snels over het belastingverdrag Nederland Malawi

MP Snels (GroenLinks) asked whether the government will ratify the 2015 Netherlands-Malawi tax treaty without reopening it, whether Malawi's requested changes are being negotiated, and whether anti-abuse provisions are adequate given an ActionAid report on treaty abuse costing Malawi USD 27.5 million. The State Secretary answered that Malawi's requested changes were not taken up, that ratification should proceed with a later amending protocol, that main purpose tests exist, and that the MLI can bring the treaty in line with BEPS.
The cabinet therefore proposed to Malawi that, as is customary, ratification of the tax treaty be completed and that negotiations on an amending protocol follow.

Derhalve heeft het kabinet in zijn reactie aan Malawi voorgesteld om, zoals gebruikelijk is, de ratificatie van het belastingverdrag af te ronden en daarnaast te gaan onderhandelen over een wijzigingsprotocol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de levering van twee Fokker 70-toestellen die in het bezit van de luchtmacht van Myanmar zijn gekomen

Karabulut (SP) asked whether two Fokker 70 aircraft sold by KLM Cityhopper and acquired by Air KBZ had ended up with Myanmar's air force, and whether export permits were granted and the aircraft should be reclaimed under the arms embargo. The ministers answered that KLM sold the planes to a Singapore company, they were converted to VIP aircraft and are leased to Myanmar's government, no export permit was needed for civil aircraft, and that leasing civil aircraft to the air force falls outside the EU arms embargo even on a strict reading.
The Netherlands advocates strict compliance with the EU arms embargo against Myanmar.
Nederland pleit voor strikte naleving van het EU-wapenembargo ten aanzien van Myanmar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch, Geurts en Omtzigt over de economische consequenties van de Brexit voor Nederland

Three CDA MPs asked the government about the economic consequences of a hard Brexit for the Netherlands, including the KPMG report on non-tariff trade barriers, planned actions, customs and inspection capacity, and information provision to businesses. The government answered that it is intensifying business information, hiring extra customs and NVWA staff, and that the cost of a hard Brexit is estimated at about 1.2% of GDP, while stressing that the EU-UK arrangements are still under negotiation.
The precise effect on employment is difficult to estimate, because trade can also shift to other countries and new jobs can therefore also arise.
Het precieze effect op de werkgelegenheid is moeilijk in te schatten, omdat handel zich ook kan verplaatsten naar andere landen en er dus ook weer nieuwe banen kunnen ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Becker en Kuik over het naar voren halen van de Nederlandse bijdrage aan UNRWA

MPs Voordewind, Becker and Kuik asked why the Netherlands should fill budget gaps at UNRWA caused by the US funding freeze, and about effects on Israel, the PA, other donors and future funding. Minister Kaag answered that the Dutch annual contribution of EUR 13 million was brought forward to address an acute liquidity problem, not to replace US money, and that the government will reassess later in the year without a commitment to top up.
The cabinet decided to make the planned annual contribution to UNRWA available early to mitigate an acute financing problem and give UNRWA the chance and time to find other donors.

Het kabinet heeft besloten de geplande jaarbijdrage voor UNRWA versneld beschikbaar te stellen om een acuut financieringsprobleem te mitigeren en UNRWA de kans en tijd te geven om andere donoren te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over de resultaten van het kledingconvenant

An SP MP asked the minister about the first annual report of the Dutch garment and textile covenant, including worker benefits, due diligence self-evaluations, market share, government action, and comparisons with binding laws abroad. The minister answered that important steps were taken, that much remains to be done, that the government will monitor progress, and that the covenant policy will be evaluated before deciding on binding measures.
The cabinet has no precise information on that.
Het kabinet heeft daar geen precieze informatie over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de voortgang van het kledingconvenant en het tekortschieten van de verbeterplannen van kledingbedrijven

MP Voordewind asked the minister about slow progress under the textile covenant, low participation by clothing firms, and weak improvement plans on child labour, living wages and supply-chain transparency. The minister replied that the 18% and 17% figures were aggregate self-assessment answers rather than shares of firms, that nearly all 57 firms submitted plans, and that the government will evaluate the covenant approach in two years.
The coalition agreement states that the cabinet will evaluate the IMVO covenant policy in two years and decide on that basis whether and which additional (binding) measures are needed.
In het regeerakkoord staat dat het kabinet het IMVO-convenantenbeleid over twee jaar zal evalueren, en op basis daarvan besluiten of en welke aanvullende (dwingende) maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het doel van 3FM Serious Request, het herenigen van ouders en vermiste kinderen na een ramp of conflict

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of the Red Cross Restoring Family Links work to reunite families and missing children after disasters and conflicts, how the government supports it, whether it will put prevention of child disappearance on the EU and UN agenda, and how it reduces the vulnerability of young migrants in Europe. The government answered that it funds the ICRC and UNHCR, supports family reunification projects, pushes for child protection in the UN Global Compacts, and works on child trafficking via EMPACT, without new binding commitments.
The Netherlands works to trace missing persons, restore contact with family and make reunification possible.
Nederland zet zich in om vermiste personen op te sporen, contacten met familie te herstellen en hereniging mogelijk te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over de steun aan het Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat en de samenwerking met de Women’s Affairs Technical Committee

MPs asked why the Dutch government ended funding for the Women's Affairs Technical Committee after it refused to distance itself from a youth centre named after a convicted terrorist, and why the Human Rights and International Humanitarian Law Secretariat still lists WATC and touts its advocacy against Israel. The ministers answered that donors ended the partnership after WATC refused to distance itself from glorifying violence, that the last payment was in May 2017, that the website figures were adjusted, and that support for Israeli and Palestinian human rights organisations will continue under review.
The cabinet considers glorifying violence simply unacceptable and expects all its partners to keep well away from it.
Het kabinet acht het verheerlijken van geweld simpelweg onacceptabel en verwacht van al zijn partners dat zij zich hier verre van houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Diks, Van den Hul en Van der Staaij over de waarschuwing van Unicef over de zorgwekkende situatie van 8,5 miljoen kinderen in Syrië en omliggende landen

Four MPs asked the ministers about UNICEF's warning on 8.5 million children in Syria and neighbouring countries, including emergency aid, action on Eastern Ghouta, the position of children in peace talks, and renewal of UN Security Council resolution 2165. The ministers answered that the Netherlands has contributed substantial humanitarian funds, pushes for humanitarian access and medical evacuations in the ISSG, and will prioritise child protection and cross-border aid during its 2018 Security Council seat.
The Netherlands raises the worrying situation weekly in the International Syria Support Group and will also work in the UN Security Council in 2018 to improve the situation.
Nederland zet zich wekelijks in de ISSG (International Syria Support Group) in om de zorgwekkende situatie aan de kaak te stellen en zal zich in 2018 ook in de VN Veiligheidsraad ervoor inzetten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker over het bericht ‘EU-exportsancties Rusland te onduidelijk’

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that EU export sanctions on Russia are unclear for businesses, including rising exports, information access for SMEs, end-user checks, payment channels, outdated guidance and licence processing times. The minister replied that information is adequately provided via RVO's sanctions desk, handbooks and apps, that the handbook is still correct, and that over 90% of licence applications in 2016 and 2017 were handled on time, while committing to continue improving guidance.
The cabinet aims to process licence applications within the statutory time limit.
Het kabinet streeft er naar de vergunningaanvragen binnen de doorlooptijd af te handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Van den Hul over de mogelijke Amerikaanse import van jachttrofeeën uit Afrika

Two Dutch PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether they knew of reports that the US planned to lift its ban on elephant trophy imports from Zimbabwe and Zambia, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister confirmed awareness, noted Trump had reportedly suspended the plan, and said the Netherlands keeps its own import ban and will raise illegal wildlife trade at EU and CITES level, without committing to specific country-level action.
In European and global CITES settings, the Netherlands will continue to call for adequate measures to combat illegal trade in wildlife products.
In Europees en mondiaal CITES-verband zal Nederland aandacht blijven vragen voor adequate maatregelen om illegale handel in wildlife producten tegen te gaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over reddingsmissies op zee

Two SP MPs asked the government whether Libya is unsafe for refugees, whether EU support for the Libyan coast guard makes the EU complicit in returns, and about rescue NGOs, corruption and an alleged Italian intelligence infiltration of a Save the Children ship. The government agreed Libya is unsafe, said it works with UNHCR and IOM on conditions and voluntary return, defended EU training with vetting, said rescued persons fall under Libyan jurisdiction, and declined to comment on foreign investigations.
The Netherlands cannot provide information about foreign investigations.
Nederland kan geen informatie verstrekken over buitenlandse onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Leijten over de gaslobby

MPs Beckerman and Leijten asked ministers about gas-industry lobbying, Shell's role at Rotterdam School of Management, government access for Shell, gas infrastructure overcapacity, EU lobbying transparency, and methane emissions. The ministers answered that universities set curricula, Shell has the same access as other firms, network investments follow public consultation and regulator review, existing lobbying rules need no change, and a methane letter will follow by Q2 2018.
There is no reason to amend the existing rules and regulations on lobbying.
Er is geen aanleiding om de bestaande regels en voorschriften met betrekking tot lobbyen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat maatschappelijke organisaties zich terug trekken uit onderhandelingen over voedingsmiddelenconvenant

MP Hijink asked about NGOs withdrawing from negotiations on the food sector covenant, the choice of trade associations as signatories, transparency, and whether the covenant approach is succeeding. Minister Kaag answered that trade associations sign on behalf of members to bind the whole sector, that monitoring is ongoing, and that after two years it will be assessed whether binding measures are needed.
As stated in the coalition agreement, after two years it will be examined whether binding measures are necessary and, if so, which measures.
Zoals aangegeven in het regeerakkoord, zal na twee jaar worden bezien of het noodzakelijk is om dwingende maatregelen te nemen en zo ja, welke maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ploumen en Van den Hul over het bericht 'Geweld tegen Rohingya: 'Massaslachtingen met honderden doden''

MPs Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the ministers about reports of mass killings and possible ethnic cleansing of Rohingya by the Myanmar army, including sexual violence, and about psychosocial aid and UN Security Council sanctions. The government expressed serious concern, called for cooperation with the UN Fact Finding Mission and humanitarian access, outlined funding for sexual violence support, and said thematic sanctions face substantial resistance in the Security Council.
The cabinet is seriously concerned about reports of human rights violations by the Myanmar army against Rohingya in Rakhine State.
Het kabinet maakt zich ernstige zorgen over berichten over mensenrechtenschendingen door het Myanmarese leger tegen Rohingya in Rakhine State
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat miljoenen aan hulpgelden ebola-crisis zijn verdwenen

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether millions in Ebola relief funds, including Red Cross money, had disappeared through fraud and what would be done. The minister answered that about 6 million Swiss francs via the IFRC was lost or misused, that only about 27,000 euros of Dutch donations was improperly spent, that IFRC has tightened controls and will pursue recovery, and that misuse will not be tolerated.
The ministry has a zero-tolerance policy regarding embezzlement.
Het ministerie heeft een zero-tolerance beleid met betrekking tot malversaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yesilgöz-Zegerius over het bericht dat de blokkade bij Jemen volgens de VN catastrofale gevolgen heeft

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Saudi-led blockade of Yemen, which the UN says threatens famine, a cholera crisis and humanitarian aid delivery. The minister confirms the severe humanitarian impact, describes Dutch aid of about 23 million euros and EU advocacy, and says the Panel of Experts report on the blockade's legality is due at the end of December.
The Netherlands will continue to closely follow developments and is in frequent contact with humanitarian organisations about the impact of the Saudi blockade.
Nederland zal de ontwikkelingen nauwgezet blijven volgen en heeft veelvuldig contact met humanitaire organisaties over de impact van de Saoedische blokkade.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Hijink en Karabulut over het bericht ‘Corrupte constructies: Shell in het nauw’

SP MPs asked the minister about a Vrij Nederland report on Shell's purchase of Nigerian oil block OPL 245 via a corrupt intermediary, questioning Shell's conduct, the alternative payment structure, and calling for corporate human rights rules and prosecution. The minister declined substantive comment because the OM and FIOD are investigating, pointed to Dutch integrated anti-corruption policy and the existing binding anti-bribery law, and said prosecution decisions rest with investigators and the prosecutor.
While this investigation is ongoing, no substantive response will be given.
Lopende dit onderzoek zal niet inhoudelijk worden gereageerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Becker over het bericht ‘Oekraïne wil tafeleieren naar Europa brengen’

MPs Lodders and Becker asked whether Ukrainian table eggs will soon be exported to the EU and whether they meet EU animal welfare and food safety standards. The minister answered that an EU-approved exporter exists, that Ukraine is phasing in EU standards by 2021 under the association agreement, and that EU egg import quotas leave the Dutch and EU producers largely unaffected.
The cabinet will continue to keep itself informed of progress.
Het kabinet zal zich blijvend op de hoogte laten stellen van de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van den Hul over het voortdurende conflict in Congo dat bij het uitblijven van hulp de komende maanden de levens kan eisen van duizenden kinderen

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the worsening humanitarian crisis in the DRC and what the Netherlands would do about the funding gap, its role in aid and diplomacy, whether forgotten crises would be considered in country prioritisation, whether protracted conflict drives migration, and the role of mining. The minister answered that the Netherlands is in close contact with the UN and Congolese government, has contributed funds and will attend a donor meeting, is reviewing its country policy with forgotten crises in mind, and describes the mining sector as both revenue and conflict driver.
The cabinet will take so-called forgotten crises, such as the crisis in the DRC, into account in that consideration.
Het kabinet zal zogeheten vergeten crises, zoals de crisis in de DRC, meenemen in die overweging.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hartsuiker over het bericht 'Kabinet zet nieuwe stap op weg naar Nota Ruimte over inrichting Nederland' en het artikel 'Kabinet plant grootschalige woonwijken bij vier Nederlandse steden'

An MP asked why Zuidoost-Drenthe was assigned the 'versterken' label rather than 'initiëren' despite the Nedersaksenlijn investment, and what the new regional large-scale housing label entails. The minister answered that the region lacks the basis for large-scale development (universities, high urbanisation, international infrastructure), so it stays under 'versterken' while the Nedersaksenlijn offers an impulse to be concretised with the province, and explained the two types of large-scale housing locations and their financial support.
Zuidoost-Drenthe does not fall under 'initiëren' because the basis for large-scale development, which we expect under the 'initiëren' strategy, is insufficiently present.
Zuidoost-Drenthe valt niet onder «initiëren», omdat de basis voor een grootschalige ontwikkeling, die we verwachten bij de strategie «initiëren», onvoldoende aanwezig is.
